`AGENTS.md`:

```md
# Jidr (جذر): rules for AI coding agents

Jidr is an open-source Genymotion Desktop alternative in Rust with one-click rooted Android devices. These are the rules an agent (and any contributor) follows when changing it. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) has the human-facing version with setup steps. Product and architecture decisions are in [docs/decisions/log.md](docs/decisions/log.md) (cited as `D<n>`) and the ADRs next to it. Don't change a decision as a side effect of other work: propose it in an issue first.

## Architecture in one paragraph

`jidr daemon` owns all device state and drives the AOSP emulator (gRPC `EmulatorController`, the telnet console, `adb`). The GUI (`apps/jidr-gui`), the CLI (`apps/jidr`) and the MCP server (`jidr mcp`) are thin clients over JSON-RPC 2.0 / NDJSON on a Unix socket. Every user action is a protocol command; UI-only view state (window size, zoom, panel layout) stays in the GUI. Providers (`jidr-daemon` core, `jidr-widgets`, `jidr-root`) register commands through the `CommandProvider` trait in `jidr-core`.

## Repository map

| Path | Contents | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/jidr-core` | model, error codes, protocol types, the `CommandProvider` trait | Apache-2.0 |
| `crates/jidr-proto` | gRPC code from the emulator's `emulator_controller.proto` / `snapshot_service.proto` | Apache-2.0 |
| `crates/jidr-adb` | wraps the `adb` binary | Apache-2.0 |
| `crates/jidr-sdk` | SDK discovery and install, license consent, AVDs, hardware profiles, download cache | Apache-2.0 |
| `crates/jidr-backend` | `Backend` trait and the AOSP emulator backend (launch, ports, boot wait, console, gRPC) | Apache-2.0 |
| `crates/jidr-daemon` | command registry, JSON-RPC server, jobs, events, locks | Apache-2.0 |
| `crates/jidr-client` | protocol client used by the CLI, the GUI and MCP | Apache-2.0 |
| `crates/jidr-mcp` | MCP server | Apache-2.0 |
| `crates/jidr-widgets` | provider for sensors, phone, network, GPS, dev tools, media, snapshots | Apache-2.0 |
| `crates/jidr-cpio` | ramdisk cpio and gz/lz4/xz codecs | Apache-2.0 |
| `crates/jidr-root` | provider for root modes (adb, Magisk, verify, revert, build props) | Apache-2.0 |
| `crates/jidr-ui` | Slint GUI library | **GPL-3.0-only** |
| `apps/jidr` | the `jidr` binary: CLI, `daemon` and `mcp` subcommands | Apache-2.0 |
| `apps/jidr-gui` | the GUI binary | **GPL-3.0-only** |
| `xtask` | `ci`, `license-check`, `e2e-mac`, `release` | Apache-2.0 |
| `skills/` | agent skills (`skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, D43), checked by `cargo xtask skills-check` | Apache-2.0 |
| `site/` | the jidr.ly site (Astro, not in the Cargo workspace) | Apache-2.0 |
| `docs/design/` | design tokens (`tokens.json`, the single source for app and site), CSS and component specs | — |

Dependency versions live in the root `[workspace.dependencies]`; crates use `foo.workspace = true`.

## Licensing (D18)

- Apache-2.0 everywhere except `crates/jidr-ui` and `apps/jidr-gui`, which are GPL-3.0-only because they link Slint.
- The CLI, the daemon, MCP and every other Apache crate must never depend on Slint or the GUI crates. `cargo xtask license-check` (part of `cargo xtask ci`) enforces this.

## Clean-room rules (non-negotiable)

See [docs/clean-room.md](docs/clean-room.md). In short: use only Genymotion's public docs and the public AOSP emulator protos and docs, plus behaviour you observe by running the SDK tools. Never decompile, string-dump or inspect Genymotion binaries. Never copy GPL code (Magisk, rootAVD); you may read their scripts to learn the documented ramdisk layout. Never bundle Google SDK binaries, system images or Magisk. No Google, Android or Genymotion logos. Log any non-obvious source in the clean-room file.

## Code rules

- Rust edition 2024, toolchain pinned in `rust-toolchain.toml`.
- Never crash: `unwrap`, `expect`, `panic!`, `todo!`, `unimplemented!` and `dbg!` are denied outside tests (workspace lints and `clippy.toml`). Return typed errors (`jidr_core::JidrError`). Integration-test files (`tests/*.rs`) start with `#![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]`, because clippy's test allowance only covers `#[test]` fns and `#[cfg(test)]` modules.
- `unsafe` is denied by default. A crate that truly needs it allows it locally with a comment explaining why.
- Every bug fix gets a regression test.
- Emulators launch with `-gpu host` on macOS (ADR-0001: `auto` falls back to software rendering under `-no-window`); CI on Linux KVM uses `swiftshader_indirect`.
- Android Studio's SDK and AVDs are read-only (D3). Jidr's own SDK lives in `~/Library/Application Support/Jidr/sdk`. Tests create AVDs in temp dirs, never in `~/.android/avd`.
- Never accept a Google SDK license on a user's behalf outside a test context.

## Tests

- `cargo nextest run -p <crate>` runs unit and integration tests offline. `jidr_daemon::testing::TestDaemon` gives a daemon with a fake backend and a fake SDK.
- Tests that need a running emulator sit behind each crate's `emulator` feature (`cargo nextest run -p <crate> --features emulator`). They read:
  - `JIDR_TEST_SDK`: the SDK root (default `~/Library/Android/sdk`, used read-only);
  - `JIDR_TEST_IMAGE`: the sdkmanager package of the image (default on Apple Silicon `system-images;android-31;google_apis;arm64-v8a`);
  - `JIDR_TEST_API`: its API level.
- On a pull request, CI runs the emulator tests on Linux KVM with x86_64 images (API 30, 33 and 35). `cargo xtask e2e-mac` is the arm64 release gate on an Apple Silicon Mac (D28).

## Protocol

The control protocol is frozen at the tag `protocol-v0.1` ([docs/control-protocol.md](docs/control-protocol.md)). Any change to the wire format, an existing command's params or result, error codes or event topics needs a row in that file's changelog. New commands from providers are additive. The generated command reference is kept in sync by `cargo nextest run -p jidr-daemon protocol_doc` (`JIDR_UPDATE_DOCS=1` rewrites it).

## Before you open a pull request

1. `cargo xtask ci` passes: fmt, clippy, tests, the licence check and the skills check.
2. If you touched a crate with emulator tests, run them for that crate if you have an image.
3. Docs that describe the change are updated (`docs/cli.md`, `docs/mcp.md`, `docs/root.md`, the protocol changelog, and `skills/` when a command an agent uses changes).
4. One conventional commit per logical change (`feat(daemon): …`, `fix(widgets): …`, `docs: …`). Release notes are generated from them.
5. Never push to `main`; open a pull request. Don't push or publish anything without the maintainer asking.

## Useful commands

```bash
cargo xtask ci                                   # fmt, clippy, tests, license-check, skills-check
cargo xtask license-check                        # D18 split-licensing guard
cargo xtask skills-check                         # skills' frontmatter and jidr commands (D43)
cargo nextest run -p <crate>                     # unit + integration tests
cargo nextest run -p <crate> --features emulator # needs an emulator image
cargo xtask e2e-mac                              # release gate on Apple Silicon (D28)
cd site && npm ci && npm run build               # the site
```

`CONTRIBUTING.md`:

```md
# Contributing to Jidr

Thanks for helping. Bug reports, fixes, features and docs are all welcome. This page covers setting up, the rules the code follows, and how a change gets merged.

## Before you start

- **Bugs:** open an issue with your macOS version, Mac model, the Android image (for example `35:google_apis`), the command or steps, and what you saw. `jidr --json …` output and the daemon log help.
- **Features:** check the issues labelled [`upcoming feature`](https://github.com/AbdurahmanAlmehdi/jidr/labels/upcoming%20feature) first, then open an issue to agree on the approach before writing a large change.
- **Security issues:** don't open a public issue; follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Setup

You need an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 14 or later for the app and the arm64 emulator tests. The CLI, the daemon and the offline tests also build on Linux.

```bash
brew install protobuf                     # protoc, for the gRPC bindings
curl https://sh.rustup.rs -sSf | sh       # rustup installs the pinned toolchain on first build
cargo install cargo-nextest --locked      # the test runner
git clone https://github.com/AbdurahmanAlmehdi/jidr && cd jidr
cargo xtask ci                            # fmt, clippy, tests, licence check, skills check
```

For the emulator tests you need an Android SDK with the emulator and one system image. Android Studio's SDK works and is only read, never modified. The tests use `system-images;android-31;google_apis;arm64-v8a` by default; override it with `JIDR_TEST_SDK`, `JIDR_TEST_IMAGE` and `JIDR_TEST_API`.

```bash
cargo nextest run -p jidr-widgets --features emulator
```

For the site: `cd site && npm ci && npm run dev`.

## How the code is organised

[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) has the architecture, a map of every crate, the licensing split and the protocol rules. Product and architecture decisions are in [docs/decisions/](docs/decisions/). If your change contradicts one, raise it in an issue first.

## Rules the code follows

- **Never crash.** `unwrap`, `expect`, `panic!`, `todo!`, `unimplemented!` and `dbg!` are denied outside tests. Return `jidr_core::JidrError`.
- **No `unsafe`** unless a crate truly needs it, allowed locally with a comment explaining why.
- **Every bug fix comes with a regression test.**
- **Split licensing.** The GUI crates are GPL-3.0-only because they link Slint; everything else is Apache-2.0 and must never depend on Slint or the GUI. `cargo xtask license-check` enforces it.
- **Clean room.** Use only Genymotion's public docs, the public AOSP emulator protos and docs, and behaviour you observe by running the SDK tools. Never decompile or inspect Genymotion binaries, never copy GPL code (Magisk, rootAVD), never bundle Google's SDK, system images or Magisk. Details in [docs/clean-room.md](docs/clean-room.md).
- **Protocol changes** that touch the wire format, an existing command, error codes or events need a row in the changelog of [docs/control-protocol.md](docs/control-protocol.md). Regenerate the command reference with `JIDR_UPDATE_DOCS=1 cargo nextest run -p jidr-daemon protocol_doc`.
- **Android Studio's SDK and AVDs stay read-only.** Tests create AVDs in temporary directories.

## Pull requests

1. Fork, branch from `main`, and keep the change focused.
2. Write [conventional commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/): `feat(widgets): …`, `fix(root): …`, `docs: …`, `test: …`, `ci: …`. The type decides the next version and the release notes.
3. Run `cargo xtask ci` and, if you touched a crate with emulator tests and have an image, its emulator tests.
4. Update the docs your change affects.
5. Open the pull request against `main`. CI runs fmt, clippy, tests and the licence check on Linux, clippy on macOS, and the emulator tests on Linux KVM (API 30, 33 and 35). PRs that only touch docs, the site or Markdown skip the emulator jobs.
6. A maintainer review is required before merging.

Emulator tests on shared CI runners can be slow. If one fails in code you didn't touch, say so in the PR; a maintainer can re-run it.

## Releases

Releases are cut from `main` by a release pull request that collects the changes since the last version. Merging it tags the version and builds the signed, notarized DMG. Contributors don't need to do anything for this beyond writing conventional commits.

## Using an AI coding agent

You're welcome to. Point it at [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md); `CLAUDE.md` does that for Claude Code. You remain responsible for the change: review it, run the checks, and make sure it follows the clean-room rules.

## Licence of contributions

By contributing you agree that your contribution is licensed under the licence of the files you change: Apache-2.0, or GPL-3.0-only for `crates/jidr-ui` and `apps/jidr-gui`.

```

`README.md`:

```md
# Jidr (جذر)

Android on your Mac, rooted in a minute.

[![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/AbdurahmanAlmehdi/jidr)](https://github.com/AbdurahmanAlmehdi/jidr/releases/latest)
![macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon](https://img.shields.io/badge/macOS_14%2B-Apple_Silicon-black)

Jidr creates and runs virtual Android phones and tablets on Apple Silicon Macs. Pick **Full root** and Magisk is patched in and verified for you; pick **Shell root** for `adb root`; or keep the device stock. It's a free, open-source alternative to Genymotion Desktop, written in Rust, with a desktop app, a CLI and an MCP server for AI agents.

```bash
brew install --cask abdurahmanalmehdi/tap/jidr
```

Or [download the DMG](https://github.com/AbdurahmanAlmehdi/jidr/releases/latest). Site: [jidr.ly](https://jidr.ly).

![Jidr after Full root: the device is rooted with Magisk and su -c id answers uid=0(root)](docs/images/root-success.png)

## Features

- **Devices:** create, clone, start, stop and delete virtual devices from Google's emulator images (API 29–36, arm64). Jidr keeps its own SDK and never modifies Android Studio's SDK or AVDs.
- **One-click root:** None, Shell root (`adb root`) or Full root (Magisk, patched into a per-device copy of the ramdisk and verified with `su -c id`). Revert at any time. Play Store images get a guided beta.
- **Player window:** the device screen with mouse and keyboard input, drag-and-drop for APKs and files, and logcat.
- **Widgets:** battery, rotation and motion sensors, network (Wi-Fi, mobile data, speed and delay profiles), calls, SMS and signal bars, GPS with GPX/KML route replay on an OpenStreetMap map, fingerprint, the host webcam as the camera, clipboard and developer toggles.
- **Media and state:** PNG screenshots, MP4 recordings, and snapshots tagged with the root mode they were taken in.
- **Build identity:** set build properties (model, brand, fingerprint…) on Full-root devices.
- **CLI:** every action is a `jidr` command, with `--json` output and stable exit codes for CI.
- **MCP server:** `jidr mcp` lets Claude and other MCP clients see and drive a device: screenshot, tap, type, UI tree, logs.

No accounts, no telemetry, no paid tier.

![The Jidr player: a running device, its toolbar, and the battery widget](docs/images/player.png)

## Install

You need macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon, and about 10 GB of free disk space for the SDK and one system image.

- **Homebrew:** `brew install --cask abdurahmanalmehdi/tap/jidr` installs `Jidr.app` and puts the `jidr` CLI on your `PATH`. Update with `brew upgrade --cask jidr`.
- **DMG:** download `Jidr-<version>-arm64.dmg` from the [latest release](https://github.com/AbdurahmanAlmehdi/jidr/releases/latest) and drag Jidr to Applications. The CLI is at `/Applications/Jidr.app/Contents/Helpers/jidr`.

On first launch the app finds or downloads the Android SDK and a system image, after you accept Google's license.

## Quick start (CLI)

```bash
jidr image install 35 --accept-licenses   # download an API 35 image; you accept Google's license
jidr device create Phone --image 35       # create a device
jidr device start Phone                   # boot it and wait until it's ready
jidr root set Phone magisk                # Full root with Magisk, verified
```

## Use it from an AI agent

Add Jidr to Claude Code as an MCP server:

```bash
claude mcp add jidr -- jidr mcp
```

For Claude Desktop, open `jidr-mcp-<version>-darwin-arm64.mcpb` from the [latest release](https://github.com/AbdurahmanAlmehdi/jidr/releases/latest). Jidr is also in the [MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io) as `io.github.AbdurahmanAlmehdi/jidr`. [docs/mcp.md](docs/mcp.md) lists the tools.

Agent skills teach Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other agents to create and drive Jidr devices with the CLI (`jidr`) and to test an app on them (`jidr-app-testing`). Install them with the open [skills](https://skills.sh) CLI:

```bash
npx skills add AbdurahmanAlmehdi/jidr
```

They live in [skills/](skills/).

## Build from source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/AbdurahmanAlmehdi/jidr
cd jidr
cargo build --release -p jidr -p jidr-gui
```

You need `rustup` (it installs the toolchain pinned in `rust-toolchain.toml`) and `protoc` (`brew install protobuf`). [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) has the full setup and how to run the tests.

## Licensing

Jidr is split-licensed. The desktop app (`crates/jidr-ui`, `apps/jidr-gui`) is **GPL-3.0-only** because it links Slint. Everything else (CLI, daemon, MCP server, libraries, site) is **Apache-2.0**. See `LICENSE-APACHE`, the `LICENSE-GPL` files in the two GUI crates, and `NOTICE`.

Jidr downloads the Android Emulator and system images from Google under the Android SDK License, which you accept in the app. It downloads Magisk (GPL-3.0) only when you choose Full root. None of these are bundled.

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome: read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Report security issues as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). If you work with an AI coding agent, point it at [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

## Trademarks

Android is a trademark of Google LLC. Genymotion is a trademark of its owner. Jidr is not affiliated with Google or Genymotion.

`SECURITY.md`:

```md
# Security policy

## Supported versions

Jidr is pre-1.0. Security fixes go into the latest release only; please update before reporting.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **don't open a public issue** for a security problem. Report it privately through GitHub: on the repository's **Security** tab, choose **Report a vulnerability**. Include what you found, how to reproduce it, the Jidr version, your macOS version, and the impact you expect.

You can expect an acknowledgement within 7 days and an assessment within 30 days. We'll keep you updated, agree on a disclosure date with you, and credit you in the release notes unless you'd rather not be named.

## What's in scope

Jidr runs a local daemon and changes Android emulator images, so these areas matter most:

- **The daemon's socket:** another local user, or an unprivileged process, controlling devices through the Unix socket.
- **The MCP server:** an agent getting past the destructive-action policy (D5), for example deleting or resetting a device that isn't `agent-owned` without `--allow-destructive`.
- **Downloads:** the SDK, system images or Magisk installed without checking their SHA-256 (Magisk is pinned in `assets/magisk-pins.toml`), or fetched over a path an attacker can tamper with.
- **Root and ramdisk patching:** a patched ramdisk affecting another device or the original image, or root reaching beyond the emulated device onto the Mac.
- **File handling:** APKs, zips, GPX/KML files or snapshots dropped on the app writing outside the places they belong.
- **The release artifact:** anything that undermines the DMG's signature or notarization.

Out of scope: the security of the Android images themselves (report those to Google), Magisk (report to its project), and the fact that a rooted emulator has root inside the emulator. That's the feature.

## Telemetry

Jidr sends no telemetry and has no accounts (D17). It contacts Google's SDK servers, GitHub (only to download the pinned Magisk release) and OpenStreetMap's tile servers for the GPS map, and nothing else.

```

```rs
//! Jidr.app: the desktop GUI (GPL-3.0-only, D18).

use std::process::ExitCode;

fn main() -> ExitCode {
    tracing_subscriber::fmt()
        .with_env_filter(
            tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::try_from_default_env()
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::new("warn")),
        )
        .init();
    match jidr_ui::run() {
        Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("jidr: {e}");
            ExitCode::FAILURE
        }
    }
}

`apps/jidr/src/cli.rs`:

```rs
//! Command-line definition (hand-written clap; every command is a thin call
//! over the daemon protocol).

use std::path::PathBuf;

use clap::{Args, Parser, Subcommand, ValueEnum};

#[derive(Debug, Parser)]
#[command(
    name = "jidr",
    version,
    about = "Android emulators with one-click root, for people, CI and AI agents",
    after_help = "Exit codes: 0 ok · 1 unexpected · 2 usage · 3 not found · 4 busy · 5 boot timeout · 6 sdk · 7 root failed · 8 daemon stale"
)]
pub struct Cli {
    /// Machine-readable output: {"jidr_json": 1, "ok": …, "result"|"error": …}.
    #[arg(long, global = true)]
    pub json: bool,
    /// Only print results and errors (no progress).
    #[arg(long, short, global = true)]
    pub quiet: bool,
    /// Replace a running daemon of another version without asking.
    #[arg(long, global = true, env = "JIDR_RESTART_STALE")]
    pub restart_stale: bool,
    #[command(subcommand)]
    pub cmd: Cmd,
}

#[derive(Debug, Subcommand)]
pub enum Cmd {
    /// Run or control the Jidr daemon (started automatically when needed).
    Daemon {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        action: Option<DaemonCmd>,
    },
    /// Create, start, stop and manage devices.
    Device {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: DeviceCmd,
    },
    /// Install an APK on a running device.
    Install {
        device: String,
        apk: PathBuf,
        /// Fail if the app is already installed (default: replace it).
        #[arg(long)]
        no_replace: bool,
        /// Grant all runtime permissions.
        #[arg(long)]
        grant: bool,
        /// Allow a version downgrade.
        #[arg(long)]
        downgrade: bool,
    },
    /// Copy a file to a device (default destination /sdcard/Download/).
    Push {
        device: String,
        local: PathBuf,
        remote: Option<String>,
    },
    /// Copy a file from a device.
    Pull {
        device: String,
        remote: String,
        local: PathBuf,
    },
    /// Flash a zip onto /system (not available yet).
    Flash { device: String, zip: PathBuf },
    /// Show, follow or clear the device log.
    Logcat {
        device: String,
        /// Only the last N lines.
        #[arg(long, short = 'n')]
        lines: Option<u32>,
        /// Filter spec, e.g. `ActivityManager:I` (repeatable).
        #[arg(long = "filter")]
        filter: Vec<String>,
        /// Keep streaming new lines.
        #[arg(long, short)]
        follow: bool,
        /// Clear the log instead of showing it.
        #[arg(long, conflicts_with_all = ["follow", "lines"])]
        clear: bool,
    },
    /// List and install system images.
    Image {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: ImageCmd,
    },
    /// Hardware profiles.
    Profile {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: ProfileCmd,
    },
    /// The Android SDK Jidr uses.
    Sdk {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: SdkCmd,
    },
    /// Root a device: adb root or Magisk.
    Root {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: RootCmd,
    },
    /// Device snapshots, tagged with their root mode.
    Snapshot {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: SnapshotCmd,
    },
    /// The device's global HTTP proxy (Burp, mitmproxy, …).
    Proxy {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: ProxyCmd,
    },
    /// The download cache (Magisk APKs and other pinned files, by SHA-256).
    Cache {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: CacheCmd,
    },
    /// Daemon-wide settings, shared with the desktop app.
    Settings {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: SettingsCmd,
    },
    /// Remove Jidr's daemon, MCP entries, caches and logs; `--purge` also
    /// deletes every Jidr device and its private SDK. Never touches Android
    /// Studio's SDK or devices.
    Uninstall {
        /// Also delete all Jidr data: devices, private SDK, settings.
        #[arg(long)]
        purge: bool,
        /// Don't ask for confirmation.
        #[arg(long, short)]
        yes: bool,
    },
    /// Long-running operations.
    Jobs {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: JobsCmd,
    },
    /// Serve MCP on stdio for AI agents (add to Claude: `claude mcp add jidr -- jidr mcp`).
    Mcp {
        /// Allow destructive commands (reset, delete…) on devices the agent didn't create (D5).
        #[arg(long)]
        allow_destructive: bool,
    },
    /// List every protocol command (the same list the GUI and MCP see).
    Commands,
    /// Call any protocol command directly: `jidr call device.list` or
    /// `jidr call device.start '{"device":"Phone"}'`.
    Call {
        method: String,
        /// Params as a JSON object.
        params: Option<String>,
    },
    /// Print shell completions.
    Completions { shell: clap_complete::Shell },
}

#[derive(Debug, Subcommand)]
pub enum DaemonCmd {
    /// Run the daemon in the foreground (what auto-start runs).
    Run,
    /// Stop the running daemon. Running devices keep running.
    Stop,
    /// Daemon version, uptime and device counts.
    Status,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, ValueEnum)]
pub enum RootModeArg {
    None,
    Adb,
    Magisk,
}

impl RootModeArg {
    pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::None => "none",
            Self::Adb => "adb",
            Self::Magisk => "magisk",
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Args)]
pub struct Hardware {
    /// RAM in MB.
    #[arg(long = "ram")]
    pub ram_mb: Option<u32>,
    /// CPU cores.
    #[arg(long)]
    pub cpus: Option<u32>,
    /// Screen width in pixels.
    #[arg(long)]
    pub width: Option<u32>,
    /// Screen height in pixels.
    #[arg(long)]
    pub height: Option<u32>,
    /// Screen density in dpi.
    #[arg(long)]
    pub density: Option<u32>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Args)]
pub struct Selection {
    /// Device names or ids.
    pub names: Vec<String>,
    /// Every device.
    #[arg(long, conflicts_with = "names")]
    pub all: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Subcommand)]
pub enum DeviceCmd {
    /// Create a device.
    Create {
        name: String,
        /// System image: `35`, `35:google_apis`, `35:google_apis_playstore` or a full package.
        #[arg(long, short)]
        image: String,
        /// Hardware profile id (`jidr profile list`).
        #[arg(long, short)]
        profile: Option<String>,
        #[command(flatten)]
        hw: Hardware,
        /// Data partition in MB.
        #[arg(long)]
        data_mb: Option<u32>,
        /// Root mode (default: `jidr settings`' default root mode, adb unless
        /// changed; none where the image doesn't allow adb root). Magisk runs
        /// the Full-root setup right after creating.
        #[arg(long, value_enum)]
        root: Option<RootModeArg>,
        /// Let AI agents run destructive commands on it.
        #[arg(long)]
        agent_owned: bool,
    },
    /// Start devices and wait until they've booted.
    Start {
        #[command(flatten)]
        sel: Selection,
        /// Ignore the quick-boot snapshot.
        #[arg(long)]
        cold_boot: bool,
        /// Return as soon as the boot job starts.
        #[arg(long, conflicts_with = "timeout")]
        no_wait: bool,
        /// Give up (and stop the boot) after this many seconds.
        #[arg(long)]
        timeout: Option<u64>,
    },
    /// Stop devices (saves their quick-boot state).
    Stop {
        #[command(flatten)]
        sel: Selection,
    },
    /// List devices.
    List,
    /// Settings, status and disk usage of a device.
    Details { device: String },
    /// Copy a stopped device.
    Clone { device: String, name: String },
    /// Factory reset: wipe all user data.
    Reset {
        device: String,
        /// Don't ask for confirmation.
        #[arg(long, short)]
        yes: bool,
    },
    /// Delete devices and their data.
    Delete {
        #[command(flatten)]
        sel: Selection,
        /// Don't ask for confirmation.
        #[arg(long, short)]
        yes: bool,
    },
    /// Rename a device or change its hardware (while stopped).
    Edit {
        device: String,
        /// New name.
        #[arg(long)]
        rename: Option<String>,
        #[command(flatten)]
        hw: Hardware,
        /// Let AI agents run destructive commands on it.
        #[arg(long)]
        agent_owned: Option<bool>,
    },
    /// gRPC endpoint, token and adb serial of a running device.
    ConnectInfo { device: String },
    /// Zip a device's settings, emulator and crash logs and logcat (for bug reports).
    Logs {
        device: String,
        /// Where to write the zip (default: Jidr's logs folder).
        #[arg(long)]
        zip: Option<PathBuf>,
    },
}

#[derive(Debug, Subcommand)]
pub enum SettingsCmd {
    /// Show the settings.
    Get,
    /// Change settings; only the options given change.
    Set {
        /// Root mode for `jidr device create` without `--root`.
        #[arg(long, value_enum)]
        default_root: Option<RootModeArg>,
        /// Save a quick-boot snapshot when a device stops (from its next start).
        #[arg(long)]
        quick_boot: Option<bool>,
    },
}

#[derive(Debug, Subcommand)]
pub enum CacheCmd {
    /// Cached downloads.
    List,
    /// Add a local file (e.g. a Magisk APK) for offline use.
    Import {
        path: PathBuf,
        /// Expected SHA-256 of the file.
        #[arg(long)]
        sha256: Option<String>,
    },
    /// Delete cached downloads.
    Prune {
        /// Only those older than this many days.
        #[arg(long)]
        older_than_days: Option<u64>,
    },
}

#[derive(Debug, Subcommand)]
pub enum ImageCmd {
    /// System images for this Mac, installed or available.
    List {
        /// Only installed images (works offline).
        #[arg(long)]
        installed: bool,
    },
    /// Download and install a system image (and the emulator if needed).
    Install {
        image: String,
        /// Accept the licenses shown (prints each license id and hash).
        #[arg(long)]
        accept_licenses: bool,
    },
}

#[derive(Debug, Subcommand)]
pub enum ProfileCmd {
    /// Built-in hardware profiles.
    List,
}

#[derive(Debug, Subcommand)]
pub enum SdkCmd {
    /// Where the SDKs are, emulator version, hypervisor, free disk.
    Status,
    /// Licenses still to accept for these packages, with their text.
    Licenses { packages: Vec<String> },
    /// Install SDK packages into Jidr's private SDK.
    Install {
        packages: Vec<String>,
        /// Accept the licenses shown (prints each license id and hash).
        #[arg(long)]
        accept_licenses: bool,
    },
}

#[derive(Debug, Subcommand)]
pub enum RootCmd {
    /// Switch root mode (cold boots the device).
    Set {
        device: String,
        #[arg(value_enum)]
        mode: RootModeArg,
        /// Use this Magisk APK instead of downloading the pinned release (offline, D30).
        #[arg(long)]
        magisk: Option<PathBuf>,
    },
    /// Check that root works.
    Verify { device: String },
    /// Root mode and health.
    Status { device: String },
}

#[derive(Debug, Subcommand)]
pub enum SnapshotCmd {
    List { device: String },
    Save { device: String, name: String },
    Load { device: String, name: String },
    Delete { device: String, name: String },

#[derive(Debug, Subcommand)]
pub enum ProxyCmd {

    Set { device: String, proxy: String },

    Clear { device: String },
    /// The current proxy.
    Show { device: String },
}

#[derive(Debug, Subcommand)]

    List {
        /// Include finished jobs.
        #[arg(long)]
        all: bool,
    },
    /// Wait for a job and print its result.
    Wait { job: String },
    /// Cancel a job.
    Cancel { job: String },

`apps/jidr/src/main.rs`:

```rs
//! `jidr`: the Jidr CLI, daemon and MCP server.

mod cli;
mod output;
mod uninstall;

use std::io::{BufRead, IsTerminal, Write};
use std::process::ExitCode;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;

use clap::{CommandFactory, Parser};
use cli::{
    CacheCmd, Cli, Cmd, DaemonCmd, DeviceCmd, Hardware, ImageCmd, JobsCmd, ProfileCmd, ProxyCmd,
    RootCmd, SdkCmd, Selection, SettingsCmd, SnapshotCmd,
};
use jidr_client::{Client, SpawnOptions};
use jidr_core::{ErrorCode, JidrError, JidrPaths, JidrResult, Job, JobState};
use output::Out;
use serde_json::{Map, Value, json};
use uuid::Uuid;

fn main() -> ExitCode {
    let cli = Cli::parse();
    let out = Out {
        json: cli.json,
        quiet: cli.quiet,
    };
    let code = match &cli.cmd {
        Cmd::Completions { shell } => {
            clap_complete::generate(*shell, &mut Cli::command(), "jidr", &mut std::io::stdout());
            0
        }
        Cmd::Daemon {
            action: None | Some(DaemonCmd::Run),
        } => run_daemon(out),
        _ => match tokio::runtime::Builder::new_multi_thread()
            .enable_all()
            .build()
        {
            Ok(rt) => match rt.block_on(run(cli, out)) {
                Ok(()) => 0,
                Err(e) => out.err(&e),
            },
            Err(e) => out.err(&JidrError::unexpected(format!("tokio runtime: {e}"))),
        },
    };
    ExitCode::from(code)
}

fn interactive(out: Out) -> bool {
    !out.json && std::io::stdin().is_terminal() && std::io::stderr().is_terminal()
}

/// Asks a yes/no question on the terminal.
fn ask(question: &str, default_yes: bool) -> bool {
    eprint!(
        "{question} {} ",
        if default_yes { "[Y/n]" } else { "[y/N]" }
    );
    let _ = std::io::stderr().flush();
    let mut answer = String::new();
    if std::io::stdin().lock().read_line(&mut answer).is_err() {
        return false;
    }
    match answer.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
        "" => default_yes,
        a => a == "y" || a == "yes",
    }
}

fn confirm(out: Out, yes: bool, what: &str) -> JidrResult<()> {
    if yes {
        return Ok(());
    }
    if interactive(out) {
        return if ask(&format!("{what}?"), false) {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(JidrError::usage("cancelled"))
        };
    }
    Err(JidrError::usage(format!("{what}: pass --yes to confirm")))
}

async fn connect(paths: &JidrPaths, cli: &Cli, out: Out) -> JidrResult<Client> {
    let mut opts = SpawnOptions {
        program: std::env::current_exe().ok(),
        restart_stale: cli.restart_stale,
        timeout: None,
    };
    match Client::connect_or_spawn(paths, "cli", &opts).await {
        Err(e) if e.code == ErrorCode::DaemonStale && interactive(out) => {
            eprintln!("{}", e.message);
            if !ask("Restart the daemon? Running devices keep running.", true) {
                return Err(e);
            }
            opts.restart_stale = true;
            Client::connect_or_spawn(paths, "cli", &opts).await
        }
        other => other,
    }
}

/// Follows a `{job, pending}` answer to its end, with an optional deadline
/// after which the job is cancelled.
async fn follow(
    client: &Client,
    out: Out,
    v: Value,
    timeout: Option<Duration>,
) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    let Some(job) = jidr_client::pending_job(&v) else {
        return Ok(v);
    };
    let deadline = timeout.map(|t| tokio::time::Instant::now() + t);
    let mut last: Option<(Option<f32>, String)> = None;
    loop {
        let j: Job = client.wait_job(job, Some(Duration::from_secs(1))).await?;
        if last.as_ref() != Some(&(j.progress, j.message.clone())) {
            out.progress(&j);
            last = Some((j.progress, j.message.clone()));
        }
        match j.state {
            JobState::Succeeded => {
                out.progress_done();
                return Ok(j.result.unwrap_or(Value::Null));
            }
            JobState::Failed => {
                out.progress_done();
                return Err(j
                    .error
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| JidrError::unexpected(format!("{} failed", j.kind))));
            }
            JobState::Cancelled => {
                out.progress_done();
                return Err(jidr_core::cancel::cancelled());
            }
            JobState::Pending | JobState::Running => {}
        }
        if let Some(d) = deadline
            && tokio::time::Instant::now() >= d
        {
            out.progress_done();
            let _ = client.cancel_job(job).await;
            let _ = client.wait_job(job, Some(Duration::from_secs(30))).await;
            let secs = timeout.map(|t| t.as_secs()).unwrap_or(0);
            return Err(if j.kind == "device.start" {
                JidrError::boot_timeout(format!(
                    "the device did not boot within {secs} s; the boot was cancelled"
                ))
            } else {
                JidrError::unexpected(format!(
                    "{} did not finish within {secs} s; it was cancelled",
                    j.kind
                ))
            }
            .with_data(json!({ "job": job })));
        }
    }
}

/// Calls a method and follows its job if it starts one.
async fn exec(client: &Client, out: Out, method: &str, params: Value) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    let v = client
        .call(method, params)
        .await
        .map_err(|e| missing_provider(method, e))?;
    follow(client, out, v, None).await
}

/// Commands whose provider isn't registered (the CLI's in-process test
/// daemon has only the core one); say so clearly.
fn missing_provider(method: &str, e: JidrError) -> JidrError {
    if e.code == ErrorCode::Usage && e.message.starts_with("unknown method") {
        let area = method.split('.').next().unwrap_or(method);
        return JidrError::usage(format!(
            "`{area}` commands aren't available in this build of Jidr yet ({method})"
        ));
    }
    e
}

/// Runs `f`; if it fails on unaccepted licenses, shows/accepts them and retries once.
async fn with_licenses<F, Fut>(client: &Client, out: Out, accept: bool, f: F) -> JidrResult<Value>
where
    F: Fn() -> Fut,
    Fut: std::future::Future<Output = JidrResult<Value>>,
{
    let err = match f().await {
        Ok(v) => return Ok(v),
        Err(e) => e,
    };
    let Some(pending) = err
        .data
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|d| d.get("pending_licenses"))
        .and_then(Value::as_array)
        .cloned()
    else {
        return Err(err);
    };
    for lic in &pending {
        let (id, sha) = (
            lic["id"].as_str().unwrap_or_default(),
            lic["sha256"].as_str().unwrap_or_default(),
        );
        if accept {
            out.info(&format!(
                "Accepting license {id} (sha256 {sha}) for {}",
                lic["packages"]
            ));
        } else if interactive(out) {
            eprintln!(
                "\n----- License {id} -----\n{}\n----- end of {id} (sha256 {sha}) -----",
                lic["text"].as_str().unwrap_or_default()
            );
            if !ask(&format!("Accept license {id}?"), false) {
                return Err(JidrError::sdk(format!("license {id} was not accepted")));
            }
        } else {
            return Err(JidrError::sdk(format!(
                "{}; read them with `jidr sdk licenses …` and rerun with --accept-licenses",
                err.message
            ))
            .with_data(json!({ "pending_licenses": pending })));
        }
        client
            .call("sdk.accept_license", json!({ "id": id, "sha256": sha }))
            .await?;
    }
    f().await
}

fn hw_params(m: &mut Map<String, Value>, hw: &Hardware) {
    for (k, v) in [
        ("ram_mb", hw.ram_mb),
        ("cpus", hw.cpus),
        ("width", hw.width),
        ("height", hw.height),
        ("density", hw.density),
    ] {
        if let Some(v) = v {
            m.insert(k.into(), json!(v));
        }
    }
}

/// Resolves `names` / `--all` to device names, filtered by `keep` for `--all`.
async fn select(
    client: &Client,
    sel: &Selection,
    keep: impl Fn(&Value) -> bool,
) -> JidrResult<Vec<String>> {
    if sel.all {
        let list = client.call("device.list", json!({})).await?;
        return Ok(list
            .as_array()
            .map(|a| {
                a.iter()
                    .filter(|d| keep(d))
                    .filter_map(|d| d["name"].as_str().map(str::to_string))
                    .collect()
            })
            .unwrap_or_default());
    }
    if sel.names.is_empty() {
        return Err(JidrError::usage("name at least one device, or pass --all"));
    }
    Ok(sel.names.clone())
}

fn state_of(d: &Value) -> &str {
    d["status"]["state"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
}

fn dirs_home() -> JidrResult<std::path::PathBuf> {
    std::env::var_os("HOME")
        .map(std::path::PathBuf::from)
        .filter(|h| h.is_absolute())
        .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::unexpected("HOME is not set"))
}

fn parse_job(s: &str) -> JidrResult<Uuid> {
    Uuid::parse_str(s).map_err(|_| JidrError::usage(format!("{s:?} is not a job id")))
}

/// `jidr proxy set`'s `[host:]port`; the host defaults to the Mac as the
/// emulator sees it.
fn proxy_target(s: &str) -> JidrResult<(String, u16)> {
    let (host, port) = match s.rsplit_once(':') {
        Some((h, p)) => (h.trim(), p),
        None => (jidr_widgets::network::proxy::HOST_LOOPBACK, s),
    };
    match port.trim().parse::<u16>() {
        Ok(port) if port != 0 && !host.is_empty() => Ok((host.to_string(), port)),
        _ => Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
            "{s:?} isn't [host:]port, e.g. 8080 or 10.0.2.2:8080"
        ))),
    }
}

async fn run(cli: Cli, out: Out) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let paths = JidrPaths::discover()?;
    if let Cmd::Daemon {
        action: Some(DaemonCmd::Stop),
    } = &cli.cmd
    {
        let socket = paths.socket();
        if !socket.exists() {
            out.ok(&json!({ "stopped": false }), |_| {
                "The daemon isn't running.".into()
            });
            return Ok(());
        }
        jidr_client::shutdown_daemon(&socket).await?;
        out.ok(&json!({ "stopped": true }), |_| "Daemon stopped.".into());
        return Ok(());
    }
    if let Cmd::Uninstall { purge, yes } = &cli.cmd {
        let what = if *purge {
            "Remove Jidr's daemon, MCP entries, caches, logs AND all Jidr devices and its private SDK"
        } else {
            "Remove Jidr's daemon, MCP entries, caches and logs (devices are kept)"
        };
        confirm(out, *yes, what)?;
        let home = dirs_home()?;
        let report = uninstall::run(&paths, &home, *purge).await?;
        let v = serde_json::to_value(&report).unwrap_or(Value::Null);
        out.ok(&v, |_| {
            let mut lines = Vec::new();
            if !report.stopped_devices.is_empty() {
                lines.push(format!("Stopped {}.", report.stopped_devices.join(", ")));
            }
            for m in &report.mcp {
                lines.push(format!("Removed MCP entries {:?} from {} (backup: {}).", m.removed, m.file.display(), m.backup.display()));
            }
            for p in &report.removed {
                lines.push(format!("Deleted {}.", p.display()));
            }
            for p in &report.kept {
                lines.push(format!("Kept {} (use --purge to delete devices and the private SDK).", p.display()));
            }
            lines.push("Android Studio's SDK and devices were not touched. Remove the app itself with `brew uninstall --cask jidr` or by moving Jidr.app to the Trash.".into());
            lines.join("\n")
        });
        return Ok(());
    }
    if let Cmd::Flash { .. } = &cli.cmd {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(
            "flash isn't available yet: Genymotion's flash semantics are an open research item",
        ));
    }
    let client = connect(&paths, &cli, out).await?;
    let c = &client;
    match cli.cmd {
        Cmd::Completions { .. }
        | Cmd::Flash { .. }
        | Cmd::Uninstall { .. }
        | Cmd::Daemon {
            action: None | Some(DaemonCmd::Run | DaemonCmd::Stop),
        } => {}
        Cmd::Daemon {
            action: Some(DaemonCmd::Status),
        } => {
            let v = c.call("daemon.status", json!({})).await?;
            out.ok(&v, |v| {
                format!(
                    "Jidr daemon {} (pid {}), up {} s, {} devices ({} running), socket {}",
                    v["version"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                    v["pid"],
                    v["uptime_s"],
                    v["devices"],
                    v["running"],
                    v["socket"].as_str().unwrap_or("?")
                )
            });
        }
        Cmd::Device { cmd } => device(c, out, cmd).await?,
        Cmd::Install {
            device,
            apk,
            no_replace,
            grant,
            downgrade,
        } => {
            let apk = std::path::absolute(&apk).unwrap_or(apk);
            let v = exec(c, out, "file.install", json!({ "device": device, "apk": apk, "replace": !no_replace, "grant_permissions": grant, "downgrade": downgrade })).await?;
            out.ok(&v, |_| format!("Installed {} on {device}.", apk.display()));
        }
        Cmd::Push {
            device,
            local,
            remote,
        } => {
            let local = std::path::absolute(&local).unwrap_or(local);
            let mut p = json!({ "device": device, "local": local });
            if let Some(r) = remote {
                p["remote"] = json!(r);
            }
            let v = exec(c, out, "file.push", p).await?;
            out.ok(&v, |v| {
                format!("Pushed to {}.", v["remote"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"))
            });
        }
        Cmd::Pull {
            device,
            remote,
            local,
        } => {
            let local = std::path::absolute(&local).unwrap_or(local);
            let v = exec(
                c,
                out,
                "file.pull",
                json!({ "device": device, "remote": remote, "local": local }),
            )
            .await?;
            out.ok(&v, |_| format!("Pulled to {}.", local.display()));
        }
        Cmd::Logcat {
            device,
            lines,
            filter,
            follow,
            clear,
        } => {
            if clear {
                let v = exec(c, out, "logcat.clear", json!({ "device": device })).await?;
                out.ok(&v, |_| String::new());
            } else if follow {
                let mut rx = c.events();
                c.call(
                    "logcat.follow",
                    json!({ "device": device, "filter": filter }),
                )
                .await?;
                loop {
                    tokio::select! {
                        _ = tokio::signal::ctrl_c() => break,
                        ev = rx.recv() => match ev {
                            Ok(ev) if ev.topic == "logcat" => {
                                if out.json {
                                    println!("{}", json!({ "jidr_json": output::JSON_VERSION, "ok": true, "event": ev.data }));
                                } else {
                                    println!("{}", ev.data["line"].as_str().unwrap_or_default());
                                }
                            }
                            Ok(_) | Err(tokio::sync::broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(_)) => {}
                            Err(_) => break,
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                let mut p = json!({ "device": device, "filter": filter });
                if let Some(n) = lines {
                    p["lines"] = json!(n);
                }
                let v = exec(c, out, "logcat.dump", p).await?;
                out.ok(&v, |v| v["text"].as_str().unwrap_or_default().to_string());
            }
        }
        Cmd::Image {
            cmd: ImageCmd::List { installed },
        } => {
            let v = exec(c, out, "image.list", json!({ "available": !installed })).await?;
            out.ok(&v, output::images);
        }
        Cmd::Image {
            cmd:
                ImageCmd::Install {
                    image,
                    accept_licenses,
                },
        } => {
            let v = with_licenses(c, out, accept_licenses, || {
                exec(c, out, "image.install", json!({ "image": image }))
            })
            .await?;
            out.ok(&v, |v| {
                v["message"]
                    .as_str()
                    .map(str::to_string)
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("Installed {image}."))
            });
        }
        Cmd::Profile {
            cmd: ProfileCmd::List,
        } => {
            let v = exec(c, out, "profile.list", json!({})).await?;
            out.ok(&v, output::profiles);
        }
        Cmd::Sdk {
            cmd: SdkCmd::Status,
        } => {
            let v = exec(c, out, "sdk.status", json!({})).await?;
            out.ok(&v, output::pretty);
        }
        Cmd::Sdk {
            cmd: SdkCmd::Licenses { packages },
        } => {
            let v = exec(c, out, "sdk.licenses", json!({ "packages": packages })).await?;
            out.ok(&v, |v| {
                let list = v.as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
                if list.is_empty() {
                    return "All licenses for these packages are accepted.".into();
                }
                list.iter()
                    .map(|l| {
                        format!(
                            "----- License {} (sha256 {}) for {} -----\n{}\n",
                            l["id"].as_str().unwrap_or_default(),
                            l["sha256"].as_str().unwrap_or_default(),
                            l["packages"],
                            l["text"].as_str().unwrap_or_default()
                        )
                    })
                    .collect()
            });
        }
        Cmd::Sdk {
            cmd:
                SdkCmd::Install {
                    packages,
                    accept_licenses,
                },
        } => {
            let v = with_licenses(c, out, accept_licenses, || {
                exec(c, out, "sdk.install", json!({ "packages": packages }))
            })
            .await?;
            out.ok(&v, |_| "Installed.".into());
        }
        Cmd::Settings { cmd } => {
            let v = match cmd {
                SettingsCmd::Get => c.call("settings.get", json!({})).await?,
                SettingsCmd::Set {
                    default_root,
                    quick_boot,
                } => {
                    let mut p = Map::new();
                    if let Some(r) = default_root {
                        p.insert("default_root_mode".into(), json!(r.as_str()));
                    }
                    if let Some(q) = quick_boot {
                        p.insert("quick_boot".into(), json!(q));
                    }
                    c.call("settings.set", Value::Object(p)).await?
                }
            };
            out.ok(&v, |v| {
                format!(
                    "Default root mode: {}\nQuick boot on stop: {}",
                    v["default_root_mode"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                    if v["quick_boot"].as_bool().unwrap_or(true) {
                        "on"
                    } else {
                        "off"
                    }
                )
            });
        }
        Cmd::Cache {
            cmd: CacheCmd::List,
        } => {
            let v = c.call("cache.list", json!({})).await?;
            out.ok(&v, |v| {
                output::table(
                    &["SHA256", "SIZE", "PATH"],
                    v.as_array()
                        .into_iter()
                        .flatten()
                        .map(|e| {
                            vec![
                                e["sha256"].as_str().unwrap_or_default().to_string(),
                                format!("{:.1} MB", e["size"].as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0) / 1e6),
                                e["path"].as_str().unwrap_or_default().to_string(),
                            ]
                        })
                        .collect(),
                )
            });
        }
        Cmd::Cache {
            cmd: CacheCmd::Import { path, sha256 },
        } => {
            let path = std::path::absolute(&path).unwrap_or(path);
            let v = c
                .call("cache.import", json!({ "path": path, "sha256": sha256 }))
                .await?;
            out.ok(&v, |v| {
                format!(
                    "Cached {} (sha256 {}).",
                    path.display(),
                    v["sha256"].as_str().unwrap_or("?")
                )
            });
        }
        Cmd::Cache {
            cmd: CacheCmd::Prune { older_than_days },
        } => {
            let v = c
                .call("cache.prune", json!({ "older_than_days": older_than_days }))
                .await?;
            out.ok(&v, |v| {
                format!(
                    "Removed {} files ({:.1} MB).",
                    v["removed"],
                    v["bytes"].as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0) / 1e6
                )
            });
        }
        Cmd::Root { cmd } => {
            let (method, params) = match cmd {
                RootCmd::Set {
                    device,
                    mode,
                    magisk,
                } => {
                    let mut p = json!({ "device": device, "mode": mode.as_str() });
                    if let Some(apk) = magisk {
                        let apk = std::path::absolute(&apk).unwrap_or(apk);
                        let entry = c.call("cache.import", json!({ "path": apk })).await?;
                        p["magisk_sha256"] = entry["sha256"].clone();
                    }
                    ("root.set", p)
                }
                RootCmd::Verify { device } => ("root.verify", json!({ "device": device })),
                RootCmd::Status { device } => ("root.status", json!({ "device": device })),
            };
            let v = exec(c, out, method, params).await?;
            out.ok(&v, output::pretty);
        }
        Cmd::Snapshot { cmd } => {
            let (method, params) = match cmd {
                SnapshotCmd::List { device } => ("snapshot.list", json!({ "device": device })),
                SnapshotCmd::Save { device, name } => {
                    ("snapshot.save", json!({ "device": device, "name": name }))
                }
                SnapshotCmd::Load { device, name } => {
                    ("snapshot.load", json!({ "device": device, "name": name }))
                }
                SnapshotCmd::Delete { device, name } => {
                    ("snapshot.delete", json!({ "device": device, "name": name }))
                }
            };
            let v = exec(c, out, method, params).await?;
            out.ok(&v, output::pretty);
        }
        Cmd::Proxy { cmd } => {
            let (method, params) = match cmd {
                ProxyCmd::Set { device, proxy } => {
                    let (host, port) = proxy_target(&proxy)?;
                    (
                        "network.proxy.set",
                        json!({ "device": device, "host": host, "port": port }),
                    )
                }
                ProxyCmd::Clear { device } => ("network.proxy.clear", json!({ "device": device })),
                ProxyCmd::Show { device } => ("network.proxy.get", json!({ "device": device })),
            };
            let v = c.call(method, params).await?;
            out.ok(&v, |v| match v["proxy"].as_str() {
                Some(p) => format!("HTTP proxy: {p}"),
                None => "No HTTP proxy.".to_string(),
            });
        }
        Cmd::Jobs {
            cmd: JobsCmd::List { all },
        } => {
            let v = c.call("jobs.list", json!({ "all": all })).await?;
            out.ok(&v, output::jobs);
        }
        Cmd::Jobs {
            cmd: JobsCmd::Wait { job },
        } => {
            let id = parse_job(&job)?;
            let v = follow(c, out, json!({ "job": id, "pending": true }), None).await?;
            out.ok(&v, output::pretty);
        }
        Cmd::Jobs {
            cmd: JobsCmd::Cancel { job },
        } => {
            let j = c.cancel_job(parse_job(&job)?).await?;
            out.ok(&serde_json::to_value(&j).unwrap_or(Value::Null), |_| {
                format!("Cancelling {job}.")
            });
        }
        Cmd::Mcp { allow_destructive } => {
            // MCP owns stdout from here on.
            let opts = jidr_mcp::McpOptions { allow_destructive };
            return jidr_mcp::serve_stdio(client, opts).await;
        }
        Cmd::Commands => {
            let v = c.call("commands.list", json!({})).await?;
            out.ok(&v, output::commands);
        }
        Cmd::Call { method, params } => {
            let params: Value = match params {
                Some(p) => serde_json::from_str(&p)
                    .map_err(|e| JidrError::usage(format!("params must be JSON: {e}")))?,
                None => json!({}),
            };
            let v = exec(c, out, &method, params).await?;
            out.ok(&v, output::pretty);
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

async fn device(c: &Client, out: Out, cmd: DeviceCmd) -> JidrResult<()> {
    match cmd {
        DeviceCmd::Create {
            name,
            image,
            profile,
            hw,
            data_mb,
            root,
            agent_owned,
        } => {
            let mut p = Map::new();
            p.insert("name".into(), json!(name));
            p.insert("image".into(), json!(image));
            if let Some(pr) = profile {
                p.insert("profile".into(), json!(pr));
            }
            hw_params(&mut p, &hw);
            if let Some(d) = data_mb {
                p.insert("data_mb".into(), json!(d));
            }
            if let Some(r) = root {
                p.insert("root_mode".into(), json!(r.as_str()));
            }
            if agent_owned {
                p.insert("agent_owned".into(), json!(true));
            }
            let mut v = exec(c, out, "device.create", Value::Object(p)).await?;
            // Full root needs its setup (download, patch, boot, verify), not
            // just the stored mode.
            if v["root"]["mode"] == "magisk"
                && let Some(id) = v["id"].as_str().map(str::to_string)
            {
                out.info(&format!("Setting up Full root on {}…", output::device(&v)));
                exec(
                    c,
                    out,
                    "root.set",
                    json!({ "device": id, "mode": "magisk" }),
                )
                .await?;
                v = c.call("device.details", json!({ "device": id })).await?["device"].take();
            }
            out.ok(&v, |v| format!("Created {}", output::device(v)));
        }
        DeviceCmd::Start {
            sel,
            cold_boot,
            no_wait,
            timeout,
        } => {
            let names = select(c, &sel, |d| matches!(state_of(d), "stopped" | "crashed")).await?;
            let mut results = Vec::new();
            for name in names {
                let v = c
                    .call(
                        "device.start",
                        json!({ "device": name, "cold_boot": cold_boot }),
                    )
                    .await?;
                if no_wait {
                    results.push(v);
                    continue;
                }
                out.info(&format!("Starting {name}…"));
                results.push(follow(c, out, v, timeout.map(Duration::from_secs)).await?);
            }
            out.ok(&Value::Array(results.clone()), |_| {
                results
                    .iter()
                    .map(|r| {
                        if r["pending"] == true {
                            format!("Boot job {}", r["job"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"))
                        } else {
                            output::device(r)
                        }
                    })
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .join("\n")
            });
        }
        DeviceCmd::Stop { sel } => {
            let names = select(c, &sel, |d| !matches!(state_of(d), "stopped" | "crashed")).await?;
            let mut results = Vec::new();
            for name in names {
                results.push(exec(c, out, "device.stop", json!({ "device": name })).await?);
            }
            out.ok(&Value::Array(results.clone()), |_| {
                results
                    .iter()
                    .map(output::device)
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .join("\n")
            });
        }
        DeviceCmd::List => {
            let v = c.call("device.list", json!({})).await?;
            out.ok(&v, output::devices);
        }
        DeviceCmd::Details { device } => {
            let v = c
                .call("device.details", json!({ "device": device }))
                .await?;
            out.ok(&v, |v| {
                format!(
                    "{}\nAVD: {}\nDisk: {:.1} GB\n{}",
                    output::device(&v["device"]),
                    v["avd_dir"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                    v["disk_usage"].as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0) / 1e9,
                    output::pretty(&v["config"])
                )
            });
        }
        DeviceCmd::Clone { device, name } => {
            let v = exec(
                c,
                out,
                "device.clone",
                json!({ "device": device, "name": name }),
            )
            .await?;
            out.ok(&v, |v| format!("Created {}", output::device(v)));
        }
        DeviceCmd::Reset { device, yes } => {
            confirm(out, yes, &format!("Wipe all data on {device}"))?;
            let v = exec(c, out, "device.reset", json!({ "device": device })).await?;
            out.ok(&v, |_| format!("{device} was reset to factory state."));
        }
        DeviceCmd::Delete { sel, yes } => {
            let names = select(c, &sel, |_| true).await?;
            confirm(out, yes, &format!("Delete {}", names.join(", ")))?;
            let mut results = Vec::new();
            for name in names {
                results.push(exec(c, out, "device.delete", json!({ "device": name })).await?);
            }
            out.ok(&Value::Array(results.clone()), |_| {
                results
                    .iter()
                    .map(|r| format!("Deleted {}.", r["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("?")))
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .join("\n")
            });
        }
        DeviceCmd::Edit {
            device,
            rename,
            hw,
            agent_owned,
        } => {
            let mut p = Map::new();
            p.insert("device".into(), json!(device));
            if let Some(n) = rename {
                p.insert("name".into(), json!(n));
            }
            hw_params(&mut p, &hw);
            if let Some(a) = agent_owned {
                p.insert("agent_owned".into(), json!(a));
            }
            let v = exec(c, out, "device.edit", Value::Object(p)).await?;
            out.ok(&v, output::device);
        }
        DeviceCmd::Logs { device, zip } => {
            let zip = zip.map(|z| std::path::absolute(&z).unwrap_or(z));
            let v = exec(
                c,
                out,
                "device.logs",
                json!({ "device": device, "output": zip }),
            )
            .await?;
            out.ok(&v, |v| {
                format!(
                    "Wrote {} ({} files).",
                    v["path"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                    v["files"]
                )
            });
        }
        DeviceCmd::ConnectInfo { device } => {
            let v = c
                .call("device.connect_info", json!({ "device": device }))
                .await?;
            out.ok(&v, output::pretty);
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// `jidr daemon` (run in the foreground; what auto-start spawns).
fn run_daemon(out: Out) -> u8 {
    use tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter;
    let filter = EnvFilter::try_from_env("JIDR_LOG").unwrap_or_else(|_| EnvFilter::new("info"));
    let _ = tracing_subscriber::fmt()
        .with_env_filter(filter)
        .with_writer(std::io::stderr)
        .try_init();
    let rt = match tokio::runtime::Builder::new_multi_thread()
        .enable_all()
        .build()
    {
        Ok(rt) => rt,
        Err(e) => return out.err(&JidrError::unexpected(format!("tokio runtime: {e}"))),
    };
    let result: JidrResult<()> = rt.block_on(async {
        let daemon = build_daemon(JidrPaths::discover()?)?;
        daemon.serve(shutdown_signal()).await
    });
    match result {
        Ok(()) => 0,
        Err(e) => out.err(&e),
    }
}

/// The daemon `jidr daemon` serves: the AOSP backend plus every provider.
fn build_daemon(paths: JidrPaths) -> JidrResult<Arc<jidr_daemon::Daemon>> {
    jidr_daemon::Daemon::builder(
        jidr_daemon::DaemonConfig::new(paths),
        Arc::new(jidr_backend::AospBackend::new()),
    )
    .provider(jidr_widgets::provider())
    .provider(jidr_root::provider())
    .build()
}

async fn shutdown_signal() {
    #[cfg(unix)]
    {
        use tokio::signal::unix::{SignalKind, signal};
        match signal(SignalKind::terminate()) {
            Ok(mut term) => {
                tokio::select! {
                    _ = tokio::signal::ctrl_c() => {}
                    _ = term.recv() => {}
                }
            }
            Err(_) => {
                let _ = tokio::signal::ctrl_c().await;
            }
        }
    }
    #[cfg(not(unix))]
    {
        let _ = tokio::signal::ctrl_c().await;
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn proxy_targets_default_to_the_mac() {
        assert_eq!(proxy_target("8080").unwrap(), ("10.0.2.2".into(), 8080));
        assert_eq!(
            proxy_target("192.168.1.5:3128").unwrap(),
            ("192.168.1.5".into(), 3128)
        );
        for bad in ["", "x", ":8080", "h:0", "h:70000"] {
            assert!(proxy_target(bad).is_err(), "{bad}");
        }
    }

    // G6/G7: without the widgets and root providers, the CLI and MCP reject
    // every widget and root command.
    #[test]
    fn daemon_serves_widget_and_root_commands() {
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let daemon = build_daemon(JidrPaths::under(tmp.path())).unwrap();
        for method in [
            "device.list",
            "gps.set",
            "battery.set",
            "snapshot.save",
            "root.set",
        ] {
            assert!(daemon.registry().get(method).is_some(), "{method}");
        }
    }

    /// docs/control-protocol.md's command reference must match what
    /// `jidr daemon` serves: core, jobs, widgets and root (gap G16; the old
    /// check in jidr-daemon saw only the core). `JIDR_UPDATE_DOCS=1 cargo
    /// nextest run -p jidr protocol_doc` rewrites it.
    #[test]
    fn protocol_doc_matches_commands_list() {
        use jidr_daemon::protocol_doc::{render, splice};
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let daemon = build_daemon(JidrPaths::under(tmp.path())).unwrap();
        let generated = render(&daemon.registry().list());
        assert!(generated.contains("root.set") && generated.contains("gps.set"));
        let path =
            std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../docs/control-protocol.md");
        let doc = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).unwrap();
        let updated =
            splice(&doc, &generated).expect("docs/control-protocol.md lost its commands markers");
        if std::env::var_os("JIDR_UPDATE_DOCS").is_some() {
            std::fs::write(&path, &updated).unwrap();
            return;
        }
        assert!(
            updated == doc,
            "docs/control-protocol.md is out of date with commands.list; run\n  JIDR_UPDATE_DOCS=1 cargo nextest run -p jidr protocol_doc"
        );
    }
}

```rs
//! Printing results: human text, or a versioned JSON envelope (D10).

use std::io::{IsTerminal, Write};

use jidr_core::{JidrError, Job};
use serde_json::{Value, json};

/// Version of the `--json` envelope. Bump on breaking changes (docs/cli.md).
pub const JSON_VERSION: u32 = 1;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub struct Out {
    pub json: bool,
    pub quiet: bool,
}

impl Out {
    /// Prints a successful result.
    pub fn ok(&self, result: &Value, human: impl FnOnce(&Value) -> String) {
        if self.json {
            println!(
                "{}",
                json!({ "jidr_json": JSON_VERSION, "ok": true, "result": result })
            );
        } else {
            let text = human(result);
            if !text.is_empty() {
                println!("{}", text.trim_end());
            }
        }
    }

    /// Prints an error (to stdout as JSON, else stderr) and returns its exit code.
    pub fn err(&self, e: &JidrError) -> u8 {
        if self.json {
            println!(
                "{}",
                json!({ "jidr_json": JSON_VERSION, "ok": false, "error": { "code": e.code, "exit_code": e.code.exit_code(), "message": e.message, "data": e.data } })
            );
        } else {
            let mut stderr = std::io::stderr().lock();
            let _ = writeln!(stderr, "error: {}", e.message);
            if let Some(hint) = hint(e) {
                let _ = writeln!(stderr, "hint: {hint}");
            }
        }
        e.code.exit_code()
    }

    /// Progress of a job, on stderr.
    pub fn progress(&self, job: &Job) {
        if self.json || self.quiet {
            return;
        }
        let pct = job
            .progress
            .map(|p| format!("{:>3.0}%", p * 100.0))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "  …".into());
        let mut stderr = std::io::stderr().lock();
        if std::io::stderr().is_terminal() {
            let _ = write!(stderr, "\r\x1b[2K[{pct}] {} {}", job.kind, job.message);
        } else {
            let _ = writeln!(stderr, "[{pct}] {} {}", job.kind, job.message);
        }
        let _ = stderr.flush();
    }

    /// Ends a progress line.
    pub fn progress_done(&self) {
        if !self.json && !self.quiet && std::io::stderr().is_terminal() {
            eprintln!();
        }
    }

    /// Informational line on stderr.
    pub fn info(&self, text: &str) {
        if !self.json && !self.quiet {
            eprintln!("{text}");
        }
    }
}

fn hint(e: &JidrError) -> Option<&'static str> {
    use jidr_core::ErrorCode::*;
    match e.code {
        DaemonStale => Some("run again with --restart-stale to replace the running daemon"),
        Busy => Some("wait for the running operation, or cancel it with `jidr jobs cancel <job>`"),
        BootTimeout => Some(
            "try `jidr device start <name> --cold-boot`, or see the emulator log with `jidr device details <name>`",
        ),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn s(v: &Value, key: &str) -> String {
    match v.get(key) {
        Some(Value::String(x)) => x.clone(),
        Some(Value::Null) | None => String::new(),
        Some(other) => other.to_string(),
    }
}

/// Left-aligned columns.
pub fn table(headers: &[&str], rows: Vec<Vec<String>>) -> String {
    let mut widths: Vec<usize> = headers.iter().map(|h| h.chars().count()).collect();
    for r in &rows {
        for (i, c) in r.iter().enumerate() {
            if let Some(w) = widths.get_mut(i) {
                *w = (*w).max(c.chars().count());
            }
        }
    }
    let line = |cells: Vec<String>| {
        cells
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(i, c)| format!("{c:<w$}", w = widths.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(0)))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("  ")
            .trim_end()
            .to_string()
    };
    let mut out = vec![line(headers.iter().map(|h| h.to_string()).collect())];
    out.extend(rows.into_iter().map(line));
    out.join("\n")
}

pub fn device_status(d: &Value) -> String {
    let state = d["status"]["state"].as_str().unwrap_or("?").to_string();
    match d["status"]["reason"].as_str() {
        Some(r) => format!("{state} ({r})"),
        None => state,
    }
}

pub fn devices(v: &Value) -> String {
    let rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = v
        .as_array()
        .map(|a| {
            a.iter()
                .map(|d| {
                    vec![
                        s(d, "name"),
                        device_status(d),
                        format!("{}:{}", d["image"]["api"], s(&d["image"], "tag")),
                        s(&d["root"], "mode"),
                        s(&d["runtime"], "adb_serial"),
                    ]
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    if rows.is_empty() {
        return "No devices. Create one with `jidr device create <name> --image 35`.".into();
    }
    table(&["NAME", "STATUS", "IMAGE", "ROOT", "SERIAL"], rows)
}

pub fn device(d: &Value) -> String {
    format!(
        "{}  {}  {}:{}  root {}{}",
        s(d, "name"),
        device_status(d),
        d["image"]["api"],
        s(&d["image"], "tag"),
        s(&d["root"], "mode"),
        d["runtime"]["adb_serial"]
            .as_str()
            .map(|x| format!("  {x}"))
            .unwrap_or_default()
    )
}

pub fn images(v: &Value) -> String {
    let rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = v
        .as_array()
        .map(|a| {
            a.iter()
                .map(|i| {
                    let size = i["size"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0);
                    vec![
                        format!("{}:{}", i["api"], s(i, "tag")),
                        s(i, "abi"),
                        s(i, "revision"),
                        if size > 0 {
                            format!("{:.0} MB", size as f64 / 1e6)
                        } else {
                            String::new()
                        },
                        s(i, "support"),
                        if i["installed_in"].is_string() {
                            "installed".into()
                        } else {
                            String::new()
                        },
                    ]
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    table(&["IMAGE", "ABI", "REVISION", "SIZE", "SUPPORT", ""], rows)
}

pub fn profiles(v: &Value) -> String {
    let rows = v
        .as_array()
        .map(|a| {
            a.iter()
                .map(|p| {
                    vec![
                        s(p, "id"),
                        s(p, "name"),
                        format!("{}×{} @{}dpi", p["width"], p["height"], p["density"]),
                        format!("{} MB", p["ram_mb"]),
                        s(p, "cpus"),
                    ]
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    table(&["ID", "NAME", "SCREEN", "RAM", "CPUS"], rows)
}

pub fn jobs(v: &Value) -> String {
    let rows = v
        .as_array()
        .map(|a| {
            a.iter()
                .map(|j| {
                    vec![
                        s(j, "id"),
                        s(j, "kind"),
                        s(j, "state"),
                        j["progress"]
                            .as_f64()
                            .map(|p| format!("{:.0}%", p * 100.0))
                            .unwrap_or_default(),
                        s(j, "message"),
                    ]
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    table(&["JOB", "KIND", "STATE", "PROGRESS", "MESSAGE"], rows)
}

pub fn commands(v: &Value) -> String {
    let rows = v
        .as_array()
        .map(|a| {
            a.iter()
                .map(|c| {
                    let mut flags = Vec::new();
                    if c["longRunning"] == true {
                        flags.push("job");
                    }
                    if c["destructive"] == true {
                        flags.push("destructive");
                    }
                    vec![s(c, "id"), flags.join(","), s(c, "label")]
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    table(&["COMMAND", "FLAGS", "DESCRIPTION"], rows)
}

/// Pretty JSON for results without a dedicated view.
pub fn pretty(v: &Value) -> String {
    serde_json::to_string_pretty(v).unwrap_or_default()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn tables_align() {

            &["A", "LONGER"],
            vec![vec!["xyz".into(), "1".into()], vec!["q".into(), "".into()]],
        );
        assert_eq!(t, "A    LONGER\nxyz  1\nq");
    }

        let t = devices(&d);
        assert!(t.contains("crashed (boom)"));
        assert!(t.contains("35:google_apis"));
