`apps/jidr/src/uninstall.rs`:

```rs
//! `jidr uninstall [--purge]` (D31): stop everything, remove Jidr's MCP
//! entries, caches and logs, and with `--purge` all Jidr data. Android
//! Studio's SDK and `~/.android` are never touched.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::time::Duration;

use jidr_core::{ErrorCode, JidrError, JidrPaths, JidrResult, ResultExt};
use serde::Serialize;
use serde_json::Value;

/// MCP client configs Jidr may have added itself to.
pub fn mcp_config_paths(home: &Path) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
    let mut v = vec![home.join(".claude.json"), home.join(".cursor/mcp.json")];
    if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
        v.push(home.join("Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json"));
    } else {
        v.push(home.join(".config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json"));
    }
    v
}

/// An entry is Jidr's if it's named `jidr` or runs `jidr mcp`.
pub fn is_jidr_server(name: &str, server: &Value) -> bool {
    if name == "jidr" {
        return true;
    }
    let runs_jidr = server
        .get("command")
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .and_then(|c| {
            Path::new(c)
                .file_name()
                .and_then(|n| n.to_str())
                .map(|n| n == "jidr")
        })
        .unwrap_or(false);
    let mcp_arg = server
        .get("args")
        .and_then(Value::as_array)
        .is_some_and(|a| a.first().and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("mcp"));
    runs_jidr && mcp_arg
}

fn strip(servers: Option<&mut Value>, prefix: &str, removed: &mut Vec<String>) {
    let Some(map) = servers.and_then(Value::as_object_mut) else {
        return;
    };
    let names: Vec<String> = map
        .iter()
        .filter(|(n, v)| is_jidr_server(n, v))
        .map(|(n, _)| n.clone())
        .collect();
    for n in names {
        map.shift_remove(&n);
        removed.push(format!("{prefix}{n}"));
    }
}

/// Removes Jidr's servers from `mcpServers` and (Claude Code) from every
/// `projects.<dir>.mcpServers`. Returns what was removed.
pub fn remove_jidr_entries(doc: &mut Value) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut removed = Vec::new();
    strip(doc.get_mut("mcpServers"), "", &mut removed);
    if let Some(projects) = doc.get_mut("projects").and_then(Value::as_object_mut) {
        for (dir, project) in projects.iter_mut() {
            strip(
                project.get_mut("mcpServers"),
                &format!("{dir}: "),
                &mut removed,
            );
        }
    }
    removed
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
pub struct McpCleanup {
    pub file: PathBuf,
    pub removed: Vec<String>,
    pub backup: PathBuf,
}

/// Cleans every known MCP config under `home`, backing each changed file
/// up to `<file>.jidr-backup` first. Unparseable files are left alone.
pub fn clean_mcp_configs(home: &Path) -> Vec<McpCleanup> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for file in mcp_config_paths(home) {
        let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(&file) else {
            continue;
        };
        let Ok(mut doc) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&text) else {
            tracing::warn!(file = %file.display(), "not JSON; left alone");
            continue;
        };
        let removed = remove_jidr_entries(&mut doc);
        if removed.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let backup = PathBuf::from(format!("{}.jidr-backup", file.display()));
        let Ok(pretty) = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&doc) else {
            continue;
        };
        if std::fs::write(&backup, &text).is_ok() && std::fs::write(&file, pretty + "\n").is_ok() {
            out.push(McpCleanup {
                file,
                removed,
                backup,
            });
        }
    }
    out
}

/// Refuses to delete anything that isn't plainly a Jidr directory.
pub fn safe_to_remove(p: &Path, home: &Path) -> bool {
    let protected = [
        PathBuf::from("/"),
        home.to_path_buf(),
        home.join("Library"),
        home.join("Library/Android"),
        home.join(".android"),
    ];
    let android = [
        home.join("Library/Android"),
        home.join(".android"),
        home.join("Android"),
    ];
    p.is_absolute()
        && p.components().count() > 2
        && !protected.iter().any(|x| x == p)
        && !android.iter().any(|a| p.starts_with(a) || a.starts_with(p))
}

fn remove(p: &Path, home: &Path, removed: &mut Vec<PathBuf>) -> JidrResult<()> {
    if !p.exists() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    if !safe_to_remove(p, home) {
        return Err(JidrError::unexpected(format!(
            "refusing to delete {}",
            p.display()
        )));
    }
    std::fs::remove_dir_all(p).ctx(ErrorCode::Unexpected, format!("deleting {}", p.display()))?;
    removed.push(p.to_path_buf());
    Ok(())
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize)]
pub struct Report {
    pub stopped_devices: Vec<String>,
    pub daemon_stopped: bool,
    pub killed_emulators: Vec<u32>,
    pub mcp: Vec<McpCleanup>,
    pub removed: Vec<PathBuf>,
    pub kept: Vec<PathBuf>,
    pub purged: bool,
}

async fn alive(pid: u32) -> bool {
    jidr_backend::aosp::process_alive(pid).await
}

async fn kill(pid: u32, signal: &str) {
    let _ = tokio::process::Command::new("kill")
        .args([signal, &pid.to_string()])
        .status()
        .await;
}

pub async fn run(paths: &JidrPaths, home: &Path, purge: bool) -> JidrResult<Report> {
    let mut report = Report {
        purged: purge,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let socket = paths.socket();

    // 1. Stop devices gracefully through the daemon, then the daemon.
    if socket.exists() {
        if let Ok(client) = jidr_client::Client::connect(&socket, "cli").await
            && let Ok(list) = client.call("device.list", serde_json::json!({})).await
        {
            for d in list.as_array().into_iter().flatten() {
                let (Some(name), Some(state)) = (d["name"].as_str(), d["status"]["state"].as_str())
                else {
                    continue;
                };
                if !matches!(state, "stopped" | "crashed")
                    && client
                        .call("device.stop", serde_json::json!({ "device": name }))
                        .await
                        .is_ok()
                {
                    report.stopped_devices.push(name.to_string());
                }
            }
        }
        report.daemon_stopped = jidr_client::shutdown_daemon(&socket).await.is_ok();
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&socket);
    }

    // 2. Anything still running a Jidr AVD (e.g. after a crashed daemon).
    for d in jidr_backend::discovery::scan() {
        let Some(info) = jidr_backend::adopt::instance_from(&d, &paths.avd_home()) else {
            continue;
        };
        if !alive(info.pid).await {
            continue;
        }
        kill(info.pid, "-TERM").await;
        for _ in 0..50 {
            if !alive(info.pid).await {
                break;
            }
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
        }
        if alive(info.pid).await {
            kill(info.pid, "-KILL").await;
        }
        report.killed_emulators.push(info.pid);
    }

    // 3. MCP entries (D31).
    report.mcp = clean_mcp_configs(home);

    // 4. Files.
    remove(&paths.cache, home, &mut report.removed)?;
    remove(&paths.logs, home, &mut report.removed)?;
    if purge {
        remove(&paths.data, home, &mut report.removed)?;
    } else if paths.data.exists() {
        report.kept.push(paths.data.clone());
    }
    Ok(report)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use serde_json::json;

    #[test]
    fn strips_only_jidr_servers_keeping_order() {
        let mut doc = json!({
            "theme": "dark",
            "mcpServers": {
                "github": { "command": "gh-mcp" },
                "jidr": { "command": "jidr", "args": ["mcp"] },
                "phone": { "command": "/opt/homebrew/bin/jidr", "args": ["mcp", "--allow-destructive"] },
                "other-jidr-ish": { "command": "jidr", "args": ["device", "list"] }
            },
            "projects": {
                "/src/app": { "mcpServers": { "jidr": { "command": "jidr", "args": ["mcp"] } }, "x": 1 }
            }
        });
        let removed = remove_jidr_entries(&mut doc);
        assert_eq!(removed, vec!["jidr", "phone", "/src/app: jidr"]);
        let keys: Vec<&String> = doc["mcpServers"].as_object().unwrap().keys().collect();
        assert_eq!(
            keys,
            ["github", "other-jidr-ish"],
            "others kept, order preserved"
        );
        assert_eq!(doc["projects"]["/src/app"]["x"], 1);
        let top: Vec<&String> = doc.as_object().unwrap().keys().collect();
        assert_eq!(top, ["theme", "mcpServers", "projects"]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn cleans_files_with_backup() {
        let home = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let cfg = home.path().join(".cursor/mcp.json");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(cfg.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
        let original =
            r#"{"mcpServers":{"jidr":{"command":"jidr","args":["mcp"]},"keep":{"command":"x"}}}"#;
        std::fs::write(&cfg, original).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(home.path().join(".claude.json"), "not json").unwrap();
        let done = clean_mcp_configs(home.path());
        assert_eq!(done.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read_to_string(&done[0].backup).unwrap(), original);
        let now: Value = serde_json::from_str(&std::fs::read_to_string(&cfg).unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert!(now["mcpServers"].get("jidr").is_none());
        assert!(now["mcpServers"].get("keep").is_some());
        assert_eq!(
            std::fs::read_to_string(home.path().join(".claude.json")).unwrap(),
            "not json"
        );
        assert!(clean_mcp_configs(home.path()).is_empty(), "idempotent");
    }

    #[test]
    fn never_removes_android_or_home_dirs() {
        let home = Path::new("/Users/me");
        for bad in [
            "/",
            "/Users/me",
            "/Users/me/Library",
            "/Users/me/Library/Android/sdk",
            "/Users/me/.android/avd",
            "relative/dir",
            "/tmp",
        ] {
            assert!(!safe_to_remove(Path::new(bad), home), "{bad}");
        }
        assert!(safe_to_remove(
            Path::new("/Users/me/Library/Application Support/Jidr"),
            home
        ));
        assert!(safe_to_remove(Path::new("/tmp/jidr-e2e.x/data"), home));
    }
}

#[test]
fn busy_and_timeout() {
    let e = Env::new();
    e.ok(&["device", "create", "Slow", "--image", "35"]);
    let gate = e.backend().gate_starts();
    let pending = e.ok(&["device", "start", "Slow", "--no-wait"]);
    let job = pending[0]["job"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    let err = e.fail(&["device", "stop", "Slow"], 4);
    assert_eq!(err["data"]["holder"], job);
    e.ok(&["jobs", "cancel", &job]);
    let (code, _) = e.json(&["jobs", "wait", &job]);
    assert_ne!(code, 0, "a cancelled job is not a success");

    // --timeout cancels the boot and exits 5 (boot_timeout).
    let err = e.fail(&["device", "start", "Slow", "--timeout", "1"], 5);
    assert!(err["message"].as_str().unwrap().contains("did not boot"));
    let d = e.ok(&["device", "details", "Slow"]);
    assert_eq!(d["device"]["status"]["state"], "stopped");
    gate.add_permits(10);
    e.ok(&["device", "start", "--all"]);
    assert_eq!(
        e.ok(&["device", "stop", "--all"]).as_array().unwrap().len(),
        1
    );
}

`apps/jidr/tests/common/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! Runs the `jidr` binary against an in-process fake daemon (`TestDaemon`).
#![allow(dead_code)]

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use assert_cmd::Command;
use jidr_daemon::testing::TestDaemon;
use serde_json::Value;

pub struct Env {
    _tmp: tempfile::TempDir,
    rt: tokio::runtime::Runtime,
    daemon: Option<TestDaemon>,
    /// `JIDR_HOME` for the CLI.
    pub home: PathBuf,
}

impl Env {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let rt = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().unwrap();
        let daemon = rt.block_on(TestDaemon::start(tmp.path())).unwrap();
        let home = tmp.path().join("j");
        Self {
            _tmp: tmp,
            rt,
            daemon: Some(daemon),
            home,
        }
    }

    pub fn backend(&self) -> &jidr_backend::fake::FakeBackend {
        &self.daemon.as_ref().unwrap().backend
    }

    fn command(&self, args: &[&str]) -> Command {
        let mut c = Command::cargo_bin("jidr").unwrap();
        c.args(args)
            .env("JIDR_HOME", &self.home)
            // Never spawn a real daemon from tests.
            .env("JIDR_DAEMON_BIN", "/nonexistent/jidr")
            .env_remove("JIDR_RESTART_STALE")
            .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(60));
        c
    }

    pub fn jidr(&self, args: &[&str]) -> std::process::Output {
        self.command(args).output().unwrap()
    }

    fn parse(args: &[&str], o: &std::process::Output) -> (i32, Value) {
        let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stdout);
        let v: Value = serde_json::from_str(stdout.lines().last().unwrap_or("null"))
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| {
                panic!(
                    "{args:?}: bad JSON {stdout:?} ({e}); stderr {}",
                    String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stderr)
                )
            });
        assert_eq!(
            v["jidr_json"],
            1,
            "{args:?}: stdout {stdout:?} stderr {}",
            String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stderr)
        );
        (o.status.code().unwrap_or(-1), v)
    }

    /// Runs with --json; returns (exit code, envelope).
    pub fn json(&self, args: &[&str]) -> (i32, Value) {
        let mut all = vec!["--json"];
        all.extend_from_slice(args);
        Self::parse(args, &self.jidr(&all))
    }

    /// Like `json`, with `HOME` pointed somewhere else.
    pub fn json_with_home(&self, args: &[&str], home: &Path) -> (i32, Value) {
        let mut all = vec!["--json"];
        all.extend_from_slice(args);
        Self::parse(
            args,
            &self.command(&all).env("HOME", home).output().unwrap(),
        )
    }

    pub fn ok(&self, args: &[&str]) -> Value {
        let (code, v) = self.json(args);
        assert_eq!(code, 0, "{args:?} → {v}");
        assert_eq!(v["ok"], true);
        v["result"].clone()
    }

    pub fn fail(&self, args: &[&str], exit: i32) -> Value {
        let (code, v) = self.json(args);
        assert_eq!(code, exit, "{args:?} → {v}");
        assert_eq!(v["ok"], false);
        assert_eq!(v["error"]["exit_code"], exit);
        v["error"].clone()
    }
}

impl Drop for Env {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if let Some(d) = self.daemon.take() {
            self.rt.block_on(d.stop());
        }
    }
}

//! Cache, log bundles and uninstall (Phase 5b) through the `jidr` binary.
#![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]

mod common;

use common::Env;
use serde_json::{Value, json};

#[test]
fn cache_and_magisk_import() {
    let e = Env::new();
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&e.home).unwrap();
    let apk = e.home.join("Magisk-v27.0.apk");
    std::fs::write(&apk, b"magisk").unwrap();
    let entry = e.ok(&["cache", "import", apk.to_str().unwrap()]);
    assert_eq!(entry["sha256"].as_str().unwrap().len(), 64);
    e.fail(
        &[
            "cache",
            "import",
            apk.to_str().unwrap(),
            "--sha256",
            &"0".repeat(64),
        ],
        2,
    );
    assert_eq!(e.ok(&["cache", "list"]).as_array().unwrap().len(), 1);
    // --magisk imports the APK before calling root.set (which this build lacks).
    e.ok(&["device", "create", "M", "--image", "35"]);
    let other = e.home.join("other.apk");
    std::fs::write(&other, b"other magisk").unwrap();
    e.fail(
        &[
            "root",
            "set",
            "M",
            "magisk",
            "--magisk",
            other.to_str().unwrap(),
        ],
        2,
    );
    assert_eq!(e.ok(&["cache", "list"]).as_array().unwrap().len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(e.ok(&["cache", "prune"])["removed"], 2);
    assert_eq!(e.ok(&["cache", "list"]), json!([]));
}

#[test]
fn device_log_bundle() {
    let e = Env::new();
    e.ok(&["device", "create", "Logs", "--image", "35"]);
    e.ok(&["device", "start", "Logs"]);
    let out = e.home.join("bundle.zip");
    let v = e.ok(&["device", "logs", "Logs", "--zip", out.to_str().unwrap()]);
    assert!(out.is_file());
    assert!(
        v["files"].as_u64().unwrap() >= 4,
        "device.json, config.ini, logcat, about: {v}"
    );
    let default = e.ok(&["device", "logs", "Logs"]);
    assert!(default["path"].as_str().unwrap().ends_with(".zip"));
}

#[test]
fn uninstall_purge_removes_everything_jidr_and_nothing_else() {
    let e = Env::new();
    let home = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let cursor = home.path().join(".cursor/mcp.json");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(cursor.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(
        &cursor,
        r#"{"mcpServers":{"jidr":{"command":"jidr","args":["mcp"]},"keep":{"command":"x"}}}"#,
    )
    .unwrap();
    // Something that looks like Studio's files must survive.
    let android = home.path().join(".android/avd/Pixel.avd");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&android).unwrap();

    e.ok(&["device", "create", "Gone", "--image", "35"]);
    e.ok(&["device", "start", "Gone"]);
    // Off a terminal, uninstall needs --yes.
    let (code, _) = e.json_with_home(&["uninstall", "--purge"], home.path());
    assert_eq!(code, 2);

    let (code, v) = e.json_with_home(&["uninstall", "--purge", "--yes"], home.path());
    assert_eq!(code, 0, "{v}");
    let r = &v["result"];
    assert_eq!(r["stopped_devices"], json!(["Gone"]));
    assert_eq!(r["daemon_stopped"], true);
    assert_eq!(r["purged"], true);
    assert_eq!(r["mcp"][0]["removed"], json!(["jidr"]));
    let cfg: Value = serde_json::from_str(&std::fs::read_to_string(&cursor).unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert!(cfg["mcpServers"].get("jidr").is_none() && cfg["mcpServers"].get("keep").is_some());
    for d in ["data", "cache", "logs"] {
        assert!(!e.home.join(d).exists(), "{d} remains");
    }
    assert!(android.is_dir(), "never touches ~/.android");
    assert!(e.backend().running().is_empty(), "devices stopped");
}

#[test]
fn uninstall_without_purge_keeps_devices() {
    let e = Env::new();
    let home = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    e.ok(&["device", "create", "Kept", "--image", "35"]);
    let (code, v) = e.json_with_home(&["uninstall", "--yes"], home.path());
    assert_eq!(code, 0, "{v}");
    assert_eq!(v["result"]["purged"], false);
    assert!(e.home.join("data/devices.json").is_file());
    assert_eq!(v["result"]["kept"][0], json!(e.home.join("data")));
}

`assets/brand/README.md`:

```md
# Jidr brand assets

The symbol is a root (جذر) that grows into a phone outline. Everything here is generated from `source/appLogoOnPaper.jpg` by `build.sh`. Don't hand-edit outputs; change `build.sh` and re-run it.

```bash
brew install potrace librsvg imagemagick   # once
assets/brand/build.sh
```

## Colours

| Token | Hex | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Brand blue (top) | `#2A88FA` | icon gradient start |
| Brand blue (bottom) | `#1267E0` | icon gradient end; favicon symbol |
| Lilac | `#B9A6F7` | Arabic wordmark جذر on dark |
| Ink | `#101010` | social card background |

These were sampled from the approved board (`source/brand-board.jpg`). When the design system's `tokens.json` lands in `docs/design/`, it is the source of truth; update the colours in `build.sh` to match and re-run.

## Files

| File | What | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `symbol.svg` | the symbol, `fill="currentColor"` | everything; tint it |
| `symbol-bold.svg` | thicker strokes for ≤32 px | small icons, favicon, menu bar |
| `app-icon.svg` / `app-icon-1024.png` | macOS icon master (1024 canvas, 824 squircle, shadow) | `.icns`, website, docs |
| `app-icon-small.svg` | 16/32 px cut (no shadow, larger body) | `.icns` small sizes, favicon |
| `avatar.svg` / `avatar-1024.png` | circular avatar | GitHub org/repo, social profiles |
| `social-card.svg` / `.png` | 1200×630 preview card | Open Graph / Twitter card |
| `web/` | `favicon.svg`, `favicon.ico`, `favicon-32.png`, `apple-touch-icon.png`, `og-image.png`, `avatar-512.png`, `symbol.svg` | **site** (copied into `site/public/`) |
| `../../apps/jidr-gui/assets/macos/Jidr.icns` | app bundle icon (16–1024, @1x/@2x) | Phase 12a bundle (`CFBundleIconFile`) |
| `../../apps/jidr-gui/assets/macos/AppIcon-1024.png` | master PNG | DMG background / About |
| `../../apps/jidr-gui/assets/menubar/MenuBarTemplate{,@2x}.png` | 18 pt template image (black + alpha; macOS tints it) | menu bar extra (post-MVP) |
| `../../apps/jidr-gui/assets/icons/symbol.svg` | in-app symbol; Slint renders SVG natively, tint with `colorize` | Phase 7a/7b (title bar, empty states, About) |
| `../../apps/jidr-gui/assets/icons/app-icon-256.png` | window/About icon | Phase 7a |

## Rules

- Never recolour the app icon gradient outside the tokens above. Tint `symbol.svg` with text or accent tokens in-app.
- Keep clear space around the symbol of at least ¼ of its width.
- No Google, Android or Genymotion marks next to the symbol.
- Ownership: this folder is shared and read-only for the work streams. Only `build.sh` changes it.

`assets/brand/build.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Regenerates every Jidr brand/icon asset from source/appLogoOnPaper.jpg.
# Requires: potrace, rsvg-convert (librsvg), magick (ImageMagick), iconutil (macOS).
#   brew install potrace librsvg imagemagick
# Usage: assets/brand/build.sh   (run from anywhere; outputs are committed)
set -euo pipefail

BRAND="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
ROOT="$(cd "$BRAND/../.." && pwd)"
GUI="$ROOT/apps/jidr-gui/assets"
WEB="$BRAND/web"
TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT

# Brand colours (sampled from the approved board, source/brand-board.jpg).
TOP="#2A88FA"; BOTTOM="#1267E0"; LILAC="#B9A6F7"; INK="#101010"

mkdir -p "$WEB" "$GUI/macos" "$GUI/menubar" "$GUI/icons"

# 1. Trace the symbol (regular and a bolder cut for ≤32 px).
trace() { # $1 = extra morphology, $2 = output svg
  magick "$BRAND/source/appLogoOnPaper.jpg" -colorspace Gray -blur 0x1 -threshold 45% \
    -morphology Close Disk:1 $1 -trim +repage -bordercolor white -border 4 "$TMP/s.pbm"
  potrace "$TMP/s.pbm" -s --flat -a 1.0 -O 0.4 -t 8 -o "$TMP/raw.svg"
  local vb; vb=$(grep -o 'viewBox="[^"]*"' "$TMP/raw.svg")
  { echo "<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" $vb>"
    sed -n '/<g /,/<\/g>/p' "$TMP/raw.svg" | sed 's/fill="#000000"/fill="currentColor"/'
    echo "</svg>"; } > "$2"
}
trace "" "$BRAND/symbol.svg"
trace "-morphology Erode Disk:14" "$BRAND/symbol-bold.svg"   # Erode on black-on-white = thicker strokes

inner() { sed -n '/<g /,/<\/g>/p' "$1"; }
vbox()  { grep -o 'viewBox="[^"]*"' "$1" | head -1; }

# 2. macOS app icon master: 1024 canvas, 824 squircle body, symbol ≈60% of body.
app_icon() { # $1 = symbol svg, $2 = output svg, $3 = symbol width, $4 = body inset, $5 = shadow (1/0)
  local sw=$3 inset=${4:-100} shadow=${5:-1} sh x y body rx filt=""
  sh=$(( sw * 879 / 851 )); x=$(( 512 - sw / 2 )); y=$(( 512 - sh / 2 ))
  body=$(( 1024 - 2 * inset )); rx=$(( body * 185 / 824 ))
  [ "$shadow" = 1 ] && filt=' filter="url(#shadow)"'
  cat > "$2" <<EOF
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1024 1024">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="$TOP"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="$BOTTOM"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="120%" height="125%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="10" stdDeviation="12" flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.28"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>
  <rect x="$inset" y="$inset" width="$body" height="$body" rx="$rx" fill="url(#bg)"$filt/>
  <svg x="$x" y="$y" width="$sw" height="$sh" $(vbox "$1") color="#FFFFFF">$(inner "$1")</svg>
</svg>
EOF
}
app_icon "$BRAND/symbol.svg"      "$BRAND/app-icon.svg"       494 100 1
app_icon "$BRAND/symbol-bold.svg" "$BRAND/app-icon-small.svg" 640 40  0   # ≤32 px: no shadow, fuller body

# 3. Circular avatar (GitHub org, social).
cat > "$BRAND/avatar.svg" <<EOF
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1024 1024">
  <defs><linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="$TOP"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="$BOTTOM"/></linearGradient></defs>
  <circle cx="512" cy="512" r="512" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <svg x="282" y="274" width="460" height="475" $(vbox "$BRAND/symbol.svg") color="#FFFFFF">$(inner "$BRAND/symbol.svg")</svg>
</svg>
EOF

# 4. Social preview card 1200×630.
cat > "$BRAND/social-card.svg" <<EOF
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 630">
  <defs><linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="$TOP"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="$BOTTOM"/></linearGradient></defs>
  <rect width="1200" height="630" fill="$INK"/>
  <circle cx="250" cy="315" r="160" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <svg x="178" y="241" width="144" height="149" $(vbox "$BRAND/symbol.svg") color="#FFFFFF">$(inner "$BRAND/symbol.svg")</svg>
  <text x="470" y="285" font-family="Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="120" fill="#FFFFFF">Jidr</text>
  <text x="474" y="390" font-family="Geeza Pro, SF Arabic, Noto Naskh Arabic, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="92" fill="$LILAC">جذر</text>
  <text x="472" y="470" font-family="Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="32" fill="#C9C9C9">Android on your Mac. Rooted in a minute.</text>
</svg>
EOF

# 5. Raster masters.
rsvg-convert -w 1024 -h 1024 "$BRAND/app-icon.svg" -o "$BRAND/app-icon-1024.png"
rsvg-convert -w 512 -h 512   "$BRAND/app-icon.svg" -o "$BRAND/app-icon-512.png"  # the MCP bundle icon
rsvg-convert -w 1024 -h 1024 "$BRAND/avatar.svg"   -o "$BRAND/avatar-1024.png"
rsvg-convert -w 1200 -h 630  "$BRAND/social-card.svg" -o "$BRAND/social-card.png"

# 6. macOS .icns (bold cut for 16/32 px).
SET="$TMP/AppIcon.iconset"; mkdir -p "$SET"
for s in 16 32 128 256 512; do
  src="$BRAND/app-icon.svg"; [ "$s" -le 32 ] && src="$BRAND/app-icon-small.svg"
  rsvg-convert -w $s -h $s "$src" -o "$SET/icon_${s}x${s}.png"
  d=$((s*2)); src2="$BRAND/app-icon.svg"; [ "$d" -le 32 ] && src2="$BRAND/app-icon-small.svg"
  rsvg-convert -w $d -h $d "$src2" -o "$SET/icon_${s}x${s}@2x.png"
done
iconutil -c icns "$SET" -o "$GUI/macos/Jidr.icns"
cp "$BRAND/app-icon-1024.png" "$GUI/macos/AppIcon-1024.png"

# 7. Menu bar template (black + alpha; macOS tints it). 18 pt @1x/@2x.
mk_template() { # $1 = px
  local pad=$(( $1 / 9 ))
  rsvg-convert -h $(( $1 - 2*pad )) "$BRAND/symbol-bold.svg" -o "$TMP/t.png"
  magick "$TMP/t.png" -background none -gravity center -extent "${1}x${1}" "$2"
}
mk_template 18 "$GUI/menubar/MenuBarTemplate.png"
mk_template 36 "$GUI/menubar/MenuBarTemplate@2x.png"

# 8. In-app assets for Slint (SVG renders natively; use `colorize` to tint the symbol).
cp "$BRAND/symbol.svg" "$GUI/icons/symbol.svg"
rsvg-convert -w 256 -h 256 "$BRAND/app-icon.svg" -o "$GUI/icons/app-icon-256.png"

# 9. Web set (copied into site/public).
sed "s/currentColor/$BOTTOM/" "$BRAND/symbol-bold.svg" > "$WEB/favicon.svg"
rsvg-convert -w 32 -h 32 "$BRAND/app-icon-small.svg" -o "$WEB/favicon-32.png"
rsvg-convert -w 16 -h 16 "$BRAND/app-icon-small.svg" -o "$TMP/f16.png"
magick "$TMP/f16.png" "$WEB/favicon-32.png" "$WEB/favicon.ico"
rsvg-convert -w 180 -h 180 "$BRAND/app-icon.svg" -o "$WEB/apple-touch-icon.png"
rsvg-convert -w 512 -h 512 "$BRAND/avatar.svg" -o "$WEB/avatar-512.png"
cp "$BRAND/social-card.png" "$WEB/og-image.png"
cp "$BRAND/symbol.svg" "$WEB/symbol.svg"

echo "Brand assets rebuilt."

```

# Pinned Magisk releases (D30). The root engine downloads the first entry at
# runtime and checks its SHA-256 before anything is baked into a ramdisk.
# Magisk is GPL-3.0-only, so Jidr never bundles it: it is fetched from the
# official GitHub release, and the licence and source link are shown to the
# user before the download.
#
# When a new Magisk release is tested and accepted, prepend a new [[magisk]]
# table and keep the old one as a fallback. `version` must match the release
# tag (without the leading `v`) so `magisk -v` output can be compared to it.

[[magisk]]
version = "30.7"
# The official GitHub release asset (also a valid APK, so one file serves both
# the ramdisk payload and `adb install`).
url = "https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk/releases/download/v30.7/Magisk-v30.7.apk"
# SHA-256 of the asset above (from the GitHub release's `digest` field).
sha256 = "e0d32d2123532860f97123d927b1bb86c4e08e6fd8a48bfc6b5bee0afae9ebd5"
license = "GPL-3.0-only"
source = "https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk"

`crates/jidr-adb/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! Async wrapper around the `adb` binary: devices, shell, install, push/pull,
//! logcat, root/unroot, connect. Errors map to Jidr error codes.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::Stdio;
use std::time::Duration;

use jidr_core::{ErrorCode, JidrError, JidrResult};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use tokio::io::{AsyncBufReadExt, BufReader};
use tokio::process::{Child, Command};

/// Default timeout for one adb invocation.
pub const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(120);

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Adb {
    bin: PathBuf,
    serial: Option<String>,
    timeout: Duration,
}

/// Captured result of one adb run.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Output {
    pub status: Option<i32>,
    pub stdout: String,
    pub stderr: String,
}

impl Output {
    pub fn success(&self) -> bool {
        self.status == Some(0)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct DeviceEntry {
    pub serial: String,
    /// `device`, `offline`, `unauthorized`, `recovery`, …
    pub state: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct InstallOptions {
    /// `-r`: replace an installed app.
    pub replace: bool,
    /// `-g`: grant all runtime permissions.
    pub grant_permissions: bool,
    /// `-d`: allow version downgrade.
    pub downgrade: bool,
}

/// Why an install failed, for the UI's signature-mismatch prompt.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct InstallFailure {
    /// e.g. `INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE`.
    pub reason: String,
    /// True when uninstalling the existing app would let the install succeed.
    pub signature_mismatch: bool,
}

impl Adb {
    pub fn new(bin: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Self {
        Self {
            bin: bin.into(),
            serial: None,
            timeout: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
        }
    }

    /// The same adb, targeting one device (`-s <serial>`).
    pub fn device(&self, serial: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            serial: Some(serial.into()),
            ..self.clone()
        }
    }

    pub fn with_timeout(mut self, timeout: Duration) -> Self {
        self.timeout = timeout;
        self
    }

    pub fn serial(&self) -> Option<&str> {
        self.serial.as_deref()
    }

    pub fn bin(&self) -> &Path {
        &self.bin
    }

    fn command(&self, args: &[&str]) -> Command {
        let mut cmd = Command::new(&self.bin);
        if let Some(s) = &self.serial {
            cmd.arg("-s").arg(s);
        }
        cmd.args(args)
            .stdin(Stdio::null())
            .stdout(Stdio::piped())
            .stderr(Stdio::piped())
            .kill_on_drop(true);
        cmd
    }

    /// Runs adb and returns its output, whatever the exit status.
    pub async fn raw(&self, args: &[&str]) -> JidrResult<Output> {
        let child = self.command(args).spawn().map_err(|e| {
            JidrError::sdk(format!("cannot run adb at {}: {e}", self.bin.display()))
        })?;
        let out = tokio::time::timeout(self.timeout, child.wait_with_output())
            .await
            .map_err(|_| {
                JidrError::unexpected(format!(
                    "adb {} timed out after {} s",
                    args.join(" "),
                    self.timeout.as_secs()
                ))
            })?
            .map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(format!("adb {}: {e}", args.join(" "))))?;
        Ok(Output {
            status: out.status.code(),
            stdout: String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).into_owned(),
            stderr: String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr).into_owned(),
        })
    }

    /// Runs adb and fails unless it exits 0.
    pub async fn run(&self, args: &[&str]) -> JidrResult<Output> {
        let out = self.raw(args).await?;
        if out.success() {
            Ok(out)
        } else {
            Err(self.classify(args, &out))
        }
    }

    /// Maps adb's error text to a Jidr error code.
    fn classify(&self, args: &[&str], out: &Output) -> JidrError {
        let text = format!("{}{}", out.stderr, out.stdout);
        let msg = text.trim();
        let code = if msg.contains("not found") && msg.contains("device")
            || msg.contains("no devices/emulators found")
        {
            ErrorCode::NotFound
        } else if msg.contains("device offline") || msg.contains("device still authorizing") {
            ErrorCode::Busy
        } else {
            ErrorCode::Sdk
        };
        JidrError::new(code, format!("adb {} failed: {msg}", args.join(" ")))
            .with_data(serde_json::json!({"status": out.status, "serial": self.serial}))
    }

    pub async fn version(&self) -> JidrResult<String> {
        let out = self.run(&["version"]).await?;
        Ok(out.stdout.lines().next().unwrap_or_default().to_string())
    }

    pub async fn devices(&self) -> JidrResult<Vec<DeviceEntry>> {
        let out = self.run(&["devices"]).await?;
        Ok(parse_devices(&out.stdout))
    }

    /// Runs a shell command and returns `(exit code, stdout)`. adb's shell
    /// protocol v2 propagates the remote exit code.
    pub async fn shell_status(&self, cmd: &str) -> JidrResult<(i32, String)> {
        let out = self.raw(&["shell", cmd]).await?;
        if out.status.is_none()
            || out.stderr.contains("error: device")
            || out.stderr.contains("no devices")
        {
            return Err(self.classify(&["shell", cmd], &out));
        }
        Ok((out.status.unwrap_or(-1), out.stdout))
    }

    /// Runs a shell command; non-zero exit is an error.
    pub async fn shell(&self, cmd: &str) -> JidrResult<String> {
        let out = self.run(&["shell", cmd]).await?;
        Ok(out.stdout)
    }

    pub async fn getprop(&self, name: &str) -> JidrResult<String> {
        Ok(self
            .shell(&format!("getprop {name}"))
            .await?
            .trim()
            .to_string())
    }

    /// Installs an APK. A rejected install returns `sdk` with an
    /// [`InstallFailure`] in `data`.
    pub async fn install(&self, apk: &Path, opts: InstallOptions) -> JidrResult<()> {
        let apk_s = apk.to_string_lossy();
        let mut args = vec!["install"];
        if opts.replace {
            args.push("-r");
        }
        if opts.grant_permissions {
            args.push("-g");
        }
        if opts.downgrade {
            args.push("-d");
        }
        args.push(&apk_s);
        let out = self.raw(&args).await?;
        let text = format!("{}\n{}", out.stdout, out.stderr);
        if out.success() && text.contains("Success") {
            return Ok(());
        }
        match parse_install_failure(&text) {
            Some(f) => Err(JidrError::sdk(format!("install failed: {}", f.reason))
                .with_data(serde_json::to_value(&f).unwrap_or_default())),
            None => Err(self.classify(&args, &out)),
        }
    }

    pub async fn uninstall(&self, package: &str) -> JidrResult<()> {
        let out = self.run(&["uninstall", package]).await?;
        if out.stdout.contains("Success") {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(JidrError::sdk(format!(
                "uninstall {package}: {}",
                out.stdout.trim()
            )))
        }
    }

    pub async fn push(&self, local: &Path, remote: &str) -> JidrResult<()> {
        self.run(&["push", &local.to_string_lossy(), remote])
            .await
            .map(|_| ())
    }

    pub async fn pull(&self, remote: &str, local: &Path) -> JidrResult<()> {
        self.run(&["pull", remote, &local.to_string_lossy()])
            .await
            .map(|_| ())
    }

    /// `logcat -d` with extra filter args.
    pub async fn logcat_dump(&self, args: &[&str]) -> JidrResult<String> {
        let mut all = vec!["logcat", "-d"];
        all.extend_from_slice(args);
        Ok(self.run(&all).await?.stdout)
    }

    pub async fn logcat_clear(&self) -> JidrResult<()> {
        self.run(&["logcat", "-c"]).await.map(|_| ())
    }

    /// Follows logcat; lines arrive on the returned receiver until the child
    /// exits or the receiver is dropped (which kills the child).
    pub fn logcat_follow(&self, args: &[&str]) -> JidrResult<LogcatStream> {
        let mut all = vec!["logcat"];
        all.extend_from_slice(args);
        let mut child = self
            .command(&all)
            .spawn()
            .map_err(|e| JidrError::sdk(format!("cannot run adb logcat: {e}")))?;
        let stdout = child
            .stdout
            .take()
            .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::unexpected("adb logcat has no stdout"))?;
        let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel(1024);
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut lines = BufReader::new(stdout).lines();
            while let Ok(Some(line)) = lines.next_line().await {
                if tx.send(line).await.is_err() {
                    break;
                }
            }
        });
        Ok(LogcatStream { child, lines: rx })
    }

    /// `adb root`. Images that don't allow it ("production builds") fail
    /// with `root_failed`.
    pub async fn root(&self) -> JidrResult<()> {
        self.adbd_mode("root", "restarting adbd as root", "already running as root")
            .await
    }

    pub async fn unroot(&self) -> JidrResult<()> {
        self.adbd_mode(
            "unroot",
            "restarting adbd as non root",
            "not running as root",
        )
        .await
    }

    async fn adbd_mode(&self, verb: &str, restarted: &str, already: &str) -> JidrResult<()> {
        let out = self.raw(&[verb]).await?;
        let text = format!("{}{}", out.stdout, out.stderr);
        if text.contains(restarted) || text.contains(already) {
            return Ok(());
        }
        if text.contains("cannot run as root") || text.contains("production builds") {
            return Err(JidrError::root_failed(format!(
                "adb {verb}: {}",
                text.trim()
            )));
        }
        if out.success() {
            return Ok(());
        }
        Err(self.classify(&[verb], &out))
    }

    /// `adb connect host:port` (needed past the ~16 instances adb scans, D9).
    pub async fn connect(&self, addr: &str) -> JidrResult<()> {
        let out = self.raw(&["connect", addr]).await?;
        if out.stdout.contains("connected to") {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(JidrError::sdk(format!(
                "adb connect {addr}: {}",
                out.stdout.trim()
            )))
        }
    }

    pub async fn disconnect(&self, addr: &str) -> JidrResult<()> {
        self.raw(&["disconnect", addr]).await.map(|_| ())
    }

    /// Waits until `adb -s <serial>` reports `device`.
    pub async fn wait_for_device(&self, timeout: Duration) -> JidrResult<()> {
        let serial = self
            .serial
            .clone()
            .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::usage("wait_for_device needs a serial"))?;
        let deadline = tokio::time::Instant::now() + timeout;
        loop {
            let base = Adb {
                serial: None,
                ..self.clone()
            };
            if base
                .devices()
                .await?
                .iter()
                .any(|d| d.serial == serial && d.state == "device")
            {
                return Ok(());
            }
            if tokio::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
                return Err(JidrError::boot_timeout(format!(
                    "{serial} did not come online"
                )));
            }
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
        }
    }
}

/// A running `adb logcat`; dropping it kills the process.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct LogcatStream {
    child: Child,
    pub lines: tokio::sync::mpsc::Receiver<String>,
}

impl LogcatStream {
    pub async fn stop(mut self) {
        let _ = self.child.kill().await;
    }
}

pub fn parse_devices(text: &str) -> Vec<DeviceEntry> {
    text.lines()
        .skip_while(|l| !l.starts_with("List of devices"))
        .skip(1)
        .filter_map(|l| {
            let mut parts = l.split_whitespace();
            Some(DeviceEntry {
                serial: parts.next()?.to_string(),
                state: parts.next()?.to_string(),
            })
        })
        .collect()
}

/// Extracts `Failure [REASON ...]` or `INSTALL_FAILED_…` from install output.
pub fn parse_install_failure(text: &str) -> Option<InstallFailure> {
    let reason = text
        .split(|c: char| c.is_whitespace() || c == '[' || c == ']' || c == ':')
        .find(|w| w.starts_with("INSTALL_FAILED_") || w.starts_with("INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_"))?
        .to_string();
    let signature_mismatch = matches!(
        reason.as_str(),
        "INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE" | "INSTALL_FAILED_SHARED_USER_INCOMPATIBLE"
    );
    Some(InstallFailure {
        reason,
        signature_mismatch,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn parses_device_list() {
        let text = "* daemon started successfully\nList of devices attached\nemulator-5554\tdevice\n127.0.0.1:5585\toffline\n\n";
        assert_eq!(
            parse_devices(text),
            vec![
                DeviceEntry {
                    serial: "emulator-5554".into(),
                    state: "device".into()
                },
                DeviceEntry {
                    serial: "127.0.0.1:5585".into(),
                    state: "offline".into()
                },
            ]
        );
        assert!(parse_devices("List of devices attached\n").is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_install_failures() {
        let f = parse_install_failure(
            "Performing Streamed Install\nadb: failed to install x.apk: Failure [INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE: Existing package com.x signatures do not match]",
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(f.reason, "INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE");
        assert!(f.signature_mismatch);
        let f = parse_install_failure("Failure [INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE]").unwrap();
        assert!(!f.signature_mismatch);
        assert!(parse_install_failure("Success").is_none());
    }
}

`crates/jidr-adb/tests/fake_adb.rs`:

```rs
//! `jidr-adb` against a fake `adb` shell script: argument passing, output
//! parsing and error classification without a real device.
#![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::time::Duration;

use jidr_adb::{Adb, InstallOptions};
use jidr_core::ErrorCode;

const FAKE: &str = r#"#!/bin/bash
echo "$*" >> "$(dirname "$0")/calls.log"
serial=""
if [ "$1" = "-s" ]; then serial="$2"; shift 2; fi
if [ "$serial" = "emulator-9999" ]; then
  echo "error: device 'emulator-9999' not found" >&2; exit 1
fi
case "$1" in
  version) echo "Android Debug Bridge version 1.0.41";;
  devices) printf 'List of devices attached\nemulator-5554\tdevice\nemulator-5556\toffline\n\n';;
  shell)
    case "$2" in
      "getprop sys.boot_completed") echo 1;;
      "exit 3") echo partial; exit 3;;
      *) echo "ran: $2";;
    esac;;
  install)
    apk="${@: -1}"
    if [[ "$apk" == *bad-sig* ]]; then
      echo "Performing Streamed Install"
      echo "adb: failed to install $apk: Failure [INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE: Existing package signatures do not match]" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "Performing Streamed Install"; echo "Success";;
  uninstall) echo "Success";;
  push) echo "$2: 1 file pushed";;
  pull) touch "$3"; echo "$2: 1 file pulled";;
  root)
    if [ "$serial" = "emulator-5556" ]; then echo "adbd cannot run as root in production builds"; exit 1; fi
    echo "restarting adbd as root";;
  unroot) echo "restarting adbd as non root";;
  connect) echo "connected to $2";;
  logcat)
    if [ "$2" = "-d" ]; then echo "D/tag: one"; echo "D/tag: two";
    elif [ "$2" = "-c" ]; then :;
    else echo "I/live: a"; echo "I/live: b"; sleep 30; fi;;
  slow) sleep 10;;
  *) echo "unknown command $1" >&2; exit 1;;
esac
"#;

fn fake() -> (tempfile::TempDir, Adb) {
    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let bin = dir.path().join("adb");
    std::fs::write(&bin, FAKE).unwrap();
    #[cfg(unix)]
    {
        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
        std::fs::set_permissions(&bin, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).unwrap();
    }
    (dir, Adb::new(bin))
}

fn calls(dir: &Path) -> Vec<String> {
    std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join("calls.log"))
        .unwrap_or_default()
        .lines()
        .map(str::to_string)
        .collect()
}

async fn install_success_and_signature_mismatch() {
    let (dir, adb) = fake();
    let dev = adb.device("emulator-5554");
    let opts = InstallOptions {
        replace: true,
        grant_permissions: true,
        downgrade: false,

    assert!(
        calls(dir.path())
            .iter()
            .any(|c| c.ends_with("install -r -g /tmp/app.apk"))
    );

    let err = dev
        .install(Path::new("/tmp/bad-sig.apk"), InstallOptions::default())
        .await
        .unwrap_err();

    let data = err.data.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(data["reason"], "INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE");
    assert_eq!(data["signature_mismatch"], true);
    dev.uninstall("com.example").await.unwrap();
}

```rs
//! Re-adopting emulators that kept running across a daemon restart.

use std::path::Path;

use chrono::Utc;

use crate::discovery::{self, Discovery};
use crate::ports::Ports;
use crate::{InstanceInfo, aosp};

/// Turns a discovery file into an `InstanceInfo` if it belongs to an AVD
/// under `avd_home` (Jidr's own; emulators started by Android Studio are left
/// alone).
pub fn instance_from(d: &Discovery, avd_home: &Path) -> Option<InstanceInfo> {
    let avd_dir = d.avd_dir()?;
    let home = std::fs::canonicalize(avd_home).unwrap_or_else(|_| avd_home.to_path_buf());
    let dir = std::fs::canonicalize(&avd_dir).unwrap_or(avd_dir);
    if !dir.starts_with(&home) {
        return None;
    }
    let console = d.console_port()?;
    let ports = Ports {
        console,
        adb: d.adb_port().unwrap_or(console + 1),
        grpc: d.grpc_port()?,
    };
    Some(InstanceInfo {
        avd: d.avd_id()?.to_string(),
        pid: d.pid,
        console_port: ports.console,
        adb_port: ports.adb,
        grpc_port: ports.grpc,
        adb_serial: ports.adb_serial(),
        grpc_token: d.grpc_token()?.to_string(),
        // The discovery file doesn't record the start time.
        started_at: Utc::now(),
        log_path: None,
    })
}

impl aosp::AospBackend {
    /// Finds live emulators running Jidr AVDs and claims their ports.
    pub async fn adopt_running(&self, avd_home: &Path) -> Vec<InstanceInfo> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        for d in discovery::scan() {
            let Some(info) = instance_from(&d, avd_home) else {
                continue;
            };
            if !aosp::process_alive(info.pid).await {
                continue;
            }
            self.ports().claim(info.ports());
            tracing::info!(avd = %info.avd, pid = info.pid, "adopted running emulator");
            out.push(info);
        }
        out
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn only_jidr_avds_are_adopted() {
        let home = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let ours = home.path().join("phone.avd");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&ours).unwrap();
        let text = |dir: &Path| {
            format!(
                "port.serial=5590\nport.adb=5591\ngrpc.port=9001\ngrpc.token=tok\navd.id=phone\navd.dir={}\n",
                dir.display()
            )
        };
        let d = discovery::parse(Path::new("/r/pid_77.ini"), &text(&ours)).unwrap();
        let info = instance_from(&d, home.path()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(info.pid, 77);
        assert_eq!(info.adb_serial, "127.0.0.1:5591");
        assert_eq!(info.grpc_token, "tok");

        let studio = discovery::parse(
            Path::new("/r/pid_78.ini"),
            &text(Path::new("/Users/x/.android/avd/Pixel.avd")),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(instance_from(&studio, home.path()).is_none());
    }
}

`crates/jidr-backend/src/aosp.rs`:

```rs
//! The AOSP emulator backend: spawn headless with gRPC, wait for boot, stop.

use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::path::Path;
use std::process::Stdio;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::Duration;

use async_trait::async_trait;
use chrono::Utc;
use jidr_adb::Adb;
use jidr_core::{Cancel, ErrorCode, JidrError, JidrResult, ResultExt};
use jidr_proto::control::{VmRunState, vm_run_state::RunState};
use tokio::process::Command;
use tokio::sync::watch;
use tokio::time::{Instant, sleep, timeout};

use crate::grpc;
use crate::ports::{PortAllocator, Ports};
use crate::{
    Backend, BootProgress, BootStage, InstanceInfo, LaunchOptions, LaunchSpec, default_gpu,
};

/// How long the emulator gets to write its discovery file.
const DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(90);
/// How long a graceful shutdown (which saves the quick-boot snapshot) may take.
const SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(120);

/// Exit status of an emulator we spawned: `None` while running.
pub type ExitWatch = watch::Receiver<Option<Option<i32>>>;

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct AospBackend {
    ports: PortAllocator,
    /// Exit watchers of the emulators this process spawned, by pid.
    exits: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<u32, ExitWatch>>>,
    /// AVDs being launched right now (before the emulator holds its lock).
    launching: Arc<Mutex<HashSet<std::path::PathBuf>>>,
}

impl AospBackend {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    pub fn ports(&self) -> &PortAllocator {
        &self.ports
    }

    /// Watches the exit of a spawned emulator (crash detection).
    pub fn exit_watch(&self, pid: u32) -> Option<ExitWatch> {
        self.exits
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
            .get(&pid)
            .cloned()
    }

    /// The emulator command line (without the binary).
    pub fn args(spec: &LaunchSpec, opts: &LaunchOptions, ports: Ports) -> Vec<String> {
        let mut a: Vec<String> = [
            "-avd",
            &spec.avd,
            "-no-window",
            "-no-boot-anim",
            "-grpc-use-token",
        ]
        .iter()
        .map(|s| s.to_string())
        .collect();
        a.splice(
            2..2,
            ["-sysdir".into(), spec.sysdir.to_string_lossy().into_owned()],
        );
        a.extend(["-grpc".into(), ports.grpc.to_string()]);
        a.extend(["-port".into(), ports.console.to_string()]);
        a.extend([
            "-gpu".into(),
            opts.gpu.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| default_gpu().into()),
        ]);
        if opts.cold_boot {
            a.push("-no-snapshot-load".into());
        }
        if !opts.snapshot_save {
            a.push("-no-snapshot-save".into());
        }
        if opts.wipe {
            a.push("-wipe-data".into());
        }
        if !opts.audio {
            a.push("-no-audio".into());
        }
        for (flag, cam) in [
            ("-camera-back", &opts.camera_back),
            ("-camera-front", &opts.camera_front),
        ] {
            if let Some(c) = cam {
                a.extend([flag.to_string(), c.clone()]);
            }
        }
        if let Some(r) = &opts.ramdisk {
            a.extend(["-ramdisk".into(), r.to_string_lossy().into_owned()]);
        }
        a.extend(opts.extra_args.iter().cloned());
        a
    }

    async fn launch(
        &self,
        spec: &LaunchSpec,
        opts: &LaunchOptions,
        ports: Ports,
        progress: BootProgress<'_>,
        cancel: &Cancel,
    ) -> JidrResult<InstanceInfo> {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&spec.log_dir).ctx(
            ErrorCode::Sdk,
            format!("creating {}", spec.log_dir.display()),
        )?;
        let log_path = spec.log_dir.join(format!(
            "emulator-{}.log",
            Utc::now().format("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
        ));
        let log = std::fs::File::create(&log_path)
            .ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, format!("creating {}", log_path.display()))?;
        let log_err = log
            .try_clone()
            .ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, "duplicating log handle")?;
        let args = Self::args(spec, opts, ports);
        tracing::info!(avd = %spec.avd, ?ports, "starting emulator: {}", args.join(" "));
        let mut child = Command::new(&spec.emulator)
            .args(&args)
            .env("ANDROID_AVD_HOME", &spec.avd_home)
            .env("ANDROID_SDK_ROOT", &spec.sdk_root)
            .stdin(Stdio::null())
            .stdout(Stdio::from(log))
            .stderr(Stdio::from(log_err))
            .spawn()
            .map_err(|e| JidrError::sdk(format!("cannot run {}: {e}", spec.emulator.display())))?;
        let pid = child
            .id()
            .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::unexpected("emulator exited before it had a pid"))?;
        let (tx, rx) = watch::channel(None);
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let code = child.wait().await.ok().and_then(|s| s.code());
            let _ = tx.send(Some(code));
        });
        self.exits
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
            .insert(pid, rx.clone());
        progress(BootStage::Spawned);

        let result = self
            .wait_boot(spec, opts, ports, pid, &log_path, &rx, progress, cancel)
            .await;
        if result.is_err() {
            kill(pid).await;
            self.exits
                .lock()
                .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
                .remove(&pid);
        }
        result
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    async fn wait_boot(
        &self,
        spec: &LaunchSpec,
        opts: &LaunchOptions,
        ports: Ports,
        pid: u32,
        log_path: &Path,
        exit: &ExitWatch,
        progress: BootProgress<'_>,
        cancel: &Cancel,
    ) -> JidrResult<InstanceInfo> {
        let started = Instant::now();
        let check = |stage: &str| -> JidrResult<()> {
            cancel.check()?;
            if let Some(code) = *exit.borrow() {
                return Err(JidrError::sdk(format!(
                    "emulator exited ({}) while {stage}; see {}",
                    code.map(|c| c.to_string())
                        .unwrap_or_else(|| "signal".into()),
                    log_path.display()
                ))
                .with_data(serde_json::json!({"log": log_path, "tail": log_tail(log_path, 20)})));
            }
            if started.elapsed() > opts.boot_timeout {
                return Err(JidrError::boot_timeout(format!(
                    "{} did not boot within {} s ({stage}); see {}",
                    spec.avd,
                    opts.boot_timeout.as_secs(),
                    log_path.display()
                ))
                .with_data(serde_json::json!({"log": log_path})));
            }
            Ok(())
        };

        // 1. Discovery file → gRPC token.
        let disc_deadline = Instant::now() + DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT;
        let (token, ports) = loop {
            check("starting")?;
            if let Some(d) = crate::discovery::find(pid, ports.grpc)
                && let Some(t) = d.grpc_token()
            {
                // Trust the ports the emulator actually bound: if another
                // process took our console port first, the emulator falls
                // back to a different one.
                let actual = d.ports().unwrap_or(ports);
                if actual != ports {
                    tracing::warn!(
                        ?ports,
                        ?actual,
                        "emulator bound different ports than requested"
                    );
                    // (If the boot then fails, the actual pair stays reserved
                    // until restart; allocation skips it, nothing breaks.)
                    self.ports().release(ports);
                    self.ports().claim(actual);
                }
                break (t.to_string(), actual);
            }
            if Instant::now() > disc_deadline {
                return Err(JidrError::sdk(format!(
                    "emulator wrote no discovery file within {} s; see {}",
                    DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT.as_secs(),
                    log_path.display()
                )));
            }
            sleep(Duration::from_millis(250)).await;
        };
        let (mut controller, _) = loop {
            check("connecting gRPC")?;
            if let Ok(c) = grpc::connect_port(ports.grpc, &token).await {
                break c;
            }
            sleep(Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
        };
        progress(BootStage::GrpcReady);

        // 2. adb.
        let serial = ports.adb_serial();
        let adb = Adb::new(&spec.adb)
            .device(&serial)
            .with_timeout(Duration::from_secs(30));
        loop {
            check("waiting for adb")?;
            if !ports.auto_discovered() {
                let _ = Adb::new(&spec.adb).connect(&serial).await;
            }
            if adb.wait_for_device(Duration::from_secs(2)).await.is_ok() {
                break;
            }
        }
        progress(BootStage::AdbOnline);

        // 3. Boot completed: the emulator's own flag and the guest property.
        loop {
            check("booting")?;
            let booted = match controller.get_status(()).await {
                Ok(s) => s.get_ref().booted,
                // A wrong token never fixes itself: fail now, not at the timeout.
                Err(s)
                    if s.code() == tonic::Code::Unauthenticated
                        || s.code() == tonic::Code::PermissionDenied =>
                {
                    return Err(grpc::status_error("emulator rejected the gRPC token", s));
                }
                Err(_) => false,
            };
            if booted && adb.getprop("sys.boot_completed").await.ok().as_deref() == Some("1") {
                break;
            }
            sleep(Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
        }
        progress(BootStage::Booted);
        tracing::info!(avd = %spec.avd, pid, secs = started.elapsed().as_secs_f32(), "booted");

        Ok(InstanceInfo {
            avd: spec.avd.clone(),
            pid,
            console_port: ports.console,
            adb_port: ports.adb,
            grpc_port: ports.grpc,
            adb_serial: serial,
            grpc_token: token,
            started_at: Utc::now(),
            log_path: Some(log_path.to_path_buf()),
        })
    }

    async fn wait_exit(&self, instance: &InstanceInfo, within: Duration) -> bool {
        if let Some(mut rx) = self.exit_watch(instance.pid) {
            return timeout(within, rx.wait_for(Option::is_some)).await.is_ok();
        }
        let deadline = Instant::now() + within;
        while Instant::now() < deadline {
            if !process_alive(instance.pid).await {
                return true;
            }
            sleep(Duration::from_millis(250)).await;
        }
        false
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl Backend for AospBackend {
    async fn start(
        &self,
        spec: &LaunchSpec,
        opts: &LaunchOptions,
        progress: BootProgress<'_>,
        cancel: &Cancel,
    ) -> JidrResult<InstanceInfo> {
        // Refuse an AVD that is already running: started by Android Studio,
        // another Jidr, or a launch still in progress here.
        if jidr_sdk::AvdManager::new(&spec.avd_home).is_running(&spec.avd) {
            return Err(JidrError::busy(format!(
                "{} is already running in another emulator (Android Studio or another Jidr)",
                spec.avd
            )));
        }
        let key = spec.avd_home.join(&spec.avd);
        if !self
            .launching
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
            .insert(key.clone())
        {
            return Err(JidrError::busy(format!("{} is already starting", spec.avd)));
        }
        let mut in_use = HashSet::new();
        for d in crate::discovery::scan() {
            if let Some(p) = d.ports()
                && process_alive(d.pid).await
            {
                in_use.extend([p.console, p.adb]);
            }
        }
        let result = match self.ports.allocate_avoiding(&in_use) {
            Ok(ports) => {
                let r = self.launch(spec, opts, ports, progress, cancel).await;
                if r.is_err() {
                    self.ports.release(ports);
                }
                r
            }
            Err(e) => Err(e),
        };
        self.launching
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
            .remove(&key);
        result
    }

    async fn stop(&self, instance: &InstanceInfo) -> JidrResult<()> {
        let graceful = match grpc::connect(instance).await {
            Ok((mut c, _)) => c
                .set_vm_state(VmRunState {
                    state: RunState::Shutdown as i32,
                })
                .await
                .is_ok(),
            Err(_) => false,
        };
        if !(graceful && self.wait_exit(instance, SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT).await) {
            tracing::warn!(
                pid = instance.pid,
                graceful,
                "emulator did not shut down; killing"
            );
            kill(instance.pid).await;
            self.wait_exit(instance, Duration::from_secs(10)).await;
        }
        if !instance.ports().auto_discovered() {
            // The adb binary isn't known here; the daemon disconnects TCP serials.
            tracing::debug!(serial = %instance.adb_serial, "tcp adb serial left for the daemon to disconnect");
        }
        self.exits
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
            .remove(&instance.pid);
        self.ports.release(instance.ports());
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn is_alive(&self, instance: &InstanceInfo) -> bool {
        match self.exit_watch(instance.pid) {
            Some(rx) => rx.borrow().is_none(),
            None => process_alive(instance.pid).await,
        }
    }

    async fn adopt(&self, avd_home: &Path) -> Vec<InstanceInfo> {
        self.adopt_running(avd_home).await
    }

    async fn wait_for_crash(&self, instance: &InstanceInfo, log_dir: &Path) -> crate::CrashReport {
        self.crash_watch(instance, log_dir).await
    }
}

pub async fn process_alive(pid: u32) -> bool {
    Command::new("kill")
        .args(["-0", &pid.to_string()])
        .stderr(Stdio::null())
        .status()
        .await
        .map(|s| s.success())
        .unwrap_or(false)
}

async fn kill(pid: u32) {
    let _ = Command::new("kill")
        .args(["-9", &pid.to_string()])
        .stderr(Stdio::null())
        .status()
        .await;
}

/// The last `n` lines of a log file, for error reports.
pub fn log_tail(path: &Path, n: usize) -> Vec<String> {
    std::fs::read_to_string(path)
        .map(|t| {
            let lines: Vec<&str> = t.lines().collect();
            lines[lines.len().saturating_sub(n)..]
                .iter()
                .map(|s| s.to_string())
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

            "-camera-back webcam0",
            "-camera-front emulated",
        ] {
            assert!(all.contains(want), "missing {want}: {all}");
        }
        assert!(all.ends_with("-feature -SystemAsRoot"), "extra args last");
    }

    #[test]
    fn log_tail_returns_last_lines() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let p = dir.path().join("l.log");
        std::fs::write(&p, "a\nb\nc\nd\n").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(log_tail(&p, 2), vec!["c", "d"]);
        assert!(log_tail(&dir.path().join("missing"), 2).is_empty());

    /// A fake `emulator` that exits immediately: start fails fast with the
    /// log path, and the ports go back to the pool.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn early_exit_is_reported_with_log() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let emu = dir.path().join("emulator");
        std::fs::write(&emu, "#!/bin/sh\necho 'FATAL: no such AVD' >&2\nexit 1\n").unwrap();
        #[cfg(unix)]
        {
            use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
            std::fs::set_permissions(&emu, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).unwrap();
        }
        let s = LaunchSpec {
            emulator: emu,
            log_dir: dir.path().join("logs"),
            ..spec()
        };
        let backend = AospBackend::new();
        let stages = Mutex::new(Vec::new());
        let err = backend
            .start(
                &s,
                &LaunchOptions::default(),
                &|st| stages.lock().unwrap().push(st),
                &Cancel::new(),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(err.code, ErrorCode::Sdk, "{err}");
        assert!(err.message.contains("exited"), "{err}");
        let tail = err.data.unwrap()["tail"].clone();
        assert!(tail.to_string().contains("no such AVD"), "{tail}");
        assert_eq!(*stages.lock().unwrap(), vec![BootStage::Spawned]);
        // Ports were released: the same pair is handed out again.
        let again = backend.ports().allocate().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(again.console % 2, 0);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn cancel_stops_a_boot() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();

        std::fs::write(&emu, "#!/bin/sh\nsleep 30\n").unwrap();

        }
        let s = LaunchSpec {
            emulator: emu,
            log_dir: dir.path().join("logs"),
            ..spec()
        };
        let backend = AospBackend::new();
        let cancel = Cancel::new();
        let c2 = cancel.clone();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            sleep(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
            c2.cancel();
        });
        let err = backend
            .start(&s, &LaunchOptions::default(), &|_| {}, &cancel)
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert!(jidr_core::cancel::is_cancelled(&err), "{err}");
    }

```rs
//! The emulator's telnet console (`127.0.0.1:<console port>`), for what gRPC
//! doesn't cover: network speed/delay, gsm, power ac/health.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::time::Duration;

use jidr_core::{ErrorCode, JidrError, JidrResult, ResultExt};
use tokio::io::{AsyncBufReadExt, AsyncWriteExt, BufReader};
use tokio::net::TcpStream;
use tokio::net::tcp::{OwnedReadHalf, OwnedWriteHalf};
use tokio::time::timeout;

const IO_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);

/// The token file the emulator creates for console auth.
pub fn default_token_path() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    dirs::home_dir().map(|h| h.join(".emulator_console_auth_token"))
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Console {
    reader: BufReader<OwnedReadHalf>,
    writer: OwnedWriteHalf,
}

impl Console {
    /// Connects and authenticates with the token in `token_file` (an empty
    /// or missing file means the console has auth disabled).
    pub async fn connect(port: u16, token_file: Option<&Path>) -> JidrResult<Self> {
        let stream = timeout(IO_TIMEOUT, TcpStream::connect(("127.0.0.1", port)))
            .await
            .map_err(|_| JidrError::sdk(format!("emulator console on {port} timed out")))?
            .ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, format!("emulator console on {port}"))?;
        let (r, w) = stream.into_split();
        let mut console = Self {
            reader: BufReader::new(r),
            writer: w,
        };
        let banner = console.read_reply().await?;
        if banner.iter().any(|l| l.contains("Authentication required")) {
            let token = token_file
                .and_then(|p| std::fs::read_to_string(p).ok())
                .map(|t| t.trim().to_string())
                .filter(|t| !t.is_empty())
                .ok_or_else(|| {
                    JidrError::sdk("emulator console needs auth but no token file was found")
                })?;
            console.command(&format!("auth {token}")).await?;
        }
        Ok(console)
    }

    /// Reads lines until `OK` (returns the lines before it) or `KO: msg`.
    async fn read_reply(&mut self) -> JidrResult<Vec<String>> {
        let mut lines = Vec::new();
        loop {
            let mut line = String::new();
            let n = timeout(IO_TIMEOUT, self.reader.read_line(&mut line))
                .await
                .map_err(|_| JidrError::sdk("emulator console reply timed out"))?
                .ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, "reading emulator console")?;
            if n == 0 {
                return Err(JidrError::sdk("emulator console closed the connection"));
            }
            let line = line.trim_end_matches(['\r', '\n']).to_string();
            if line == "OK" {
                return Ok(lines);
            }
            if let Some(msg) = line.strip_prefix("KO:") {
                return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
                    "emulator console: {}",
                    msg.trim()
                )));
            }
            lines.push(line);
        }
    }

    /// Sends one command and returns its output lines (without `OK`).
    pub async fn command(&mut self, cmd: &str) -> JidrResult<Vec<String>> {
        if cmd.contains(['\r', '\n']) {
            return Err(JidrError::usage("console commands are a single line"));
        }
        timeout(
            IO_TIMEOUT,
            self.writer.write_all(format!("{cmd}\r\n").as_bytes()),
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|_| JidrError::sdk("emulator console write timed out"))?
        .ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, "writing emulator console")?;
        self.read_reply().await
    }

    pub async fn avd_name(&mut self) -> JidrResult<String> {
        Ok(self
            .command("avd name")
            .await?
            .join("\n")
            .trim()
            .to_string())
    }

    /// `gsm`, `hscsd`, `gprs`, `edge`, `umts`, `hsdpa`, `lte`, `evdo`, `full`,
    /// or `<up>:<down>` kbps.
    pub async fn network_speed(&mut self, speed: &str) -> JidrResult<()> {
        check_word(speed)?;
        self.command(&format!("network speed {speed}"))
            .await
            .map(|_| ())
    }

    /// `gprs`, `edge`, `umts`, `none`, or `<min>:<max>` ms.
    pub async fn network_delay(&mut self, delay: &str) -> JidrResult<()> {
        check_word(delay)?;
        self.command(&format!("network delay {delay}"))
            .await
            .map(|_| ())
    }

    /// `gsm signal <rssi 0..31> [<ber 0..7>]`.
    pub async fn gsm_signal(&mut self, rssi: u8, ber: Option<u8>) -> JidrResult<()> {
        if rssi > 31 || ber.is_some_and(|b| b > 7) {
            return Err(JidrError::usage("gsm signal: rssi 0..31, ber 0..7"));
        }
        let cmd = match ber {
            Some(b) => format!("gsm signal {rssi} {b}"),
            None => format!("gsm signal {rssi}"),
        };
        self.command(&cmd).await.map(|_| ())
    }

    /// `gsm data|voice <unregistered|home|roaming|searching|denied|off|on>`.
    pub async fn gsm_state(&mut self, which: GsmLine, state: &str) -> JidrResult<()> {
        const STATES: &[&str] = &[
            "unregistered",
            "home",
            "roaming",
            "searching",
            "denied",
            "off",
            "on",
        ];
        if !STATES.contains(&state) {
            return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
                "gsm state must be one of {}",
                STATES.join(", ")
            )));
        }
        let line = match which {
            GsmLine::Data => "data",
            GsmLine::Voice => "voice",
        };
        self.command(&format!("gsm {line} {state}"))
            .await
            .map(|_| ())
    }

    pub async fn power_ac(&mut self, on: bool) -> JidrResult<()> {
        self.command(if on { "power ac on" } else { "power ac off" })
            .await
            .map(|_| ())
    }

    /// `unknown|good|overheat|dead|overvoltage|failure`.
    pub async fn power_health(&mut self, health: &str) -> JidrResult<()> {
        check_word(health)?;
        self.command(&format!("power health {health}"))
            .await
            .map(|_| ())
    }

    /// Asks the emulator to exit (no graceful snapshot save guarantee).
    pub async fn kill(mut self) -> JidrResult<()> {
        // The emulator may close the socket before answering.
        let _ = self.command("kill").await;
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum GsmLine {
    Data,
    Voice,
}

fn check_word(arg: &str) -> JidrResult<()> {
    if !arg.is_empty()
        && arg
            .chars()
            .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == ':' || c == '.')
    {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
            "invalid console argument {arg:?}"
        )))
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use tokio::net::TcpListener;

    /// A fake console: auth required, records commands, answers like the emulator.
    async fn fake_console(token: &'static str) -> (u16, tokio::task::JoinHandle<Vec<String>>) {
        let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
        let port = listener.local_addr().unwrap().port();
        let handle = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let (sock, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
            let (r, mut w) = sock.into_split();
            let mut r = BufReader::new(r);
            w.write_all(b"Android Console: Authentication required\r\nAndroid Console: type 'auth <auth_token>' to authenticate\r\nOK\r\n")
                .await
                .unwrap();
            let mut seen = Vec::new();
            let mut authed = false;
            loop {
                let mut line = String::new();
                if r.read_line(&mut line).await.unwrap() == 0 {
                    return seen;
                }
                let cmd = line.trim().to_string();
                seen.push(cmd.clone());
                let reply: String = if let Some(t) = cmd.strip_prefix("auth ") {
                    authed = t == token;
                    if authed {
                        "Android Console: type 'help'\r\nOK\r\n".into()
                    } else {
                        "KO: authentication token does not match\r\n".into()
                    }
                } else if !authed {
                    "KO: unknown command, try 'help'\r\n".into()
                } else if cmd == "avd name" {
                    "Phone_6_1\r\nOK\r\n".into()
                } else if cmd.starts_with("network speed bogus") {
                    "KO: invalid speed\r\n".into()
                } else {
                    "OK\r\n".into()
                };
                w.write_all(reply.as_bytes()).await.unwrap();
            }
        });
        (port, handle)
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn authenticates_and_runs_commands() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let token = dir.path().join("token");
        std::fs::write(&token, "s3cret\n").unwrap();
        let (port, server) = fake_console("s3cret").await;
        let mut c = Console::connect(port, Some(&token)).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(c.avd_name().await.unwrap(), "Phone_6_1");
        c.network_speed("edge").await.unwrap();
        c.network_delay("100:200").await.unwrap();
        c.gsm_signal(20, Some(3)).await.unwrap();
        c.gsm_state(GsmLine::Data, "roaming").await.unwrap();
        c.power_ac(false).await.unwrap();
        c.power_health("overheat").await.unwrap();
        let err = c.network_speed("bogus").await.unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(err.code, ErrorCode::Usage);
        assert!(err.message.contains("invalid speed"));
        drop(c);
        let seen = server.await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(seen[0], "auth s3cret");
        assert!(seen.contains(&"gsm data roaming".to_string()));
        assert!(seen.contains(&"power ac off".to_string()));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn wrong_token_and_bad_arguments() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let token = dir.path().join("token");
        std::fs::write(&token, "nope").unwrap();
        let (port, _server) = fake_console("s3cret").await;
        assert!(Console::connect(port, Some(&token)).await.is_err());

        let (port, _server) = fake_console("t").await;
        std::fs::write(&token, "t").unwrap();
        let mut c = Console::connect(port, Some(&token)).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            c.network_speed("edge; kill").await.unwrap_err().code,
            ErrorCode::Usage
        );
        assert_eq!(
            c.gsm_signal(40, None).await.unwrap_err().code,
            ErrorCode::Usage
        );
        assert_eq!(
            c.gsm_state(GsmLine::Voice, "maybe").await.unwrap_err().code,
            ErrorCode::Usage
        );
        assert_eq!(c.command("a\nb").await.unwrap_err().code, ErrorCode::Usage);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn missing_token_file_is_a_clear_error() {
        let (port, _server) = fake_console("t").await;
        let err = Console::connect(port, Some(Path::new("/nonexistent/token")))
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert!(err.message.contains("token"), "{err}");
    }
}
