```rs
// ---- helpers ------------------------------------------------------------

/// The root mode `device.create` uses without `root_mode`: the setting, but
/// `none` instead of `adb` on images that refuse adb root (Play Store).
fn default_root(setting: RootMode, image: &ImageRef) -> RootMode {
    if setting == RootMode::Adb && !image.allows_adb_root() {
        RootMode::None
    } else {
        setting
    }
}

/// Parses an image selector; the ABI defaults to the host's.
pub fn parse_image(sel: &str) -> JidrResult<ImageRef> {
    if sel.starts_with("system-images;") {
        return ImageRef::parse_package(sel)
            .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::usage(format!("invalid image package {sel:?}")));
    }
    let mut parts = sel.split(':');
    let api = parts
        .next()
        .and_then(|a| a.trim().trim_start_matches("android-").parse().ok())
        .ok_or_else(|| {
            JidrError::usage(format!(
                "invalid image {sel:?}: expected e.g. 35:google_apis"
            ))
        })?;
    let tag = parts
        .next()
        .filter(|t| !t.is_empty())
        .unwrap_or("google_apis")
        .to_string();
    let abi = parts
        .next()
        .filter(|a| !a.is_empty())
        .unwrap_or(jidr_sdk::host::host_abi())
        .to_string();
    if parts.next().is_some() {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(format!("invalid image {sel:?}")));
    }
    Ok(ImageRef { api, tag, abi })
}

/// `logcat -d` arguments. logcat applies `-t N` to the raw buffer *before*
/// tag filtering, so with a filter we dump everything and keep the last N
/// matching lines ourselves (`tail_lines`).
pub fn logcat_args(lines: Option<u32>, filter: &[String]) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut args = Vec::new();
    if let (Some(n), true) = (lines, filter.is_empty()) {
        args.extend(["-t".to_string(), n.to_string()]);
    }
    args.extend(filter.iter().cloned());
    args
}

pub fn tail_lines(text: &str, n: usize) -> String {
    let lines: Vec<&str> = text.lines().collect();
    let mut out = lines[lines.len().saturating_sub(n)..].join("\n");
    if !out.is_empty() {
        out.push('\n');
    }
    out
}

fn validate_device_name(name: &str) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let name = name.trim();
    if name.is_empty() || name.len() > 64 || name.contains(['/', '\n', '\r']) {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(
            "device names are 1–64 characters, without / or newlines",
        ));
    }
    if Uuid::parse_str(name).is_ok() {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(
            "a device name can't look like a device id",
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn json<T: Serialize>(v: T) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    serde_json::to_value(v).map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(format!("encoding result: {e}")))
}

fn hw_changes(
    ram_mb: Option<u32>,
    cpus: Option<u32>,
    width: Option<u32>,
    height: Option<u32>,
    density: Option<u32>,
) -> BTreeMap<String, Option<String>> {
    [
        ("hw.ramSize", ram_mb),
        ("hw.cpu.ncore", cpus),
        ("hw.lcd.width", width),
        ("hw.lcd.height", height),
        ("hw.lcd.density", density),
    ]
    .into_iter()
    .filter_map(|(k, v)| v.map(|v| (k.to_string(), Some(v.to_string()))))
    .collect()
}

impl CoreProvider {
    async fn adb(&self, device: &Device) -> JidrResult<Adb> {
        let info = self.state.connect_info(device.id).await?;
        Ok(Adb::new(info.adb_path).device(info.adb_serial))
    }

    async fn repository(&self) -> JidrResult<Repository> {
        let base = self.state.sdk_repo.clone().unwrap_or_else(repo::repo_base);
        Fetcher::new()?.repository(&base).await
    }

    fn cache(&self) -> jidr_sdk::DownloadCache {
        jidr_sdk::DownloadCache::new(self.state.paths.downloads())
    }

    fn consent(&self) -> JidrResult<ConsentStore> {
        ConsentStore::load(self.state.paths.consent_file())
    }

    /// Installs packages into the private SDK after checking licenses.
    async fn install_packages(
        &self,
        ctx: &CallCtx,
        repo: &Repository,
        packages: &[String],
    ) -> JidrResult<Value> {
        let pkgs = packages
            .iter()
            .map(|p| {
                repo.latest(p, 0)
                    .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::not_found(format!("no SDK package {p}")))
            })
            .collect::<JidrResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
        let consent = self.consent()?;
        let pending = consent.pending(repo, &pkgs)?;
        if !pending.is_empty() {
            return Err(JidrError::sdk(format!(
                "accept these licenses first: {}",
                pending
                    .iter()
                    .map(|p| p.id.as_str())
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .join(", ")
            ))
            .with_data(json!({ "pending_licenses": pending })));
        }
        let fetcher = Fetcher::new()?;
        let sdk = self.state.sdks().private;
        let n = pkgs.len() as f32;
        let mut installed = Vec::new();
        for (i, pkg) in pkgs.iter().enumerate() {
            let report = |p: jidr_sdk::Progress| {
                let frac = if p.total > 0 {
                    p.done as f32 / p.total as f32
                } else {
                    0.0
                };
                let fraction = Some((i as f32 + frac) / n);
                let message = format!("{:?} {}", p.phase, p.package);
                // B5: bytes only while downloading; other phases clear them.
                if p.phase == jidr_sdk::Phase::Downloading {
                    ctx.report_bytes(fraction, &message, p.done, p.total);
                } else {
                    ctx.report(fraction, &message);
                }
            };
            let dir = jidr_sdk::install(&fetcher, &sdk, repo, &consent, pkg, &report, &ctx.cancel)
                .await?;
            installed.push(
                json!({ "package": pkg.path, "revision": pkg.revision.to_string(), "path": dir }),
            );
        }
        Ok(json!({ "installed": installed }))
    }

    async fn create(&self, p: CreateParams) -> JidrResult<Value> {
        validate_device_name(&p.name)?;
        let name = p.name.trim().to_string();
        if self.state.with_store(|s| s.name_taken(&name, None)) {
            return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
                "a device named {name:?} already exists"
            )));
        }
        let image = parse_image(&p.image)?;
        let sdks = self.state.sdks();
        let sdk = sdks.find_image(&image).cloned().ok_or_else(|| {
            JidrError::sdk(format!(
                "{} is not installed; run `jidr image install {}`",
                image.package(),
                p.image
            ))
        })?;
        let mut profile = match &p.profile {
            Some(id) => profiles::find(id)?,
            None => profiles::default_profile()?,
        };
        if let Some(v) = p.ram_mb {
            profile.ram_mb = v;
        }
        if let Some(v) = p.cpus {
            profile.cpus = v;
        }
        if let Some(v) = p.width {
            profile.width = v;
        }
        if let Some(v) = p.height {
            profile.height = v;
        }
        if let Some(v) = p.density {
            profile.density = v;
        }
        if let Some(v) = p.data_mb {
            profile.data_mb = v;
        }
        let mode = p
            .root_mode
            .unwrap_or_else(|| default_root(self.state.settings().default_root_mode, &image));
        if mode == RootMode::Adb && !image.allows_adb_root() {
            return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
                "{} images don't allow adb root; use root_mode magisk or none",
                image.tag
            )));
        }
        let avds = self.state.avds();
        let avd = self
            .state
            .with_store(|s| s.avd_id_for(&name, |id| avds.exists(id)));
        avds.create(&AvdSpec {
            name: avd.clone(),
            display_name: name.clone(),
            profile: profile.clone(),
            image: image.clone(),
            overrides: BTreeMap::new(),
        })?;
        let device = Device {
            id: Uuid::new_v4(),
            name,
            avd: avd.clone(),
            profile: profile.id,
            image,
            sdk_root: sdk.root,
            root: RootState {
                mode,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            agent_owned: p.agent_owned.unwrap_or(false),
            created_at: chrono::Utc::now(),
            launch: Default::default(),
            status: Default::default(),
            runtime: None,
        };
        if let Err(e) = self.state.with_store(|s| s.insert(device.clone())) {
            let _ = avds.delete(&avd);
            return Err(e);
        }
        self.state.emit(
            "device.created",
            json!({ "device": device.id, "name": device.name }),
        );
        json(device)
    }

    async fn edit(&self, p: EditParams) -> JidrResult<Value> {
        let d = self.state.device(&p.device).await?;
        let changes = hw_changes(p.ram_mb, p.cpus, p.width, p.height, p.density);
        if !changes.is_empty() {
            if d.status.is_active() {
                return Err(JidrError::busy(format!(
                    "{} is running; stop it to change its hardware",
                    d.name
                )));
            }
            self.state.avds().edit(&d.avd, &changes)?;
        }
        if let Some(name) = &p.name {
            validate_device_name(name)?;
            if self.state.with_store(|s| s.name_taken(name, Some(d.id))) {
                return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
                    "a device named {name:?} already exists"
                )));
            }
            self.state.avds().edit(
                &d.avd,
                &BTreeMap::from([("avd.ini.displayname".into(), Some(name.clone()))]),
            )?;
        }
        let (name, agent_owned) = (p.name, p.agent_owned);
        let d = self
            .state
            .update_device(
                d.id,
                Box::new(move |d| {
                    if let Some(n) = name {
                        d.name = n.trim().to_string();
                    }
                    if let Some(a) = agent_owned {
                        d.agent_owned = a;
                    }
                }),
            )
            .await?;
        json(d)
    }

    async fn clone_device(&self, p: CloneParams) -> JidrResult<Value> {
        let src = self.state.device(&p.device).await?;
        if src.status.is_active() {
            return Err(JidrError::busy(format!(
                "{} is running; stop it before cloning",
                src.name
            )));
        }
        validate_device_name(&p.name)?;
        let name = p.name.trim().to_string();
        if self.state.with_store(|s| s.name_taken(&name, None)) {
            return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
                "a device named {name:?} already exists"
            )));
        }
        let avds = self.state.avds();
        let avd = self
            .state
            .with_store(|s| s.avd_id_for(&name, |id| avds.exists(id)));
        avds.clone_avd(&src.avd, &avd, &name)?;
        let (src_dir, dst_dir) = (avds.dir(&src.avd), avds.dir(&avd));
        let mut launch = src.launch.clone();
        // Per-device files (e.g. a patched ramdisk) move with the copy.
        if let Some(r) = &launch.ramdisk
            && let Ok(rel) = r.strip_prefix(&src_dir)
        {
            launch.ramdisk = Some(dst_dir.join(rel));
        }
        let mut root = src.root.clone();
        if let Some(r) = &root.patched_ramdisk_path
            && let Ok(rel) = r.strip_prefix(&src_dir)
        {
            root.patched_ramdisk_path = Some(dst_dir.join(rel));
        }
        launch.force_cold_boot = true;
        let device = Device {
            id: Uuid::new_v4(),
            name,
            avd: avd.clone(),
            created_at: chrono::Utc::now(),
            launch,
            root,
            status: Default::default(),
            runtime: None,
            ..src
        };
        if let Err(e) = self.state.with_store(|s| s.insert(device.clone())) {
            let _ = avds.delete(&avd);
            return Err(e);
        }
        self.state.emit(
            "device.created",
            json!({ "device": device.id, "name": device.name }),
        );
        json(device)
    }

    async fn reset(&self, p: DeviceParams) -> JidrResult<Value> {
        let d = self.state.device(&p.device).await?;
        if d.status.is_active() {
            self.state.stop_device(d.id).await?;
        }
        self.state.avds().factory_reset(&d.avd)?;
        let d = self
            .state
            .update_device(d.id, Box::new(|d| d.launch.force_cold_boot = true))
            .await?;
        json(d)
    }

    async fn delete(&self, p: DeviceParams) -> JidrResult<Value> {
        let d = self.state.device(&p.device).await?;
        if d.status.is_active() {
            self.state.stop_device(d.id).await?;
        }
        let avds = self.state.avds();
        if avds.exists(&d.avd) {
            avds.delete(&d.avd)?;
        }
        self.state.with_store(|s| s.remove(d.id))?;
        self.state
            .emit("device.deleted", json!({ "device": d.id, "name": d.name }));
        Ok(json!({ "deleted": d.id, "name": d.name }))
    }

    async fn details(&self, p: DeviceParams) -> JidrResult<Value> {
        let device = self.state.device(&p.device).await?;
        let avds = self.state.avds();
        let config = avds
            .config(&device.avd)
            .map(|c| c.entries())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let disk_usage = avds.disk_usage(&device.avd).unwrap_or(0);
        let pristine_ramdisk_sha256 =
            jidr_sdk::pristine_ramdisk_sha256(&self.state.sdks(), &device.image);
        json(DeviceDetails {
            avd_dir: avds.dir(&device.avd),
            device,
            config,
            disk_usage,
            pristine_ramdisk_sha256,
        })
    }

    async fn image_list(&self, p: ImageListParams) -> JidrResult<Value> {
        let repo = if p.available {
            match self.repository().await {
                Ok(r) => r,
                Err(e) => {
                    tracing::warn!("offline image list: {e}");
                    Repository::default()
                }
            }
        } else {
            Repository::default()
        };
        json(jidr_sdk::image_catalog(
            &repo,
            &self.state.sdks(),
            &CatalogFilter::default(),
        ))
    }

    async fn image_install(&self, ctx: &CallCtx, p: ImageParams) -> JidrResult<Value> {
        let image = parse_image(&p.image)?;
        let repo = self.repository().await?;
        let mut packages = Vec::new();
        if self.state.sdks().tools().is_err() {
            packages.extend(["emulator".to_string(), "platform-tools".to_string()]);
        }
        if self.state.sdks().find_image(&image).is_none() {
            packages.push(image.package());
        }
        if packages.is_empty() {
            return Ok(
                json!({ "installed": [], "message": format!("{} is already installed", image.package()) }),
            );
        }
        self.install_packages(ctx, &repo, &packages).await
    }

    async fn sdk_status(&self) -> JidrResult<Value> {
        let sdks = self.state.sdks();
        let tools = sdks.tools().ok().cloned();
        Ok(json!({
            "private_sdk": sdks.private.root,
            "studio_sdk": sdks.studio.as_ref().map(|s| &s.root),
            "tools_sdk": tools.as_ref().map(|s| &s.root),
            "emulator_version": tools.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.emulator_version()),
            "hypervisor": jidr_sdk::host::hypervisor_available(),
            "host_abi": jidr_sdk::host::host_abi(),
            "free_bytes": jidr_sdk::host::free_space(&self.state.paths.data).unwrap_or(0),
            "installed_images": sdks.private.installed_images().into_iter()
                .chain(sdks.studio.iter().flat_map(|s| s.installed_images()))
                .map(|i| i.package()).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        }))
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl CommandProvider for CoreProvider {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "core"
    }

    fn commands(&self) -> Vec<CommandSpec> {
        vec![

    async fn call(&self, ctx: &CallCtx, method: &str, params: Value) -> JidrResult<Value> {
        match method {
            "daemon.status" => {
                parse_params::<NoParams>(params)?;
                let devices = self.state.devices().await;
                Ok(json!({
                    "version": env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
                    "protocol": crate::rpc::PROTOCOL_VERSION,
                    "pid": std::process::id(),
                    "uptime_s": self.state.started_at.elapsed().as_secs(),
                    "devices": devices.len(),
                    "running": self.state.running_count(),
                    "socket": self.state.paths.socket(),
                }))
            }
            "sdk.status" => {
                parse_params::<NoParams>(params)?;
                self.sdk_status().await
            }
            "sdk.licenses" => {
                let p: PackagesParams = parse_params(params)?;
                let repo = self.repository().await?;
                let pkgs = p
                    .packages
                    .iter()
                    .map(|n| {
                        repo.latest(n, 0)
                            .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::not_found(format!("no SDK package {n}")))
                    })
                    .collect::<JidrResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
                json(self.consent()?.pending(&repo, &pkgs)?)
            }
            "sdk.accept_license" => {
                let p: AcceptLicenseParams = parse_params(params)?;
                let repo = self.repository().await?;
                json(self.consent()?.accept_hash(&repo, &p.id, &p.sha256)?)
            }
            "sdk.install" => {
                let p: PackagesParams = parse_params(params)?;
                let repo = self.repository().await?;
                self.install_packages(ctx, &repo, &p.packages).await
            }
            "image.list" => self.image_list(parse_params(params)?).await,
            "image.install" => self.image_install(ctx, parse_params(params)?).await,
            "profile.list" => {
                parse_params::<NoParams>(params)?;
                json(profiles::builtin())
            }
            "device.create" => self.create(parse_params(params)?).await,
            "device.edit" => self.edit(parse_params(params)?).await,
            "device.clone" => self.clone_device(parse_params(params)?).await,
            "device.start" => {
                let p: StartParams = parse_params(params)?;
                let d = self.state.device(&p.device).await?;
                json(
                    self.state
                        .start_device(d.id, p.cold_boot, &ctx.cancel)
                        .await?,
                )
            }
            "device.stop" => {
                let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
                let d = self.state.device(&p.device).await?;
                json(self.state.stop_device(d.id).await?)
            }
            "device.reset" => self.reset(parse_params(params)?).await,
            "device.delete" => self.delete(parse_params(params)?).await,
            "device.list" => {
                parse_params::<NoParams>(params)?;
                json(self.state.devices().await)
            }
            "device.details" => self.details(parse_params(params)?).await,
            "settings.get" => {
                parse_params::<NoParams>(params)?;
                json(self.state.settings())
            }
            "settings.set" => {
                let p: SettingsParams = parse_params(params)?;
                json(self.state.update_settings(|s| {
                    if let Some(m) = p.default_root_mode {
                        s.default_root_mode = m;
                    }
                    if let Some(q) = p.quick_boot {
                        s.quick_boot = q;
                    }
                })?)
            }
            "device.connect_info" => {
                let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
                let d = self.state.device(&p.device).await?;
                json(self.state.connect_info(d.id).await?)
            }
            "file.install" => {
                let p: InstallParams = parse_params(params)?;
                let d = self.state.device(&p.device).await?;
                if !p.apk.is_file() {
                    return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
                        "no such APK: {}",
                        p.apk.display()
                    )));
                }
                let opts = InstallOptions {
                    replace: p.replace,
                    grant_permissions: p.grant_permissions,
                    downgrade: p.downgrade,
                };
                self.adb(&d)
                    .await?
                    .with_timeout(Duration::from_secs(600))
                    .install(&p.apk, opts)
                    .await?;
                Ok(json!({ "installed": p.apk }))
            }
            "file.push" => {
                let p: PushParams = parse_params(params)?;
                let d = self.state.device(&p.device).await?;
                let remote = p.remote.unwrap_or_else(|| "/sdcard/Download/".into());
                self.adb(&d)
                    .await?
                    .with_timeout(Duration::from_secs(600))
                    .push(&p.local, &remote)
                    .await?;
                Ok(json!({ "pushed": p.local, "remote": remote }))
            }
            "file.pull" => {
                let p: PullParams = parse_params(params)?;
                let d = self.state.device(&p.device).await?;
                self.adb(&d)
                    .await?
                    .with_timeout(Duration::from_secs(600))
                    .pull(&p.remote, &p.local)
                    .await?;
                Ok(json!({ "pulled": p.remote, "local": p.local }))
            }
            "logcat.dump" => {
                let p: LogcatDumpParams = parse_params(params)?;
                let d = self.state.device(&p.device).await?;
                let args = logcat_args(p.lines, &p.filter);
                let args: Vec<&str> = args.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();
                let text = self.adb(&d).await?.logcat_dump(&args).await?;
                let text = match (p.lines, p.filter.is_empty()) {
                    (Some(n), false) => tail_lines(&text, n as usize),
                    _ => text,
                };
                Ok(json!({ "text": text }))
            }
            "device.logs" => {
                let p: LogsParams = parse_params(params)?;
                let d = self.state.device(&p.device).await?;
                let logcat = match self.adb(&d).await {
                    Ok(adb) => adb
                        .with_timeout(Duration::from_secs(30))
                        .logcat_dump(&[])
                        .await
                        .ok(),
                    Err(_) => None,
                };
                let out = p.output.unwrap_or_else(|| {
                    self.state.paths.logs.join(format!(
                        "{}-logs-{}.zip",
                        d.avd,
                        chrono::Utc::now().format("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
                    ))
                });
                let files = crate::bundle::write_bundle(
                    &out,
                    &d,
                    &self.state.avds().dir(&d.avd),
                    &self.state.paths.device_logs(&d.avd),
                    logcat.as_deref(),
                )?;
                Ok(json!({ "path": out, "files": files }))
            }
            "cache.list" => {
                parse_params::<NoParams>(params)?;
                json(self.cache().list())
            }
            "cache.import" => {
                let p: CacheImportParams = parse_params(params)?;
                json(self.cache().import(&p.path, p.sha256.as_deref())?)
            }
            "cache.prune" => {
                let p: CachePruneParams = parse_params(params)?;
                let age = p.older_than_days.map(|d| Duration::from_secs(d * 86_400));
                json(self.cache().prune(age))
            }
            "logcat.clear" => {
                let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
                let d = self.state.device(&p.device).await?;
                self.adb(&d).await?.logcat_clear().await?;
                Ok(json!({ "cleared": true }))
            }
            other => Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
                "core provider has no command {other}"
            ))),
        }
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-daemon/src/jobs.rs`:

```rs
//! Jobs: long-running commands (boot, image install, Magisk patch) run in the
//! background with progress, cancel and a waitable result.

use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, MutexGuard};
use std::time::Duration;

use async_trait::async_trait;
use chrono::Utc;
use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, CommandProvider, CommandSpec, DaemonContext, parse_params};
use jidr_core::{Cancel, JidrError, JidrResult, Job, JobBytes, JobState};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use tokio::sync::watch;
use uuid::Uuid;

/// Finished jobs kept for `jobs.get` / `jobs.list`.
const KEEP_FINISHED: usize = 200;

#[derive(Debug)]
struct Entry {
    job: watch::Sender<Job>,
    cancel: Cancel,
}

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct JobManager {
    entries: Mutex<VecDeque<(Uuid, Entry)>>,
}

fn lock<T>(m: &Mutex<T>) -> MutexGuard<'_, T> {
    m.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
}

impl JobManager {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    /// Registers a running job and returns its id and cancel flag.
    pub fn create(&self, kind: &str, device: Option<Uuid>) -> (Uuid, Cancel) {
        let id = Uuid::new_v4();
        let cancel = Cancel::new();
        let job = Job {
            id,
            kind: kind.to_string(),
            device,
            progress: Some(0.0),
            message: String::new(),
            bytes: None,
            state: JobState::Running,
            error: None,
            result: None,
            created_at: Utc::now(),
        };
        let (tx, _) = watch::channel(job);
        let mut entries = lock(&self.entries);
        entries.push_back((
            id,
            Entry {
                job: tx,
                cancel: cancel.clone(),
            },
        ));
        // Drop the oldest finished jobs beyond the cap.
        while entries.len() > KEEP_FINISHED {
            let Some(pos) = entries
                .iter()
                .position(|(_, e)| e.job.borrow().state.is_terminal())
            else {
                break;
            };
            entries.remove(pos);
        }
        (id, cancel)
    }

    fn with<T>(&self, id: Uuid, f: impl FnOnce(&Entry) -> T) -> JidrResult<T> {
        lock(&self.entries)
            .iter()
            .find(|(j, _)| *j == id)
            .map(|(_, e)| f(e))
            .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::not_found(format!("no job {id}")))
    }

    pub fn progress(&self, id: Uuid, fraction: Option<f32>, message: &str) {
        self.update(id, fraction, message, None);
    }

    /// Progress with the bytes of the current download (gap B5).
    pub fn progress_bytes(
        &self,
        id: Uuid,
        fraction: Option<f32>,
        message: &str,
        done: u64,
        total: u64,
    ) {
        self.update(id, fraction, message, Some(JobBytes { done, total }));
    }

    fn update(&self, id: Uuid, fraction: Option<f32>, message: &str, bytes: Option<JobBytes>) {
        let _ = self.with(id, |e| {
            e.job.send_modify(|j| {
                if !j.state.is_terminal() {
                    j.progress = fraction.map(|f| f.clamp(0.0, 1.0));
                    j.message = message.to_string();
                    j.bytes = bytes;
                }
            })
        });
    }

    /// Records the outcome; a cancelled error ends as `cancelled`.
    pub fn finish(&self, id: Uuid, result: JidrResult<Value>) -> Option<Job> {
        self.with(id, |e| {
            e.job.send_modify(|j| match result {
                Ok(v) => {
                    j.state = JobState::Succeeded;
                    j.progress = Some(1.0);
                    j.result = Some(v);
                }
                Err(err) => {
                    j.state = if jidr_core::cancel::is_cancelled(&err) || e.cancel.is_cancelled() {
                        JobState::Cancelled
                    } else {
                        JobState::Failed
                    };
                    j.error = Some(err);
                }
            });
            e.job.borrow().clone()
        })
        .ok()
    }

    pub fn get(&self, id: Uuid) -> JidrResult<Job> {
        self.with(id, |e| e.job.borrow().clone())
    }

    pub fn list(&self, include_finished: bool) -> Vec<Job> {
        lock(&self.entries)
            .iter()
            .map(|(_, e)| e.job.borrow().clone())
            .filter(|j| include_finished || !j.state.is_terminal())
            .collect()
    }

    pub fn active(&self) -> usize {
        self.list(false).len()
    }

    pub fn cancel(&self, id: Uuid) -> JidrResult<Job> {
        self.with(id, |e| {
            e.cancel.cancel();
            e.job.borrow().clone()
        })
    }

    /// Waits until the job ends, or `timeout` passes (then returns it as is).
    pub async fn wait(&self, id: Uuid, timeout: Option<Duration>) -> JidrResult<Job> {
        let mut rx = self.with(id, |e| e.job.subscribe())?;
        let done = async {
            let _ = rx.wait_for(|j| j.state.is_terminal()).await;
        };
        match timeout {
            Some(t) => {
                let _ = tokio::time::timeout(t, done).await;
            }
            None => done.await,
        }
        self.get(id)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct JobParams {
    /// Job id.
    pub job: Uuid,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct JobsListParams {
    /// Include finished jobs.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub all: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct JobWaitParams {
    pub job: Uuid,
    /// Give up after this many seconds and return the job as it is.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub timeout_s: Option<u64>,
}

/// `jobs.*` commands.
pub struct JobsProvider {
    jobs: Arc<JobManager>,
}

impl JobsProvider {
    pub fn new(jobs: Arc<JobManager>) -> Self {
        Self { jobs }
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl CommandProvider for JobsProvider {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "jobs"
    }

    fn commands(&self) -> Vec<CommandSpec> {
        vec![
            CommandSpec::new::<JobsListParams>(
                "jobs.list",
                "Running jobs (and finished ones with all=true)",
            ),
            CommandSpec::new::<JobParams>("jobs.get", "A job's state, progress and result"),
            CommandSpec::new::<JobParams>("jobs.cancel", "Cancel a running job"),
            CommandSpec::new::<JobWaitParams>(
                "jobs.wait",
                "Wait for a job to finish and return it",
            ),
        ]
    }

    async fn call(&self, ctx: &CallCtx, method: &str, params: Value) -> JidrResult<Value> {
        let to_json =
            |j: Job| serde_json::to_value(j).map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(e.to_string()));
        match method {
            "jobs.list" => {
                let p: JobsListParams = parse_params(params)?;
                serde_json::to_value(self.jobs.list(p.all))
                    .map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(e.to_string()))
            }
            "jobs.get" => to_json(self.jobs.get(parse_params::<JobParams>(params)?.job)?),
            "jobs.cancel" => {
                let job = self.jobs.cancel(parse_params::<JobParams>(params)?.job)?;
                ctx.daemon.emit("job.cancelling", json!({ "job": job.id }));
                to_json(job)
            }
            "jobs.wait" => {
                let p: JobWaitParams = parse_params(params)?;
                to_json(
                    self.jobs
                        .wait(p.job, p.timeout_s.map(Duration::from_secs))
                        .await?,
                )
            }
            other => Err(JidrError::usage(format!("no command {other}"))),
        }
    }
}

/// Runs `fut` as job `id`, reporting the outcome through `jobs` and events.
pub async fn run_job(
    jobs: Arc<JobManager>,
    daemon: Arc<dyn DaemonContext>,
    id: Uuid,
    fut: impl std::future::Future<Output = JidrResult<Value>>,
) {
    let result = fut.await;
    if let Some(job) = jobs.finish(id, result) {
        daemon.emit(
            "job.finished",
            serde_json::to_value(&job).unwrap_or(Value::Null),
        );
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn lifecycle_and_wait() {
        let m = Arc::new(JobManager::new());
        let (id, cancel) = m.create("device.start", None);
        m.progress(id, Some(0.5), "booting");
        assert_eq!(m.get(id).unwrap().progress, Some(0.5));
        assert_eq!(m.active(), 1);
        let waiter = {
            let m = m.clone();
            tokio::spawn(async move { m.wait(id, None).await.unwrap() })
        };
        m.cancel(id).unwrap();
        assert!(cancel.is_cancelled());
        m.finish(id, Err(jidr_core::cancel::cancelled()));
        let j = waiter.await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(j.state, JobState::Cancelled);
        assert_eq!(m.active(), 0);
        assert_eq!(m.list(true).len(), 1);

        let (ok, _) = m.create("image.install", None);
        m.finish(ok, Ok(json!({"x": 1})));
        assert_eq!(m.get(ok).unwrap().state, JobState::Succeeded);
        let (bad, _) = m.create("image.install", None);
        m.finish(bad, Err(JidrError::sdk("disk full")));
        assert_eq!(m.get(bad).unwrap().state, JobState::Failed);
        assert_eq!(
            m.get(Uuid::new_v4()).unwrap_err().code,
            jidr_core::ErrorCode::NotFound
        );
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn wait_times_out_with_the_current_state() {
        let m = JobManager::new();
        let (id, _) = m.create("x", None);
        let j = m.wait(id, Some(Duration::from_millis(20))).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(j.state, JobState::Running);
    }

    /// Gap B5: a download's bytes show on the job; any other progress clears
    /// them.
    #[test]
    fn download_bytes_are_set_then_cleared() {
        let m = JobManager::new();
        let (id, _) = m.create("image.install", None);
        m.progress_bytes(id, Some(0.1), "Downloading x", 10, 100);
        let j = m.get(id).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            j.bytes,
            Some(JobBytes {
                done: 10,
                total: 100
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(j.message, "Downloading x");
        m.progress(id, Some(0.9), "Extracting x");
        assert_eq!(m.get(id).unwrap().bytes, None);
        let json = serde_json::to_value(m.get(id).unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert!(json.get("bytes").is_none(), "absent, not null: {json}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn finished_jobs_are_capped() {
        let m = JobManager::new();
        for _ in 0..(KEEP_FINISHED + 50) {
            let (id, _) = m.create("x", None);
            m.finish(id, Ok(Value::Null));
        }
        assert!(m.list(true).len() <= KEEP_FINISHED);
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Jidr daemon: command registry, JSON-RPC 2.0 server, jobs, events and
//! per-device locks. Registers the core provider plus any provider handed to
//! the builder (`jidr-widgets`, `jidr-root`).

pub mod bundle;
pub mod core_provider;
pub mod jobs;
pub mod lifecycle;
pub mod locks;
pub mod protocol_doc;
pub mod registry;
pub use jidr_core::rpc;
pub mod server;
pub mod state;
pub mod store;
pub mod testing;
pub mod validate;

use std::future::Future;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};

use jidr_backend::Backend;
use jidr_core::JidrResult;
use jidr_core::provider::CommandProvider;

pub use jidr_core::rpc::Event;
pub use registry::Registry;
pub use state::{DaemonConfig, State};

/// The daemon version clients must match (`hello`).
pub const VERSION: &str = env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION");

pub struct Daemon {
    pub(crate) state: Arc<State>,
    pub(crate) jobs: Arc<jobs::JobManager>,
    idle_timeout: Option<std::time::Duration>,
    /// Fired by `daemon.shutdown`.
    pub(crate) stop: tokio::sync::Notify,
    /// Set when serving ends; open connections close.
    pub(crate) closing: tokio::sync::watch::Sender<bool>,
    pub(crate) registry: Registry,
    pub(crate) version: String,
    clients: AtomicUsize,
}

impl std::fmt::Debug for Daemon {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        f.debug_struct("Daemon")
            .field("version", &self.version)
            .field("registry", &self.registry)
            .finish()
    }
}

pub struct DaemonBuilder {
    config: DaemonConfig,
    backend: Arc<dyn Backend>,
    providers: Vec<Arc<dyn CommandProvider>>,
    version: Option<String>,
}

impl DaemonBuilder {
    /// Adds a provider (registered after the core one, in call order).
    pub fn provider(mut self, p: Arc<dyn CommandProvider>) -> Self {
        self.providers.push(p);
        self
    }

    /// Overrides the advertised version (tests of the stale-daemon path).
    pub fn version(mut self, v: &str) -> Self {
        self.version = Some(v.to_string());
        self
    }

    pub fn build(self) -> JidrResult<Arc<Daemon>> {
        let idle_timeout = self.config.idle_timeout;
        let state = State::new(self.config, self.backend)?;
        let jobs = Arc::new(jobs::JobManager::new());
        let mut registry = Registry::new();
        let core: Arc<dyn CommandProvider> =
            Arc::new(core_provider::CoreProvider::new(state.clone()));
        registry.register(core)?;
        registry.register(Arc::new(jobs::JobsProvider::new(jobs.clone())))?;
        for p in self.providers {
            registry.register(p)?;
        }
        state.set_providers(registry.providers().to_vec());
        Ok(Arc::new(Daemon {
            state,
            jobs,
            idle_timeout,
            stop: tokio::sync::Notify::new(),
            closing: tokio::sync::watch::channel(false).0,
            registry,
            version: self.version.unwrap_or_else(|| VERSION.to_string()),
            clients: AtomicUsize::new(0),
        }))
    }
}

impl Daemon {
    pub fn builder(config: DaemonConfig, backend: Arc<dyn Backend>) -> DaemonBuilder {
        DaemonBuilder {
            config,
            backend,
            providers: Vec::new(),
            version: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn state(&self) -> &Arc<State> {
        &self.state
    }

    pub fn registry(&self) -> &Registry {
        &self.registry
    }

    pub(crate) fn client_connected(&self) {
        self.clients.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }

    pub(crate) fn client_disconnected(&self) {
        self.clients.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }

    pub fn client_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.clients.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
    }

    pub fn jobs(&self) -> &Arc<jobs::JobManager> {
        &self.jobs
    }

    /// No running devices, no connected clients, no active jobs (D4).
    pub fn is_idle(&self) -> bool {
        self.state.running_count() == 0 && self.client_count() == 0 && self.jobs.active() == 0
    }

    /// Binds the socket, re-adopts running emulators and serves until
    /// `shutdown` resolves or the daemon has been idle for `idle_timeout`.
    /// The socket file is removed on exit.
    pub async fn serve(self: Arc<Self>, shutdown: impl Future<Output = ()>) -> JidrResult<()> {
        let path = self.state.paths.socket();
        let listener = server::bind(&path)?;
        self.state.adopt_running().await;
        tracing::info!(socket = %path.display(), version = %self.version, "daemon listening");
        let idle = {
            let me = self.clone();
            let timeout = self.idle_timeout;
            async move {
                match timeout {
                    Some(t) => lifecycle::idle_for(t, || me.is_idle()).await,
                    None => std::future::pending().await,
                }
            }
        };
        tokio::pin!(shutdown);
        tokio::pin!(idle);
        loop {
            tokio::select! {
                _ = &mut shutdown => break,
                _ = self.stop.notified() => {
                    tracing::info!("shutdown requested");
                    break;
                }
                _ = &mut idle => {
                    tracing::info!("idle; exiting (D4)");
                    break;
                }
                accepted = listener.accept() => match accepted {
                    Ok((stream, _)) => {
                        tokio::spawn(server::handle_connection(self.clone(), stream));
                    }
                    Err(e) => tracing::warn!("accept failed: {e}"),
                },
            }
        }
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&path);
        self.closing.send_replace(true);
        Ok(())
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-daemon/src/lifecycle.rs`:

```rs
//! Daemon lifetime (D4): started on demand by the first client, alive while
//! devices run, clients are connected or jobs are active, gone after
//! `IDLE_TIMEOUT` of idleness.

use std::time::Duration;

use tokio::time::{Instant, interval};

pub const IDLE_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10 * 60);
const CHECK_EVERY: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1);

/// Resolves once `is_idle()` has been true continuously for `timeout`.
pub async fn idle_for(timeout: Duration, is_idle: impl Fn() -> bool) {
    let mut tick = interval(CHECK_EVERY);
    let mut idle_since: Option<Instant> = None;
    loop {
        tick.tick().await;
        if is_idle() {
            let since = *idle_since.get_or_insert_with(Instant::now);
            if since.elapsed() >= timeout {
                return;
            }
        } else {
            idle_since = None;
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::sync::Arc;
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};

    /// Time-mocked: busy for 15 virtual minutes, then idle; exits 10 minutes
    /// after becoming idle, not before.
    #[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]
    async fn exits_ten_minutes_after_last_activity() {
        let idle = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
        let flag = idle.clone();
        let start = Instant::now();
        let monitor = tokio::spawn(async move {
            idle_for(IDLE_TIMEOUT, move || flag.load(Ordering::Relaxed)).await
        });

        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(15 * 60)).await;
        assert!(!monitor.is_finished(), "busy daemon stays up");
        idle.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(9 * 60)).await;
        assert!(!monitor.is_finished(), "not yet: only 9 idle minutes");
        // Activity resets the clock.
        idle.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(2)).await;
        idle.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(9 * 60 + 50)).await;
        assert!(!monitor.is_finished(), "clock restarted after activity");
        monitor.await.unwrap();
        let elapsed = start.elapsed();
        assert!(
            elapsed >= Duration::from_secs(34 * 60) && elapsed < Duration::from_secs(35 * 60),
            "{elapsed:?}"
        );
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-daemon/src/locks.rs`:

```rs
//! Per-device single-writer locks. A conflicting call fails fast with `busy`
//! naming the holder, instead of queueing behind a long boot.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};
use serde_json::json;
use uuid::Uuid;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct Holder {
    /// The command holding the lock, e.g. `device.start`.
    op: String,
    /// The job id, when the holder is a job.
    job: Option<Uuid>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct DeviceLocks {
    held: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<Uuid, Holder>>>,
}

/// Releases the lock when dropped.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct LockGuard {
    locks: DeviceLocks,
    device: Uuid,
}

impl Drop for LockGuard {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.locks
            .held
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
            .remove(&self.device);
    }
}

impl DeviceLocks {
    pub fn try_lock(
        &self,
        device: Uuid,
        device_name: &str,
        op: &str,
        job: Option<Uuid>,
    ) -> JidrResult<LockGuard> {
        let mut held = self.held.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        if let Some(h) = held.get(&device) {
            return Err(JidrError::busy(format!("{device_name} is busy with {}", h.op))
                .with_data(json!({ "holder": h.job.map(|j| j.to_string()).unwrap_or_else(|| h.op.clone()), "op": h.op, "device": device })));
        }
        held.insert(
            device,
            Holder {
                op: op.to_string(),
                job,
            },
        );
        Ok(LockGuard {
            locks: self.clone(),
            device,
        })
    }

    /// Records the job id once the holder became a job.
    pub fn set_job(&self, device: Uuid, job: Uuid) {
        if let Some(h) = self
            .held
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
            .get_mut(&device)
        {
            h.job = Some(job);
        }
    }

    pub fn is_locked(&self, device: Uuid) -> bool {
        self.held
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
            .contains_key(&device)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use jidr_core::ErrorCode;

    #[test]
    fn single_writer() {
        let locks = DeviceLocks::default();
        let d = Uuid::new_v4();
        let g = locks.try_lock(d, "phone", "device.start", None).unwrap();
        let err = locks.try_lock(d, "phone", "device.stop", None).unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(err.code, ErrorCode::Busy);
        assert_eq!(err.data.as_ref().unwrap()["op"], "device.start");
        let job = Uuid::new_v4();
        locks.set_job(d, job);
        let err = locks.try_lock(d, "phone", "x", None).unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(err.data.unwrap()["holder"], job.to_string());
        // Other devices are independent.
        let _other = locks
            .try_lock(Uuid::new_v4(), "tablet", "device.stop", None)
            .unwrap();
        drop(g);
        assert!(!locks.is_locked(d));
        locks.try_lock(d, "phone", "device.stop", None).unwrap();
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-daemon/src/protocol_doc.rs`:

```rs
//! Renders the command reference in docs/control-protocol.md from
//! `commands.list`, so the document can't drift from the code.

use jidr_core::provider::CommandSpec;
use serde_json::Value;

pub const BEGIN: &str = "<!-- commands:begin (generated from commands.list; JIDR_UPDATE_DOCS=1 cargo nextest run -p jidr protocol_doc) -->";
pub const END: &str = "<!-- commands:end -->";

fn type_of(schema: &Value, prop: &Value) -> String {
    if let Some(t) = prop.get("type") {
        let base = match t {
            Value::String(s) => s.clone(),
            Value::Array(ts) => ts
                .iter()
                .filter_map(Value::as_str)
                .filter(|t| *t != "null")
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join(" | "),
            _ => "any".into(),
        };
        if base == "array" {
            let item = prop
                .get("items")
                .map(|i| type_of(schema, i))
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "any".into());
            return format!("{item}[]");
        }
        if let Some(format) = prop.get("format").and_then(Value::as_str)
            && format == "uuid"
        {
            return "uuid".into();
        }
        return base;
    }
    let reference = prop
        .get("$ref")
        .or_else(|| {
            prop.get("anyOf")
                .and_then(|a| a.as_array())
                .and_then(|a| a.iter().find_map(|v| v.get("$ref")))
        })
        .and_then(Value::as_str);
    if let Some(r) = reference {
        let name = r.rsplit('/').next().unwrap_or(r);
        if let Some(variants) = schema
            .pointer(&format!("/$defs/{name}/enum"))
            .and_then(Value::as_array)
        {
            return variants
                .iter()
                .filter_map(Value::as_str)
                .map(|v| format!("`{v}`"))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join(" \\| ");
        }
        return name.to_string();
    }
    "any".into()
}

fn description(schema: &Value, prop: &Value) -> String {
    let own = prop.get("description").and_then(Value::as_str);
    let via_ref = prop
        .get("$ref")
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .and_then(|r| {
            schema.pointer(&format!(
                "/$defs/{}/description",
                r.rsplit('/').next().unwrap_or(r)
            ))
        })
        .and_then(Value::as_str);
    own.or(via_ref)
        .unwrap_or("")
        .replace('\n', " ")
        .replace('|', "\\|")
}

pub fn render(specs: &[CommandSpec]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    let mut namespace = "";
    for s in specs {
        let ns = s.id.split('.').next().unwrap_or("");
        if ns != namespace {
            namespace = ns;
            out.push_str(&format!("\n### `{ns}.*`\n"));
        }
        let mut flags = Vec::new();
        if s.long_running {
            flags.push("long-running (job)");
        }
        if s.locks_device {
            flags.push("locks the device");
        }
        if s.destructive {
            flags.push("**destructive**");
        }
        out.push_str(&format!("\n#### `{}`\n\n{}", s.id, s.label));
        if !flags.is_empty() {
            out.push_str(&format!(" · {}", flags.join(" · ")));
        }
        out.push('\n');
        let required: Vec<&str> = s
            .params
            .get("required")
            .and_then(Value::as_array)
            .map(|r| r.iter().filter_map(Value::as_str).collect())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let props = s.params.get("properties").and_then(Value::as_object);
        match props {
            Some(props) if !props.is_empty() => {
                out.push_str("\n| Param | Type | Required | Description |\n|---|---|---|---|\n");
                for (name, prop) in props {
                    out.push_str(&format!(
                        "| `{name}` | {} | {} | {} |\n",
                        type_of(&s.params, prop),
                        if required.contains(&name.as_str()) {
                            "yes"
                        } else {
                            ""
                        },
                        description(&s.params, prop)
                    ));
                }
            }
            _ => out.push_str("\nNo params.\n"),
        }
    }
    out
}

/// Replaces the generated section of `doc` with `generated`.
pub fn splice(doc: &str, generated: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let start = doc.find(BEGIN)? + BEGIN.len();
    let end = doc.find(END)?;
    if end < start {
        return None;
    }
    Some(format!(
        "{}\n{}\n{}",
        &doc[..start],
        generated.trim_end(),
        &doc[end..]
    ))
}
```

`crates/jidr-daemon/src/registry.rs`:

```rs
//! The command table built from every provider's `CommandSpec`s.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::sync::Arc;

use jidr_core::provider::{CommandProvider, CommandSpec};
use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Registry {
    providers: Vec<Arc<dyn CommandProvider>>,
    table: BTreeMap<String, (usize, CommandSpec)>,
}

impl std::fmt::Debug for Registry {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        f.debug_struct("Registry")
            .field("commands", &self.table.keys().collect::<Vec<_>>())
            .finish()
    }
}

/// Methods the server handles itself (not provider commands).
pub const BUILTIN_METHODS: &[&str] = &[
    "hello",
    "commands.list",
    "events.subscribe",
    "logcat.follow",
    "daemon.shutdown",
];

impl Registry {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    /// Adds a provider; a command id that already exists is an error.
    pub fn register(&mut self, provider: Arc<dyn CommandProvider>) -> JidrResult<()> {
        let specs = provider.commands();
        for s in &specs {
            if self.table.contains_key(&s.id) || BUILTIN_METHODS.contains(&s.id.as_str()) {
                return Err(JidrError::unexpected(format!(
                    "provider {} registers {}, which already exists",
                    provider.name(),
                    s.id
                )));
            }
        }
        let index = self.providers.len();
        self.providers.push(provider);
        for s in specs {
            self.table.insert(s.id.clone(), (index, s));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn get(&self, method: &str) -> Option<(&Arc<dyn CommandProvider>, &CommandSpec)> {
        let (i, spec) = self.table.get(method)?;
        Some((self.providers.get(*i)?, spec))
    }

    /// Every command, sorted by id.
    pub fn list(&self) -> Vec<CommandSpec> {
        self.table.values().map(|(_, s)| s.clone()).collect()
    }

    pub fn providers(&self) -> &[Arc<dyn CommandProvider>] {
        &self.providers
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use async_trait::async_trait;
    use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, NoParams};
    use serde_json::Value;

    struct P(&'static str, &'static [&'static str]);

    #[async_trait]
    impl CommandProvider for P {
        fn name(&self) -> &str {
            self.0
        }
        fn commands(&self) -> Vec<CommandSpec> {
            self.1
                .iter()
                .map(|id| CommandSpec::new::<NoParams>(id, "x"))
                .collect()
        }
        async fn call(&self, _: &CallCtx, _: &str, _: Value) -> JidrResult<Value> {
            Ok(Value::Null)
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn duplicate_ids_are_rejected() {
        let mut r = Registry::new();
        r.register(Arc::new(P("a", &["x.one", "x.two"]))).unwrap();
        assert!(r.register(Arc::new(P("b", &["x.two"]))).is_err());
        assert!(r.register(Arc::new(P("c", &["hello"]))).is_err());
        r.register(Arc::new(P("d", &["y.one"]))).unwrap();
        let ids: Vec<String> = r.list().into_iter().map(|s| s.id).collect();
        assert_eq!(ids, ["x.one", "x.two", "y.one"]);
        assert_eq!(r.get("y.one").unwrap().0.name(), "d");
        assert!(r.get("nope").is_none());
```
