`crates/jidr-daemon/src/server.rs`:

```rs
//! JSON-RPC 2.0 over newline-delimited JSON on a Unix socket.

use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};

use jidr_adb::Adb;
use jidr_core::provider::{BytesFn, CallCtx, DaemonContext, ProgressFn, parse_params};
use jidr_core::rpc::Notification;
use jidr_core::{ErrorCode, JidrError, JidrResult, ResultExt};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use tokio::io::{AsyncBufReadExt, AsyncWriteExt, BufReader};
use tokio::net::{UnixListener, UnixStream};
use tokio::sync::broadcast;
use tokio::sync::mpsc;
use tokio::task::JoinHandle;

use crate::Daemon;
use crate::rpc::{
    self, HelloParams, HelloResult, INVALID_REQUEST, METHOD_NOT_FOUND, PARSE_ERROR, Request,
    Response, RpcError,
};

/// Longest request line we accept (APK paths, not APK bytes, go over the wire).
pub const MAX_LINE: usize = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
/// macOS limits Unix socket paths to 104 bytes.
const MAX_SOCKET_PATH: usize = 100;

/// Binds the daemon socket (mode 0600), replacing a stale one. Fails with
/// `busy` if another daemon is listening.
pub fn bind(path: &Path) -> JidrResult<UnixListener> {
    if path.as_os_str().len() > MAX_SOCKET_PATH {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
            "socket path is too long for a Unix socket ({} bytes): {}",
            path.as_os_str().len(),
            path.display()
        )));
    }
    if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)
            .ctx(ErrorCode::Unexpected, format!("creating {}", dir.display()))?;
    }
    if path.exists() {
        if std::os::unix::net::UnixStream::connect(path).is_ok() {
            return Err(JidrError::busy(format!(
                "another Jidr daemon is listening on {}",
                path.display()
            )));
        }
        std::fs::remove_file(path).ctx(ErrorCode::Unexpected, "removing stale socket")?;
    }
    let listener = UnixListener::bind(path)
        .ctx(ErrorCode::Unexpected, format!("binding {}", path.display()))?;
    #[cfg(unix)]
    {
        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
        std::fs::set_permissions(path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600))
            .ctx(ErrorCode::Unexpected, "setting socket permissions")?;
    }
    Ok(listener)
}

fn line(v: &impl serde::Serialize) -> String {
    serde_json::to_string(v).unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        r#"{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":null,"error":{"code":-32603,"message":"encoding failed"}}"#.into()
    })
}

pub(crate) async fn handle_connection(daemon: Arc<Daemon>, stream: UnixStream) {
    let (r, mut w) = stream.into_split();
    let (tx, mut rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel::<String>();
    let writer = tokio::spawn(async move {
        while let Some(mut l) = rx.recv().await {
            l.push('\n');
            if w.write_all(l.as_bytes()).await.is_err() {
                break;
            }
        }
    });
    daemon.client_connected();
    let hello = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
    let mut subscription: Option<JoinHandle<()>> = None;
    let mut closing = daemon.closing.subscribe();
    let mut streams: Vec<JoinHandle<()>> = Vec::new();
    let mut reader = BufReader::new(r);
    let mut buf = Vec::new();
    loop {
        buf.clear();
        let mut limited = tokio::io::AsyncReadExt::take(&mut reader, MAX_LINE as u64 + 1);
        let read = limited.read_until(b'\n', &mut buf);
        let n = tokio::select! {
            r = read => match r {
                Ok(n) => n,
                Err(_) => break,
            },
            _ = closing.wait_for(|c| *c) => break,
        };
        if n == 0 {
            break;
        }
        if buf.len() > MAX_LINE {
            let _ = tx.send(line(&Response::err(
                Value::Null,
                RpcError::new(INVALID_REQUEST, "request line too long"),
            )));
            break;
        }
        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf);
        let text = text.trim();
        if text.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let value: Value = match serde_json::from_str(text) {
            Ok(v) => v,
            Err(e) => {
                let _ = tx.send(line(&Response::err(
                    Value::Null,
                    RpcError::new(PARSE_ERROR, format!("parse error: {e}")),
                )));
                continue;
            }
        };
        let id = value.get("id").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null);
        let req = match serde_json::from_value::<Request>(value) {
            Ok(r) if r.jsonrpc == "2.0" => r,
            Ok(_) => {
                let _ = tx.send(line(&Response::err(
                    id,
                    RpcError::new(INVALID_REQUEST, "jsonrpc must be \"2.0\""),
                )));
                continue;
            }
            Err(e) => {
                let _ = tx.send(line(&Response::err(
                    id,
                    RpcError::new(INVALID_REQUEST, format!("invalid request: {e}")),
                )));
                continue;
            }
        };
        let Some(id) = req.id.clone() else {
            // Notifications from clients have no meaning here.
            continue;
        };
        if req.method == "daemon.shutdown" {
            // Allowed before hello, so a newer client can replace a stale
            // daemon. Running emulators keep running and are re-adopted.
            let _ = tx.send(line(&Response::ok(id, json!({ "stopping": true }))));
            daemon.stop.notify_one();
            continue;
        }
        if req.method == "hello" {
            let resp = match daemon.hello(req.params) {
                Ok(r) => {
                    hello.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
                    Response::ok(id, r)
                }
                Err(e) => Response::err(id, RpcError::from_jidr(&e)),
            };
            let _ = tx.send(line(&resp));
            continue;
        }
        if !hello.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
            let _ = tx.send(line(&Response::err(
                id,
                RpcError::new(INVALID_REQUEST, "call hello first"),
            )));
            continue;
        }
        // Connection-scoped streams.
        let stream = match req.method.as_str() {
            "events.subscribe" => Some(daemon.subscribe(req.params.clone(), tx.clone())),
            "logcat.follow" => Some(daemon.logcat_follow(req.params.clone(), tx.clone()).await),
            _ => None,
        };
        if let Some(started) = stream {
            let resp = match started {
                Ok((result, task)) => {
                    if req.method == "events.subscribe" {
                        // A new subscription replaces the previous filter.
                        if let Some(old) = subscription.replace(task) {
                            old.abort();
                        }
                    } else {
                        streams.push(task);
                    }
                    Response::ok(id, result)
                }
                Err(e) => Response::err(id, RpcError::from_jidr(&e)),
            };
            let _ = tx.send(line(&resp));
            continue;
        }
        let (daemon, tx) = (daemon.clone(), tx.clone());
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let resp = daemon.dispatch(id, req.method, req.params).await;
            let _ = tx.send(line(&resp));
        });
    }
    for t in streams.into_iter().chain(subscription) {
        t.abort();
    }
    drop(tx);
    let _ = writer.await;
    daemon.client_disconnected();
}

impl Daemon {
    fn hello(&self, params: Value) -> JidrResult<Value> {
        let p: HelloParams = jidr_core::provider::parse_params(params)?;
        if p.version != self.version {
            return Err(JidrError::new(
                ErrorCode::DaemonStale,
                format!(
                    "the running daemon is {} but this client is {}; restart the daemon",
                    self.version, p.version
                ),
            )
            .with_data(json!({ "daemon_version": self.version, "client_version": p.version })));
        }
        serde_json::to_value(HelloResult {
            version: self.version.clone(),
            protocol: rpc::PROTOCOL_VERSION.into(),
            pid: std::process::id(),
        })
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(e.to_string()))
    }

    /// Runs one request.
    pub(crate) async fn dispatch(
        self: &Arc<Self>,
        id: Value,
        method: String,
        params: Value,
    ) -> Response {
        if method == "commands.list" {
            return Response::ok(
                id,
                serde_json::to_value(self.registry.list()).unwrap_or(Value::Null),
            );
        }
        let Some((provider, spec)) = self.registry.get(&method) else {
            return Response::err(
                id,
                RpcError::new(METHOD_NOT_FOUND, format!("unknown method {method}")),
            );
        };
        let (provider, spec) = (provider.clone(), spec.clone());
        let result: JidrResult<Value> = async {
            crate::validate::validate(&spec.params, &params)?;
            let (guard, device) = if spec.locks_device {
                let selector = params
                    .get("device")
                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
                    .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::usage("invalid params: missing field `device`"))?;
                let device = self.state.device(selector).await?;
                let guard = self
                    .state
                    .locks
                    .try_lock(device.id, &device.name, &method, None)?;
                (Some(guard), Some(device.id))
            } else {
                (None, None)
            };
            let daemon: Arc<dyn DaemonContext> = self.state.clone();
            if !spec.long_running {
                return provider.call(&CallCtx::new(daemon), &method, params).await;
            }
            // Long-running: answer now with the job; the lock moves into it.
            let (job, cancel) = self.jobs.create(&method, device);
            if let Some(d) = device {
                self.state.locks.set_job(d, job);
            }
            let (jobs, events) = (self.jobs.clone(), daemon.clone());
            let progress: ProgressFn = Arc::new(move |fraction, message| {
                jobs.progress(job, fraction, message);
                events.emit(
                    "job.progress",
                    json!({ "job": job, "progress": fraction, "message": message }),
                );
            });
            let (jobs, events) = (self.jobs.clone(), daemon.clone());
            let bytes: BytesFn = Arc::new(move |fraction, message, done, total| {
                jobs.progress_bytes(job, fraction, message, done, total);
                events.emit(
                    "job.progress",
                    json!({
                        "job": job,
                        "progress": fraction,
                        "message": message,
                        "bytes": { "done": done, "total": total },
                    }),
                );
            });
            let ctx = CallCtx {
                daemon: daemon.clone(),
                progress,
                bytes,
                cancel,
            };
            let jobs = self.jobs.clone();
            daemon.emit(
                "job.started",
                json!({ "job": job, "kind": method, "device": device }),
            );
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                let _guard = guard;
                crate::jobs::run_job(jobs, daemon, job, provider.call(&ctx, &method, params)).await;
            });
            Ok(json!({ "job": job, "pending": true }))
        }
        .await;
        match result {
            Ok(v) => Response::ok(id, v),
            Err(e) => Response::err(id, RpcError::from_jidr(&e)),
        }
    }

    /// `events.subscribe {topics}`: forwards matching events to this connection.
    fn subscribe(
        &self,
        params: Value,
        tx: mpsc::UnboundedSender<String>,
    ) -> JidrResult<(Value, JoinHandle<()>)> {
        let p: SubscribeParams = parse_params(params)?;
        let mut rx = self.state.subscribe();
        let topics = p.topics.clone();
        let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            loop {
                match rx.recv().await {
                    Ok(ev) => {
                        if topics.is_empty()
                            || topics.iter().any(|t| ev.topic.starts_with(t.as_str()))
                        {
                            let n = Notification::new(
                                rpc::EVENT_METHOD,
                                serde_json::to_value(&ev).unwrap_or(Value::Null),
                            );
                            if tx.send(line(&n)).is_err() {
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(n)) => {
                        let n = Notification::new(
                            rpc::EVENT_METHOD,
                            json!({ "topic": "events.lagged", "data": { "missed": n } }),
                        );
                        let _ = tx.send(line(&n));
                    }
                    Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Closed) => break,
                }
            }
        });
        Ok((json!({ "subscribed": p.topics }), task))
    }

    /// `logcat.follow {device, filter}`: streams `logcat` events to this connection.
    async fn logcat_follow(
        &self,
        params: Value,
        tx: mpsc::UnboundedSender<String>,
    ) -> JidrResult<(Value, JoinHandle<()>)> {
        let p: LogcatFollowParams = parse_params(params)?;
        let device = self.state.device(&p.device).await?;
        let info = self.state.connect_info(device.id).await?;
        let mut args = vec!["-v", "threadtime"];
        args.extend(p.filter.iter().map(String::as_str));
        let mut stream = Adb::new(info.adb_path)
            .device(info.adb_serial)
            .logcat_follow(&args)?;
        let id = device.id;
        let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            while let Some(l) = stream.lines.recv().await {
                let ev = json!({ "topic": "logcat", "data": { "device": id, "line": l } });
                if tx
                    .send(line(&Notification::new(rpc::EVENT_METHOD, ev)))
                    .is_err()
                {
                    break;
                }
            }
            stream.stop().await;
        });
        Ok((json!({ "following": id }), task))
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SubscribeParams {
    /// Topic prefixes, e.g. `["device.", "job."]`; empty = everything.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub topics: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct LogcatFollowParams {
    pub device: String,
    /// logcat filter specs.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub filter: Vec<String>,
}

```

`crates/jidr-daemon/src/state.rs`:

```rs
//! Daemon state: devices, running instances, crash watchers. Implements the
//! `DaemonContext` providers use.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, MutexGuard, OnceLock, Weak};

use async_trait::async_trait;
use jidr_backend::{Backend, BootStage, InstanceInfo, LaunchOptions, LaunchSpec};
use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, CommandProvider, DaemonContext, DeviceUpdate};
use jidr_core::{
    Cancel, ConnectInfo, Device, DeviceStatus, JidrError, JidrPaths, JidrResult, Settings,
};
use jidr_sdk::{AvdManager, Sdk, SdkSet};
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use tokio::sync::broadcast;
use tokio::task::JoinHandle;
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::locks::DeviceLocks;
use crate::store::DeviceStore;
use jidr_core::rpc::Event;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct DaemonConfig {
    pub paths: JidrPaths,
    /// Android Studio's SDK (read-only). `None` = auto-detect.
    pub studio_sdk: Option<PathBuf>,
    /// Exit after this long idle (D4: 10 min). `None` = never.
    pub idle_timeout: Option<std::time::Duration>,
    /// SDK repository base URL (mirrors, tests). `None` = `$JIDR_SDK_REPO`
    /// or Google's.
    pub sdk_repo: Option<String>,
}

impl DaemonConfig {
    /// Product defaults: auto-detected Studio SDK, 10-minute idle exit (D4).
    pub fn new(paths: JidrPaths) -> Self {
        Self {
            paths,
            studio_sdk: None,
            idle_timeout: Some(crate::lifecycle::IDLE_TIMEOUT),
            sdk_repo: None,
        }
    }
}

pub struct State {
    pub(crate) paths: JidrPaths,
    studio_sdk: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub(crate) sdk_repo: Option<String>,
    pub(crate) backend: Arc<dyn Backend>,
    store: Mutex<DeviceStore>,
    settings: Mutex<Settings>,
    instances: Mutex<HashMap<Uuid, InstanceInfo>>,
    watchers: Mutex<HashMap<Uuid, JoinHandle<()>>>,
    pub(crate) locks: DeviceLocks,
    providers: OnceLock<Vec<Arc<dyn CommandProvider>>>,
    events: broadcast::Sender<Event>,
    me: Weak<State>,
    pub(crate) started_at: std::time::Instant,
}

impl std::fmt::Debug for State {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        f.debug_struct("State")
            .field("paths", &self.paths)
            .finish_non_exhaustive()
    }
}

fn lock<T>(m: &Mutex<T>) -> MutexGuard<'_, T> {
    m.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
}

/// `settings.json`, or the defaults when it is missing or unreadable.
fn load_settings(path: &std::path::Path) -> Settings {
    match std::fs::read_to_string(path) {
        Ok(text) => serde_json::from_str(&text).unwrap_or_else(|e| {
            tracing::warn!("{}: {e}; using the default settings", path.display());
            Settings::default()
        }),
        Err(_) => Settings::default(),
    }
}

fn save_settings(path: &std::path::Path, s: &Settings) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let text = serde_json::to_string_pretty(s).map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(e.to_string()))?;
    if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)
            .map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(format!("{}: {e}", dir.display())))?;
    }
    let tmp = path.with_extension("json.tmp");
    std::fs::write(&tmp, text)
        .and_then(|()| std::fs::rename(&tmp, path))
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(format!("{}: {e}", path.display())))
}

impl State {
    pub fn new(config: DaemonConfig, backend: Arc<dyn Backend>) -> JidrResult<Arc<Self>> {
        let store = DeviceStore::load(config.paths.devices_file())?;
        let settings = load_settings(&config.paths.settings_file());
        let (events, _) = broadcast::channel(1024);
        Ok(Arc::new_cyclic(|me| Self {
            paths: config.paths,
            studio_sdk: config.studio_sdk,
            sdk_repo: config.sdk_repo,
            backend,
            store: Mutex::new(store),
            settings: Mutex::new(settings),
            instances: Mutex::new(HashMap::new()),
            watchers: Mutex::new(HashMap::new()),
            locks: DeviceLocks::default(),
            providers: OnceLock::new(),
            events,
            me: me.clone(),
            started_at: std::time::Instant::now(),
        }))
    }

    /// Daemon-wide settings (gap B4).
    pub fn settings(&self) -> Settings {
        *lock(&self.settings)
    }

    /// Changes the settings and saves them to `settings.json`.
    pub fn update_settings(&self, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Settings)) -> JidrResult<Settings> {
        let mut current = lock(&self.settings);
        let mut next = *current;
        f(&mut next);
        save_settings(&self.paths.settings_file(), &next)?;
        *current = next;
        Ok(next)
    }

    pub(crate) fn set_providers(&self, providers: Vec<Arc<dyn CommandProvider>>) {
        let _ = self.providers.set(providers);
    }

    fn arc(&self) -> JidrResult<Arc<State>> {
        self.me
            .upgrade()
            .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::unexpected("daemon is shutting down"))
    }

    pub fn sdks(&self) -> SdkSet {
        SdkSet {
            private: Sdk::private(&self.paths),
            studio: match &self.studio_sdk {
                Some(p) => Some(Sdk::read_only(p)),
                None => Sdk::studio(),
            },
        }
    }

    pub fn avds(&self) -> AvdManager {
        AvdManager::new(self.paths.avd_home())
    }

    pub fn subscribe(&self) -> broadcast::Receiver<Event> {
        self.events.subscribe()
    }

    /// Runs `f` on the device store.
    pub fn with_store<T>(&self, f: impl FnOnce(&mut DeviceStore) -> T) -> T {
        f(&mut lock(&self.store))
    }

    pub fn instance(&self, id: Uuid) -> Option<InstanceInfo> {
        lock(&self.instances).get(&id).cloned()
    }

    pub fn running_count(&self) -> usize {
        lock(&self.instances).len()
    }

    fn set_status(
        &self,
        id: Uuid,
        status: DeviceStatus,
        runtime: Option<Option<jidr_core::DeviceRuntime>>,
    ) {
        let updated = self.with_store(|s| {
            s.set_runtime(id, |d| {
                d.status = status;
                if let Some(rt) = runtime {
                    d.runtime = rt;
                }
            })
        });
        if let Some(d) = updated {
            self.emit(
                "device.status",
                json!({ "device": d.id, "name": d.name, "status": d.status }),
            );
        }
    }

    /// Re-adopts emulators that kept running across a daemon restart.
    pub async fn adopt_running(&self) {
        for info in self.backend.adopt(&self.paths.avd_home()).await {
            let id = self.with_store(|s| s.all().iter().find(|d| d.avd == info.avd).map(|d| d.id));
            let Some(id) = id else { continue };
            lock(&self.instances).insert(id, info.clone());
            self.set_status(id, DeviceStatus::Running, Some(Some(info.runtime())));
            self.watch_crash(id, info);
        }
    }

    fn watch_crash(&self, id: Uuid, info: InstanceInfo) {
        let Ok(me) = self.arc() else { return };
        let handle = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let log_dir = me.paths.device_logs(&info.avd);
            let report = me.backend.wait_for_crash(&info, &log_dir).await;
            let still_ours = lock(&me.instances)
                .get(&id)
                .is_some_and(|i| i.pid == info.pid);
            if !still_ours {
                return;
            }
            lock(&me.instances).remove(&id);
            lock(&me.watchers).remove(&id);
            // Releases ports; the process is already gone.
            let _ = me.backend.stop(&info).await;
            me.set_status(
                id,
                DeviceStatus::Crashed {
                    reason: report.reason.clone(),
                    log: report.log.clone(),
                },
                Some(None),
            );
            me.emit("device.crashed", json!({ "device": id, "report": report }));
        });
        if let Some(old) = lock(&self.watchers).insert(id, handle) {
            old.abort();
        }
    }

    fn launch_spec(&self, d: &Device) -> JidrResult<(LaunchSpec, Sdk)> {
        let sdks = self.sdks();
        let image_sdk = sdks.find_image(&d.image).cloned().ok_or_else(|| {
            JidrError::sdk(format!(
                "system image {} is not installed; run `jidr image install {}:{}`",
                d.image.package(),
                d.image.api,
                d.image.tag
            ))
        })?;
        let tools = sdks.tools()?.clone();
        Ok((
            LaunchSpec {
                avd: d.avd.clone(),
                avd_home: self.paths.avd_home(),
                sdk_root: image_sdk.root.clone(),
                sysdir: image_sdk.image_dir(&d.image),
                emulator: tools.emulator(),
                adb: tools.adb(),
                log_dir: self.paths.device_logs(&d.avd),
            },
            image_sdk,
        ))
    }

    async fn run_boot_hooks(&self, device: &Device) {
        let Ok(me) = self.arc() else { return };
        let providers = self.providers.get().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
        let ctx = CallCtx::new(me);
        for p in providers {
            if let Err(e) = p.on_booted(&ctx, device).await {
                tracing::warn!(provider = p.name(), device = %device.name, "boot hook failed: {e}");
                self.emit(
                    "device.hook_failed",
                    json!({ "device": device.id, "provider": p.name(), "error": e }),
                );
            }
        }
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl DaemonContext for State {
    fn paths(&self) -> &JidrPaths {
        &self.paths
    }

    fn adb_path(&self) -> JidrResult<PathBuf> {
        Ok(self.sdks().tools()?.adb())
    }

    async fn device(&self, selector: &str) -> JidrResult<Device> {
        self.with_store(|s| s.find(selector).cloned())
    }

    async fn devices(&self) -> Vec<Device> {
        self.with_store(|s| s.all().to_vec())
    }

    async fn connect_info(&self, device: Uuid) -> JidrResult<ConnectInfo> {
        let info = self
            .instance(device)
            .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::not_found("device is not running; start it first"))?;
        Ok(ConnectInfo {
            device,
            grpc_endpoint: format!("127.0.0.1:{}", info.grpc_port),
            grpc_port: info.grpc_port,
            grpc_token: info.grpc_token.clone(),
            adb_serial: info.adb_serial.clone(),
            adb_path: self.adb_path()?,
            console_port: info.console_port,
        })
    }

    async fn update_device(&self, device: Uuid, f: DeviceUpdate) -> JidrResult<Device> {
        let d = self.with_store(|s| s.update(device, f))?;
        self.emit("device.updated", json!({ "device": d.id, "name": d.name }));
        Ok(d)
    }

    async fn start_device(&self, id: Uuid, cold_boot: bool, cancel: &Cancel) -> JidrResult<Device> {
        let device = self.with_store(|s| s.get(id).cloned())?;
        if let Some(info) = self.instance(id) {
            if self.backend.is_alive(&info).await {
                return Ok(device);
            }
            lock(&self.instances).remove(&id);
        }
        let (spec, _) = self.launch_spec(&device)?;
        for cam in [&device.launch.camera_back, &device.launch.camera_front]
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
        {
            if !jidr_backend::valid_camera(cam) {
                return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
                    "invalid camera {cam:?}: use emulated, virtualscene, none or webcamN"
                )));
            }
        }
        let opts = LaunchOptions {
            ramdisk: device.launch.ramdisk.clone(),
            camera_back: device.launch.camera_back.clone(),
            camera_front: device.launch.camera_front.clone(),
            extra_args: device.launch.extra_args.clone(),
            gpu: device.launch.gpu.clone(),
            cold_boot: cold_boot || device.launch.force_cold_boot,
            // D29 / gap B4: save a quick-boot snapshot on stop unless off.
            snapshot_save: self.settings().quick_boot,
            ..LaunchOptions::default()
        };
        self.set_status(id, DeviceStatus::Starting, None);
        let progress = |stage: BootStage| {
            if stage == BootStage::Spawned {
                self.set_status(id, DeviceStatus::Booting, None);
            }
            self.emit(
                "device.boot",
                json!({ "device": id, "stage": stage, "progress": stage.progress() }),
            );
        };
        let info = match self.backend.start(&spec, &opts, &progress, cancel).await {
            Ok(info) => info,
            Err(e) => {
                self.set_status(id, DeviceStatus::Stopped, Some(None));
                self.emit("device.boot_failed", json!({ "device": id, "error": e }));
                return Err(e);
            }
        };
        lock(&self.instances).insert(id, info.clone());
        self.set_status(id, DeviceStatus::Running, Some(Some(info.runtime())));
        if device.launch.force_cold_boot {
            self.with_store(|s| s.update(id, |d| d.launch.force_cold_boot = false))?;
        }
        self.watch_crash(id, info);
        let device = self.with_store(|s| s.get(id).cloned())?;
        self.run_boot_hooks(&device).await;
        Ok(device)
    }

    async fn stop_device(&self, id: Uuid) -> JidrResult<Device> {
        if let Some(w) = lock(&self.watchers).remove(&id) {
            w.abort();
        }
        let info = lock(&self.instances).remove(&id);
        if let Some(info) = info {
            self.set_status(id, DeviceStatus::Stopping, None);
            if let Err(e) = self.backend.stop(&info).await {
                // Put it back: we don't know its state.
                lock(&self.instances).insert(id, info.clone());
                self.watch_crash(id, info);
                return Err(e);
            }
        }
        self.set_status(id, DeviceStatus::Stopped, Some(None));
        self.with_store(|s| s.get(id).cloned())
    }

    fn emit(&self, topic: &str, data: Value) {
        // No listeners is fine.
        let _ = self.events.send(Event {
            topic: topic.to_string(),
            data,
        });
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-daemon/src/store.rs`:

```rs
//! The device registry (`devices.json`): Jidr's metadata for every AVD it owns.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use jidr_core::{Device, ErrorCode, JidrError, JidrResult, ResultExt};
use uuid::Uuid;

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct DeviceStore {
    path: PathBuf,
    devices: Vec<Device>,
}

impl DeviceStore {
    pub fn load(path: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> JidrResult<Self> {
        let path = path.into();
        let devices = match std::fs::read(&path) {
            Ok(b) => serde_json::from_slice(&b)
                .ctx(ErrorCode::Unexpected, format!("reading {}", path.display()))?,
            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Vec::new(),
            Err(e) => {
                return Err(JidrError::unexpected(format!(
                    "reading {}: {e}",
                    path.display()
                )));
            }
        };
        Ok(Self { path, devices })
    }

    pub fn path(&self) -> &Path {
        &self.path
    }

    fn save(&self) -> JidrResult<()> {
        if let Some(dir) = self.path.parent() {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)
                .ctx(ErrorCode::Unexpected, format!("creating {}", dir.display()))?;
        }
        // Runtime fields are not persisted: a restart re-adopts running devices.
        let persisted: Vec<Device> = self
            .devices
            .iter()
            .cloned()
            .map(|mut d| {
                d.runtime = None;
                if d.status.is_active() {
                    d.status = jidr_core::DeviceStatus::Stopped;
                }
                d
            })
            .collect();
        let json =
            serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&persisted).ctx(ErrorCode::Unexpected, "encoding devices")?;
        let tmp = self.path.with_extension("json.tmp");
        std::fs::write(&tmp, json)
            .ctx(ErrorCode::Unexpected, format!("writing {}", tmp.display()))?;
        std::fs::rename(&tmp, &self.path).ctx(
            ErrorCode::Unexpected,
            format!("writing {}", self.path.display()),
        )
    }

    pub fn all(&self) -> &[Device] {
        &self.devices
    }

    /// By id, or by name (case-insensitive).
    pub fn find(&self, selector: &str) -> JidrResult<&Device> {
        let by_id = Uuid::parse_str(selector).ok();
        self.devices
            .iter()
            .find(|d| Some(d.id) == by_id || d.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(selector))
            .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::not_found(format!("no device named {selector:?}")))
    }

    pub fn get(&self, id: Uuid) -> JidrResult<&Device> {
        self.devices
            .iter()
            .find(|d| d.id == id)
            .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::not_found(format!("no device {id}")))
    }

    pub fn name_taken(&self, name: &str, except: Option<Uuid>) -> bool {
        self.devices
            .iter()
            .any(|d| d.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name) && Some(d.id) != except)
    }

    /// A free AVD id derived from a display name: `My Phone` → `My_Phone`.
    pub fn avd_id_for(&self, name: &str, exists: impl Fn(&str) -> bool) -> String {
        let base: String = name
            .chars()
            .map(|c| {
                if c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(c, '.' | '-' | '_') {
                    c
                } else {
                    '_'
                }
            })
            .collect::<String>()
            .trim_start_matches('.')
            .chars()
            .take(48)
            .collect();
        let base = if base.is_empty() {
            "device".to_string()
        } else {
            base
        };
        let taken = |id: &str| exists(id) || self.devices.iter().any(|d| d.avd == id);
        if !taken(&base) {
            return base;
        }
        (2..)
            .map(|n| format!("{base}_{n}"))
            .find(|c| !taken(c))
            .unwrap_or(base)
    }

    pub fn insert(&mut self, device: Device) -> JidrResult<()> {
        if self.name_taken(&device.name, None) {
            return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
                "a device named {:?} already exists",
                device.name
            )));
        }
        self.devices.push(device);
        self.save()
    }

    /// Updates a device in memory and on disk.
    pub fn update(&mut self, id: Uuid, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Device)) -> JidrResult<Device> {
        let d = self
            .devices
            .iter_mut()
            .find(|d| d.id == id)
            .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::not_found(format!("no device {id}")))?;
        f(d);
        let out = d.clone();
        self.save()?;
        Ok(out)
    }

    /// Runtime-only change (status, runtime): not written to disk.
    pub fn set_runtime(&mut self, id: Uuid, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Device)) -> Option<Device> {
        let d = self.devices.iter_mut().find(|d| d.id == id)?;
        f(d);
        Some(d.clone())
    }

    pub fn remove(&mut self, id: Uuid) -> JidrResult<Device> {
        let i = self
            .devices
            .iter()
            .position(|d| d.id == id)
            .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::not_found(format!("no device {id}")))?;
        let d = self.devices.remove(i);
        self.save()?;
        Ok(d)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use jidr_core::{DeviceRuntime, DeviceStatus, ImageRef};

    fn device(name: &str) -> Device {
        Device {
            id: Uuid::new_v4(),
            name: name.into(),
            avd: name.replace(' ', "_"),
            profile: "phone-6.1-fhd".into(),
            image: ImageRef {
                api: 35,
                tag: "google_apis".into(),
                abi: "arm64-v8a".into(),
            },
            sdk_root: "/sdk".into(),
            root: Default::default(),
            agent_owned: false,
            created_at: chrono::Utc::now(),
            launch: Default::default(),
            status: Default::default(),
            runtime: None,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn insert_find_update_remove_persist() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let path = dir.path().join("devices.json");
        let mut s = DeviceStore::load(&path).unwrap();
        let a = device("My Phone");
        s.insert(a.clone()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            s.insert(device("my phone")).unwrap_err().code,
            ErrorCode::Usage,
            "names are unique, case-insensitive"
        );
        assert_eq!(s.find("MY PHONE").unwrap().id, a.id);
        assert_eq!(s.find(&a.id.to_string()).unwrap().name, "My Phone");
        assert_eq!(s.find("nope").unwrap_err().code, ErrorCode::NotFound);

        s.update(a.id, |d| d.agent_owned = true).unwrap();
        s.set_runtime(a.id, |d| {
            d.status = DeviceStatus::Running;
            d.runtime = Some(DeviceRuntime {
                pid: 1,
                console_port: 5554,
                adb_serial: "emulator-5554".into(),
                grpc_port: 1,
                started_at: chrono::Utc::now(),
            });
        });
        s.update(a.id, |_| {}).unwrap();
        let reloaded = DeviceStore::load(&path).unwrap();
        let d = reloaded.find("My Phone").unwrap();
        assert!(d.agent_owned);
        assert_eq!(
            d.status,
            DeviceStatus::Stopped,
            "runtime state is not persisted"
        );
        assert!(d.runtime.is_none());

        s.remove(a.id).unwrap();
        assert!(DeviceStore::load(&path).unwrap().all().is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn avd_ids_are_sanitized_and_unique() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let mut s = DeviceStore::load(dir.path().join("d.json")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(s.avd_id_for("My Phone 6.1″", |_| false), "My_Phone_6.1_");
        assert_eq!(s.avd_id_for(".hidden", |_| false), "hidden");
        assert_eq!(s.avd_id_for("ü", |_| false), "_");
        s.insert(device("Pixel")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(s.avd_id_for("Pixel", |_| false), "Pixel_2");
        assert_eq!(s.avd_id_for("Other", |id| id == "Other"), "Other_2");
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Test helpers shared by the daemon, client, CLI and MCP tests: an
//! in-process daemon on a temp socket with the fake backend and a fake
//! Android Studio SDK. Not used by the product.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;

use jidr_backend::fake::FakeBackend;
use jidr_core::{ImageRef, JidrPaths, JidrResult};

use crate::{Daemon, DaemonConfig};

/// The image the fake SDK provides (API 35 `google_apis`, host ABI), plus its
/// Play Store twin.
pub fn fake_image() -> ImageRef {
    ImageRef {
        api: 35,
        tag: "google_apis".into(),
        abi: jidr_sdk::host::host_abi().into(),
    }
}

fn write_exec(path: &Path, body: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)?;
    }
    std::fs::write(path, body)?;
    #[cfg(unix)]
    {
        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
        std::fs::set_permissions(path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755))?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// A Studio-like SDK: an `emulator` stub, an `adb` that answers like a
/// device, and two complete images.
pub fn fake_studio(root: &Path) -> std::io::Result<PathBuf> {
    write_exec(&root.join("emulator/emulator"), "#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n")?;
    write_exec(
        &root.join("platform-tools/adb"),
        "#!/bin/sh\nwhile [ \"$1\" = -s ]; do shift 2; done\ncase \"$1\" in\n  install) echo Success;;\n  uninstall) echo Success;;\n  logcat) echo 'I/fake: hello';;\n  shell) echo 'fake shell';;\n  *) echo ok;;\nesac\n",
    )?;
    for img in [
        fake_image(),
        ImageRef {
            tag: "google_apis_playstore".into(),
            ..fake_image()
        },
    ] {
        let dir = root.join(img.sysdir());
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir)?;
        for f in ["source.properties", "system.img", "ramdisk.img"] {
            std::fs::write(dir.join(f), b"x")?;
        }
    }
    Ok(root.to_path_buf())
}

/// A daemon serving on `<root>/j/data/daemon.sock`.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct TestDaemon {
    pub paths: JidrPaths,
    pub studio: PathBuf,
    pub backend: Arc<FakeBackend>,
    pub daemon: Arc<Daemon>,
    shutdown: Option<tokio::sync::oneshot::Sender<()>>,
    task: Option<tokio::task::JoinHandle<JidrResult<()>>>,
}

impl TestDaemon {
    /// Starts serving and waits for the socket.
    pub async fn start(root: &Path) -> JidrResult<Self> {
        let paths = JidrPaths::under(root.join("j"));
        let studio = fake_studio(&root.join("studio"))
            .map_err(|e| jidr_core::JidrError::unexpected(format!("fake SDK: {e}")))?;
        // An empty local SDK repository: no test ever reaches the network.
        let repo = root.join("repo");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&repo)
            .and_then(|()| {
                std::fs::write(
                    repo.join("repository2-3.xml"),
                    "<sdk:sdk-repository xmlns:sdk=\"x\"/>",
                )
            })
            .map_err(|e| jidr_core::JidrError::unexpected(format!("fake repo: {e}")))?;
        let backend = Arc::new(FakeBackend::new());
        let daemon = Daemon::builder(
            DaemonConfig {
                paths: paths.clone(),
                studio_sdk: Some(studio.clone()),
                idle_timeout: None,
                sdk_repo: Some(format!("file://{}/", repo.display())),
            },
            backend.clone(),
        )
        .build()?;
        let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel();
        let d = daemon.clone();
        let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            d.serve(async {
                let _ = rx.await;
            })
            .await
        });
        for _ in 0..500 {
            if paths.socket().exists() {
                break;
            }
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
        }
        Ok(Self {
            paths,
            studio,
            backend,
            daemon,
            shutdown: Some(tx),
            task: Some(task),
        })
    }

    pub async fn stop(mut self) {
        if let Some(tx) = self.shutdown.take() {
            let _ = tx.send(());
        }
        if let Some(t) = self.task.take() {
            let _ = t.await;
        }
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-daemon/src/validate.rs`:

```rs
//! Params validation against a command's JSON Schema, before any lock is
//! taken or handler runs: object shape, unknown keys, required keys and
//! primitive types. Handlers still deserialize strictly; this makes the error
//! uniform (`usage`, -32602, naming the key) for every provider.

use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};
use serde_json::Value;

/// `params` (null = `{}`) against `schema` (schemars output).
pub fn validate(schema: &Value, params: &Value) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let empty = Value::Object(Default::default());
    let params = if params.is_null() { &empty } else { params };
    let Some(obj) = params.as_object() else {
        return Err(JidrError::usage("invalid params: expected an object"));
    };
    let props = schema.get("properties").and_then(Value::as_object);
    if schema.get("additionalProperties") == Some(&Value::Bool(false)) {
        for key in obj.keys() {
            if !props.is_some_and(|p| p.contains_key(key)) {
                return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
                    "invalid params: unknown field `{key}`"
                )));
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(required) = schema.get("required").and_then(Value::as_array) {
        for key in required.iter().filter_map(Value::as_str) {
            if !obj.contains_key(key) {
                return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
                    "invalid params: missing field `{key}`"
                )));
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(props) = props {
        for (key, value) in obj {
            if let Some(prop) = props.get(key)
                && !type_matches(prop, value)
            {
                return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
                    "invalid params: `{key}` must be {}",
                    describe(prop)
                )));
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// The property's declared JSON types; `None` when it uses `$ref`/`anyOf`/…
/// (left to the handler's own deserialization).
fn declared_types(prop: &Value) -> Option<Vec<&str>> {
    match prop.get("type")? {
        Value::String(t) => Some(vec![t.as_str()]),
        Value::Array(ts) => Some(ts.iter().filter_map(Value::as_str).collect()),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn type_matches(prop: &Value, v: &Value) -> bool {
    let Some(types) = declared_types(prop) else {
        return true;
    };
    types.iter().any(|t| match *t {
        "string" => v.is_string(),
        "boolean" => v.is_boolean(),
        "integer" => v.is_i64() || v.is_u64(),
        "number" => v.is_number(),
        "array" => v.is_array(),
        "object" => v.is_object(),
        "null" => v.is_null(),
        _ => true,
    })
}

fn describe(prop: &Value) -> String {
    declared_types(prop)
        .map(|t| t.join(" or "))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "valid".into())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use serde_json::json;

    fn schema() -> Value {
        json!({
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": ["device"],
            "properties": {
                "device": { "type": "string" },
                "cold_boot": { "type": "boolean" },
                "lines": { "type": ["integer", "null"], "format": "uint32" },
                "mode": { "$ref": "#/$defs/RootMode" }
            }
        })
    }

    #[test]
    fn accepts_valid_params() {
        validate(&schema(), &json!({ "device": "a" })).unwrap();
        validate(
            &schema(),
            &json!({ "device": "a", "cold_boot": true, "lines": null, "mode": "adb" }),
        )
        .unwrap();
        validate(&json!({ "type": "object", "properties": {} }), &Value::Null).unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_with_the_key_named() {
        let cases = [
            (json!({ "device": "a", "colld": 1 }), "colld"),
            (json!({}), "device"),
            (json!({ "device": 5 }), "device"),
            (json!({ "device": "a", "cold_boot": "yes" }), "cold_boot"),
            (json!({ "device": "a", "lines": 1.5 }), "lines"),
            (json!([1, 2]), "object"),
        ];
        for (params, key) in cases {
            let e = validate(&schema(), &params).unwrap_err();
            assert_eq!(e.code, jidr_core::ErrorCode::Usage);
            assert!(e.message.contains(key), "{params} → {e}");
        }
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-daemon/tests/common/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! A raw-socket client on top of `jidr_daemon::testing::TestDaemon`.
#![allow(dead_code)]

use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;

use jidr_backend::fake::FakeBackend;
use jidr_core::JidrPaths;
use jidr_daemon::Daemon;
use jidr_daemon::testing::TestDaemon;
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use tokio::io::{AsyncBufReadExt, AsyncWriteExt, BufReader};
use tokio::net::UnixStream;
use tokio::net::unix::{OwnedReadHalf, OwnedWriteHalf};

pub struct Harness {
    pub tmp: tempfile::TempDir,
    pub paths: JidrPaths,
    pub backend: Arc<FakeBackend>,
    pub daemon: Arc<Daemon>,
    inner: TestDaemon,
}

impl Harness {
    pub async fn start() -> Self {
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let inner = TestDaemon::start(tmp.path()).await.unwrap();
        Self {
            paths: inner.paths.clone(),
            backend: inner.backend.clone(),
            daemon: inner.daemon.clone(),
            tmp,
            inner,
        }
    }

    pub async fn conn(&self) -> Conn {
        Conn::open(&self.paths.socket()).await
    }

    /// A connection that already said hello.
    pub async fn client(&self) -> Conn {
        let mut c = self.conn().await;
        let r = c
            .call(
                "hello",
                json!({ "version": jidr_daemon::VERSION, "client": "test" }),
            )
            .await;
        assert!(r.get("result").is_some(), "{r}");
        c
    }

    pub async fn stop(self) {
        self.inner.stop().await;
    }
}

pub struct Conn {
    reader: BufReader<OwnedReadHalf>,
    writer: OwnedWriteHalf,
    next: u64,
}

impl Conn {
    pub async fn open(path: &Path) -> Self {
        let s = UnixStream::connect(path).await.unwrap();
        let (r, w) = s.into_split();
        Self {
            reader: BufReader::new(r),
            writer: w,
            next: 1,
        }
    }

    pub async fn send_raw(&mut self, line: &str) {
        self.writer
            .write_all(format!("{line}\n").as_bytes())
            .await
            .unwrap();
    }

    pub async fn read(&mut self) -> Value {
        let mut l = String::new();
        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(10), self.reader.read_line(&mut l))
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap();
        serde_json::from_str(&l).unwrap()
    }

    /// Sends a request and returns the full response object.
    pub async fn call(&mut self, method: &str, params: Value) -> Value {
        let id = self.next;
        self.next += 1;
        let req = json!({ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": id, "method": method, "params": params });
        self.send_raw(&req.to_string()).await;
        loop {
            let v = self.read().await;
            if v.get("id") == Some(&json!(id)) {
                return v;
            }
        }
    }

    pub async fn ok(&mut self, method: &str, params: Value) -> Value {
        let r = self.call(method, params).await;
        r.get("result")
            .cloned()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{method} failed: {r}"))
    }

    /// Like `ok`, but follows a `{job, pending}` answer to the job's result.
    pub async fn run(&mut self, method: &str, params: Value) -> Value {
        let r = self.ok(method, params).await;
        if r.get("pending") != Some(&json!(true)) {
            return r;
        }
        let job = self.ok("jobs.wait", json!({ "job": r["job"] })).await;
        assert_eq!(job["state"], "succeeded", "{method} job: {job}");
        job["result"].clone()
    }

    pub async fn err(&mut self, method: &str, params: Value) -> Value {
        let r = self.call(method, params).await;
        r.get("error")
            .cloned()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{method} unexpectedly succeeded: {r}"))
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Protocol conformance over a real Unix socket (fake backend, no emulator).
#![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]

mod common;

use std::time::Duration;

use common::Harness;
use serde_json::json;

#[tokio::test]
async fn bad_json_is_parse_error() {
    let h = Harness::start().await;
    let mut c = h.conn().await;
    c.send_raw("{not json").await;
    let r = c.read().await;
    assert_eq!(r["error"]["code"], -32700);
    assert_eq!(r["id"], serde_json::Value::Null);
    // The connection survives.
    c.send_raw(r#"{"jsonrpc":"1.0","id":7,"method":"hello"}"#)
        .await;
    let r = c.read().await;
    assert_eq!(r["error"]["code"], -32600);
    assert_eq!(r["id"], 7);
    h.stop().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn hello_is_required_and_stale_clients_are_refused() {
    let h = Harness::start().await;
    let mut c = h.conn().await;
    assert_eq!(c.err("device.list", json!({})).await["code"], -32600);
    let e = c.err("hello", json!({ "version": "0.0.0-old" })).await;
    assert_eq!(e["code"], -32008);
    assert_eq!(e["data"]["code"], "daemon_stale");
    assert_eq!(e["data"]["exit_code"], 8);
    assert_eq!(e["data"]["details"]["daemon_version"], jidr_daemon::VERSION);
    let ok = c
        .ok("hello", json!({ "version": jidr_daemon::VERSION }))
        .await;
    assert_eq!(ok["protocol"], "0.1");
    c.ok("device.list", json!({})).await;
    h.stop().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn unknown_method_and_params() {
    let h = Harness::start().await;
    let mut c = h.client().await;
    assert_eq!(c.err("device.explode", json!({})).await["code"], -32601);
    let e = c
        .err("device.create", json!({ "nmae": "x", "image": "35" }))
        .await;
    assert_eq!(e["code"], -32602);
    assert!(e["message"].as_str().unwrap().contains("nmae"), "{e}");
    let e = c
        .err("device.start", json!({ "device": "p", "cold_boot": "yes" }))
        .await;
    assert_eq!(e["code"], -32602, "type errors are usage errors too: {e}");
    let e = c.err("hello", json!({ "version": "x", "extra": 1 })).await;
    assert!(e["message"].as_str().unwrap().contains("extra"), "{e}");
    h.stop().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn device_lifecycle() {
    let h = Harness::start().await;
    let mut c = h.client().await;
    let d = c
        .ok(
            "device.create",
            json!({ "name": "Phone A", "image": "35:google_apis", "ram_mb": 3072 }),
        )
        .await;
    assert_eq!(d["root"]["mode"], "adb", "D7: adb where allowed");
    assert_eq!(d["avd"], "Phone_A");
    let e = c
        .err("device.create", json!({ "name": "phone a", "image": "35" }))
        .await;
    assert_eq!(e["data"]["code"], "usage");
    let e = c
        .err(
            "device.create",
            json!({ "name": "PS", "image": "35:google_apis_playstore", "root_mode": "adb" }),
        )
        .await;
    assert_eq!(e["data"]["code"], "usage");
    let ps = c
        .ok(
            "device.create",
            json!({ "name": "PS", "image": "35:google_apis_playstore" }),
        )
        .await;
    assert_eq!(ps["root"]["mode"], "none");
    let e = c
        .err("device.create", json!({ "name": "B", "image": "29" }))
        .await;
    assert_eq!(e["data"]["code"], "sdk", "image not installed: {e}");

    let details = c.ok("device.details", json!({ "device": "Phone A" })).await;
    assert_eq!(details["config"]["hw.ramSize"], "3072");

    let e = c
        .err("device.connect_info", json!({ "device": "Phone A" }))
        .await;
    assert_eq!(e["data"]["code"], "not_found");
    let started = c.run("device.start", json!({ "device": "Phone A" })).await;
    assert_eq!(started["status"]["state"], "running");
    let ci = c
        .ok("device.connect_info", json!({ "device": "Phone A" }))
        .await;
    assert!(ci["grpc_token"].as_str().unwrap().starts_with("fake-token"));
    assert!(
        ci["grpc_endpoint"]
            .as_str()
            .unwrap()
            .starts_with("127.0.0.1:")
    );

    // adb-backed commands go through the fake adb.
    let apk = h.tmp.path().join("app.apk");
    std::fs::write(&apk, b"apk").unwrap();
    c.ok("file.install", json!({ "device": "Phone A", "apk": apk }))
        .await;
    let log = c
        .ok("logcat.dump", json!({ "device": "Phone A", "lines": 10 }))
        .await;
    assert!(log["text"].as_str().unwrap().contains("hello"));

    let e = c
        .err(
            "device.edit",
            json!({ "device": "Phone A", "ram_mb": 4096 }),
        )
        .await;
    assert_eq!(
        e["data"]["code"], "busy",
        "hardware edits need a stopped device"
    );
    c.ok("device.stop", json!({ "device": "Phone A" })).await;
    c.ok(
        "device.edit",
        json!({ "device": "Phone A", "ram_mb": 4096, "name": "Phone B" }),
    )
    .await;
    let copy = c
        .ok(
            "device.clone",
            json!({ "device": "Phone B", "name": "Phone C" }),
        )
        .await;
    assert_eq!(copy["launch"]["force_cold_boot"], true);
    c.run("device.start", json!({ "device": "Phone C" })).await;
    let launches = h.backend.launches();
    assert!(
        launches.last().unwrap().1.cold_boot,
        "a clone's first boot is cold"
    );
    c.ok("device.reset", json!({ "device": "Phone C" })).await;
    c.ok("device.delete", json!({ "device": "Phone C" })).await;
    c.ok("device.delete", json!({ "device": "Phone B" })).await;
    c.ok("device.delete", json!({ "device": "PS" })).await;
    assert_eq!(c.ok("device.list", json!({})).await, json!([]));
    assert!(h.backend.running().is_empty());
    h.stop().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn busy_lock_names_the_holder() {
    let h = Harness::start().await;
    let mut a = h.client().await;
    let mut b = h.client().await;
    a.ok("device.create", json!({ "name": "Slow", "image": "35" }))
        .await;
    let gate = h.backend.gate_starts();
    // A starts: the job holds the lock while the backend blocks.
    let started = a.ok("device.start", json!({ "device": "Slow" })).await;
    assert_eq!(started["pending"], true);
    let job = started["job"].clone();
    let e = b.err("device.stop", json!({ "device": "Slow" })).await;
    assert_eq!(e["code"], -32004);
    assert_eq!(e["data"]["code"], "busy");
    assert_eq!(e["data"]["details"]["op"], "device.start");
    assert_eq!(e["data"]["details"]["holder"], job, "the holder is the job");
    // Reads don't take the lock.
    b.ok("device.details", json!({ "device": "Slow" })).await;
    gate.add_permits(1);
    let done = a.ok("jobs.wait", json!({ "job": job })).await;
    assert_eq!(done["state"], "succeeded");
    assert_eq!(done["result"]["status"]["state"], "running");
    b.ok("device.stop", json!({ "device": "Slow" })).await;
    h.stop().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn crash_is_reported_not_restarted() {
    let h = Harness::start().await;
    let mut c = h.client().await;
    c.ok("device.create", json!({ "name": "Crashy", "image": "35" }))
        .await;
    let d = c.run("device.start", json!({ "device": "Crashy" })).await;
    let pid = d["runtime"]["pid"].as_u64().unwrap() as u32;
    h.backend.crash(pid);
    let mut state = json!(null);
    for _ in 0..100 {
        let list = c.ok("device.list", json!({})).await;
        state = list[0]["status"].clone();
        if state["state"] == "crashed" {
            break;
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20)).await;
    }
    assert_eq!(state["state"], "crashed", "{state}");
    assert_eq!(state["reason"], "fake crash");
    assert_eq!(h.backend.launches().len(), 1, "D9: no auto-restart");
    // A crashed device can be started again.
    c.run("device.start", json!({ "device": "Crashy" })).await;
    h.stop().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn socket_is_private_and_single_instance() {
    use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
    let h = Harness::start().await;
    let mode = std::fs::metadata(h.paths.socket())
        .unwrap()
        .permissions()
        .mode()
        & 0o777;
    assert_eq!(mode, 0o600);
    let err = jidr_daemon::server::bind(&h.paths.socket()).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(err.code, jidr_core::ErrorCode::Busy);

}

/// Regression (9e manual check, 2026-10-16): with the emulator from Android
/// Studio's SDK and the image only in Jidr's private SDK, the emulator
/// rejected the private SDK as `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT` ("Broken AVD system path")
/// and exited. The launch names the image directory as `-sysdir`.
#[tokio::test]
async fn a_private_sdk_image_launches_with_its_sysdir() {
    let h = Harness::start().await;
    let image = jidr_core::ImageRef {
        api: 34,
        tag: "google_apis".into(),
        abi: jidr_sdk::host::host_abi().into(),
    };
    let dir = h.paths.sdk().join(image.sysdir());
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
    for f in ["source.properties", "system.img", "ramdisk.img"] {
        std::fs::write(dir.join(f), b"x").unwrap();
    }
    let mut c = h.client().await;
    c.ok("device.create", json!({ "name": "Private", "image": "34" }))
        .await;
    c.run("device.start", json!({ "device": "Private" })).await;
    let spec = h.backend.specs().pop().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(spec.sdk_root, h.paths.sdk());
    assert_eq!(spec.sysdir, dir);
    h.stop().await;
}

/// Gap B4: settings live in the daemon (`settings.json`), so `device.create`
/// without `root_mode` and the quick-boot launch flag follow them for every
/// client.
#[tokio::test]
async fn settings_drive_create_and_quick_boot() {
    let h = Harness::start().await;
    let mut c = h.client().await;
    let s = c.ok("settings.get", json!({})).await;
    assert_eq!(s, json!({ "default_root_mode": "adb", "quick_boot": true }));
    // Default adb, but Play Store images refuse adb root: none.
    let ps = c
        .ok(
            "device.create",
            json!({ "name": "PS", "image": "35:google_apis_playstore" }),
        )
        .await;
    assert_eq!(ps["root"]["mode"], "none");

    let s = c
        .ok(
            "settings.set",
            json!({ "default_root_mode": "none", "quick_boot": false }),
        )
        .await;
    assert_eq!(
        s,
        json!({ "default_root_mode": "none", "quick_boot": false })
    );
    let saved: serde_json::Value =
        serde_json::from_str(&std::fs::read_to_string(h.paths.settings_file()).unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(saved, s);
    // Only the given fields change.
    let s = c.ok("settings.set", json!({ "quick_boot": true })).await;
    assert_eq!(s["default_root_mode"], "none");
    c.ok("settings.set", json!({ "quick_boot": false })).await;
    assert_eq!(
        c.err("settings.set", json!({ "quick": true })).await["code"],
        -32602
    );

    let d = c
        .ok("device.create", json!({ "name": "Plain", "image": "35" }))
        .await;
    assert_eq!(d["root"]["mode"], "none");
    c.run("device.start", json!({ "device": "Plain" })).await;
    let (_, opts) = h.backend.launches().pop().unwrap();
    assert!(!opts.snapshot_save, "quick_boot off: -no-snapshot-save");

    // G14: device.details carries the image's pristine ramdisk hash.
    let det = c.ok("device.details", json!({ "device": "Plain" })).await;
    assert_eq!(
        det["pristine_ramdisk_sha256"],
        "2d711642b726b04401627ca9fbac32f5c8530fb1903cc4db02258717921a4881"
    );
    h.stop().await;
}
```

`crates/jidr-daemon/tests/fuzz_params.rs`:

```rs
//! Fuzzes the JSON-RPC parser and params validation through the real socket:
//! 10,000 generated lines (garbage, broken requests, every real method with
//! random params). Each must get exactly one well-formed answer with the
//! right id; a panic in the daemon would show up as a missing answer.
#![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]

mod common;

use common::Harness;
use proptest::prelude::*;
use proptest::strategy::ValueTree;
use proptest::test_runner::{Config, TestRng, TestRunner};
use serde_json::{Map, Value, json};

const CASES: usize = 10_000;

fn json_value() -> impl Strategy<Value = Value> {
    let leaf = prop_oneof![
        Just(Value::Null),
        any::<bool>().prop_map(Value::from),
        any::<i64>().prop_map(Value::from),
        any::<f64>()
            .prop_filter("finite", |f| f.is_finite())
            .prop_map(Value::from),
        "[a-zA-Z0-9 _:;./-]{0,24}".prop_map(Value::from),
        Just(Value::from("35:google_apis")),
        Just(Value::from("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000")),
    ];
    leaf.prop_recursive(3, 32, 6, |inner| {
        prop_oneof![
            prop::collection::vec(inner.clone(), 0..4).prop_map(Value::from),
            prop::collection::btree_map("[a-z_]{1,12}", inner, 0..5)
                .prop_map(|m| Value::Object(m.into_iter().collect())),
        ]
    })
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
enum Case {
    /// A raw line that isn't a well-formed request.
    Raw(String),
    /// A request with an id that must be answered.
    Request(Value),
}

/// Params built from a command's schema: real keys with random values, plus
/// sometimes a bogus key or a missing required one.
fn params_for(schema: Value) -> impl Strategy<Value = Value> {
    let keys: Vec<String> = schema
        .get("properties")
        .and_then(Value::as_object)
        .map(|p| p.keys().cloned().collect())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let n = keys.len();
    (
        prop::collection::vec((0..n.max(1), json_value()), 0..(n + 2)),
        prop::option::of("[a-z]{1,8}"),
        json_value(),
        0..10u8,
    )
        .prop_map(move |(fields, bogus, raw, mode)| {
            if mode == 0 {
                return raw;
            }
            let mut obj = Map::new();
            for (i, v) in fields {
                if let Some(k) = keys.get(i) {
                    obj.insert(k.clone(), v);
                }
            }
            if let (Some(b), true) = (bogus, mode == 1) {
                obj.insert(b, Value::from(1));
            }
            Value::Object(obj)
        })
}

fn case(methods: Vec<(String, Value)>) -> impl Strategy<Value = Case> {
    let raw = prop_oneof![
        "[^\\n\\r]{1,80}"
            .prop_filter("not blank", |s| !s.trim().is_empty())
            .prop_map(Case::Raw),
        json_value()
            .prop_filter("not a request", |v| !v.is_object())
            .prop_map(|v| Case::Raw(v.to_string())),
    ];
    let broken = (
        any::<u32>(),
        json_value(),
        prop_oneof![Just("1.0"), Just("2"), Just("")],
    )
        .prop_map(|(id, params, version)| {
            Case::Request(
                json!({ "jsonrpc": version, "id": id, "method": "device.list", "params": params }),
            )
        });
    let no_method =
        any::<u32>().prop_map(|id| Case::Request(json!({ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": id })));
    let unknown = (any::<u32>(), "[a-z.]{1,20}", json_value()).prop_map(|(id, m, p)| {
        Case::Request(json!({ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": id, "method": m, "params": p }))
    });
    let real = (any::<u32>(), prop::sample::select(methods)).prop_flat_map(|(id, (method, schema))| {
        params_for(schema).prop_map(move |params| {
            Case::Request(json!({ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": id, "method": method.clone(), "params": params }))
        })
    });
    prop_oneof![2 => raw, 1 => broken, 1 => no_method, 1 => unknown, 5 => real]
}

/// Reads until a response (not an event notification) arrives; panics
/// naming the case if none comes.
async fn answer(c: &mut common::Conn, case: &dyn std::fmt::Debug) -> Value {
    let read = async {
        loop {
            let v = c.read().await;
            if v.get("result").is_some() || v.get("error").is_some() {
                return v;
            }
        }
    };
    tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(8), read)
        .await
        .unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!("no answer for {case:?}"))
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn fuzz_ten_thousand_cases() {
    let h = Harness::start().await;
    let mut c = h.client().await;
    let list = c.ok("commands.list", json!({})).await;
    let mut methods: Vec<(String, Value)> = list
        .as_array()
        .unwrap()
        .iter()
        .map(|s| (s["id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string(), s["params"].clone()))
        .collect();
    // Connection-scoped methods too (not daemon.shutdown: it would end the test).
    methods.push((
        "events.subscribe".into(),
        json!({ "properties": { "topics": {} } }),
    ));
    methods.push((
        "logcat.follow".into(),
        json!({ "properties": { "device": {}, "filter": {} } }),
    ));
    methods.push((
        "hello".into(),
        json!({ "properties": { "version": {}, "client": {} } }),
    ));

    let strategy = case(methods);
    let mut runner = TestRunner::new_with_rng(
        Config::default(),
        TestRng::deterministic_rng(proptest::test_runner::RngAlgorithm::ChaCha),
    );
    let (mut answered, mut errors) = (0usize, 0usize);
    for i in 0..CASES {
        let tree = strategy.new_tree(&mut runner).unwrap();
        match tree.current() {
            Case::Raw(line) => {
                c.send_raw(&line).await;
                let v = answer(&mut c, &line).await;
                let code = v["error"]["code"]
                    .as_i64()
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("case {i}: {line:?} → {v}"));
                assert!(code == -32700 || code == -32600, "case {i}: {line:?} → {v}");
                errors += 1;
            }
            Case::Request(req) => {
                c.send_raw(&req.to_string()).await;
                let v = answer(&mut c, &req).await;
                assert_eq!(v["jsonrpc"], "2.0", "case {i}: {req} → {v}");
                assert_eq!(v["id"], req["id"], "case {i}: {req} → {v}");
                assert!(
                    v.get("result").is_some() != v.get("error").is_some(),
                    "case {i}: {v}"
                );
                if let Some(e) = v.get("error") {
                    assert!(
                        e["code"].is_i64() && e["message"].is_string(),
                        "case {i}: {v}"
                    );
                    errors += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        answered += 1;
    }
    assert_eq!(answered, CASES);
    assert!(
        errors > CASES / 2,
        "most fuzz cases should be rejected ({errors})"
    );
    // Still healthy.
    c.ok("daemon.status", json!({})).await;
    h.stop().await;
}

proptest! {
    #![proptest_config(Config { cases: 2_000, .. Config::default() })]

    /// The validator itself never panics, whatever the schema's params.
    #[test]
    fn validator_never_panics(params in json_value()) {
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let daemon = jidr_daemon::Daemon::builder(
            jidr_daemon::DaemonConfig { paths: jidr_core::JidrPaths::under(tmp.path()), studio_sdk: None, idle_timeout: None, sdk_repo: None, },
            std::sync::Arc::new(jidr_backend::fake::FakeBackend::new()),
        ).build().unwrap();
        for spec in daemon.registry().list() {
            let _ = jidr_daemon::validate::validate(&spec.params, &params);
        }
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-daemon/tests/jobs_events.rs`:

```rs
//! Jobs, events and logcat streaming over the socket (fake backend).
#![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]

mod common;

use std::time::Duration;

use common::Harness;
use serde_json::{Value, json};

/// Reads notifications until one with `topic` arrives.
async fn next_event(c: &mut common::Conn, topic: &str) -> Value {
    loop {
        let v = c.read().await;
        if v["method"] == "event" && v["params"]["topic"] == topic {
            return v["params"]["data"].clone();
        }
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn cancelling_a_boot_leaves_the_device_stopped() {
    let h = Harness::start().await;
    let mut c = h.client().await;
    c.ok("device.create", json!({ "name": "P", "image": "35" }))
        .await;
    let _gate = h.backend.gate_starts();
    let job = c.ok("device.start", json!({ "device": "P" })).await["job"].clone();
    let running = c.ok("jobs.list", json!({})).await;
    assert_eq!(running.as_array().unwrap().len(), 1);
    c.ok("jobs.cancel", json!({ "job": job })).await;
    let done = c
        .ok("jobs.wait", json!({ "job": job, "timeout_s": 10 }))
        .await;
    assert_eq!(done["state"], "cancelled", "{done}");
    let d = c.ok("device.details", json!({ "device": "P" })).await;
    assert_eq!(d["device"]["status"]["state"], "stopped");
    assert!(d["device"]["runtime"].is_null());
    assert!(h.backend.running().is_empty(), "nothing left running");
    assert_eq!(c.ok("jobs.list", json!({})).await, json!([]));
    assert_eq!(
        c.ok("jobs.list", json!({ "all": true }))
            .await
            .as_array()
            .unwrap()
            .len(),
        1
    );
    // The lock was released with the job.
    c.ok("device.edit", json!({ "device": "P", "ram_mb": 2048 }))
        .await;
    h.stop().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn subscriber_receives_boot_progress_and_job_events() {
    let h = Harness::start().await;
    let mut sub = h.client().await;
    let mut c = h.client().await;
    c.ok("device.create", json!({ "name": "Ev", "image": "35" }))
        .await;
    sub.ok(
        "events.subscribe",
        json!({ "topics": ["device.boot", "job.finished"] }),
    )
    .await;
    let job = c.ok("device.start", json!({ "device": "Ev" })).await["job"].clone();
    let mut stages = Vec::new();
    while stages.last() != Some(&json!("booted")) {
        stages.push(next_event(&mut sub, "device.boot").await["stage"].clone());
    }
    assert_eq!(
        stages,
        vec![
            json!("spawned"),
            json!("grpc_ready"),
            json!("adb_online"),
            json!("booted")
        ]
    );
    let finished = next_event(&mut sub, "job.finished").await;
    assert_eq!(finished["id"], job);
    assert_eq!(finished["state"], "succeeded");
    h.stop().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn topic_filters_and_resubscribe() {
    let h = Harness::start().await;
    let mut sub = h.client().await;
    let mut c = h.client().await;
    sub.ok("events.subscribe", json!({ "topics": ["device.created"] }))
        .await;
    c.ok("device.create", json!({ "name": "One", "image": "35" }))
        .await;
    assert_eq!(next_event(&mut sub, "device.created").await["name"], "One");
    // Replace the filter: now only deletions.
    sub.ok("events.subscribe", json!({ "topics": ["device.deleted"] }))
        .await;
    c.ok("device.create", json!({ "name": "Two", "image": "35" }))
        .await;
    c.ok("device.delete", json!({ "device": "One" })).await;
    let v = sub.read().await;
    assert_eq!(
        v["params"]["topic"], "device.deleted",
        "created events are filtered out: {v}"
    );
    h.stop().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn logcat_follow_streams_lines() {
    let h = Harness::start().await;
    let mut c = h.client().await;
    c.ok("device.create", json!({ "name": "L", "image": "35" }))
        .await;
    let e = c.err("logcat.follow", json!({ "device": "L" })).await;
    assert_eq!(e["data"]["code"], "not_found", "stopped device");
    c.run("device.start", json!({ "device": "L" })).await;
    c.ok("logcat.follow", json!({ "device": "L" })).await;
    let line = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), next_event(&mut c, "logcat"))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(line["line"], "I/fake: hello");
    h.stop().await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn failed_jobs_carry_the_error() {
    let h = Harness::start().await;
    let mut c = h.client().await;
    c.ok("device.create", json!({ "name": "F", "image": "35" }))
        .await;
    h.backend
        .fail_next_start(jidr_core::JidrError::boot_timeout("too slow"));
    let job = c.ok("device.start", json!({ "device": "F" })).await["job"].clone();
    let done = c.ok("jobs.wait", json!({ "job": job })).await;
    assert_eq!(done["state"], "failed");
    assert_eq!(done["error"]["code"], "boot_timeout");
    h.stop().await;
}
```
