`crates/jidr-root/src/adb_mode.rs`:

```rs
//! Shell root through adbd: `adb root` / `adb unroot`, then wait for adbd to
//! come back with the expected uid. Works on `default`, `google_apis` and
//! `aosp_atd` images; Play Store images refuse it ("production builds").

use std::time::Duration;

use jidr_core::provider::CallCtx;
use jidr_core::{Device, JidrError, JidrResult, RootHealth, RootMode};

use crate::verify::{self, Verification};

/// How long adbd may take to restart under its new uid.
const RESTART_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(60);
/// How long the shell may take to answer before the switch.
const READY_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(60);
const POLL: Duration = Duration::from_millis(500);

/// Switches a running device's adbd to `mode` and verifies it. On failure the
/// device's root health is set to `failed`.
pub(crate) async fn apply(
    ctx: &CallCtx,
    device: &Device,
    mode: RootMode,
) -> JidrResult<Verification> {
    match switch(ctx, device, mode).await {
        Ok(v) => Ok(v),
        Err(e) => {
            let _ = ctx
                .daemon
                .update_device(device.id, Box::new(|d| d.root.health = RootHealth::Failed))
                .await;
            Err(e)
        }
    }
}

async fn switch(ctx: &CallCtx, device: &Device, mode: RootMode) -> JidrResult<Verification> {
    if mode == RootMode::Magisk {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(
            "Full root (Magisk) isn't applied through adbd",
        ));
    }
    let adb = verify::device_adb(ctx, device).await?;
    crate::adb_ready::switch_adbd(
        &adb,
        Some(&ctx.cancel),
        mode == RootMode::Adb,
        READY_TIMEOUT,
    )
    .await?;
    // adbd restarts: the device drops off and comes back. Poll until the shell
    // answers with the uid the mode promises, or time out.
    let deadline = tokio::time::Instant::now() + RESTART_TIMEOUT;
    let mut last = None;
    loop {
        ctx.cancel.check()?;
        match verify::probe(&adb, mode).await {
            Ok(uid) if verify::uid_matches(mode, uid) => {
                return verify::record(ctx, device, mode, uid, None).await;
            }
            Ok(uid) => last = Some(uid),
            Err(_) => {}
        }
        if tokio::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
            return match last {
                Some(uid) => verify::record(ctx, device, mode, uid, None).await,
                None => Err(JidrError::root_failed(format!(
                    "{}: adbd didn't come back within {} s",
                    device.name,
                    RESTART_TIMEOUT.as_secs()
                ))),
            };
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(POLL).await;
    }
}

```

`crates/jidr-root/src/adb_ready.rs`:

```rs
//! Waiting for adb to answer after a cold boot or an adbd restart.
//!
//! When the emulator reboots, or adbd restarts for `adb root`/`unroot`, the
//! host adb server can keep a stale transport that stays `offline` for a
//! while, sometimes until `adb reconnect offline`. Linux KVM CI hit both:
//! "adb: device offline" on the Magisk app install right after the cold boot
//! (API 35), and "adbd did not settle to the expected uid" (API 30). So
//! every step that talks to the device after one waits here first.

use std::time::Duration;

use jidr_adb::Adb;
use jidr_core::{Cancel, JidrError, JidrResult};

/// What to do next while waiting.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Step {
    Done,
    Wait,
    /// Run `adb reconnect offline`: drop the stale transport.
    Reconnect,
    GiveUp,
}

/// The wait/reconnect decision on elapsed time, so it can be tested without
/// a device: reconnect once the device hasn't answered for `grace`, then at
/// most every `every`; give up at `timeout`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Wait {
    timeout: Duration,
    grace: Duration,
    every: Duration,
    failing_since: Option<Duration>,
    last_reconnect: Option<Duration>,
}

impl Wait {
    pub fn new(timeout: Duration) -> Self {
        Self::with(timeout, Duration::from_secs(5), Duration::from_secs(10))
    }

    fn with(timeout: Duration, grace: Duration, every: Duration) -> Self {
        Self {
            timeout,
            grace,
            every,
            failing_since: None,
            last_reconnect: None,
        }
    }

    /// `answered`: the probe gave the expected answer. `now`: time since the
    /// wait began.
    pub fn step(&mut self, answered: bool, now: Duration) -> Step {
        if answered {
            return Step::Done;
        }
        if now >= self.timeout {
            return Step::GiveUp;
        }
        let since = *self.failing_since.get_or_insert(now);
        let due = self.last_reconnect.is_none_or(|t| now >= t + self.every);
        if now >= since + self.grace && due {
            self.last_reconnect = Some(now);
            return Step::Reconnect;
        }
        Step::Wait
    }
}

const POLL: Duration = Duration::from_millis(500);

/// Runs `probe` in the device shell until `ok` accepts its output,
/// reconnecting a stale transport on the way. `what` names the wait in the
/// error ("after the cold boot").
pub async fn until(
    adb: &Adb,
    cancel: Option<&Cancel>,
    timeout: Duration,
    what: &str,
    probe: &str,
    ok: impl Fn(&str) -> bool,
) -> JidrResult<()> {
    until_with(adb, cancel, Wait::new(timeout), what, probe, ok).await
}

async fn until_with(
    adb: &Adb,
    cancel: Option<&Cancel>,
    mut wait: Wait,
    what: &str,
    probe: &str,
    ok: impl Fn(&str) -> bool,
) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let timeout = wait.timeout;
    let shell = adb.clone().with_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5));
    let host = Adb::new(adb.bin()).with_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10));
    let start = tokio::time::Instant::now();
    let mut last: String;
    loop {
        if let Some(c) = cancel {
            c.check()?;
        }
        let answered = match shell.shell_status(probe).await {
            Ok((_, out)) => {
                let good = ok(&out);
                last = out.trim().to_string();
                good
            }
            Err(e) => {
                last = e.message;
                false
            }
        };
        match wait.step(answered, start.elapsed()) {
            Step::Done => return Ok(()),
            Step::Wait => {}
            Step::Reconnect => {
                // A stale transport shows as `offline`, or as `device` with a
                // shell that hangs (CI, API 30: "state: device; last: adb
                // shell id -u timed out"). `reconnect offline` only drops the
                // first kind, so also kick this device's own transport.
                // While the device is still booting it isn't `device` yet,
                // and kicking it then only slows the reconnect.
                let _ = host.raw(&["reconnect", "offline"]).await;
                if adb.serial().is_some() && state(&shell).await == "device" {
                    let _ = adb
                        .clone()
                        .with_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10))
                        .raw(&["reconnect"])
                        .await;
                }
            }
            Step::GiveUp => {
                let state = state(&shell).await;
                return Err(JidrError::root_failed(format!(
                    "{what}: adb didn't answer within {} s (state: {state}; last: {last})",
                    timeout.as_secs()
                ))
                .with_data(serde_json::json!({ "adb_state": state, "last": last })));
            }
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(POLL).await;
    }
}

/// `adb get-state` for the device: `device`, `offline`, or the error text.
async fn state(adb: &Adb) -> String {
    adb.raw(&["get-state"])
        .await
        .map(|o| format!("{}{}", o.stdout, o.stderr).trim().to_string())
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

/// `adb root` (`root`) or `adb unroot`, once the shell answers.
///
/// Regression (CI, API 35): right after a boot the transport was stale and
/// `adb root` failed with "unable to connect for root: closed". So wait for
/// the shell first, and when the transport still drops during the call, wait
/// again and retry once. A refused switch ("production builds") isn't retried.
/// The caller then waits for the new uid.
pub async fn switch_adbd(
    adb: &Adb,
    cancel: Option<&Cancel>,
    root: bool,
    ready: Duration,
) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let wait = || {
        until(
            adb,
            cancel,
            ready,
            "before switching adbd",
            "echo ok",
            |o| o.trim() == "ok",
        )
    };
    let run = || async {
        if root {
            adb.root().await
        } else {
            adb.unroot().await
        }
    };
    wait().await?;
    match run().await {
        Err(e) if transport_dropped(&e) => {
            wait().await?;
            run().await
        }
        r => r,
    }
}

/// adb lost the device mid-call (as opposed to refusing the switch).
fn transport_dropped(e: &JidrError) -> bool {
    let m = e.message.to_lowercase();
    ["unable to connect", "closed", "offline", "no devices"]
        .iter()
        .any(|s| m.contains(s))
}

    fn waits_then_reconnects_at_most_every_ten_seconds() {
        let mut w = Wait::new(s(90.0));
        assert_eq!(w.step(true, s(0.0)), Step::Done);

        let mut w = Wait::new(s(90.0));
        assert_eq!(w.step(false, s(0.0)), Step::Wait);
        assert_eq!(w.step(false, s(4.9)), Step::Wait);
        assert_eq!(w.step(false, s(5.0)), Step::Reconnect);
        assert_eq!(w.step(false, s(9.0)), Step::Wait);
        assert_eq!(w.step(false, s(15.0)), Step::Reconnect);
        assert_eq!(w.step(true, s(16.0)), Step::Done);
    }
```

`crates/jidr-root/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! CommandProvider for root modes: adb root, Magisk, verify and revert.
//!
//! Commands (plan, "Root engine"):
//! - `root.status`: the stored root state of a device;
//! - `root.verify`: checks the live uid (and Magisk version) against the mode;
//! - `root.set`: switches the mode, live when the device is running;
//! - `root.module.install`: installs a Magisk module zip on a Magisk device;
//! - `device.props.get` / `device.props.set`: a Full-root device's build
//!   props (Phase 9f, [`props`]).
//!
//! adb-mode devices get `adb root` after every boot through
//! [`CommandProvider::on_booted`]; Magisk devices get a re-patch check.

mod adb_mode;
mod adb_ready;
mod magisk;
pub mod props;
mod verify;

use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Arc;

use async_trait::async_trait;
use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, CommandProvider, CommandSpec, DeviceParams, parse_params};
use jidr_core::{Device, DeviceStatus, JidrError, JidrResult, RootHealth, RootMode};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::{Value, json};

pub use verify::Verification;

/// Shown in `root.status` and `root.set` results so the UI and CLI agree.
pub const PLAY_INTEGRITY_NOTICE: &str = "Play Integrity cannot pass on any emulator; Zygisk/DenyList only hides root from local checks.";

/// The root provider, for `jidr daemon` to register (gap G8).
pub fn provider() -> Arc<dyn CommandProvider> {
    Arc::new(RootProvider)
}

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct RootProvider;

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SetParams {
    /// Device name or id.
    pub device: String,
    /// `none`, `adb` (images that allow it) or `magisk`.
    pub mode: RootMode,
    /// SHA-256 of a Magisk APK already in the download cache (the CLI imports
    /// it with `--magisk <path>` before calling this); overrides the pinned
    /// release (D30, offline).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub magisk_sha256: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ModuleInstallParams {
    /// Device name or id (must be in `magisk` mode).
    pub device: String,
    /// A local Magisk module zip.
    pub path: PathBuf,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct AutoGrantParams {
    /// Device name or id (must be in `magisk` mode).
    pub device: String,
    /// Grant every app root without a prompt (D22, off by default).
    pub enabled: bool,
}

#[async_trait]
impl CommandProvider for RootProvider {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "root"
    }

    fn commands(&self) -> Vec<CommandSpec> {
        vec![
            CommandSpec::new::<DeviceParams>("root.status", "Show a device's root mode and health"),
            CommandSpec::new::<DeviceParams>(
                "root.verify",
                "Check a running device's root against its mode",
            )
            .locks_device(),
            CommandSpec::new::<SetParams>(
                "root.set",
                "Set a device's root mode (applied live if it is running; the next start is a cold boot)",
            )
            .locks_device()
            .long_running(),
            CommandSpec::new::<ModuleInstallParams>(
                "root.module.install",
                "Install a Magisk module zip and reboot (Full-root devices only)",
            )
            .locks_device()
            .long_running()
            .destructive(),
            CommandSpec::new::<AutoGrantParams>(
                "root.auto_grant",
                "Grant every app root without a prompt on a Full-root device (D22, off by default)",
            )
            .locks_device(),
            CommandSpec::new::<DeviceParams>(
                "device.props.get",
                "A device's build props (model, brand, fingerprint…) and whether a restart is pending",
            ),
            CommandSpec::new::<props::SetParams>(
                "device.props.set",
                "Set a Full-root device's build props; the next start (a cold boot) applies them",
            )
            .locks_device(),
        ]
    }

    async fn call(&self, ctx: &CallCtx, method: &str, params: Value) -> JidrResult<Value> {
        match method {
            "root.status" => {
                let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
                let device = ctx.daemon.device(&p.device).await?;
                Ok(status(&device))
            }
            "root.verify" => {
                let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
                let device = ctx.daemon.device(&p.device).await?;
                ensure_running(&device)?;
                to_value(verify::verify(ctx, &device).await?)
            }
            "root.set" => set(ctx, parse_params(params)?).await,
            "root.module.install" => {
                let p: ModuleInstallParams = parse_params(params)?;
                let device = ctx.daemon.device(&p.device).await?;
                ensure_running(&device)?;
                magisk::install_module(ctx, &device, &p.path).await
            }
            "root.auto_grant" => auto_grant(ctx, parse_params(params)?).await,
            "device.props.get" => {
                props::get(ctx, &parse_params::<DeviceParams>(params)?.device).await
            }
            "device.props.set" => props::set(ctx, parse_params(params)?).await,
            other => Err(JidrError::not_found(format!("unknown method {other}"))),
        }
    }

    async fn on_booted(&self, ctx: &CallCtx, device: &Device) -> JidrResult<()> {
        match device.root.mode {
            RootMode::Adb => adb_mode::apply(ctx, device, RootMode::Adb)
                .await
                .map(|_| ()),
            RootMode::Magisk => magisk::on_booted(ctx, device).await,
            RootMode::None => Ok(()),
        }
    }
}

fn to_value<T: serde::Serialize>(v: T) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    serde_json::to_value(v).map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(format!("serializing result: {e}")))
}

fn status(device: &Device) -> Value {
    json!({
        "device": device.id,
        "name": device.name,
        "root": device.root,
        "adb_root_allowed": device.image.allows_adb_root(),
        "play_integrity": PLAY_INTEGRITY_NOTICE,
    })
}

fn is_running(device: &Device) -> bool {
    matches!(device.status, DeviceStatus::Running)
}

fn ensure_running(device: &Device) -> JidrResult<()> {
    if is_running(device) {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
            "{} is not running; start it first",
            device.name
        )))
    }
}

async fn set(ctx: &CallCtx, p: SetParams) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    let device = ctx.daemon.device(&p.device).await?;
    if p.mode == RootMode::Adb && !device.image.allows_adb_root() {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
            "{} images don't allow adb root; use mode none, or magisk for full root",
            device.image.tag
        )));
    }
    if p.mode == RootMode::Magisk {
        return magisk::to_magisk(ctx, &device, p.magisk_sha256.as_deref()).await;
    }

    let changed = device.root.mode != p.mode;
    // Leaving Magisk: clear the patch and cold-boot before applying the target
    // mode, so `none` and `adb` behave exactly as they do today.
    let device = if device.root.mode == RootMode::Magisk {
        magisk::clear_patch(ctx, &device, p.mode).await?
    } else if changed {
        let mode = p.mode;
        ctx.daemon
            .update_device(
                device.id,
                Box::new(move |d: &mut Device| {
                    d.root.mode = mode;
                    d.root.health = RootHealth::Unverified;
                    d.root.verified_at = None;
                    // D29: a root change never resumes a snapshot taken under the old mode.
                    d.launch.force_cold_boot = true;
                }),
            )
            .await?
    } else {
        device
    };

    if !is_running(&device) {
        return Ok(json!({
            "device": device.id,
            "mode": device.root.mode,
            "changed": changed,
            "applied": "next_boot",
            "play_integrity": PLAY_INTEGRITY_NOTICE,
        }));
    }
    ctx.cancel.check()?;
    ctx.report(None, &format!("Applying {} root", mode_label(p.mode)));
    let verification = adb_mode::apply(ctx, &device, p.mode).await?;
    Ok(json!({
        "device": device.id,
        "mode": p.mode,
        "changed": changed,
        "applied": "live",
        "verification": verification,
        "play_integrity": PLAY_INTEGRITY_NOTICE,
    }))
}

fn mode_label(mode: RootMode) -> &'static str {
    match mode {
        RootMode::None => "no",
        RootMode::Adb => "shell (adb)",
        RootMode::Magisk => "full (Magisk)",
    }
}

/// `root.auto_grant`: toggle the D22 "auto-grant all" flag. Only Full root.
/// Stored on the device; applied live when running, on the next boot otherwise.
async fn auto_grant(ctx: &CallCtx, p: AutoGrantParams) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    let device = ctx.daemon.device(&p.device).await?;
    if device.root.mode != RootMode::Magisk {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
            "{} isn't Full-root (Magisk); auto-grant applies to Magisk devices only",
            device.name
        )));
    }
    let enabled = p.enabled;
    let device = ctx
        .daemon
        .update_device(
            device.id,
            Box::new(move |d: &mut Device| {
                d.root.auto_grant_all = enabled;
            }),
        )
        .await?;
    if !is_running(&device) {
        return Ok(json!({
            "device": device.id,
            "auto_grant_all": enabled,
            "applied": "next_boot",
        }));
    }
    let adb = verify::device_adb(ctx, &device).await?;
    magisk::auto_grant::apply(&adb, enabled).await?;
    Ok(json!({
        "device": device.id,
        "auto_grant_all": enabled,
        "applied": "live",
    }))
}
```

`crates/jidr-root/src/magisk/auto_grant.rs`:

```rs
//! The D22 "auto-grant all" toggle: Magisk's superuser *automatic response*.
//!
//! Magisk's su grant decision (native `uid_granted_root`) only knows per-uid
//! `policies` rows; the *global* "grant every app without a prompt" behaviour
//! lives in the Magisk app, which auto-answers superuser requests when its
//! `su_auto_response` preference is `2` (allow) and shows the normal prompt at
//! `0`. That preference is a SharedPreferences value, not a `magisk --sqlite`
//! setting, so Jidr edits just that one key over `adb root` and reads it back.
//!
//! Learned read-only from Magisk v30.7 (`Config.kt`, `SuRequestHandler.kt`,
//! `PreferenceConfig.kt`); no GPL code was copied (docs/clean-room.md).

use jidr_adb::Adb;
use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};

use super::grant;

/// The Magisk app's SharedPreferences file (device-protected storage).
const PREF_FILE: &str =
    "/data/user_de/0/com.topjohnwu.magisk/shared_prefs/com.topjohnwu.magisk_preferences.xml";
const PREF_DIR: &str = "/data/user_de/0/com.topjohnwu.magisk/shared_prefs";

/// The Magisk application id.
const MAGISK_PACKAGE: &str = "com.topjohnwu.magisk";

/// The preference key (`Config.Key.SU_AUTO_RESPONSE`).
const PREF_KEY: &str = "su_auto_response";

/// `Config.Value`: prompt (default) and auto-allow.
const SU_PROMPT: &str = "0";
const SU_AUTO_ALLOW: &str = "2";

/// Applies the D22 "auto-grant all" flag: sets Magisk's automatic response to
/// `allow` (enabled) or back to `prompt` (disabled), but only when the stored
/// preference actually differs — the value is read first, so a boot with the
/// flag off and no key present never touches the file. Runs as root and drops
/// back to the normal shell afterwards.
pub(crate) async fn apply(adb: &Adb, enabled: bool) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let desired = if enabled { SU_AUTO_ALLOW } else { SU_PROMPT };
    grant::ensure_adbd_root(adb).await?;
    let result = sync(adb, desired).await;
    let _ = grant::drop_adbd_root(adb).await;
    result
}

/// Reads the current value, writes only when it differs, then restarts the app
/// so its cached SharedPreferences reflect the change.
async fn sync(adb: &Adb, desired: &str) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let current = read_auto_response(adb).await?;
    // An absent key means Magisk's default: prompt (`0`).
    if current.as_deref().unwrap_or(SU_PROMPT) == desired {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let content = read_raw(adb).await?;
    let edited = edit_content(content.as_deref(), desired);
    write_raw(adb, &edited).await?;
    // SharedPreferences are cached in the app process; force-stop so the next
    // launch re-reads the file instead of writing the stale value back.
    force_stop(adb).await?;
    // Confirm the value stuck.
    let after = read_auto_response(adb).await?;
    if after.as_deref() != Some(desired) {
        return Err(JidrError::root_failed(format!(
            "Magisk's automatic response was not stored (prefs: {})",
            after.as_deref().unwrap_or("(absent)")
        )));
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Reads the raw preferences file, or `None` when it does not exist yet.
async fn read_raw(adb: &Adb) -> JidrResult<Option<String>> {
    let (status, out) = adb.shell_status(&format!("cat {PREF_FILE}")).await?;
    if status != 0 { Ok(None) } else { Ok(Some(out)) }
}

/// Reads the `su_auto_response` value, or `None` when the file or key is absent.
async fn read_auto_response(adb: &Adb) -> JidrResult<Option<String>> {
    Ok(read_raw(adb).await?.as_deref().and_then(extract_value))
}

/// Rewrites the preferences keeping every other key: removes any existing
/// `su_auto_response` entry and appends the new one before `</map>`.
fn edit_content(current: Option<&str>, value: &str) -> String {
    let entry = format!("    <string name=\"{PREF_KEY}\">{value}</string>");
    let mut lines: Vec<&str> = match current {
        None => vec![
            "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"utf-8\" standalone=\"yes\" ?>",
            "<map>",
        ],
        Some(content) => content
            .lines()
            .filter(|l| !l.contains(&format!("name=\"{PREF_KEY}\"")))
            .collect(),
    };
    // Drop a trailing `</map>` (the XML root close) so the entry sits inside it.
    while lines.last().is_some_and(|l| l.trim() == "</map>") {
        lines.pop();
    }
    // An empty SharedPreferences file is written self-closing (`<map />`, or
    // `<map/>`); turn that into an opening `<map>` so the appended entry and
    // `</map>` keep the document well-formed (otherwise Android discards the
    // file and the Magisk app loses every setting).
    if lines
        .last()
        .is_some_and(|l| matches!(l.trim(), "<map />" | "<map/>" | "<map></map>"))
    {
        let i = lines.len() - 1;
        lines[i] = "<map>";
    }
    lines.push(&entry);
    lines.push("</map>");
    let mut out = lines.join("\n");
    out.push('\n');
    out
}

/// Writes the file (as root), fixes the app's ownership and SELinux label.
async fn write_raw(adb: &Adb, content: &str) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let script = format!(
        "D={PREF_DIR}; P={PREF_FILE}; mkdir -p $D; printf '%s' {} > $P; \
         u=$(stat -c %u /data/data/{MAGISK_PACKAGE} 2>/dev/null); \
         if [ -n \"$u\" ]; then g=$(stat -c %g /data/data/{MAGISK_PACKAGE} 2>/dev/null); chown \"$u:$g\" $P; fi; \
         chmod 660 $P; restorecon $P 2>/dev/null",
        shell_single_quote(content)
    );
    adb.shell(&script)
        .await
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::root_failed(format!("writing Magisk's automatic response: {e}")))?;
    Ok(())
}

/// Force-stops the Magisk app so its cached SharedPreferences are re-read.
async fn force_stop(adb: &Adb) -> JidrResult<()> {
    adb.shell(&format!("am force-stop {MAGISK_PACKAGE}"))
        .await
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::root_failed(format!("stopping the Magisk app: {e}")))?;
    Ok(())
}

/// Single-quotes `s` for the device shell, escaping any embedded single quotes.
fn shell_single_quote(s: &str) -> String {
    format!("'{}'", s.replace('\'', "'\\''"))
}

fn extract_value(xml: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let marker = format!("name=\"{PREF_KEY}\">");
    let rest = xml.split_once(&marker)?.1;
    let digits: String = rest.chars().take_while(char::is_ascii_digit).collect();
    (!digits.is_empty()).then_some(digits)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn values_match_magisk_30_7() {
        assert_eq!(SU_PROMPT, "0");
        assert_eq!(SU_AUTO_ALLOW, "2");
        assert_eq!(PREF_KEY, "su_auto_response");
    }

    #[test]
    fn edit_preserves_other_preferences_and_replaces_the_key() {
        let before = "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"utf-8\" standalone=\"yes\" ?>\n\
                      <map>\n    <string name=\"denylist\">false</string>\n    \
                      <string name=\"su_auto_response\">0</string>\n    \
                      <string name=\"zygisk\">true</string>\n</map>\n";
        let after = edit_content(Some(before), "2");
        assert!(after.contains("<string name=\"denylist\">false</string>"));
        assert!(after.contains("<string name=\"zygisk\">true</string>"));
        assert!(after.contains("<string name=\"su_auto_response\">2</string>"));
        assert!(!after.contains("<string name=\"su_auto_response\">0</string>"));
        assert_eq!(after.lines().filter(|l| l.trim() == "</map>").count(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn edit_adds_the_key_to_a_fresh_file() {
        let after = edit_content(None, "2");
        assert_eq!(
            after,
            "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"utf-8\" standalone=\"yes\" ?>\n\
             <map>\n    <string name=\"su_auto_response\">2</string>\n</map>\n"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn edit_handles_an_empty_self_closing_map() {
        // Android writes an empty SharedPreferences file self-closing; the
        // result must stay well-formed (one <map> root) or Android discards it.
        for empty in ["<map />", "<map/>"] {
            let before = format!(
                "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"utf-8\" standalone=\"yes\" ?>\n{empty}\n"
            );
            let after = edit_content(Some(&before), "2");
            assert_eq!(
                after,
                "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"utf-8\" standalone=\"yes\" ?>\n\
                 <map>\n    <string name=\"su_auto_response\">2</string>\n</map>\n",
                "input: {empty}"
            );
            assert!(!after.contains("<map />") && !after.contains("<map/>"));
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn extracts_the_value_from_shared_preferences_xml() {
        let xml = "<map><string name=\"denylist\">false</string>\
                   <string name=\"su_auto_response\">2</string></map>";
        assert_eq!(extract_value(xml).as_deref(), Some("2"));
        assert_eq!(
            extract_value("<map><string name=\"other\">1</string></map>"),
            None
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn shell_quoting_escapes_single_quotes() {
        assert_eq!(shell_single_quote("a'b"), "'a'\\''b'");
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-root/src/magisk/env.rs`:

```rs
//! Magisk's runtime environment under `/data/adb/magisk`.
//!
//! A patched ramdisk carries Magisk's init and daemon and nothing else. The
//! rest (the `magisk` binary, `magiskpolicy`, `busybox`, the manager scripts)
//! lives in the app and is unpacked into `/data/adb/magisk` before `su` works.
//! We reproduce that unpack on the host and push it up, so the setup stays
//! headless on `google_apis` images (which allow `adb root`).

use std::io::{Cursor, Read};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use jidr_adb::Adb;
use jidr_core::{ErrorCode, JidrError, JidrResult, ResultExt};

/// Where Magisk's runtime files live on the device.
pub const MAGISK_ENV_DIR: &str = "/data/adb/magisk";
/// A staging path the files are pushed to before being installed, so a failed
/// transfer cannot leave `/data/adb/magisk` half written.
pub const MAGISK_ENV_STAGING: &str = "/data/local/tmp/jidr-magisk-env";

/// One file of Magisk's runtime environment, named as it must appear on the
/// device.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct EnvFile {
    pub name: String,
    pub data: Vec<u8>,
}

/// Assets copied verbatim (named without the `assets/` prefix), as the manager
/// app does.
const ENV_ASSETS: &[&str] = &[
    "assets/util_functions.sh",
    "assets/boot_patch.sh",
    "assets/addon.d.sh",
    "assets/stub.apk",
];

/// ChromeOS flashing tools, in a subdirectory.
const ENV_CHROMEOS: &[&str] = &["futility", "kernel_data_key.vbprivk", "kernel.keyblock"];

fn read_entry(archive: &mut zip::ZipArchive<Cursor<Vec<u8>>>, name: &str) -> JidrResult<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut f = archive
        .by_name(name)
        .map_err(|_| JidrError::sdk(format!("{name} is missing from the Magisk APK")))?;
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    f.read_to_end(&mut out).ctx(
        ErrorCode::Sdk,
        format!("reading {name} from the Magisk APK"),
    )?;
    Ok(out)
}

/// Extracts the files the manager app unpacks into `/data/adb/magisk`.
///
/// The rule for native libraries is the app's own: `lib/<abi>/libmagisk.so`
/// becomes `magisk` (drop the `lib` prefix and the `.so` suffix). Four assets
/// and the ChromeOS tools are copied as they are.
pub fn environment_files(apk: &Path, abi: &str) -> JidrResult<Vec<EnvFile>> {
    let lib = super::patch::normalize_abi(abi)?;
    let data = std::fs::read(apk).ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, format!("reading {}", apk.display()))?;
    let mut archive = zip::ZipArchive::new(Cursor::new(data)).ctx(
        ErrorCode::Sdk,
        format!("{} is not a zip/APK", apk.display()),
    )?;

    let mut files = Vec::new();
    let prefix = format!("lib/{lib}/");
    for i in 0..archive.len() {
        let mut entry = archive
            .by_index(i)
            .ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, "listing the Magisk APK")?;
        let entry_name = entry
            .name()
            .map_err(|e| JidrError::sdk(format!("reading a zip entry name: {e}")))?
            .into_owned();
        if entry.is_dir() || !entry_name.starts_with(&prefix) || !entry_name.ends_with(".so") {
            continue;
        }
        let trimmed = entry_name
            .strip_prefix(&prefix)
            .and_then(|n| n.strip_suffix(".so"))
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .to_string();
        // The app keeps only names that start with `lib` and are longer than
        // it; `libbootctl.so` → `bootctl`.
        if trimmed.len() <= 3 || !trimmed.starts_with("lib") {
            continue;
        }
        let name = trimmed[3..].to_string();
        let mut data = Vec::new();
        entry.read_to_end(&mut data).ctx(
            ErrorCode::Sdk,
            format!("reading {entry_name} from the Magisk APK"),
        )?;
        files.push(EnvFile { name, data });
    }

    if files.is_empty() {
        return Err(JidrError::sdk(format!(
            "the Magisk APK carries no {lib} binaries, so the environment cannot be built"
        )));
    }
    for asset in ENV_ASSETS {
        let data = read_entry(&mut archive, asset)?;
        files.push(EnvFile {
            name: asset.strip_prefix("assets/").unwrap_or(asset).to_string(),
            data,
        });
    }
    for tool in ENV_CHROMEOS {
        let path = format!("assets/chromeos/{tool}");
        let data = read_entry(&mut archive, &path)?;
        files.push(EnvFile {
            name: format!("chromeos/{tool}"),
            data,
        });
    }
    files.sort_by(|a, b| a.name.cmp(&b.name));
    Ok(files)
}

/// Removes a staging directory when dropped.
struct Cleanup(PathBuf);

impl Drop for Cleanup {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&self.0);
    }
}

/// Pushes `files` to the device and installs them under `/data/adb/magisk`.
///
/// The caller must have already run `adb root` (writing `/data/adb` needs it);
/// on images that refuse `adb root` this returns an error and the guided-tap
/// path takes over.
pub async fn push_environment(adb: &Adb, files: &[EnvFile]) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let staging = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("jidr-magisk-env-{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4()));
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&staging)
        .ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, format!("creating {}", staging.display()))?;
    let _cleanup = Cleanup(staging.clone());

    for f in files {
        let path = staging.join(&f.name);
        if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)
                .ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, format!("creating {}", parent.display()))?;
        }
        std::fs::write(&path, &f.data)
            .ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, format!("writing {}", path.display()))?;
        #[cfg(unix)]
        {
            use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
            std::fs::set_permissions(&path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755))
                .ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, format!("chmod {}", path.display()))?;
        }
    }

    adb.push(&staging.join("."), MAGISK_ENV_STAGING).await?;

    let script = [
        "set -e",
        &format!("rm -rf {MAGISK_ENV_DIR}"),
        &format!("mkdir -p {MAGISK_ENV_DIR}"),
        "chmod 700 /data/adb",
        &format!("cp -af {MAGISK_ENV_STAGING}/. {MAGISK_ENV_DIR}/"),
        &format!("chmod -R 755 {MAGISK_ENV_DIR}"),
        &format!("chown -R 0:0 {MAGISK_ENV_DIR}"),
        "mkdir -p /data/adb/modules /data/adb/post-fs-data.d /data/adb/service.d",
        &format!("rm -rf {MAGISK_ENV_STAGING}"),
        // The caller cold-boots next; without this the files may only exist in
        // the page cache and vanish right when magiskd needs them.
        "sync",
    ]
    .join(" && ");

    let out = adb
        .shell(&script)
        .await
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::root_failed(format!("installing Magisk's environment: {e}")))?;
    if out.trim().is_empty() {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        // `shell` only errors on non-zero exit; any stray output is noise.
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {

    /// A synthetic Magisk-like APK (zip) with the lib files and assets the
    /// environment extractor needs.
    fn fake_apk(dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {

        let mut zip = zip::ZipWriter::new(file);
        let opts = zip::write::SimpleFileOptions::default();
        for name in [
            "lib/arm64-v8a/libmagisk.so",
            "lib/arm64-v8a/libmagiskinit.so",
            "lib/arm64-v8a/libmagiskpolicy.so",
            "lib/arm64-v8a/libbootctl.so",
            "assets/util_functions.sh",
            "assets/boot_patch.sh",
            "assets/addon.d.sh",
            "assets/stub.apk",
            "assets/chromeos/futility",
            "assets/chromeos/kernel_data_key.vbprivk",
            "assets/chromeos/kernel.keyblock",
        ] {
            zip.start_file(name, opts).unwrap();
            use std::io::Write;
            zip.write_all(b"x").unwrap();
        }
        zip.finish().unwrap();
        path
    }

        let apk = fake_apk(dir.path());
        assert!(environment_files(&apk, "x86_64").is_err());
    }
```

`crates/jidr-root/src/magisk/grant.rs`:

```rs
//! Grant the adb shell automatic `su` (D22).
//!
//! On images that allow `adb root` (`google_apis`, `default`, `aosp_atd`) the
//! grant is zero-touch: root adbd, write the shell uid's policy row through
//! `magisk --sqlite`, then drop back to the normal shell. On Play Store images
//! `adb root` is refused, so the guided tap from ADR-0002 is used instead: run
//! `su -c id`, which raises Magisk's normal prompt, and wait for the person to
//! tap Grant.

use std::time::Duration;

use jidr_adb::Adb;
use jidr_core::provider::CallCtx;
use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};

use crate::verify::parse_uid;

/// Android user id of the adb shell, whose `su` request we pre-approve.
pub const AID_SHELL: u32 = 2000;

/// Magisk's `SuPolicy` values; `Allow` pre-approves without a prompt.
const SU_POLICY_ALLOW: i32 = 2;

/// How long the guided tap waits for the person to tap Grant.
const GUIDED_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(60);
/// Per-attempt `su -c id` timeout; a shorter window lets the total stay 60 s
/// while re-raising the prompt.
const GUIDED_ATTEMPT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(20);

const POLL: Duration = Duration::from_millis(500);

/// The places Magisk puts its binary, most likely first.
const MAGISK_BINARIES: &[&str] = &[
    "/debug_ramdisk/magisk",
    "/sbin/magisk",
    "/data/adb/magisk/magisk",
];

/// Finds the `magisk` binary on the device.
async fn magisk_binary(adb: &Adb) -> JidrResult<String> {
    for path in MAGISK_BINARIES {
        let (_, out) = adb
            .shell_status(&format!("[ -x {path} ] && echo yes"))
            .await?;
        if out.contains("yes") {
            return Ok((*path).to_string());
        }
    }
    Err(JidrError::root_failed(
        "the magisk binary was not found on the device; Magisk has not initialised",
    ))
}

/// Waits until the shell answers `id` with the uid `mode` promises. adbd
/// restarts for `adb root`/`unroot`, and its transport can stay offline
/// until reconnected (CI: "adbd did not settle to the expected uid").
async fn wait_adbd(adb: &Adb, want_root: bool) -> JidrResult<()> {
    crate::adb_ready::until(
        adb,
        None,
        Duration::from_secs(60),
        "adbd did not settle to the expected uid",
        "id -u",
        |out| (out.trim() == "0") == want_root,
    )
    .await
}

/// Runs `adb root` unless the shell is already root.
pub async fn ensure_adbd_root(adb: &Adb) -> JidrResult<()> {
    match adb.shell_status("id -u").await {
        Ok((_, out)) if out.trim() == "0" => return Ok(()),
        _ => {}
    }
    crate::adb_ready::switch_adbd(adb, None, true, Duration::from_secs(60)).await?;
    wait_adbd(adb, true).await
}

/// Runs `adb unroot` so later checks exercise Magisk's `su`, not adbd's root.
pub async fn drop_adbd_root(adb: &Adb) -> JidrResult<()> {
    crate::adb_ready::switch_adbd(adb, None, false, Duration::from_secs(60)).await?;
    wait_adbd(adb, false).await
}

/// Writes and verifies a su policy row for `uid` through `magisk --sqlite`.
async fn set_su_policy(adb: &Adb, bin: &str, uid: u32, policy: i32) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let sql = format!(
        "REPLACE INTO policies (uid, policy, until, logging, notification) VALUES ({uid}, {policy}, 0, 1, 1)"
    );
    adb.shell(&format!("{bin} --sqlite \"{sql}\""))
        .await
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::root_failed(format!("writing the su policy for uid {uid}: {e}")))?;

    let out = adb
        .shell(&format!(
            "{bin} --sqlite \"SELECT policy FROM policies WHERE uid={uid}\""
        ))
        .await
        .map_err(|e| {
            JidrError::root_failed(format!("verifying the su policy for uid {uid}: {e}"))
        })?;
    if !out.contains(&format!("policy={policy}")) {
        return Err(JidrError::root_failed(format!(
            "the su policy for uid {uid} was not stored (device reports {})",
            out.trim()
        )));
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Zero-touch grant: root adbd, pre-approve the shell, drop back to shell.
pub async fn grant_shell_zero_touch(adb: &Adb) -> JidrResult<()> {
    ensure_adbd_root(adb).await?;
    let bin = magisk_binary(adb).await?;
    set_su_policy(adb, &bin, AID_SHELL, SU_POLICY_ALLOW).await?;
    drop_adbd_root(adb).await?;
    Ok(())
}

/// The guided tap from ADR-0002: run `su -c id` (which raises Magisk's prompt)
/// and wait up to 60 s for the person to tap Grant. Timed out or denied, it
/// fails with `data.state = "awaiting_user_grant"` and the caller offers
/// "Try again" and "Revert".
pub async fn grant_shell_guided(ctx: &CallCtx, adb: &Adb) -> JidrResult<()> {
    ctx.report(
        None,
        "Magisk will ask to grant root to Shell. Tap Grant in the device window.",
    );
    poll_for_grant(&ctx.cancel, adb, GUIDED_TIMEOUT).await
}

/// Polls `su -c id` until it reports uid 0 or `timeout` elapses.
async fn poll_for_grant(
    cancel: &jidr_core::Cancel,
    adb: &Adb,
    timeout: Duration,
) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let deadline = tokio::time::Instant::now() + timeout;
    loop {
        cancel.check()?;
        let attempt = adb.clone().with_timeout(GUIDED_ATTEMPT);
        match attempt.shell_status("su -c id").await {
            Ok((_, out)) if parse_uid(&out) == Some(0) => return Ok(()),
            _ => {}
        }
        if tokio::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
            return Err(JidrError::root_failed(
                "root grant to Shell was denied or timed out; tap Grant and try again, or revert",
            )
            .with_data(serde_json::json!({ "state": "awaiting_user_grant" })));
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(POLL).await;
    }
}

/// Grants the shell su, choosing the zero-touch path when `adb root` works and
/// the guided tap otherwise.
pub async fn grant_shell(ctx: &CallCtx, adb: &Adb, adb_root_allowed: bool) -> JidrResult<()> {
    if adb_root_allowed {
        grant_shell_zero_touch(adb).await
    } else {
        grant_shell_guided(ctx, adb).await
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::path::Path;

    fn write_exec(path: &Path, body: &str) {
        std::fs::write(path, body).unwrap();
        #[cfg(unix)]
        {
            use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
            std::fs::set_permissions(path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).unwrap();
        }
    }

    /// A fake adb whose `su -c id` never grants root (the prompt stays pending).
    fn adb_that_never_grants(dir: &Path) -> Adb {
        let adb = dir.join("adb");
        write_exec(
            &adb,
            "#!/bin/sh\nwhile [ \"$1\" = -s ]; do shift 2; done\ncase \"$1\" in\n  shell)\n    case \"$2\" in\n      \"su -c id\") echo denied >&2; exit 1;;\n      \"id -u\") echo 2000;;\n      *) echo ok;;\n    esac;;\n  *) echo ok;;\nesac\n",
        );
        Adb::new(adb)
    }

    #[test]
    fn policy_constants_match_magisk() {
        assert_eq!(SU_POLICY_ALLOW, 2);
        assert_eq!(AID_SHELL, 2000);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn guided_grant_times_out_as_awaiting_user_grant() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let adb = adb_that_never_grants(dir.path());
        let cancel = jidr_core::Cancel::new();
        let err = poll_for_grant(&cancel, &adb, Duration::from_millis(200))
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(err.code, jidr_core::ErrorCode::RootFailed);
        assert_eq!(err.data.as_ref().unwrap()["state"], "awaiting_user_grant");
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn guided_grant_succeeds_once_su_answers_root() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let adb = dir.path().join("adb");
        write_exec(
            &adb,
            "#!/bin/sh\nwhile [ \"$1\" = -s ]; do shift 2; done\ncase \"$1\" in\n  shell) echo \"uid=0(root) gid=0(root)\";;\n  *) echo ok;;\nesac\n",
        );
        let cancel = jidr_core::Cancel::new();
        poll_for_grant(&cancel, &Adb::new(adb), Duration::from_secs(5))
            .await
            .unwrap();
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-root/src/magisk/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! Magisk mode: the per-device patched ramdisk and the `root.set magisk`
//! state machine.
//!
//! Flow (plan, "Root engine"): fetch the pinned APK → hash the pristine
//! `ramdisk.img` → patch a per-device copy with `jidr-cpio` → cold boot with
//! `-ramdisk` → install the app → set up `/data/adb/magisk` → one reboot →
//! grant the shell su → verify. Revert clears the ramdisk, deletes the patched
//! file and cold-boots. Re-patching happens whenever the pristine hash or the
//! pinned version differs from what was recorded; patches never stack.

pub mod auto_grant;
pub mod env;
pub mod grant;
pub mod patch;
pub mod pins;

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use jidr_adb::InstallOptions;
use jidr_core::provider::CallCtx;
use jidr_core::{Device, ErrorCode, JidrError, JidrResult, ResultExt, RootHealth, RootMode};
use jidr_sdk::DownloadCache;
use serde_json::{Value, json};

use crate::verify;
use pins::MagiskPin;

/// Where the pristine `ramdisk.img` of a device's image lives.
pub fn pristine_ramdisk_path(device: &Device) -> PathBuf {
    device
        .sdk_root
        .join(device.image.sysdir())
        .join("ramdisk.img")
}

/// The per-device patched ramdisk, under `<avd>/jidr/` (never the SDK image).
pub fn patched_ramdisk_path(ctx: &CallCtx, device: &Device, version: &str) -> PathBuf {
    ctx.daemon
        .paths()
        .avd_home()
        .join(format!("{}.avd", device.avd))
        .join("jidr")
        .join(format!("ramdisk.magisk-{version}.img"))
}

/// Resolves the Magisk APK: either the pinned release (downloaded through the
/// 5b cache, verified by SHA-256) or a local `--magisk <path>` imported into
/// the cache. Returns the APK path, its SHA-256 and the Magisk version it
/// carries.
async fn resolve_apk(
    ctx: &CallCtx,
    pin: &MagiskPin,
    magisk_sha256: Option<&str>,
) -> JidrResult<(PathBuf, String, String)> {
    let cache = DownloadCache::new(ctx.daemon.paths().downloads());
    match magisk_sha256 {
        Some(sha) => {
            let apk = cache.get_verified(sha)?.ok_or_else(|| {
                JidrError::usage(format!(
                    "no Magisk APK with sha256 {sha} in the download cache; \
                     import one with `jidr root set --magisk <apk>` first"
                ))
            })?;
            let version = patch::version_from_apk(&apk)?;
            Ok((apk, sha.to_string(), version))
        }
        None => {
            // A verified cached copy means no download, so the GPL licence and
            // source link are shown only before the first fetch.
            if cache.get_verified(&pin.sha256)?.is_none() {
                ctx.report(None, &pins::notice(pin));
            }
            let fetcher = jidr_sdk::Fetcher::new()?;
            let report = ctx.clone();
            let version = pin.version.clone();
            let apk = cache
                .fetch(
                    &fetcher,
                    &pin.url,
                    &pin.sha256,
                    &move |done, total| {
                        let frac = if total > 0 {
                            done as f32 / total as f32
                        } else {
                            0.0
                        };
                        report.report(Some(frac), &format!("Downloading Magisk {version}"));
                    },
                    &ctx.cancel,
                )
                .await?;
            Ok((apk, pin.sha256.clone(), pin.version.clone()))
        }
    }
}

/// Hashes the pristine ramdisk and rebuilds the patched copy when the pristine
/// hash, the Magisk version or the device's build props (Phase 9f) differ
/// from what is recorded (patches never stack). Returns the patched file path.
async fn ensure_patched(
    ctx: &CallCtx,
    device: &Device,
    version: &str,
    apk: &Path,
    apk_sha256: &str,
) -> JidrResult<PathBuf> {
    let pristine_path = pristine_ramdisk_path(device);
    let pristine_sha = jidr_sdk::cache::sha256_file(&pristine_path)?;
    let patched = patched_ramdisk_path(ctx, device, version);
    let props = crate::props::load(ctx, device);

    if patched.is_file()
        && patch::read_provenance(&patched).is_some_and(|p| {
            p.pristine_sha256 == pristine_sha && p.magisk_version == version && p.props == props
        })
    {
        return Ok(patched);
    }

    ctx.report(None, &format!("Patching the ramdisk for Magisk {version}"));
    let pristine = std::fs::read(&pristine_path).ctx(
        ErrorCode::Sdk,
        format!("reading {}", pristine_path.display()),
    )?;
    let payload = patch::load_payload(apk, &device.image.abi)?;
    let bytes = patch::patch_ramdisk(&pristine, &payload, &props)?;
    patch::write_atomic(&patched, &bytes)?;
    patch::write_provenance(
        &patched,
        &patch::Provenance {
            magisk_version: version.to_string(),
            pristine_sha256: pristine_sha,
            apk_sha256: Some(apk_sha256.to_string()),
            props,
        },
    )?;
    Ok(patched)
}

/// Rebuilds a Full-root device's patched ramdisk after its build props
/// changed (Phase 9f), with the same Magisk APK it was patched from (or the
/// cached pinned release of the same version), and makes the next start a
/// cold boot. Never downloads.
pub(crate) async fn repatch(ctx: &CallCtx, device: &Device) -> JidrResult<Device> {
    let version = device
        .root
        .magisk_version
        .clone()
        .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::usage(format!("{} has no Magisk patch yet", device.name)))?;
    let cache = DownloadCache::new(ctx.daemon.paths().downloads());
    let recorded = device
        .root
        .patched_ramdisk_path
        .as_deref()
        .and_then(patch::read_provenance)
        .and_then(|p| p.apk_sha256);
    let pin = pins::default_pin().ok().filter(|p| p.version == version);
    let mut found = None;
    for sha in recorded.into_iter().chain(pin.map(|p| p.sha256)) {
        if let Some(apk) = cache.get_verified(&sha)? {
            found = Some((apk, sha));
            break;
        }
    }
    let (apk, sha) = found.ok_or_else(|| {
        JidrError::usage(format!(
            "the Magisk {version} APK isn't in the download cache; run `root.set magisk` again"
        ))
    })?;
    ctx.report(None, "Patching the ramdisk with the build props");
    let patched = ensure_patched(ctx, device, &version, &apk, &sha).await?;
    ctx.daemon
        .update_device(
            device.id,
            Box::new(move |d| {
                d.root.patched_ramdisk_path = Some(patched.clone());
                d.launch.ramdisk = Some(patched);
                d.launch.force_cold_boot = true;
            }),
        )
        .await
}

/// Stops the device if it is running, then cold-boots it. The stored
/// `launch.ramdisk` points at the patched copy, so this boots Magisk.
async fn cold_boot(ctx: &CallCtx, device: &Device) -> JidrResult<Device> {
    if device.status.is_active() {
        ctx.report(None, "Stopping before the cold boot");
        ctx.daemon.stop_device(device.id).await?;
    }
    ctx.report(None, "Cold booting");
    let device = ctx
        .daemon
        .start_device(device.id, true, &ctx.cancel)
        .await?;
    // Booted is not yet reachable: the adb transport can stay offline for a
    // while after a cold boot (CI: "adb: device offline" on the app install).
    let adb = verify::device_adb(ctx, &device).await?;
    crate::adb_ready::until(
        &adb,
        Some(&ctx.cancel),
        std::time::Duration::from_secs(90),
        "after the cold boot",
        "echo ok",
        |out| out.trim() == "ok",
    )
    .await?;
    Ok(device)
}

/// Switches a device to Magisk mode: fetch, patch, set state, cold boot, then
/// finish the setup (app install, environment, one reboot, shell grant,
/// verify). On any failure the health is set to `failed` and the device is
/// left in a state revert can recover from.
pub(crate) async fn to_magisk(
    ctx: &CallCtx,
    device: &Device,
    magisk_sha256: Option<&str>,
) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    let changed = device.root.mode != RootMode::Magisk;
    match to_magisk_inner(ctx, device, changed, magisk_sha256).await {
        Ok(v) => Ok(v),
        Err(e) => {
            let _ = ctx
                .daemon
                .update_device(device.id, Box::new(|d| d.root.health = RootHealth::Failed))
                .await;
            Err(e)
        }
    }
}

async fn to_magisk_inner(
    ctx: &CallCtx,
    device: &Device,
    changed: bool,
    magisk_sha256: Option<&str>,
) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    let pin = pins::default_pin()?;
    let adb_root_allowed = device.image.allows_adb_root();

    ctx.report(None, "Resolving the Magisk release");
    let (apk, apk_sha, version) = resolve_apk(ctx, &pin, magisk_sha256).await?;

    let patched = ensure_patched(ctx, device, &version, &apk, &apk_sha).await?;
    let device = ctx
        .daemon
        .update_device(
            device.id,
            Box::new(move |d| {
                d.root.mode = RootMode::Magisk;
                d.root.magisk_version = Some(version);
                d.root.patched_ramdisk_path = Some(patched.clone());
                d.root.health = RootHealth::Unverified;
                d.root.verified_at = None;
                d.launch.ramdisk = Some(patched);
                d.launch.force_cold_boot = true;
            }),
        )
        .await?;

    let device = cold_boot(ctx, &device).await?;

    // Install the manager app (the release APK is also a valid APK).
    ctx.report(None, "Installing the Magisk app");
    verify::device_adb(ctx, &device)
        .await?
        .with_timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(600))
        .install(
            &apk,
            InstallOptions {
                replace: true,
                ..Default::default()
            },
        )
        .await?;

    // Environment setup: unpack the app's files into /data/adb/magisk. On
    // images that allow adb root this is headless; Play Store defers to the
    // app (the guided tap below covers it).
    if adb_root_allowed {
        ctx.report(None, "Setting up Magisk's environment");
        let files = env::environment_files(&apk, &device.image.abi)?;
        let adb = verify::device_adb(ctx, &device).await?;
        grant::ensure_adbd_root(&adb).await?;
        let pushed = env::push_environment(&adb, &files).await;
        let _ = grant::drop_adbd_root(&adb).await;
        pushed?;
    } else {
        ctx.report(
            None,
            "Play Store: open the Magisk app to finish its setup, then grant root to Shell",
        );
    }

    // One reboot so magiskd re-reads the environment and enables su.
    ctx.report(None, "Rebooting");
    let device = cold_boot(ctx, &device).await?;

    // Shell su grant: zero-touch on adb-root images, guided tap on Play Store.
    ctx.report(None, "Granting the adb shell su access");
    let adb = verify::device_adb(ctx, &device).await?;
    grant::grant_shell(ctx, &adb, adb_root_allowed).await?;

    ctx.report(None, "Verifying root");
    let verification = verify::verify(ctx, &device).await?;
    Ok(json!({
        "device": device.id,
        "mode": "magisk",
        "changed": changed,
        "applied": "live",
        "magisk_version": verification.magisk_version,
        "verification": verification,
        "beta": !adb_root_allowed,
        "play_integrity": crate::PLAY_INTEGRITY_NOTICE,
    }))
}

/// Clears a Magisk patch: delete the patched file, clear `launch.ramdisk` and
/// the Magisk fields, set `target` as the new mode and cold-boot if running.
pub(crate) async fn clear_patch(
    ctx: &CallCtx,
    device: &Device,
    target: RootMode,
) -> JidrResult<Device> {
    if let Some(patched) = &device.root.patched_ramdisk_path {
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(patched);
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(patch::provenance_path(patched));
    }
    // Build props only apply on Full root (Phase 9f); like auto-grant, they
    // don't survive leaving it.
    crate::props::clear(ctx, device);
    let device = ctx
        .daemon
        .update_device(
            device.id,
            Box::new(move |d| {
                d.root.mode = target;
                d.root.magisk_version = None;
                d.root.patched_ramdisk_path = None;
                // D22: leaving Full root also drops "auto-grant all".
                d.root.auto_grant_all = false;
                d.root.health = RootHealth::Unverified;
                d.root.verified_at = None;
                d.launch.ramdisk = None;
                d.launch.force_cold_boot = true;
            }),
        )
        .await?;
    if device.status.is_active() {
        cold_boot(ctx, &device).await
    } else {
        Ok(device)
    }
}

/// The boot hook: for a Magisk device, rebuild the patched ramdisk for the
/// next boot when the pristine image or the pinned version changed. Best
/// effort — it never fails the boot, because the current boot already worked.
pub(crate) async fn on_booted(ctx: &CallCtx, device: &Device) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let Ok(pin) = pins::default_pin() else {
        return Ok(());
    };
    // Re-patch only when the pinned APK is already cached; never fetch here
    // (a boot must not block on, or be slowed by, the network).
    let cache = DownloadCache::new(ctx.daemon.paths().downloads());
    let Ok(Some(apk)) = cache.get_verified(&pin.sha256) else {
        return Ok(());
    };
    let version = pin.version.clone();
    let Ok(patched) = ensure_patched(ctx, device, &version, &apk, &pin.sha256).await else {
        return Ok(());
    };
    // Force the next start to be a cold boot only when the patch actually
    // changed under us (a new image hash or a Magisk upgrade).
    if device.root.magisk_version.as_deref() != Some(version.as_str())
        || device.root.patched_ramdisk_path.as_deref() != Some(patched.as_path())
    {
        let _ = ctx
            .daemon
            .update_device(
                device.id,
                Box::new(move |d| {
                    d.root.magisk_version = Some(version);
                    d.root.patched_ramdisk_path = Some(patched.clone());
                    d.launch.ramdisk = Some(patched);
                    d.launch.force_cold_boot = true;
                }),
            )
            .await;
    }

    // Apply the stored "auto-grant all" flag (D22). Best-effort: on the very
    // first boot of a fresh setup the Magisk app is not installed yet, and a
    // boot must never fail over a preference write.
    if let Ok(adb) = verify::device_adb(ctx, device).await {
        let _ = auto_grant::apply(&adb, device.root.auto_grant_all).await;
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// `root.module.install`: push a module zip, install it through Magisk, reboot
/// and verify. Only available on Magisk devices.
pub(crate) async fn install_module(
    ctx: &CallCtx,
    device: &Device,
    path: &Path,
) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    if device.root.mode != RootMode::Magisk {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(
            "root.module.install needs a Full-root (Magisk) device",
        ));
    }
    if !path.is_file() {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
            "no such module zip: {}",
            path.display()
        )));
    }
    let adb = verify::device_adb(ctx, device).await?;
    let remote = "/data/local/tmp/jidr-module.zip";
    ctx.report(None, "Pushing the module");
    adb.push(path, remote).await?;

    ctx.report(None, "Installing the module");
    let adb_root_allowed = device.image.allows_adb_root();
    if adb_root_allowed {
        grant::ensure_adbd_root(&adb).await?;
    }
    let result = adb
        .shell(&format!("su -c 'magisk --install-module {remote}'"))
        .await;
    if adb_root_allowed {
        let _ = grant::drop_adbd_root(&adb).await;
    }
    result.map_err(|e| JidrError::root_failed(format!("installing the module: {e}")))?;

    ctx.report(None, "Rebooting");
    let device = cold_boot(ctx, device).await?;
    let verification = verify::verify(ctx, &device).await?;
    Ok(json!({
        "device": device.id,
        "installed": true,
        "verification": verification,
    }))
}

```

`crates/jidr-root/src/magisk/patch.rs`:

```rs
//! Host-side Magisk ramdisk patch.
//!
//! The patch mirrors the ramdisk edits Magisk's own `boot_patch.sh` applies
//! (read clean-room, never copied): `init` is replaced by `magiskinit`, the
//! compressed payload lands under `overlay.d/sbin`, and `.backup/.magisk`
//! records the config. The payload binaries are extracted from the pinned APK
//! (a release zip is also a valid APK), which is the same file `adb install`
//! uses for the manager app.
//!
//! We always patch the *pristine* `ramdisk.img` read fresh from the SDK (the
//! shared image is never written, D3), so patches never stack. The result is
//! written to a temp file and renamed into place, so a crash never leaves a
//! half-written image.

use std::io::{Cursor, Read};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use jidr_core::{ErrorCode, JidrError, JidrResult, ResultExt};
use jidr_cpio::compress::XzCheck;
use jidr_cpio::{Compression, Entry, Ramdisk};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

/// xz settings matching `magiskboot compress=xz` (preset 6, CRC32).
fn payload_xz() -> Compression {
    Compression::Xz {
        preset: 6,
        check: XzCheck::Crc32,
    }
}

/// What was extracted from the Magisk APK for one ABI.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Payload {
    pub abi: String,
    /// Replaces `/init` inside the ramdisk.
    pub magisk_init: Vec<u8>,
    /// The magisk binary, stored compressed in `overlay.d/sbin`.
    pub magisk: Vec<u8>,
    /// The `LD_PRELOAD` shim for `/init`.
    pub init_ld: Vec<u8>,
    /// The stub APK embedded in the ramdisk.
    pub stub: Vec<u8>,
}

/// Maps a system-image ABI onto the `lib/` directory name inside the APK.
pub fn normalize_abi(abi: &str) -> JidrResult<&'static str> {
    match abi {
        "arm64-v8a" => Ok("arm64-v8a"),
        "x86_64" => Ok("x86_64"),
        "x86" => Ok("x86"),
        "armeabi-v7a" => Ok("armeabi-v7a"),
        other => Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
            "no Magisk support for ABI {other:?} (expected arm64-v8a or x86_64)"
        ))),
    }
}

fn read_entry(archive: &mut zip::ZipArchive<Cursor<Vec<u8>>>, name: &str) -> JidrResult<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut f = archive
        .by_name(name)
        .map_err(|_| JidrError::sdk(format!("{name} is missing from the Magisk APK")))?;
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    f.read_to_end(&mut out).ctx(
        ErrorCode::Sdk,
        format!("reading {name} from the Magisk APK"),
    )?;
    Ok(out)
}

/// The Magisk version declared by the APK's `assets/util_functions.sh`
/// (`MAGISK_VER='30.7'`), used to name the patched ramdisk when a local APK is
/// supplied with `--magisk <path>`.
pub fn version_from_apk(apk: &Path) -> JidrResult<String> {
    let data = std::fs::read(apk).ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, format!("reading {}", apk.display()))?;
    let mut archive = zip::ZipArchive::new(Cursor::new(data)).ctx(
        ErrorCode::Sdk,
        format!("{} is not a zip/APK", apk.display()),
    )?;
    let script = read_entry(&mut archive, "assets/util_functions.sh")?;
    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&script);
    for line in text.lines() {
        if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("MAGISK_VER=") {
            let v = rest.trim().trim_matches(['\'', '"']);
            if !v.is_empty() {
                return Ok(v.to_string());
            }
        }
    }
    Err(JidrError::sdk(
        "the Magisk APK does not declare MAGISK_VER in util_functions.sh",
    ))
}

/// Extracts the binaries a ramdisk patch needs from a Magisk release APK.
///
/// The SHA-256 of the APK was already checked against the pin by the caller,
/// so the contents are trusted; this only verifies the package shape.
pub fn load_payload(apk: &Path, abi: &str) -> JidrResult<Payload> {
    let lib = normalize_abi(abi)?;
    let data = std::fs::read(apk).ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, format!("reading {}", apk.display()))?;
    let mut archive = zip::ZipArchive::new(Cursor::new(data)).ctx(
        ErrorCode::Sdk,
        format!("{} is not a zip/APK", apk.display()),
    )?;

    let magisk_init = read_entry(&mut archive, &format!("lib/{lib}/libmagiskinit.so"))?;
    let magisk = read_entry(&mut archive, &format!("lib/{lib}/libmagisk.so"))?;
    let init_ld = read_entry(&mut archive, &format!("lib/{lib}/libinit-ld.so"))?;
    let stub = read_entry(&mut archive, "assets/stub.apk")?;

    Ok(Payload {
        abi: lib.to_string(),
        magisk_init,
        magisk,
        init_ld,
        stub,
    })
}

/// The `.backup/.magisk` config, as `boot_patch.sh` writes it for an emulator:
/// dm-verity and forced encryption are kept because the AVD relies on them.
fn config() -> Vec<u8> {
    b"KEEPVERITY=true\nKEEPFORCEENCRYPT=true\nRECOVERYMODE=false\nVENDORBOOT=false\n".to_vec()
}

/// Builds a patched ramdisk from pristine bytes and a payload. Non-empty
/// `props` also add the build-prop hook (Phase 9f): `overlay.d/jidr-props.rc`
/// and its script under `overlay.d/sbin`.
///
/// Only the first (generic) segment is edited: that is where the emulator's
/// `init` lives, and Magisk's own patcher operates on one cpio archive. The
/// vendor fragments are left byte-identical.
pub fn patch_ramdisk(
    pristine: &[u8],
    payload: &Payload,
    props: &crate::props::BuildProps,
) -> JidrResult<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut ramdisk = Ramdisk::parse(pristine)
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::root_failed(format!("parsing ramdisk.img: {e}")))?;
    let archive = &mut ramdisk
        .segments
        .first_mut()
        .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::root_failed("ramdisk.img has no cpio segments"))?
        .archive;

    // We always patch pristine; a pre-patched input means a caller handed us a
    // modified image (which would stack patches). Refuse rather than guess.
    if archive.contains(".backup/.magisk") || archive.contains("overlay.d") {
        return Err(JidrError::root_failed(
            "ramdisk already carries a Magisk patch; patch the pristine image only",
        ));
    }

    let compress = |data: &[u8]| -> JidrResult<Vec<u8>> {
        payload_xz()
            .compress(data)
            .map_err(|e| JidrError::root_failed(format!("compressing Magisk payload: {e}")))
    };

    let magisk_xz = compress(&payload.magisk)?;
    let stub_xz = compress(&payload.stub)?;
    let init_ld_xz = compress(&payload.init_ld)?;

    // Snapshot the stock archive before editing it, so the diff can be
    // recorded under `.backup/` — magiskinit re-execs the original `init` from
    // there, so without it the device never reaches adb.
    let original = archive.clone();

    // `insert` replaces `init` in place (keeping its inode) and appends the
    // rest before the trailer — the same edits `magiskboot cpio` performs.
    archive.insert(Entry::file("init", 0o750, payload.magisk_init.clone()));
    archive.insert(Entry::dir("overlay.d", 0o750));
    archive.insert(Entry::dir("overlay.d/sbin", 0o750));
    archive.insert(Entry::file("overlay.d/sbin/magisk.xz", 0o644, magisk_xz));
    archive.insert(Entry::file("overlay.d/sbin/stub.xz", 0o644, stub_xz));
    archive.insert(Entry::file("overlay.d/sbin/init-ld.xz", 0o644, init_ld_xz));
    if !props.is_empty() {
        use crate::props::{RC, SCRIPT, rc};
        archive.insert(Entry::file(
            format!("overlay.d/{RC}"),
            0o644,
            rc().into_bytes(),
        ));
        archive.insert(Entry::file(
            format!("overlay.d/sbin/{SCRIPT}"),
            0o755,
            props.script().into_bytes(),
        ));
    }
    backup(archive, &original)?;
    archive.insert(Entry::dir(".backup", 0));
    archive.insert(Entry::file(".backup/.magisk", 0, config()));

    ramdisk
        .to_bytes()
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::root_failed(format!("serializing the patched ramdisk: {e}")))
}

/// Ports `magiskboot cpio backup ORIG`: records the difference between the
/// patched archive and the stock archive under `.backup/`, so magiskinit can
/// restore the original entries at boot — above all the original `init`, which
/// it re-execs as the real first-stage init. Entries the patch introduced are
/// listed in `.backup/.rmlist` so a Magisk restore can remove them again.
fn backup(patched: &mut jidr_cpio::Archive, original: &jidr_cpio::Archive) -> JidrResult<()> {
    patched.insert(Entry::dir(".backup", 0));

    // Stock entries whose content changed (or which were removed) are stored
    // under `.backup/<name>`, xz-compressed when they are regular files.
    for entry in original.iter() {
        if entry.name.starts_with(".backup") {
            continue;
        }
        let unchanged = patched
            .get(&entry.name)
            .is_some_and(|p| p.data == entry.data);
        if unchanged {
            continue;
        }
        let name = format!(".backup/{}", entry.name);
        if entry.is_file() {
            let compressed = payload_xz().compress(&entry.data).map_err(|e| {
                JidrError::root_failed(format!("compressing {} for backup: {e}", entry.name))
            })?;
            patched.insert(Entry::file(
                format!("{name}.xz"),
                entry.permissions(),
                compressed,
            ));
        } else {
            let mut copy = entry.clone();
            copy.name = name;
            patched.insert(copy);
        }
    }

    // Entries the patch introduced are listed so a restore can delete them.
    let mut rmlist = Vec::new();
    for entry in patched.iter() {
        if entry.name.starts_with(".backup") {
            continue;
        }
        if original.get(&entry.name).is_none() {
            rmlist.extend_from_slice(entry.name.as_bytes());
            rmlist.push(0);
        }
    }
    if !rmlist.is_empty() {
        patched.insert(Entry::file(".backup/.rmlist", 0, rmlist));
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Writes `bytes` to `path` atomically: a temp file in the same directory is
/// renamed into place, so a crash never leaves a half-written image.
pub fn write_atomic(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let dir = path
        .parent()
        .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::unexpected(format!("{} has no parent", path.display())))?;
    std::fs::create_dir_all(dir).ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, format!("creating {}", dir.display()))?;
    let tmp = dir.join(format!(".{}.tmp", uuid::Uuid::new_v4()));
    std::fs::write(&tmp, bytes).ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, format!("writing {}", tmp.display()))?;
    std::fs::rename(&tmp, path).ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, format!("writing {}", path.display()))
}

/// The provenance a patched ramdisk records, so a later start can tell whether
/// the pristine image or the pinned release changed (and re-patch).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Provenance {
    pub magisk_version: String,
    pub pristine_sha256: String,
    /// The APK the payload came from, so a props change re-patches with the
    /// same release (absent in patches made before Phase 9f).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub apk_sha256: Option<String>,
    /// The build props baked in (Phase 9f); stock when absent.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "crate::props::BuildProps::is_empty")]
    pub props: crate::props::BuildProps,
}

/// The sidecar metadata file next to a patched ramdisk.
pub fn provenance_path(patched: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    let mut name = patched
        .file_name()
        .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "ramdisk.magisk.img".to_string());
    name.push_str(".json");
    patched.with_file_name(name)
}

pub fn read_provenance(patched: &Path) -> Option<Provenance> {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(provenance_path(patched)).ok()?;
    serde_json::from_str(&text).ok()
}

pub fn write_provenance(patched: &Path, provenance: &Provenance) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let text = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(provenance)
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(format!("encoding provenance: {e}")))?;
    write_atomic(&provenance_path(patched), &text)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// Builds a minimal pristine ramdisk (a single uncompressed cpio segment).
    fn pristine_ramdisk() -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut a = jidr_cpio::Archive::new();
        a.insert(Entry::file("init", 0o750, b"#!stock init".to_vec()));
        a.insert(Entry::dir("dev", 0o755));
        let ramdisk = Ramdisk {
            segments: vec![jidr_cpio::Segment {
                compression: Compression::None,
                archive: a,
            }],
            trailing: Vec::new(),
        };
        ramdisk.to_bytes().unwrap()
    }

    fn payload() -> Payload {
        Payload {
            abi: "arm64-v8a".into(),
            magisk_init: b"MAGISKINIT".to_vec(),
            magisk: b"MAGISK".to_vec(),
            init_ld: b"INITLD".to_vec(),
            stub: b"STUBAPK".to_vec(),
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn patch_replaces_init_and_adds_magisk_entries() {
        let patched = patch_ramdisk(&pristine_ramdisk(), &payload(), &Default::default()).unwrap();
        let ramdisk = Ramdisk::parse(&patched).unwrap();
        let (idx, init) = ramdisk.get("init").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(idx, 0);
        assert_eq!(init.data, b"MAGISKINIT");
        assert_eq!(init.permissions(), 0o750);

        let (_, overlay) = ramdisk.get("overlay.d").unwrap();
        assert!(overlay.is_dir());
        assert_eq!(overlay.permissions(), 0o750);

        let (_, magisk) = ramdisk.get("overlay.d/sbin/magisk.xz").unwrap();
        assert!(magisk.is_file());
        // The payload is xz-compressed inside the ramdisk.
        assert!(
            magisk
                .data
                .starts_with(&[0xfd, b'7', b'z', b'X', b'Z', 0x00])
        );

        let (_, cfg) = ramdisk.get(".backup/.magisk").unwrap();
        assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&cfg.data).contains("KEEPVERITY=true"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn patch_backs_up_the_original_init_for_magiskinit() {
        // Regression: without `.backup/init.xz`, magiskinit's restore step
        // falls back to symlinking `/init` -> `/system/bin/init`, which skips
        // the emulator's real first-stage init and the device never reaches
        // adb (Phase 9d e2e hang).
        let pristine = pristine_ramdisk();
        let patched = patch_ramdisk(&pristine, &payload(), &Default::default()).unwrap();
        let ramdisk = Ramdisk::parse(&patched).unwrap();

        let (_, backup) = ramdisk.get(".backup/init.xz").unwrap();
        assert!(backup.is_file());
        assert!(
            backup
                .data
                .starts_with(&[0xfd, b'7', b'z', b'X', b'Z', 0x00]),
            "the backup init is xz-compressed"
        );
        let decoded = jidr_cpio::compress::decompress(&backup.data).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(decoded.data, b"#!stock init", "the original init is kept");

        // Entries the patch added are listed for restore.
        let (_, rmlist) = ramdisk.get(".backup/.rmlist").unwrap();
        let mut names: Vec<&str> = rmlist
            .data
            .split(|&b| b == 0)
            .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
            .map(|s| std::str::from_utf8(s).unwrap())
            .collect();
        names.sort_unstable();
        assert!(names.contains(&"overlay.d"), "{names:?}");
        assert!(names.contains(&"overlay.d/sbin/magisk.xz"), "{names:?}");

        // The stock entries that were not touched stay out of the backup.
        assert!(ramdisk.get(".backup/dev.xz").is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn patch_is_idempotent_and_deterministic() {
        let a = patch_ramdisk(&pristine_ramdisk(), &payload(), &Default::default()).unwrap();
        let b = patch_ramdisk(&pristine_ramdisk(), &payload(), &Default::default()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(a, b);
    }

    #[test]
    fn patch_refuses_an_already_patched_ramdisk() {
        let once = patch_ramdisk(&pristine_ramdisk(), &payload(), &Default::default()).unwrap();
        let err = patch_ramdisk(&once, &payload(), &Default::default()).unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(err.code, ErrorCode::RootFailed);
        assert!(err.message.contains("pristine"), "{err}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn atomic_write_and_provenance_round_trip() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let path = dir.path().join("ramdisk.magisk-30.7.img");
        write_atomic(&path, b"hello").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(std::fs::read(&path).unwrap(), b"hello");

        let prov = Provenance {
            magisk_version: "30.7".into(),
            pristine_sha256: "a".repeat(64),
            apk_sha256: Some("b".repeat(64)),
            props: crate::props::BuildProps {
                model: Some("Pixel 8".into()),
                ..Default::default()
            },
        };
        write_provenance(&path, &prov).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(read_provenance(&path).as_ref(), Some(&prov));
        assert!(provenance_path(&path).ends_with("ramdisk.magisk-30.7.img.json"));
        assert!(read_provenance(&dir.path().join("missing.img")).is_none());
    }

    /// Phase 9f: props add the rc hook and its script, both listed in
    /// `.rmlist` so a Magisk restore removes them; stock adds neither.
    #[test]
    fn props_add_the_boot_hook() {
        let props = crate::props::BuildProps {
            model: Some("Pixel 8".into()),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let patched = patch_ramdisk(&pristine_ramdisk(), &payload(), &props).unwrap();
        let ramdisk = Ramdisk::parse(&patched).unwrap();
        let a = &ramdisk.segments[0].archive;
        let rc = a.get("overlay.d/jidr-props.rc").unwrap();
        assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&rc.data).contains("on post-fs-data"));
        let script = a.get("overlay.d/sbin/jidr-props.sh").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(script.permissions(), 0o755);
        assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&script.data).contains("ro.product.model 'Pixel 8'"));
        let rmlist = String::from_utf8_lossy(&a.get(".backup/.rmlist").unwrap().data).into_owned();
        assert!(rmlist.contains("overlay.d/jidr-props.rc"), "{rmlist:?}");
        assert!(
            rmlist.contains("overlay.d/sbin/jidr-props.sh"),
            "{rmlist:?}"
        );

        let stock = patch_ramdisk(&pristine_ramdisk(), &payload(), &Default::default()).unwrap();
        let stock = Ramdisk::parse(&stock).unwrap();
        assert!(
            !stock.segments[0]
                .archive
                .contains("overlay.d/jidr-props.rc")
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn abi_mapping() {
        assert_eq!(normalize_abi("arm64-v8a").unwrap(), "arm64-v8a");
        assert_eq!(normalize_abi("x86_64").unwrap(), "x86_64");
        assert!(normalize_abi("mips").is_err());
    }
}
```
