`crates/jidr-root/src/magisk/pins.rs`:

```rs
//! The pinned Magisk releases the root engine may use (D30).
//!
//! The pin file is compiled into the binary, so `root.set magisk` works
//! offline once the APK is in the download cache. Magisk is GPL-3.0-only, so
//! Jidr never bundles it: the release is downloaded at runtime from the
//! official GitHub release and its SHA-256 is checked before use.

use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};
use serde::Deserialize;

const PINS: &str = include_str!("../../../../assets/magisk-pins.toml");

/// One entry of `assets/magisk-pins.toml`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Deserialize)]
pub struct MagiskPin {
    /// Human-readable version, e.g. `30.7` (matches the release tag without `v`).
    pub version: String,
    /// The official GitHub release URL of the APK.
    pub url: String,
    /// Lowercase SHA-256 hex of the APK.
    pub sha256: String,
    /// The licence the release is under.
    pub license: String,
    /// Where the source lives.
    pub source: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct PinsFile {
    #[serde(default)]
    magisk: Vec<MagiskPin>,
}

/// All pinned releases, in preference order (first is the default).
pub fn pins() -> JidrResult<Vec<MagiskPin>> {
    let file: PinsFile = toml::from_str(PINS)
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(format!("parsing magisk-pins.toml: {e}")))?;
    if file.magisk.is_empty() {
        return Err(JidrError::unexpected("magisk-pins.toml has no entries"));
    }
    Ok(file.magisk)
}

/// The release used when no `--magisk` override is supplied.
pub fn default_pin() -> JidrResult<MagiskPin> {
    pins()?
        .into_iter()
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::unexpected("magisk-pins.toml has no entries"))
}

/// The licence + source notice shown once before the first download.
pub fn notice(pin: &MagiskPin) -> String {
    format!(
        "Magisk {} is {}; source: {}. Jidr downloads it at runtime and never bundles it.",
        pin.version, pin.license, pin.source
    )
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn the_default_pin_is_a_valid_release() {
        let pin = default_pin().unwrap();
        assert!(!pin.version.is_empty());
        assert!(
            pin.url
                .starts_with("https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk/releases/download/")
        );
        assert_eq!(pin.sha256.len(), 64);
        assert!(pin.sha256.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_hexdigit()));
        assert!(!pin.license.is_empty());
        assert!(pin.source.contains("topjohnwu/Magisk"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn notice_names_the_licence_and_source() {
        let n = notice(&default_pin().unwrap());
        assert!(n.contains("GPL"));
        assert!(n.contains("github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk"));
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-root/src/props.rs`:

```rs
//! Build-prop spoofing (Phase 9f, R5): the identity properties a Full-root
//! device reports (`Build.MODEL`, `BRAND`, `FINGERPRINT`, …).
//!
//! `-prop` only reaches `qemu.*` (disproven in the R5 proof run), so the
//! values are applied by Magisk's `resetprop` from the per-device patched
//! ramdisk. Magisk's documented overlay system appends `overlay.d/*.rc` to
//! `init.rc` (with `${MAGISKTMP}` replaced by its tmpfs) and copies
//! `overlay.d/sbin/*` into that tmpfs. Our rc runs a small script at
//! `post-fs-data`, before zygote starts, which calls `resetprop -n` once per
//! property (the docs' replacement for `setprop` at that stage). Un-patching
//! boots the stock ramdisk, so the stock values come back.
//!
//! Identity properties only: never hardware or HAL properties.

use std::path::PathBuf;

use jidr_core::provider::CallCtx;
use jidr_core::{Device, DeviceStatus, ErrorCode, JidrError, JidrResult, RootMode};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::{Value, json};

use crate::magisk;

/// The values a device reports instead of its image's. `None` keeps stock.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct BuildProps {
    /// `Build.MODEL` (`ro.product.model`), e.g. "Pixel 8".
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub model: Option<String>,
    /// `Build.BRAND` (`ro.product.brand`).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub brand: Option<String>,
    /// `Build.MANUFACTURER` (`ro.product.manufacturer`).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub manufacturer: Option<String>,
    /// `Build.DEVICE` (`ro.product.device`).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub device: Option<String>,
    /// `Build.FINGERPRINT` (`ro.build.fingerprint`).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub fingerprint: Option<String>,
    /// `Build.VERSION.SECURITY_PATCH` (`ro.build.version.security_patch`),
    /// `YYYY-MM-DD`.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub security_patch: Option<String>,
}

/// The field names, in form order.
pub const FIELDS: [&str; 6] = [
    "model",
    "brand",
    "manufacturer",
    "device",
    "fingerprint",
    "security_patch",
];

/// Longest value accepted. `ro.*` values may exceed the 91-byte limit of
/// other properties; fingerprints often do.
const MAX_LEN: usize = 256;

/// The partitions whose copies of the product properties Android also reads
/// (`ro.product.<partition>.model`, …); `""` is the plain property.
const PRODUCT_PARTITIONS: [&str; 6] = ["", "system.", "vendor.", "product.", "odm.", "system_ext."];
const BUILD_PARTITIONS: [&str; 6] = [
    "system.",
    "vendor.",
    "product.",
    "odm.",
    "system_ext.",
    "bootimage.",
];

impl BuildProps {
    pub fn get(&self, field: &str) -> Option<&str> {
        match field {
            "model" => self.model.as_deref(),
            "brand" => self.brand.as_deref(),
            "manufacturer" => self.manufacturer.as_deref(),
            "device" => self.device.as_deref(),
            "fingerprint" => self.fingerprint.as_deref(),
            "security_patch" => self.security_patch.as_deref(),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    fn fields_mut(&mut self) -> [(&'static str, &mut Option<String>); 6] {
        [
            ("model", &mut self.model),
            ("brand", &mut self.brand),
            ("manufacturer", &mut self.manufacturer),
            ("device", &mut self.device),
            ("fingerprint", &mut self.fingerprint),
            ("security_patch", &mut self.security_patch),
        ]
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        FIELDS.iter().all(|f| self.get(f).is_none())
    }

    /// Trims every value (an empty one means stock) and checks it. The error
    /// is `usage` with `data.field` naming the first bad field.
    pub fn normalized(mut self) -> JidrResult<Self> {
        for (name, value) in self.fields_mut() {
            *value = value
                .take()
                .map(|v| v.trim().to_string())
                .filter(|v| !v.is_empty());
            if let Some(v) = value.as_deref() {
                check(name, v)?;
            }
        }
        Ok(self)
    }

    /// Every property to set, in a stable order.
    pub fn properties(&self) -> Vec<(String, &str)> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        for (field, key) in [
            ("model", "model"),
            ("brand", "brand"),
            ("manufacturer", "manufacturer"),
            ("device", "device"),
        ] {
            if let Some(v) = self.get(field) {
                for p in PRODUCT_PARTITIONS {
                    out.push((format!("ro.product.{p}{key}"), v));
                }
            }
        }
        if let Some(v) = self.fingerprint.as_deref() {
            out.push(("ro.build.fingerprint".to_string(), v));
            for p in BUILD_PARTITIONS {
                out.push((format!("ro.{p}build.fingerprint"), v));
            }
        }
        if let Some(v) = self.security_patch.as_deref() {
            out.push(("ro.build.version.security_patch".to_string(), v));
            out.push(("ro.vendor.build.security_patch".to_string(), v));
        }
        out
    }

    /// The boot script copied into Magisk's tmpfs: one `resetprop -n` per
    /// property. `$1` is that tmpfs (the rc passes `${MAGISKTMP}`), where
    /// `magisk` lives.
    pub fn script(&self) -> String {
        let mut s = String::from("#!/system/bin/sh\n# Jidr build props (Phase 9f).\n");
        for (name, value) in self.properties() {
            s.push_str(&format!(
                "\"$1/magisk\" resetprop -n {name} {}\n",
                quote(value)
            ));
        }
        s
    }
}

/// The `overlay.d` rc that runs [`BuildProps::script`] at `post-fs-data`,
/// before zygote (and so every app) reads the properties.
pub fn rc() -> String {
    format!(
        "# Jidr build props (Phase 9f).\n\
         on post-fs-data\n    \
         exec u:r:magisk:s0 root root -- /system/bin/sh ${{MAGISKTMP}}/{SCRIPT} ${{MAGISKTMP}}\n"
    )
}

/// Names inside `overlay.d` (the script goes under `overlay.d/sbin`).
pub const RC: &str = "jidr-props.rc";
pub const SCRIPT: &str = "jidr-props.sh";

/// Single-quotes `v` for `sh`.
fn quote(v: &str) -> String {
    format!("'{}'", v.replace('\'', r"'\''"))
}

fn check(field: &str, v: &str) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let bad = |why: &str| {
        Err(JidrError::usage(format!("{field}: {why}")).with_data(json!({ "field": field })))
    };
    if v.chars().count() > MAX_LEN {
        return bad(&format!("at most {MAX_LEN} characters"));
    }
    if v.chars().any(char::is_control) {
        return bad("no line breaks or control characters");
    }
    if field == "security_patch" && !is_date(v) {
        return bad("a date like 2026-10-05");
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// `YYYY-MM-DD` with a plausible month and day.
fn is_date(v: &str) -> bool {
    let b = v.as_bytes();
    let digits = |r: std::ops::Range<usize>| b[r].iter().all(u8::is_ascii_digit);
    if b.len() != 10
        || b[4] != b'-'
        || b[7] != b'-'
        || !digits(0..4)
        || !digits(5..7)
        || !digits(8..10)
    {
        return false;
    }
    let month = (b[5] - b'0') * 10 + (b[6] - b'0');
    let day = (b[8] - b'0') * 10 + (b[9] - b'0');
    (1..=12).contains(&month) && (1..=31).contains(&day)
}

/// `<avd>/jidr/props.json`, next to the patched ramdisk.
pub fn path(ctx: &CallCtx, device: &Device) -> PathBuf {
    ctx.daemon
        .paths()
        .avd_home()
        .join(format!("{}.avd", device.avd))
        .join("jidr")
        .join("props.json")
}

/// The stored props; stock when there are none (or the file is unreadable).
pub fn load(ctx: &CallCtx, device: &Device) -> BuildProps {
    std::fs::read_to_string(path(ctx, device))
        .ok()
        .and_then(|t| serde_json::from_str(&t).ok())
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

fn save(ctx: &CallCtx, device: &Device, props: &BuildProps) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let p = path(ctx, device);
    if props.is_empty() {
        return match std::fs::remove_file(&p) {
            Err(e) if e.kind() != std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Err(JidrError::new(
                ErrorCode::Sdk,
                format!("removing {}: {e}", p.display()),
            )),
            _ => Ok(()),
        };
    }
    let text = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(props)
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(format!("encoding props: {e}")))?;
    magisk::patch::write_atomic(&p, &text)
}

/// Drops the stored props (leaving Full root).
pub fn clear(ctx: &CallCtx, device: &Device) {
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(path(ctx, device));
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SetParams {
    /// Device name or id (must be in `magisk` mode).
    pub device: String,
    /// The whole set: fields left out (or empty) report the stock value.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub props: BuildProps,
}

/// The result of `device.props.get` / `.set`.
fn view(ctx: &CallCtx, device: &Device, props: &BuildProps) -> Value {
    let running = matches!(device.status, DeviceStatus::Running);
    json!({
        "device": device.id,
        "props": props,
        // Only a Full-root boot applies them.
        "applies": device.root.mode == RootMode::Magisk,
        // Saved since this boot: the next start (a cold boot) applies them.
        "restart_required": running && device.launch.force_cold_boot,
        "path": path(ctx, device),
    })
}

/// `device.props.get`.
pub async fn get(ctx: &CallCtx, selector: &str) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    let device = ctx.daemon.device(selector).await?;
    let props = load(ctx, &device);
    Ok(view(ctx, &device, &props))
}

/// `device.props.set`: Full root only. Stores the set, re-patches the
/// per-device ramdisk and makes the next start a cold boot.
pub async fn set(ctx: &CallCtx, p: SetParams) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    let device = ctx.daemon.device(&p.device).await?;
    if device.root.mode != RootMode::Magisk {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
            "{} isn't Full-root (Magisk); build props apply to Magisk devices only",
            device.name
        )));
    }
    let props = p.props.normalized()?;
    let before = load(ctx, &device);
    save(ctx, &device, &props)?;
    if props == before {
        return Ok(view(ctx, &device, &props));
    }
    let device = match magisk::repatch(ctx, &device).await {
        Ok(d) => d,
        Err(e) => {
            // Keep what the ramdisk actually carries.
            let _ = save(ctx, &device, &before);
            return Err(e);
        }
    };
    Ok(view(ctx, &device, &props))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn props() -> BuildProps {
        BuildProps {
            model: Some("Pixel 8".into()),
            brand: Some("google".into()),
            security_patch: Some("2026-10-05".into()),
            ..Default::default()
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn empty_values_mean_stock_and_values_are_trimmed() {
        let p = BuildProps {
            model: Some("  Pixel 8 ".into()),
            brand: Some("   ".into()),
            ..Default::default()
        }
        .normalized()
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p.model.as_deref(), Some("Pixel 8"));
        assert_eq!(p.brand, None);
        assert!(BuildProps::default().normalized().unwrap().is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn bad_values_name_their_field() {
        for (p, field) in [
            (
                BuildProps {
                    security_patch: Some("Oct 2026".into()),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                "security_patch",
            ),
            (
                BuildProps {
                    security_patch: Some("2026-13-01".into()),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                "security_patch",
            ),
            (
                BuildProps {
                    model: Some("a\nb".into()),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                "model",
            ),
            (
                BuildProps {
                    fingerprint: Some("x".repeat(MAX_LEN + 1)),
                    ..Default::default()
                },
                "fingerprint",
            ),
        ] {
            let e = p.normalized().unwrap_err();
            assert_eq!(e.code, ErrorCode::Usage);
            assert_eq!(e.data.unwrap()["field"], field);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn each_field_sets_its_property_and_partition_copies() {
        let names: Vec<String> = props().properties().into_iter().map(|(n, _)| n).collect();
        assert!(names.contains(&"ro.product.model".to_string()));
        assert!(names.contains(&"ro.product.vendor.model".to_string()));
        assert!(names.contains(&"ro.product.system.brand".to_string()));
        assert!(names.contains(&"ro.build.version.security_patch".to_string()));
        assert!(!names.iter().any(|n| n.contains("manufacturer")));
        assert!(!names.iter().any(|n| n.contains("hardware")));
        let fp = BuildProps {
            fingerprint: Some("google/husky/husky:15/AP4A/1:user/release-keys".into()),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let names: Vec<String> = fp.properties().into_iter().map(|(n, _)| n).collect();
        assert!(names.contains(&"ro.build.fingerprint".to_string()));
        assert!(names.contains(&"ro.vendor.build.fingerprint".to_string()));
        assert!(names.contains(&"ro.bootimage.build.fingerprint".to_string()));
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_script_quotes_values_and_uses_the_magisk_tmpfs() {
        let p = BuildProps {
            model: Some("Bob's \"phone\" $HOME".into()),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let s = p.script();
        assert!(s.starts_with("#!/system/bin/sh\n"));
        assert!(
            s.contains(r#""$1/magisk" resetprop -n ro.product.model 'Bob'\''s "phone" $HOME'"#),
            "{s}"
        );
        let rc = rc();
        assert!(rc.contains("on post-fs-data\n"));
        assert!(
            rc.contains("${MAGISKTMP}/jidr-props.sh ${MAGISKTMP}"),
            "{rc}"
        );
        assert!(!rc.contains("/sbin/"), "never hardcode /sbin: {rc}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn dates() {
        assert!(is_date("2026-10-05"));
        assert!(!is_date("2026-1-05"));
        assert!(!is_date("2026-00-05"));
        assert!(!is_date("2026-10-32"));
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-root/src/verify.rs`:

```rs
//! Root verification: compare the live uid of the adb shell (or of `su`)
//! with what the device's root mode promises, and record the result.

use std::time::Duration;

use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use jidr_adb::Adb;
use jidr_core::provider::CallCtx;
use jidr_core::{Device, JidrError, JidrResult, RootHealth, RootMode};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::Serialize;
use uuid::Uuid;

/// The result of one verification.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct Verification {
    pub device: Uuid,
    pub mode: RootMode,
    /// The command that was run in `adb shell`.
    pub command: String,
    /// The uid it reported.
    pub uid: u32,
    pub ok: bool,
    pub health: RootHealth,
    pub verified_at: DateTime<Utc>,
    /// For Magisk mode, the version reported by `magisk -v`.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub magisk_version: Option<String>,
}

/// What `adb shell` runs to check `mode`.
pub(crate) fn probe_command(mode: RootMode) -> &'static str {
    match mode {
        RootMode::Magisk => "su -c id",
        RootMode::None | RootMode::Adb => "id",
    }
}

/// `none` must not be root; `adb` and `magisk` must be.
pub(crate) fn uid_matches(mode: RootMode, uid: u32) -> bool {
    match mode {
        RootMode::None => uid != 0,
        RootMode::Adb | RootMode::Magisk => uid == 0,
    }
}

/// The uid in `id` output: `uid=0(root) gid=0(root) …`.
pub(crate) fn parse_uid(output: &str) -> Option<u32> {
    let rest = &output[output.find("uid=")? + 4..];
    let digits: String = rest.chars().take_while(char::is_ascii_digit).collect();
    digits.parse().ok()
}

/// An `adb` aimed at a running device.
pub(crate) async fn device_adb(ctx: &CallCtx, device: &Device) -> JidrResult<Adb> {
    let info = ctx.daemon.connect_info(device.id).await?;
    Ok(Adb::new(info.adb_path)
        .device(info.adb_serial)
        .with_timeout(Duration::from_secs(20)))
}

/// Runs the probe once and returns the uid.
pub(crate) async fn probe(adb: &Adb, mode: RootMode) -> JidrResult<u32> {
    let cmd = probe_command(mode);
    let (_, out) = adb.shell_status(cmd).await?;
    parse_uid(&out)
        .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::root_failed(format!("`{cmd}` printed no uid: {}", out.trim())))
}

/// Probes, stores `health` and `verified_at`, and fails with `root_failed`
/// when the uid doesn't match the mode. Magisk mode additionally checks
/// `magisk -v`.
pub(crate) async fn verify(ctx: &CallCtx, device: &Device) -> JidrResult<Verification> {
    let adb = device_adb(ctx, device).await?;
    let mode = device.root.mode;
    let uid = probe(&adb, mode).await?;
    let version = if mode == RootMode::Magisk {
        Some(magisk_version(&adb).await?)
    } else {
        None
    };
    record(ctx, device, mode, uid, version).await
}

/// The Magisk version reported by `su -c 'magisk -v'`.
pub(crate) async fn magisk_version(adb: &Adb) -> JidrResult<String> {
    let (status, out) = adb.shell_status("su -c 'magisk -v'").await?;
    let version = out.trim();
    if status == 0 && !version.is_empty() {
        Ok(version.to_string())
    } else {
        Err(JidrError::root_failed(format!(
            "`su -c 'magisk -v'` reported no version: {}",
            out.trim()
        )))
    }
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub(crate) async fn record(
    ctx: &CallCtx,
    device: &Device,
    mode: RootMode,
    uid: u32,
    magisk_version: Option<String>,
) -> JidrResult<Verification> {
    let ok = uid_matches(mode, uid);
    let health = if ok {
        RootHealth::Ok
    } else {
        RootHealth::Failed
    };
    let now = Utc::now();
    ctx.daemon
        .update_device(
            device.id,
            Box::new(move |d| {
                d.root.health = health;
                d.root.verified_at = Some(now);
            }),
        )
        .await?;
    let v = Verification {
        device: device.id,
        mode,
        command: probe_command(mode).to_string(),
        uid,
        ok,
        health,
        verified_at: now,
        magisk_version,
    };
    if ok {
        Ok(v)
    } else {
        Err(JidrError::root_failed(format!(
            "{}: `{}` reported uid {uid}, expected {}",
            device.name,
            v.command,
            if mode == RootMode::None {
                "non-root"
            } else {
                "0 (root)"
            }
        ))
        .with_data(serde_json::to_value(&v).unwrap_or_default()))
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn parses_uids_from_id_output() {
        assert_eq!(parse_uid("uid=0(root) gid=0(root) groups=0(root)"), Some(0));
        assert_eq!(
            parse_uid("uid=2000(shell) gid=2000(shell) groups=2000(shell),1004(input)\n"),
            Some(2000)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            parse_uid("/system/bin/sh: su: inaccessible or not found"),
            None
        );
        assert_eq!(parse_uid("uid=(x)"), None);
        assert_eq!(parse_uid(""), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn modes_expect_the_right_uid() {
        assert!(uid_matches(RootMode::None, 2000));
        assert!(!uid_matches(RootMode::None, 0));
        assert!(uid_matches(RootMode::Adb, 0));
        assert!(!uid_matches(RootMode::Adb, 2000));
        assert!(uid_matches(RootMode::Magisk, 0));
        assert_eq!(probe_command(RootMode::Magisk), "su -c id");
        assert_eq!(probe_command(RootMode::Adb), "id");
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-root/tests/adb_emulator.rs`:

```rs
//! Phase 9c acceptance on a real emulator: none → adb (live) → cold boot
//! (the boot hook re-applies root) → none, verified at every step.
//!
//! The image comes from `JIDR_TEST_IMAGE` (default: API 31 `google_apis` for
//! the host ABI) in `JIDR_TEST_SDK` (default: Android Studio's SDK, opened
//! read-only). The AVD lives in a temp Jidr home.
#![cfg(feature = "emulator")]
#![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]

use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Instant;

use jidr_backend::AospBackend;
use jidr_backend::testing::{AvdGuard, kill_orphans, unique_avd};
use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, DaemonContext};
use jidr_core::{JidrPaths, RootHealth, RootMode};
use jidr_daemon::{Daemon, DaemonConfig};
use serde_json::{Value, json};

fn test_sdk() -> PathBuf {
    std::env::var_os("JIDR_TEST_SDK")
        .map(PathBuf::from)
        .or_else(|| std::env::var_os("HOME").map(|h| PathBuf::from(h).join("Library/Android/sdk")))
        .unwrap()
}

fn test_image() -> String {
    std::env::var("JIDR_TEST_IMAGE").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        let abi = if cfg!(target_arch = "aarch64") {
            "arm64-v8a"
        } else {
            "x86_64"
        };
        format!("system-images;android-31;google_apis;{abi}")
    })
}

async fn call(daemon: &Arc<Daemon>, ctx: &CallCtx, method: &str, params: Value) -> Value {
    let (p, _) = daemon.registry().get(method).unwrap();
    p.call(ctx, method, params)
        .await
        .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{method}: {e}"))
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn adb_root_cycle_none_adb_none() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let daemon = Daemon::builder(
        DaemonConfig {
            paths: JidrPaths::under(tmp.path()),
            studio_sdk: Some(test_sdk()),
            idle_timeout: None,
            sdk_repo: None,
        },
        Arc::new(AospBackend::new()),
    )
    .provider(jidr_root::provider())
    .build()
    .unwrap();
    let ctx = CallCtx::new(daemon.state().clone());
    let state = daemon.state().clone();
    let image = test_image();
    println!("image: {image}");
    // Leftovers of earlier killed runs, then a name unique to this process.
    kill_orphans("root-e2e");
    let name = unique_avd("root-e2e");

    call(
        &daemon,
        &ctx,
        "device.create",
        json!({ "name": name, "image": image, "profile": "small-phone-5", "root_mode": "none" }),
    )
    .await;
    // Kills the emulator on drop, and via a reaper process if this test is killed.
    let _guard = AvdGuard::new(&state.device(&name).await.unwrap().avd);

    // 1. none: the shell is not root.
    let t = Instant::now();
    call(&daemon, &ctx, "device.start", json!({ "device": name })).await;
    println!("cold boot: {:.1} s", t.elapsed().as_secs_f64());
    // Checks the guard: a red run must still shut the emulator down.
    if std::env::var_os("JIDR_ROOT_E2E_FAIL_AFTER_BOOT").is_some() {
        panic!("JIDR_ROOT_E2E_FAIL_AFTER_BOOT is set: failing on purpose");
    }
    let v = call(&daemon, &ctx, "root.verify", json!({ "device": name })).await;
    assert_eq!(v["mode"], "none");
    assert_ne!(v["uid"], 0, "{v}");

    // 2. none → adb, live.
    let t = Instant::now();
    let r = call(
        &daemon,
        &ctx,
        "root.set",
        json!({ "device": name, "mode": "adb" }),
    )
    .await;
    println!("live adb root: {:.1} s", t.elapsed().as_secs_f64());
    assert_eq!(r["applied"], "live");
    assert_eq!(r["verification"]["uid"], 0, "{r}");

    // 3. Stop and start: cold boot (D29), the boot hook roots adbd again.
    call(&daemon, &ctx, "device.stop", json!({ "device": name })).await;
    let t = Instant::now();
    call(&daemon, &ctx, "device.start", json!({ "device": name })).await;
    println!("cold boot + hook: {:.1} s", t.elapsed().as_secs_f64());
    let d = state.device(&name).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(d.root.mode, RootMode::Adb);
    assert_eq!(d.root.health, RootHealth::Ok, "boot hook verified root");
    assert!(!d.launch.force_cold_boot);
    let v = call(&daemon, &ctx, "root.verify", json!({ "device": name })).await;
    assert_eq!(v["uid"], 0);

    // 4. adb → none, live.
    let r = call(
        &daemon,
        &ctx,
        "root.set",
        json!({ "device": name, "mode": "none" }),
    )
    .await;
    assert_eq!(r["applied"], "live");
    assert_ne!(r["verification"]["uid"], 0, "{r}");

    // Magisk mode (9d) is covered by magisk_emulator.rs.

    call(&daemon, &ctx, "device.stop", json!({ "device": name })).await;
    call(&daemon, &ctx, "device.delete", json!({ "device": name })).await;
}
```

```rs
#[tokio::test]
async fn adb_device_is_rooted_and_verified_after_every_boot() {
```

```rs
//! Offline tests of `root.auto_grant` (G15): the D22 "auto-grant all" toggle.

mod common;

use common::Env;
use jidr_core::{ErrorCode, RootMode};
use serde_json::json;

async fn to_magisk(env: &Env, name: &str) {
    let entry = env
        .call("cache.import", json!({ "path": env.apk }))
        .await
        .unwrap();

    .await
    .unwrap();

#[tokio::test]
async fn auto_grant_on_a_stopped_device_applies_at_next_boot() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    env.create("phone", "35:google_apis", None).await;
    to_magisk(&env, "phone").await;
    env.call("device.stop", json!({ "device": "phone" }))
        .await
        .unwrap();

    let r = env
        .call(
            "root.auto_grant",
            json!({ "device": "phone", "enabled": true }),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r["applied"], "next_boot");
    assert!(env.device("phone").await.root.auto_grant_all);
    assert_eq!(env.auto_response(), "", "not applied while stopped");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn leaving_magisk_resets_auto_grant() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    env.create("phone", "35:google_apis", None).await;
    to_magisk(&env, "phone").await;
    env.call(
        "root.auto_grant",
        json!({ "device": "phone", "enabled": true }),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert!(env.device("phone").await.root.auto_grant_all);

    env.call("root.set", json!({ "device": "phone", "mode": "none" }))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let d = env.device("phone").await;
    assert_eq!(d.root.mode, RootMode::None);
    assert!(!d.root.auto_grant_all, "D22: reset when leaving Full root");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn auto_grant_only_writes_when_the_value_changes() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    env.create("phone", "35:google_apis", None).await;
    to_magisk(&env, "phone").await;

    // Off is the default and no key is present → nothing to write.
    env.call(
        "root.auto_grant",
        json!({ "device": "phone", "enabled": false }),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(env.auto_response(), "");
    assert_eq!(env.force_stop_count(), 0);

    // On → writes the value and restarts the app so it re-reads.
    env.call(
        "root.auto_grant",
        json!({ "device": "phone", "enabled": true }),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(env.auto_response(), "2");
    assert_eq!(env.force_stop_count(), 1);

    // On again → already "2", no write and no restart.
    env.call(
        "root.auto_grant",
        json!({ "device": "phone", "enabled": true }),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(env.force_stop_count(), 1);

    // Off → writes "0" and restarts.
    env.call(
        "root.auto_grant",
        json!({ "device": "phone", "enabled": false }),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(env.auto_response(), "0");
    assert_eq!(env.force_stop_count(), 2);
}
```

`crates/jidr-root/tests/common/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! An in-process daemon with the root provider: the fake backend, a fake
//! Studio SDK and a fake `adb` whose adbd remembers `root` / `unroot` and which
//! simulates Magisk (`su`, the `magisk` binary and the su-policy database).
#![allow(dead_code)]

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::Arc;

use jidr_backend::fake::FakeBackend;
use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, DaemonContext};
use jidr_core::{Device, ImageRef, JidrPaths, JidrResult};
use jidr_daemon::{Daemon, DaemonConfig};
use serde_json::{Value, json};

/// The Magisk version the fake APK (and fake `magisk -v`) reports.
pub const MAGISK_VERSION: &str = "30.7";

/// adbd's uid lives in a file next to the script, so it survives "reboots"
/// unless a test resets it (a real reboot starts adbd as shell again). A
/// second file records whether the shell's su request has been granted.
const FAKE_ADB: &str = r#"#!/bin/sh
dir="$(dirname "$0")"
state="$dir/adbd-uid"
grant="$dir/su-granted"
[ -f "$state" ] || echo 2000 > "$state"
while [ "$1" = -s ]; do shift 2; done
case "$1" in
  root) echo 0 > "$state"; echo "restarting adbd as root";;
  unroot) echo 2000 > "$state"; echo "restarting adbd as non root";;
  devices) printf 'List of devices attached\nemulator-5556\tdevice\nemulator-5558\tdevice\nemulator-5560\tdevice\n';;
  push) echo "pushed";;
  install) echo "Success";;
  uninstall) echo "Success";;
  logcat) echo 'I/fake: hello';;
  shell)
    uid=$(cat "$state")
    if [ "$uid" = 0 ]; then name=root; else name=shell; fi
    cmd="$2"
    case "$cmd" in
      "id -u") echo "$uid";;
      id*) echo "uid=$uid($name) gid=$uid($name) groups=$uid($name)";;
      "su -c id")
        if [ -f "$grant" ]; then echo "uid=0(root) gid=0(root) groups=0(root)"; else echo "su: Permission denied" >&2; exit 1; fi;;
      "su -c 'magisk -v'"|"su -c magisk -v")
        if [ -f "$grant" ]; then echo "30.7:MAGISK:R"; else echo "su: Permission denied" >&2; exit 1; fi;;
      "[ -x /debug_ramdisk/magisk ] && echo yes"|"[ -x /sbin/magisk ] && echo yes")
        echo "yes";;
      "/debug_ramdisk/magisk --sqlite"*|"/sbin/magisk --sqlite"*|"/data/adb/magisk/magisk --sqlite"*)
        case "$cmd" in
          *"REPLACE INTO policies"*) echo 1 > "$grant"; echo "done";;
          *"SELECT policy FROM policies"*)
            if [ -f "$grant" ]; then echo "policy=2"; else echo "policy=0"; fi;;
          *) echo "done";;
        esac;;
      "cat /data/user_de/0/com.topjohnwu.magisk/shared_prefs/com.topjohnwu.magisk_preferences.xml")
        if [ -f "$dir/auto-response" ]; then
          v=$(cat "$dir/auto-response")
          echo "<map><string name=\"su_auto_response\">$v</string></map>"
        else
          exit 1
        fi;;
      "am force-stop com.topjohnwu.magisk")
        echo 1 >> "$dir/force-stopped"; echo "ok";;
      *"su_auto_response"*)
        # root.auto_grant writes Magisk's SharedPreferences; remember the value.
        case "$cmd" in
          *'">2</string>'*) echo 2 > "$dir/auto-response"; echo '<map><string name="su_auto_response">2</string></map>';;
          *) echo 0 > "$dir/auto-response"; echo '<map><string name="su_auto_response">0</string></map>';;
        esac;;
      *) echo ok;;
    esac;;
  *) echo ok;;
esac
"#;

pub struct Env {
    pub tmp: tempfile::TempDir,
    pub studio: PathBuf,
    pub apk: PathBuf,
    pub backend: Arc<FakeBackend>,
    pub daemon: Arc<Daemon>,
    pub ctx: CallCtx,
}

/// A minimal, parseable pristine ramdisk (one uncompressed cpio segment).
fn valid_ramdisk() -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut a = jidr_cpio::Archive::new();
    a.insert(jidr_cpio::Entry::file(
        "init",
        0o750,
        b"#!stock init".to_vec(),
    ));
    let ramdisk = jidr_cpio::Ramdisk {
        segments: vec![jidr_cpio::Segment {
            compression: jidr_cpio::Compression::None,
            archive: a,
        }],
        trailing: Vec::new(),
    };
    ramdisk.to_bytes().unwrap()
}

/// Writes a valid pristine ramdisk over the fake SDK's `ramdisk.img` (the fake
/// SDK writes a single byte, which the cpio parser can't read).
fn write_valid_ramdisks(studio: &Path) {
    let base = jidr_daemon::testing::fake_image();
    for tag in ["google_apis", "google_apis_playstore"] {
        let image = ImageRef {
            tag: tag.to_string(),
            ..base.clone()
        };
        let path = studio.join(image.sysdir()).join("ramdisk.img");
        std::fs::write(path, valid_ramdisk()).unwrap();
    }
}

/// A synthetic Magisk release APK: a zip with the payload libraries, the
/// environment files and `assets/util_functions.sh` declaring the version.
fn write_fake_apk(dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    let path = dir.join("Magisk-v30.7.apk");
    let file = std::fs::File::create(&path).unwrap();
    let mut zip = zip::ZipWriter::new(file);
    let opts = zip::write::SimpleFileOptions::default();
    let add = |zip: &mut zip::ZipWriter<std::fs::File>, name: &str, body: &[u8]| {
        zip.start_file(name, opts).unwrap();
        use std::io::Write;
        zip.write_all(body).unwrap();
    };
    for abi in ["arm64-v8a", "x86_64"] {
        add(
            &mut zip,
            &format!("lib/{abi}/libmagiskinit.so"),
            b"magiskinit",
        );
        add(&mut zip, &format!("lib/{abi}/libmagisk.so"), b"magisk");
        add(&mut zip, &format!("lib/{abi}/libinit-ld.so"), b"init-ld");
        add(
            &mut zip,
            &format!("lib/{abi}/libmagiskpolicy.so"),
            b"magiskpolicy",
        );
    }
    add(&mut zip, "assets/stub.apk", b"stub");
    add(
        &mut zip,
        "assets/util_functions.sh",
        b"MAGISK_VER='30.7'\nMAGISK_VER_CODE=30700\n",
    );
    add(&mut zip, "assets/boot_patch.sh", b"#!/system/bin/sh\n");
    add(&mut zip, "assets/addon.d.sh", b"#!/system/bin/sh\n");
    add(&mut zip, "assets/chromeos/futility", b"futility");
    add(&mut zip, "assets/chromeos/kernel_data_key.vbprivk", b"key");
    add(&mut zip, "assets/chromeos/kernel.keyblock", b"keyblock");
    zip.finish().unwrap();
    path
}

impl Env {
    pub async fn start() -> Self {
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let studio = jidr_daemon::testing::fake_studio(&tmp.path().join("studio")).unwrap();
        write_exec(&studio.join("platform-tools/adb"), FAKE_ADB);
        write_valid_ramdisks(&studio);
        let apk = write_fake_apk(tmp.path());
        let repo = tmp.path().join("repo");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&repo).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(
            repo.join("repository2-3.xml"),
            "<sdk:sdk-repository xmlns:sdk=\"x\"/>",
        )
        .unwrap();
        let backend = Arc::new(FakeBackend::new());
        let daemon = Daemon::builder(
            DaemonConfig {
                paths: JidrPaths::under(tmp.path().join("j")),
                studio_sdk: Some(studio.clone()),
                idle_timeout: None,
                sdk_repo: Some(format!("file://{}/", repo.display())),
            },
            backend.clone(),
        )
        .provider(jidr_root::provider())
        .build()
        .unwrap();
        let ctx = CallCtx::new(daemon.state().clone());
        Self {
            tmp,
            studio,
            apk,
            backend,
            daemon,
            ctx,
        }
    }

    pub async fn call(&self, method: &str, params: Value) -> JidrResult<Value> {
        let (provider, _) = self.daemon.registry().get(method).unwrap();
        provider.call(&self.ctx, method, params).await
    }

    pub async fn create(&self, name: &str, image: &str, root_mode: Option<&str>) -> Device {
        let mut params = json!({ "name": name, "image": image });
        if let Some(mode) = root_mode {
            params["root_mode"] = json!(mode);
        }
        self.call("device.create", params).await.unwrap();
        self.device(name).await
    }

    pub async fn device(&self, name: &str) -> Device {
        self.daemon.state().device(name).await.unwrap()
    }

    pub fn adbd_uid(&self) -> String {
        std::fs::read_to_string(self.studio.join("platform-tools/adbd-uid"))
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "2000".into())
            .trim()
            .to_string()
    }

    /// What a real reboot does to adbd.
    pub fn reset_adbd(&self, uid: &str) {
        std::fs::write(
            self.studio.join("platform-tools/adbd-uid"),
            format!("{uid}\n"),
        )
        .unwrap();
    }

    /// Whether the fake Magisk has granted the shell su.
    pub fn su_granted(&self) -> bool {
        self.studio.join("platform-tools/su-granted").exists()
    }

    /// Simulates the person tapping Grant on the Magisk prompt.
    pub fn tap_grant(&self) {
        std::fs::write(self.studio.join("platform-tools/su-granted"), b"1").unwrap();
    }

    pub fn revoke_su(&self) {
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(self.studio.join("platform-tools/su-granted"));
    }

    /// The Magisk automatic-response value the fake adb last wrote ("" if never).
    pub fn auto_response(&self) -> String {
        std::fs::read_to_string(self.studio.join("platform-tools/auto-response"))
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .trim()
            .to_string()
    }

    /// How many times the fake adb force-stopped the Magisk app.
    pub fn force_stop_count(&self) -> usize {
        std::fs::read_to_string(self.studio.join("platform-tools/force-stopped"))
            .map(|s| s.lines().count())
            .unwrap_or(0)
    }

    /// SHA-256 of the pristine `ramdisk.img` the fake SDK provides.
    pub fn pristine_sha256(&self) -> String {
        let image = jidr_daemon::testing::fake_image();
        jidr_sdk::cache::sha256_file(&self.studio.join(image.sysdir()).join("ramdisk.img")).unwrap()
    }

    /// The per-device patched ramdisk path for the pinned version.
    pub fn patched_ramdisk(&self, device: &Device) -> PathBuf {
        self.daemon
            .state()
            .paths()
            .avd_home()
            .join(format!("{}.avd", device.avd))
            .join("jidr")
            .join(format!("ramdisk.magisk-{MAGISK_VERSION}.img"))
    }
}

fn write_exec(path: &Path, body: &str) {
    std::fs::write(path, body).unwrap();
    #[cfg(unix)]
    {
        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
        std::fs::set_permissions(path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).unwrap();
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-root/tests/magisk_emulator.rs`:

```rs
//! Phase 9d acceptance on a real emulator: none → magisk (full setup) → none,
//! with `su -c id` = uid 0 in magisk mode and the shared SDK ramdisk hash
//! unchanged at the end.
//!
//! The image comes from `JIDR_TEST_IMAGE` (default: API 31 `google_apis` for
//! the host ABI) in `JIDR_TEST_SDK` (default: Android Studio's SDK, opened
//! read-only). Magisk is the pinned release, downloaded at runtime (or a local
//! APK via `JIDR_TEST_MAGISK`). The AVD lives in a temp Jidr home.
#![cfg(feature = "emulator")]
#![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]

use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Arc;

use jidr_adb::Adb;
use jidr_backend::AospBackend;
use jidr_backend::testing::{AvdGuard, kill_orphans, unique_avd};
use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, DaemonContext};
use jidr_core::{JidrPaths, RootMode};
use jidr_daemon::{Daemon, DaemonConfig};
use serde_json::{Value, json};

fn test_sdk() -> PathBuf {
    std::env::var_os("JIDR_TEST_SDK")
        .map(PathBuf::from)
        .or_else(|| std::env::var_os("HOME").map(|h| PathBuf::from(h).join("Library/Android/sdk")))
        .unwrap()
}

fn test_image() -> String {
    std::env::var("JIDR_TEST_IMAGE").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        let abi = if cfg!(target_arch = "aarch64") {
            "arm64-v8a"
        } else {
            "x86_64"
        };
        format!("system-images;android-31;google_apis;{abi}")
    })
}

async fn call(daemon: &Arc<Daemon>, ctx: &CallCtx, method: &str, params: Value) -> Value {
    let (p, _) = daemon.registry().get(method).unwrap();
    p.call(ctx, method, params)
        .await
        .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{method}: {e}"))
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn magisk_root_cycle_none_magisk_none() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let daemon = Daemon::builder(
        DaemonConfig {
            paths: JidrPaths::under(tmp.path()),
            studio_sdk: Some(test_sdk()),
            idle_timeout: None,
            sdk_repo: None,
        },
        Arc::new(AospBackend::new()),
    )
    .provider(jidr_root::provider())
    .build()
    .unwrap();
    let ctx = CallCtx::new(daemon.state().clone());
    let state = daemon.state().clone();
    let image = test_image();
    println!("image: {image}");
    kill_orphans("root-magisk");
    let name = unique_avd("root-magisk");

    call(
        &daemon,
        &ctx,
        "device.create",
        json!({ "name": name, "image": image, "profile": "small-phone-5", "root_mode": "none" }),
    )
    .await;
    let device = state.device(&name).await.unwrap();
    let _guard = AvdGuard::new(&device.avd);
    // The pristine ramdisk Jidr must never touch (D3).
    let pristine = device
        .sdk_root
        .join(device.image.sysdir())
        .join("ramdisk.img");
    let before = jidr_sdk::cache::sha256_file(&pristine).unwrap();

    // An optional local APK avoids the runtime download (offline tests).
    let mut params = json!({ "device": name, "mode": "magisk" });
    if let Some(apk) = std::env::var_os("JIDR_TEST_MAGISK") {
        let entry = call(
            &daemon,
            &ctx,
            "cache.import",
            json!({ "path": apk.to_string_lossy() }),
        )
        .await;
        params["magisk_sha256"] = entry["sha256"].clone();
    }

    // 1. none → magisk: the full setup (patch, cold boot, app, env, grant).
    let r = call(&daemon, &ctx, "root.set", params).await;
    assert_eq!(r["mode"], "magisk", "{r}");
    assert_eq!(r["verification"]["uid"], 0, "{r}");
    assert_eq!(r["verification"]["command"], "su -c id");

    let d = state.device(&name).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(d.root.mode, RootMode::Magisk);
    assert!(d.root.magisk_version.is_some());

    // 2. The shared SDK ramdisk is byte-identical.
    assert_eq!(jidr_sdk::cache::sha256_file(&pristine).unwrap(), before);

    // 2b. auto-grant all (D22/G15): on → Magisk's setting reads "grant", off → "prompt".
    let info = state.connect_info(d.id).await.unwrap();
    let adb = Adb::new(info.adb_path).device(info.adb_serial);
    let prefs =
        "/data/user_de/0/com.topjohnwu.magisk/shared_prefs/com.topjohnwu.magisk_preferences.xml";

    let r = call(
        &daemon,
        &ctx,
        "root.auto_grant",
        json!({ "device": name, "enabled": true }),
    )
    .await;
    assert_eq!(r["applied"], "live", "{r}");
    let out = adb.shell(&format!("su -c 'cat {prefs}'")).await.unwrap();
    assert!(
        out.contains("su_auto_response\">2</string>"),
        "Magisk auto-grants every app: {out}"
    );

    let r = call(
        &daemon,
        &ctx,
        "root.auto_grant",
        json!({ "device": name, "enabled": false }),
    )
    .await;
    assert_eq!(r["applied"], "live", "{r}");
    let out = adb.shell(&format!("su -c 'cat {prefs}'")).await.unwrap();
    assert!(
        out.contains("su_auto_response\">0</string>"),
        "Magisk is back to the prompt: {out}"
    );

    // 3. magisk → none: revert deletes the patched copy and cold-boots.
    let r = call(
        &daemon,
        &ctx,
        "root.set",
        json!({ "device": name, "mode": "none" }),
    )
    .await;
    assert_eq!(r["applied"], "live", "{r}");
    assert_ne!(r["verification"]["uid"], 0, "{r}");
    let d = state.device(&name).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(d.root.mode, RootMode::None);
    assert!(d.root.patched_ramdisk_path.is_none());

    call(&daemon, &ctx, "device.stop", json!({ "device": name })).await;
    call(&daemon, &ctx, "device.delete", json!({ "device": name })).await;
}
```

`crates/jidr-root/tests/magisk_mode.rs`:

```rs
//! Offline tests of Magisk mode: the patched ramdisk, the full `root.set
//! magisk` flow, revert, re-patch, the SDK hash staying untouched, and
//! `root.module.install` refusal on non-Magisk devices.
#![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]

mod common;

use common::Env;
use jidr_core::{ErrorCode, RootMode};
use serde_json::json;

async fn to_magisk(env: &Env, name: &str) -> serde_json::Value {
    // The CLI imports a local APK (`--magisk <path>`) and passes its SHA-256.
    let entry = env
        .call("cache.import", json!({ "path": env.apk }))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let sha = entry["sha256"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    env.call(
        "root.set",
        json!({ "device": name, "mode": "magisk", "magisk_sha256": sha }),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap()
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn magisk_flow_roots_and_verifies_a_device() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    env.create("phone", "35:google_apis", None).await;

    let r = to_magisk(&env, "phone").await;
    assert_eq!(r["mode"], "magisk");
    assert_eq!(r["changed"], true);
    assert_eq!(r["applied"], "live");
    assert_eq!(r["verification"]["uid"], 0, "{r}");
    assert_eq!(r["verification"]["command"], "su -c id");
    assert_eq!(r["verification"]["magisk_version"], "30.7:MAGISK:R");
    assert!(
        r["play_integrity"]
            .as_str()
            .unwrap()
            .contains("Play Integrity")
    );

    let d = env.device("phone").await;
    assert_eq!(d.root.mode, RootMode::Magisk);
    assert_eq!(
        d.root.magisk_version.as_deref(),
        Some(common::MAGISK_VERSION)
    );
    assert!(d.root.patched_ramdisk_path.is_some());
    assert!(d.launch.ramdisk.is_some());
    assert!(env.su_granted(), "the shell su was granted");

    let status = env
        .call("root.status", json!({ "device": "phone" }))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(status["root"]["mode"], "magisk");
    assert_eq!(status["root"]["health"], "ok");
    assert!(
        status["play_integrity"]
            .as_str()
            .unwrap()
            .contains("Play Integrity")
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn re_patch_when_the_pristine_image_changes() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    env.create("phone", "35:google_apis", None).await;
    to_magisk(&env, "phone").await;

    let d = env.device("phone").await;
    let patched = env.patched_ramdisk(&d);
    let first = std::fs::read(&patched).unwrap();

    // Simulate an image update: the pristine ramdisk gains an entry.
    let image = jidr_daemon::testing::fake_image();
    let pristine = env.studio.join(image.sysdir()).join("ramdisk.img");
    let mut a = jidr_cpio::Archive::new();
    a.insert(jidr_cpio::Entry::file(
        "init",
        0o750,
        b"#!stock init".to_vec(),
    ));
    a.insert(jidr_cpio::Entry::file("extra", 0o644, b"new".to_vec()));
    let ramdisk = jidr_cpio::Ramdisk {
        segments: vec![jidr_cpio::Segment {
            compression: jidr_cpio::Compression::None,
            archive: a,
        }],
        trailing: Vec::new(),
    };
    std::fs::write(&pristine, ramdisk.to_bytes().unwrap()).unwrap();

    // Re-patch: the patched copy is rebuilt from the new pristine.
    to_magisk(&env, "phone").await;
    let second = std::fs::read(&patched).unwrap();
    assert_ne!(first, second, "the patched ramdisk was rebuilt");
    let d = env.device("phone").await;
    assert_eq!(
        d.root.magisk_version.as_deref(),
        Some(common::MAGISK_VERSION)
    );
}

}
```

`crates/jidr-root/tests/props_emulator.rs`:

```rs
//! Phase 9f acceptance on a real emulator: a Full-root device reports the
//! build props it was given after a cold boot, still has root, and reports
//! its stock values again once root is reverted.
//!
//! Same setup as `magisk_emulator` (`JIDR_TEST_IMAGE`, `JIDR_TEST_SDK`,
//! optional `JIDR_TEST_MAGISK`).
#![cfg(feature = "emulator")]
#![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]

use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Arc;

use jidr_adb::Adb;
use jidr_backend::AospBackend;
use jidr_backend::testing::{AvdGuard, kill_orphans, unique_avd};
use jidr_core::JidrPaths;
use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, DaemonContext};
use jidr_daemon::{Daemon, DaemonConfig};
use serde_json::{Value, json};

fn test_sdk() -> PathBuf {
    std::env::var_os("JIDR_TEST_SDK")
        .map(PathBuf::from)
        .or_else(|| std::env::var_os("HOME").map(|h| PathBuf::from(h).join("Library/Android/sdk")))
        .unwrap()
}

fn test_image() -> String {
    std::env::var("JIDR_TEST_IMAGE").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        let abi = if cfg!(target_arch = "aarch64") {
            "arm64-v8a"
        } else {
            "x86_64"
        };
        format!("system-images;android-31;google_apis;{abi}")
    })
}

async fn call(daemon: &Arc<Daemon>, ctx: &CallCtx, method: &str, params: Value) -> Value {
    let (p, _) = daemon.registry().get(method).unwrap();
    p.call(ctx, method, params)
        .await
        .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{method}: {e}"))
}

/// `getprop name`, polled: right after a boot the shell may not answer yet.
async fn getprop(adb: &Adb, name: &str) -> String {
    let mut last = String::new();
    for _ in 0..60 {
        match adb.shell(&format!("getprop {name}")).await {
            Ok(v) if !v.trim().is_empty() => return v.trim().to_string(),
            Ok(v) => last = v,
            Err(e) => last = e.message,
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
    }
    panic!("getprop {name} never answered: {last}");
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn props_spoof_after_cold_boot_and_stock_after_revert() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let daemon = Daemon::builder(
        DaemonConfig {
            paths: JidrPaths::under(tmp.path()),
            studio_sdk: Some(test_sdk()),
            idle_timeout: None,
            sdk_repo: None,
        },
        Arc::new(AospBackend::new()),
    )
    .provider(jidr_root::provider())
    .build()
    .unwrap();
    let ctx = CallCtx::new(daemon.state().clone());
    let state = daemon.state().clone();
    let image = test_image();
    println!("image: {image}");
    kill_orphans("root-props");
    let name = unique_avd("root-props");

    call(
        &daemon,
        &ctx,
        "device.create",
        json!({ "name": name, "image": image, "profile": "small-phone-5", "root_mode": "none" }),
    )
    .await;
    let device = state.device(&name).await.unwrap();
    let _guard = AvdGuard::new(&device.avd);

    let mut params = json!({ "device": name, "mode": "magisk" });
    if let Some(apk) = std::env::var_os("JIDR_TEST_MAGISK") {
        let entry = call(
            &daemon,
            &ctx,
            "cache.import",
            json!({ "path": apk.to_string_lossy() }),
        )
        .await;
        params["magisk_sha256"] = entry["sha256"].clone();
    }
    let r = call(&daemon, &ctx, "root.set", params).await;
    assert_eq!(r["verification"]["uid"], 0, "{r}");

    let adb = || async {
        let d = state.device(&name).await.unwrap();
        let info = state.connect_info(d.id).await.unwrap();
        Adb::new(info.adb_path).device(info.adb_serial)
    };
    let stock_model = getprop(&adb().await, "ro.product.model").await;
    let stock_patch = getprop(&adb().await, "ro.build.version.security_patch").await;
    println!("stock: {stock_model} / {stock_patch}");
    assert_ne!(stock_model, "Jidr One");

    // 1. Set the props: stored, re-patched, applied on the next start.
    let r = call(
        &daemon,
        &ctx,
        "device.props.set",
        json!({ "device": name, "props": {
            "model": "Jidr One", "brand": "jidr", "manufacturer": "Jidr",
            "security_patch": "2026-10-05",
        }}),
    )
    .await;
    assert_eq!(r["restart_required"], true, "{r}");

    // 2. A cold boot applies them; root still works.
    call(&daemon, &ctx, "device.stop", json!({ "device": name })).await;
    call(&daemon, &ctx, "device.start", json!({ "device": name })).await;
    let a = adb().await;
    assert_eq!(getprop(&a, "ro.product.model").await, "Jidr One");
    assert_eq!(getprop(&a, "ro.product.brand").await, "jidr");
    assert_eq!(getprop(&a, "ro.product.manufacturer").await, "Jidr");
    assert_eq!(
        getprop(&a, "ro.build.version.security_patch").await,
        "2026-10-05"
    );
    let r = call(&daemon, &ctx, "root.verify", json!({ "device": name })).await;
    assert_eq!(r["uid"], 0, "root survives the props hook: {r}");
    let r = call(&daemon, &ctx, "device.props.get", json!({ "device": name })).await;
    assert_eq!(r["restart_required"], false, "{r}");

    // 3. Revert root: the stock ramdisk boots and the stock values return.
    call(
        &daemon,
        &ctx,
        "root.set",
        json!({ "device": name, "mode": "none" }),
    )
    .await;
    let a = adb().await;
    assert_eq!(getprop(&a, "ro.product.model").await, stock_model);
    assert_eq!(
        getprop(&a, "ro.build.version.security_patch").await,
        stock_patch
    );

    call(&daemon, &ctx, "device.stop", json!({ "device": name })).await;
    call(&daemon, &ctx, "device.delete", json!({ "device": name })).await;
}
```

`crates/jidr-root/tests/props_mode.rs`:

```rs
//! Offline tests of build-prop spoofing (Phase 9f): `device.props.get/set`
//! on a Full-root device, the re-patched ramdisk carrying the boot hook, the
//! refusal on other modes, and the props dropping when root is reverted.
#![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]

mod common;

use common::Env;
use jidr_core::ErrorCode;
use serde_json::json;

async fn to_magisk(env: &Env, name: &str) {
    let entry = env
        .call("cache.import", json!({ "path": env.apk }))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let sha = entry["sha256"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    env.call(
        "root.set",
        json!({ "device": name, "mode": "magisk", "magisk_sha256": sha }),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
}

fn hook(env: &Env, d: &jidr_core::Device) -> Option<String> {
    let bytes = std::fs::read(env.patched_ramdisk(d)).unwrap();
    let ramdisk = jidr_cpio::Ramdisk::parse(&bytes).unwrap();
    let a = &ramdisk.segments[0].archive;
    a.get("overlay.d/jidr-props.rc")?;
    a.get("overlay.d/sbin/jidr-props.sh")
        .map(|e| String::from_utf8_lossy(&e.data).into_owned())
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn props_set_repatches_and_the_next_start_applies_them() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    env.create("phone", "35:google_apis", None).await;
    to_magisk(&env, "phone").await;

    let r = env
        .call("device.props.get", json!({ "device": "phone" }))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r["props"], json!({}), "stock until set");
    assert_eq!(r["applies"], true);
    assert_eq!(r["restart_required"], false);
    let d = env.device("phone").await;
    assert!(hook(&env, &d).is_none(), "no hook for stock props");

    let r = env
        .call(
            "device.props.set",
            json!({ "device": "phone", "props": {
                "model": " Pixel 8 ", "brand": "google", "manufacturer": "",
                "security_patch": "2026-10-05",
            }}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        r["props"],
        json!({ "model": "Pixel 8", "brand": "google", "security_patch": "2026-10-05" }),
        "trimmed, empty means stock"
    );
    assert_eq!(r["restart_required"], true, "{r}");

    let d = env.device("phone").await;
    assert!(d.launch.force_cold_boot, "the next start is a cold boot");
    let script = hook(&env, &d).expect("the hook is in the patched ramdisk");
    assert!(
        script.contains("resetprop -n ro.product.model 'Pixel 8'"),
        "{script}"
    );
    assert!(script.contains("ro.build.version.security_patch '2026-10-05'"));

    // Back to stock: the hook goes away again.
    env.call(
        "device.props.set",
        json!({ "device": "phone", "props": {} }),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    let d = env.device("phone").await;
    assert!(hook(&env, &d).is_none());
}
```

```rs
//! Prints the image catalog and the emulator package for this host.
//! `cargo run -p jidr-sdk --example catalog` (set `JIDR_SDK_REPO` for a mirror).

use jidr_core::JidrPaths;
use jidr_sdk::{CatalogFilter, Fetcher, SdkSet, image_catalog, repo};

#[tokio::main(flavor = "current_thread")]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let repo = Fetcher::new()?.repository(&repo::repo_base()).await?;
    println!(
        "{} packages, {} licenses",
        repo.packages.len(),
        repo.licenses.len()
    );
    if let Some(emu) = repo.latest("emulator", 0) {
        let arc = emu.archive_for_host();
        println!(
            "emulator {} ({}), license {:?}, {:.0} MB",
            emu.revision,
            arc.map(|a| a.url.as_str())
                .unwrap_or("no archive for this host"),
            emu.license,
            arc.map(|a| a.size as f64 / 1e6).unwrap_or(0.0)
        );
    }
    let sdks = SdkSet::discover(&JidrPaths::discover()?);
    for img in image_catalog(&repo, &sdks, &CatalogFilter::default()) {
        println!(
            "API {:>2} {:<28} r{:<8} {:>6.0} MB  {:?}  {}",
            img.image.api,
            img.image.tag,
            img.revision,
            img.size as f64 / 1e6,
            img.support,
            img.installed_in
                .map(|p| format!("installed in {}", p.display()))
                .unwrap_or_default()
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}
```
