`crates/jidr-sdk/src/repo.rs`:

```rs
//! Parser for Google's SDK repository XML (`repository2-3.xml`,
//! `sys-img/<tag>/sys-img2-3.xml`): packages, archives and license texts.

use std::cmp::Ordering;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

use jidr_core::{ErrorCode, ImageRef, JidrError, JidrResult, ResultExt};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

/// Default repository root; override with `JIDR_SDK_REPO` (mirrors, tests).
pub const DEFAULT_REPO_BASE: &str = "https://dl.google.com/android/repository/";

/// Directory names of the system-image listings we read, under `sys-img/`.
pub const SYS_IMG_LISTS: &[&str] = &[
    "android",
    "google_apis",
    "google_apis_playstore",
    "aosp_atd",
];

pub fn repo_base() -> String {
    let base = std::env::var("JIDR_SDK_REPO").unwrap_or_else(|_| DEFAULT_REPO_BASE.to_string());
    if base.ends_with('/') {
        base
    } else {
        format!("{base}/")
    }
}

/// URLs of every listing Jidr reads, relative to `repo_base()`.
pub fn listing_urls(base: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    std::iter::once(format!("{base}repository2-3.xml"))
        .chain(
            SYS_IMG_LISTS
                .iter()
                .map(|t| format!("{base}sys-img/{t}/sys-img2-3.xml")),
        )
        .collect()
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Revision {
    pub major: u32,
    pub minor: u32,
    pub micro: u32,
    /// Preview number; `None` sorts after any preview of the same version.
    pub preview: Option<u32>,
}

impl Revision {
    pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Option<Self> {
        let (main, preview) = match s.split_once(" rc") {
            Some((m, p)) => (m, p.trim().parse().ok()),
            None => (s, None),
        };
        let mut parts = main.trim().split('.').map(|p| p.parse::<u32>());
        Some(Self {
            major: parts.next()?.ok()?,
            minor: parts.next().unwrap_or(Ok(0)).ok()?,
            micro: parts.next().unwrap_or(Ok(0)).ok()?,
            preview,
        })
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Display for Revision {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{}.{}.{}", self.major, self.minor, self.micro)?;
        if let Some(p) = self.preview {
            write!(f, " rc{p}")?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl Ord for Revision {
    fn cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Ordering {
        (self.major, self.minor, self.micro)
            .cmp(&(other.major, other.minor, other.micro))
            .then_with(|| match (self.preview, other.preview) {
                (None, None) => Ordering::Equal,
                (None, Some(_)) => Ordering::Greater,
                (Some(_), None) => Ordering::Less,
                (Some(a), Some(b)) => a.cmp(&b),
            })
    }
}

impl PartialOrd for Revision {
    fn partial_cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Option<Ordering> {
        Some(self.cmp(other))
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Archive {
    /// Absolute URL.
    pub url: String,
    pub sha1: String,
    pub size: u64,
    pub host_os: Option<String>,
    pub host_arch: Option<String>,
}

impl Archive {
    fn matches(&self, os: &str, arch: &str) -> bool {
        self.host_os.as_deref().is_none_or(|o| o == os)
            && self.host_arch.as_deref().is_none_or(|a| a == arch)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct RemotePackage {
    /// SDK path, e.g. `emulator` or `system-images;android-35;google_apis;arm64-v8a`.
    pub path: String,
    pub display: String,
    pub revision: Revision,
    pub license: Option<String>,
    /// 0 = stable, 1 = beta, 2 = dev, 3 = canary.
    pub channel: u32,
    pub archives: Vec<Archive>,
    pub image: Option<ImageRef>,
}

impl RemotePackage {
    pub fn archive_for(&self, os: &str, arch: &str) -> Option<&Archive> {
        self.archives.iter().find(|a| a.matches(os, arch))
    }

    pub fn archive_for_host(&self) -> Option<&Archive> {
        self.archive_for(crate::host::host_os(), crate::host::host_arch())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct License {
    pub id: String,
    pub text: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct Repository {
    pub packages: Vec<RemotePackage>,
    pub licenses: BTreeMap<String, License>,
}

impl Repository {
    /// Parses one listing. Relative archive URLs resolve against `listing_url`.
    pub fn parse(xml: &str, listing_url: &str) -> JidrResult<Self> {
        let doc =
            roxmltree::Document::parse(xml).ctx(ErrorCode::Sdk, "parsing SDK repository XML")?;
        let base = listing_url
            .rfind('/')
            .map(|i| &listing_url[..=i])
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let root = doc.root_element();
        let mut repo = Self::default();
        for node in root.children().filter(|n| n.is_element()) {
            match node.tag_name().name() {
                "license" => {
                    if let Some(id) = node.attribute("id") {
                        let text = node.text().unwrap_or_default().to_string();
                        repo.licenses.insert(
                            id.to_string(),
                            License {
                                id: id.to_string(),
                                text,
                            },
                        );
                    }
                }
                "remotePackage" => {
                    if let Some(p) = parse_package(node, base) {
                        repo.packages.push(p);
                    }
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        Ok(repo)
    }

    pub fn merge(&mut self, other: Repository) {
        self.packages.extend(other.packages);
        for (id, l) in other.licenses {
            self.licenses.entry(id).or_insert(l);
        }
    }

    /// The newest revision of `path` on a channel no less stable than `max_channel`.
    pub fn latest(&self, path: &str, max_channel: u32) -> Option<&RemotePackage> {
        self.packages
            .iter()
            .filter(|p| p.path == path && p.channel <= max_channel)
            .max_by(|a, b| a.revision.cmp(&b.revision))
    }

    pub fn license(&self, id: &str) -> JidrResult<&License> {
        self.licenses
            .get(id)
            .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::sdk(format!("license {id} is not in the SDK repository")))
    }
}

fn child<'a, 'i>(node: roxmltree::Node<'a, 'i>, name: &str) -> Option<roxmltree::Node<'a, 'i>> {
    node.children()
        .find(|c| c.is_element() && c.tag_name().name() == name)
}

fn child_text(node: roxmltree::Node<'_, '_>, name: &str) -> Option<String> {
    child(node, name)
        .and_then(|c| c.text())
        .map(|t| t.trim().to_string())
}

fn parse_package(node: roxmltree::Node<'_, '_>, base: &str) -> Option<RemotePackage> {
    let path = node.attribute("path")?.to_string();
    let rev = child(node, "revision")?;
    let num = |n: &str| child_text(rev, n).and_then(|t| t.parse().ok());
    let revision = Revision {
        major: num("major")?,
        minor: num("minor").unwrap_or(0),
        micro: num("micro").unwrap_or(0),
        preview: num("preview"),
    };
    let channel = child(node, "channelRef")
        .and_then(|c| c.attribute("ref"))
        .and_then(|r| r.strip_prefix("channel-"))
        .and_then(|n| n.parse().ok())
        .unwrap_or(0);
    let license = child(node, "uses-license")
        .and_then(|l| l.attribute("ref"))
        .map(str::to_string);
    let archives = child(node, "archives")
        .map(|a| {
            a.children()
                .filter(|c| c.is_element() && c.tag_name().name() == "archive")
                .filter_map(|arc| {
                    let complete = child(arc, "complete")?;
                    let url = child_text(complete, "url")?;
                    Some(Archive {
                        url: if url.contains("://") {
                            url
                        } else {
                            format!("{base}{url}")
                        },
                        sha1: child_text(complete, "checksum")?.to_lowercase(),
                        size: child_text(complete, "size")
                            .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
                            .unwrap_or(0),
                        host_os: child_text(arc, "host-os"),
                        host_arch: child_text(arc, "host-arch"),
                    })
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let image = ImageRef::parse_package(&path);
    Some(RemotePackage {
        display: child_text(node, "display-name").unwrap_or_else(|| path.clone()),
        path,
        revision,
        license,
        channel,
        archives,
        image,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// A tiny synthetic listing in the published format (not Google's text).
    pub const FIXTURE: &str = r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<sdk:sdk-repository xmlns:sdk="http://schemas.android.com/sdk/android/repo/repository2/03"
                    xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <license id="test-license" type="text">Line one.
Line two &amp; more.</license>
  <channel id="channel-0">stable</channel>
  <remotePackage path="emulator">
    <type-details xsi:type="generic:genericDetailsType"/>
    <revision><major>36</major><minor>1</minor><micro>2</micro></revision>
    <display-name>Emulator</display-name>
    <uses-license ref="test-license"/>
    <channelRef ref="channel-0"/>
    <archives>
      <archive>
        <complete><size>10</size><checksum type="sha1">ABCDEF</checksum><url>emu-mac-arm.zip</url></complete>
        <host-os>macosx</host-os><host-arch>aarch64</host-arch>
      </archive>
      <archive>
        <complete><size>11</size><checksum type="sha1">012345</checksum><url>https://mirror.example/emu-linux.zip</url></complete>
        <host-os>linux</host-os>
      </archive>
    </archives>
  </remotePackage>
  <remotePackage path="emulator">
    <revision><major>37</major><minor>0</minor><micro>0</micro></revision>
    <display-name>Emulator canary</display-name>
    <channelRef ref="channel-3"/>
    <archives/>
  </remotePackage>
  <remotePackage path="system-images;android-31;google_apis;arm64-v8a">
    <revision><major>11</major></revision>
    <display-name>Google APIs ARM 64 v8a System Image</display-name>
    <uses-license ref="test-license"/>
    <channelRef ref="channel-0"/>
    <archives>
      <archive><complete><size>99</size><checksum type="sha1">aa</checksum><url>arm64-v8a-31_r11.zip</url></complete></archive>
    </archives>
  </remotePackage>
</sdk:sdk-repository>"#;

    #[test]
    fn parses_packages_archives_and_licenses() {
        let repo = Repository::parse(FIXTURE, "https://dl.example/repo/repository2-3.xml").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(repo.packages.len(), 3);
        assert_eq!(
            repo.licenses["test-license"].text,
            "Line one.\nLine two & more."
        );
        let emu = repo.latest("emulator", 0).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(emu.revision.to_string(), "36.1.2");
        let arc = emu.archive_for("macosx", "aarch64").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(arc.url, "https://dl.example/repo/emu-mac-arm.zip");
        assert_eq!(arc.sha1, "abcdef");
        assert_eq!(
            emu.archive_for("linux", "x64").unwrap().url,
            "https://mirror.example/emu-linux.zip"
        );
        assert!(emu.archive_for("windows", "x64").is_none());
        assert_eq!(repo.latest("emulator", 3).unwrap().revision.major, 37);
        let img = repo
            .latest("system-images;android-31;google_apis;arm64-v8a", 0)
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(img.image.as_ref().unwrap().api, 31);
        assert!(
            img.archive_for("macosx", "aarch64").is_some(),
            "host-less archive matches any host"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn revision_ordering() {
        let r = |s: &str| Revision::parse(s).unwrap();
        assert!(r("36.1.2") > r("36.1.1"));
        assert!(r("36.1.2") > r("36.1.2 rc3"));
        assert!(r("36.1.2 rc4") > r("36.1.2 rc3"));
        assert_eq!(
            r("11"),
            Revision {
                major: 11,
                ..Default::default()
            }
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn bad_xml_is_an_sdk_error() {
        assert_eq!(
            Repository::parse("<nope", "x").unwrap_err().code,
            ErrorCode::Sdk
        );
    }
}

`crates/jidr-sdk/src/sdk.rs`:

```rs
//! Android SDK locations. Jidr installs into its private SDK; Android Studio's
//! SDK is only ever read (D3).

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use jidr_core::{ImageRef, JidrError, JidrPaths, JidrResult};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SdkKind {
    /// `~/Library/Application Support/Jidr/sdk`, owned by Jidr.
    Private,
    /// Android Studio's SDK: read-only.
    StudioReadOnly,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct Sdk {
    pub root: PathBuf,
    pub kind: SdkKind,
}

impl Sdk {
    pub fn private(paths: &JidrPaths) -> Self {
        Self {
            root: paths.sdk(),
            kind: SdkKind::Private,
        }
    }

    /// Android Studio's SDK, if present: `ANDROID_HOME`, `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT`,
    /// then the platform default.
    pub fn studio() -> Option<Self> {
        let candidates = ["ANDROID_HOME", "ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"]
            .iter()
            .filter_map(std::env::var_os)
            .map(PathBuf::from)
            .chain(dirs::home_dir().map(|h| {
                if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
                    h.join("Library/Android/sdk")
                } else {
                    h.join("Android/Sdk")
                }
            }));
        candidates
            .into_iter()
            .find(|p| p.is_dir())
            .map(Self::read_only)
    }

    /// Any SDK root, read-only.
    pub fn read_only(root: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Self {
        Self {
            root: root.into(),
            kind: SdkKind::StudioReadOnly,
        }
    }

    pub fn emulator(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.root.join("emulator/emulator")
    }

    pub fn adb(&self) -> PathBuf {
        self.root.join("platform-tools/adb")
    }

    pub fn has_emulator(&self) -> bool {
        self.emulator().is_file()
    }

    pub fn has_adb(&self) -> bool {
        self.adb().is_file()
    }

    /// Emulator version from `emulator/source.properties`.
    pub fn emulator_version(&self) -> Option<String> {
        read_properties(&self.root.join("emulator/source.properties"))
            .into_iter()
            .find(|(k, _)| k == "Pkg.Revision")
            .map(|(_, v)| v)
    }

    pub fn image_dir(&self, image: &ImageRef) -> PathBuf {
        self.root.join(image.sysdir())
    }

    /// True if the image directory is complete (not an empty or partial install).
    pub fn has_image(&self, image: &ImageRef) -> bool {
        is_complete_image(&self.image_dir(image))
    }

    /// All complete system images in this SDK.
    pub fn installed_images(&self) -> Vec<ImageRef> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        let Ok(apis) = std::fs::read_dir(self.root.join("system-images")) else {
            return out;
        };
        for api_dir in apis.flatten() {
            let name = api_dir.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
            let Some(api) = name.strip_prefix("android-").and_then(|a| a.parse().ok()) else {
                continue;
            };
            for tag in read_dirs(&api_dir.path()) {
                for abi in read_dirs(&tag) {
                    if !is_complete_image(&abi) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if let (Some(t), Some(a)) = (file_name(&tag), file_name(&abi)) {
                        out.push(ImageRef {
                            api,
                            tag: t,
                            abi: a,
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        out.sort();
        out
    }

    /// Refuses writes to an SDK Jidr doesn't own.
    pub fn ensure_writable(&self) -> JidrResult<()> {
        match self.kind {
            SdkKind::Private => Ok(()),
            SdkKind::StudioReadOnly => Err(JidrError::sdk(format!(
                "{} is Android Studio's SDK; Jidr never writes to it",
                self.root.display()
            ))),
        }
    }
}

/// The SDKs Jidr can use: its own, plus Studio's read-only.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SdkSet {
    pub private: Sdk,
    pub studio: Option<Sdk>,
}

impl SdkSet {
    pub fn discover(paths: &JidrPaths) -> Self {
        Self {
            private: Sdk::private(paths),
            studio: Sdk::studio(),
        }
    }

    /// The SDK that provides `emulator` and `adb`: the private one if complete,
    /// else Studio's.
    pub fn tools(&self) -> JidrResult<&Sdk> {
        std::iter::once(&self.private)
            .chain(self.studio.as_ref())
            .find(|s| s.has_emulator() && s.has_adb())
            .ok_or_else(|| JidrError::sdk("no Android emulator installed; run `jidr sdk install`"))
    }

    /// The SDK holding `image`, preferring the private one.
    pub fn find_image(&self, image: &ImageRef) -> Option<&Sdk> {
        std::iter::once(&self.private)
            .chain(self.studio.as_ref())
            .find(|s| s.has_image(image))
    }
}

fn is_complete_image(dir: &Path) -> bool {
    ["source.properties", "system.img", "ramdisk.img"]
        .iter()
        .all(|f| dir.join(f).is_file())
}

fn read_dirs(dir: &Path) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
    std::fs::read_dir(dir)
        .map(|rd| {
            rd.flatten()
                .map(|e| e.path())
                .filter(|p| p.is_dir())
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

fn file_name(p: &Path) -> Option<String> {
    p.file_name().map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
}

/// Reads a Java-style `key=value` properties file; missing file → empty.
pub fn read_properties(path: &Path) -> Vec<(String, String)> {
    std::fs::read_to_string(path)
        .map(|t| {
            t.lines()
                .filter(|l| !l.trim_start().starts_with('#'))
                .filter_map(|l| l.split_once('='))
                .map(|(k, v)| (k.trim().to_string(), v.trim().to_string()))
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn fake_image(root: &Path, image: &ImageRef, complete: bool) {
        let dir = root.join(image.sysdir());
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
        if complete {
            for f in ["source.properties", "system.img", "ramdisk.img"] {
                std::fs::write(dir.join(f), b"x").unwrap();
            }
        }
    }

    fn img(api: u32, tag: &str) -> ImageRef {
        ImageRef {
            api,
            tag: tag.into(),
            abi: "arm64-v8a".into(),
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn lists_only_complete_images() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        fake_image(dir.path(), &img(31, "google_apis"), true);
        fake_image(dir.path(), &img(36, "google_apis"), false);
        let sdk = Sdk::read_only(dir.path());
        assert_eq!(sdk.installed_images(), vec![img(31, "google_apis")]);
        assert!(sdk.has_image(&img(31, "google_apis")));
        assert!(!sdk.has_image(&img(36, "google_apis")));
    }

    #[test]
    fn studio_sdk_is_never_writable() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        assert!(Sdk::read_only(dir.path()).ensure_writable().is_err());
        let paths = JidrPaths::under(dir.path());
        assert!(Sdk::private(&paths).ensure_writable().is_ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn find_image_prefers_private() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let paths = JidrPaths::under(dir.path().join("jidr"));
        let studio = dir.path().join("studio");
        fake_image(&studio, &img(31, "google_apis"), true);
        let set = SdkSet {
            private: Sdk::private(&paths),
            studio: Some(Sdk::read_only(&studio)),
        };
        assert_eq!(
            set.find_image(&img(31, "google_apis")).map(|s| s.kind),
            Some(SdkKind::StudioReadOnly)
        );
        fake_image(&paths.sdk(), &img(31, "google_apis"), true);
        assert_eq!(
            set.find_image(&img(31, "google_apis")).map(|s| s.kind),
            Some(SdkKind::Private)
        );
        assert!(set.tools().is_err());
    }
}

`crates/jidr-sdk/tests/avd_emulator.rs`:

```rs
//! Emulator integration: create → clone → boot the clone → delete, using an
//! image from `JIDR_TEST_SDK` (read-only) and a temp AVD home.
#![cfg(feature = "emulator")]
#![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]

use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::process::{Command, Stdio};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use jidr_core::{ImageRef, JidrPaths};
use jidr_sdk::{AvdManager, AvdSpec, Sdk, SdkSet, profiles};

fn test_sdk() -> PathBuf {
    std::env::var_os("JIDR_TEST_SDK")
        .map(PathBuf::from)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| dirs::home_dir().unwrap().join("Library/Android/sdk"))
}

fn test_image() -> ImageRef {
    let pkg = std::env::var("JIDR_TEST_IMAGE").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        format!(
            "system-images;android-31;google_apis;{}",
            jidr_sdk::host::host_abi()
        )
    });
    ImageRef::parse_package(&pkg).unwrap()
}

fn gpu() -> &'static str {
    if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
        "host"
    } else {
        "swiftshader_indirect"
    }
}

fn free_console_port() -> u16 {
    (5600..5680)
        .step_by(2)
        .find(|p| {
            std::net::TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", *p)).is_ok()
                && std::net::TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", *p + 1)).is_ok()
        })
        .unwrap()
}

#[test]
fn create_clone_boot_delete() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let paths = JidrPaths::under(tmp.path());
    let sdks = SdkSet {
        private: Sdk::private(&paths),
        studio: Some(Sdk::read_only(test_sdk())),
    };
    let image = test_image();
    let sdk = sdks
        .find_image(&image)
        .expect("test image installed in JIDR_TEST_SDK")
        .clone();
    let tools = sdks.tools().unwrap().clone();

    // Per-process names, a guard that kills the clone's emulator however
    // the test ends, and cleanup of orphans from earlier killed runs.
    jidr_backend::testing::kill_orphans("jidr_e2e_clone-");
    let src = jidr_backend::testing::unique_avd("jidr_e2e_src");
    let clone_name = jidr_backend::testing::unique_avd("jidr_e2e_clone");
    let _guard = jidr_backend::testing::AvdGuard::new(&clone_name);
    let avds = AvdManager::new(paths.avd_home());
    let spec = AvdSpec {
        name: src.clone(),
        display_name: "E2E source".into(),
        profile: profiles::find("small-phone-5").unwrap(),
        image: image.clone(),
        overrides: Default::default(),
    };
    avds.create(&spec).unwrap();
    avds.clone_avd(&src, &clone_name, "E2E clone").unwrap();

    let listed = Command::new(tools.emulator())
        .arg("-list-avds")
        .env("ANDROID_AVD_HOME", avds.home())
        .env("ANDROID_SDK_ROOT", &sdk.root)
        .output()
        .unwrap();
    let listed = String::from_utf8_lossy(&listed.stdout);
    assert!(
        listed.contains(src.as_str()) && listed.contains(clone_name.as_str()),
        "{listed}"
    );

    // Boot the clone to prove a cloned AVD is valid.
    let port = free_console_port();
    let serial = format!("emulator-{port}");
    let mut child = Command::new(tools.emulator())
        .args([
            "-avd",
            &clone_name,
            "-no-window",
            "-no-audio",
            "-no-boot-anim",
            "-no-snapshot",
        ])
        .args(["-gpu", gpu(), "-port", &port.to_string()])
        .env("ANDROID_AVD_HOME", avds.home())
        .env("ANDROID_SDK_ROOT", &sdk.root)
        .stdout(Stdio::null())
        .stderr(Stdio::null())
        .spawn()
        .unwrap();
    let adb = |args: &[&str]| {
        Command::new(tools.adb())
            .arg("-s")
            .arg(&serial)
            .args(args)
            .output()
            .map(|o| String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stdout).trim().to_string())
            .unwrap_or_default()
    };
    let start = Instant::now();
    let mut booted = false;
    while start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(300) {
        if adb(&["shell", "getprop", "sys.boot_completed"]) == "1" {
            booted = true;
            break;
        }
        if let Ok(Some(status)) = child.try_wait() {
            panic!("emulator exited early: {status}");
        }
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(2));
    }
    let model = adb(&["shell", "getprop", "ro.product.cpu.abi"]);
    adb(&["emu", "kill"]);
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(30);
    while child.try_wait().ok().flatten().is_none() && Instant::now() < deadline {
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(500));
    }
    let _ = child.kill();
    let _ = child.wait();
    assert!(booted, "clone did not boot within 300 s");
    assert_eq!(model, image.abi);
    println!("clone booted in {:.1} s", start.elapsed().as_secs_f64());

    assert!(avds.disk_usage(&clone_name).unwrap() > 0);
    avds.delete(&src).unwrap();
    avds.delete(&clone_name).unwrap();
    assert!(avds.list().unwrap().is_empty());
}

//! Generates `ui/theme.slint` from `docs/design/tokens.json` (D41: one
//! source, never hand-copied hex) and compiles the Slint UI.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::fmt::Write as _;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use serde_json::Value;

type Res<T> = Result<T, Box<dyn std::error::Error>>;

fn main() -> Res<()> {
    let manifest = PathBuf::from(std::env::var("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")?);
    let design = manifest.join("../../docs/design");
    let tokens = design.join("tokens.json");
    let bundle = design.join("system/components/bundle.css");
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed={}", tokens.display());
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed={}", bundle.display());

    write_if_changed(
        &manifest.join("ui/theme.slint"),
        &generate_theme(&tokens, &bundle)?,
    )?;
    let icons = manifest.join("ui/icons");
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed={}", icons.display());
    write_if_changed(&manifest.join("ui/icons.slint"), &generate_icons(&icons)?)?;

    let config = slint_build::CompilerConfiguration::new().with_style("fluent".into());
    slint_build::compile_with_config(manifest.join("ui/app.slint"), config)?;
    Ok(())
}

fn write_if_changed(path: &Path, text: &str) -> Res<()> {
    if std::fs::read_to_string(path).ok().as_deref() != Some(text) {
        std::fs::write(path, text)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// `export global Icons` with one `@image-url` per Lucide SVG in `ui/icons/`.
fn generate_icons(dir: &Path) -> Res<String> {
    let mut names: Vec<String> = std::fs::read_dir(dir)?
        .filter_map(|e| e.ok())
        .filter_map(|e| {
            e.file_name()
                .to_str()
                .and_then(|n| n.strip_suffix(".svg"))
                .map(str::to_string)
        })
        .collect();
    names.sort();
    let mut s = String::from(
        "// Generated by crates/jidr-ui/build.rs from ui/icons/*.svg (Lucide, ISC). Do not edit.\n\nexport global Icons {\n",
    );
    for n in names {
        writeln!(
            s,
            "    out property <image> {n}: @image-url(\"icons/{n}.svg\");"
        )?;
    }
    s.push_str("}\n");
    Ok(s)
}

/// `jidr-color-surface-raised` → `surface-raised`; other paths keep their
/// group (`jidr-space-sm` → `space-sm`).
fn slint_name(token: &str) -> String {
    let n = token.strip_prefix("jidr-").unwrap_or(token);
    n.strip_prefix("color-").unwrap_or(n).to_string()
}

struct Tokens {
    /// name → (dark, light) raw values.
    themed: BTreeMap<String, (String, String)>,
}

impl Tokens {
    /// Resolves `{jidr-…}` references (one level is all the file uses, but
    /// follow chains anyway).
    fn resolve(&self, v: &str, dark: bool) -> String {
        let mut v = v.to_string();
        for _ in 0..8 {
            let Some(r) = v.strip_prefix('{').and_then(|s| s.strip_suffix('}')) else {
                break;
            };
            match self.themed.get(r) {
                Some((d, l)) => v = if dark { d.clone() } else { l.clone() },
                None => break,
            }
        }
        v
    }
}

fn str_of(v: &Value, key: &str) -> Res<String> {
    v.get(key)
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .map(str::to_string)
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("token without string `{key}`: {v}").into())
}

fn generate_theme(tokens_path: &Path, bundle_css: &Path) -> Res<String> {
    let root: Value = serde_json::from_str(&std::fs::read_to_string(tokens_path)?)?;
    let mut themed = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut plain: Vec<(String, String)> = Vec::new();
    for group in [
        "color", "shadow", "spacing", "radius", "border", "size", "frame", "density", "layout",
        "duration", "easing",
    ] {
        let list = root
            .get(group)
            .and_then(|g| g.get("tokens"))
            .and_then(Value::as_array)
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("tokens.json: no `{group}.tokens`"))?;
        for t in list {
            let name = str_of(t, "name")?;
            match t.get("value") {
                Some(Value::Object(m)) => {
                    let d = m.get("dark").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or_default();
                    let l = m.get("light").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or_default();
                    themed.insert(name, (d.to_string(), l.to_string()));
                }
                Some(Value::String(s)) => plain.push((name, s.clone())),
                _ => return Err(format!("token {name}: unexpected value").into()),
            }
        }
    }
    let tokens = Tokens { themed };
    let reduced = reduced_motion(&std::fs::read_to_string(bundle_css)?);

    let mut s = String::new();
    let mut easings = String::new();
    writeln!(
        s,
        "// Generated by crates/jidr-ui/build.rs from docs/design/tokens.json. Do not edit."
    )?;
    writeln!(
        s,
        "// Dark and light values side by side; `dark` picks one."
    )?;
    writeln!(s)?;
    writeln!(s, "export global Theme {{")?;
    writeln!(s, "    in-out property <bool> dark: true;")?;
    writeln!(
        s,
        "    /// Mirrors layouts for right-to-left scripts (D33). Logcat, code and the Android screen never mirror."
    )?;
    writeln!(s, "    in-out property <bool> rtl: false;")?;
    writeln!(
        s,
        "    /// macOS Reduce Motion: motion-* durations switch to their reduced values."
    )?;
    writeln!(s, "    in-out property <bool> reduce-motion: false;")?;
    writeln!(s)?;

    for (name, (d, l)) in &tokens.themed {
        let id = slint_name(name);
        if name.ends_with("-shadow") {
            let (dy, blur, dc) = parse_shadow(&tokens.resolve(d, true))?;
            let (ly, lblur, lc) = parse_shadow(&tokens.resolve(l, false))?;
            writeln!(
                s,
                "    out property <length> {id}-y: dark ? {dy} : {ly};\n    out property <length> {id}-blur: dark ? {blur} : {lblur};\n    out property <color> {id}-color: dark ? {dc} : {lc};"
            )?;
            continue;
        }
        let dv = color(&tokens.resolve(d, true))?;
        let lv = color(&tokens.resolve(l, false))?;
        writeln!(s, "    out property <color> {id}: dark ? {dv} : {lv};")?;
    }
    writeln!(s)?;
    for (name, v) in &plain {
        let id = slint_name(name);
        if let Some(ms) = v.strip_suffix("ms") {
            match reduced.get(name.as_str()) {
                Some(r) => writeln!(
                    s,
                    "    out property <duration> {id}: reduce-motion ? {r} : {ms}ms;"
                )?,
                None => writeln!(s, "    out property <duration> {id}: {ms}ms;")?,
            }
        } else if v.ends_with("px") {
            match reduced.get(name.as_str()) {
                Some(r) => writeln!(
                    s,
                    "    out property <length> {id}: reduce-motion ? {r} : {v};"
                )?,
                None => writeln!(s, "    out property <length> {id}: {v};")?,
            }
        } else if v.starts_with("cubic-bezier(") {
            // Easing can't cross into Rust, so it lives in its own global.
            writeln!(easings, "    out property <easing> {id}: {v};")?;
        } else {
            return Err(format!("token {name}: unknown unit in {v}").into());
        }
    }
    writeln!(s)?;

    let families = root
        .get("type")
        .and_then(|t| t.get("families"))
        .ok_or("tokens.json: no type.families")?;
    for key in ["ui", "mono", "arabic"] {
        let stack = str_of(families, key)?;
        let first = stack
            .split(',')
            .next()
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .trim()
            .trim_matches('"');
        writeln!(s, "    out property <string> font-{key}: \"{first}\";")?;
    }
    let groups = root
        .get("type")
        .and_then(|t| t.get("groups"))
        .and_then(Value::as_array)
        .ok_or("tokens.json: no type.groups")?;
    for g in groups {
        let gfamily = str_of(g, "family")?;
        for st in g
            .get("styles")
            .and_then(Value::as_array)
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
        {
            let id = str_of(st, "name")?;
            let family = st
                .get("family")
                .and_then(Value::as_str)
                .unwrap_or(&gfamily)
                .to_string();
            let weight = st.get("fontWeight").and_then(Value::as_i64).unwrap_or(400);
            writeln!(
                s,
                "    out property <length> {id}-size: {};\n    out property <length> {id}-line-height: {};\n    out property <int> {id}-weight: {weight};\n    out property <length> {id}-letter-spacing: {};\n    out property <string> {id}-family: font-{family};",
                str_of(st, "fontSize")?,
                str_of(st, "lineHeight")?,
                str_of(st, "letterSpacing")?,
            )?;
        }
    }
    writeln!(s, "}}")?;
    writeln!(s)?;
    writeln!(s, "export global Easing {{")?;
    s.push_str(&easings);
    writeln!(s, "}}")?;
    Ok(s)
}

/// `#rrggbb` / `#rrggbbaa` → a Slint colour literal (validated).
fn color(v: &str) -> Res<String> {
    let hex = v
        .strip_prefix('#')
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("not a colour: {v}"))?;
    if !(hex.len() == 6 || hex.len() == 8) || !hex.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
        return Err(format!("not a colour: {v}").into());
    }
    Ok(format!("#{}", hex.to_ascii_lowercase()))
}

/// `0px 6px 16px 0px #12151A24` → (y, blur, colour).
fn parse_shadow(v: &str) -> Res<(String, String, String)> {
    let parts: Vec<&str> = v.split_whitespace().collect();
    match parts.as_slice() {
        [_x, y, blur, _spread, c] => Ok((y.to_string(), blur.to_string(), color(c)?)),
        _ => Err(format!("bad shadow: {v}").into()),
    }
}

/// The `prefers-reduced-motion` overrides from the generated `bundle.css`.
fn reduced_motion(css: &str) -> BTreeMap<String, String> {
    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
    let Some(start) = css.find("prefers-reduced-motion: reduce") else {
        return out;
    };
    let block = &css[start..];
    let end = block.find("}\n}").unwrap_or(block.len());
    for line in block[..end].lines() {
        let line = line.trim().trim_end_matches(';');
        if let Some((k, v)) = line.split_once(':')
            && let Some(name) = k.trim().strip_prefix("--")
        {
            out.insert(name.to_string(), v.trim().to_string());
        }
    }
    out
}

`crates/jidr-ui/examples/snapshot.rs`:

```rs
//! Golden snapshots of every screen and state, in dark, light and RTL.
//!
//! ```text
//! cargo run -p jidr-ui --example snapshot -- --check     # compare with tests/golden
//! cargo run -p jidr-ui --example snapshot -- --update    # rewrite the goldens
//! cargo run -p jidr-ui --example snapshot -- --only launcher
//! ```
//! Renders with Slint's software renderer, so it runs headless and the same
//! everywhere. Failures write `<target>/snapshots/<name>.png` for review.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::ExitCode;

use jidr_ui::goldens::{Variant, cases};
use jidr_ui::offscreen;

/// A channel may drift this much (font hinting, rounding)…
const TOLERANCE: u8 = 24;
/// …and this share of pixels may differ before a case fails.
const BUDGET: f64 = 0.002;

fn main() -> ExitCode {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();
    let update = args.iter().any(|a| a == "--update");
    let only = args
        .iter()
        .position(|a| a == "--only")
        .and_then(|i| args.get(i + 1))
        .cloned();
    let golden = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("tests/golden");
    let out = std::env::var_os("CARGO_TARGET_DIR")
        .map(PathBuf::from)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../target"))
        .join("snapshots");

    if let Err(e) = offscreen::init() {
        eprintln!("snapshot: {e}");
        return ExitCode::FAILURE;
    }
    let mut failed = Vec::new();
    let mut count = 0;
    for case in cases() {
        if only.as_deref().is_some_and(|o| !case.name.contains(o)) {
            continue;
        }
        for variant in Variant::ALL {
            let name = format!("{}.{}", case.name, variant.suffix());
            let buf = match (case.render)(variant) {
                Ok(b) => b,
                Err(e) => {
                    eprintln!("✗ {name}: render failed: {e}");
                    failed.push(name);
                    continue;
                }
            };
            count += 1;
            let path = golden.join(format!("{name}.png"));
            if update {
                if let Err(e) = offscreen::write_png(&path, &buf) {
                    eprintln!("✗ {name}: {e}");
                    failed.push(name);
                }
                continue;
            }
            let verdict = offscreen::read_png(&path).map(|(w, h, px)| {
                if (w, h) != (buf.width(), buf.height()) {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "size {}×{} vs golden {w}×{h}",
                        buf.width(),
                        buf.height()
                    ));
                }
                let d = offscreen::diff(buf.as_bytes(), &px, TOLERANCE);
                if d.ratio() > BUDGET {
                    Err(format!(
                        "{} of {} pixels differ ({:.2}%)",
                        d.differing,
                        d.total,
                        d.ratio() * 100.0
                    ))
                } else {
                    Ok(())
                }
            });
            match verdict {
                Ok(Ok(())) => println!("✓ {name}"),
                Ok(Err(why)) | Err(why) => {
                    let actual = out.join(format!("{name}.png"));
                    let _ = offscreen::write_png(&actual, &buf);
                    eprintln!("✗ {name}: {why}; actual: {}", actual.display());
                    failed.push(name);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if update {
        println!("updated {count} goldens in {}", golden.display());
    }
    if failed.is_empty() {
        println!("snapshot: {count} renders ok");
        ExitCode::SUCCESS
    } else {
        eprintln!(
            "snapshot: {} of {count} failed (rerun with --update after reviewing)",
            failed.len()
        );
        ExitCode::FAILURE
    }
}

`crates/jidr-ui/src/app.rs`:

```rs
//! The running app: wires `AppWindow` callbacks to daemon calls and pushes
//! daemon data back into the view models. View state (selection, tabs,
//! theme) stays here (plan: UI-only state is not a protocol command).

use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::rc::Rc;

use jidr_core::{JidrPaths, JidrResult};
use serde_json::Value;
use slint::{ComponentHandle, ModelRc, VecModel, Weak};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::bridge::{Bridge, Conn, Data, Update};
use crate::model::{self, Clock};
use crate::{AppWindow, ConnState, Theme};

/// UI-thread state.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct State {
    pub data: Data,
    pub selected: Option<Uuid>,
    pub tabs: Vec<Uuid>,
    pub active: Option<usize>,
}

pub type Shared = Rc<RefCell<State>>;

/// System appearance (macOS `AppleInterfaceStyle`).
pub fn system_dark() -> bool {
    std::process::Command::new("defaults")
        .args(["read", "-g", "AppleInterfaceStyle"])
        .output()
        .map(|o| String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stdout).trim() == "Dark")
        .unwrap_or(true)
}

/// macOS Reduce Motion.
pub fn system_reduce_motion() -> bool {
    std::process::Command::new("defaults")
        .args(["read", "com.apple.universalaccess", "reduceMotion"])
        .output()
        .map(|o| String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stdout).trim() == "1")
        .unwrap_or(false)
}

/// Pushes `state` into the window's models.
pub fn render(app: &AppWindow, state: &State) {
    let clock = Clock::system();
    let vms: Vec<_> = state
        .data
        .devices
        .iter()
        .map(|i| model::device_vm(i, &clock))
        .collect();
    let selected = state
        .selected
        .and_then(|id| state.data.devices.iter().position(|d| d.device.id == id))
        .or(if vms.is_empty() { None } else { Some(0) });
    let tabs: Vec<_> = state
        .tabs
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|id| vms.iter().find(|v| v.id == id.to_string().as_str()))
        .map(model::tab_vm)
        .collect();
    let jobs: Vec<_> = state
        .data
        .jobs
        .iter()
        .filter(|j| {
            j.kind == "image.install" || j.kind == "sdk.install" || j.kind.starts_with("root.")
        })
        .map(|j| {
            // B5: real bytes while the daemon reports a download.
            let bytes = j.bytes.map(|b| (b.done, b.total));
            model::job_vm(j, &job_title(j), bytes, None)
        })
        .collect();
    app.set_devices(ModelRc::new(VecModel::from(vms)));
    app.set_jobs(ModelRc::new(VecModel::from(jobs)));
    app.set_tabs(ModelRc::new(VecModel::from(tabs)));
    app.set_selected(selected.map(|i| i as i32).unwrap_or(-1));
    app.set_active_tab(state.active.map(|i| i as i32).unwrap_or(-1));
    let active_device = state
        .active
        .and_then(|i| state.tabs.get(i))
        .and_then(|id| state.data.devices.iter().position(|d| d.device.id == *id));
    app.set_active_device(active_device.map(|i| i as i32).unwrap_or(-1));
    app.set_sdk_ready(state.data.sdk_ready);
}

fn job_title(j: &jidr_core::Job) -> String {
    match j.kind.as_str() {
        "image.install" | "sdk.install" => {
            if j.message.is_empty() {
                "Downloading".into()
            } else {
                j.message.clone()
            }
        }
        k if k.starts_with("root.") => "Setting up root".into(),
        k => k.to_string(),
    }
}

/// Shows a toast for a few seconds.
pub fn toast(weak: &Weak<AppWindow>, text: String) {
    let weak = weak.clone();
    let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
        if let Some(app) = weak.upgrade() {
            app.set_toast(text.clone().into());
            let w = app.as_weak();
            slint::Timer::single_shot(std::time::Duration::from_secs(4), move || {
                if let Some(app) = w.upgrade()
                    && app.get_toast() == text.as_str()
                {
                    app.set_toast("".into());
                }
            });
        }
    });
}

/// Toast an error, or a confirmation on success.
pub fn report(
    weak: &Weak<AppWindow>,
    ok: impl Into<String>,
) -> impl FnOnce(JidrResult<Value>) + Send + 'static {
    let weak = weak.clone();
    let ok = ok.into();
    move |r| match r {
        Ok(_) if !ok.is_empty() => toast(&weak, ok),
        Ok(_) => {}
        Err(e) => toast(&weak, e.message),
    }
}

/// Everything the UI-thread controllers share.
pub struct Ctx {
    pub app: AppWindow,
    pub bridge: std::sync::Arc<Bridge>,
    pub state: Shared,
    pub paths: JidrPaths,
    pub prefs: RefCell<crate::settings::Prefs>,
    /// Secondary windows (setup, settings) kept alive while shown.
    pub windows: RefCell<Vec<Box<dyn std::any::Any>>>,
    /// Catalog for the create sheet, loaded when it opens.
    pub catalog: RefCell<Catalog>,
    /// What the confirmation dialog will do.
    pub pending_confirm: RefCell<Option<Box<dyn Fn()>>>,
    /// The device window's live session.
    pub player: RefCell<crate::player::Player>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Catalog {
    pub profiles: Vec<jidr_core::HardwareProfile>,
    pub images: Vec<jidr_core::SystemImage>,
    /// Device being edited.
    pub editing: Option<Uuid>,
}

impl Ctx {
    pub fn device_id(&self, index: i32) -> Option<Uuid> {
        let st = self.state.borrow();
        usize::try_from(index)
            .ok()
            .and_then(|i| st.data.devices.get(i))
            .map(|d| d.device.id)
    }

    pub fn info(&self, id: Uuid) -> Option<crate::model::DeviceInfo> {
        self.state
            .borrow()
            .data
            .devices
            .iter()
            .find(|d| d.device.id == id)
            .cloned()
    }

    pub fn rerender(self: &Rc<Self>) {
        render(&self.app, &self.state.borrow());
        crate::player::sync(self);
        crate::root::sync(self);
    }

    /// Applies the Appearance pref (System follows macOS).
    pub fn apply_appearance(&self) {
        let dark = match self.prefs.borrow().appearance {
            1 => false,
            2 => true,
            _ => system_dark(),
        };
        self.app.global::<Theme>().set_dark(dark);
    }
}

thread_local! {
    /// The UI thread's state; IO-thread updates reach it via the event loop.
    static STATE: Shared = Rc::default();
    /// The controllers' context, once the app runs.
    static CTX: RefCell<Option<Rc<Ctx>>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
}

/// The running app's context (UI thread only).
pub fn ctx() -> Option<Rc<Ctx>> {
    CTX.with(|c| c.borrow().clone())
}

/// The UI thread's shared state.
pub fn state() -> Shared {
    STATE.with(Rc::clone)
}

/// Feeds bridge updates into the window (called on the IO thread).
pub fn sink(weak: Weak<AppWindow>) -> impl Fn(Update) + Send + Sync + 'static {
    move |u: Update| {
        let weak = weak.clone();
        let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
            let Some(app) = weak.upgrade() else { return };
            match u {
                Update::Conn(conn) => {
                    if matches!(conn, Conn::Online)
                        && let Some(c) = ctx()
                    {
                        crate::settings::sync_from_daemon(&c);
                    }
                    let (s, text) = match conn {
                        Conn::Connecting => (
                            ConnState::Connecting,
                            "Connecting to the daemon…".to_string(),
                        ),
                        Conn::Online => (ConnState::Online, String::new()),
                        Conn::Reconnecting(t) => (ConnState::Reconnecting, t),
                    };
                    app.set_conn(s);
                    app.set_conn_text(text.into());
                }
                Update::Data(data) => {
                    let state = state();
                    let mut st = state.borrow_mut();
                    let ids: Vec<Uuid> = data.devices.iter().map(|d| d.device.id).collect();
                    st.tabs.retain(|t| ids.contains(t));
                    if st.active.is_some_and(|a| a >= st.tabs.len()) {
                        st.active = None;
                    }
                    st.data = data;
                    render(&app, &st);
                    drop(st);
                    if let Some(c) = ctx() {
                        crate::player::sync(&c);
                    }
                }
                Update::Event(_) => {}
            }
        });
    }
}

/// Starts the GUI: native window, theme from the system, daemon connection.
pub fn run() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    select_backend()?;
    let app = AppWindow::new()?;
    app.set_draw_lights(!cfg!(target_os = "macos"));
    app.global::<Theme>()
        .set_reduce_motion(system_reduce_motion());

    let paths = JidrPaths::discover()?;
    let bridge = Bridge::new()?;
    let ctx = Rc::new(Ctx {
        app: app.clone_strong(),
        bridge: bridge.clone(),
        state: state(),
        prefs: RefCell::new(crate::settings::Prefs::load(&paths.data)),
        paths: paths.clone(),
        windows: RefCell::default(),
        catalog: RefCell::default(),
        pending_confirm: RefCell::default(),
        player: RefCell::default(),
    });
    CTX.with(|c| *c.borrow_mut() = Some(ctx.clone()));
    ctx.apply_appearance();
    crate::launcher::wire(&ctx);
    crate::player::wire(&ctx);
    crate::widgets::wire(&ctx);
    crate::snapshots::wire(&ctx);
    crate::root::wire(&ctx);
    auto_open(&ctx);
    bridge.connect(paths, sink(app.as_weak()));
    app.run()?;
    Ok(())
}

/// Dev hook: `JIDR_PLAYER_DEVICE=<name>` opens that device's tab (starting
/// it if needed) once the daemon's device list arrives.
fn auto_open(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    let Ok(name) = std::env::var("JIDR_PLAYER_DEVICE") else {
        return;
    };
    let c = ctx.clone();
    let timer = slint::Timer::default();
    let started = std::cell::Cell::new(false);
    timer.start(
        slint::TimerMode::Repeated,
        std::time::Duration::from_millis(500),
        move || {
            let found = c
                .state
                .borrow()
                .data
                .devices
                .iter()
                .find(|d| d.device.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&name))
                .map(|d| (d.device.id, d.device.status.clone()));
            let Some((id, status)) = found else { return };
            if c.state.borrow().tabs.contains(&id) {
                return;
            }
            if matches!(status, jidr_core::DeviceStatus::Stopped) && !started.get() {
                started.set(true);
                crate::launcher::start(&c, id);
            }
            crate::launcher::open_tab(&c, id);
        },
    );
    ctx.windows.borrow_mut().push(Box::new(timer));
}

fn select_backend() -> Result<(), slint::PlatformError> {
    let selector = slint::BackendSelector::new().backend_name("winit".into());
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    let selector = selector.with_winit_window_attributes_hook(|attrs| {
        use slint::winit_030::winit::platform::macos::WindowAttributesExtMacOS;
        attrs
            .with_titlebar_transparent(true)
            .with_fullsize_content_view(true)
            .with_title_hidden(true)
    });
    selector.select()
}

/// A UI-thread continuation waiting for a value from the IO thread.
pub type Token = u64;

type Continuation = Box<dyn FnOnce(Box<dyn std::any::Any + Send>)>;

thread_local! {
    static PENDING: RefCell<(Token, std::collections::HashMap<Token, Continuation>)> =
        RefCell::new((0, std::collections::HashMap::new()));
}

/// Parks `f` (which may hold UI-thread values such as `Rc<Ctx>`) and
/// returns a `Send` token; `fire(token, value)` runs it on the UI thread.
pub fn defer<T: Send + 'static>(f: impl FnOnce(T) + 'static) -> Token {
    PENDING.with(|p| {
        let mut p = p.borrow_mut();
        p.0 += 1;
        let token = p.0;
        p.1.insert(
            token,
            Box::new(move |v: Box<dyn std::any::Any + Send>| {
                if let Ok(v) = v.downcast::<T>() {
                    f(*v);
                }
            }),
        );
        token
    })
}

/// Runs a deferred continuation on the UI thread (callable from any thread).
pub fn fire<T: Send + 'static>(token: Token, value: T) {
    let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
        let f = PENDING.with(|p| p.borrow_mut().1.remove(&token));
        if let Some(f) = f {
            f(Box::new(value));
        }
    });
}

`crates/jidr-ui/src/bridge.rs`:

```rs
//! The GUI's only link to the daemon: a `jidr-client` connection on its own
//! tokio runtime, with events, a health check and reconnect. The UI thread
//! never blocks on it; results come back through callbacks.

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap, HashSet};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::Duration;

use jidr_client::{Client, SpawnOptions};
use jidr_core::{Device, HardwareProfile, JidrError, JidrPaths, JidrResult, Job};
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::model::DeviceInfo;

/// How often to check that the daemon is still there.
const HEALTH_EVERY: Duration = Duration::from_secs(3);
/// Wait between reconnect attempts.
const RETRY_EVERY: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2);

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Conn {
    Connecting,
    Online,
    Reconnecting(String),
}

/// Daemon data the launcher shows, gathered after each change.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct Data {
    pub devices: Vec<DeviceInfo>,
    pub jobs: Vec<Job>,
    pub sdk_ready: bool,
}

pub enum Update {
    Conn(Conn),
    Data(Data),
    /// A raw event, for views that follow one device (player, logcat).
    Event(jidr_core::rpc::Event),
}

type Sink = Arc<dyn Fn(Update) + Send + Sync>;

#[derive(Default)]
struct Cache {
    details: HashMap<Uuid, Value>,
    profiles: BTreeMap<String, HardwareProfile>,
    boot: HashMap<Uuid, f32>,
}

pub struct Bridge {
    rt: tokio::runtime::Runtime,
    client: Arc<tokio::sync::RwLock<Option<Arc<Client>>>>,
    /// Jobs this window started (others holding a device mean Busy).
    mine: Arc<Mutex<HashSet<Uuid>>>,
}

impl std::fmt::Debug for Bridge {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        f.debug_struct("Bridge").finish_non_exhaustive()
    }
}

impl Bridge {
    pub fn new() -> JidrResult<Arc<Self>> {
        let rt = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_multi_thread()
            .worker_threads(2)
            .enable_all()
            .thread_name("jidr-ui-io")
            .build()
            .map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(format!("tokio runtime: {e}")))?;
        Ok(Arc::new(Self {
            rt,
            client: Arc::default(),
            mine: Arc::default(),
        }))
    }

    pub fn handle(&self) -> tokio::runtime::Handle {
        self.rt.handle().clone()
    }

    /// Connects (starting the daemon if needed, D4) and keeps reconnecting
    /// for the life of the app.
    pub fn connect(
        self: &Arc<Self>,
        paths: JidrPaths,
        sink: impl Fn(Update) + Send + Sync + 'static,
    ) {
        let opts = SpawnOptions {
            restart_stale: true,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        self.connect_with(paths, opts, sink);
    }

    /// `connect` with explicit spawn options (tests point `program` at a
    /// binary that doesn't exist so nothing is spawned).
    pub fn connect_with(
        self: &Arc<Self>,
        paths: JidrPaths,
        opts: SpawnOptions,
        sink: impl Fn(Update) + Send + Sync + 'static,
    ) {
        let sink: Sink = Arc::new(sink);
        let me = self.clone();
        self.rt.spawn(async move {
            let mut cache = Cache::default();
            let mut first = true;
            loop {
                sink(Update::Conn(if first {
                    Conn::Connecting
                } else {
                    Conn::Reconnecting("Reconnecting to the daemon…".into())
                }));
                first = false;
                match Client::connect_or_spawn(&paths, "gui", &opts).await {
                    Ok(c) => {
                        let c = Arc::new(c);
                        *me.client.write().await = Some(c.clone());
                        sink(Update::Conn(Conn::Online));
                        if let Err(e) = me.session(&c, &sink, &mut cache).await {
                            tracing::warn!("daemon session ended: {e}");
                        }
                        *me.client.write().await = None;
                    }
                    Err(e) => tracing::warn!("cannot reach the daemon: {e}"),
                }
                tokio::time::sleep(RETRY_EVERY).await;
            }
        });
    }

    /// One connected session: subscribe, load, then follow events until the
    /// health check fails.
    async fn session(&self, c: &Arc<Client>, sink: &Sink, cache: &mut Cache) -> JidrResult<()> {
        let mut events = c.subscribe(&["device.", "job."]).await?;
        cache.details.clear();
        if let Ok(p) = c
            .call_as::<_, Vec<HardwareProfile>>("profile.list", json!({}))
            .await
        {
            cache.profiles = p.into_iter().map(|p| (p.id.clone(), p)).collect();
        }
        sink(Update::Data(self.load(c, cache).await?));
        let mut health = tokio::time::interval(HEALTH_EVERY);
        loop {
            tokio::select! {
                ev = events.recv() => match ev {
                    Ok(ev) => {
                        let reload = self.note(&ev, cache);
                        sink(Update::Event(ev));
                        if reload {
                            // Coalesce bursts (boot progress, job progress).
                            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(80)).await;
                            while let Ok(ev) = events.try_recv() {
                                self.note(&ev, cache);
                                sink(Update::Event(ev));
                            }
                            sink(Update::Data(self.load(c, cache).await?));
                        }
                    }
                    Err(tokio::sync::broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(_)) => {
                        sink(Update::Data(self.load(c, cache).await?));
                    }
                    Err(e) => return Err(JidrError::unexpected(format!("events: {e}"))),
                },
                _ = health.tick() => {
                    c.call("daemon.status", json!({})).await?;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Updates the cache from an event; true when the launcher should reload.
    fn note(&self, ev: &jidr_core::rpc::Event, cache: &mut Cache) -> bool {
        let device = ev
            .data
            .get("device")
            .and_then(Value::as_str)
            .and_then(|s| Uuid::parse_str(s).ok());
        match ev.topic.as_str() {
            "device.boot" => {
                if let (Some(d), Some(p)) =
                    (device, ev.data.get("progress").and_then(Value::as_f64))
                {
                    cache.boot.insert(d, p as f32);
                }
                true
            }
            "device.created" | "device.updated" | "device.deleted" => {
                if let Some(d) = device {
                    cache.details.remove(&d);
                }
                true
            }
            t => t.starts_with("device.") || t.starts_with("job."),
        }
    }

    async fn load(&self, c: &Client, cache: &mut Cache) -> JidrResult<Data> {
        let devices: Vec<Device> = c.call_as("device.list", json!({})).await?;
        let jobs: Vec<Job> = c.call_as("jobs.list", json!({})).await.unwrap_or_default();
        let sdk_ready = c
            .call("sdk.status", json!({}))
            .await
            .map(|v| sdk_has_tools(&v))
            .unwrap_or(false);
        let mine = self.mine.lock().map(|m| m.clone()).unwrap_or_default();
        let mut infos = Vec::with_capacity(devices.len());
        for d in devices {
            if !cache.details.contains_key(&d.id)
                && let Ok(v) = c.call("device.details", json!({ "device": d.id })).await
            {
                cache.details.insert(d.id, v);
            }
            let mut info = DeviceInfo::new(d.clone());
            if let Some(det) = cache.details.get(&d.id) {
                apply_details(&mut info, det);
            }
            if let Some(p) = cache.profiles.get(&d.profile) {
                info.profile_name = Some(p.name.clone());
                if info.width == 0 {
                    (info.width, info.height, info.density) = (p.width, p.height, p.density);
                }
                if info.ram_mb == 0 {
                    (info.ram_mb, info.cpus) = (p.ram_mb, p.cpus);
                }
            }
            if matches!(
                d.status,
                jidr_core::DeviceStatus::Booting | jidr_core::DeviceStatus::Starting
            ) {
                info.boot_progress = cache.boot.get(&d.id).copied();
            } else {
                cache.boot.remove(&d.id);
            }
            let holding: Vec<&Job> = jobs
                .iter()
                .filter(|j| j.device == Some(d.id) && !j.state.is_terminal())
                .collect();
            info.root_job = holding.iter().any(|j| j.kind.starts_with("root."));
            if holding
                .iter()
                .any(|j| !mine.contains(&j.id) && j.kind != "device.start")
            {
                info.busy_holder = Some("another client".into());
            }
            infos.push(info);
        }
        Ok(Data {
            devices: infos,
            jobs,
            sdk_ready,
        })
    }

    /// Runs a call off the UI thread; `done` gets the result (on the IO thread).
    pub fn call(
        &self,
        method: &str,
        params: Value,
        done: impl FnOnce(JidrResult<Value>) + Send + 'static,
    ) {
        let client = self.client.clone();
        let method = method.to_string();
        self.rt.spawn(async move {
            let c = client.read().await.clone();
            let r = match c {
                Some(c) => c.call(&method, params).await,
                None => Err(JidrError::unexpected("not connected to the daemon")),
            };
            done(r);
        });
    }

    /// Calls a long-running command and follows its job to the end.
    pub fn run(
        &self,
        method: &str,
        params: Value,
        progress: impl Fn(&Job) + Send + Sync + 'static,
        done: impl FnOnce(JidrResult<Value>) + Send + 'static,
    ) {
        let client = self.client.clone();
        let mine = self.mine.clone();
        let method = method.to_string();
        self.rt.spawn(async move {
            let Some(c) = client.read().await.clone() else {
                done(Err(JidrError::unexpected("not connected to the daemon")));
                return;
            };
            let first = match c.call(&method, params).await {
                Ok(v) => v,
                Err(e) => return done(Err(e)),
            };
            let Some(job) = jidr_client::pending_job(&first) else {
                return done(Ok(first));
            };
            if let Ok(mut m) = mine.lock() {
                m.insert(job);
            }
            let r = loop {
                match c.wait_job(job, Some(Duration::from_secs(1))).await {
                    Ok(j) => {
                        progress(&j);
                        match j.state {
                            jidr_core::JobState::Succeeded => {
                                break Ok(j.result.unwrap_or(Value::Null));
                            }
                            jidr_core::JobState::Failed => {
                                break Err(j.error.unwrap_or_else(|| {
                                    JidrError::unexpected(format!("{method} failed"))
                                }));
                            }
                            jidr_core::JobState::Cancelled => {
                                break Err(jidr_core::cancel::cancelled());
                            }
                            _ => {}
                        }
                    }
                    Err(e) => break Err(e),
                }
            };
            if let Ok(mut m) = mine.lock() {
                m.remove(&job);
            }
            done(r);
        });
    }

    /// The current client, for views that stream (logcat).
    pub fn client(&self) -> Option<Arc<Client>> {
        self.rt.block_on(async { self.client.read().await.clone() })
    }
}

/// `sdk.status` names the SDK whose emulator it would use; without one
/// (and without an image) Jidr still needs setting up (first run).
pub fn sdk_has_tools(v: &Value) -> bool {
    v.get("tools_sdk").is_some_and(|e| !e.is_null())
        && v.get("installed_images")
            .and_then(Value::as_array)
            .is_some_and(|a| !a.is_empty())
}

/// Screen and hardware from `device.details` (config.ini) and disk usage.
fn apply_details(info: &mut DeviceInfo, det: &Value) {
    let cfg = det.get("config");
    let num = |k: &str| -> u32 {
        cfg.and_then(|c| c.get(k))
            .and_then(Value::as_str)
            .and_then(|s| s.trim_end_matches(['M', 'B']).parse().ok())
            .unwrap_or(0)
    };
    info.width = num("hw.lcd.width");
    info.height = num("hw.lcd.height");
    info.density = num("hw.lcd.density");
    info.ram_mb = num("hw.ramSize");
    info.cpus = num("hw.cpu.ncore");
    info.disk_bytes = det.get("disk_usage").and_then(Value::as_u64);
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn details_fill_screen_and_hardware() {
        let det = json!({
            "config": {"hw.lcd.width": "1080", "hw.lcd.height": "2400", "hw.lcd.density": "420",
                       "hw.ramSize": "4096M", "hw.cpu.ncore": "4"},
            "disk_usage": 6_800_000_000u64
        });
        let d: Device = serde_json::from_value(json!({
            "id": Uuid::nil(), "name": "p", "avd": "p", "profile": "phone-6.1-fhd",
            "image": {"api": 35, "tag": "google_apis", "abi": "arm64-v8a"},
            "sdk_root": "/sdk", "created_at": "2026-10-13T00:00:00Z"
        }))
        .unwrap();
        let mut info = DeviceInfo::new(d);
        apply_details(&mut info, &det);
        assert_eq!((info.width, info.height, info.density), (1080, 2400, 420));
        assert_eq!((info.ram_mb, info.cpus), (4096, 4));
        assert_eq!(info.disk_bytes, Some(6_800_000_000));
    }
}
