`crates/jidr-ui/src/device_form/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! Create / edit device form: options from `profile.list` and `image.list`,
//! defaults (D7), validation, and the `device.create` / `device.edit` params.

use jidr_core::{HardwareProfile, Job, Support, SystemImage};
use serde_json::{Map, Value, json};

use crate::model::{self, DeviceInfo};
use crate::{DeviceForm, ImageRowVm, OptionVm, RootChoice};

/// Images users can pick: supported or best-effort API levels (D23),
/// newest first, Google APIs before Play Store before AOSP.
pub fn sorted_images(images: &[SystemImage]) -> Vec<SystemImage> {
    let mut v: Vec<SystemImage> = images
        .iter()
        .filter(|i| i.support != Support::Unsupported)
        .cloned()
        .collect();
    let tag_rank = |t: &str| match t {
        "google_apis" => 0,
        "google_apis_playstore" => 1,
        "default" => 2,
        _ => 3,
    };
    v.sort_by(|a, b| {
        b.image
            .api
            .cmp(&a.image.api)
            .then(tag_rank(&a.image.tag).cmp(&tag_rank(&b.image.tag)))
    });
    v
}

/// A running `image.install` job for this package, if any.
fn install_job<'a>(img: &SystemImage, jobs: &'a [Job]) -> Option<&'a Job> {
    jobs.iter().find(|j| {
        !j.state.is_terminal()
            && (j.kind == "image.install" || j.kind == "sdk.install")
            && j.message.contains(&img.image.package())
    })
}

pub fn image_label(img: &SystemImage) -> String {
    format!(
        "{} · {}",
        model::android_label(img.image.api),
        model::image_tag(&img.image)
    )
}

pub fn image_rows(images: &[SystemImage], jobs: &[Job]) -> Vec<ImageRowVm> {
    images
        .iter()
        .map(|img| {
            let installed = img.installed_in.is_some();
            let job = install_job(img, jobs);
            let status = match (installed, job) {
                (true, _) => format!("Installed · {}", size_or_dash(img.size)),
                (false, Some(j)) => match j.progress {
                    Some(p) if img.size > 0 => format!(
                        "Downloading · {:.1} / {}",
                        f64::from(p) * img.size as f64 / 1e9,
                        model::gb(img.size)
                    ),
                    _ => "Downloading…".into(),
                },
                (false, None) => format!("Download · {}", size_or_dash(img.size)),
            };
            ImageRowVm {
                package: img.image.package().into(),
                label: image_label(img).into(),
                status: status.into(),
                installed,
                enabled: job.is_none(),
                play_store: !img.image.allows_adb_root(),
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

fn size_or_dash(bytes: u64) -> String {
    if bytes > 0 {
        model::gb(bytes)
    } else {
        "size unknown".into()
    }
}

pub fn profile_options(profiles: &[HardwareProfile]) -> Vec<OptionVm> {
    profiles
        .iter()
        .map(|p| OptionVm {
            id: p.id.clone().into(),
            label: format!("{} · {}×{}", p.name, p.width, p.height).into(),
        })
        .collect()
}

/// A free "Pixel-ish 6.1"-style name: the profile name, numbered if taken.
pub fn free_name(base: &str, taken: &[String]) -> String {
    let base = base.replace('″', "");
    if !taken.iter().any(|t| t.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&base)) {
        return base;
    }
    (2..)
        .map(|n| format!("{base} {n}"))
        .find(|n| !taken.iter().any(|t| t.eq_ignore_ascii_case(n)))
        .unwrap_or(base)
}

/// Root choice for an image: Shell root where adb root works, else None (D7).
pub fn default_root(img: Option<&SystemImage>, preferred: RootChoice) -> RootChoice {
    let shell_ok = img.is_none_or(|i| i.image.allows_adb_root());
    match preferred {
        RootChoice::Shell if !shell_ok => RootChoice::None,
        other => other,
    }
}

/// Defaults for a new device: first profile (`phone-6.1-fhd` if present),
/// newest installed Google APIs image, Shell root where allowed.
pub fn new_form(
    profiles: &[HardwareProfile],
    images: &[SystemImage],
    taken: &[String],
    preferred_root: RootChoice,
) -> DeviceForm {
    let profile = profiles
        .iter()
        .position(|p| p.id == "phone-6.1-fhd")
        .unwrap_or(0);
    let image = images
        .iter()
        .position(|i| i.installed_in.is_some() && i.image.allows_adb_root())
        .or_else(|| images.iter().position(|i| i.installed_in.is_some()))
        .unwrap_or(0);
    let mut form = DeviceForm {
        start_after: true,
        image: image as i32,
        root: default_root(images.get(image), preferred_root),
        ..Default::default()
    };
    apply_profile(&mut form, profiles, profile);
    form.name = free_name(
        profiles
            .get(profile)
            .map(|p| p.name.as_str())
            .unwrap_or("Phone"),
        taken,
    )
    .into();
    form
}

/// Fills RAM, CPU and screen from a profile.
pub fn apply_profile(form: &mut DeviceForm, profiles: &[HardwareProfile], index: usize) {
    form.profile = index as i32;
    if let Some(p) = profiles.get(index) {
        form.ram_gb = format_gb(p.ram_mb).into();
        form.cpus = p.cpus.to_string().into();
        form.screen = format!("{}×{}", p.width, p.height).into();
        form.density = p.density.to_string().into();
    }
}

fn format_gb(mb: u32) -> String {
    if mb.is_multiple_of(1024) {
        (mb / 1024).to_string()
    } else {
        format!("{:.1}", f64::from(mb) / 1024.0)
    }
}

/// The edit form for an existing device.
pub fn edit_form(info: &DeviceInfo, profiles: &[HardwareProfile]) -> DeviceForm {
    DeviceForm {
        edit: true,
        name: info.device.name.clone().into(),
        profile: profiles
            .iter()
            .position(|p| p.id == info.device.profile)
            .unwrap_or(0) as i32,
        image: -1,
        root: match info.device.root.mode {
            jidr_core::RootMode::None => RootChoice::None,
            jidr_core::RootMode::Adb => RootChoice::Shell,
            jidr_core::RootMode::Magisk => RootChoice::Full,
        },
        ram_gb: format_gb(info.ram_mb).into(),
        cpus: info.cpus.to_string().into(),
        screen: format!("{}×{}", info.width, info.height).into(),
        density: info.density.to_string().into(),
        start_after: false,
        error: Default::default(),
        play_store: !info.device.image.allows_adb_root(),
    }
}

struct Hardware {
    ram_mb: u32,
    cpus: u32,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
}

fn parse_hardware(form: &DeviceForm) -> Result<Hardware, String> {
    let ram: f64 = form
        .ram_gb
        .trim()
        .parse()
        .map_err(|_| "RAM must be a number of GB, like 4.".to_string())?;
    if !(0.5..=64.0).contains(&ram) {
        return Err("RAM must be between 0.5 and 64 GB.".into());
    }
    let cpus: u32 = form
        .cpus
        .trim()
        .parse()
        .map_err(|_| "CPU cores must be a whole number.".to_string())?;
    if !(1..=16).contains(&cpus) {
        return Err("CPU cores must be between 1 and 16.".into());
    }
    let (w, h) = form
        .screen
        .split(['×', 'x', 'X'])
        .map(|s| s.trim().parse::<u32>())
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
        .ok()
        .and_then(|v| match v.as_slice() {
            [w, h] => Some((*w, *h)),
            _ => None,
        })
        .ok_or_else(|| "Screen must look like 1080×2400.".to_string())?;
    if !(240..=4096).contains(&w) || !(240..=4096).contains(&h) {
        return Err("Screen sides must be between 240 and 4096 pixels.".into());
    }
    Ok(Hardware {
        ram_mb: (ram * 1024.0).round() as u32,
        cpus,
        width: w,
        height: h,
    })
}

fn check_name(name: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    let name = name.trim();
    if name.is_empty() {
        return Err("Give the device a name.".into());
    }
    Ok(name.to_string())
}

pub fn root_mode(c: RootChoice) -> &'static str {
    match c {
        RootChoice::None => "none",
        RootChoice::Shell => "adb",
        RootChoice::Full => "magisk",
    }
}

/// `device.create` params; only values that differ from the profile are sent.
pub fn create_params(
    form: &DeviceForm,
    profiles: &[HardwareProfile],
    images: &[SystemImage],
) -> Result<Value, String> {
    let name = check_name(&form.name)?;
    let img = usize::try_from(form.image)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|i| images.get(i))
        .ok_or_else(|| "Pick an Android version.".to_string())?;
    if form.root == RootChoice::Shell && !img.image.allows_adb_root() {
        return Err("Play Store images don't allow adb root.".into());
    }
    let hw = parse_hardware(form)?;
    let profile = usize::try_from(form.profile)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|i| profiles.get(i));
    let mut p = Map::new();
    p.insert("name".into(), json!(name));
    p.insert("image".into(), json!(img.image.package()));
    p.insert("root_mode".into(), json!(root_mode(form.root)));
    if let Some(prof) = profile {
        p.insert("profile".into(), json!(prof.id));
        if prof.ram_mb != hw.ram_mb {
            p.insert("ram_mb".into(), json!(hw.ram_mb));
        }
        if prof.cpus != hw.cpus {
            p.insert("cpus".into(), json!(hw.cpus));
        }
        if (prof.width, prof.height) != (hw.width, hw.height) {
            p.insert("width".into(), json!(hw.width));
            p.insert("height".into(), json!(hw.height));
        }
    }
    Ok(Value::Object(p))
}

/// `device.edit` params for the fields that changed.
pub fn edit_params(form: &DeviceForm, info: &DeviceInfo) -> Result<Value, String> {
    let name = check_name(&form.name)?;
    let hw = parse_hardware(form)?;
    let mut p = Map::new();
    p.insert("device".into(), json!(info.device.id));
    if name != info.device.name {
        p.insert("name".into(), json!(name));
    }
    if hw.ram_mb != info.ram_mb {
        p.insert("ram_mb".into(), json!(hw.ram_mb));
    }
    if hw.cpus != info.cpus {
        p.insert("cpus".into(), json!(hw.cpus));
    }
    if (hw.width, hw.height) != (info.width, info.height) {
        p.insert("width".into(), json!(hw.width));
        p.insert("height".into(), json!(hw.height));
    }
    Ok(Value::Object(p))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use jidr_core::ImageRef;

    fn img(api: u32, tag: &str, installed: bool) -> SystemImage {
        SystemImage {
            image: ImageRef {
                api,
                tag: tag.into(),
                abi: "arm64-v8a".into(),
            },
            display: String::new(),
            revision: "1".into(),
            support: Support::for_api(api),
            size: 2_000_000_000,
            license: None,
            installed_in: installed.then(|| "/sdk".into()),
            pristine_ramdisk_sha256: None,
        }
    }

    fn profiles() -> Vec<HardwareProfile> {
        jidr_core::provider::parse_params(serde_json::json!([
            {"id": "small-phone-5", "name": "Small phone 5″", "width": 720, "height": 1280, "density": 320, "ram_mb": 2048, "cpus": 2},
            {"id": "phone-6.1-fhd", "name": "Phone 6.1″ FHD+", "width": 1080, "height": 2400, "density": 420, "ram_mb": 4096, "cpus": 4}
        ]))
        .unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn images_sort_newest_first_and_drop_unsupported() {
        let v = sorted_images(&[
            img(33, "google_apis_playstore", true),
            img(35, "google_apis", true),
            img(26, "google_apis", true),
            img(35, "google_apis_playstore", false),
        ]);
        let labels: Vec<_> = v.iter().map(image_label).collect();
        assert_eq!(
            labels,
            [
                "Android 15 · API 35 · Google APIs",
                "Android 15 · API 35 · Play Store",
                "Android 13 · API 33 · Play Store"
            ]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn defaults_follow_d7() {
        let images = sorted_images(&[
            img(35, "google_apis", true),
            img(33, "google_apis_playstore", true),
        ]);
        let f = new_form(
            &profiles(),
            &images,
            &["Phone 6.1 FHD+".into()],
            RootChoice::Shell,
        );
        assert_eq!(f.profile, 1);
        assert_eq!(f.image, 0);
        assert_eq!(f.root, RootChoice::Shell);
        assert_eq!(f.name, "Phone 6.1 FHD+ 2");
        assert_eq!(
            (f.ram_gb.as_str(), f.cpus.as_str(), f.screen.as_str()),
            ("4", "4", "1080×2400")
        );
        assert_eq!(
            default_root(images.get(1), RootChoice::Shell),
            RootChoice::None
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn create_params_send_only_overrides_and_validate() {
        let images = sorted_images(&[
            img(35, "google_apis", true),
            img(33, "google_apis_playstore", true),
        ]);
        let mut f = new_form(&profiles(), &images, &[], RootChoice::Shell);
        let p = create_params(&f, &profiles(), &images).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p["profile"], "phone-6.1-fhd");
        assert_eq!(p["root_mode"], "adb");
        assert!(p.get("ram_mb").is_none());
        f.ram_gb = "6".into();
        f.screen = "1440x3120".into();
        let p = create_params(&f, &profiles(), &images).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p["ram_mb"], 6144);
        assert_eq!(
            (p["width"].as_u64(), p["height"].as_u64()),
            (Some(1440), Some(3120))
        );
        f.image = 1;
        assert!(
            create_params(&f, &profiles(), &images)
                .unwrap_err()
                .contains("Play Store")
        );
        f.root = RootChoice::Full;
        f.cpus = "x".into();
        assert!(
            create_params(&f, &profiles(), &images)
                .unwrap_err()
                .contains("CPU")
        );
        f.cpus = "4".into();
        f.name = "  ".into();
        assert!(
            create_params(&f, &profiles(), &images)
                .unwrap_err()
                .contains("name")
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn image_rows_show_install_state() {
        let images = [img(35, "google_apis", true), img(36, "google_apis", false)];
        let rows = image_rows(&images, &[]);
        assert_eq!(rows[0].status, "Installed · 2.0 GB");
        assert_eq!(rows[1].status, "Download · 2.0 GB");
        assert!(rows[1].enabled);
    }

    /// The edit sheet shows root-mode cards (9e); a Play Store device must
    /// keep Shell root disabled there, so the form carries the image kind.
    #[test]
    fn edit_form_knows_play_store_devices() {
        let profiles = profiles();
        let mut info = crate::fixtures::device_infos()[1].clone();
        assert!(!edit_form(&info, &profiles).play_store);
        info.device.image.tag = "google_apis_playstore".into();
        info.device.root.mode = jidr_core::RootMode::Magisk;
        let form = edit_form(&info, &profiles);
        assert!(form.play_store && form.edit);
        assert_eq!(form.root, RootChoice::Full);
    }
}
```

```rs
//! The golden snapshot cases: every screen and state, filled with the
//! PRODUCT.md §7 fixtures. Rendered by `examples/snapshot.rs`.

use jidr_core::RootMode;
use slint::{ComponentHandle, ModelRc, Rgba8Pixel, SharedPixelBuffer, VecModel};

use crate::{
    AppWindow, ConnState, DetectRow, JobTone, JobVm, PlanRow, RootChoice, SettingsWindow,
    SetupWindow, Theme, device_form, fixtures, model, offscreen, palette, settings,
};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Variant {
    Dark,
    Light,
    /// Dark, mirrored for right-to-left (D33).
    Rtl,
}

impl Variant {
    pub const ALL: [Variant; 3] = [Variant::Dark, Variant::Light, Variant::Rtl];

    pub fn suffix(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Variant::Dark => "dark",
            Variant::Light => "light",
            Variant::Rtl => "rtl",
        }
    }
}

pub type Render = fn(Variant) -> Result<SharedPixelBuffer<Rgba8Pixel>, String>;

pub struct Case {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub render: Render,
}

/// Applies a variant to a component's `Theme` global. Snapshots freeze
/// motion (spinners, transitions) by turning Reduce Motion on.
pub fn apply<C: ComponentHandle>(c: &C, v: Variant)
where
    for<'a> Theme<'a>: slint::Global<'a, C>,
{
    let theme = c.global::<Theme>();
    theme.set_dark(v != Variant::Light);
    theme.set_rtl(v == Variant::Rtl);
    theme.set_reduce_motion(true);
}

fn model<T: Clone + 'static>(v: Vec<T>) -> ModelRc<T> {
    ModelRc::new(VecModel::from(v))
}

fn app(v: Variant) -> Result<AppWindow, String> {
    let app = AppWindow::new().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    apply(&app, v);
    Ok(app)
}

pub(crate) fn shot<C: ComponentHandle>(
    c: &C,
    w: u32,
    h: u32,
) -> Result<SharedPixelBuffer<Rgba8Pixel>, String> {
    offscreen::render(c.window(), w, h).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

fn create_sheet(
    v: Variant,
    play_store: bool,
    edit: bool,
) -> Result<SharedPixelBuffer<Rgba8Pixel>, String> {
    let app = populated(v)?;
    let profiles = fixtures::profiles();
    let images = fixtures::system_images();
    let jobs = vec![fixtures::download_job()];
    app.set_profiles(model(device_form::profile_options(&profiles)));
    app.set_images(model(device_form::image_rows(&images, &jobs)));
    let mut form = device_form::new_form(&profiles, &images, &[], RootChoice::Shell);
    if edit {
        form = device_form::edit_form(&fixtures::device_infos()[1], &profiles);
    } else if play_store {
        form.name = "Play Store test 2".into();
        form.image = images
            .iter()
            .position(|i| i.image.api == 33)
            .map(|i| i as i32)
            .unwrap_or(0);
        form.root = RootChoice::None;
    } else {
        form.name = "Checkout test".into();
    }
    app.set_form(form);
    app.set_sheet_open(true);
    shot(&app, 1440, 900)
}

fn setup(v: Variant, step: i32) -> Result<SharedPixelBuffer<Rgba8Pixel>, String> {
    let w = SetupWindow::new().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    apply(&w, v);
    w.set_step(step);
    w.set_detect(model(vec![
        DetectRow {
            path: "~/Library/Android/sdk".into(),
            state: "Not found".into(),
            found: false,
        },
        DetectRow {
            path: "$ANDROID_HOME".into(),
            state: "Not set".into(),
            found: false,
        },
        DetectRow {
            path: "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT".into(),
            state: "Not set".into(),
            found: false,
        },
    ]));
    w.set_plan(model(vec![
        PlanRow {
            label: "Android Emulator".into(),
            size: "0.3 GB".into(),
        },
        PlanRow {
            label: "Android 15 (API 35) · Google APIs · arm64".into(),
            size: "2.0 GB".into(),
        },
    ]));
    w.set_plan_dir("~/Library/Application Support/Jidr/sdk".into());
    w.set_plan_total("2.3 GB".into());
    w.set_license_title("Android Software Development Kit License Agreement".into());
    w.set_license_text(fixtures::LICENSE_EXCERPT.into());
    w.set_accepted_note(
        "License accepted Oct 13, 14:01. You can close this window; downloads keep going in Jobs."
            .into(),
    );
    let row = |title: &str, tone, p: f32, detail: &str, eta: &str| JobVm {
        id: "".into(),
        title: title.into(),
        tone,
        progress: p,
        indeterminate: false,
        detail: detail.into(),
        eta: eta.into(),
        cancellable: false,
    };
    w.set_downloads(model(vec![
        row(
            "Android Emulator",
            JobTone::Done,
            1.0,
            "0.3 / 0.3 GB",
            "Done",
        ),
        row(
            "Android 15 (API 35) image",
            JobTone::Running,
            0.6,
            "1.2 / 2.0 GB · 18 MB/s",
            "About 1 min left",
        ),
        row(
            "Verify checksums",
            JobTone::Queued,
            0.0,
            "Queued",
            "After download",
        ),
    ]));
    let profiles = fixtures::profiles();
    let images: Vec<_> = fixtures::system_images()
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|i| i.image.api == 35 && i.installed_in.is_some())
        .collect();
    let mut form = device_form::new_form(&profiles, &images, &[], RootChoice::Shell);
    form.name = "Pixel-ish 6.1".into();
    w.set_form(form);
    w.set_profiles(model(device_form::profile_options(&profiles)));
    w.set_image_label("Android 15 · API 35 · Google APIs".into());
    w.set_image_status("Installed · 2.0 GB".into());
    shot(&w, 760, 580)
}

fn settings_tab(v: Variant, tab: i32) -> Result<SharedPixelBuffer<Rgba8Pixel>, String> {
    shot(&settings_window(v, tab)?, 820, 640)
}

fn settings_window(v: Variant, tab: i32) -> Result<SettingsWindow, String> {
    let w = SettingsWindow::new().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    apply(&w, v);
    w.set_tab(tab);
    w.set_version("0.1.0".into());
    w.set_tile_options(model(settings::tile_options()));
    w.set_sdk_path("~/Library/Application Support/Jidr/sdk".into());
    w.set_sdk_note("License accepted Oct 13, 14:01".into());
    let infos = fixtures::device_infos();
    w.set_device_usage(model(settings::device_usage(
        &infos,
        &[(uuid::Uuid::from_u128(1), 3)],
    )));
    w.set_image_usage(model(settings::image_usage(
        &fixtures::system_images(),
        &infos,
    )));
    w.set_cache_size("0.4 GB".into());
    Ok(w)
}

/// The device tab for `device` (0 = Pixel-ish 6.1) with the mock screen.
pub(crate) fn device_tab(v: Variant, device: usize) -> Result<AppWindow, String> {
    let app = populated(v)?;
    let devices = fixtures::devices();
    app.set_tabs(model(vec![
        model::tab_vm(&devices[0]),
        model::tab_vm(&devices[2]),
        model::tab_vm(&devices[1]),
    ]));
    app.set_active_tab(match device {
        0 => 0,
        2 => 1,
        _ => 2,
    });
    app.set_active_device(device as i32);
    app.set_player_mock(true);
    let lines = fixtures::log_lines();
    app.set_log_errors(1);
    app.set_log_last_error(crate::player::logcat::short(&lines[3]).into());
    app.set_log_summary("5 of 12,408 lines · 1 error".into());
    app.set_log_lines(model(lines));
    let mut w = crate::widgets::default_vm();
    w.battery_level = 64;
    w.wifi = true;
    w.mobile = true;
    w.signal = 3;
    w.phone_number = "+218 91 234 5678".into();
    w.sms_text = "Your courier is 4 min away".into();
    w.clipboard = "ORDER-4821".into();
    app.set_widgets(w);
    Ok(app)
}

/// Launcher with the four sample devices, Pixel-ish 6.1 selected.
pub fn populated(v: Variant) -> Result<AppWindow, String> {
    let app = app(v)?;
    let devices = fixtures::devices();
    let tabs = vec![model::tab_vm(&devices[0])];
    app.set_devices(model(devices));
    app.set_jobs(model(fixtures::jobs()));
    app.set_tabs(model(tabs));
    app.set_selected(0);
    app.set_snapshots(model(fixtures::snapshots(RootMode::Magisk)));
    Ok(app)
}
```

`crates/jidr-ui/src/launcher/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! Launcher wiring: selection, tabs, lifecycle actions, the create/edit
//! sheet, the command palette and the confirmation dialog.

use std::rc::Rc;

use jidr_core::{HardwareProfile, SystemImage};
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use slint::{ComponentHandle, ModelRc, VecModel};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::app::{Ctx, report, toast};
use crate::device_form;
use crate::{DeviceForm, PaletteItem, RootChoice};

fn models<T: Clone + 'static>(v: Vec<T>) -> ModelRc<T> {
    ModelRc::new(VecModel::from(v))
}

pub fn wire(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    let app = &ctx.app;
    let weak = app.as_weak();

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_select_device(move |i| {
        let id = c.device_id(i);
        c.state.borrow_mut().selected = id;
        c.rerender();
        crate::snapshots::load(&c);
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_open_device(move |i| {
        if let Some(id) = c.device_id(i) {
            open_tab(&c, id);
        }
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_select_tab(move |i| {
        c.state.borrow_mut().active = usize::try_from(i).ok();
        c.rerender();
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_close_tab(move |i| close_tab(&c, usize::try_from(i).ok()));

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_shortcut(move |s| match s.as_str() {
        p if crate::player::shortcut(&c, p) => {}
        "library" => {
            c.state.borrow_mut().active = None;
            c.rerender();
        }
        "close-tab" => {
            let active = c.state.borrow().active;
            close_tab(&c, active);
        }
        t => {
            if let Some(n) = t.strip_prefix("tab-").and_then(|n| n.parse::<usize>().ok()) {
                let len = c.state.borrow().tabs.len();
                if n >= 1 && n <= len {
                    c.state.borrow_mut().active = Some(n - 1);
                    c.rerender();
                }
            }
        }
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_start_device(move |i| {
        if let Some(id) = c.device_id(i) {
            start(&c, id);
        }
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_stop_device(move |i| {
        if let Some(id) = c.device_id(i) {
            stop(&c, id);
        }
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    let w = weak.clone();
    app.on_cancel_job(move |i| {
        let job = {
            let st = c.state.borrow();
            usize::try_from(i)
                .ok()
                .and_then(|i| st.data.jobs.get(i))
                .map(|j| j.id)
        };
        if let Some(job) = job {
            c.bridge.call(
                "jobs.cancel",
                json!({ "job": job }),
                report(&w, "Cancelled"),
            );
        }
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    let w = weak.clone();
    app.on_verify_root(move |i| {
        if let Some(id) = c.device_id(i) {
            c.bridge.run(
                "root.verify",
                json!({ "device": id }),
                |_| {},
                report(&w, "Root verified"),
            );
        }
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_revert_root(move |i| {
        let Some(id) = c.device_id(i) else { return };
        let name = c.info(id).map(|d| d.device.name).unwrap_or_default();
        let c2 = c.clone();
        confirm(
            &c,
            &format!("Revert {name} to unrooted?"),
            "Removes root and cold boots the device (about 40 s). Apps and data stay. Snapshots taken with root can't be restored until root is set up again.",
            "Revert",
            move || {
                let w = c2.app.as_weak();
                c2.bridge.run(
                    "root.set",
                    json!({ "device": id, "mode": "none" }),
                    |_| {},
                    report(&w, &format!("Reverted {name} to unrooted")),
                );
            },
        );
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_more_device(move |i| {
        // The palette, narrowed to this device, lists everything it can do.
        let name = c
            .device_id(i)
            .and_then(|id| c.info(id))
            .map(|d| d.device.name)
            .unwrap_or_default();
        open_palette(&c, &name);
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_new_device(move || new_device(&c));

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_cancel_form(move || {
        c.app.set_sheet_open(false);
        c.catalog.borrow_mut().editing = None;
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_form_image_changed(move |i| {
        let mut form = c.app.get_form();
        let preferred = c.prefs.borrow().root_choice();
        let cat = c.catalog.borrow();
        if let Some(img) = usize::try_from(i).ok().and_then(|i| cat.images.get(i)) {
            if !img.image.allows_adb_root() && form.root == RootChoice::Shell {
                form.root = RootChoice::None;
            } else if img.image.allows_adb_root() && form.root == RootChoice::None {
                form.root = device_form::default_root(Some(img), preferred);
            }
        }
        form.image = i;
        c.app.set_form(form);
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_submit_form(move |form| submit(&c, form));

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_open_palette(move || open_palette(&c, ""));

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_palette_query_changed(move |q| {
        let all = palette_items(&c);
        c.app
            .set_palette_items(models(crate::palette::filter(&all, &q)));
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_palette_run(move |item| run_palette(&c, &item));

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_confirm_ok(move || {
        if let Some(f) = c.pending_confirm.borrow_mut().take() {
            f();
        }
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_open_settings(move || crate::settings::open(&c, 0));

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_setup_sdk(move || crate::wizard::open(&c));
    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_use_existing_sdk(move || crate::wizard::open(&c));

    let w = weak.clone();
    app.on_drag_window(move || {
        if let Some(app) = w.upgrade() {
            use slint::winit_030::WinitWindowAccessor;
            app.window().with_winit_window(|win| {
                let _ = win.drag_window();
            });
        }
    });
}

pub fn open_tab(c: &Rc<Ctx>, id: Uuid) {
    {
        let mut st = c.state.borrow_mut();
        st.selected = Some(id);
        let pos = match st.tabs.iter().position(|t| *t == id) {
            Some(p) => p,
            None => {
                st.tabs.push(id);
                st.tabs.len() - 1
            }
        };
        st.active = Some(pos);
    }
    c.rerender();
}

fn close_tab(c: &Rc<Ctx>, i: Option<usize>) {
    {
        let mut st = c.state.borrow_mut();
        if let Some(i) = i
            && i < st.tabs.len()
        {
            st.tabs.remove(i);
        }
        st.active = None;
    }
    c.rerender();
}

pub fn start(c: &Rc<Ctx>, id: Uuid) {
    let w = c.app.as_weak();
    c.bridge.run(
        "device.start",
        json!({ "device": id }),
        |_| {},
        report(&w, ""),
    );
}

pub fn stop(c: &Rc<Ctx>, id: Uuid) {
    let w = c.app.as_weak();
    c.bridge
        .call("device.stop", json!({ "device": id }), report(&w, ""));
}

/// Shows the confirmation dialog; `ok` runs on confirm.
pub fn confirm(c: &Rc<Ctx>, title: &str, body: &str, action: &str, ok: impl Fn() + 'static) {
    *c.pending_confirm.borrow_mut() = Some(Box::new(ok));
    c.app.set_confirm_title(title.into());
    c.app.set_confirm_body(body.into());
    c.app.set_confirm_action(action.into());
    c.app.set_confirm_open(true);
}

/// Loads profiles and images, then calls `then` on the UI thread.
fn load_catalog(c: &Rc<Ctx>, then: impl FnOnce(&Rc<Ctx>) + 'static) {
    let bridge = c.bridge.clone();
    let b2 = bridge.clone();
    let c2 = c.clone();
    let token = crate::app::defer(
        move |(profiles, images): (Vec<HardwareProfile>, Vec<SystemImage>)| {
            {
                let mut cat = c2.catalog.borrow_mut();
                cat.profiles = profiles;
                cat.images = device_form::sorted_images(&images);
            }
            then(&c2);
        },
    );
    bridge.call("profile.list", json!({}), move |p| {
        let profiles: Vec<HardwareProfile> = p
            .ok()
            .and_then(|v| serde_json::from_value(v).ok())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        b2.call("image.list", json!({}), move |i| {
            let images: Vec<SystemImage> = i
                .ok()
                .and_then(|v| serde_json::from_value(v).ok())
                .unwrap_or_default();
            crate::app::fire(token, (profiles, images));
        });
    });
}

fn new_device(c: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    load_catalog(c, |c| {
        let taken: Vec<String> = c
            .state
            .borrow()
            .data
            .devices
            .iter()
            .map(|d| d.device.name.clone())
            .collect();
        let preferred = c.prefs.borrow().root_choice();
        let jobs = c.state.borrow().data.jobs.clone();
        let cat = c.catalog.borrow();
        let form = device_form::new_form(&cat.profiles, &cat.images, &taken, preferred);
        c.app
            .set_profiles(models(device_form::profile_options(&cat.profiles)));
        c.app
            .set_images(models(device_form::image_rows(&cat.images, &jobs)));
        c.app.set_form(form);
        c.app.set_sheet_open(true);
        drop(cat);
        c.catalog.borrow_mut().editing = None;
    });
}

pub fn edit_device(c: &Rc<Ctx>, id: Uuid) {
    load_catalog(c, move |c| {
        let Some(info) = c.info(id) else { return };
        let cat = c.catalog.borrow();
        c.app
            .set_profiles(models(device_form::profile_options(&cat.profiles)));
        c.app.set_form(device_form::edit_form(&info, &cat.profiles));
        c.app.set_sheet_open(true);
        drop(cat);
        c.catalog.borrow_mut().editing = Some(id);
    });
}

fn set_form_error(c: &Rc<Ctx>, msg: String) {
    let mut f = c.app.get_form();
    f.error = msg.into();
    c.app.set_form(f);
}

fn submit(c: &Rc<Ctx>, form: DeviceForm) {
    let editing = c.catalog.borrow().editing;
    let w = c.app.as_weak();
    if let Some(id) = editing {
        let Some(info) = c.info(id) else { return };
        match device_form::edit_params(&form, &info) {
            Err(e) => set_form_error(c, e),
            Ok(params) => {
                c.app.set_sheet_open(false);
                // 9e: a changed root mode runs `root.set` (Full root opens
                // the Root sheet).
                let mode = crate::root::mode_of(form.root);
                let changed = mode != info.device.root.mode;
                let saved = report(&w, &format!("Saved {}", form.name));
                c.bridge.call("device.edit", params, move |r| {
                    let ok = r.is_ok();
                    saved(r);
                    if ok && changed {
                        crate::root::start_later(id, mode);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    let cat = c.catalog.borrow();
    let params = match device_form::create_params(&form, &cat.profiles, &cat.images) {
        Ok(p) => p,
        Err(e) => {
            drop(cat);
            return set_form_error(c, e);
        }
    };
    let image = usize::try_from(form.image)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|i| cat.images.get(i))
        .cloned();
    drop(cat);
    c.app.set_sheet_open(false);
    let bridge = c.bridge.clone();
    let start = form.start_after;
    let name = form.name.to_string();
    // 9e: Full root runs `root.set magisk` after create (it boots the
    // device and opens the Root sheet) instead of a plain start.
    let full_root = crate::root::mode_of(form.root) == jidr_core::RootMode::Magisk;
    // A missing image is downloaded first (a job, shown in the sidebar).
    let create = move |bridge: std::sync::Arc<crate::bridge::Bridge>,
                       w: slint::Weak<crate::AppWindow>| {
        let b2 = bridge.clone();
        bridge.call("device.create", params, move |r| match r {
            Ok(dev) => {
                toast(&w, format!("Created {name}"));
                if full_root
                    && let Some(id) = dev
                        .get("id")
                        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                        .and_then(|s| uuid::Uuid::parse_str(s).ok())
                {
                    crate::root::start_later(id, jidr_core::RootMode::Magisk);
                } else if start && let Some(id) = dev.get("id").cloned() {
                    b2.run(
                        "device.start",
                        json!({ "device": id }),
                        |_| {},
                        report(&w, ""),
                    );
                }
            }
            Err(e) => toast(&w, e.message),
        });
    };
    match image {
        Some(img) if img.installed_in.is_none() => {
            let b = bridge.clone();
            let w2 = w.clone();
            bridge.run(
                "image.install",
                json!({ "image": img.image.package() }),
                |_| {},
                move |r| match r {
                    Ok(_) => create(b, w2),
                    Err(e) => toast(&w2, e.message),
                },
            );
        }
        _ => create(bridge, w),
    }
}

fn palette_items(c: &Rc<Ctx>) -> Vec<PaletteItem> {
    use slint::Model;
    let devices: Vec<_> = c.app.get_devices().iter().collect();
    crate::palette::items(&devices, c.app.get_sdk_ready())
}

fn open_palette(c: &Rc<Ctx>, query: &str) {
    let all = palette_items(c);
    c.app.set_palette_query(query.into());
    c.app
        .set_palette_items(models(crate::palette::filter(&all, query)));
    c.app.set_palette_open(true);
}

fn run_palette(c: &Rc<Ctx>, item: &PaletteItem) {
    let action = item.action.to_string();
    let (verb, arg) = action.split_once(':').unwrap_or((action.as_str(), ""));
    let id = Uuid::parse_str(arg).ok();
    match (verb, id) {
        ("open", Some(id)) => open_tab(c, id),
        ("start", Some(id)) => start(c, id),
        ("stop", Some(id)) => stop(c, id),
        ("edit", Some(id)) => edit_device(c, id),
        ("new", _) => new_device(c),
        ("setup", _) => crate::wizard::open(c),
        ("settings", _) => crate::settings::open(c, if arg == "agents" { 2 } else { 0 }),
        ("appearance", _) => {
            let dark = c.app.global::<crate::Theme>().get_dark();
            c.prefs.borrow_mut().appearance = if dark { 1 } else { 2 };
            let _ = c.prefs.borrow().save(&c.paths.data);
            c.apply_appearance();
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

/// Exposed for tests: the params the sheet would send.
pub fn create_params_for(
    form: &DeviceForm,
    profiles: &[HardwareProfile],
    images: &[SystemImage],
) -> Result<Value, String> {
    device_form::create_params(form, profiles, images)
}
```

`crates/jidr-ui/src/model.rs`:

```rs
//! Daemon data → view models. Every user-facing label is built here, from
//! the status vocabulary in docs/design/PRODUCT.md §5 and the number rules
//! in docs/design/system/README.md, so the Slint files only lay things out.

use chrono::{DateTime, FixedOffset, Utc};
use jidr_core::{Device, DeviceStatus, ImageRef, Job, JobState, RootHealth, RootMode};
use slint::SharedString;

use crate::{DevState, DeviceVm, FormFactor, JobTone, JobVm, RootKind, SnapshotVm, TabVm};

/// "Now" and the local time zone, injected so goldens don't depend on the
/// machine's clock or zone.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub struct Clock {
    pub now: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub tz: FixedOffset,
}

impl Clock {
    pub fn system() -> Self {
        let now = Utc::now();
        Self {
            now,
            tz: *now.with_timezone(&chrono::Local).offset(),
        }
    }

    pub fn local(&self, t: DateTime<Utc>) -> DateTime<FixedOffset> {
        t.with_timezone(&self.tz)
    }
}

/// Everything the UI knows about one device, gathered from `device.list`,
/// `device.details`, `profile.list`, events and jobs.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct DeviceInfo {
    pub device: Device,
    pub profile_name: Option<String>,
    pub width: u32,
    pub height: u32,
    pub density: u32,
    pub ram_mb: u32,
    pub cpus: u32,
    pub disk_bytes: Option<u64>,
    /// Latest `device.boot` progress while booting.
    pub boot_progress: Option<f32>,
    /// Who holds the device lock when it isn't this window ("CLI", "agent").
    pub busy_holder: Option<String>,
    /// A root job (`root.set`) is running on it.
    pub root_job: bool,
}

impl DeviceInfo {
    pub fn new(device: Device) -> Self {
        Self {
            device,
            profile_name: None,
            width: 0,
            height: 0,
            density: 0,
            ram_mb: 0,
            cpus: 0,
            disk_bytes: None,
            boot_progress: None,
            busy_holder: None,
            root_job: false,
        }
    }
}

/// "Android 15" for API 35 (marketing names, D23 range plus neighbours).
pub fn android_version(api: u32) -> String {
    let v = match api {
        25 => "7.1",
        26 => "8.0",
        27 => "8.1",
        28 => "9",
        29 => "10",
        30 => "11",
        31 => "12",
        32 => "12L",
        33 => "13",
        34 => "14",
        35 => "15",
        36 => "16",
        _ => return format!("API {api}"),
    };
    format!("Android {v}")
}

/// "Android 15 · API 35".
pub fn android_label(api: u32) -> String {
    format!("{} · API {api}", android_version(api))
}

/// Image tag as users read it: Google APIs / Play Store / AOSP.
pub fn image_tag(image: &ImageRef) -> String {
    match image.tag.as_str() {
        "google_apis" => "Google APIs".into(),
        "google_apis_playstore" | "playstore" => "Play Store".into(),
        "default" => "AOSP".into(),
        "aosp_atd" => "AOSP ATD".into(),
        "google_atd" => "Google ATD".into(),
        other => other.replace('_', " "),
    }
}

/// Decimal GB with one decimal, like Finder ("6.8 GB").
pub fn gb(bytes: u64) -> String {
    format!("{:.1} GB", bytes as f64 / 1e9)
}

/// RAM in whole binary GB ("4 GB"); under 1 GB in MB.
pub fn ram(mb: u32) -> String {
    if mb >= 1024 && mb.is_multiple_of(1024) {
        format!("{} GB", mb / 1024)
    } else if mb >= 1024 {
        format!("{:.1} GB", f64::from(mb) / 1024.0)
    } else {
        format!("{mb} MB")
    }
}

/// "40 s", "12 m", "2 h 14 m" (number, no-break space, unit).
pub fn duration(secs: i64) -> String {
    let secs = secs.max(0);
    if secs < 60 {
        format!("{secs}\u{a0}s")
    } else if secs < 3600 {
        format!("{}\u{a0}m", secs / 60)
    } else {
        format!("{}\u{a0}h {}\u{a0}m", secs / 3600, (secs % 3600) / 60)
    }
}

/// "2 min ago", "Today 14:02"-style relative time for verification stamps.
pub fn ago(then: DateTime<Utc>, now: DateTime<Utc>) -> String {
    let s = (now - then).num_seconds().max(0);
    if s < 60 {
        "just now".into()
    } else if s < 3600 {
        format!("{} min ago", s / 60)
    } else if s < 86_400 {
        format!("{} h ago", s / 3600)
    } else {
        format!("{} days ago", s / 86_400)
    }
}

fn state_of(info: &DeviceInfo) -> DevState {
    if info.busy_holder.is_some() {
        return DevState::Busy;
    }
    match &info.device.status {
        DeviceStatus::Stopped => DevState::Stopped,
        DeviceStatus::Starting => DevState::Starting,
        DeviceStatus::Booting => DevState::Booting,
        DeviceStatus::Running => DevState::Running,
        DeviceStatus::Stopping => DevState::Stopping,
        DeviceStatus::Crashed { .. } => DevState::Crashed,
    }
}

/// The status line: "Running · 2 h 14 m", "Booting Android… 62%", …
pub fn status_label(info: &DeviceInfo, now: DateTime<Utc>) -> String {
    if let Some(h) = &info.busy_holder {
        return format!("Busy · in use by {h}");
    }
    match &info.device.status {
        DeviceStatus::Stopped => "Stopped".into(),
        DeviceStatus::Starting => "Starting…".into(),
        DeviceStatus::Booting => match info.boot_progress {
            Some(p) => format!("Booting Android… {}%", (p * 100.0).round() as i64),
            None => "Booting Android…".into(),
        },
        DeviceStatus::Running => match &info.device.runtime {
            Some(rt) => format!(
                "Running · {}",
                duration((now - rt.started_at).num_seconds())
            ),
            None => "Running".into(),
        },
        DeviceStatus::Stopping => "Stopping…".into(),
        DeviceStatus::Crashed { .. } => "Crashed".into(),
    }
}

/// Root badge kind and its long and short labels (RootBadge spec).
pub fn root_labels(info: &DeviceInfo) -> (RootKind, String, String) {
    let root = &info.device.root;
    if info.root_job {
        return (
            RootKind::SettingUp,
            "Setting up root…".into(),
            "Setup".into(),
        );
    }
    match root.mode {
        RootMode::None => (RootKind::None, "Not rooted".into(), "No root".into()),
        RootMode::Adb => (RootKind::Shell, "Shell root (adb)".into(), "Shell".into()),
        RootMode::Magisk => match root.health {
            RootHealth::Ok => {
                let long = match &root.magisk_version {
                    Some(v) => format!("Rooted · Magisk {v}"),
                    None => "Rooted".into(),
                };
                (RootKind::Verified, long, "Rooted".into())
            }
            RootHealth::Failed => (RootKind::Failed, "Root failed".into(), "Failed".into()),
            RootHealth::Unverified if root.verified_at.is_some() => (
                RootKind::Unverified,
                "Root unverified".into(),
                "Unverified".into(),
            ),
            RootHealth::Unverified => (RootKind::Full, "Full root".into(), "Full".into()),
        },
    }
}

fn root_mode_name(mode: RootMode) -> &'static str {
    match mode {
        RootMode::None => "Not rooted",
        RootMode::Adb => "Shell root",
        RootMode::Magisk => "Full root",
    }
}

fn form_factor(info: &DeviceInfo) -> FormFactor {
    let short = info.width.min(info.height);
    let long = info.width.max(info.height);
    if info.device.profile.starts_with("tablet") || (short >= 1200 && long < short * 2) {
        FormFactor::Tablet
    } else if short > 0 && short <= 720 {
        FormFactor::SmallPhone
    } else {
        FormFactor::Phone
    }
}

pub fn device_vm(info: &DeviceInfo, clock: &Clock) -> DeviceVm {
    let now = clock.now;
    let d = &info.device;
    let (root, root_label, root_short) = root_labels(info);
    let verified = match d.root.verified_at {
        Some(t) if d.root.mode == RootMode::Magisk => format!("{} · su -c id → uid=0", ago(t, now)),
        Some(t) => format!("{} · adb shell id → uid=0", ago(t, now)),
        None if d.root.mode == RootMode::None => "Not needed".into(),
        None => "Not yet".into(),
    };
    let screen = if info.width > 0 {
        format!("{}×{} · {} dpi", info.width, info.height, info.density)
    } else {
        String::new()
    };
    let play_store = !d.image.allows_adb_root();
    DeviceVm {
        id: d.id.to_string().into(),
        name: d.name.clone().into(),
        profile: info
            .profile_name
            .clone()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| d.profile.clone())
            .into(),
        screen: screen.into(),
        android: android_label(d.image.api).into(),
        image: image_tag(&d.image).into(),
        state: state_of(info),
        status: status_label(info, now).into(),
        progress: info.boot_progress.unwrap_or(0.0),
        root,
        root_label: root_label.into(),
        root_short: root_short.into(),
        beta: play_store && d.root.mode == RootMode::Magisk,
        root_mode: root_mode_name(d.root.mode).into(),
        magisk: d.root.magisk_version.clone().unwrap_or_default().into(),
        verified: verified.into(),
        serial: d
            .runtime
            .as_ref()
            .map(|r| r.adb_serial.clone())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "—".into())
            .into(),
        disk: info.disk_bytes.map(gb).unwrap_or_else(|| "—".into()).into(),
        ram: if info.ram_mb > 0 {
            ram(info.ram_mb)
        } else {
            "—".into()
        }
        .into(),
        cpus: if info.cpus > 0 {
            format!("{} cores", info.cpus)
        } else {
            "—".into()
        }
        .into(),
        uptime: d
            .runtime
            .as_ref()
            .filter(|_| matches!(d.status, DeviceStatus::Running))
            .map(|r| duration((now - r.started_at).num_seconds()))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "—".into())
            .into(),
        last_started: d
            .runtime
            .as_ref()
            .map(|r| clock.local(r.started_at).format("Today, %H:%M").to_string())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "—".into())
            .into(),
        form: form_factor(info),
        width_px: info.width as i32,
        height_px: info.height as i32,
        play_store,
    }
}

pub fn tab_vm(vm: &DeviceVm) -> TabVm {
    TabVm {
        id: vm.id.clone(),
        name: vm.name.clone(),
        state: vm.state,
    }
}

/// A job row. `title` comes from the job kind and message.
pub fn job_vm(job: &Job, title: &str, bytes: Option<(u64, u64)>, eta: Option<i64>) -> JobVm {
    let tone = match job.state {
        JobState::Pending => JobTone::Queued,
        JobState::Running => JobTone::Running,
        JobState::Succeeded => JobTone::Done,
        JobState::Failed => JobTone::Failed,
        JobState::Cancelled => JobTone::Cancelled,
    };
    let detail = match (bytes, job.state) {
        (Some((done, total)), _) if total > 0 => {
            format!("{:.1} / {:.1} GB", done as f64 / 1e9, total as f64 / 1e9)
        }
        (_, JobState::Failed) => job
            .error
            .as_ref()
            .map(|e| e.message.clone())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "Failed".into()),
        (_, JobState::Cancelled) => "Cancelled".into(),
        (_, JobState::Succeeded) => "Done".into(),
        (_, JobState::Pending) => "Queued".into(),
        _ => job.message.clone(),
    };
    let eta = match eta {
        Some(s) if s >= 60 => format!("{} min left", (s + 59) / 60),
        Some(s) => format!("{s} s left"),
        None => String::new(),
    };
    JobVm {
        id: job.id.to_string().into(),
        title: SharedString::from(title),
        tone,
        progress: job.progress.unwrap_or(0.0),
        indeterminate: job.progress.is_none(),
        detail: detail.into(),
        eta: eta.into(),
        cancellable: !job.state.is_terminal(),
    }
}

/// Snapshot row; `refused` when its root mode differs from the device's (D29).
pub fn snapshot_vm(
    s: &jidr_core::Snapshot,
    device_mode: RootMode,
    size: Option<u64>,
    clock: &Clock,
) -> SnapshotVm {
    let auto = s.name == "default_boot";
    let root = match s.root_mode {
        RootMode::None => RootKind::None,
        RootMode::Adb => RootKind::Shell,
        RootMode::Magisk => RootKind::Full,
    };
    SnapshotVm {
        name: if auto {
            "Quick boot".into()
        } else {
            s.name.clone().into()
        },
        tag: format!("Taken with: {}", root_mode_name(s.root_mode)).into(),
        root,
        auto,
        size: size.map(gb).unwrap_or_default().into(),
        when: clock
            .local(s.created_at)
            .format("%b %-d, %H:%M")
            .to_string()
            .into(),
        refused: !auto && s.root_mode != device_mode,
        thumb: Default::default(),
        has_thumb: false,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use chrono::TimeZone;
    use jidr_core::{DeviceRuntime, RootState};

    fn utc(now: DateTime<Utc>) -> Clock {
        Clock {
            now,
            tz: FixedOffset::east_opt(0).unwrap(),
        }
    }

    fn device(status: DeviceStatus) -> Device {
        Device {
            id: uuid::Uuid::nil(),
            name: "Pixel-ish 6.1".into(),
            avd: "pixel".into(),
            profile: "phone-6.1-fhd".into(),
            image: ImageRef {
                api: 35,
                tag: "google_apis".into(),
                abi: "arm64-v8a".into(),
            },
            sdk_root: "/sdk".into(),
            root: RootState::default(),
            agent_owned: false,
            created_at: Utc.with_ymd_and_hms(2026, 10, 1, 0, 0, 0).unwrap(),
            launch: Default::default(),
            status,
            runtime: None,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn numbers_follow_the_system_rules() {
        assert_eq!(gb(6_800_000_000), "6.8 GB");
        assert_eq!(ram(4096), "4 GB");
        assert_eq!(ram(1536), "1.5 GB");
        assert_eq!(duration(40), "40\u{a0}s");
        assert_eq!(duration(12 * 60), "12\u{a0}m");
        assert_eq!(duration(2 * 3600 + 14 * 60), "2\u{a0}h 14\u{a0}m");
        assert_eq!(android_label(35), "Android 15 · API 35");
        assert_eq!(android_label(32), "Android 12L · API 32");
    }

    #[test]
    fn status_labels_match_product_vocabulary() {
        let now = Utc.with_ymd_and_hms(2026, 10, 13, 14, 32, 0).unwrap();
        let mut d = device(DeviceStatus::Running);
        d.runtime = Some(DeviceRuntime {
            pid: 1,
            console_port: 5556,
            adb_serial: "emulator-5556".into(),
            grpc_port: 8554,
            started_at: Utc.with_ymd_and_hms(2026, 10, 13, 12, 18, 0).unwrap(),
        });
        let mut info = DeviceInfo::new(d);
        assert_eq!(status_label(&info, now), "Running · 2\u{a0}h 14\u{a0}m");
        info.device.status = DeviceStatus::Booting;
        info.boot_progress = Some(0.62);
        assert_eq!(status_label(&info, now), "Booting Android… 62%");
        info.busy_holder = Some("CLI".into());
        assert_eq!(status_label(&info, now), "Busy · in use by CLI");
        assert_eq!(device_vm(&info, &utc(now)).state, DevState::Busy);
    }

    #[test]
    fn root_states_are_distinct() {
        let mut info = DeviceInfo::new(device(DeviceStatus::Stopped));
        assert_eq!(root_labels(&info).0, RootKind::None);
        info.device.root.mode = RootMode::Adb;
        assert_eq!(root_labels(&info).1, "Shell root (adb)");
        info.device.root.mode = RootMode::Magisk;
        assert_eq!(root_labels(&info).0, RootKind::Full);
        info.device.root.health = RootHealth::Ok;
        info.device.root.magisk_version = Some("30.7".into());
        assert_eq!(root_labels(&info).1, "Rooted · Magisk 30.7");
        info.device.root.health = RootHealth::Failed;
        assert_eq!(root_labels(&info).0, RootKind::Failed);
        info.root_job = true;
        assert_eq!(root_labels(&info).0, RootKind::SettingUp);
    }

    #[test]
    fn play_store_full_root_is_beta() {
        let mut info = DeviceInfo::new(device(DeviceStatus::Stopped));
        info.device.image.tag = "google_apis_playstore".into();
        info.device.root.mode = RootMode::Magisk;
        let vm = device_vm(&info, &Clock::system());
        assert!(vm.beta);
        assert_eq!(vm.image, "Play Store");
    }

    #[test]
    fn cross_mode_snapshots_are_refused() {
        let s = jidr_core::Snapshot {
            name: "Clean install".into(),
            root_mode: RootMode::Magisk,
            magisk_version: Some("30.7".into()),
            created_at: Utc::now(),
        };
        assert!(snapshot_vm(&s, RootMode::None, None, &Clock::system()).refused);
        assert!(!snapshot_vm(&s, RootMode::Magisk, None, &Clock::system()).refused);
        let quick = jidr_core::Snapshot {
            name: "default_boot".into(),
            ..s
        };
        let vm = snapshot_vm(&quick, RootMode::None, None, &Clock::system());
        assert!(vm.auto && !vm.refused);
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Offscreen rendering for golden snapshots: Slint's software renderer on a
//! `MinimalSoftwareWindow`, so no display, GPU or event loop is needed.

use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::path::Path;
use std::rc::Rc;

use slint::platform::software_renderer::{MinimalSoftwareWindow, RepaintBufferType};
use slint::platform::{Platform, WindowAdapter, WindowEvent};
use slint::{PlatformError, Rgba8Pixel, SharedPixelBuffer};

thread_local! {
    static LAST: RefCell<Option<Rc<MinimalSoftwareWindow>>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
}

struct OffscreenPlatform;

impl Platform for OffscreenPlatform {
    fn create_window_adapter(&self) -> Result<Rc<dyn WindowAdapter>, PlatformError> {
        let w = MinimalSoftwareWindow::new(RepaintBufferType::NewBuffer);
        LAST.with(|c| *c.borrow_mut() = Some(w.clone()));
        Ok(w)
    }
}

/// Installs the offscreen platform. Call once, before creating components.
pub fn init() -> Result<(), String> {
    slint::platform::set_platform(Box::new(OffscreenPlatform)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

/// Renders `window` at `width`×`height` logical px (scale 1).
pub fn render(
    window: &slint::Window,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
) -> Result<SharedPixelBuffer<Rgba8Pixel>, PlatformError> {
    window.dispatch_event(WindowEvent::ScaleFactorChanged { scale_factor: 1.0 });
    window.set_size(slint::PhysicalSize::new(width, height));
    slint::platform::update_timers_and_animations();
    window.take_snapshot()
}

pub fn write_png(path: &Path, buf: &SharedPixelBuffer<Rgba8Pixel>) -> Result<(), String> {
    if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }
    let file = std::fs::File::create(path).map_err(|e| format!("{}: {e}", path.display()))?;
    let mut enc = png::Encoder::new(std::io::BufWriter::new(file), buf.width(), buf.height());
    enc.set_color(png::ColorType::Rgba);
    enc.set_depth(png::BitDepth::Eight);
    enc.set_compression(png::Compression::High);
    let mut w = enc.write_header().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    w.write_image_data(buf.as_bytes())
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

/// Reads an RGBA8 PNG as (width, height, pixels).
pub fn read_png(path: &Path) -> Result<(u32, u32, Vec<u8>), String> {
    let file = std::fs::File::open(path).map_err(|e| format!("{}: {e}", path.display()))?;
    let mut dec = png::Decoder::new(std::io::BufReader::new(file));
    dec.set_transformations(png::Transformations::EXPAND);
    let mut reader = dec.read_info().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let size = reader
        .output_buffer_size()
        .ok_or_else(|| "PNG too large".to_string())?;
    let mut data = vec![0; size];
    let info = reader.next_frame(&mut data).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    data.truncate(info.buffer_size());
    if info.color_type != png::ColorType::Rgba {
        return Err(format!("{}: not RGBA", path.display()));
    }
    Ok((info.width, info.height, data))
}

/// Result of comparing a render with its golden.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub struct Diff {
    pub differing: usize,
    pub total: usize,
}

impl Diff {
    pub fn ratio(&self) -> f64 {
        self.differing as f64 / self.total.max(1) as f64
    }
}

/// Pixels whose channels differ by more than `tolerance`. Size mismatches
/// count every pixel.
pub fn diff(actual: &[u8], expected: &[u8], tolerance: u8) -> Diff {
    let total = actual.len().max(expected.len()) / 4;
    if actual.len() != expected.len() {
        return Diff {
            differing: total,
            total,
        };
    }
    let differing = actual
        .as_chunks::<4>()
        .0
        .iter()
        .zip(expected.as_chunks::<4>().0)
        .filter(|(a, e)| {
            a.iter()
                .zip(e.iter())
                .any(|(x, y)| x.abs_diff(*y) > tolerance)
        })
        .count();
    Diff { differing, total }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn diff_counts_pixels_over_tolerance() {
        let a = [10, 10, 10, 255, 0, 0, 0, 255];
        let b = [12, 10, 10, 255, 0, 90, 0, 255];
        assert_eq!(
            diff(&a, &b, 4),
            Diff {
                differing: 1,
                total: 2
            }
        );
        assert_eq!(diff(&a, &b[..4], 4).differing, 2);
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Command palette (⌘K): every launcher action plus one entry per device,
//! fuzzy-filtered (letters in order, case-insensitive).

use crate::{DevState, DeviceVm, PaletteItem, PaletteKind};

fn item(kind: PaletteKind, title: &str, subtitle: &str, kbd: &str, action: String) -> PaletteItem {
    PaletteItem {
        kind,
        title: title.into(),
        subtitle: subtitle.into(),
        kbd: kbd.into(),
        action: action.into(),
        state: DevState::Stopped,
    }
}

/// All entries for the current devices.
pub fn items(devices: &[DeviceVm], sdk_ready: bool) -> Vec<PaletteItem> {
    let mut v = Vec::new();
    for d in devices {
        let mut open = item(
            PaletteKind::Device,
            &format!("Open {}", d.name),
            &d.status,
            "",
            format!("open:{}", d.id),
        );
        open.state = d.state;
        v.push(open);
    }
    if !sdk_ready {
        v.push(item(
            PaletteKind::Action,
            "Set up Android SDK",
            "Find or install the emulator and an image",
            "⌘↵",
            "setup".into(),
        ));
    }
    v.push(item(
        PaletteKind::Action,
        "New device",
        "Create a device from a profile",
        "⌘N",
        "new".into(),
    ));
    for d in devices {
        match d.state {
            DevState::Stopped | DevState::Crashed => v.push(item(
                PaletteKind::Action,
                &format!("Start {}", d.name),
                &d.android,
                "",
                format!("start:{}", d.id),
            )),
            DevState::Running | DevState::Booting | DevState::Starting => v.push(item(
                PaletteKind::Action,
                &format!("Stop {}", d.name),
                "Saves a quick-boot snapshot",
                "",
                format!("stop:{}", d.id),
            )),
            _ => {}
        }
        if d.state == DevState::Stopped {
            v.push(item(
                PaletteKind::Action,
                &format!("Edit {}", d.name),
                "Name, RAM, CPU, screen",
                "",
                format!("edit:{}", d.id),
            ));
        }
    }
    v.push(item(
        PaletteKind::Setting,
        "Settings",
        "SDK, storage, agents, about",
        "⌘,",
        "settings".into(),
    ));
    v.push(item(
        PaletteKind::Setting,
        "Add Jidr to Claude",
        "MCP setup",
        "",
        "settings:agents".into(),
    ));
    v.push(item(
        PaletteKind::Setting,
        "Toggle light and dark",
        "Appearance",
        "",
        "appearance".into(),
    ));
    v
}

/// Letters of `query` appear in `text` in order (case-insensitive).
pub fn matches(text: &str, query: &str) -> bool {
    let mut t = text.chars().flat_map(char::to_lowercase);
    query
        .chars()
        .filter(|c| !c.is_whitespace())
        .flat_map(char::to_lowercase)
        .all(|q| t.any(|c| c == q))
}

/// Entries matching `query`; contiguous matches first.
pub fn filter(all: &[PaletteItem], query: &str) -> Vec<PaletteItem> {
    let q = query.trim().to_lowercase();
    if q.is_empty() {
        return all.to_vec();
    }
    let mut v: Vec<(bool, PaletteItem)> = all
        .iter()
        .filter(|i| matches(&i.title, &q) || matches(&i.subtitle, &q))
        .map(|i| (!i.title.to_lowercase().contains(&q), i.clone()))
        .collect();
    v.sort_by_key(|(rank, _)| *rank);
    v.into_iter().map(|(_, i)| i).collect()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn fuzzy_matching_is_ordered_and_case_insensitive() {
        assert!(matches("Open Pixel-ish 6.1", "pix61"));
        assert!(matches("New device", "nd"));
        assert!(!matches("New device", "dn"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn devices_get_open_and_lifecycle_entries() {
        let devices = crate::fixtures::devices();
        let all = items(&devices, true);
        assert!(
            all.iter()
                .any(|i| i.action == format!("open:{}", devices[0].id).as_str())
        );
        assert!(all.iter().any(|i| i.title == "Stop Pixel-ish 6.1"));
        assert!(all.iter().any(|i| i.title == "Start Tablet 11"));
        let f = filter(&all, "tablet");
        assert!(f.iter().all(|i| i.title.to_lowercase().contains("tablet")
            || i.subtitle.to_lowercase().contains("tablet")));
        assert_eq!(filter(&all, "").len(), all.len());
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-ui/src/player/bench.rs`:

```rs
//! Dev-only measurement for the Phase 7c player check. With
//! `JIDR_PLAYER_BENCH=<report file>` the player opens Settings and drives
//! 30 s of scrolling through its own input path (the same channel the
//! mouse uses), then writes fps and touch→frame numbers. With
//! `JIDR_PLAYER_DROP=<file>` it then handles that file as if dropped.

use std::rc::Rc;
use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use serde_json::json;
use slint::ComponentHandle;

use super::input::{self, Screen};
use super::session::{lock, percentile};
use crate::app::Ctx;

/// Seconds of scrolling (default 30, `JIDR_PLAYER_BENCH_SECS`).
fn seconds() -> u64 {
    std::env::var("JIDR_PLAYER_BENCH_SECS")
        .ok()
        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
        .unwrap_or(30)
}

fn cpu_seconds(pid: u32) -> f64 {
    std::process::Command::new("ps")
        .args(["-o", "time=", "-p", &pid.to_string()])
        .output()
        .map(|o| {
            String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stdout)
                .trim()
                .split(':')
                .fold(0.0, |acc, part| {
                    acc * 60.0 + part.parse::<f64>().unwrap_or(0.0)
                })
        })
        .unwrap_or(0.0)
}

pub fn start(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    let report_path = std::env::var_os("JIDR_PLAYER_BENCH");
    let drop_path = std::env::var_os("JIDR_PLAYER_DROP");
    let Some((tx, stats, native, device)) = ctx
        .player
        .borrow()
        .session
        .as_ref()
        .map(|s| (s.input.clone(), s.stats.clone(), s.native, s.device))
    else {
        return;
    };
    let bridge = ctx.bridge.clone();
    let scale = ctx.app.window().scale_factor();
    let drop_token = crate::app::defer(move |path: std::path::PathBuf| {
        if let Some(c) = crate::app::ctx() {
            super::handle_drop(&c, &path);
        }
    });
    ctx.bridge.handle().spawn(async move {
        // Wait for the first frame.
        for _ in 0..100 {
            if stats.received.load(Ordering::Relaxed) > 0 {
                break;
            }
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
        }
        if let Some(out) = report_path {
            let (done_tx, done_rx) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel();
            bridge.call(
                "app.launch",
                json!({ "device": device, "package": "com.android.settings" }),
                move |r| {
                    let _ = done_tx.send(r);
                },
            );
            let _ = done_rx.await;
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(3)).await;
            lock(&stats.arrivals).clear();
            lock(&stats.latencies).clear();
            lock(&stats.ages).clear();
            let (r0, s0, b0) = (
                stats.received.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
                stats.shown.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
                stats.bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
            );
            let pid = std::process::id();
            let cpu0 = cpu_seconds(pid);
            let screen = Screen {
                width: native.width,
                height: native.height,
            };
            let secs = seconds();
            let t0 = Instant::now();
            let mut up = true;
            let mut intervals_ms: Vec<f32> = Vec::new();
            while t0.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(secs) {
                let (y0, y1) = if up { (0.78, 0.30) } else { (0.30, 0.78) };
                up = !up;
                let steps = 30;
                for i in 0..=steps {
                    let y = y0 + (y1 - y0) * i as f32 / steps as f32;
                    let p = screen.to_px(0.5, y);
                    if i == 1 {
                        let mut t = lock(&stats.touch_sent);
                        if t.is_none() {
                            *t = Some(Instant::now());
                        }
                    }
                    let _ = tx.send(input::touch_event(&[(1, p.0, p.1)], true));
                    tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
                }
                let p = screen.to_px(0.5, y1);
                let _ = tx.send(input::touch_event(&[(1, p.0, p.1)], false));
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(150)).await;
            }
            let dt = t0.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
            {
                let q = lock(&stats.arrivals);
                intervals_ms.extend(
                    q.iter()
                        .zip(q.iter().skip(1))
                        .map(|(a, b)| b.duration_since(*a).as_secs_f32() * 1000.0)
                        .filter(|ms| *ms < 100.0),
                );
            }
            let received = stats.received.load(Ordering::Relaxed) - r0;
            let shown = stats.shown.load(Ordering::Relaxed) - s0;
            let mb = (stats.bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed) - b0) as f64 / 1e6;
            let cpu = (cpu_seconds(pid) - cpu0) / dt * 100.0;
            let mut lat: Vec<f32> = lock(&stats.latencies).iter().copied().collect();
            let mut ages: Vec<f32> = lock(&stats.ages).iter().copied().collect();
            let frame = *lock(&stats.frame);
            let med = percentile(&mut intervals_ms.clone(), 0.5)
                .map(|m| 1000.0 / m)
                .unwrap_or(0.0);
            let p10 = percentile(&mut intervals_ms, 0.9)
                .map(|m| 1000.0 / m)
                .unwrap_or(0.0);
            let text = format!(
                "player bench: {secs} s of scrolling Settings through the player's input path\n\
                 window scale {scale:.1}, frames {}×{} RGBA8888\n\
                 active fps: median {med:.1}, p10 {p10:.1}\n\
                 received {:.1} fps, shown {:.1} fps, {:.0} MB/s\n\
                 frame age (emulator ts → shown): median {:.1} ms, p90 {:.1} ms\n\
                 touch → next frame: median {:.1} ms, p90 {:.1} ms ({} drags)\n\
                 player CPU {cpu:.0}%\n",
                frame.0,
                frame.1,
                received as f64 / dt,
                shown as f64 / dt,
                mb / dt,
                percentile(&mut ages.clone(), 0.5).unwrap_or(f32::NAN),
                percentile(&mut ages, 0.9).unwrap_or(f32::NAN),
                percentile(&mut lat.clone(), 0.5).unwrap_or(f32::NAN),
                percentile(&mut lat, 0.9).unwrap_or(f32::NAN),
                lock(&stats.latencies).len(),
            );
            eprint!("{text}");
            let _ = std::fs::write(&out, text);
        }
        if let Some(p) = drop_path {
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
            crate::app::fire(drop_token, std::path::PathBuf::from(p));
        }
    });
}
```

`crates/jidr-ui/src/player/drop.rs`:

```rs
//! What a file dropped on the device does (plan 7c, D35).

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum DropAction {
    /// `file.install` (replace, keep data), then launch it.
    InstallApk(PathBuf),
    /// Full-root device: `root.module.install` + reboot (D35).
    MagiskModule(PathBuf),
    /// Anything else, or a zip without Full root: `file.push` to Download.
    Push {
        path: PathBuf,
        note: Option<&'static str>,
    },
}

pub fn classify(path: &Path, full_root: bool) -> DropAction {
    let ext = path
        .extension()
        .and_then(|e| e.to_str())
        .map(str::to_ascii_lowercase)
        .unwrap_or_default();
    match ext.as_str() {
        "apk" => DropAction::InstallApk(path.to_path_buf()),
        "zip" if full_root => DropAction::MagiskModule(path.to_path_buf()),
        "zip" => DropAction::Push {
            path: path.to_path_buf(),
            note: Some("Magisk modules need Full root, so it was copied to Download."),
        },
        _ => DropAction::Push {
            path: path.to_path_buf(),
            note: None,
        },
    }
}

/// Title and body for the drop label while a file hovers (the device design).
pub fn hover_text(action: &DropAction, device: &str) -> (String, String) {
    let name = |p: &Path| {
        p.file_name()
            .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
            .unwrap_or_default()
    };
    match action {
        DropAction::InstallApk(p) => (
            format!("Release to install {}", name(p)),
            format!(
                "adb install -r on {device}. Replaces the installed version and keeps its data."
            ),
        ),
        DropAction::MagiskModule(p) => (
            format!("Release to install {} as a Magisk module", name(p)),
            "Installs the module and reboots the device (about 40 s).".into(),
        ),
        DropAction::Push { path, note } => (
            format!("Release to copy {}", name(path)),
            match note {
                Some(n) => (*n).to_string(),
                None => format!("Goes to /sdcard/Download on {device}."),
            },
        ),
    }
}

/// Signature mismatch from `adb install -r`: the user may reinstall
/// (which deletes the app's data).
pub fn is_signature_mismatch(message: &str) -> bool {
    message.contains("INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE")
        || message.contains("signatures do not match")
        || message.contains("INSTALL_FAILED_SHARED_USER_INCOMPATIBLE")
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn drops_route_by_type_and_root() {
        assert_eq!(
            classify(Path::new("/x/shop.APK"), false),
            DropAction::InstallApk("/x/shop.APK".into())
        );
        assert_eq!(
            classify(Path::new("/x/m.zip"), true),
            DropAction::MagiskModule("/x/m.zip".into())
        );
        assert!(matches!(
            classify(Path::new("/x/m.zip"), false),
            DropAction::Push { note: Some(_), .. }
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            classify(Path::new("/x/a.png"), true),
            DropAction::Push { note: None, .. }
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn hover_copy_matches_design() {
        let (t, b) = hover_text(
            &DropAction::InstallApk("/x/shop-debug.apk".into()),
            "Pixel-ish 6.1",
        );
        assert_eq!(t, "Release to install shop-debug.apk");
        assert_eq!(
            b,
            "adb install -r on Pixel-ish 6.1. Replaces the installed version and keeps its data."
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn signature_mismatch_is_detected() {
        assert!(is_signature_mismatch(
            "adb: failed to install x.apk: Failure [INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE: Package com.x signatures do not match previously installed version; ignoring!]"
        ));
        assert!(!is_signature_mismatch(
            "Failure [INSTALL_FAILED_INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE]"
        ));
    }
}
```
