`crates/jidr-ui/src/player/input.rs`:

```rs
//! Window input → emulator input: touch points in device pixels, gestures
//! with modifiers, keys as W3C key names, wheel.

use jidr_proto::control as pb;

/// Device size in pixels in its current orientation.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Screen {
    pub width: u32,
    pub height: u32,
}

impl Screen {
    /// Normalized (0..1) → device pixels, clamped to the screen.
    pub fn to_px(&self, nx: f32, ny: f32) -> (i32, i32) {
        let x = (nx.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * self.width as f32).min(self.width.saturating_sub(1) as f32);
        let y = (ny.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * self.height as f32).min(self.height.saturating_sub(1) as f32);
        (x as i32, y as i32)
    }

    /// A pixel of the screen as shown, turned `quarter` quarter turns (the
    /// frame's `ImageFormat.rotation`) → the same pixel on this, the
    /// unrotated panel. Frames come rotated to how the device is held, but
    /// the emulator reads touches in panel pixels.
    pub fn unrotate(&self, quarter: u32, (x, y): (i32, i32)) -> (i32, i32) {
        let (r, b) = (self.width as i32 - 1, self.height as i32 - 1);
        match quarter % 4 {
            1 => (r - y, x),
            2 => (r - x, b - y),
            3 => (y, b - x),
            _ => (x, y),
        }
    }
}

/// Panel touch points (id, x, y) for a pointer at normalized (`nx`, `ny`)
/// of the shown frame: `shown` is the screen as the frame shows it, `panel`
/// the device's own pixels, `quarter` the frame's rotation.
pub fn panel_touches(
    g: Gesture,
    panel: Screen,
    shown: Screen,
    quarter: u32,
    (nx, ny): (f32, f32),
) -> Vec<(i32, i32, i32)> {
    fingers(g, shown, shown.to_px(nx, ny))
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(id, x, y)| {
            let (x, y) = panel.unrotate(quarter, (x, y));
            (id, x, y)
        })
        .collect()
}

/// Multi-touch with modifiers (our own bindings; Genymotion's aren't public).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub enum Gesture {
    #[default]
    Single,
    /// ⌥ drag: a second finger mirrors the first around the screen centre
    /// (pinch / zoom / rotate).
    Pinch,
    /// ⇧⌥ drag: a second finger follows at a fixed offset (two-finger pan).
    Pan,
}

impl Gesture {
    pub fn from_mods(alt: bool, shift: bool) -> Self {
        match (alt, shift) {
            (true, true) => Gesture::Pan,
            (true, false) => Gesture::Pinch,
            _ => Gesture::Single,
        }
    }
}

/// Touch points (id, x, y) for a pointer at `p` under `g`.
pub fn fingers(g: Gesture, screen: Screen, p: (i32, i32)) -> Vec<(i32, i32, i32)> {
    let (w, h) = (screen.width as i32, screen.height as i32);
    let clamp = |x: i32, max: i32| x.clamp(0, (max - 1).max(0));
    match g {
        Gesture::Single => vec![(1, p.0, p.1)],
        Gesture::Pinch => vec![(1, p.0, p.1), (2, clamp(w - p.0, w), clamp(h - p.1, h))],
        Gesture::Pan => {
            let dx = (w / 8).max(40);
            vec![(1, p.0, p.1), (2, clamp(p.0 + dx, w), p.1)]
        }
    }
}

/// A touch event; `down == false` lifts every finger (pressure 0).
pub fn touch_event(points: &[(i32, i32, i32)], down: bool) -> pb::InputEvent {
    pb::InputEvent {
        r#type: Some(pb::input_event::Type::TouchEvent(pb::TouchEvent {
            touches: points
                .iter()
                .map(|&(id, x, y)| pb::Touch {
                    x,
                    y,
                    identifier: id,
                    pressure: if down { 100 } else { 0 },
                    touch_major: if down { 5 } else { 0 },
                    expiration: pb::touch::EventExpiration::NeverExpire as i32,
                    ..Default::default()
                })
                .collect(),
            display: 0,
        })),
    }
}

/// Slint's key text → W3C `KeyboardEvent.key` for non-printing keys.
pub fn special_key(text: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {
    Some(match text {
        "\u{8}" => "Backspace",
        "\t" => "Tab",
        "\n" | "\r" => "Enter",
        "\u{1b}" => "Escape",
        "\u{7f}" => "Delete",
        "\u{f700}" => "ArrowUp",
        "\u{f701}" => "ArrowDown",
        "\u{f702}" => "ArrowLeft",
        "\u{f703}" => "ArrowRight",
        "\u{f729}" => "Home",
        "\u{f72b}" => "End",
        "\u{f72c}" => "PageUp",
        "\u{f72d}" => "PageDown",
        _ => return None,
    })
}

/// Modifier-only key presses that shouldn't reach the device.
fn is_modifier(text: &str) -> bool {
    matches!(
        text,
        "\u{10}"
            | "\u{11}"
            | "\u{12}"
            | "\u{13}"
            | "\u{14}"
            | "\u{15}"
            | "\u{16}"
            | "\u{17}"
            | "\u{18}"
    )
}

/// A key press or release → emulator keyboard event (printable text is
/// sent once, on press).
pub fn key_event(text: &str, down: bool) -> Option<pb::KeyboardEvent> {
    if text.is_empty() || is_modifier(text) {
        return None;
    }
    if let Some(key) = special_key(text) {
        return Some(pb::KeyboardEvent {
            code_type: pb::keyboard_event::KeyCodeType::Usb as i32,
            event_type: if down {
                pb::keyboard_event::KeyEventType::Keydown as i32
            } else {
                pb::keyboard_event::KeyEventType::Keyup as i32
            },
            key: key.into(),
            ..Default::default()
        });
    }
    // Private-use codes are other function keys we don't map.
    if text
        .chars()
        .any(|c| ('\u{e000}'..='\u{f8ff}').contains(&c) || c.is_control())
        || !down
    {
        return None;
    }
    Some(pb::KeyboardEvent {
        code_type: pb::keyboard_event::KeyCodeType::Usb as i32,
        event_type: pb::keyboard_event::KeyEventType::Keypress as i32,
        text: text.into(),
        ..Default::default()
    })
}

/// Toolbar buttons that are hardware keys (`key.press` names).
pub fn tool_key(tool: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {
    Some(match tool {
        "back" => "back",
        "home" => "home",
        "recents" => "recents",
        "volume-up" => "volume_up",
        "volume-down" => "volume_down",
        "power" => "power",
        _ => return None,
    })
}

/// Window scroll (logical px, macOS natural direction) → wheel clicks.
pub fn wheel(dx: f32, dy: f32) -> pb::WheelEvent {
    // About 40 px per notch; the emulator wants 120 units per notch.
    pb::WheelEvent {
        dx: (dx * 3.0).round() as i32,
        dy: (dy * 3.0).round() as i32,
        display: 0,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const S: Screen = Screen {
        width: 1080,
        height: 2400,
    };

    #[test]
    fn normalized_points_map_to_device_pixels() {
        assert_eq!(S.to_px(0.5, 0.5), (540, 1200));
        assert_eq!(S.to_px(-1.0, 2.0), (0, 2399));
        assert_eq!(S.to_px(1.0, 1.0), (1079, 2399));
    }

    const TABLET: Screen = Screen {
        width: 1600,
        height: 2560,
    };

    /// The panel as a frame turned `quarter` quarter turns shows it.
    fn turned(panel: Screen, quarter: u32) -> Screen {
        if quarter % 2 == 1 {
            Screen {
                width: panel.height,
                height: panel.width,
            }
        } else {
            panel
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn shown_corners_map_to_panel_corners_in_every_rotation() {
        for panel in [S, TABLET] {
            let (r, b) = (panel.width as i32 - 1, panel.height as i32 - 1);
            // Clockwise from the top left.
            let panel_corners = [(0, 0), (r, 0), (r, b), (0, b)];
            for q in 0..4 {
                let shown = turned(panel, q);
                let (sr, sb) = (shown.width as i32 - 1, shown.height as i32 - 1);
                let shown_corners = [(0, 0), (sr, 0), (sr, sb), (0, sb)];
                for (i, c) in shown_corners.into_iter().enumerate() {
                    assert_eq!(
                        panel.unrotate(q, c),
                        panel_corners[(i + q as usize) % 4],
                        "{panel:?}, {q} quarter turns, shown corner {c:?}"
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn touches_stay_on_the_panel_in_every_rotation() {
        // Regression for #51: in landscape the player sent x up to 2559 on
        // a 1600-wide tablet panel, so taps landed elsewhere or nowhere.
        for panel in [S, TABLET] {
            for q in 0..4 {
                let shown = turned(panel, q);
                for i in 0..=10 {
                    for j in 0..=10 {
                        let n = (i as f32 / 10.0, j as f32 / 10.0);
                        for g in [Gesture::Single, Gesture::Pinch, Gesture::Pan] {
                            for (_, x, y) in panel_touches(g, panel, shown, q, n) {
                                assert!(
                                    (0..panel.width as i32).contains(&x)
                                        && (0..panel.height as i32).contains(&y),
                                    "{panel:?}, {q} quarter turns, {n:?}: ({x}, {y})"
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn landscape_tablet_taps_land_under_the_pointer() {
        // Measured on a Tablet 11″ AVD with pointer location on (#51):
        // (quarter turns, panel touch sent, where the device showed it).
        // Mapping the shown point back must give the panel point.
        for (q, sent, seen) in [
            (1, (640, 200), (200, 960)),
            (2, (400, 320), (1200, 2240)),
            (3, (640, 200), (2360, 640)),
        ] {
            let (x, y) = TABLET.unrotate(q, seen);
            assert!(
                (x - sent.0).abs() <= 1 && (y - sent.1).abs() <= 1,
                "{q} quarter turns: ({x}, {y}), want {sent:?}"
            );
        }
        // A quarter of the way across and an eighth down a landscape frame.
        let shown = turned(TABLET, 1);
        assert_eq!(
            panel_touches(Gesture::Single, TABLET, shown, 1, (0.25, 0.125)),
            vec![(1, 1399, 640)]
        );
        // Upright, nothing changes.
        assert_eq!(
            panel_touches(Gesture::Single, S, S, 0, (0.5, 0.5)),
            vec![(1, 540, 1200)]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn gestures_add_a_second_finger() {
        assert_eq!(fingers(Gesture::Single, S, (100, 200)), vec![(1, 100, 200)]);
        assert_eq!(
            fingers(Gesture::Pinch, S, (100, 200)),
            vec![(1, 100, 200), (2, 980, 2200)]
        );
        let pan = fingers(Gesture::Pan, S, (100, 200));
        assert_eq!(pan[1], (2, 235, 200));
        assert_eq!(Gesture::from_mods(true, true), Gesture::Pan);
        assert_eq!(Gesture::from_mods(false, true), Gesture::Single);
    }

    #[test]
    fn touch_release_has_zero_pressure() {
        let ev = touch_event(&[(1, 10, 20)], false);
        let Some(pb::input_event::Type::TouchEvent(t)) = ev.r#type else {
            panic!()
        };
        assert_eq!(t.touches[0].pressure, 0);
        assert_eq!(
            t.touches[0].expiration,
            pb::touch::EventExpiration::NeverExpire as i32
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn keys_map_to_w3c_names_and_text() {
        let k = key_event("\u{8}", true).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(k.key, "Backspace");
        assert_eq!(
            k.event_type,
            pb::keyboard_event::KeyEventType::Keydown as i32
        );
        assert_eq!(key_event("\u{f702}", false).unwrap().key, "ArrowLeft");
        let a = key_event("a", true).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(a.text, "a");
        assert!(key_event("a", false).is_none());
        assert!(key_event("\u{10}", true).is_none());
        assert!(key_event("\u{f704}", true).is_none());
        assert_eq!(tool_key("volume-up"), Some("volume_up"));
        assert_eq!(tool_key("screenshot"), None);
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Logcat lines (threadtime format) for the device window's logcat panel.

use crate::LogLine;

/// Keep this many lines in memory per device.
pub const KEEP: usize = 5000;

/// `10-13 14:02:07.318  4821  4821 I ActivityManager: Start proc …`
pub fn parse(line: &str) -> Option<LogLine> {
    let mut it = line.split_whitespace();
    let date = it.next()?;
    let time = it.next()?;
    let pid = it.next()?;
    let _tid = it.next()?;
    let level = it.next()?;
    if date.len() != 5
        || !time.contains(':')
        || level.len() != 1
        || !pid.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit())
    {
        return None;
    }
    // The rest is "Tag: message"; tags may contain spaces before the colon.
    let after_level = line.find(&format!(" {level} "))? + 3;
    let rest = line.get(after_level..)?.trim_start();
    let (tag, msg) = rest.split_once(':').unwrap_or((rest, ""));
    Some(LogLine {
        ts: format!("{date} {time}").into(),
        pid: pid.into(),
        level: level.into(),
        tag: tag.trim().into(),
        msg: msg.trim_start().into(),
    })
}

pub fn level_rank(level: &str) -> usize {
    match level {
        "V" => 0,
        "D" => 1,
        "I" => 2,
        "W" => 3,
        "E" => 4,
        "F" | "A" => 5,
        _ => 0,
    }
}

/// Lines at or above `min_level` (0 = V … 5 = F) that contain `filter` in
/// the tag, pid or message (case-insensitive).
pub fn visible(lines: &[LogLine], min_level: usize, filter: &str) -> Vec<LogLine> {
    let f = filter.trim().to_lowercase();
    lines
        .iter()
        .filter(|l| level_rank(&l.level) >= min_level)
        .filter(|l| {
            f.is_empty()
                || l.tag.to_lowercase().contains(&f)
                || l.pid.contains(&f)
                || l.msg.to_lowercase().contains(&f)
        })
        .cloned()
        .collect()
}

/// "E AndroidRuntime  FATAL EXCEPTION: main" for the collapsed bar.
pub fn short(l: &LogLine) -> String {
    format!("{} {}  {}", l.level, l.tag, l.msg)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn parses_threadtime_lines() {
        let l = parse("10-13 14:02:07.318  4821  4821 I ActivityManager: Start proc 4821:com.example.shop/u0a190").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(l.ts, "10-13 14:02:07.318");
        assert_eq!(l.pid, "4821");
        assert_eq!(l.level, "I");
        assert_eq!(l.tag, "ActivityManager");
        assert_eq!(l.msg, "Start proc 4821:com.example.shop/u0a190");
        assert!(parse("--------- beginning of main").is_none());
        assert!(parse("").is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn filters_by_level_and_text() {
        let lines: Vec<_> = [
            "10-13 14:02:07.318  4821  4821 I ActivityManager: Start proc",
            "10-13 14:02:08.115  1288  1288 W Magisk: su: request from uid 10190",
            "10-13 14:02:08.640  4821  4821 E AndroidRuntime: FATAL EXCEPTION: main",
        ]
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|l| parse(l))
        .collect();
        assert_eq!(visible(&lines, 3, "").len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(visible(&lines, 0, "magisk").len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(visible(&lines, 0, "4821").len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(short(&lines[2]), "E AndroidRuntime  FATAL EXCEPTION: main");
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-ui/src/player/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! The device window (Phase 7c): a session per active device tab, input,
//! toolbar, drag-drop, shared clipboard, logcat and the debug overlay.

pub mod bench;
pub mod drop;
pub mod input;
pub mod logcat;
pub mod session;

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::rc::Rc;
use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;
use std::time::Duration;

use jidr_core::{ConnectInfo, DeviceStatus, RootMode};
use jidr_proto::control as pb;
use serde_json::json;
use slint::{ComponentHandle, ModelRc, VecModel};
use tokio::task::JoinHandle;
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::LogLine;
use crate::app::{Ctx, report, toast};
use input::{Gesture, Screen};
use session::{Session, lock, oriented, request_size};

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Player {
    pub session: Option<Session>,
    opening: Option<Uuid>,
    gesture: Gesture,
    quarter: i32,
    logical: (f32, f32),
    overlay: Option<slint::Timer>,
    log_device: Option<Uuid>,
    log_task: Option<JoinHandle<()>>,
    pub log_lines: Vec<LogLine>,
    log_dirty: bool,
    log_timer: Option<slint::Timer>,
    bench_started: bool,
}

impl Drop for Player {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if let Some(t) = self.log_task.take() {
            t.abort();
        }
    }
}

/// The active tab's device id.
pub fn active_id(ctx: &Ctx) -> Option<Uuid> {
    let st = ctx.state.borrow();
    st.active.and_then(|i| st.tabs.get(i)).copied()
}

/// The active tab's device id and whether it is running.
fn active_device(ctx: &Ctx) -> Option<(Uuid, bool, Screen, RootMode)> {
    let st = ctx.state.borrow();
    let id = st.active.and_then(|i| st.tabs.get(i)).copied()?;
    let info = st.data.devices.iter().find(|d| d.device.id == id)?;
    let running = matches!(info.device.status, DeviceStatus::Running);
    let screen = Screen {
        width: info.width.max(1),
        height: info.height.max(1),
    };
    Some((id, running, screen, info.device.root.mode))
}

/// Makes the session match the active tab: open for a running device,
/// close otherwise. Called after every tab or data change.
pub fn sync(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    let active = active_device(ctx);
    crate::recording::show(ctx, active.as_ref().map(|a| a.0));
    let mut p = ctx.player.borrow_mut();
    let want = active.filter(|a| a.1).map(|a| a.0);
    if p.session.as_ref().map(|s| s.device) != want {
        p.session = None;
        ctx.app.set_player_has_frame(false);
        ctx.app.set_player_clipboard(false);
    }
    if p.log_device != want {
        if let Some(t) = p.log_task.take() {
            t.abort();
        }
        p.log_lines.clear();
        p.log_dirty = true;
        p.log_device = None;
    }
    let Some((id, _, screen, _)) = active.filter(|a| a.1) else {
        return;
    };
    if p.log_device.is_none() {
        p.log_device = Some(id);
        p.log_task = Some(follow_logcat(ctx, id));
    }
    if p.session.is_some() || p.opening == Some(id) {
        return;
    }
    p.opening = Some(id);
    let scale = ctx.app.window().scale_factor();
    ctx.app.set_player_scale(scale);
    let want_px = request_size(p.logical, scale, screen);
    drop(p);
    let weak = ctx.app.as_weak();
    let handle = ctx.bridge.handle();
    let c = ctx.clone();
    let token = crate::app::defer(move |r: jidr_core::JidrResult<Session>| {
        let still_active = |id| active_device(&c).filter(|a| a.1).map(|a| a.0) == Some(id);
        match r {
            Ok(s) => {
                let keep = still_active(s.device);
                let mut p = c.player.borrow_mut();
                p.opening = None;
                if keep {
                    p.session = Some(s);
                }
                drop(p);
                if keep {
                    crate::widgets::load(&c);
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                c.player.borrow_mut().opening = None;
                toast(
                    &c.app.as_weak(),
                    format!("Can't show the screen: {}", e.message),
                );
            }
        }
        drop_bench_hooks(&c);
    });
    ctx.bridge
        .call("device.connect_info", json!({ "device": id }), move |r| {
            let r = r.and_then(|v| {
                serde_json::from_value::<ConnectInfo>(v)
                    .map_err(|e| jidr_core::JidrError::unexpected(e.to_string()))
            });
            handle.spawn(async move {
                let s = match r {
                    Ok(info) => Session::open(id, info, screen, want_px, weak).await,
                    Err(e) => Err(e),
                };
                crate::app::fire(token, s);
            });
        });
}

fn with_session(ctx: &Ctx, f: impl FnOnce(&Session)) {
    if let Some(s) = ctx.player.borrow().session.as_ref() {
        f(s);
    }
}

fn current_screen(s: &Session) -> Screen {
    let frame = *lock(&s.stats.frame);
    if frame.0 == 0 {
        s.native
    } else {
        oriented(s.native, frame)
    }
}

fn spawn_key(ctx: &Ctx, ev: pb::KeyboardEvent) {
    with_session(ctx, |s| {
        let mut c = s.ctl.clone();
        ctx.bridge.handle().spawn(async move {
            let _ = c.send_key(ev).await;
        });
    });
}

pub fn wire(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    let app = &ctx.app;

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_player_pointer(move |kind, nx, ny, alt, shift| {
        let mut p = c.player.borrow_mut();
        if kind == 0 {
            p.gesture = Gesture::from_mods(alt, shift);
        }
        let g = p.gesture;
        let Some(s) = p.session.as_ref() else { return };
        let quarter = s.stats.quarter.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        let pts = input::panel_touches(g, s.native, current_screen(s), quarter, (nx, ny));
        s.send(input::touch_event(&pts, kind != 2), kind != 2);
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_player_wheel(move |dx, dy| {
        with_session(&c, |s| {
            let mut ctl = s.ctl.clone();
            let ev = input::wheel(dx, dy);
            c.bridge.handle().spawn(async move {
                let _ = ctl.inject_wheel(tokio_stream::iter(vec![ev])).await;
            });
        });
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_player_key(move |text, down| {
        if let Some(ev) = input::key_event(&text, down) {
            spawn_key(&c, ev);
        }
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_player_tool(move |tool| tool_action(&c, &tool));

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_player_start(move || {
        if let Some((id, ..)) = active_device(&c) {
            crate::launcher::start(&c, id);
        }
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_player_resized(move |w, h| {
        tracing::info!(w, h, "player screen resized");
        let Ok(mut p) = c.player.try_borrow_mut() else {
            return;
        };
        p.logical = (w, h);
        let scale = c.app.window().scale_factor();
        if let Some(s) = p.session.as_ref() {
            s.resize(request_size((w, h), scale, current_screen(s)));
        }
    });

    // Logcat panel.
    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_log_level_changed(move |_| refresh_log(&c));
    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_log_filter_changed(move |_| refresh_log(&c));
    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_log_clear(move || {
        c.player.borrow_mut().log_lines.clear();
        refresh_log(&c);
        if let Some((id, ..)) = active_device(&c) {
            c.bridge
                .call("logcat.clear", json!({ "device": id }), |_| {});
        }
    });
    let c = ctx.clone();
    app.on_log_toggle_follow(move || {
        let f = !c.app.get_log_following();
        c.app.set_log_following(f);
    });
    app.on_log_open(|_| {});

    // Refresh the logcat model at most 5× a second.
    let c = ctx.clone();
    let timer = slint::Timer::default();
    timer.start(
        slint::TimerMode::Repeated,
        Duration::from_millis(200),
        move || {
            let dirty = std::mem::take(&mut c.player.borrow_mut().log_dirty);
            if dirty {
                refresh_log(&c);
            }
        },
    );
    ctx.player.borrow_mut().log_timer = Some(timer);

    // Drag and drop from Finder (winit window events).
    let c = ctx.clone();
    {
        use slint::winit_030::{EventResult, WinitWindowAccessor, winit::event::WindowEvent};
        app.window().on_winit_window_event(move |_, ev| {
            match ev {
                WindowEvent::HoveredFile(p) => hover(&c, Some(p.clone())),
                WindowEvent::HoveredFileCancelled => hover(&c, None),
                WindowEvent::DroppedFile(p) => {
                    hover(&c, None);
                    handle_drop(&c, p);
                }
                _ => {}
            }
            EventResult::Propagate
        });
    }
}

/// Meta shortcuts that belong to the device tab.
pub fn shortcut(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, s: &str) -> bool {
    match s {
        "overlay" => toggle_overlay(ctx),
        "pixel-perfect" => {
            let v = !ctx.app.get_player_pixel_perfect();
            ctx.app.set_player_pixel_perfect(v);
        }
        "logcat" => {
            let v = !ctx.app.get_logcat_open();
            ctx.app.set_logcat_open(v);
        }
        "panel" => {
            let v = !ctx.app.get_player_panel_open();
            ctx.app.set_player_panel_open(v);
        }
        "screenshot" => tool_action(ctx, "screenshot"),
        _ => return false,
    }
    true
}

fn tool_action(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, tool: &str) {
    let Some((id, ..)) = active_device(ctx) else {
        return;
    };
    let w = ctx.app.as_weak();
    if let Some(key) = input::tool_key(tool) {
        // Same path as the CLI and MCP (`key.press`): hardware buttons go
        // in as evdev codes there.
        ctx.bridge.call(
            "key.press",
            json!({ "device": id, "key": key }),
            report(&w, ""),
        );
        return;
    }
    match tool {
        "rotate-left" | "rotate-right" => {
            let q = {
                let mut p = ctx.player.borrow_mut();
                p.quarter = (p.quarter + if tool == "rotate-left" { 1 } else { 3 }) % 4;
                p.quarter
            };
            let mut vm = ctx.app.get_widgets();
            vm.rotation = q;
            ctx.app.set_widgets(vm);
            ctx.bridge.call(
                "sensor.rotate",
                json!({ "device": id, "angle": 90 * q }),
                report(&w, ""),
            );
        }
        "screenshot" => crate::recording::screenshot(ctx, id),
        "record" => crate::recording::toggle(ctx, id),
        "clipboard" => {
            let on = {
                let mut p = ctx.player.borrow_mut();
                match p.session.as_mut() {
                    Some(s) => {
                        let on = !s.clipboard_sharing();
                        // The tasks run on the IO runtime.
                        let _guard = ctx.bridge.handle().enter();
                        s.set_clipboard_sharing(on);
                        on
                    }
                    None => false,
                }
            };
            ctx.app.set_player_clipboard(on);
            toast(
                &w,
                if on {
                    "Sharing the clipboard with the device"
                } else {
                    "Stopped sharing the clipboard"
                }
                .into(),
            );
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

use crate::recording::file_name;

fn toggle_overlay(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    let on = !ctx.app.get_player_overlay();
    ctx.app.set_player_overlay(on);
    let mut p = ctx.player.borrow_mut();
    if !on {
        p.overlay = None;
        return;
    }
    let c = ctx.clone();
    let mut last = (std::time::Instant::now(), 0u64, 0u64);
    let timer = slint::Timer::default();
    timer.start(slint::TimerMode::Repeated, Duration::from_millis(500), move || {
        let text = {
            let p = c.player.borrow();
            match p.session.as_ref() {
                Some(s) => {
                    let st = &s.stats;
                    let (r, sh) = (st.received.load(Ordering::Relaxed), st.shown.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
                    let dt = last.0.elapsed().as_secs_f32().max(0.001);
                    let line = format!(
                        "recv {:.0} fps · shown {:.0} fps · active {:.0} fps\nframe {}×{} · age {} · touch→frame {}",
                        (r - last.1) as f32 / dt,
                        (sh - last.2) as f32 / dt,
                        st.active_fps(),
                        lock(&st.frame).0,
                        lock(&st.frame).1,
                        st.median_age().map(|a| format!("{a:.1} ms")).unwrap_or_else(|| "—".into()),
                        st.median_latency().map(|a| format!("{a:.1} ms")).unwrap_or_else(|| "—".into()),
                    );
                    last = (std::time::Instant::now(), r, sh);
                    line
                }
                None => "no frames yet".into(),
            }
        };
        c.app.set_player_overlay_text(text.into());
    });
    p.overlay = Some(timer);
}

fn refresh_log(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    let p = ctx.player.borrow();
    let level = usize::try_from(ctx.app.get_log_level()).unwrap_or(1);
    let filter = ctx.app.get_log_filter().to_string();
    let vis = logcat::visible(&p.log_lines, level, &filter);
    let errors: Vec<&LogLine> = p
        .log_lines
        .iter()
        .filter(|l| logcat::level_rank(&l.level) >= 4)
        .collect();
    ctx.app.set_log_errors(errors.len() as i32);
    ctx.app.set_log_last_error(
        errors
            .last()
            .map(|l| logcat::short(l))
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .into(),
    );
    ctx.app.set_log_summary(
        format!(
            "{} of {} lines · {} error{}",
            vis.len(),
            p.log_lines.len(),
            errors.len(),
            if errors.len() == 1 { "" } else { "s" }
        )
        .into(),
    );
    let shown: Vec<LogLine> = vis.into_iter().rev().take(500).rev().collect();
    ctx.app.set_log_lines(ModelRc::new(VecModel::from(shown)));
}

/// Follows the device log on a connection of its own (`logcat.follow`
/// pushes until the connection closes).
fn follow_logcat(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, device: Uuid) -> JoinHandle<()> {
    let socket = ctx.paths.socket();
    let c = ctx.clone();
    let token_base = std::sync::Arc::new(());
    let _ = token_base;
    let (tx, mut rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel::<Vec<LogLine>>();
    // UI side: drain batches on the event loop.
    let weak = ctx.app.as_weak();
    let ui = ctx.bridge.handle().spawn(async move {
        while let Some(batch) = rx.recv().await {
            let weak = weak.clone();
            let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
                if weak.upgrade().is_none() {
                    return;
                }
                if let Some(ctx) = crate::app::ctx() {
                    let mut p = ctx.player.borrow_mut();
                    if p.log_device != Some(device) {
                        return;
                    }
                    p.log_lines.extend(batch);
                    let n = p.log_lines.len();
                    if n > logcat::KEEP {
                        p.log_lines.drain(..n - logcat::KEEP);
                    }
                    p.log_dirty = true;
                }
            });
        }
    });
    let _ = c;
    ctx.bridge.handle().spawn(async move {
        let _ui = AbortOnDrop(ui);
        let Ok(client) = jidr_client::Client::connect(&socket, "gui-logcat").await else {
            return;
        };
        let mut events = client.events();
        if client
            .call("logcat.follow", json!({ "device": device }))
            .await
            .is_err()
        {
            return;
        }
        let mut batch = Vec::new();
        let mut tick = tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_millis(150));
        loop {
            tokio::select! {
                ev = events.recv() => match ev {
                    Ok(ev) if ev.topic == "logcat" => {
                        if let Some(l) = ev.data.get("line").and_then(|l| l.as_str()).and_then(logcat::parse) {
                            batch.push(l);
                        }
                    }
                    Ok(_) => {}
                    Err(tokio::sync::broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(_)) => {}
                    Err(_) => break,
                },
                _ = tick.tick() => {
                    if !batch.is_empty() && tx.send(std::mem::take(&mut batch)).is_err() {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    })
}

struct AbortOnDrop(JoinHandle<()>);

impl Drop for AbortOnDrop {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.0.abort();
    }
}

fn hover(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, path: Option<PathBuf>) {
    let Some(path) = path else {
        ctx.app.set_drop_hover(false);
        return;
    };
    let Some((id, running, _, mode)) = active_device(ctx) else {
        return;
    };
    if !running {
        return;
    }
    let name = ctx.info(id).map(|d| d.device.name).unwrap_or_default();
    let (t, b) = drop::hover_text(&drop::classify(&path, mode == RootMode::Magisk), &name);
    ctx.app.set_drop_title(t.into());
    ctx.app.set_drop_body(b.into());
    ctx.app.set_drop_hover(true);
}

/// Installs, flashes or copies a dropped file (D35).
pub fn handle_drop(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, path: &Path) {
    let Some((id, running, _, mode)) = active_device(ctx) else {
        return;
    };
    let w = ctx.app.as_weak();
    if !running {
        toast(
            &w,
            "Start the device first, then drop the file again".into(),
        );
        return;
    }
    let name = file_name(&path.to_string_lossy());
    match drop::classify(path, mode == RootMode::Magisk) {
        drop::DropAction::InstallApk(apk) => install_apk(ctx, id, apk, false),
        drop::DropAction::MagiskModule(zip) => {
            let b = ctx.bridge.clone();
            let w2 = w.clone();
            let zip2 = zip.clone();
            ctx.bridge.run(
                "root.module.install",
                json!({ "device": id, "path": zip }),
                |_| {},
                move |r| match r {
                    Ok(_) => toast(&w2, format!("Installed {name}; the device is rebooting")),
                    Err(e)
                        if e.message.contains("Unknown method")
                            || e.message.contains("unknown method")
                            || e.message.contains("Method not found") =>
                    {
                        // Magisk modules arrive with Stream C's 9d; until then copy it.
                        b.call(
                            "file.push",
                            json!({ "device": id, "local": zip2 }),
                            report(
                                &w2,
                                &format!(
                                    "Copied {name} to Download (module install isn't available yet)"
                                ),
                            ),
                        );
                    }
                    Err(e) => toast(&w2, e.message),
                },
            );
        }
        drop::DropAction::Push { path, note } => {
            let msg = match note {
                Some(n) => format!("Copied {name} to Download. {n}"),
                None => format!("Copied {name} to /sdcard/Download"),
            };
            ctx.bridge.call(
                "file.push",
                json!({ "device": id, "local": path }),
                report(&w, &msg),
            );
        }
    }
}

fn install_apk(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, id: Uuid, apk: PathBuf, reinstall: bool) {
    let w = ctx.app.as_weak();
    let name = file_name(&apk.to_string_lossy());
    toast(&w, format!("Installing {name}…"));
    let b = ctx.bridge.clone();
    let apk2 = apk.clone();
    let token = crate::app::defer(move |r: jidr_core::JidrResult<()>| {
        let Some(c) = crate::app::ctx() else { return };
        match r {
            Ok(()) => {}
            Err(e) if !reinstall && drop::is_signature_mismatch(&e.message) => {
                let c2 = c.clone();
                let apk3 = apk2.clone();
                crate::launcher::confirm(
                    &c,
                    &format!("Reinstall {}?", file_name(&apk2.to_string_lossy())),
                    "The installed app was signed with a different key. Reinstalling uninstalls it first, which deletes its data.",
                    "Reinstall",
                    move || install_apk(&c2, id, apk3.clone(), true),
                );
            }
            Err(e) => toast(&c.app.as_weak(), e.message),
        }
    });
    let w2 = w.clone();
    ctx.bridge.handle().spawn(async move {
        let call = |method: &'static str, params: serde_json::Value| {
            let b = b.clone();
            async move {
                let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel();
                b.call(method, params, move |r| {
                    let _ = tx.send(r);
                });
                rx.await
                    .unwrap_or_else(|_| Err(jidr_core::JidrError::unexpected("cancelled")))
            }
        };
        if reinstall {
            let pkg = call("app.inspect", json!({ "apk": apk })).await;
            if let Ok(v) = pkg
                && let Some(p) = v.get("package").and_then(|p| p.as_str())
            {
                let _ = call("app.uninstall", json!({ "device": id, "package": p })).await;
            }
        }
        let r = call(
            "file.install",
            json!({ "device": id, "apk": apk, "replace": true }),
        )
        .await;
        let r = match r {
            Ok(_) => match call("app.launch", json!({ "device": id, "apk": apk })).await {
                Ok(_) => {
                    toast(&w2, format!("Installed and opened {name}"));
                    Ok(())
                }
                Err(_) => {
                    toast(&w2, format!("Installed {name}"));
                    Ok(())
                }
            },
            Err(e) => Err(e),
        };
        crate::app::fire(token, r);
    });
}

/// Dev hooks for the Phase 7c check (`JIDR_PLAYER_BENCH`, `JIDR_PLAYER_DROP`).
fn drop_bench_hooks(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    if ctx.player.borrow().bench_started {
        return;
    }
    if std::env::var_os("JIDR_PLAYER_BENCH").is_none()
        && std::env::var_os("JIDR_PLAYER_DROP").is_none()
    {
        return;
    }
    ctx.player.borrow_mut().bench_started = true;
    bench::start(ctx);
}

```

`crates/jidr-ui/src/player/session.rs`:

```rs
//! A live player session on one emulator, talking to it directly (plan,
//! "Display pipeline"; ADR-0001): `streamScreenshot` RGBA8888 at the
//! window's physical size into a newest-frame slot, input over
//! `streamInputEvent`, unary calls for keys, rotation and clipboard.

use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU32, AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, MutexGuard};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use jidr_core::{ConnectInfo, JidrResult};
use jidr_proto::Controller;
use jidr_proto::control as pb;
use slint::{Image, Rgba8Pixel, SharedPixelBuffer, Weak};
use tokio::sync::{mpsc, watch};
use tokio::task::JoinHandle;
use tokio_stream::wrappers::UnboundedReceiverStream;
use uuid::Uuid;

use super::input::Screen;
use crate::AppWindow;

pub fn lock<T>(m: &Mutex<T>) -> MutexGuard<'_, T> {
    m.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
}

/// Live numbers for the debug overlay and the bench.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct Stats {
    pub received: AtomicU64,
    pub shown: AtomicU64,
    pub bytes: AtomicU64,
    /// Arrival time of each frame (last few seconds).
    pub arrivals: Mutex<VecDeque<Instant>>,
    /// Emulator timestamp → shown on the UI thread, ms.
    pub ages: Mutex<VecDeque<f32>>,
    /// Touch sent → next frame received, ms.
    pub latencies: Mutex<VecDeque<f32>>,
    pub touch_sent: Mutex<Option<Instant>>,
    /// Last frame size in pixels as received.
    pub frame: Mutex<(u32, u32)>,
    /// Display rotation of the last frame, in quarter turns.
    pub quarter: AtomicU32,
}

impl Stats {
    fn push<T>(q: &Mutex<VecDeque<T>>, v: T, keep: usize) {
        let mut q = lock(q);
        q.push_back(v);
        while q.len() > keep {
            q.pop_front();
        }
    }

    /// Frames received per second over the last `window`.
    pub fn fps(&self, window: Duration) -> f32 {
        let now = Instant::now();
        let q = lock(&self.arrivals);
        let n = q
            .iter()
            .filter(|t| now.duration_since(**t) <= window)
            .count();
        n as f32 / window.as_secs_f32()
    }

    /// 1 / median frame interval, ignoring gaps over 100 ms (idle screen).
    pub fn active_fps(&self) -> f32 {
        let q = lock(&self.arrivals);
        let mut iv: Vec<f32> = q
            .iter()
            .zip(q.iter().skip(1))
            .map(|(a, b)| b.duration_since(*a).as_secs_f32() * 1000.0)
            .filter(|ms| *ms < 100.0)
            .collect();
        median(&mut iv).map(|m| 1000.0 / m).unwrap_or(0.0)
    }

    pub fn median_latency(&self) -> Option<f32> {
        median(&mut lock(&self.latencies).iter().copied().collect::<Vec<_>>())
    }

    pub fn median_age(&self) -> Option<f32> {
        median(&mut lock(&self.ages).iter().copied().collect::<Vec<_>>())
    }
}

pub fn median(v: &mut [f32]) -> Option<f32> {
    if v.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    v.sort_by(f32::total_cmp);
    Some(v[v.len() / 2])
}

pub fn percentile(v: &mut [f32], p: f32) -> Option<f32> {
    if v.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    v.sort_by(f32::total_cmp);
    let i = ((v.len() - 1) as f32 * p).round() as usize;
    v.get(i).copied()
}

struct Frame {
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
    data: Vec<u8>,
    ts_us: u64,
}

fn now_us() -> u64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .map(|d| d.as_micros() as u64)
        .unwrap_or(0)
}

/// Device pixels in the orientation a frame shows.
pub fn oriented(native: Screen, frame: (u32, u32)) -> Screen {
    let landscape_frame = frame.0 > frame.1;
    let landscape_native = native.width > native.height;
    if landscape_frame != landscape_native {
        Screen {
            width: native.height,
            height: native.width,
        }
    } else {
        native
    }
}

/// The size to request: the screen's physical pixels, capped at the
/// device's own size, both sides set (ADR-0001: width-only is ignored).
pub fn request_size(logical: (f32, f32), scale: f32, device: Screen) -> (u32, u32) {
    let (w, h) = (logical.0 * scale, logical.1 * scale);
    if w <= 0.0 || h <= 0.0 {
        return (device.width.min(540), device.height.min(1200));
    }
    // Never more pixels than the device has.
    let k = (device.width as f32 / w)
        .min(device.height as f32 / h)
        .min(1.0);
    let (w, h) = (w * k, h * k);
    ((w.round() as u32).max(1), (h.round() as u32).max(1))
}

/// An authenticated `EmulatorController` client (`-grpc-use-token`).
pub async fn connect(info: &ConnectInfo) -> JidrResult<Controller> {
    use jidr_core::JidrError;
    let token = jidr_proto::BearerToken::new(&info.grpc_token)
        .map_err(|_| JidrError::unexpected("invalid gRPC token"))?;
    let channel = tonic::transport::Endpoint::from_shared(format!("http://{}", info.grpc_endpoint))
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(format!("gRPC endpoint: {e}")))?
        .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5))
        .tcp_nodelay(true)
        .connect()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| {
            JidrError::sdk(format!(
                "can't reach the emulator at {}: {e}",
                info.grpc_endpoint
            ))
        })?;
    Ok(jidr_proto::clients(channel, token).0)
}

pub struct Session {
    pub device: Uuid,
    pub native: Screen,
    pub ctl: Controller,
    pub input: mpsc::UnboundedSender<pb::InputEvent>,
    pub want: watch::Sender<(u32, u32)>,
    pub stats: Arc<Stats>,
    tasks: Vec<JoinHandle<()>>,
    clipboard: Option<Vec<JoinHandle<()>>>,
}

impl Drop for Session {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        for t in self.tasks.drain(..) {
            t.abort();
        }
        for t in self.clipboard.take().into_iter().flatten() {
            t.abort();
        }
    }
}

impl std::fmt::Debug for Session {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        f.debug_struct("Session")
            .field("device", &self.device)
            .finish_non_exhaustive()
    }
}

impl Session {
    /// Connects and starts streaming at `want` pixels.
    pub async fn open(
        device: Uuid,
        info: ConnectInfo,
        native: Screen,
        want: (u32, u32),
        weak: Weak<AppWindow>,
    ) -> JidrResult<Self> {
        let ctl = connect(&info).await?;
        let stats = Arc::new(Stats::default());
        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel::<pb::InputEvent>();
        let (want_tx, want_rx) = watch::channel(want);
        let mut tasks = Vec::new();
        {
            let mut c = ctl.clone();
            tasks.push(tokio::spawn(async move {
                if let Err(e) = c.stream_input_event(UnboundedReceiverStream::new(rx)).await {
                    tracing::warn!("input stream ended: {e}");
                }
            }));
        }
        tasks.push(tokio::spawn(stream_frames(
            ctl.clone(),
            want_rx,
            stats.clone(),
            native,
            weak,
        )));
        Ok(Self {
            device,
            native,
            ctl,
            input: tx,
            want: want_tx,
            stats,
            tasks,
            clipboard: None,
        })
    }

    /// Sends a touch (and marks it for the latency probe on press/move).
    pub fn send(&self, ev: pb::InputEvent, probe: bool) {
        if probe {
            let mut t = lock(&self.stats.touch_sent);
            if t.is_none() {
                *t = Some(Instant::now());
            }
        }
        let _ = self.input.send(ev);
    }

    /// Re-requests frames at a new size (resize, rotation, Retina change).
    pub fn resize(&self, want: (u32, u32)) {
        let cur = *self.want.borrow();
        let changed = |a: u32, b: u32| (a as f32 - b as f32).abs() / (b.max(1) as f32) > 0.04;
        if changed(want.0, cur.0) || changed(want.1, cur.1) {
            let _ = self.want.send(want);
        }
    }

    /// Shares the clipboard both ways while on.
    pub fn set_clipboard_sharing(&mut self, on: bool) {
        for t in self.clipboard.take().into_iter().flatten() {
            t.abort();
        }
        if !on {
            return;
        }
        let last = Arc::new(Mutex::new(String::new()));
        let mut down = self.ctl.clone();
        let l1 = last.clone();
        let device_to_host = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let Ok(resp) = down.stream_clipboard(()).await else {
                return;
            };
            let mut s = resp.into_inner();
            while let Ok(Some(clip)) = s.message().await {
                let changed = {
                    let mut l = lock(&l1);
                    if *l != clip.text {
                        l.clone_from(&clip.text);
                        true
                    } else {
                        false
                    }
                };
                if changed {
                    crate::settings::copy_text(&clip.text);
                }
            }
        });
        let mut up = self.ctl.clone();
        let host_to_device = tokio::spawn(async move {
            loop {
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(800)).await;
                let Ok(out) = tokio::process::Command::new("pbpaste").output().await else {
                    continue;
                };
                let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).into_owned();
                let send = {
                    let mut l = lock(&last);
                    if !text.is_empty() && *l != text {
                        l.clone_from(&text);
                        true
                    } else {
                        false
                    }
                };
                if send {
                    let _ = up.set_clipboard(pb::ClipData { text }).await;
                }
            }
        });
        self.clipboard = Some(vec![device_to_host, host_to_device]);
    }

    pub fn clipboard_sharing(&self) -> bool {
        self.clipboard.is_some()
    }
}

async fn stream_frames(
    mut ctl: Controller,
    mut want: watch::Receiver<(u32, u32)>,
    stats: Arc<Stats>,
    native: Screen,
    weak: Weak<AppWindow>,
) {
    let latest: Arc<Mutex<Option<Frame>>> = Arc::default();
    let pending = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
    loop {
        let (w, h) = *want.borrow_and_update();
        let fmt = pb::ImageFormat {
            format: pb::image_format::ImgFormat::Rgba8888 as i32,
            width: w,
            height: h,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let mut stream = match ctl.stream_screenshot(fmt).await {
            Ok(s) => s.into_inner(),
            Err(e) => {
                tracing::warn!("streamScreenshot: {e}");
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
                continue;
            }
        };
        loop {
            tokio::select! {
                changed = want.changed() => {
                    if changed.is_err() {
                        return;
                    }
                    break;
                }
                msg = stream.message() => {
                    let img = match msg {
                        Ok(Some(img)) => img,
                        Ok(None) | Err(_) => {
                            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
                            break;
                        }
                    };
                    let Some(f) = img.format else { continue };
                    if img.image.is_empty() {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let now = Instant::now();
                    stats.received.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
                    stats.bytes.fetch_add(img.image.len() as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
                    Stats::push(&stats.arrivals, now, 600);
                    if let Some(t) = lock(&stats.touch_sent).take() {
                        Stats::push(&stats.latencies, now.duration_since(t).as_secs_f32() * 1000.0, 200);
                    }
                    *lock(&stats.frame) = (f.width, f.height);
                    let quarter = f.rotation.map_or(0, |r| r.rotation.rem_euclid(4) as u32);
                    stats.quarter.store(quarter, Ordering::Relaxed);
                    *lock(&latest) = Some(Frame {
                        width: f.width,
                        height: f.height,
                        data: img.image,
                        ts_us: img.timestamp_us,
                    });
                    // One hop to the UI thread in flight; newer frames replace older ones.
                    if !pending.swap(true, Ordering::AcqRel) {
                        let (latest, pending, stats, weak) =
                            (latest.clone(), pending.clone(), stats.clone(), weak.clone());
                        let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
                            pending.store(false, Ordering::Release);
                            let Some(frame) = lock(&latest).take() else { return };
                            let Some(app) = weak.upgrade() else { return };
                            if frame.data.len() < (frame.width * frame.height * 4) as usize {
                                return;
                            }
                            let buf = SharedPixelBuffer::<Rgba8Pixel>::clone_from_slice(
                                &frame.data,
                                frame.width,
                                frame.height,
                            );
                            let dev = oriented(native, (frame.width, frame.height));
                            app.set_player_frame(Image::from_rgba8(buf));
                            app.set_player_has_frame(true);
                            app.set_player_frame_w(dev.width as i32);
                            app.set_player_frame_h(dev.height as i32);
                            stats.shown.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
                            Stats::push(&stats.ages, now_us().saturating_sub(frame.ts_us) as f32 / 1000.0, 200);
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-ui/src/recording.rs`:

```rs
//! Screenshots and screen recording from the device window (Phase 10a).
//! The daemon does the work (`media.screenshot`, `media.record`); the GUI
//! copies screenshots to the pasteboard and shows the recording clock.

use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::Path;
use std::rc::Rc;

use serde_json::{Value, json};
use slint::ComponentHandle;
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::app::{Ctx, toast};

/// Recordings in progress, per device: the clock text each one shows.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct Active(HashMap<Uuid, String>);

impl Active {
    pub fn is_recording(&self, device: Uuid) -> bool {
        self.0.contains_key(&device)
    }

    pub fn set(&mut self, device: Uuid, text: Option<String>) {
        match text {
            Some(t) => {
                self.0.insert(device, t);
            }
            None => {
                self.0.remove(&device);
            }
        }
    }

    /// What the toolbar shows for the active tab's device.
    pub fn view(&self, active: Option<Uuid>) -> (bool, String) {
        match active.and_then(|id| self.0.get(&id)) {
            Some(t) => (true, t.clone()),
            None => (false, String::new()),
        }
    }
}

thread_local! {
    static ACTIVE: RefCell<Active> = RefCell::default();
}

/// Shows the recording state of `active` (the active tab's device).
pub fn show(ctx: &Ctx, active: Option<Uuid>) {
    let (on, text) = ACTIVE.with(|a| a.borrow().view(active));
    ctx.app.set_player_recording(on);
    ctx.app.set_player_record_text(text.into());
}

/// Updates one device's state from any thread and refreshes the toolbar.
fn update(device: Uuid, text: Option<String>) {
    let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
        ACTIVE.with(|a| a.borrow_mut().set(device, text));
        if let Some(ctx) = crate::app::ctx() {
            show(&ctx, crate::player::active_id(&ctx));
        }
    });
}

pub fn file_name(path: &str) -> String {
    Path::new(path)
        .file_name()
        .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| path.to_string())
}

fn path_of(v: &Value) -> String {
    v.get("path")
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .unwrap_or_default()
        .to_string()
}

/// `osascript` arguments that put the PNG at `path` on the pasteboard. The
/// path goes in as `argv`, never into the script text, so no file name can
/// change what the script does.
pub fn copy_image_args(path: &str) -> [&str; 7] {
    [
        "-e",
        "on run argv",
        "-e",
        "set the clipboard to (read (POSIX file (item 1 of argv)) as «class PNGf»)",
        "-e",
        "end run",
        path,
    ]
}

/// Puts a PNG on the macOS pasteboard.
pub fn copy_image(path: &str) {
    if path.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let _ = std::process::Command::new("osascript")
        .args(copy_image_args(path))
        .spawn();
}

/// `media.screenshot`: saved to ~/Pictures/Jidr and copied.
pub fn screenshot(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, device: Uuid) {
    let w = ctx.app.as_weak();
    ctx.bridge.call(
        "media.screenshot",
        json!({ "device": device }),
        move |r| match r {
            Ok(v) => {
                let path = path_of(&v);
                copy_image(&path);
                toast(&w, format!("Saved {} and copied it", file_name(&path)));
            }
            Err(e) => toast(&w, e.message),
        },
    );
}

/// Starts or stops `media.record`; the job's progress drives the clock.
pub fn toggle(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, device: Uuid) {
    let w = ctx.app.as_weak();
    if ACTIVE.with(|a| a.borrow().is_recording(device)) {
        // The job ends and reports the file.
        ctx.bridge
            .call("media.record_stop", json!({ "device": device }), move |r| {
                if let Err(e) = r {
                    toast(&w, e.message);
                }
            });
        return;
    }
    ACTIVE.with(|a| a.borrow_mut().set(device, Some("Recording 0:00".into())));
    show(ctx, Some(device));
    ctx.bridge.run(
        "media.record",
        json!({ "device": device }),
        move |job| update(device, Some(job.message.clone())),
        move |r| {
            update(device, None);
            match r {
                Ok(v) => {
                    let secs = v.get("duration_s").and_then(Value::as_f64).unwrap_or(0.0);
                    toast(
                        &w,
                        format!(
                            "Saved {} ({})",
                            file_name(&path_of(&v)),
                            crate::model::duration(secs.round() as i64)
                        ),
                    );
                }
                Err(e) if !jidr_core::cancel::is_cancelled(&e) => toast(&w, e.message),
                Err(_) => {}
            }
        },
    );
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// Regression (review of PR #3): one global flag meant that after
    /// switching from device A's tab to B and back, A's recording showed as
    /// stopped and the button tried to start a second one.
    #[test]
    fn recording_state_is_per_device() {
        let (a, b) = (Uuid::new_v4(), Uuid::new_v4());
        let mut st = Active::default();
        st.set(a, Some("Recording 0:03".into()));
        assert_eq!(st.view(Some(b)), (false, String::new()));
        assert!(!st.is_recording(b));
        assert_eq!(st.view(Some(a)), (true, "Recording 0:03".into()));
        assert!(st.is_recording(a));
        st.set(a, None);
        assert_eq!(st.view(Some(a)), (false, String::new()));
    }

    /// Regression (review of PR #3): the path was spliced into the
    /// AppleScript with only `"` escaped, so a device name with `\` could
    /// close the string and run `do shell script` on the host.
    #[test]
    fn the_image_path_is_an_argument_not_script() {
        let evil = r#"/tmp/a\"&(do shell script "touch /tmp/pwned")--.png"#;
        let args = copy_image_args(evil);
        assert_eq!(args.last(), Some(&evil));
        assert!(args[..args.len() - 1].iter().all(|a| !a.contains("pwned")));
    }

    /// The script really reads its path from argv (macOS only).
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    #[test]
    fn osascript_takes_the_path_from_argv() {
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let marker = tmp.path().join("pwned");
        let evil = format!(
            r#"{}/a\"&(do shell script "touch {}")--.png"#,
            tmp.path().display(),
            marker.display()
        );
        let mut args = copy_image_args(&evil);
        // Same script, but echo the path back instead of touching the pasteboard.
        args[3] = "return item 1 of argv";
        let out = std::process::Command::new("osascript")
            .args(args)
            .output()
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim(), evil);
        assert!(!marker.exists());
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Golden scenes for every root state (Phase 9e acceptance): the Root sheet
//! in progress, rooted, failed, Play Store first boot, guided tap and
//! unverified, the dev-tools root section, and the new root-mode cards.
//! `crate::goldens::cases()` appends these (gap B8).

use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use jidr_core::{ErrorCode, JidrError, RootHealth};
use serde_json::json;
use slint::ComponentHandle;

use super::steps::{self, LogEntry};
use super::{Outcome, Sheet, apply, sheet_vm, tools_vm};
use crate::RootUi;

use crate::goldens::{Case, Variant, device_tab, shot};

/// Device fixtures: 0 is "Pixel-ish 6.1" (google_apis, rooted, running);
/// 2 is "Play Store test" (Play Store image, booting at 62%).
const PIXEL: usize = 0;
const PLAY_STORE: usize = 2;

fn log(lines: &[(&str, &'static str, &str)]) -> Vec<LogEntry> {
    lines
        .iter()
        .map(|(t, level, text)| LogEntry {
            time: (*t).into(),
            source: "jidr",
            level,
            text: (*text).into(),
        })
        .collect()
}

/// The device window of fixture `device` with the Root sheet on top.
fn sheet(
    v: Variant,
    device: usize,
    s: Sheet,
    elapsed: u64,
) -> Result<slint::SharedPixelBuffer<slint::Rgba8Pixel>, String> {
    let app = device_tab(v, device)?;
    // The window behind the sheet shows the same root state.
    let mut infos = fixtures::device_infos();
    let root = &mut infos[device].device.root;
    match &s.outcome {
        None => infos[device].root_job = true,
        Some(Outcome::Rooted { .. }) => {
            root.health = RootHealth::Ok;
            root.verified_at = Some(fixtures::now());
        }
        Some(Outcome::Failed { failure, .. }) if failure.unverified => {
            root.health = RootHealth::Unverified;
            root.verified_at = Some(fixtures::now());
        }
        Some(Outcome::Failed { .. }) => root.health = RootHealth::Failed,
    }
    if s.pending {
        infos[device].root_job = false;
    }
    let clock = fixtures::clock();
    app.set_devices(slint::ModelRc::new(slint::VecModel::from(
        infos
            .iter()
            .map(|i| crate::model::device_vm(i, &clock))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    )));
    let info = infos.swap_remove(device);
    let s = Sheet {
        device: Some(info.device.id),
        ..s
    };
    let base = s.started.unwrap_or_else(Instant::now);
    let vm = sheet_vm(&s, Some(&info), base + Duration::from_secs(elapsed));
    let ui = app.global::<RootUi>();
    apply(&ui, &vm);
    ui.set_open(true);
    shot(&app, 1440, 900)
}

/// A job on `step`, rendered `total` seconds after it started, with the
/// step's clock at `step_secs`.
fn running(step: usize, total: u64, step_secs: u64) -> Sheet {
    let t0 = Instant::now();
    Sheet {
        step,
        started: Some(t0),
        step_started: Some(t0 + Duration::from_secs(total.saturating_sub(step_secs))),
        ..Sheet::default()
    }
}

pub fn cases() -> Vec<Case> {

                    }),
                    ..running(steps::VERIFY, 150, 60)

        Case {

/// The dev-tools section with the build-identity block (Phase 9f).
fn props_shot(
    v: Variant,
    editing: bool,
) -> Result<slint::SharedPixelBuffer<slint::Rgba8Pixel>, String> {
    use super::props::{Form, apply, field_error, props_vm};
    let app = device_tab(v, PIXEL)?;
    app.set_player_panel_tab(4);
    let mut info = fixtures::device_infos().remove(PIXEL);
    info.device.launch.force_cold_boot = true;
    let fill = |ui: &RootUi| {
        let vm = tools_vm(Some(&info), None, fixtures::now());
        ui.set_tools_visible(vm.visible);
        ui.set_tools_kind(vm.kind);
        ui.set_tools_badge(vm.badge);
        ui.set_tools_beta(vm.beta);
        ui.set_tools_full(vm.full);
        ui.set_tools_running(vm.running);
        ui.set_tools_busy(vm.busy);
        ui.set_tools_verified(vm.verified);
        ui.set_tools_failed(vm.failed);
        ui.set_tools_auto_grant(vm.auto_grant);
        ui.set_tools_auto_grant_supported(true);
        ui.set_props_supported(true);
    };
    let ui = app.global::<RootUi>();
    fill(&ui);
    let stored = [
        "Jidr One".to_string(),
        "jidr".into(),
        "Jidr".into(),
        String::new(),
        String::new(),
        "2026-10-05".into(),
    ];
    let vm = if editing {
        let mut draft = stored.clone();
        draft[3] = "jidr_one".into();
        draft[4] = "jidr/jidr_one/jidr_one:12/SP2A.220505/1:user/release-keys".into();
        draft[5] = "2026-13-05".into();
        let err = field_error(
            &JidrError::usage("security_patch: a date like 2026-10-05")
                .with_data(json!({ "field": "security_patch" })),
        );
        info.device.launch.force_cold_boot = false;
        props_vm(
            &info,
            &stored,
            Some(Form {
                draft: &draft,
                saving: false,
                error: Some(&err),
            }),
        )
    } else {
        props_vm(&info, &stored, None)
    };
    apply(&ui, &vm);
    // The open form runs below the fold at 900 px (the panel scrolls), so
    // the edit frame is taller to show all of it.
    shot(&app, 1440, if editing { 1240 } else { 900 })
}

/// The widget panel's "More" tab with the root section, for a rooted device
/// or one whose setup failed.
fn devtools(
    v: Variant,
    device: usize,
    failed: bool,
    auto_grant: bool,
) -> Result<slint::SharedPixelBuffer<slint::Rgba8Pixel>, String> {
    let app = device_tab(v, device)?;
    app.set_player_panel_tab(4);
    let mut info = fixtures::device_infos().remove(device);
    let failure = failed.then(|| {
        info.device.root.health = RootHealth::Failed;
        steps::failure(&JidrError::new(ErrorCode::BootTimeout, "x"), steps::REBOOT)
    });
    if failed {
        let mut infos = fixtures::device_infos();
        infos[device] = info.clone();
        let clock = fixtures::clock();
        app.set_devices(slint::ModelRc::new(slint::VecModel::from(
            infos
                .iter()
                .map(|i| crate::model::device_vm(i, &clock))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        )));
    }
    let vm = tools_vm(Some(&info), failure.as_ref(), fixtures::now());
    let ui = app.global::<RootUi>();
    ui.set_tools_visible(vm.visible);
    ui.set_tools_kind(vm.kind);
    ui.set_tools_badge(vm.badge);
    ui.set_tools_beta(vm.beta);
    ui.set_tools_full(vm.full);
    ui.set_tools_running(vm.running);
    ui.set_tools_busy(vm.busy);
    ui.set_tools_verified(vm.verified);
    ui.set_tools_failed(vm.failed);
    ui.set_tools_auto_grant(vm.auto_grant);
    ui.set_tools_auto_grant_supported(auto_grant);
    shot(&app, 1440, 900)
}
```
