`crates/jidr-ui/src/root/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! Root UX (Phase 9e, Stream C): the Root setup sheet that follows a
//! `root.set` job step by step, its failure and revert UI, the Play Store
//! guided tap (ADR-0002) and the dev-tools root section with the opt-in
//! "auto-grant all" toggle (D22). The Slint side is `root.slint`; B's code
//! calls [`wire`], [`sync`] and [`start`] (gap B8).

pub mod goldens;
pub mod props;
pub mod steps;

pub use goldens::cases as golden_cases;

use std::cell::{Cell, RefCell};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::rc::Rc;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use jidr_core::{DeviceStatus, ErrorCode, JidrError, JidrResult, Job, RootHealth, RootMode};
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use slint::{ComponentHandle, ModelRc, SharedString, Timer, TimerMode, VecModel};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::app::{Ctx, report, toast};
use crate::model::{DeviceInfo, ago, root_labels};
use crate::{RootLogLine, RootSheetState, RootStep, RootStepState, RootStepVm, RootUi};
use steps::{Failure, LogEntry, STEPS};

/// The sheet's job, from the first progress message to the result.
#[derive(Debug, Default)]
struct Sheet {
    device: Option<Uuid>,
    job: Option<String>,
    step: usize,
    started: Option<Instant>,
    step_started: Option<Instant>,
    /// Play Store image still on its first boot: `root.set` runs once it's up.
    pending: bool,
    /// The guided tap started at.
    grant_since: Option<Instant>,
    /// "Stop and revert" cancelled the job: revert once it ends.
    revert_after_cancel: bool,
    log: Vec<LogEntry>,
    outcome: Option<Outcome>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
enum Outcome {
    Rooted {
        secs: u64,
        magisk: Option<String>,
        uid: Option<i64>,
    },
    Failed {
        failure: Failure,
        secs: u64,
        detail: String,
    },
}

thread_local! {
    static SHEET: RefCell<Sheet> = RefCell::default();
    /// The last failed root job per device: the device only stores
    /// `health: failed`, the reason lives here (and in the job).
    static FAILED: RefCell<HashMap<Uuid, Failure>> = RefCell::default();
    /// Ticks the running step's clock while the sheet is open.
    static TICK: Timer = Timer::default();
    static AUTO_GRANT: Cell<bool> = const { Cell::new(false) };
    /// `start` calls for devices the UI hasn't seen yet (just created).
    static QUEUED: RefCell<Vec<(Uuid, RootMode)>> = RefCell::default();
}

/// Hooks the sheet and dev-tools callbacks up. Called once from `app::run`.
pub fn wire(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    let ui = ctx.app.global::<RootUi>();
    let c = ctx.clone();
    ui.on_action(move |a| sheet_action(&c, a.as_str()));
    let c = ctx.clone();
    ui.on_tools_action(move |a, v| tools_action(&c, a.as_str(), v.as_str()));

    props::wire(ctx);

    // G15 and 9f: `root.auto_grant` and `device.props.set` arrive with a
    // newer daemon; find out whether this one has them.
    let w = ctx.app.as_weak();
    ctx.bridge.call("commands.list", json!({}), move |r| {
        let list = r.ok();
        let has = list
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|v| lists_command(v, "root.auto_grant"));
        let props = list
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|v| lists_command(v, "device.props.set"));
        let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
            AUTO_GRANT.with(|g| g.set(has));
            if let Some(app) = w.upgrade() {
                let ui = app.global::<RootUi>();
                ui.set_tools_auto_grant_supported(has);
                ui.set_props_supported(props);
            }
            if let Some(c) = crate::app::ctx() {
                sync(&c);
            }
        });
    });
}

/// Whether a `commands.list` result has `id`.
fn lists_command(v: &Value, id: &str) -> bool {
    let list = v.get("commands").unwrap_or(v);
    list.as_array().is_some_and(|a| {
        a.iter()
            .any(|c| c.get("id").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some(id))
    })
}

/// Sets `device` to `mode`. Full root opens the Root sheet and follows the
/// job; None and Shell run in the background with a toast.
pub fn start(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, device: Uuid, mode: RootMode) {
    if ctx.info(device).is_none() {
        // Just created: `sync` starts it once `device.updated` brings it in.
        QUEUED.with(|q| q.borrow_mut().push((device, mode)));
        return;
    }
    match mode {
        RootMode::Magisk => full_root(ctx, device),
        RootMode::None | RootMode::Adb => {
            let name = name_of(ctx, device);
            let label = if mode == RootMode::Adb {
                "Shell root (adb)"
            } else {
                "unrooted"
            };
            ctx.bridge.run(
                "root.set",
                json!({ "device": device, "mode": mode_name(mode) }),
                |_| {},
                report(&ctx.app.as_weak(), format!("{name} is now {label}")),
            );
        }
    }
}

/// [`start`] from an IO-thread callback (a `device.create` / `device.edit`
/// result): hops to the UI thread first.
pub fn start_later(device: Uuid, mode: RootMode) {
    let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
        if let Some(ctx) = crate::app::ctx() {
            start(&ctx, device, mode);
        }
    });
}

/// The form's root choice as a mode.
pub fn mode_of(choice: crate::RootChoice) -> RootMode {
    match choice {
        crate::RootChoice::None => RootMode::None,
        crate::RootChoice::Shell => RootMode::Adb,
        crate::RootChoice::Full => RootMode::Magisk,
    }
}

fn mode_name(mode: RootMode) -> &'static str {
    match mode {
        RootMode::None => "none",
        RootMode::Adb => "adb",
        RootMode::Magisk => "magisk",
    }
}

fn name_of(ctx: &Ctx, id: Uuid) -> String {
    ctx.info(id).map(|d| d.device.name).unwrap_or_default()
}

fn play_store(info: &DeviceInfo) -> bool {
    !info.device.image.allows_adb_root()
}

/// Full root: open the sheet and run `root.set magisk`. A Play Store image
/// on its first boot waits for Android first (the root design, beta frame).
fn full_root(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, device: Uuid) {
    let Some(info) = ctx.info(device) else { return };
    FAILED.with(|f| f.borrow_mut().remove(&device));
    let now = Instant::now();
    let first_boot = play_store(&info) && !matches!(info.device.status, DeviceStatus::Running);
    SHEET.with(|s| {
        *s.borrow_mut() = Sheet {
            device: Some(device),
            started: Some(now),
            step_started: Some(now),
            pending: first_boot,
            ..Sheet::default()
        };
    });
    ctx.app.global::<RootUi>().set_show_steps(false);
    ctx.app.global::<RootUi>().set_open(true);
    start_tick();
    if first_boot {
        if matches!(info.device.status, DeviceStatus::Stopped) {
            ctx.bridge.call(
                "device.start",
                json!({ "device": device }),
                report(&ctx.app.as_weak(), ""),
            );
        }
        render(ctx);
        return;
    }
    run_set(ctx, device);
}

fn run_set(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, device: Uuid) {
    render(ctx);
    ctx.bridge.run(
        "root.set",
        json!({ "device": device, "mode": "magisk" }),
        |job: &Job| {
            let job = job.clone();
            let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || progress(&job));
        },
        move |r: JidrResult<Value>| {
            let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || finished(device, r));
        },
    );
}

/// A `job.progress` of the sheet's job.
fn progress(job: &Job) {
    let Some(ctx) = crate::app::ctx() else { return };
    SHEET.with(|s| {
        let mut s = s.borrow_mut();
        if s.device != job.device || s.outcome.is_some() {
            return;
        }
        s.job = Some(job.id.to_string());
        let msg = job.message.trim();
        if msg.is_empty() || s.log.last().is_some_and(|l| l.text == msg) {
            return;
        }
        s.log.push(entry("", msg));
        let next = steps::step_for(msg, s.step);
        if next != s.step {
            s.step = next;
            s.step_started = Some(Instant::now());
        }
        if steps::is_grant_prompt(msg) && s.grant_since.is_none() {
            s.grant_since = Some(Instant::now());
        }
    });
    render(&ctx);
}

fn entry(level: &'static str, text: &str) -> LogEntry {
    LogEntry {
        time: chrono::Local::now().format("%H:%M:%S").to_string(),
        source: "jidr",
        level,
        text: text.to_string(),
    }
}

/// The sheet's job ended.
fn finished(device: Uuid, r: JidrResult<Value>) {
    let Some(ctx) = crate::app::ctx() else { return };
    let name = name_of(&ctx, device);
    let mut revert = false;
    let outcome = SHEET.with(|s| {
        let mut s = s.borrow_mut();
        let secs = s.started.map_or(0, |t| t.elapsed().as_secs());
        let outcome = match r {
            Ok(v) => Outcome::Rooted {
                secs,
                magisk: v
                    .get("magisk_version")
                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
                    .map(str::to_string),
                uid: v.pointer("/verification/uid").and_then(Value::as_i64),
            },
            Err(e) => {
                let mut failure = steps::failure(&e, s.step);
                if failure.cancelled && s.grant_since.is_some() {
                    // Cancelling the guided tap leaves root unverified.
                    failure.unverified = true;
                }
                revert = failure.cancelled && s.revert_after_cancel;
                s.log.push(entry("e", &short_error(&e)));
                s.log.push(entry(
                    "",
                    &format!("root setup stopped at step {} of {STEPS}", failure.step + 1),
                ));
                let detail = detail(&name, &e);
                Outcome::Failed {
                    failure,
                    secs,
                    detail,
                }
            }
        };
        if s.device == Some(device) {
            s.outcome = Some(outcome.clone());
        }
        outcome
    });
    let open = ctx.app.global::<RootUi>().get_open();
    match &outcome {
        Outcome::Rooted { magisk, .. } => {
            FAILED.with(|f| f.borrow_mut().remove(&device));
            if !open {
                let text = match magisk {
                    Some(v) => format!("{name} is rooted · Magisk {v}"),
                    None => format!("{name} is rooted"),
                };
                toast(&ctx.app.as_weak(), text);
            }
        }
        Outcome::Failed { failure, .. } => {
            FAILED.with(|f| f.borrow_mut().insert(device, failure.clone()));
            if revert {
                ctx.app.global::<RootUi>().set_open(false);
                start(&ctx, device, RootMode::None);
            } else if !open {
                toast(
                    &ctx.app.as_weak(),
                    format!(
                        "Root failed: {}. Open {name} to revert or try again.",
                        failure.reason
                    ),
                );
            }
        }
    }
    render(&ctx);
    sync(&ctx);
}

/// The daemon's error, one line, for the log tail.
fn short_error(e: &JidrError) -> String {
    let code = serde_json::to_value(e.code)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|v| v.as_str().map(str::to_string))
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let first = e.message.lines().next().unwrap_or_default();
    if code.is_empty() {
        first.to_string()
    } else {
        format!("{code}: {first}")
    }
}

/// The failure explanation when the error says more than the step does:
/// a boot timeout names how long Jidr waited.
fn detail(name: &str, e: &JidrError) -> String {
    if e.code == ErrorCode::BootTimeout {
        let waited = e
            .message
            .split("within ")
            .nth(1)
            .and_then(|r| r.split(" s").next())
            .and_then(|n| n.trim().parse::<u64>().ok());
        return match waited {
            Some(n) => format!(
                "{name} didn't finish booting after the reboot (waited {n} s). Your data is intact and the original boot image is kept, so you can revert."
            ),
            None => String::new(),
        };
    }
    String::new()
}

fn start_tick() {
    TICK.with(|t| {
        if !t.running() {
            t.start(TimerMode::Repeated, Duration::from_secs(1), || {
                let Some(ctx) = crate::app::ctx() else { return };
                if ctx.app.global::<RootUi>().get_open() {
                    render(&ctx);
                } else {
                    TICK.with(Timer::stop);
                }
            });
        }
    });
}

/// Fills `RootUi` from the sheet's job.
fn render(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    let ui = ctx.app.global::<RootUi>();
    SHEET.with(|s| {
        let s = s.borrow();
        let Some(device) = s.device else { return };
        let info = ctx.info(device);
        let vm = sheet_vm(&s, info.as_ref(), Instant::now());
        apply(&ui, &vm);
    });
}

/// Everything the sheet shows, computed from the job's state (pure, so
/// goldens and tests can build it from fixtures).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct SheetVm {
    pub state: RootSheetState,
    pub device_name: String,
    pub serial: String,
    pub play_store: bool,
    pub magisk: String,
    pub steps: Vec<RootStepVm>,
    pub step_index: i32,
    pub reason: String,
    pub detail: String,
    pub log: Vec<RootLogLine>,
    pub su_output: String,
    pub took: String,
    pub grant_left: String,
}

fn sheet_vm(s: &Sheet, info: Option<&DeviceInfo>, now: Instant) -> SheetVm {
    let since = |t: Option<Instant>| t.map_or(0, |t| now.saturating_duration_since(t).as_secs());
    let play = info.is_some_and(play_store);
    let magisk = info
        .and_then(|i| i.device.root.magisk_version.clone())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "30.7".into());
    let mut vm = SheetVm {
        state: RootSheetState::Progress,
        device_name: info.map(|i| i.device.name.clone()).unwrap_or_default(),
        serial: info
            .and_then(|i| i.device.runtime.as_ref())
            .map(|r| r.adb_serial.clone())
            .unwrap_or_default(),
        play_store: play,
        magisk,
        steps: Vec::new(),
        step_index: i32::try_from(s.step + 1).unwrap_or(1),
        reason: String::new(),
        detail: String::new(),
        log: Vec::new(),
        su_output: "uid=0(root) gid=0(root)".into(),
        took: String::new(),
        grant_left: String::new(),
    };
    match &s.outcome {
        None if s.pending => {
            vm.state = RootSheetState::Waiting;
            let pct = info
                .and_then(|i| i.boot_progress)
                .map_or(0.0, |p| p * 100.0);
            vm.steps = vec![
                step(
                    RootStep::FirstBoot,
                    RootStepState::Now,
                    String::new(),
                    format!("{pct:.0}%"),
                ),
                step(
                    RootStep::All,
                    RootStepState::Waiting,
                    String::new(),
                    String::new(),
                ),
            ];
        }
        None => {
            vm.state = if s.grant_since.is_some() {
                RootSheetState::Grant
            } else {
                RootSheetState::Progress
            };
            vm.grant_left = format!("{} s", 60u64.saturating_sub(since(s.grant_since)));
            vm.steps = rows(s.step, None, &steps::clock(since(s.step_started)));
        }
        Some(Outcome::Rooted { secs, magisk, uid }) => {
            vm.state = RootSheetState::Success;
            if let Some(m) = magisk {
                vm.magisk = m.clone();
            }
            if let Some(u) = uid.filter(|u| *u != 0) {
                vm.su_output = format!("uid={u}");
            }
            vm.took = format!("{secs} s");
            vm.steps = rows(STEPS, None, "");
        }
        Some(Outcome::Failed {
            failure,
            secs,
            detail,
        }) => {
            vm.state = if failure.unverified {
                RootSheetState::Unverified
            } else {
                RootSheetState::Failed
            };
            vm.reason = failure.reason.clone();
            vm.detail = detail.clone();
            vm.step_index = i32::try_from(failure.step + 1).unwrap_or(1);
            let step_secs = since(s.step_started).min(*secs);
            vm.steps = rows(failure.step, Some(failure), &steps::clock(step_secs));
            vm.log = steps::log_tail(&s.log, 4)
                .into_iter()
                .map(log_line)
                .collect();
        }
    }
    vm
}

fn step(step: RootStep, state: RootStepState, time: String, percent: String) -> RootStepVm {
    RootStepVm {
        step,
        state,
        time: time.into(),
        percent: percent.into(),
    }
}

const ORDER: [RootStep; STEPS] = [
    RootStep::Download,
    RootStep::Patch,
    RootStep::Reboot,
    RootStep::Install,
    RootStep::Verify,
];

/// The step rows: done before `at`, running (or failed) at `at`, queued (or
/// not run) after. A failed reboot folds Install and Verify into one row.
fn rows(at: usize, failure: Option<&Failure>, time: &str) -> Vec<RootStepVm> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for (i, s) in ORDER.iter().enumerate() {
        let state = if i < at {
            RootStepState::Done
        } else if i == at {
            if failure.is_some() {
                RootStepState::Failed
            } else {
                RootStepState::Now
            }
        } else if failure.is_some() {
            RootStepState::Skipped
        } else {
            RootStepState::Waiting
        };
        if failure.is_some() && at == steps::REBOOT && i == steps::VERIFY {
            continue;
        }
        let t = if i == at {
            time.to_string()
        } else {
            String::new()
        };
        out.push(step(*s, state, t, String::new()));
    }
    out
}

fn log_line(e: LogEntry) -> RootLogLine {
    RootLogLine {
        time: e.time.into(),
        source: e.source.into(),
        level: e.level.into(),
        text: e.text.into(),
    }
}

fn apply(ui: &RootUi<'_>, vm: &SheetVm) {
    ui.set_state(vm.state);
    ui.set_device_name(vm.device_name.as_str().into());
    ui.set_serial(vm.serial.as_str().into());
    ui.set_play_store(vm.play_store);
    ui.set_magisk_version(vm.magisk.as_str().into());
    ui.set_steps(ModelRc::new(VecModel::from(vm.steps.clone())));
    ui.set_step_index(vm.step_index);
    ui.set_reason(vm.reason.as_str().into());
    ui.set_detail(vm.detail.as_str().into());
    ui.set_log(ModelRc::new(VecModel::from(vm.log.clone())));
    ui.set_su_output(vm.su_output.as_str().into());
    ui.set_took(vm.took.as_str().into());
    ui.set_grant_left(vm.grant_left.as_str().into());
}

fn sheet_device(ctx: &Ctx) -> Option<(Uuid, Option<String>)> {
    let _ = ctx;
    SHEET.with(|s| {
        let s = s.borrow();
        s.device.map(|d| (d, s.job.clone()))
    })
}

fn device_index(ctx: &Ctx, id: Uuid) -> Option<i32> {
    let st = ctx.state.borrow();
    st.data
        .devices
        .iter()
        .position(|d| d.device.id == id)
        .and_then(|i| i32::try_from(i).ok())
}

fn sheet_action(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, action: &str) {
    let ui = ctx.app.global::<RootUi>();
    let Some((device, job)) = sheet_device(ctx) else {
        ui.set_open(false);
        return;
    };
    match action {
        "background" | "done" => ui.set_open(false),
        "stop" | "cancel-grant" => {
            if action == "stop" {
                SHEET.with(|s| s.borrow_mut().revert_after_cancel = true);
            }
            if let Some(job) = job {
                ctx.bridge.call(
                    "jobs.cancel",
                    json!({ "job": job }),
                    report(&ctx.app.as_weak(), ""),
                );
            }
        }
        "try-again" => full_root(ctx, device),
        "revert" => {
            ui.set_open(false);
            start(ctx, device, RootMode::None);
        }
        "dont-root" => {
            SHEET.with(|s| s.borrow_mut().pending = false);
            ui.set_open(false);
            start(ctx, device, RootMode::None);
        }
        "copy-log" => {
            let text = SHEET.with(|s| {
                s.borrow()
                    .log
                    .iter()
                    .map(|l| {
                        format!(
                            "{}  {} {} {}",
                            l.time,
                            l.source,
                            if l.level.is_empty() { " " } else { l.level },
                            l.text
                        )
                    })
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .join("\n")
            });
            crate::settings::copy_text(&text);
            toast(&ctx.app.as_weak(), "Copied the root setup log".into());
        }
        "save-snapshot" => {
            ui.set_open(false);
            if let Some(i) = device_index(ctx, device) {
                ctx.app.set_selected(i);
            }
            ctx.app.invoke_snapshot_save_request();
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

fn tools_action(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, action: &str, value: &str) {
    let Some(device) = crate::player::active_id(ctx) else {
        return;
    };
    match action {
        "verify" => {
            if let Some(i) = device_index(ctx, device) {
                ctx.app.invoke_verify_root(i);
            }
        }
        "revert" => {
            if let Some(i) = device_index(ctx, device) {
                ctx.app.invoke_revert_root(i);
            }
        }
        "set-up" => full_root(ctx, device),
        "auto-grant" => {
            let enabled = value == "true";
            let w = ctx.app.as_weak();
            ctx.bridge.call(
                "root.auto_grant",
                json!({ "device": device, "enabled": enabled }),
                move |r| {
                    toast(
                        &w,
                        match r {
                            Ok(_) if enabled => "Apps now get root without asking".into(),
                            Ok(_) => "Apps ask before they get root".into(),
                            Err(e) => e.message,
                        },
                    );
                    // Show the stored flag again (it stays put on an error).
                    let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(|| {
                        if let Some(c) = crate::app::ctx() {
                            sync(&c);
                        }
                    });
                },
            );
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

/// Re-reads the device list: starts a pending Play Store setup once Android
/// is up, and fills the dev-tools section for the active tab. Called from
/// `Ctx::rerender`.
pub fn sync(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    let ready: Vec<(Uuid, RootMode)> = QUEUED.with(|q| {
        let mut q = q.borrow_mut();
        let (ready, wait) = q.drain(..).partition(|(d, _)| ctx.info(*d).is_some());
        *q = wait;
        ready
    });
    for (device, mode) in ready {
        start(ctx, device, mode);
    }
    let pending = SHEET.with(|s| {
        let s = s.borrow();
        s.device.filter(|_| s.pending && s.outcome.is_none())
    });
    if let Some(device) = pending {
        let running = ctx
            .info(device)
            .is_some_and(|i| matches!(i.device.status, DeviceStatus::Running));
        if running {
            SHEET.with(|s| s.borrow_mut().pending = false);
            run_set(ctx, device);
        } else if ctx.app.global::<RootUi>().get_open() {
            render(ctx);
        }
    }
    let ui = ctx.app.global::<RootUi>();
    let info = crate::player::active_id(ctx).and_then(|id| ctx.info(id));
    let failure = info
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|i| FAILED.with(|f| f.borrow().get(&i.device.id).cloned()));
    let vm = tools_vm(info.as_ref(), failure.as_ref(), chrono::Utc::now());
    ui.set_tools_visible(vm.visible);
    ui.set_tools_kind(vm.kind);
    ui.set_tools_badge(vm.badge);
    ui.set_tools_beta(vm.beta);
    ui.set_tools_full(vm.full);
    ui.set_tools_running(vm.running);
    ui.set_tools_busy(vm.busy);
    ui.set_tools_verified(vm.verified);
    ui.set_tools_failed(vm.failed);
    ui.set_tools_auto_grant(vm.auto_grant);
    ui.set_tools_auto_grant_supported(AUTO_GRANT.with(Cell::get));
    props::sync(ctx, info.as_ref());
}

/// The dev-tools root section for one device.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct ToolsVm {
    pub visible: bool,
    pub kind: crate::RootKind,
    pub badge: SharedString,
    pub beta: bool,
    pub full: bool,
    pub running: bool,
    pub busy: bool,
    pub verified: SharedString,
    pub failed: bool,
    pub auto_grant: bool,
}

pub fn tools_vm(
    info: Option<&DeviceInfo>,
    failure: Option<&Failure>,
    now: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
) -> ToolsVm {
    let Some(info) = info else {
        return ToolsVm {
            visible: false,
            kind: crate::RootKind::None,
            badge: SharedString::new(),
            beta: false,
            full: false,
            running: false,
            busy: false,
            verified: SharedString::new(),
            failed: false,
            auto_grant: false,
        };
    };
    let root = &info.device.root;
    let (kind, mut badge, _) = root_labels(info);
    if let Some(f) = failure.filter(|_| root.health == RootHealth::Failed && !info.root_job) {
        badge = format!("Root failed: {}", f.reason);
    }
    let full = root.mode == RootMode::Magisk;
    let verified = match root.verified_at {
        Some(t) if root.health == RootHealth::Ok => format!("{} · su -c id → uid=0", ago(t, now)),
        _ => String::new(),
    };
    ToolsVm {
        visible: true,
        kind,
        badge: badge.into(),
        beta: full && play_store(info),
        full,
        running: matches!(info.device.status, DeviceStatus::Running),
        busy: info.root_job || info.busy_holder.is_some(),
        verified: verified.into(),
        failed: full && root.health == RootHealth::Failed,
        auto_grant: root.auto_grant_all,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::fixtures;

    fn pixel() -> DeviceInfo {
        fixtures::device_infos().remove(0)
    }

    #[test]
    fn progress_rows_follow_the_step() {
        let r = rows(steps::REBOOT, None, "0:18");
        let states: Vec<_> = r.iter().map(|s| s.state).collect();
        assert_eq!(
            states,
            [
                RootStepState::Done,
                RootStepState::Done,
                RootStepState::Now,
                RootStepState::Waiting,
                RootStepState::Waiting
            ]
        );
        assert_eq!(r[2].time, "0:18");
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_failed_reboot_folds_the_rest_into_one_row() {
        let f = steps::failure(
            &JidrError::new(ErrorCode::BootTimeout, "x did not boot within 120 s"),
            steps::REBOOT,
        );
        let r = rows(steps::REBOOT, Some(&f), "2:00");
        assert_eq!(r.len(), 4);
        assert_eq!(r[2].state, RootStepState::Failed);
        assert_eq!(
            (r[3].step, r[3].state),
            (RootStep::Install, RootStepState::Skipped)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn sheet_states() {
        let info = pixel();
        let t0 = Instant::now();
        let mut s = Sheet {
            device: Some(info.device.id),
            started: Some(t0),
            step_started: Some(t0),
            step: steps::REBOOT,
            ..Sheet::default()
        };
        let now = t0 + Duration::from_secs(18);
        let vm = sheet_vm(&s, Some(&info), now);
        assert_eq!(vm.state, RootSheetState::Progress);
        assert_eq!(vm.step_index, 3);
        assert_eq!(vm.steps[2].time, "0:18");
        assert_eq!(vm.serial, "emulator-5556");

        s.grant_since = Some(t0);
        let vm = sheet_vm(&s, Some(&info), now);
        assert_eq!(
            (vm.state, vm.grant_left.as_str()),
            (RootSheetState::Grant, "42 s")
        );

        s.outcome = Some(Outcome::Rooted {
            secs: 58,
            magisk: Some("30.7".into()),
            uid: Some(0),
        });
        let vm = sheet_vm(&s, Some(&info), now);
        assert_eq!(
            (vm.state, vm.took.as_str()),
            (RootSheetState::Success, "58 s")
        );
        assert!(vm.steps.iter().all(|r| r.state == RootStepState::Done));

        let e = JidrError::new(
            ErrorCode::BootTimeout,
            "Pixel did not boot within 120 s (boot); see log",
        );
        s.outcome = Some(Outcome::Failed {
            failure: steps::failure(&e, steps::REBOOT),
            secs: 140,
            detail: detail("Pixel-ish 6.1", &e),
        });
        let vm = sheet_vm(&s, Some(&info), now);
        assert_eq!(vm.state, RootSheetState::Failed);
        assert_eq!(vm.reason, "boot timed out");
        assert!(vm.detail.contains("waited 120 s"), "{}", vm.detail);

        let grant = JidrError::new(ErrorCode::RootFailed, "denied")
            .with_data(json!({ "state": "awaiting_user_grant" }));
        s.outcome = Some(Outcome::Failed {
            failure: steps::failure(&grant, steps::VERIFY),
            secs: 90,
            detail: String::new(),
        });
        assert_eq!(
            sheet_vm(&s, Some(&info), now).state,
            RootSheetState::Unverified
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_play_store_first_boot_waits() {
        let info = fixtures::device_infos().remove(2);
        assert!(play_store(&info));
        let s = Sheet {
            device: Some(info.device.id),
            pending: true,
            ..Sheet::default()
        };
        let vm = sheet_vm(&s, Some(&info), Instant::now());
        assert_eq!(vm.state, RootSheetState::Waiting);
        assert_eq!(vm.steps[0].percent, "62%");
        assert_eq!(vm.steps[1].step, RootStep::All);
    }

    #[test]
    fn dev_tools_show_the_failure_reason() {
        let mut info = pixel();
        let vm = tools_vm(Some(&info), None, fixtures::now());
        assert!(vm.full && vm.visible && vm.running);
        assert_eq!(vm.verified, "2 min ago · su -c id → uid=0");
        info.device.root.health = RootHealth::Failed;
        let f = steps::failure(&JidrError::new(ErrorCode::BootTimeout, "x"), steps::REBOOT);
        let vm = tools_vm(Some(&info), Some(&f), fixtures::now());
        assert_eq!(vm.badge, "Root failed: boot timed out");
        assert!(!tools_vm(None, None, fixtures::now()).visible);
    }

    #[test]
    fn commands_list_shapes() {
        let v = json!([{ "id": "root.set" }, { "id": "root.auto_grant" }]);
        assert!(lists_command(&v, "root.auto_grant"));
        assert!(!lists_command(
            &json!({ "commands": [{ "id": "root.set" }] }),
            "root.auto_grant"
        ));
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-ui/src/root/props/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! Build identity (Phase 9f): the dev-tools form for a Full-root device's
//! build props (`device.props.get` / `.set`). The Slint side is
//! `props.slint`'s `PropsBlock`, bound to `RootUi` in `root.slint`.

use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::rc::Rc;

use jidr_core::{DeviceStatus, JidrError, JidrResult, RootMode};
use serde_json::{Map, Value, json};
use slint::{ComponentHandle, ModelRc, SharedString, VecModel};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::RootUi;
use crate::app::{Ctx, toast};
use crate::model::DeviceInfo;

/// The props' wire names, in form order.
pub const FIELDS: [&str; 6] = [
    "model",
    "brand",
    "manufacturer",
    "device",
    "fingerprint",
    "security_patch",
];

/// The six values in form order; empty = stock.
pub type Values = [String; 6];

/// Reads `device.props.*`'s `props` object.
pub fn values_of(props: &Value) -> Values {
    FIELDS.map(|f| {
        props
            .get(f)
            .and_then(Value::as_str)
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .to_string()
    })
}

/// The `props` object for `device.props.set`: empty fields are left out.
pub fn props_of(values: &Values) -> Value {
    let mut m = Map::new();
    for (f, v) in FIELDS.iter().zip(values) {
        if !v.trim().is_empty() {
            m.insert((*f).to_string(), json!(v.trim()));
        }
    }
    Value::Object(m)
}

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
struct State {
    /// What the daemon has stored, per device.
    stored: HashMap<Uuid, Values>,
    /// The device whose form is open, and its draft.
    editing: Option<Uuid>,
    draft: Values,
    saving: bool,
    error: Option<(i32, String)>,
    /// `device.props.get` sent, waiting for the answer.
    asked: Option<Uuid>,
}

thread_local! {
    static STATE: RefCell<State> = RefCell::default();
}

/// What the block shows for one device.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct PropsVm {
    pub summary: String,
    pub custom: bool,
    pub editing: bool,
    pub values: Values,
    pub error_field: i32,
    pub error: String,
    pub pending: bool,
    pub saving: bool,
}

/// "Stock values", or the identity at a glance: model · brand (· device) ·
/// patch date. A fingerprint alone reads "Custom fingerprint".
pub fn summary(values: &Values) -> String {
    let [model, brand, manufacturer, device, fingerprint, patch] = values;
    let mut parts: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    for v in [model, brand, manufacturer, device] {
        let v = v.trim();
        if !v.is_empty() && !parts.iter().any(|p| p.eq_ignore_ascii_case(v)) {
            parts.push(v.to_string());
        }
    }
    if !patch.trim().is_empty() {
        parts.push(format!("patch {}", patch.trim()));
    }
    if parts.is_empty() {
        if fingerprint.trim().is_empty() {
            "Stock values".into()
        } else {
            "Custom fingerprint".into()
        }
    } else {
        parts.join(" · ")
    }
}

/// The open form: its draft, whether it is saving, and the refused field.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub struct Form<'a> {
    pub draft: &'a Values,
    pub saving: bool,
    pub error: Option<&'a (i32, String)>,
}

/// The view model from what is stored and the open form, if any.
pub fn props_vm(info: &DeviceInfo, stored: &Values, form: Option<Form<'_>>) -> PropsVm {
    let custom = stored.iter().any(|v| !v.is_empty());
    let (editing, values, saving, error) = match form {
        Some(f) => (true, f.draft.clone(), f.saving, f.error.cloned()),
        None => (false, stored.clone(), false, None),
    };
    let (error_field, error) = error.unwrap_or((-1, String::new()));
    PropsVm {
        summary: summary(stored),
        custom,
        editing,
        values,
        error_field,
        error,
        // A start clears `force_cold_boot`: still set while running means
        // the props were saved after this boot.
        pending: matches!(info.device.status, DeviceStatus::Running)
            && info.device.launch.force_cold_boot,
        saving,
    }
}

/// Where a `usage` error from `device.props.set` points: the field index
/// (from `data.field`) and the message without its "field: " prefix.
pub fn field_error(e: &JidrError) -> (i32, String) {
    let field = e
        .data
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|d| d.get("field"))
        .and_then(Value::as_str);
    match field.and_then(|f| FIELDS.iter().position(|x| *x == f)) {
        Some(i) => {
            let prefix = format!("{}: ", FIELDS[i]);
            let msg = e.message.strip_prefix(&prefix).unwrap_or(&e.message);
            (i as i32, capitalize(msg))
        }
        None => (-1, e.message.clone()),
    }
}

fn capitalize(s: &str) -> String {
    let mut c = s.chars();
    match c.next() {
        Some(f) => f.to_uppercase().chain(c).collect(),
        None => String::new(),
    }
}

/// Fills `ui`'s props properties.
pub fn apply(ui: &RootUi, vm: &PropsVm) {
    ui.set_props_summary(vm.summary.clone().into());
    ui.set_props_custom(vm.custom);
    ui.set_props_editing(vm.editing);
    ui.set_props_values(ModelRc::new(VecModel::from(
        vm.values
            .iter()
            .map(|v| SharedString::from(v.as_str()))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    )));
    ui.set_props_error_field(vm.error_field);
    ui.set_props_error(vm.error.clone().into());
    ui.set_props_pending(vm.pending);
    ui.set_props_saving(vm.saving);
}

pub fn wire(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    let ui = ctx.app.global::<RootUi>();
    let c = ctx.clone();
    ui.on_props_action(move |a| action(&c, a.as_str()));
    ui.on_props_edited(|i, v| {
        STATE.with(|s| {
            let mut s = s.borrow_mut();
            if let Some(slot) = usize::try_from(i).ok().and_then(|i| s.draft.get_mut(i)) {
                *slot = v.to_string();
            }
            if s.error.as_ref().is_some_and(|(f, _)| *f == i) {
                s.error = None;
            }
        });
    });
}

/// Re-renders the block for the active device, asking the daemon for its
/// props the first time it shows. Called from `root::sync`.
pub fn sync(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, info: Option<&DeviceInfo>) {
    let ui = ctx.app.global::<RootUi>();
    let Some(info) = info.filter(|i| i.device.root.mode == RootMode::Magisk) else {
        STATE.with(|s| s.borrow_mut().editing = None);
        ui.set_props_editing(false);
        return;
    };
    let id = info.device.id;
    let vm = STATE.with(|s| {
        let mut s = s.borrow_mut();
        if s.editing.is_some_and(|e| e != id) {
            s.editing = None;
            s.error = None;
        }
        let stored = s.stored.get(&id).cloned();
        if stored.is_none() && s.asked != Some(id) && ui.get_props_supported() {
            s.asked = Some(id);
            fetch(ctx, id);
        }
        let stored = stored.unwrap_or_default();
        let form = (s.editing == Some(id)).then_some(Form {
            draft: &s.draft,
            saving: s.saving,
            error: s.error.as_ref(),
        });
        props_vm(info, &stored, form)
    });
    apply(&ui, &vm);
}

fn fetch(ctx: &Ctx, id: Uuid) {
    ctx.bridge
        .call("device.props.get", json!({ "device": id }), move |r| {
            let values = r.ok().map(|v| values_of(&v["props"]));
            let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
                STATE.with(|s| {
                    let mut s = s.borrow_mut();
                    s.asked = None;
                    s.stored.insert(id, values.unwrap_or_default());
                });
                rerender();
            });
        });
}

fn rerender() {
    if let Some(c) = crate::app::ctx() {
        crate::root::sync(&c);
    }
}

fn action(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, action: &str) {
    let Some(id) = crate::player::active_id(ctx) else {
        return;
    };
    match action {
        "edit" => STATE.with(|s| {
            let mut s = s.borrow_mut();
            s.draft = s.stored.get(&id).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
            s.editing = Some(id);
            s.error = None;
        }),
        "cancel" => STATE.with(|s| {
            let mut s = s.borrow_mut();
            s.editing = None;
            s.error = None;
        }),
        "save" => {
            let draft = STATE.with(|s| s.borrow().draft.clone());
            save(ctx, id, props_of(&draft));
        }
        "reset" => save(ctx, id, json!({})),
        "restart" => restart(ctx, id),
        _ => {}
    }
    rerender();
}

fn save(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, id: Uuid, props: Value) {
    STATE.with(|s| {
        let mut s = s.borrow_mut();
        s.saving = true;
        s.error = None;
    });
    let w = ctx.app.as_weak();
    let running = ctx
        .info(id)
        .is_some_and(|i| matches!(i.device.status, DeviceStatus::Running));
    ctx.bridge.call(
        "device.props.set",
        json!({ "device": id, "props": props }),
        move |r: JidrResult<Value>| {
            let msg = match &r {
                Ok(_) if running => Some("Build identity saved. Restart to apply it.".to_string()),
                Ok(_) => Some("Build identity saved. It applies on the next start.".to_string()),
                Err(_) => None,
            };
            if let Some(m) = msg {
                toast(&w, m);
            }
            let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
                STATE.with(|s| {
                    let mut s = s.borrow_mut();
                    s.saving = false;
                    match r {
                        Ok(v) => {
                            s.stored.insert(id, values_of(&v["props"]));
                            s.editing = None;
                        }
                        Err(e) => {
                            // Reset to stock fails outside the form too.
                            if s.editing != Some(id) {
                                s.draft = s.stored.get(&id).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
                                s.editing = Some(id);
                            }
                            s.error = Some(field_error(&e));
                        }
                    }
                });
                rerender();
            });
        },
    );
}

/// "Restart now": stop, then a start — the cold boot the props need.
fn restart(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, id: Uuid) {
    let w = ctx.app.as_weak();
    ctx.bridge
        .call("device.stop", json!({ "device": id }), move |r| match r {
            Ok(_) => {
                let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
                    if let Some(c) = crate::app::ctx() {
                        crate::launcher::start(&c, id);
                    }
                });
            }
            Err(e) => toast(&w, e.message),
        });
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::fixtures;

    fn pixel() -> DeviceInfo {
        fixtures::device_infos().remove(0)
    }

    fn values(model: &str, brand: &str, patch: &str) -> Values {
        [
            model.into(),
            brand.into(),
            String::new(),
            String::new(),
            String::new(),
            patch.into(),
        ]
    }

    #[test]
    fn summaries() {
        assert_eq!(summary(&Values::default()), "Stock values");
        assert_eq!(
            summary(&values("Jidr One", "jidr", "2026-10-05")),
            "Jidr One · jidr · patch 2026-10-05"
        );
        let mut v = values("Pixel 8", "google", "");
        v[2] = "Google".into();
        assert_eq!(summary(&v), "Pixel 8 · google", "manufacturer = brand");
        let mut v = Values::default();
        v[4] = "google/husky/husky:15".into();
        assert_eq!(summary(&v), "Custom fingerprint");
    }

    #[test]
    fn props_round_trip_and_empty_fields_are_left_out() {
        let v = values(" Jidr One ", "", "2026-10-05");
        let p = props_of(&v);
        assert_eq!(
            p,
            json!({ "model": "Jidr One", "security_patch": "2026-10-05" })
        );
        assert_eq!(values_of(&p), values("Jidr One", "", "2026-10-05"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn pending_means_saved_after_this_boot() {
        let mut info = pixel();
        let stored = values("Jidr One", "", "");
        assert!(!props_vm(&info, &stored, None).pending);
        info.device.launch.force_cold_boot = true;
        let vm = props_vm(&info, &stored, None);
        assert!(vm.pending);
        assert!(vm.custom);
        info.device.status = DeviceStatus::Stopped;
        assert!(
            !props_vm(&info, &stored, None).pending,
            "stopped: no restart"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_refused_field_shows_under_that_field() {
        let e = JidrError::usage("security_patch: a date like 2026-10-05")
            .with_data(json!({ "field": "security_patch" }));
        assert_eq!(field_error(&e), (5, "A date like 2026-10-05".into()));
        let e = JidrError::usage("phone isn't Full-root (Magisk)");
        assert_eq!(field_error(&e).0, -1);
        let draft = values("Jidr One", "", "Oct");
        let err = field_error(
            &JidrError::usage("security_patch: x").with_data(json!({ "field": "security_patch" })),
        );
        let vm = props_vm(
            &pixel(),
            &Values::default(),
            Some(Form {
                draft: &draft,
                saving: false,
                error: Some(&err),
            }),
        );
        assert!(vm.editing);
        assert_eq!(vm.error_field, 5);
        assert_eq!(vm.values[5], "Oct", "the draft stays");
    }
}
```

```slint
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
// Build identity (Phase 9f, Stream C): the build props a Full-root device
// reports, in the widget panel's Developer tools under the root rows. No
// design existed; built from the Workbench tokens and the panel's own rows
// (label + control, 11 px hints, small buttons), mirrored by hand for RTL.
// `RootDevTools` binds it to `RootUi`; Rust (`src/root/props/mod.rs`) fills it.

import { Theme } from "../../../ui/theme.slint";
import { Icons } from "../../../ui/icons.slint";
import { T, Role, Icon, Button, ButtonKind, TextField } from "../../../ui/components/base.slint";

export component PropsBlock inherits VerticalLayout {
    /// "Stock values" or "Jidr One · jidr · patch 2026-10-05".
    in property <string> summary;
    /// Any field set (Reset to stock applies).
    in property <bool> custom;
    in property <bool> editing;
    /// The six values in form order (model, brand, manufacturer, device,
    /// fingerprint, security patch); read when the form opens.
    in property <[string]> values;
    /// The field the daemon refused (-1: none) and why.
    in property <int> error-field: -1;
    in property <string> error;
    /// Saved since this boot: the next start applies them.
    in property <bool> pending;
    in property <bool> running;
    in property <bool> busy;
    in property <bool> saving;
    /// "edit", "cancel", "save", "reset", "restart".
    callback action(string);
    callback edited(int, string);

    property <[string]> labels: [@tr("Model"), @tr("Brand"), @tr("Manufacturer"), @tr("Device"), @tr("Fingerprint"), @tr("Security patch")];
    property <[string]> holders: [@tr("Stock"), @tr("Stock"), @tr("Stock"), @tr("Stock"), @tr("Stock"), "YYYY-MM-DD"];
    spacing: 8px;
    accessible-role: groupbox;
    accessible-label: @tr("Build identity");

    // "Build identity" + [Edit…] on the end edge.
    Rectangle {
        height: 20px;
        title := T {
            x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - self.width : 0px;
            width: min(self.preferred-width, parent.width - 90px);
            text: @tr("Build identity");
        }
        if !editing: Button {
            x: Theme.rtl ? 0px : parent.width - self.width;
            y: (parent.height - self.height) / 2;
            small: true;
            kind: ButtonKind.tertiary;
            has-icon: true;
            icon: Icons.sliders-horizontal;
            enabled: !busy;
            text: @tr("Edit…");
            clicked => { root.action("edit"); }
        }
    }

    if !editing: T {
        height: 16px;
        font-size: 12px;
        color: custom ? Theme.text-secondary : Theme.text-tertiary;
        overflow: elide;
        text: summary;
    }

    // ---- the form
    if editing: VerticalLayout {
        spacing: 8px;
        for label[i] in labels: VerticalLayout {
            spacing: 4px;
            property <bool> mono: i >= 4;
            T {
                height: 14px;
                role: Role.label;
                font-size: 12px;
                color: Theme.text-secondary;
                horizontal-alignment: Theme.rtl ? right : left;
                text: label;
            }
            TextField {
                text: values[i];
                placeholder: holders[i];
                mono: mono;
                enabled: !saving;
                focused-look: error-field == i;
                edited(v) => { root.edited(i, v); }
                accepted => { root.action("save"); }
            }
            if error-field == i: T {
                height: 14px;
                font-size: 11px;
                color: Theme.negative;
                overflow: elide;
                horizontal-alignment: Theme.rtl ? right : left;
                text: error;
            }
        }
        // Wrapped text reports a one-line preferred height in a layout, so
        // these get room for two lines.
        if error != "" && error-field < 0: T {
            height: 30px;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: Theme.negative;
            wrap: word-wrap;
            overflow: clip;
            vertical-alignment: top;
            horizontal-alignment: Theme.rtl ? right : left;
            text: error;
        }
        T {
            height: 30px;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: Theme.text-tertiary;
            wrap: word-wrap;
            overflow: clip;
            vertical-alignment: top;
            horizontal-alignment: Theme.rtl ? right : left;
            text: @tr("Empty fields keep the image's value. Changes apply on the next start, which is a cold boot.");
        }
        // [Save] [Cancel] … [Reset to stock]
        Rectangle {
            height: Theme.control-height-sm;
            HorizontalLayout {
                x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - self.preferred-width : 0px;
                width: self.preferred-width;
                spacing: 8px;
                for slot[j] in 2: Rectangle {
                    property <int> i: Theme.rtl ? 1 - j : j;
                    width: i == 0 ? save.width : cancel.width;
                    save := Button {
                        visible: i == 0;
                        small: true;
                        kind: ButtonKind.primary;
                        has-icon: true;
                        icon: Icons.save;
                        enabled: !saving && !busy;
                        text: saving ? @tr("Saving…") : @tr("Save");
                        clicked => { root.action("save"); }
                    }
                    cancel := Button {
                        visible: i == 1;
                        small: true;
                        enabled: !saving;
                        text: @tr("Cancel");
                        clicked => { root.action("cancel"); }
                    }
                }
            }
            if custom: Button {
                x: Theme.rtl ? 0px : parent.width - self.width;
                small: true;
                kind: ButtonKind.tertiary;
                has-icon: true;
                icon: Icons.undo-2;
                enabled: !saving && !busy;
                text: @tr("Reset to stock");
                clicked => { root.action("reset"); }
            }
        }
    }

    // ---- saved, not applied yet
    if pending && !editing: Rectangle {
        height: 30px;
        border-radius: Theme.radius-md;
        background: Theme.status-warning-container;
        border-width: 1px;
        border-color: Theme.status-warning-border;
        Icon {
            x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - 10px - self.width : 10px;
            size: Theme.icon-sm;
            source: Icons.clock;
            colorize: Theme.status-warning-on-container;
        }
        T {
            x: Theme.rtl ? (running ? restart.width + 12px : 8px) : 30px;
            width: parent.width - 38px - (running ? restart.width + 4px : 0px);
            font-size: 12px;
            color: Theme.status-warning-on-container;
            overflow: elide;
            horizontal-alignment: Theme.rtl ? right : left;
            text: @tr("Applies on the next start");
        }
        restart := Button {
            visible: running;
            x: Theme.rtl ? 4px : parent.width - self.width - 4px;
            y: (parent.height - self.height) / 2;
            small: true;
            kind: ButtonKind.tertiary;
            has-icon: true;
            icon: Icons.rotate-cw;
            enabled: !busy;
            text: @tr("Restart now");
            clicked => { root.action("restart"); }
        }
    }
}

```

`crates/jidr-ui/src/root/root.slint`:

```slint
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
// Root UX (Phase 9e, Stream C): the Root setup sheet, the root-mode cards and
// the dev-tools root section. Built to the Workbench root design,
// the create design and the RootBadge / RootModeSelector component specs.
// Rust (`src/root/mod.rs`) fills `RootUi`; every string here goes through @tr.

import { Theme } from "../../ui/theme.slint";
import { Icons } from "../../ui/icons.slint";
import { T, Role, Tone, Tones, Icon, Spinner, Tag, Button, ButtonKind, Toggle, Kbd } from "../../ui/components/base.slint";
import { RootBadge } from "../../ui/components/status.slint";
import { RootKind, RootChoice } from "../../ui/types.slint";
import { PropsBlock } from "props/props.slint";

/// Which body the Root sheet shows.
export enum RootSheetState {
    /// `root.set` is running (step N of 5).
    progress,
    /// Verified: `su -c id` answered uid 0.
    success,
    /// The job failed or was stopped; the reason and the failed step show.
    failed,
    /// Play Store image still on its first boot; setup starts after it.
    waiting,
    /// Play Store guided tap (ADR-0002): Magisk asks to grant root to Shell.
    grant,
    /// The guided tap was denied or timed out (ADR-0002): Try again / Revert.
    unverified,
}

/// The five steps of Full-root setup (the root design).
export enum RootStep { download, patch, reboot, install, verify, first-boot, all }

/// Where a step stands.
export enum RootStepState { done, now, waiting, failed, skipped }

export struct RootStepVm {
    step: RootStep,
    state: RootStepState,
    /// Elapsed `m:ss` for the running or failed step; empty otherwise.
    time: string,
    /// "62%" for the Play Store first boot; empty otherwise.
    percent: string,
}

/// One logcat-style line under a failure (`.logtail`): stays LTR.
export struct RootLogLine {
    time: string,
    source: string,
    /// "" (info), "w" or "e".
    level: string,
    text: string,
}

/// State shared by the sheet, the cards and the dev-tools section.
export global RootUi {
    // ---- the Root sheet
    in-out property <bool> open;
    in property <RootSheetState> state;
    in property <string> device-name;
    in property <string> serial;
    /// Play Store image: Beta tag, guided tap, no Shell root.
    in property <bool> play-store;
    in property <string> magisk-version: "30.7";
    in property <[RootStepVm]> steps;
    /// 1-based step the job is on (progress) or stopped at (failed).
    in property <int> step-index;
    /// Short failure reason after "Root failed: ", e.g. "boot timed out".
    in property <string> reason;
    /// Failure body: what happened, whether data is safe, what to do.
    in property <string> detail;
    in property <[RootLogLine]> log;
    /// Success proof: `uid=0(root) gid=0(root)`, seconds taken.
    in property <string> su-output: "uid=0(root) gid=0(root)";
    in property <string> took;
    /// The guided-tap wait: seconds left (60 s, ADR-0002).
    in property <string> grant-left;
    /// "Show steps" on success.
    in-out property <bool> show-steps;
    /// Sheet buttons: "background", "done", "stop", "try-again", "revert",
    /// "copy-log", "save-snapshot", "dont-root", "cancel-grant".
    callback action(string);

    // ---- the dev-tools root section (active tab)
    in property <bool> tools-visible;
    in property <RootKind> tools-kind;
    in property <string> tools-badge;
    in property <bool> tools-beta;
    /// Full root (Magisk): Verify again, Revert and Auto-grant apply.
    in property <bool> tools-full;
    in property <bool> tools-running;
    in property <bool> tools-busy;
    /// "2 min ago · su -c id → uid=0"; empty when not verified.
    in property <string> tools-verified;
    /// The last setup failed: Try again instead of Verify again.
    in property <bool> tools-failed;
    in property <bool> tools-auto-grant;
    /// The daemon can set auto-grant (gap G15).
    in property <bool> tools-auto-grant-supported;
    /// "verify", "revert", "set-up" (also Try again), "auto-grant" (value
    /// "true"/"false").
    callback tools-action(string, string);

    // ---- build identity (Phase 9f, Full root): `src/root/props`
    /// The daemon has `device.props.set`.
    in property <bool> props-supported;
    in property <string> props-summary;
    in property <bool> props-custom;
    in property <bool> props-editing;
    in property <[string]> props-values;
    in property <int> props-error-field: -1;
    in property <string> props-error;
    in property <bool> props-pending;
    in property <bool> props-saving;
    /// "edit", "cancel", "save", "reset", "restart".
    callback props-action(string);
    callback props-edited(int, string);
}

// ============================================================ Root sheet

/// `.seal`: the 72 × 72 tile at the top of the sheet.
component Seal inherits Rectangle {
    in property <RootSheetState> state;
    property <bool> bad: state == RootSheetState.failed;
    property <bool> ok: state == RootSheetState.success;
    property <bool> warn: state == RootSheetState.unverified;
    width: 72px;
    height: 72px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    background: bad ? Theme.status-negative-container
        : ok ? Theme.status-root-strong-container
        : Theme.status-root-soft-container;
    border-width: bad ? 2px : 1.5px;
    border-color: bad ? Theme.negative
        : ok ? Theme.status-root-strong-container
        : Theme.status-root-soft-border;
    Icon {
        size: 32px;
        colorize: bad ? Theme.status-negative-on-container
            : ok ? Theme.status-root-strong-on-container
            : Theme.status-root-soft-on-container;
        source: bad ? Icons.circle-x
            : ok ? Icons.badge-check
            : warn ? Icons.circle-help
            : Icons.key-round;
    }
}

/// One `.rstep` row: 24 px glyph · title (+ sub) · right column.
component StepRow inherits Rectangle {
    in property <RootStepVm> vm;
    in property <string> magisk-version;
    property <Tone> tone: vm.state == RootStepState.done ? Tone.positive
        : vm.state == RootStepState.now ? Tone.transition
        : vm.state == RootStepState.failed ? Tone.negative
        : Tone.neutral;
    property <string> title: vm.step == RootStep.download ? @tr("Download Magisk {}", magisk-version)
        : vm.step == RootStep.patch ? @tr("Patch boot image")
        : vm.step == RootStep.reboot ? (vm.state == RootStepState.now ? @tr("Rebooting") : @tr("Reboot"))
        : vm.step == RootStep.install ? (vm.state == RootStepState.skipped ? @tr("Install Magisk app · Verify") : @tr("Install Magisk app"))
        : vm.step == RootStep.verify ? @tr("Verify")
        : vm.step == RootStep.all ? @tr("Download Magisk {} › Patch › Reboot › Install › Verify", magisk-version)
        : @tr("Booting Android… {}", vm.percent);
    property <string> sub: vm.step == RootStep.patch ? @tr("Original kept for revert")
        : vm.step == RootStep.reboot && vm.state == RootStepState.now ? @tr("Waiting for Android to report boot complete")
        : vm.step == RootStep.reboot && vm.state == RootStepState.failed ? @tr("Boot complete never reported")
        : vm.step == RootStep.verify ? "su -c id"
        : vm.step == RootStep.first-boot ? @tr("First boot of a Play Store image")
        : "";
    property <string> trail: vm.state == RootStepState.done ? @tr("Done")
        : vm.state == RootStepState.now ? (vm.step == RootStep.first-boot ? vm.percent : vm.time)
        : vm.state == RootStepState.failed ? @tr("Failed · {}", vm.time)
        : vm.state == RootStepState.skipped ? @tr("Not run")
        : @tr("Queued");
    height: sub != "" ? 50px : 40px;
    background: vm.state == RootStepState.now ? Theme.status-transition-container
        : vm.state == RootStepState.failed ? Theme.status-negative-container
        : transparent;
    // `.g`: 24 px glyph on the start edge.
    Rectangle {
        x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - 14px - 24px : 14px;
        y: (parent.height - 24px) / 2;
        width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
        border-radius: 12px;
        background: Tones.container(tone);
        if vm.state == RootStepState.now: Spinner {
            size: 14px;
            tint: Tones.on(tone);
        }
        if vm.state != RootStepState.now: Icon {
            size: 14px;
            colorize: Tones.on(tone);
            source: vm.state == RootStepState.done ? Icons.check
                : vm.state == RootStepState.failed ? Icons.x
                : vm.state == RootStepState.skipped ? Icons.minus
                : Icons.clock;
        }
    }
    // `.r`: status or clock on the end edge (mono, never mirrored).
    trail-t := T {
        x: Theme.rtl ? 14px : parent.width - 14px - self.width;
        width: self.preferred-width;
        mono: true;
        ltr: true;
        font-size: 12px;
        color: vm.state == RootStepState.failed ? Theme.status-negative-on-container : Theme.text-secondary;
        text: root.trail;
    }
    property <length> text-x: Theme.rtl ? 14px + trail-t.width + 12px : 14px + 24px + 12px;
    property <length> text-w: root.width - 2 * 14px - 24px - 2 * 12px - trail-t.width;
    T {
        x: root.text-x;
        y: root.sub != "" ? 7px : 0px;
        width: root.text-w;
        height: root.sub != "" ? 18px : parent.height;
        text: root.title;
        font-size: 13px;
        font-weight: vm.state == RootStepState.now || vm.state == RootStepState.failed ? 600 : 400;
        color: vm.state == RootStepState.waiting || vm.state == RootStepState.skipped ? Theme.text-secondary : Theme.text-primary;
    }
    if root.sub != "": T {
        x: root.text-x;
        y: 26px;
        width: root.text-w;
        height: 17px;
        text: root.sub;
        mono: vm.step == RootStep.verify;
        font-size: 12px;
        color: Theme.text-secondary;
    }
}

/// `.rsteps`: rounded list of step rows with hairlines.
component Steps inherits Rectangle {

/// The Root setup sheet (`.sheet.w-root`, 620 px), dropped from the title
/// bar over a scrim. Place it under the title bar and give it the rest of
/// the window.
export component RootLayer inherits Rectangle {
    property <RootSheetState> st: RootUi.state;
    property <bool> busy: st == RootSheetState.progress || st == RootSheetState.waiting || st == RootSheetState.grant;
    background: Theme.scrim;
    TouchArea {}
    sheet := Rectangle {
        x: (parent.width - self.width) / 2;
        y: 0px;
        width: 620px;
        height: min(body.preferred-height + 52px + 56px, parent.height - 24px);
        background: Theme.elevation-3-surface;
        border-width: 1px;
        border-color: Theme.border-default;
        border-radius: Theme.radius-xl;
        drop-shadow-offset-y: Theme.elevation-3-shadow-y;
        drop-shadow-blur: Theme.elevation-3-shadow-blur;
        drop-shadow-color: Theme.elevation-3-shadow-color;
        clip: true;
        accessible-role: groupbox;
        accessible-label: @tr("Root setup");
        TouchArea {}
        // Header: "Full root · {device}" on the start edge; Beta tag and
        // serial on the end edge.
        Rectangle {
            y: 0px;
            height: 52px;
            T {
                x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - 20px - self.width : 20px;
                width: min(self.preferred-width, parent.width - 240px);
                font-size: 15px;
                font-weight: 600;
                text: @tr("Full root · {}", RootUi.device-name);
            }
            HorizontalLayout {
                x: Theme.rtl ? 20px : parent.width - 20px - self.preferred-width;
                width: self.preferred-width;
                spacing: 10px;
                for slot[j] in 2: Rectangle {
                    property <int> i: Theme.rtl ? 1 - j : j;
                    width: i == 0 ? (RootUi.play-store ? tag.width : 0px) : serial.width;
                    tag := Tag {
                        visible: i == 0 && RootUi.play-store;
                        y: (parent.height - self.height) / 2;
                        text: @tr("Beta · Play Store image");
                        tone: Tone.warning;
                    }
                    serial := T {
                        visible: i == 1;
                        width: self.preferred-width;
                        mono: true;
                        ltr: true;
                        font-size: 12px;
                        color: Theme.text-secondary;
                        text: RootUi.serial;
                    }
                }
            }
            Rectangle { y: parent.height - 1px; height: 1px; background: Theme.border-subtle; }
        }
        body := VerticalLayout {
            y: 52px;
            height: sheet.height - 52px - 56px;
            padding: 20px;
            padding-top: 4px;
            spacing: 16px;
            alignment: start;
            // `.rhero`: seal, headline, badge, explanation.
            VerticalLayout {
                padding-top: 16px;
                spacing: 12px;
                alignment: start;
                HorizontalLayout { alignment: center; Seal { state: st; } }
                T {
                    role: Role.hero;
                    horizontal-alignment: center;
                    text: st == RootSheetState.progress ? @tr("Setting up root…")
                        : st == RootSheetState.success ? @tr("Rooted")
                        : st == RootSheetState.failed ? @tr("Root failed")
                        : st == RootSheetState.waiting ? @tr("Waiting to set up root")
                        : st == RootSheetState.grant ? @tr("Tap Grant on the device")
                        : @tr("Root unverified");
                }
                HorizontalLayout {
                    alignment: center;
                    spacing: 6px;
                    RootBadge {
                        kind: st == RootSheetState.progress || st == RootSheetState.grant ? RootKind.setting-up
                            : st == RootSheetState.success ? RootKind.verified
                            : st == RootSheetState.failed ? RootKind.failed
                            : st == RootSheetState.waiting ? RootKind.full
                            : RootKind.unverified;
                        beta: RootUi.play-store && (st == RootSheetState.waiting || st == RootSheetState.success);
                        text: st == RootSheetState.progress ? @tr("Setting up root… · step {} of 5", RootUi.step-index)
                            : st == RootSheetState.grant ? @tr("Setting up root… · step 5 of 5")
                            : st == RootSheetState.success ? @tr("Rooted · Magisk {} · verified just now", RootUi.magisk-version)
                            : st == RootSheetState.failed ? @tr("Root failed: {}", RootUi.reason)
                            : st == RootSheetState.waiting ? @tr("Full root")
                            : @tr("Root unverified");
                    }
                }
                HorizontalLayout {
                    alignment: center;
                    T {
                        max-width: 440px;
                        font-size: 13px;
                        color: Theme.text-secondary;
                        wrap: word-wrap;
                        horizontal-alignment: center;
                        text: st == RootSheetState.progress ? @tr("Reboots the device to finish root setup (about 40 s). Leave it running; you can close this sheet.")
                            : st == RootSheetState.success ? @tr("Jidr checked that su really answers as root before saying so.")
                            : st == RootSheetState.failed && RootUi.detail != "" ? RootUi.detail
                            : st == RootSheetState.failed && RootUi.step-index == 1 ? @tr("Couldn't download Magisk {}. Nothing on {} changed; check the connection and try again.", RootUi.magisk-version, RootUi.device-name)
                            : st == RootSheetState.failed && RootUi.step-index == 2 ? @tr("Couldn't patch the boot image. {} is unchanged.", RootUi.device-name)
                            : st == RootSheetState.failed && RootUi.step-index == 3 ? @tr("{} didn't finish booting after the reboot. Your data is intact and the original boot image is kept, so you can revert.", RootUi.device-name)
                            : st == RootSheetState.failed && RootUi.step-index == 4 ? @tr("Couldn't install the Magisk app on {}. Your data is intact and the original boot image is kept, so you can revert.", RootUi.device-name)
                            : st == RootSheetState.failed ? @tr("su -c id didn't answer as root on {}. Your data is intact and the original boot image is kept, so you can revert.", RootUi.device-name)
                            : st == RootSheetState.waiting ? @tr("Root setup starts when Android finishes its first boot. Play Store images are signed by Google, so this path is less tested.")
                            : st == RootSheetState.grant ? @tr("Magisk will ask to grant root to Shell. Tap Grant in the device window. Jidr waits {} more; \"Forever\" is up to you.", RootUi.grant-left)
                            : @tr("Shell wasn't granted root, so Jidr can't say {} is rooted. Try again and tap Grant, or revert to unrooted. Your data is intact.", RootUi.device-name);
                    }
                }
            }
            if st == RootSheetState.success: Proof {
                su-output: RootUi.su-output;
                magisk-version: RootUi.magisk-version;
                took: RootUi.took;
            }
            if st != RootSheetState.success || RootUi.show-steps: Steps {
                steps: RootUi.steps;
                magisk-version: RootUi.magisk-version;
            }
            if st == RootSheetState.failed && RootUi.log.length > 0: LogTail { lines: RootUi.log; }
            if st == RootSheetState.success || st == RootSheetState.waiting: IntegrityBanner {
                device-name: RootUi.device-name;
                play-store: st == RootSheetState.waiting;
            }
        }
        // Footer (`.sf`): a tertiary action on the start edge, the rest on
        // the end edge with the primary last (first in RTL).
        footer := Rectangle {
            y: sheet.height - 56px;
            height: 56px;
            background: Theme.surface-chrome;
            Rectangle { y: 0px; height: 1px; background: Theme.border-default; }
            property <string> start-text: st == RootSheetState.progress ? @tr("Stop and revert")
                : st == RootSheetState.success ? (RootUi.show-steps ? @tr("Hide steps") : @tr("Show steps"))
                : st == RootSheetState.failed ? @tr("Copy log")
                : st == RootSheetState.waiting ? @tr("Don't root this device")
                : st == RootSheetState.grant ? @tr("Cancel")
                : "";
            if footer.start-text != "": Button {
                x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - 16px - self.width : 16px;
                y: (parent.height - self.height) / 2;
                kind: ButtonKind.tertiary;
                has-icon: st == RootSheetState.failed;
                icon: Icons.copy;
                text: footer.start-text;
                clicked => {
                    if (st == RootSheetState.success) {
                        RootUi.show-steps = !RootUi.show-steps;
                    } else {
                        RootUi.action(st == RootSheetState.progress ? "stop"
                            : st == RootSheetState.failed ? "copy-log"
                            : st == RootSheetState.waiting ? "dont-root"
                            : "cancel-grant");
                    }
                }
            }
            // [secondary, primary]: Continue in background | Save snapshot…
            // + Done | Revert to unrooted + Try again.
            property <bool> has-primary: st == RootSheetState.success || st == RootSheetState.failed || st == RootSheetState.unverified;
            end := HorizontalLayout {
                x: Theme.rtl ? 16px : parent.width - 16px - self.preferred-width;
                y: (parent.height - 30px) / 2;
                width: self.preferred-width;
                height: 30px;
                spacing: 8px;
                for slot[j] in 2: Rectangle {
                    property <int> i: Theme.rtl ? 1 - j : j;
                    width: i == 0 ? second.width : (footer.has-primary ? primary.width : 0px);
                    second := Button {
                        visible: i == 0;
                        has-icon: st == RootSheetState.failed || st == RootSheetState.unverified;
                        icon: Icons.undo-2;
                        text: busy ? @tr("Continue in background")
                            : st == RootSheetState.success ? @tr("Save snapshot…")
                            : @tr("Revert to unrooted");
                        clicked => {
                            RootUi.action(busy ? "background" : st == RootSheetState.success ? "save-snapshot" : "revert");
                        }
                    }
                    primary := Button {
                        visible: i == 1 && footer.has-primary;
                        kind: ButtonKind.primary;
                        has-icon: st != RootSheetState.success;
                        icon: Icons.rotate-ccw;
                        kbd: st == RootSheetState.success ? "↵" : "";
                        text: st == RootSheetState.success ? @tr("Done") : @tr("Try again");
                        clicked => { RootUi.action(st == RootSheetState.success ? "done" : "try-again"); }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================ RootModeSelector

/// One root-mode card (`.rcard`): icon + title, body, optional note, a round
/// radio on the end edge. Hover and focus states per the component spec.
component ModeCard inherits Rectangle {
    in property <string> title;
    in property <string> body;
    in property <string> note;
    in property <image> icon;
    in property <bool> on;
    in property <bool> featured;
    in property <bool> disabled;
    in property <bool> beta;
    in property <bool> compact;
    in property <bool> focused;
    callback clicked();
    property <length> pad: compact ? 10px : 14px;
    border-radius: Theme.radius-lg;
    border-width: on ? 1px : 1px;
    border-color: on ? Theme.accent-fill
        : featured && !disabled ? Theme.status-root-soft-border
        : touch.has-hover && !disabled ? Theme.border-strong
        : Theme.border-default;
    background: disabled ? transparent
        : on ? Theme.accent-container
        : featured ? Theme.status-root-soft-container
        : Theme.surface-raised;

/// None · Shell root (adb) · Full root as a radio group (RootModeSelector
/// spec). D7: Shell is the default where allowed and Full is highlighted;
/// Play Store images disable Shell and mark Full as Beta. ↑/↓ (←/→) or
/// 1/2/3 choose. Same interface as the basic `RootCards`.
export component RootModeSelector inherits Rectangle {
    in-out property <RootChoice> selected: RootChoice.shell;
    in property <bool> shell-allowed: true;
    in property <bool> play-store: false;
    in property <string> magisk-version: "30.7";
    in property <bool> compact: false;
    in property <bool> long-copy: true;
    callback changed(RootChoice);
    height: compact ? 40px : (play-store ? 120px : 96px);
    accessible-role: list;
    accessible-label: @tr("Root mode");
    property <length> w: (self.width - 20px) / 3;
    property <int> index: selected == RootChoice.none ? 0 : selected == RootChoice.shell ? 1 : 2;
    function pick(i: int) {
        if (i == 1 && !root.shell-allowed) { return; }
        root.selected = i == 0 ? RootChoice.none : i == 1 ? RootChoice.shell : RootChoice.full;
        root.changed(root.selected);
    }
    function step(d: int) {
        // Skip a disabled Shell card.
        if (d > 0) {
            root.pick(root.index == 0 ? (root.shell-allowed ? 1 : 2) : 2);
        } else {
            root.pick(root.index == 2 ? (root.shell-allowed ? 1 : 0) : 0);
        }
    }
    keys := FocusScope {
        key-pressed(ev) => {
            if (ev.text == "1") { root.pick(0); return accept; }
            if (ev.text == "2") { root.pick(1); return accept; }
            if (ev.text == "3") { root.pick(2); return accept; }
            if (ev.text == Key.DownArrow || ev.text == (Theme.rtl ? Key.LeftArrow : Key.RightArrow)) { root.step(1); return accept; }
            if (ev.text == Key.UpArrow || ev.text == (Theme.rtl ? Key.RightArrow : Key.LeftArrow)) { root.step(-1); return accept; }
            reject
        }
    }
    for slot[j] in 3: ModeCard {
        property <int> i: Theme.rtl ? 2 - j : j;
        x: j * (w + 10px);
        width: w;
        height: parent.height;
        compact: root.compact;
        focused: keys.has-focus && i == root.index;
        icon: i == 0 ? Icons.minus : i == 1 ? Icons.terminal : Icons.key-round;
        title: i == 0 ? @tr("None") : i == 1 ? (root.long-copy ? @tr("Shell root (adb)") : @tr("Shell root")) : @tr("Full root");
        body: i == 0 ? (root.long-copy ? @tr("A stock device. Test apps as users see them.") : @tr("A stock device."))
            : i == 1 ? (root.long-copy ? @tr("adb root works. Nothing on the system changes.") : @tr("adb root works. Nothing changes."))
            : (root.long-copy ? @tr("Installs and verifies Magisk {}. Reboots once (about 40 s).", root.magisk-version) : @tr("Magisk, verified. One reboot."));
        note: i == 1 && !root.shell-allowed ? @tr("Play Store images don't allow adb root.")
            : i == 2 && root.play-store ? @tr("Rooted emulators can't pass Play Integrity. Apps that check it will refuse to run.")
            : "";
        on: i == root.index;
        featured: i == 2;
        disabled: i == 1 && !root.shell-allowed;
        beta: i == 2 && root.play-store;
        clicked => {
            keys.focus();
            root.pick(i);
        }
    }
}
```
