`crates/jidr-ui/src/root/steps.rs`:

```rs
//! Full-root setup as the five steps of the Root sheet (the root design):
//! Download, Patch, Reboot, Install Magisk app, Verify. `root.set magisk`
//! reports finer job messages (`crates/jidr-root/src/magisk/mod.rs`); this
//! maps them onto the steps, monotonically, and classifies a failure.

use jidr_core::{ErrorCode, JidrError};

/// The design's steps, in order.
pub const STEPS: usize = 5;
pub const DOWNLOAD: usize = 0;
pub const PATCH: usize = 1;
pub const REBOOT: usize = 2;
pub const INSTALL: usize = 3;
pub const VERIFY: usize = 4;

/// The step a `root.set magisk` job message belongs to, given the step the
/// job is on. Unknown messages keep the current step.
pub fn step_for(message: &str, current: usize) -> usize {
    let m = message.trim();
    let mapped = if m.starts_with("Resolving the Magisk release")
        || m.starts_with("Downloading Magisk")
        || (m.starts_with("Magisk ") && m.contains("GPL"))
    {
        DOWNLOAD
    } else if m.starts_with("Patching the ramdisk") {
        PATCH
    } else if m.starts_with("Stopping before the cold boot") || m.starts_with("Cold booting") {
        // The first cold boot boots the patched ramdisk; the second one,
        // after the app and its environment, belongs to the install step.
        if current >= INSTALL { INSTALL } else { REBOOT }
    } else if m.starts_with("Installing the Magisk app")
        || m.starts_with("Setting up Magisk's environment")
        || m.starts_with("Play Store: open the Magisk app")
        || m == "Rebooting"
    {
        INSTALL
    } else if m.starts_with("Granting the adb shell su access")
        || is_grant_prompt(m)
        || m.starts_with("Verifying root")
    {
        VERIFY
    } else {
        current
    };
    mapped.max(current)
}

/// The Play Store guided tap (ADR-0002): the job waits for the user to tap
/// Grant in Magisk's prompt.
pub fn is_grant_prompt(message: &str) -> bool {
    message.starts_with("Magisk will ask to grant root to Shell")
}

/// What the Root sheet shows after a failed or stopped job.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Failure {
    /// After "Root failed: ".
    pub reason: String,
    /// The step that failed (0-based).
    pub step: usize,
    /// The guided tap was denied or timed out: "Root unverified", not failed.
    pub unverified: bool,
    /// The user stopped it.
    pub cancelled: bool,
    /// The daemon's message, for steps without a designed explanation.
    pub message: String,
}

/// Classifies the error a root job ended with, on the step it reached.
pub fn failure(err: &JidrError, step: usize) -> Failure {
    let data = err.data.as_ref();
    let flag = |k: &str| data.and_then(|d| d.get(k));
    // `jidr_core::cancel::cancelled()`: `unexpected` with `data.cancelled`.
    let cancelled = flag("cancelled").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()) == Some(true);
    let unverified = flag("state").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) == Some("awaiting_user_grant");
    let reason = if cancelled {
        "stopped".to_string()
    } else if unverified {
        "Shell wasn't granted root".to_string()
    } else if err.code == ErrorCode::BootTimeout {
        "boot timed out".to_string()
    } else if err.message.contains("su -c id") {
        "su didn't answer as root".to_string()
    } else {
        match step {
            DOWNLOAD => "download failed",
            PATCH => "patch step failed",
            REBOOT => "boot failed",
            INSTALL => "Magisk app install failed",
            _ => "verification failed",
        }
        .to_string()
    };
    Failure {
        reason,
        step: if err.code == ErrorCode::BootTimeout && step < REBOOT {
            REBOOT
        } else {
            step
        },
        unverified,
        cancelled,
        message: err.message.clone(),
    }
}

/// `m:ss` for a number of seconds.
pub fn clock(secs: u64) -> String {
    format!("{}:{:02}", secs / 60, secs % 60)
}

/// One `.logtail` line: `HH:MM:SS  source L text`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct LogEntry {
    pub time: String,
    pub source: &'static str,
    /// "", "w" or "e".
    pub level: &'static str,
    pub text: String,
}

/// The last `n` progress lines of a job, plus how it ended.
pub fn log_tail(entries: &[LogEntry], n: usize) -> Vec<LogEntry> {
    entries[entries.len().saturating_sub(n)..].to_vec()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use serde_json::json;

    /// The messages `root.set magisk` reports on a google_apis image, in
    /// order (crates/jidr-root/src/magisk/mod.rs).
    const GOOGLE_APIS: &[(&str, usize)] = &[
        ("Resolving the Magisk release", DOWNLOAD),
        (
            "Magisk 30.7 is GPL-3.0-only; source: https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk. Jidr downloads it at runtime and never bundles it.",
            DOWNLOAD,
        ),
        ("Downloading Magisk 30.7", DOWNLOAD),
        ("Patching the ramdisk for Magisk 30.7", PATCH),
        ("Stopping before the cold boot", REBOOT),
        ("Cold booting", REBOOT),
        ("Installing the Magisk app", INSTALL),
        ("Setting up Magisk's environment", INSTALL),
        ("Rebooting", INSTALL),
        ("Stopping before the cold boot", INSTALL),
        ("Cold booting", INSTALL),
        ("Granting the adb shell su access", VERIFY),
        ("Verifying root", VERIFY),
    ];

    #[test]
    fn job_messages_map_onto_the_five_steps() {
        let mut step = DOWNLOAD;
        for (msg, want) in GOOGLE_APIS {
            step = step_for(msg, step);
            assert_eq!(step, *want, "{msg}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn play_store_messages_reach_the_guided_tap() {
        let mut step = PATCH;
        for msg in [
            "Cold booting",
            "Installing the Magisk app",
            "Play Store: open the Magisk app to finish its setup, then grant root to Shell",
            "Rebooting",
            "Cold booting",
            "Magisk will ask to grant root to Shell. Tap Grant in the device window.",
        ] {
            step = step_for(msg, step);
        }
        assert_eq!(step, VERIFY);
        assert!(is_grant_prompt(
            "Magisk will ask to grant root to Shell. Tap Grant in the device window."
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn steps_never_go_back() {
        assert_eq!(step_for("Downloading Magisk 30.7", INSTALL), INSTALL);
        assert_eq!(step_for("something new", REBOOT), REBOOT);
        // A cached patch skips straight from resolving to the cold boot.
        assert_eq!(step_for("Cold booting", DOWNLOAD), REBOOT);
    }

    #[test]
    fn failures_say_what_went_wrong() {
        let boot = JidrError::new(ErrorCode::BootTimeout, "dev did not boot within 120 s");
        let f = failure(&boot, REBOOT);
        assert_eq!((f.reason.as_str(), f.step), ("boot timed out", REBOOT));
        assert!(!f.unverified && !f.cancelled);

        let grant = JidrError::new(
            ErrorCode::RootFailed,
            "root grant to Shell was denied or timed out",
        )
        .with_data(json!({ "state": "awaiting_user_grant" }));
        assert!(failure(&grant, VERIFY).unverified);

        let stopped = JidrError::unexpected("cancelled").with_data(json!({ "cancelled": true }));
        let f = failure(&stopped, PATCH);
        assert!(f.cancelled);
        assert_eq!(f.reason, "stopped");

        let su = JidrError::new(
            ErrorCode::RootFailed,
            "dev: `su -c id` reported uid 2000, expected 0 (root)",
        );
        assert_eq!(failure(&su, VERIFY).reason, "su didn't answer as root");

        let other = JidrError::new(ErrorCode::Sdk, "connection reset");
        let f = failure(&other, DOWNLOAD);
        assert_eq!(f.reason, "download failed");
        assert_eq!(f.message, "connection reset");
    }

    #[test]
    fn clock_and_tail() {
        assert_eq!(clock(18), "0:18");
        assert_eq!(clock(120), "2:00");
        let e = |t: &str| LogEntry {
            time: "14:20:31".into(),
            source: "jidr",
            level: "",
            text: t.into(),
        };
        let all = vec![e("a"), e("b"), e("c")];
        assert_eq!(log_tail(&all, 2), vec![e("b"), e("c")]);
        assert_eq!(log_tail(&all, 9).len(), 3);
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Settings: GUI preferences (pure view state, kept in `gui-prefs.json`),
//! storage rows from daemon data, the "Add Jidr to Claude" config merge and
//! the update check.

pub mod update;

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use jidr_core::SystemImage;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use slint::ComponentHandle;

use crate::model::{self, DeviceInfo};
use crate::{OptionVm, RootChoice, UsageRow};

/// The OpenStreetMap tile server (D14); attribution is always shown.
pub const OSM_TILES: &str = "https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(default)]
pub struct Prefs {
    /// 0 System, 1 Light, 2 Dark.
    pub appearance: u8,
    /// `none` | `adb` | `magisk`. A copy of the daemon's `default_root_mode`
    /// (gap B4: the daemon owns it, so the CLI and agents agree), refreshed on
    /// connect; the create sheet and Setup read it.
    pub default_root: String,
    /// Empty = OpenStreetMap.
    pub tile_url: String,
    /// A copy of the daemon's `quick_boot` setting (D29, gap B4).
    pub quick_boot: bool,
}

impl Default for Prefs {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            appearance: 0,
            default_root: "adb".into(),
            tile_url: String::new(),
            quick_boot: true,
        }
    }
}

impl Prefs {
    pub fn path(data_dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {
        data_dir.join("gui-prefs.json")
    }

    pub fn load(data_dir: &Path) -> Self {
        std::fs::read_to_string(Self::path(data_dir))
            .ok()
            .and_then(|t| serde_json::from_str(&t).ok())
            .unwrap_or_default()
    }

    pub fn save(&self, data_dir: &Path) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(data_dir)?;
        let text = serde_json::to_string_pretty(self).map_err(std::io::Error::other)?;
        std::fs::write(Self::path(data_dir), text)
    }

    /// Takes the daemon's settings (`settings.get` / `settings.set` result).
    pub fn apply_daemon_settings(&mut self, v: &Value) {
        if let Some(m) = v
            .get("default_root_mode")
            .and_then(Value::as_str)
            .filter(|m| matches!(*m, "none" | "adb" | "magisk"))
        {
            self.default_root = m.to_string();
        }
        if let Some(q) = v.get("quick_boot").and_then(Value::as_bool) {
            self.quick_boot = q;
        }
    }

    pub fn root_choice(&self) -> RootChoice {
        match self.default_root.as_str() {
            "none" => RootChoice::None,
            "magisk" => RootChoice::Full,
            _ => RootChoice::Shell,
        }
    }

    pub fn tiles(&self) -> &str {
        if self.tile_url.is_empty() {
            OSM_TILES
        } else {
            &self.tile_url
        }
    }
}

pub fn tile_options() -> Vec<OptionVm> {
    vec![
        OptionVm {
            id: "osm".into(),
            label: "OpenStreetMap (default)".into(),
        },
        OptionVm {
            id: "custom".into(),
            label: "Custom".into(),
        },
    ]
}

/// Per-device disk use, largest first, plus a total row (`fraction` −1).
pub fn device_usage(
    devices: &[DeviceInfo],
    snapshot_counts: &[(uuid::Uuid, usize)],
) -> Vec<UsageRow> {
    let mut v: Vec<(&DeviceInfo, u64)> = devices
        .iter()
        .map(|d| (d, d.disk_bytes.unwrap_or(0)))
        .collect();
    v.sort_by_key(|x| std::cmp::Reverse(x.1));
    let max = v.first().map(|x| x.1).unwrap_or(0).max(1);
    let total: u64 = v.iter().map(|x| x.1).sum();
    let mut rows: Vec<UsageRow> = v
        .iter()
        .map(|(d, bytes)| {
            let snaps = snapshot_counts
                .iter()
                .find(|(id, _)| *id == d.device.id)
                .map(|(_, n)| *n)
                .unwrap_or(0);
            UsageRow {
                name: d.device.name.clone().into(),
                sub: match snaps {
                    0 => String::new(),
                    1 => "1 snapshot".into(),
                    n => format!("{n} snapshots"),
                }
                .into(),
                fraction: *bytes as f32 / max as f32,
                size: model::gb(*bytes).into(),
            }
        })
        .collect();
    if !rows.is_empty() {
        rows.push(UsageRow {
            name: "Total".into(),
            sub: "".into(),
            fraction: -1.0,
            size: model::gb(total).into(),
        });
    }
    rows
}

/// Installed images with how many devices use them.
pub fn image_usage(images: &[SystemImage], devices: &[DeviceInfo]) -> Vec<UsageRow> {
    images
        .iter()
        .filter(|i| i.installed_in.is_some())
        .map(|i| {
            let n = devices.iter().filter(|d| d.device.image == i.image).count();
            UsageRow {
                name: crate::device_form::image_label(i).into(),
                sub: match n {
                    0 => "No devices".to_string(),
                    1 => "1 device".to_string(),
                    n => format!("{n} devices"),
                }
                .into(),
                fraction: 0.0,
                size: if i.size > 0 {
                    model::gb(i.size)
                } else {
                    "—".into()
                }
                .into(),
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

/// Claude Desktop's config file.
pub fn claude_config_path() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    dirs::config_dir().map(|d| d.join("Claude/claude_desktop_config.json"))
}

/// Adds (or replaces) the `jidr` MCP server, keeping everything else.
pub fn merge_claude_config(existing: Option<&str>, jidr_bin: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    let mut root: Value = match existing.map(str::trim) {
        Some(t) if !t.is_empty() => serde_json::from_str(t)
            .map_err(|e| format!("claude_desktop_config.json isn't valid JSON: {e}"))?,
        _ => json!({}),
    };
    let obj = root
        .as_object_mut()
        .ok_or("claude_desktop_config.json isn't a JSON object")?;
    let servers = obj
        .entry("mcpServers")
        .or_insert_with(|| json!({}))
        .as_object_mut()
        .ok_or("mcpServers isn't a JSON object")?;
    servers.insert(
        "jidr".into(),
        json!({ "command": jidr_bin, "args": ["mcp"] }),
    );
    serde_json::to_string_pretty(&root).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

/// Writes the merged config.
pub fn add_to_claude(path: &Path, jidr_bin: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    let existing = std::fs::read_to_string(path).ok();
    let merged = merge_claude_config(existing.as_deref(), jidr_bin)?;
    if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }
    std::fs::write(path, merged).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

/// Copies text to the macOS pasteboard.
pub fn copy_text(text: &str) {
    use std::io::Write as _;
    if let Ok(mut child) = std::process::Command::new("pbcopy")
        .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .spawn()
    {
        if let Some(stdin) = child.stdin.as_mut() {
            let _ = stdin.write_all(text.as_bytes());
        }
        let _ = child.wait();
    }
}

/// Opens a URL or reveals a path with macOS `open`.
pub fn open_external(args: &[&str]) {
    let _ = std::process::Command::new("open").args(args).spawn();
}

fn models<T: Clone + 'static>(v: Vec<T>) -> slint::ModelRc<T> {
    slint::ModelRc::new(slint::VecModel::from(v))
}

/// Opens the Settings window on `tab` (0 General, 1 Storage, 2 Agents, 3 About).
pub fn open(ctx: &std::rc::Rc<crate::app::Ctx>, tab: i32) {
    let Ok(win) = crate::SettingsWindow::new() else {
        return;
    };
    let theme = ctx.app.global::<crate::Theme>();
    let wt = win.global::<crate::Theme>();
    wt.set_dark(theme.get_dark());
    wt.set_rtl(theme.get_rtl());
    wt.set_reduce_motion(theme.get_reduce_motion());
    win.set_draw_lights(false);
    win.set_tab(tab);
    win.set_version(env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").into());
    let prefs = ctx.prefs.borrow().clone();
    win.set_default_root(prefs.root_choice());
    win.set_tile_options(models(tile_options()));
    win.set_tile_choice(if prefs.tile_url.is_empty() { 0 } else { 1 });
    win.set_tile_url(prefs.tile_url.clone().into());
    win.set_appearance(i32::from(prefs.appearance));
    win.set_quick_boot(prefs.quick_boot);
    let devices = ctx.state.borrow().data.devices.clone();
    win.set_device_usage(models(device_usage(&devices, &[])));
    let cache = dir_size(&ctx.paths.cache);
    win.set_cache_size(model::gb(cache).into());

    // SDK state and images come from the daemon.
    let weak = win.as_weak();
    let b2 = ctx.bridge.clone();
    let token = crate::app::defer(move |(status, images): (Value, Vec<SystemImage>)| {
        let Some(win) = weak.upgrade() else { return };
        let sdk = status
            .get("tools_sdk")
            .or_else(|| status.get("private_sdk"))
            .and_then(Value::as_str)
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .to_string();
        let ready = crate::bridge::sdk_has_tools(&status);
        win.set_sdk_path(sdk.into());
        win.set_sdk_ready(ready);
        win.set_sdk_state(if ready { "Ready" } else { "Not installed" }.into());
        win.set_sdk_note(
            status
                .get("emulator_version")
                .and_then(Value::as_str)
                .map(|v| format!("Emulator {v}"))
                .unwrap_or_default()
                .into(),
        );
        win.set_image_usage(models(image_usage(&images, &devices)));
    });
    ctx.bridge.call("sdk.status", json!({}), move |s| {
        let status = s.unwrap_or(Value::Null);
        b2.call("image.list", json!({ "available": false }), move |i| {
            let images: Vec<SystemImage> = i
                .ok()
                .and_then(|v| serde_json::from_value(v).ok())
                .unwrap_or_default();
            crate::app::fire(token, (status, images));
        });
    });

    // The daemon's settings may have changed (CLI, an agent): show them.
    let weak = win.as_weak();
    let token = crate::app::defer(move |v: Option<Value>| {
        let (Some(v), Some(c), Some(win)) = (v, crate::app::ctx(), weak.upgrade()) else {
            return;
        };
        c.prefs.borrow_mut().apply_daemon_settings(&v);
        let prefs = c.prefs.borrow();
        win.set_default_root(prefs.root_choice());
        win.set_quick_boot(prefs.quick_boot);
    });
    ctx.bridge.call("settings.get", json!({}), move |r| {
        crate::app::fire(token, r.ok());
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    win.on_default_root_changed(move |choice| {
        let mode = crate::device_form::root_mode(choice);
        c.prefs.borrow_mut().default_root = mode.into();
        let _ = c.prefs.borrow().save(&c.paths.data);
        set_daemon_setting(&c, json!({ "default_root_mode": mode }));
    });
    let c = ctx.clone();
    win.on_tiles_changed(move |choice, url| {
        c.prefs.borrow_mut().tile_url = if choice == 0 {
            String::new()
        } else {
            url.to_string()
        };
        let _ = c.prefs.borrow().save(&c.paths.data);
    });
    let c = ctx.clone();
    let w = win.as_weak();
    win.on_appearance_changed(move |i| {
        c.prefs.borrow_mut().appearance = u8::try_from(i).unwrap_or(0);
        let _ = c.prefs.borrow().save(&c.paths.data);
        c.apply_appearance();
        if let Some(win) = w.upgrade() {
            win.global::<crate::Theme>()
                .set_dark(c.app.global::<crate::Theme>().get_dark());
        }
    });
    let c = ctx.clone();
    win.on_quick_boot_changed(move |v| {
        c.prefs.borrow_mut().quick_boot = v;
        let _ = c.prefs.borrow().save(&c.paths.data);
        set_daemon_setting(&c, json!({ "quick_boot": v }));
    });
    let data = ctx.paths.data.clone();
    win.on_show_sdk(move || {
        let sdk = data.join("sdk");
        open_external(&["-R", &sdk.to_string_lossy()]);
    });
    win.on_change_sdk(|| {});
    let c = ctx.clone();
    let cache_dir = ctx.paths.cache.clone();
    let w = win.as_weak();
    win.on_clear_cache(move || {
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&cache_dir);
        if let Some(win) = w.upgrade() {
            win.set_cache_size(model::gb(0).into());
        }
        crate::app::toast(&c.app.as_weak(), "Cleared the download cache".into());
    });
    let c = ctx.clone();
    win.on_add_to_claude(move || {
        // The CLI that serves MCP, never the GUI itself (see bundled_jidr).
        let bin = jidr_client::SpawnOptions::default()
            .program()
            .to_string_lossy()
            .into_owned();
        let msg = match claude_config_path() {
            Some(path) => match add_to_claude(&path, &bin) {
                Ok(()) => "Added Jidr to Claude Desktop. Restart Claude to use it.".to_string(),
                Err(e) => e,
            },
            None => "Can't find Claude Desktop's settings folder".to_string(),
        };
        crate::app::toast(&c.app.as_weak(), msg);
    });
    let c = ctx.clone();
    win.on_copy(move |t| {
        copy_text(&t);
        crate::app::toast(&c.app.as_weak(), "Copied".into());
    });
    let repo = env!("CARGO_PKG_REPOSITORY");
    win.on_open_source(move || open_external(&[repo]));
    win.on_sponsor(move || open_external(&[repo]));
    let c = ctx.clone();
    let w = win.as_weak();
    win.on_check_updates(move || check_updates(&c, w.clone()));
    let c = ctx.clone();
    let w = win.as_weak();
    win.on_update_action(move || {
        let Some(win) = w.upgrade() else { return };
        let url = win.get_update_url().to_string();
        if url.is_empty() {
            copy_text(update::BREW_UPGRADE);
            crate::app::toast(&c.app.as_weak(), "Copied".into());
        } else {
            open_external(&[&url]);
        }
    });
    win.on_show_licences(move || open_external(&[&format!("{repo}/blob/main/NOTICE")]));

    let _ = win.show();
    ctx.windows.borrow_mut().push(Box::new(win));
}

/// Bytes under `dir` (cache size).
pub fn dir_size(dir: &Path) -> u64 {
    let Ok(rd) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) else {
        return 0;
    };
    rd.filter_map(Result::ok)
        .map(|e| match e.file_type() {
            Ok(t) if t.is_dir() => dir_size(&e.path()),
            Ok(_) => e.metadata().map(|m| m.len()).unwrap_or(0),
            Err(_) => 0,
        })
        .sum()
}

/// Gap B4: refreshes the cached default root mode and quick boot from the
/// daemon (on connect, so the create sheet follows `jidr settings`).
pub fn sync_from_daemon(ctx: &crate::app::Ctx) {
    let token = crate::app::defer(move |v: Option<Value>| {
        if let (Some(v), Some(c)) = (v, crate::app::ctx()) {
            c.prefs.borrow_mut().apply_daemon_settings(&v);
        }
    });
    ctx.bridge.call("settings.get", json!({}), move |r| {
        crate::app::fire(token, r.ok());
    });
}

/// Settings › About: asks GitHub for the latest release (IO thread) and shows
/// the answer under the version line.
fn check_updates(ctx: &crate::app::Ctx, weak: slint::Weak<crate::SettingsWindow>) {
    let current = env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION");
    let repo = env!("CARGO_PKG_REPOSITORY");
    if let Some(win) = weak.upgrade() {
        win.set_update_checking(true);
        win.set_update_status("Checking…".into());
        win.set_update_label("".into());
    }
    let token = crate::app::defer(move |check: update::Check| {
        let Some(win) = weak.upgrade() else { return };
        let (status, action, url) =
            update::view(&check, current, update::installed_by_homebrew(), repo);
        win.set_update_checking(false);
        win.set_update_status(status.into());
        win.set_update_label(action.into());
        win.set_update_url(url.into());
    });
    ctx.bridge.handle().spawn(async move {
        crate::app::fire(token, update::check(repo, current).await);
    });
}

/// `settings.set`; a failure is shown as a toast.
fn set_daemon_setting(ctx: &crate::app::Ctx, params: Value) {
    let weak = ctx.app.as_weak();
    ctx.bridge.call("settings.set", params, move |r| {
        if let Err(e) = r {
            crate::app::toast(&weak, format!("Couldn't save the setting: {}", e.message));
        }
    });
}
```

```rs
//! Settings › About › Check for updates (D17): one request to GitHub's
//! latest-release API, only when the button is clicked. Nothing is downloaded
//! or installed; the result says whether a newer release exists.

use std::path::Path;

use serde::Deserialize;

/// The brew command shown to people who installed the cask.
pub const BREW_UPGRADE: &str = "brew upgrade --cask jidr";

/// What a check found.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Check {
    UpToDate,
    /// A newer release: its version (no `v`) and its release page.
    Available {
        version: String,
        url: String,
    },
    /// Offline, rate-limited or an unexpected answer.
    Failed,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct Release {
    tag_name: String,
    html_url: String,
}

/// `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>` → its latest-release API URL.
pub fn latest_url(repo: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let path = repo
        .trim_end_matches('/')
        .strip_prefix("https://github.com/")?;
    Some(format!(
        "https://api.github.com/repos/{path}/releases/latest"
    ))
}

/// `v1.2.3`, `1.2` or `1.2.3-beta.1` → (1, 2, 3); a pre-release suffix is
/// ignored (`/releases/latest` never returns one).
fn parse(version: &str) -> Option<(u64, u64, u64)> {
    let core = version.trim().trim_start_matches('v');
    let core = core.split(['-', '+']).next()?;
    let mut parts = core.split('.').map(str::parse::<u64>);
    let major = parts.next()?.ok()?;
    let minor = parts.next().unwrap_or(Ok(0)).ok()?;
    let patch = parts.next().unwrap_or(Ok(0)).ok()?;
    Some((major, minor, patch))
}

/// Reads a `releases/latest` response against the running `current` version.
pub fn evaluate(body: &str, current: &str) -> Check {
    let Ok(release) = serde_json::from_str::<Release>(body) else {
        return Check::Failed;
    };
    match (parse(&release.tag_name), parse(current)) {
        (Some(latest), Some(now)) if latest > now => Check::Available {
            version: release.tag_name.trim_start_matches('v').to_string(),
            url: release.html_url,
        },
        (Some(_), Some(_)) => Check::UpToDate,
        _ => Check::Failed,
    }
}

/// The About tab's status line, its action button and the button's link
/// (empty = copy [`BREW_UPGRADE`]); no button when the action is empty.
pub fn view(check: &Check, current: &str, homebrew: bool, repo: &str) -> (String, String, String) {
    match check {
        Check::UpToDate => (
            format!("You're up to date ({current})"),
            String::new(),
            String::new(),
        ),
        Check::Available { version, .. } if homebrew => (
            format!("Jidr {version} is available. Update with {BREW_UPGRADE}"),
            "Copy command".into(),
            String::new(),
        ),
        Check::Available { version, url } => (
            format!("Jidr {version} is available"),
            "Download".into(),
            url.clone(),
        ),
        Check::Failed => (
            "Couldn't reach GitHub".into(),
            "Open releases page".into(),
            format!("{repo}/releases"),
        ),
    }
}

/// True when the app came from the Homebrew cask (it keeps a Caskroom entry).
pub fn installed_by_homebrew() -> bool {
    ["/opt/homebrew/Caskroom/jidr", "/usr/local/Caskroom/jidr"]
        .iter()
        .any(|p| Path::new(p).exists())
}

/// Asks GitHub for the latest release; any network or HTTP error is `Failed`.
pub async fn check(repo: &str, current: &str) -> Check {
    let Some(url) = latest_url(repo) else {
        return Check::Failed;
    };
    let Ok(client) = reqwest::Client::builder()
        .user_agent(concat!("Jidr/", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")))
        .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(8))
        .build()
    else {
        return Check::Failed;
    };
    let resp = match client
        .get(url)
        .header("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json")
        .send()
        .await
    {
        Ok(r) if r.status().is_success() => r,
        _ => return Check::Failed,
    };
    match resp.text().await {
        Ok(body) => evaluate(&body, current),
        Err(_) => Check::Failed,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// A trimmed `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/latest` response.
    const LATEST: &str = r#"{
        "url": "https://api.github.com/repos/AbdurahmanAlmehdi/jidr/releases/1",
        "html_url": "https://github.com/AbdurahmanAlmehdi/jidr/releases/tag/v0.2.0",
        "tag_name": "v0.2.0",
        "name": "v0.2.0",
        "draft": false,
        "prerelease": false,
        "assets": []
    }"#;

    #[test]
    fn api_url_from_the_repo() {
        assert_eq!(
            latest_url("https://github.com/AbdurahmanAlmehdi/jidr").as_deref(),
            Some("https://api.github.com/repos/AbdurahmanAlmehdi/jidr/releases/latest")
        );
        assert_eq!(latest_url("https://example.com/x"), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn newer_release_is_available() {
        assert_eq!(
            evaluate(LATEST, "0.1.0"),
            Check::Available {
                version: "0.2.0".into(),
                url: "https://github.com/AbdurahmanAlmehdi/jidr/releases/tag/v0.2.0".into(),
            }
        );
        assert_eq!(evaluate(LATEST, "0.1.9"), evaluate(LATEST, "0.1"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn same_or_newer_install_is_up_to_date() {
        assert_eq!(evaluate(LATEST, "0.2.0"), Check::UpToDate);
        assert_eq!(evaluate(LATEST, "0.10.0"), Check::UpToDate);
        assert_eq!(evaluate(LATEST, "1.0.0-beta.1"), Check::UpToDate);
    }

    #[test]
    fn versions_compare_numerically() {
        assert!(parse("v0.10.0") > parse("0.9.9"));
        assert_eq!(parse("1.2"), Some((1, 2, 0)));
        assert_eq!(parse("2.0.0-rc.1"), Some((2, 0, 0)));
        assert_eq!(parse("latest"), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn homebrew_installs_get_the_brew_command() {
        let repo = "https://github.com/AbdurahmanAlmehdi/jidr";
        let new = evaluate(LATEST, "0.1.0");
        let (status, action, url) = view(&new, "0.1.0", true, repo);
        assert!(status.ends_with(BREW_UPGRADE));
        assert_eq!((action.as_str(), url.as_str()), ("Copy command", ""));
        let (_, action, url) = view(&new, "0.1.0", false, repo);
        assert_eq!(action, "Download");
        assert!(url.ends_with("/tag/v0.2.0"));
        let (status, action, _) = view(&Check::UpToDate, "0.2.0", false, repo);
        assert_eq!(
            (status.as_str(), action.as_str()),
            ("You're up to date (0.2.0)", "")
        );
        let (_, _, url) = view(&Check::Failed, "0.1.0", true, repo);
        assert_eq!(url, format!("{repo}/releases"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn bad_answers_fail() {
        assert_eq!(evaluate("rate limited", "0.1.0"), Check::Failed);
        assert_eq!(
            evaluate(r#"{"message":"Not Found"}"#, "0.1.0"),
            Check::Failed
        );
        assert_eq!(
            evaluate(r#"{"tag_name":"nightly","html_url":"x"}"#, "0.1.0"),
            Check::Failed
        );
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-ui/src/snapshots/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! Snapshot manager (Phase 10b): `snapshot.*` for the selected device,
//! thumbnails from the emulator's snapshot folders, D29 refusals.

use std::path::Path;
use std::rc::Rc;

use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use jidr_core::RootMode;
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use slint::{ComponentHandle, Image, ModelRc, Rgba8Pixel, SharedPixelBuffer, VecModel};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::app::{Ctx, report, toast};
use crate::model::{self, Clock};
use crate::{RootKind, SnapshotVm};

pub fn mode_name(m: RootMode) -> &'static str {
    match m {
        RootMode::None => "Not rooted",
        RootMode::Adb => "Shell root",
        RootMode::Magisk => "Full root",
    }
}

fn root_kind(m: RootMode) -> RootKind {
    match m {
        RootMode::None => RootKind::None,
        RootMode::Adb => RootKind::Shell,
        RootMode::Magisk => RootKind::Full,
    }
}

/// One row of `snapshot.list`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct Entry {
    pub name: String,
    pub quick_boot: bool,
    pub root_mode: Option<RootMode>,
    pub magisk: Option<String>,
    pub created_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
    pub size: u64,
    pub thumbnail: Option<String>,
    pub restorable: bool,
}

pub fn parse(v: &Value) -> Vec<Entry> {
    v.get("snapshots")
        .and_then(Value::as_array)
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .map(|s| Entry {
            name: s["name"].as_str().unwrap_or_default().to_string(),
            quick_boot: s["quick_boot"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false),
            root_mode: serde_json::from_value(s["root_mode"].clone()).ok(),
            magisk: s["magisk_version"].as_str().map(str::to_string),
            created_at: serde_json::from_value(s["created_at"].clone()).ok(),
            size: s["size_bytes"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0),
            thumbnail: s["thumbnail"].as_str().map(str::to_string),
            restorable: s["restorable"].as_bool().unwrap_or(true),
        })
        .collect()
}

/// Quick boot last, newest named snapshots first.
pub fn sorted(mut v: Vec<Entry>) -> Vec<Entry> {
    v.sort_by(|a, b| {
        a.quick_boot
            .cmp(&b.quick_boot)
            .then(a.created_at.cmp(&b.created_at))
    });
    v
}

fn thumbnail(path: &str) -> Option<Image> {
    let bytes = std::fs::read(Path::new(path)).ok()?;
    let mut dec = png::Decoder::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes));
    dec.set_transformations(png::Transformations::EXPAND | png::Transformations::ALPHA);
    let mut r = dec.read_info().ok()?;
    let mut buf = vec![0; r.output_buffer_size()?];
    let info = r.next_frame(&mut buf).ok()?;
    if info.color_type != png::ColorType::Rgba {
        return None;
    }
    buf.truncate(info.buffer_size());
    Some(Image::from_rgba8(
        SharedPixelBuffer::<Rgba8Pixel>::clone_from_slice(&buf, info.width, info.height),
    ))
}

pub fn vm(e: &Entry, clock: &Clock) -> SnapshotVm {
    let thumb = e.thumbnail.as_deref().and_then(thumbnail);
    SnapshotVm {
        name: if e.quick_boot {
            "Quick boot".into()
        } else {
            e.name.clone().into()
        },
        tag: match e.root_mode {
            Some(m) => format!("Taken with: {}", mode_name(m)),
            None => "Not tagged".into(),
        }
        .into(),
        root: e.root_mode.map(root_kind).unwrap_or(RootKind::None),
        auto: e.quick_boot,
        size: if e.size > 0 {
            model::gb(e.size)
        } else {
            String::new()
        }
        .into(),
        when: e
            .created_at
            .map(|t| clock.local(t).format("%b %-d, %H:%M").to_string())
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .into(),
        refused: !e.restorable,
        has_thumb: thumb.is_some(),
        thumb: thumb.unwrap_or_default(),
    }
}

/// The banner above the cards.
pub fn banner(device: &str, mode: RootMode, entries: &[Entry]) -> (String, bool) {
    let named: Vec<&Entry> = entries.iter().filter(|e| !e.quick_boot).collect();
    let refused: Vec<&Entry> = named.iter().copied().filter(|e| !e.restorable).collect();
    let total: u64 = named.iter().map(|e| e.size).sum();
    if let Some(r) = refused.first() {
        let other = r.root_mode.map(mode_name).unwrap_or("another root mode");
        return (
            format!(
                "{device} is {} now. Snapshots taken with {other} can't be restored until {other} is set up again.",
                mode_name(mode)
            ),
            true,
        );
    }
    if named.is_empty() {
        return (String::new(), false);
    }
    let all = if named.len() == 1 {
        "it".to_string()
    } else {
        format!("all {}", named.len())
    };
    (
        format!(
            "Every snapshot remembers the root mode it was taken with. {device} is {} now, so {all} can be restored. {} in total.",
            mode_name(mode),
            model::gb(total)
        ),
        false,
    )
}

thread_local! {
    static ENTRIES: std::cell::RefCell<Vec<Entry>> = const { std::cell::RefCell::new(Vec::new()) };
}

fn selected(ctx: &Ctx) -> Option<(Uuid, String, RootMode, bool, Option<String>)> {
    let st = ctx.state.borrow();
    let id = st
        .selected
        .or_else(|| st.data.devices.first().map(|d| d.device.id))?;
    let d = st.data.devices.iter().find(|d| d.device.id == id)?;
    Some((
        id,
        d.device.name.clone(),
        d.device.root.mode,
        matches!(d.device.status, jidr_core::DeviceStatus::Running),
        d.device.root.magisk_version.clone(),
    ))
}

/// Loads the selected device's snapshots into the window.
pub fn load(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    let Some((id, name, mode, running, _)) = selected(ctx) else {
        return;
    };
    ctx.app.set_snap_can_save(running);
    let token = crate::app::defer(move |r: jidr_core::JidrResult<Value>| {
        let Some(c) = crate::app::ctx() else { return };
        // Still the same device?
        if selected(&c).map(|s| s.0) != Some(id) {
            return;
        }
        let entries = sorted(r.map(|v| parse(&v)).unwrap_or_default());
        let clock = Clock::system();
        let vms: Vec<SnapshotVm> = entries.iter().map(|e| vm(e, &clock)).collect();
        let (text, warn) = banner(&name, mode, &entries);
        c.app.set_snapshots(ModelRc::new(VecModel::from(vms)));
        c.app.set_snap_banner(text.into());
        c.app.set_snap_banner_warning(warn);
        ENTRIES.with(|e| *e.borrow_mut() = entries);
    });
    ctx.bridge
        .call("snapshot.list", json!({ "device": id }), move |r| {
            crate::app::fire(token, r)
        });
}

fn entry(i: i32) -> Option<Entry> {
    ENTRIES.with(|e| {
        usize::try_from(i)
            .ok()
            .and_then(|i| e.borrow().get(i).cloned())
    })
}

pub fn wire(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    let c = ctx.clone();
    ctx.app.on_manage_snapshots(move |_| {
        c.app.set_snapshots_open(true);
        load(&c);
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    ctx.app.on_restore_snapshot(move |_, i| {
        let Some(e) = entry(i) else { return };
        let Some((id, name, mode, running, _)) = selected(&c) else { return };
        if !e.restorable {
            let other = e.root_mode.unwrap_or(RootMode::None);
            c.app.set_refuse_name(e.name.clone().into());
            c.app.set_refuse_snapshot_line(
                format!(
                    "Taken with: {}{}",
                    mode_name(other),
                    e.magisk.as_ref().map(|v| format!(" · Magisk {v}")).unwrap_or_default()
                )
                .into(),
            );
            c.app.set_refuse_device_line(mode_name(mode).into());
            c.app.set_refuse_body(
                format!(
                    "It was taken with {}. {name} is {} now, so restoring it would bring back a root setup Jidr hasn't verified on this device.",
                    mode_name(other),
                    mode_name(mode)
                )
                .into(),
            );
            c.app.set_refuse_hint(
                format!(
                    "Set up {} first, then restore. Snapshots taken while {} restore as usual.",
                    mode_name(other),
                    mode_name(mode)
                )
                .into(),
            );
            c.app.set_refuse_action(format!("Set up {}…", mode_name(other)).into());
            c.app.set_refuse_open(true);
            return;
        }
        if !running {
            toast(&c.app.as_weak(), format!("Start {name} to restore a snapshot"));
            return;
        }
        let w = c.app.as_weak();
        let label = if e.quick_boot { "Quick boot".to_string() } else { e.name.clone() };
        c.bridge.run(
            "snapshot.load",
            json!({ "device": id, "name": e.name }),
            |_| {},
            report(&w, &format!("Restored “{label}”")),
        );
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    ctx.app.on_refuse_act(move || {
        let Some((id, ..)) = selected(&c) else { return };
        let target = ENTRIES.with(|e| {
            e.borrow()
                .iter()
                .find(|x| x.name == c.app.get_refuse_name().as_str())
                .and_then(|x| x.root_mode)
        });
        let mode = match target {
            Some(RootMode::Magisk) => "magisk",
            Some(RootMode::Adb) => "adb",
            _ => "none",
        };
        let w = c.app.as_weak();
        // root.set is Stream C's command (9c/9d).
        c.bridge.run(
            "root.set",
            json!({ "device": id, "mode": mode }),
            |_| {},
            report(&w, "Root set up; the snapshot can be restored now"),
        );
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    ctx.app.on_snapshot_save_request(move || {
        let Some((_, name, mode, running, magisk)) = selected(&c) else {
            return;
        };
        if !running {
            toast(&c.app.as_weak(), format!("Start {name} to save a snapshot"));
            return;
        }
        let sizes: Vec<String> = ENTRIES.with(|e| {
            e.borrow()
                .iter()
                .filter(|x| !x.quick_boot && x.size > 0)
                .map(|x| format!("{:.1}", x.size as f64 / 1e9))
                .collect()
        });
        c.app.set_save_name(
            chrono::Local::now()
                .format("Snapshot %b %-d, %H.%M")
                .to_string()
                .into(),
        );
        c.app.set_save_root_kind(root_kind(mode));
        c.app.set_save_root_tag(
            format!(
                "Taken with: {}{}",
                mode_name(mode),
                magisk
                    .filter(|_| mode == RootMode::Magisk)
                    .map(|v| format!(" · Magisk {v}"))
                    .unwrap_or_default()
            )
            .into(),
        );
        c.app.set_save_hint(match sizes.len() {
            0 => "Snapshots take about as much disk as the device's data.".into(),
            1 => format!("Its other snapshot is {} GB.", sizes[0]).into(),
            _ => format!(
                "Its other snapshots are {} and {} GB.",
                sizes[..sizes.len() - 1].join(", "),
                sizes[sizes.len() - 1]
            )
            .into(),
        });
        c.app.set_save_open(true);
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    ctx.app.on_snapshot_save(move |name| {
        let Some((id, ..)) = selected(&c) else { return };
        let w = c.app.as_weak();
        let token = crate::app::defer(move |r: jidr_core::JidrResult<Value>| {
            if let Some(c) = crate::app::ctx() {
                load(&c);
                if let Err(e) = r {
                    toast(&c.app.as_weak(), e.message);
                }
            }
        });
        toast(&w, format!("Saving “{name}”…"));
        let w2 = w.clone();
        let n = name.to_string();
        c.bridge.run(
            "snapshot.save",
            json!({ "device": id, "name": name.as_str() }),
            |_| {},
            move |r| {
                if r.is_ok() {
                    toast(&w2, format!("Saved snapshot “{n}”"));
                }
                crate::app::fire(token, r);
            },
        );
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    ctx.app.on_snapshot_delete(move |i| {
        let Some(e) = entry(i) else { return };
        let Some((id, ..)) = selected(&c) else { return };
        let c2 = c.clone();
        crate::launcher::confirm(
            &c,
            &format!("Delete “{}”?", e.name),
            &format!(
                "Frees {}. The device itself doesn't change. This can't be undone.",
                if e.size > 0 {
                    model::gb(e.size)
                } else {
                    "its disk space".into()
                }
            ),
            "Delete",
            move || {
                let token = crate::app::defer(move |r: jidr_core::JidrResult<Value>| {
                    if let Some(c) = crate::app::ctx() {
                        load(&c);
                        match r {
                            Ok(_) => toast(&c.app.as_weak(), "Deleted the snapshot".into()),
                            Err(e) => toast(&c.app.as_weak(), e.message),
                        }
                    }
                });
                c2.bridge.call(
                    "snapshot.delete",
                    json!({ "device": id, "name": e.name }),
                    move |r| crate::app::fire(token, r),
                );
            },
        );
    });
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn list() -> Value {
        json!({ "device_root_mode": "none", "snapshots": [
            { "name": "default_boot", "quick_boot": true, "root_mode": null, "size_bytes": 0, "restorable": true },
            { "name": "Clean install", "root_mode": "magisk", "magisk_version": "30.7",
              "created_at": "2026-10-09T18:40:00Z", "size_bytes": 2100000000u64, "restorable": false },
            { "name": "Logged in", "root_mode": "none", "created_at": "2026-10-13T11:02:00Z",
              "size_bytes": 2400000000u64, "restorable": true }
        ]})
    }

    #[test]
    fn list_parses_and_sorts_quick_boot_last() {
        let e = sorted(parse(&list()));
        assert_eq!(
            e.iter().map(|x| x.name.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            ["Clean install", "Logged in", "default_boot"]
        );
        let clock = crate::fixtures::clock();
        let v = vm(&e[0], &clock);
        assert_eq!(v.tag, "Taken with: Full root");
        assert!(v.refused);
        assert_eq!(v.size, "2.1 GB");
        assert_eq!(vm(&e[2], &clock).name, "Quick boot");
    }

    #[test]
    fn banner_explains_refusals() {
        let e = parse(&list());
        let (text, warn) = banner("Pixel-ish 6.1", RootMode::None, &e);
        assert!(warn);
        assert!(
            text.contains("Not rooted now") && text.contains("Full root"),
            "{text}"
        );
        let ok: Vec<Entry> = e
            .into_iter()
            .map(|mut x| {
                x.restorable = true;
                x
            })
            .collect();
        let (text, warn) = banner("Pixel-ish 6.1", RootMode::Magisk, &ok);
        assert!(!warn);
        assert!(
            text.contains("all 2 can be restored") && text.contains("4.5 GB"),
            "{text}"
        );
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-ui/src/widgets/gps.rs`:

```rs
//! GPS panel: OpenStreetMap tiles around the fix (D14: configurable URL,
//! attribution always shown, tiles cached on disk), map clicks, and route
//! replay through the `gps.route` job.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::rc::Rc;

use serde_json::{Value, json};
use slint::{ComponentHandle, Image, Rgba8Pixel, SharedPixelBuffer};

use crate::app::{Ctx, toast};

pub const ZOOM: u32 = 15;
/// Map image size in pixels (the panel shows it at ~292×150 logical).
pub const MAP_W: u32 = 584;
pub const MAP_H: u32 = 300;
const TILE: f64 = 256.0;
pub const SPEEDS: [f32; 3] = [1.0, 2.0, 4.0];

thread_local! {
    /// The last route file, for Play after it ends.
    pub static ROUTE_FILE: std::cell::RefCell<Option<PathBuf>> = const { std::cell::RefCell::new(None) };
}

/// World pixel of a coordinate at `zoom` (Web Mercator).
pub fn world_px(lat: f64, lon: f64, zoom: u32) -> (f64, f64) {
    let n = TILE * f64::from(1u32 << zoom);
    let lat = lat.clamp(-85.0511, 85.0511).to_radians();
    let x = (lon + 180.0) / 360.0 * n;
    let y = (1.0 - (lat.tan() + 1.0 / lat.cos()).ln() / std::f64::consts::PI) / 2.0 * n;
    (x, y)
}

/// Inverse of [`world_px`].
pub fn lat_lon(x: f64, y: f64, zoom: u32) -> (f64, f64) {
    let n = TILE * f64::from(1u32 << zoom);
    let lon = x / n * 360.0 - 180.0;
    let lat = (std::f64::consts::PI * (1.0 - 2.0 * y / n))
        .sinh()
        .atan()
        .to_degrees();
    (lat, lon)
}

/// The tile URL for `{z}/{x}/{y}`.
pub fn tile_url(template: &str, z: u32, x: u32, y: u32) -> String {
    template
        .replace("{z}", &z.to_string())
        .replace("{x}", &x.to_string())
        .replace("{y}", &y.to_string())
}

/// Tiles (x, y) needed for a `MAP_W × MAP_H` view centred on `center`.
pub fn tiles_for(center: (f64, f64)) -> Vec<(u32, u32)> {
    let (x0, y0) = (
        center.0 - f64::from(MAP_W) / 2.0,
        center.1 - f64::from(MAP_H) / 2.0,
    );
    let (x1, y1) = (x0 + f64::from(MAP_W), y0 + f64::from(MAP_H));
    let mut v = Vec::new();
    for ty in (y0 / TILE).floor() as i64..=(y1 / TILE).floor() as i64 {
        for tx in (x0 / TILE).floor() as i64..=(x1 / TILE).floor() as i64 {
            if tx >= 0 && ty >= 0 {
                v.push((tx as u32, ty as u32));
            }
        }
    }
    v
}

/// The route as SVG path commands in 0..1000 map units around `center`.
pub fn route_path(points: &[(f64, f64)], center: (f64, f64)) -> String {
    let mut s = String::new();
    for (i, (lat, lon)) in points.iter().enumerate() {
        let (x, y) = world_px(*lat, *lon, ZOOM);
        let nx = (x - (center.0 - f64::from(MAP_W) / 2.0)) / f64::from(MAP_W) * 1000.0;
        let ny = (y - (center.1 - f64::from(MAP_H) / 2.0)) / f64::from(MAP_H) * 1000.0;
        s.push_str(&format!(
            "{}{nx:.1} {ny:.1} ",
            if i == 0 { "M " } else { "L " }
        ));
    }
    s.trim_end().to_string()
}

fn decode_png(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<(u32, u32, Vec<u8>)> {
    let mut dec = png::Decoder::new(std::io::Cursor::new(bytes));
    dec.set_transformations(png::Transformations::EXPAND | png::Transformations::ALPHA);
    let mut r = dec.read_info().ok()?;
    let mut buf = vec![0; r.output_buffer_size()?];
    let info = r.next_frame(&mut buf).ok()?;
    buf.truncate(info.buffer_size());
    let rgba = match info.color_type {
        png::ColorType::Rgba => buf,
        png::ColorType::GrayscaleAlpha => buf
            .as_chunks::<2>()
            .0
            .iter()
            .flat_map(|[g, a]| [*g, *g, *g, *a])
            .collect(),
        _ => return None,
    };
    Some((info.width, info.height, rgba))
}

async fn fetch_tile(client: &reqwest::Client, cache: &Path, url: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let key = {
        use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
        let mut h = std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher::new();
        url.hash(&mut h);
        format!("{:016x}.png", h.finish())
    };
    let path = cache.join(key);
    if let Ok(b) = tokio::fs::read(&path).await {
        return Some(b);
    }
    let resp = client.get(url).send().await.ok()?;
    if !resp.status().is_success() {
        return None;
    }
    let bytes = resp.bytes().await.ok()?.to_vec();
    let _ = tokio::fs::create_dir_all(cache).await;
    let _ = tokio::fs::write(&path, &bytes).await;
    Some(bytes)
}

/// Fetches and composes the map around `(lat, lon)`; `None` offline.
pub async fn render_map(
    template: String,
    cache: PathBuf,
    lat: f64,
    lon: f64,
) -> Option<(u32, u32, Vec<u8>)> {
    let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
        .user_agent(concat!(
            "Jidr/",
            env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
            " (+https://jidr.ly)"
        ))
        .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(8))
        .build()
        .ok()?;
    let center = world_px(lat, lon, ZOOM);
    let (ox, oy) = (
        center.0 - f64::from(MAP_W) / 2.0,
        center.1 - f64::from(MAP_H) / 2.0,
    );
    let mut out = vec![0u8; (MAP_W * MAP_H * 4) as usize];
    let mut any = false;
    for (tx, ty) in tiles_for(center) {
        let url = tile_url(&template, ZOOM, tx, ty);
        let Some((w, h, px)) = fetch_tile(&client, &cache, &url)
            .await
            .and_then(|b| decode_png(&b))
        else {
            continue;
        };
        any = true;
        let (bx, by) = (
            (f64::from(tx) * TILE - ox).round() as i64,
            (f64::from(ty) * TILE - oy).round() as i64,
        );
        for row in 0..h as i64 {
            let dy = by + row;
            if dy < 0 || dy >= i64::from(MAP_H) {
                continue;
            }
            for col in 0..w as i64 {
                let dx = bx + col;
                if dx < 0 || dx >= i64::from(MAP_W) {
                    continue;
                }
                let s = ((row * i64::from(w) + col) * 4) as usize;
                let d = ((dy * i64::from(MAP_W) + dx) * 4) as usize;
                if let (Some(src), Some(dst)) = (px.get(s..s + 4), out.get_mut(d..d + 4)) {
                    dst.copy_from_slice(src);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    any.then_some((MAP_W, MAP_H, out))
}

fn parse(v: &str) -> Option<f64> {
    v.trim().parse().ok()
}

/// Reloads the map around the fields' coordinates.
pub fn refresh_map(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    let vm = ctx.app.get_widgets();
    let (Some(lat), Some(lon)) = (parse(&vm.gps_lat), parse(&vm.gps_lon)) else {
        return;
    };
    let template = ctx.prefs.borrow().tiles().to_string();
    let cache = ctx.paths.cache.join("tiles");
    let weak = ctx.app.as_weak();
    ctx.bridge.handle().spawn(async move {
        let map = render_map(template, cache, lat, lon).await;
        let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
            let Some(app) = weak.upgrade() else { return };
            match map {
                Some((w, h, px)) => {
                    let buf = SharedPixelBuffer::<Rgba8Pixel>::clone_from_slice(&px, w, h);
                    app.set_gps_map(Image::from_rgba8(buf));
                    app.set_gps_has_map(true);
                }
                None => app.set_gps_has_map(false),
            }
            app.set_gps_marker_x(0.5);
            app.set_gps_marker_y(0.5);
        });
    });
}

/// `gps.set` from the fields.
pub fn set_location(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, device: uuid::Uuid) {
    let vm = ctx.app.get_widgets();
    let (Some(lat), Some(lon)) = (parse(&vm.gps_lat), parse(&vm.gps_lon)) else {
        toast(
            &ctx.app.as_weak(),
            "Latitude and longitude must be numbers".into(),
        );
        return;
    };
    let mut p = json!({ "device": device, "latitude": lat, "longitude": lon });
    if let Some(a) = parse(&vm.gps_alt) {
        p["altitude"] = json!(a);
    }
    if let Some(b) = parse(&vm.gps_bearing) {
        p["bearing"] = json!(b);
    }
    let w = ctx.app.as_weak();
    ctx.bridge.call("gps.set", p, move |r| {
        if let Err(e) = r {
            toast(&w, e.message);
        }
    });
    refresh_map(ctx);
}

/// A click on the map moves the fix there.
pub fn map_click(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, device: uuid::Uuid, nx: f32, ny: f32) {
    let mut vm = ctx.app.get_widgets();
    let (Some(lat), Some(lon)) = (parse(&vm.gps_lat), parse(&vm.gps_lon)) else {
        return;
    };
    let c = world_px(lat, lon, ZOOM);
    let x = c.0 + (f64::from(nx) - 0.5) * f64::from(MAP_W);
    let y = c.1 + (f64::from(ny) - 0.5) * f64::from(MAP_H);
    let (la, lo) = lat_lon(x, y, ZOOM);
    vm.gps_lat = format!("{la:.4}").into();
    vm.gps_lon = format!("{lo:.4}").into();
    ctx.app.set_widgets(vm);
    set_location(ctx, device);
}

/// Asks for a GPX/KML file with the macOS file chooser.
pub fn choose_file() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let out = std::process::Command::new("osascript")
        .args([
            "-e",
            "POSIX path of (choose file with prompt \"Choose a GPX or KML route\" of type {\"gpx\", \"kml\", \"public.xml\", \"com.topografix.gpx\"})",
        ])
        .output()
        .ok()?;
    let p = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim().to_string();
    (!p.is_empty()).then(|| PathBuf::from(p))
}

/// Starts replaying `path`; progress lands in the view model.
pub fn start_route(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, device: uuid::Uuid, path: PathBuf) {
    let mut vm = ctx.app.get_widgets();
    vm.route_name = path
        .file_name()
        .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .unwrap_or_default()
        .into();
    vm.route_active = true;
    vm.route_paused = false;
    vm.route_progress = 0.0;
    vm.route_text = "Starting…".into();
    let speed = SPEEDS
        .get(usize::try_from(vm.route_speed).unwrap_or(0))
        .copied()
        .unwrap_or(1.0);
    let repeat = vm.route_loop;
    ctx.app.set_widgets(vm);
    ROUTE_FILE.with(|f| *f.borrow_mut() = Some(path.clone()));
    // Draw the route on the map.
    if let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {
        let pts = route_points(&text);
        if let Some(first) = pts.first() {
            let mut vm = ctx.app.get_widgets();
            if parse(&vm.gps_lat).is_none() {
                vm.gps_lat = format!("{:.4}", first.0).into();
                vm.gps_lon = format!("{:.4}", first.1).into();
                ctx.app.set_widgets(vm);
            }
            let vm = ctx.app.get_widgets();
            let c = world_px(
                parse(&vm.gps_lat).unwrap_or(first.0),
                parse(&vm.gps_lon).unwrap_or(first.1),
                ZOOM,
            );
            ctx.app.set_gps_route_path(route_path(&pts, c).into());
            refresh_map(ctx);
        }
    }
    let weak = ctx.app.as_weak();
    let w2 = weak.clone();
    ctx.bridge.run(
        "gps.route",
        json!({ "device": device, "path": path, "speed": speed, "loop": repeat }),
        move |job| {
            let (p, msg) = (job.progress.unwrap_or(0.0), job.message.clone());
            let weak = weak.clone();
            let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
                if let Some(app) = weak.upgrade() {
                    let mut vm = app.get_widgets();
                    vm.route_progress = p;
                    vm.route_text = msg.into();
                    app.set_widgets(vm);
                }
            });
        },
        move |r: jidr_core::JidrResult<Value>| {
            let err = r.err().filter(|e| !jidr_core::cancel::is_cancelled(e));
            let failed = err.is_some();
            let weak = w2.clone();
            let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
                if let Some(app) = weak.upgrade() {
                    let mut vm = app.get_widgets();
                    vm.route_active = false;
                    vm.route_paused = false;
                    if !failed {
                        vm.route_progress = 1.0;
                    }
                    app.set_widgets(vm);
                }
            });
            if let Some(e) = err {
                toast(&w2, e.message);
            }
        },
    );
}

/// (lat, lon) of a GPX/KML text, for drawing (the daemon parses it again).
pub fn route_points(text: &str) -> Vec<(f64, f64)> {
    let mut v = Vec::new();
    let mut rest = text;
    // GPX: lat="…" lon="…" on trkpt/rtept/wpt.
    while let Some(i) = rest.find("lat=") {
        let after = &rest[i..];
        let num = |s: &str, key: &str| -> Option<f64> {
            let j = s.find(key)? + key.len() + 1;
            let q = s[j - 1..].chars().next()?;
            let end = s[j..].find(q)?;
            s[j..j + end].parse().ok()
        };
        let head = &after[..after.find('>').unwrap_or(after.len())];
        if let (Some(la), Some(lo)) = (num(head, "lat="), num(head, "lon=")) {
            v.push((la, lo));
        }
        rest = &after[4..];
    }
    if v.is_empty() {
        // KML: lon,lat[,alt] tuples inside <coordinates>.
        if let Some(a) = text.find("<coordinates>") {
            let body = &text[a + 13..];
            let body = &body[..body.find("</coordinates>").unwrap_or(body.len())];
            for t in body.split_whitespace() {
                let p: Vec<f64> = t.split(',').filter_map(|x| x.parse().ok()).collect();
                if p.len() >= 2 {
                    v.push((p[1], p[0]));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    v
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn mercator_round_trips() {
        let (x, y) = world_px(32.8954, 13.1802, ZOOM);
        let (la, lo) = lat_lon(x, y, ZOOM);
        assert!((la - 32.8954).abs() < 1e-9 && (lo - 13.1802).abs() < 1e-9);
        // Tile of Martyrs' Square at z15.
        assert_eq!(((x / 256.0) as u32, (y / 256.0) as u32), (17583, 13210));
    }

    #[test]
    fn view_needs_the_tiles_around_the_point() {
        let c = world_px(32.8954, 13.1802, ZOOM);
        let t = tiles_for(c);
        assert!(t.len() >= 6 && t.len() <= 12, "{t:?}");
        assert!(t.contains(&((c.0 / 256.0) as u32, (c.1 / 256.0) as u32)));
        assert_eq!(
            tile_url("https://t/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", 15, 1, 2),
            "https://t/15/1/2.png"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn route_path_starts_at_the_centre() {
        let c = world_px(32.8954, 13.1802, ZOOM);
        let p = route_path(&[(32.8954, 13.1802), (32.8900, 13.1850)], c);
        assert!(p.starts_with("M 500.0 500.0 L "), "{p}");
        let pts = route_points(
            "<gpx><trkpt lat=\"32.8954\" lon=\"13.1802\"/><trkpt lat='32.89' lon='13.18'/></gpx>",
        );
        assert_eq!(pts, vec![(32.8954, 13.1802), (32.89, 13.18)]);
        assert_eq!(
            route_points("<kml><coordinates>13.18,32.89,0 13.2,32.8</coordinates></kml>").len(),
            2
        );
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-ui/src/widgets/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! Widget panels → `jidr-widgets` commands. Controls update the view model
//! at once, then call the daemon; a failure shows a toast and reloads.

use std::rc::Rc;

use serde_json::{Value, json};
use slint::ComponentHandle;
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::WidgetsVm;
use crate::app::{Ctx, toast};

pub mod gps;

pub const PROFILES: [&str; 7] = ["full", "lte", "hsdpa", "umts", "edge", "gprs", "gsm"];
pub const SCALES: [f32; 7] = [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 5.0, 10.0];
pub const CAMERAS: [&str; 4] = ["emulated", "webcam0", "virtualscene", "none"];
/// The proxy host when the field is empty: this Mac, as the emulator sees it.
pub const PROXY_HOST: &str = "10.0.2.2";

/// Defaults before the device answers.
pub fn default_vm() -> WidgetsVm {
    WidgetsVm {
        battery_level: 100,
        animation: 2,
        light: "400".into(),
        temperature: "25".into(),
        pressure: "1013".into(),
        humidity: "40".into(),
        ..Default::default()
    }
}

/// A panel action → (method, params); `None` for view-only changes, which
/// are applied to `vm` directly.
pub fn command(vm: &mut WidgetsVm, action: &str, value: &str) -> Option<(&'static str, Value)> {
    let on = value == "true";
    let num = || value.trim().parse::<f64>().ok();
    let idx = || value.trim().parse::<usize>().ok();
    Some(match action {
        "battery.level" => {
            let l = num()?.clamp(0.0, 100.0).round() as i32;
            vm.battery_level = l;
            ("battery.set", json!({ "level": l }))
        }
        "battery.charging" => {
            vm.charging = on;
            ("battery.set", json!({ "charging": on }))
        }
        "network.wifi" => {
            vm.wifi = on;
            ("network.set", json!({ "wifi": on }))
        }
        "network.mobile" => {
            vm.mobile = on;
            ("network.set", json!({ "mobile": on }))
        }
        "network.profile" => {
            let i = idx()?;
            vm.profile = i as i32;
            ("network.set", json!({ "profile": PROFILES.get(i)? }))
        }
        "network.proxy-host" => {
            vm.proxy_host = value.into();
            return None;
        }
        "network.proxy-port" => {
            vm.proxy_port = value.into();
            return None;
        }
        "network.proxy.set" => {
            let port = vm.proxy_port.trim().parse::<u16>().ok()?;
            let host = match vm.proxy_host.trim() {
                "" => PROXY_HOST,
                h => h,
            };
            ("network.proxy.set", json!({ "host": host, "port": port }))
        }
        "network.proxy.clear" => ("network.proxy.clear", json!({})),
        "phone.signal" => {
            let i = idx()?.min(4);
            vm.signal = i as i32;
            ("phone.gsm", json!({ "signal": i }))
        }
        "sensor.rotate" => {
            let a = num()? as u16;
            vm.rotation = i32::from(a / 90);
            ("sensor.rotate", json!({ "angle": a }))
        }
        "sensor.motion" => {
            let g = 9.80665;
            let v = match value {
                "upright" => [0.0, g, 0.0],
                "flat" => [0.0, 0.0, g],
                "upside-down" => [0.0, -g, 0.0],
                _ => return None,
            };
            (
                "sensor.set",
                json!({ "sensor": "acceleration", "values": v }),
            )
        }
        "sensor.light" | "sensor.temperature" | "sensor.pressure" | "sensor.humidity" => {
            let v = num()?;
            let s = action.trim_start_matches("sensor.");
            match s {
                "light" => vm.light = value.into(),
                "temperature" => vm.temperature = value.into(),
                "pressure" => vm.pressure = value.into(),
                _ => vm.humidity = value.into(),
            }
            ("sensor.set", json!({ "sensor": s, "values": [v] }))
        }
        "sensor.proximity" => {
            vm.proximity_near = value == "near";
            let cm = if vm.proximity_near { 0.0 } else { 5.0 };
            (
                "sensor.set",
                json!({ "sensor": "proximity", "values": [cm] }),
            )
        }
        "phone.number" => {
            vm.phone_number = value.into();
            return None;
        }
        "phone.sms-text" => {
            vm.sms_text = value.into();
            return None;
        }
        "phone.call" => (
            "phone.call",
            json!({ "number": vm.phone_number.as_str(), "action": value }),
        ),
        "phone.sms" => (
            "phone.sms",
            json!({ "from": vm.phone_number.as_str(), "text": vm.sms_text.as_str() }),
        ),
        "key.press" => ("key.press", json!({ "key": value })),
        "dev.show_taps" => {
            vm.show_taps = on;
            ("dev.set", json!({ "show_taps": on }))
        }
        "dev.pointer_location" => {
            vm.pointer_location = on;
            ("dev.set", json!({ "pointer_location": on }))
        }
        "dev.layout_bounds" => {
            vm.layout_bounds = on;
            ("dev.set", json!({ "layout_bounds": on }))
        }
        "dev.animation" => {
            let i = idx()?;
            vm.animation = i as i32;
            ("dev.set", json!({ "animation_scale": SCALES.get(i)? }))
        }
        "clipboard.text" => {
            vm.clipboard = value.into();
            return None;
        }
        "clipboard.set" => ("clipboard.set", json!({ "text": vm.clipboard.as_str() })),
        "clipboard.get" => ("clipboard.get", json!({})),
        "fingerprint.touch" => ("fingerprint.touch", json!({ "finger": idx()? })),
        "fingerprint.remove" => ("fingerprint.remove", json!({})),
        "camera.back" => {
            let i = idx()?;
            vm.camera_back = i as i32;
            ("camera.set", json!({ "back": CAMERAS.get(i)? }))
        }
        _ => return None,
    })
}

/// Merges `*.get` answers into the view model.
pub fn merge(vm: &mut WidgetsVm, method: &str, v: &Value) {
    match method {
        "battery.get" => {
            if let Some(l) = v.get("level").and_then(Value::as_i64) {
                vm.battery_level = l as i32;
            }
            vm.charging = v.get("charging").and_then(Value::as_bool).unwrap_or(false);
            vm.battery_health = v
                .get("health")
                .and_then(Value::as_str)
                .unwrap_or("good")
                .into();
        }
        "network.get" => {
            vm.wifi = v.get("wifi").and_then(Value::as_bool).unwrap_or(true);
            vm.mobile = v.get("mobile").and_then(Value::as_bool).unwrap_or(true);
        }
        "network.proxy.get" | "network.proxy.set" | "network.proxy.clear" => {
            vm.proxy = v
                .get("proxy")
                .and_then(Value::as_str)
                .unwrap_or_default()
                .into();
            // Fill an untouched form with the device's proxy.
            if vm.proxy_port.is_empty() {
                vm.proxy_host = v
                    .get("host")
                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
                    .unwrap_or_default()
                    .into();
                vm.proxy_port = v
                    .get("port")
                    .and_then(Value::as_u64)
                    .map(|p| p.to_string())
                    .unwrap_or_default()
                    .into();
            }
        }
        "dev.get" => {
            vm.show_taps = v.get("show_taps").and_then(Value::as_bool).unwrap_or(false);
            vm.pointer_location = v
                .get("pointer_location")
                .and_then(Value::as_bool)
                .unwrap_or(false);
            vm.layout_bounds = v
                .get("layout_bounds")
                .and_then(Value::as_bool)
                .unwrap_or(false);
            if let Some(s) = v.get("animation_scale").and_then(Value::as_f64) {
                vm.animation = SCALES
                    .iter()
                    .position(|x| (f64::from(*x) - s).abs() < 0.01)
                    .unwrap_or(2) as i32;
            }
        }
        "camera.get" => {
            let back = v.get("back").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("default");
            vm.camera_back = CAMERAS.iter().position(|c| *c == back).unwrap_or(0) as i32;
        }
        "clipboard.get" => {
            vm.clipboard = v
                .get("text")
                .and_then(Value::as_str)
                .unwrap_or_default()
                .into();
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

fn active(ctx: &Ctx) -> Option<Uuid> {
    let st = ctx.state.borrow();
    st.active.and_then(|i| st.tabs.get(i)).copied()
}

fn call_and_merge(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, device: Uuid, method: &'static str, mut params: Value) {
    params["device"] = json!(device);
    let token = crate::app::defer(move |r: jidr_core::JidrResult<Value>| {
        let Some(c) = crate::app::ctx() else { return };
        match r {
            Ok(v) => {
                let mut vm = c.app.get_widgets();
                merge(&mut vm, method, &v);
                c.app.set_widgets(vm);
                if method == "gps.get" {
                    gps::refresh_map(&c);
                }
            }
            Err(e) if method.ends_with(".get") => tracing::debug!("{method}: {}", e.message),
            Err(e) => {
                toast(&c.app.as_weak(), e.message);
                load(&c);
            }
        }
    });
    ctx.bridge
        .call(method, params, move |r| crate::app::fire(token, r));
}

/// Loads the panels' values for the active device.
pub fn load(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    let Some(id) = active(ctx) else { return };
    for m in [
        "battery.get",
        "network.get",
        "network.proxy.get",
        "dev.get",
        "camera.get",
        "gps.get",
    ] {
        call_and_merge(ctx, id, m, json!({}));
    }
}

pub fn wire(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    ctx.app.set_widgets(default_vm());
    let c = ctx.clone();
    ctx.app.on_widget_action(move |action, value| {
        let Some(id) = active(&c) else { return };
        if gps_action(&c, id, &action, &value) {
            return;
        }
        let mut vm = c.app.get_widgets();
        let cmd = command(&mut vm, &action, &value);
        c.app.set_widgets(vm);
        if let Some((method, params)) = cmd {
            call_and_merge(&c, id, method, params);
        }
    });
    let c = ctx.clone();
    ctx.app.on_widget_tab(move |_| load(&c));
    let c = ctx.clone();
    ctx.app.on_gps_map_click(move |x, y| {
        if let Some(id) = active(&c) {
            gps::map_click(&c, id, x, y);
        }
    });
}

/// GPS panel actions; true when handled.
fn gps_action(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, id: Uuid, action: &str, value: &str) -> bool {
    let mut vm = ctx.app.get_widgets();
    match action {
        "gps.lat" => vm.gps_lat = value.into(),
        "gps.lon" => vm.gps_lon = value.into(),
        "gps.alt" => vm.gps_alt = value.into(),
        "gps.bearing" => vm.gps_bearing = value.into(),
        "gps.set" => {
            gps::set_location(ctx, id);
            return true;
        }
        "gps.route.choose" => {
            let token = crate::app::defer(move |path: Option<std::path::PathBuf>| {
                if let (Some(p), Some(c)) = (path, crate::app::ctx()) {
                    gps::start_route(&c, id, p);
                }
            });
            std::thread::spawn(move || crate::app::fire(token, gps::choose_file()));
            return true;
        }
        "gps.route.toggle" => {
            if vm.route_active {
                vm.route_paused = !vm.route_paused;
                let paused = vm.route_paused;
                ctx.app.set_widgets(vm);
                ctx.bridge.call(
                    "gps.route_control",
                    json!({ "device": id, "paused": paused }),
                    |_| {},
                );
            } else if let Some(p) = gps::ROUTE_FILE.with(|f| f.borrow().clone()) {
                gps::start_route(ctx, id, p);
            }
            return true;
        }
        "gps.route.speed" => {
            let i = value.parse::<usize>().unwrap_or(0).min(2);
            vm.route_speed = i as i32;
            if vm.route_active {
                ctx.bridge.call(
                    "gps.route_control",
                    json!({ "device": id, "speed": gps::SPEEDS[i] }),
                    |_| {},
                );
            }
        }
        "gps.route.loop" => {
            vm.route_loop = value == "true";
            if vm.route_active {
                ctx.bridge.call(
                    "gps.route_control",
                    json!({ "device": id, "loop": vm.route_loop }),
                    |_| {},
                );
            }
        }
        _ => return false,
    }
    ctx.app.set_widgets(vm);
    true
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn actions_become_commands() {
        let mut vm = default_vm();
        let (m, p) = command(&mut vm, "battery.level", "64").unwrap();
        assert_eq!((m, p["level"].as_i64()), ("battery.set", Some(64)));
        assert_eq!(vm.battery_level, 64);
        let (_, p) = command(&mut vm, "network.profile", "4").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p["profile"], "edge");
        let (_, p) = command(&mut vm, "dev.animation", "1").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p["animation_scale"], 0.5);
        assert!(command(&mut vm, "phone.number", "+218 91").is_none());
        let (m, p) = command(&mut vm, "phone.call", "incoming").unwrap();
        assert_eq!((m, p["number"].as_str()), ("phone.call", Some("+218 91")));
        assert!(command(&mut vm, "battery.level", "x").is_none());
        let (_, p) = command(&mut vm, "camera.back", "1").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p["back"], "webcam0");
    }

    #[test]
    fn proxy_form_sets_and_clears() {
        let mut vm = default_vm();
        assert!(command(&mut vm, "network.proxy-port", "8080").is_none());
        let (m, p) = command(&mut vm, "network.proxy.set", "").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(m, "network.proxy.set");
        assert_eq!(
            p,
            json!({ "host": "10.0.2.2", "port": 8080 }),
            "empty host = this Mac"
        );
        command(&mut vm, "network.proxy-host", " 192.168.1.5 ");
        let (_, p) = command(&mut vm, "network.proxy.set", "").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p["host"], "192.168.1.5");
        command(&mut vm, "network.proxy-port", "x");
        assert!(
            command(&mut vm, "network.proxy.set", "").is_none(),
            "bad port"
        );
        let (m, _) = command(&mut vm, "network.proxy.clear", "").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(m, "network.proxy.clear");
    }

    #[test]
    fn proxy_answers_merge() {
        let mut vm = default_vm();
        let set = json!({ "proxy": "10.0.2.2:8080", "host": "10.0.2.2", "port": 8080 });
        merge(&mut vm, "network.proxy.get", &set);
        assert_eq!(
            (
                vm.proxy.as_str(),
                vm.proxy_host.as_str(),
                vm.proxy_port.as_str()
            ),
            ("10.0.2.2:8080", "10.0.2.2", "8080")
        );
        merge(
            &mut vm,
            "network.proxy.clear",
            &json!({ "proxy": null, "host": null, "port": null }),
        );
        assert_eq!(vm.proxy, "");
        assert_eq!(vm.proxy_port, "8080", "the form keeps what was typed");
    }

    #[test]
    fn get_answers_merge() {
        let mut vm = default_vm();
        merge(
            &mut vm,
            "battery.get",
            &json!({"level": 42, "charging": true, "health": "good"}),
        );
        merge(
            &mut vm,
            "dev.get",
            &json!({"show_taps": true, "animation_scale": 0.5}),
        );
        assert_eq!(
            (vm.battery_level, vm.charging, vm.show_taps, vm.animation),
            (42, true, true, 1)
        );
    }
}
```
