`crates/jidr-ui/src/wizard/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! First-run setup: find an SDK, show Google's license unchanged (accept
//! only after reading to the end, D8), download, create the first device.

use std::rc::Rc;

use jidr_core::{HardwareProfile, Support, SystemImage};
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use slint::{ComponentHandle, ModelRc, VecModel};

use crate::app::Ctx;
use crate::model;
use crate::{DetectRow, JobTone, JobVm, PlanRow, RootChoice, SetupWindow, Theme};

/// One license still to accept (`sdk.licenses`).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize)]
pub struct PendingLicense {
    pub id: String,
    pub sha256: String,
    pub text: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub packages: Vec<String>,
}

/// Where Jidr looked for an SDK, from `sdk.status` and the environment.
pub fn detect_rows(
    status: &Value,
    android_home: Option<&str>,
    sdk_root: Option<&str>,
) -> (Vec<DetectRow>, bool) {
    let studio = status.get("studio_sdk").and_then(Value::as_str);
    let tools = status.get("tools_sdk").and_then(Value::as_str);
    let row = |path: &str, state: &str, found: bool| DetectRow {
        path: path.into(),
        state: state.into(),
        found,
    };
    let rows = vec![
        match studio {
            Some(p) => row(&tilde(p), "Found · used read-only", true),
            None => row("~/Library/Android/sdk", "Not found", false),
        },
        match android_home {
            Some(p) if !p.is_empty() => row("$ANDROID_HOME", &tilde(p), true),
            _ => row("$ANDROID_HOME", "Not set", false),
        },
        match sdk_root {
            Some(p) if !p.is_empty() => row("$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT", &tilde(p), true),
            _ => row("$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT", "Not set", false),
        },
    ];
    (rows, tools.is_some())
}

fn tilde(p: &str) -> String {
    match dirs::home_dir().and_then(|h| h.to_str().map(str::to_string)) {
        Some(h) if p.starts_with(&h) => format!("~{}", &p[h.len()..]),
        _ => p.to_string(),
    }
}

/// The first image to offer: API 35 Google APIs, else the newest supported
/// Google APIs image, else the newest supported one.
pub fn pick_image(images: &[SystemImage]) -> Option<SystemImage> {
    let supported: Vec<&SystemImage> = images
        .iter()
        .filter(|i| i.support == Support::Supported)
        .collect();
    supported
        .iter()
        .find(|i| i.image.api == 35 && i.image.tag == "google_apis")
        .or_else(|| {
            supported
                .iter()
                .filter(|i| i.image.tag == "google_apis")
                .max_by_key(|i| i.image.api)
        })
        .or_else(|| supported.iter().max_by_key(|i| i.image.api))
        .map(|i| (*i).clone())
}

/// What will be downloaded, with real catalog sizes where known.
pub fn plan(needs_emulator: bool, image: Option<&SystemImage>) -> (Vec<PlanRow>, String) {
    let mut rows = Vec::new();
    let mut total = 0u64;
    let mut unknown = false;
    if needs_emulator {
        rows.push(PlanRow {
            label: "Android Emulator and platform tools".into(),
            size: "size shown when it starts".into(),
        });
        unknown = true;
    }
    if let Some(img) = image.filter(|i| i.installed_in.is_none()) {
        rows.push(PlanRow {
            label: format!(
                "{} · {} · arm64",
                model::android_version(img.image.api) + &format!(" (API {})", img.image.api),
                model::image_tag(&img.image)
            )
            .into(),
            size: if img.size > 0 {
                model::gb(img.size)
            } else {
                "—".into()
            }
            .into(),
        });
        total += img.size;
    }
    let total = match (total, unknown) {
        (0, true) => "emulator only".to_string(),
        (t, true) => format!("{} + emulator", model::gb(t)),
        (t, false) => model::gb(t),
    };
    (rows, total)
}

fn models<T: Clone + 'static>(v: Vec<T>) -> ModelRc<T> {
    ModelRc::new(VecModel::from(v))
}

/// Opens the setup window and drives it.
pub fn open(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>) {
    let Ok(win) = SetupWindow::new() else { return };
    let theme = ctx.app.global::<Theme>();
    let wt = win.global::<Theme>();
    wt.set_dark(theme.get_dark());
    wt.set_rtl(theme.get_rtl());
    wt.set_reduce_motion(theme.get_reduce_motion());
    win.set_draw_lights(false);

    let weak = win.as_weak();
    let state: St = St::default();

    // Step 1: detection and plan.
    {
        let weak = weak.clone();
        let state = state.clone();
        let bridge = ctx.bridge.clone();
        let b2 = bridge.clone();
        bridge.call("sdk.status", json!({}), move |status| {
            let status = status.unwrap_or(Value::Null);
            b2.call("image.list", json!({}), move |images| {
                let images: Vec<SystemImage> = images
                    .ok()
                    .and_then(|v| serde_json::from_value(v).ok())
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
                    let Some(win) = weak.upgrade() else { return };
                    let home = std::env::var("ANDROID_HOME").ok();
                    let root = std::env::var("ANDROID_SDK_ROOT").ok();
                    let (rows, found) = detect_rows(&status, home.as_deref(), root.as_deref());
                    let image = pick_image(&images);
                    let (plan_rows, total) = plan(!found, image.as_ref());
                    win.set_detect(models(rows));
                    win.set_sdk_found(found);
                    win.set_plan(models(plan_rows));
                    win.set_plan_total(total.into());
                    win.set_plan_dir(
                        status
                            .get("private_sdk")
                            .and_then(Value::as_str)
                            .map(tilde)
                            .unwrap_or_default()
                            .into(),
                    );
                    let mut st = lock(&state);
                    st.image = image;
                    st.needs_install =
                        !found || st.image.as_ref().is_some_and(|i| i.installed_in.is_none());
                });
            });
        });
    }

    let c = ctx.clone();
    let st = state.clone();
    let w = weak.clone();
    win.on_next(move || {
        let Some(win) = w.upgrade() else { return };
        match win.get_step() {
            1 if lock(&st).needs_install => load_licenses(&c, &win, &st),
            1 | 3 => to_first_device(&c, &win, &st),
            _ => {}
        }
    });

    let w = weak.clone();
    win.on_back(move || {
        if let Some(win) = w.upgrade() {
            win.set_step(1);
        }
    });
    let w = weak.clone();
    win.on_decline(move || {
        if let Some(win) = w.upgrade() {
            let _ = win.hide();
        }
    });
    let w = weak.clone();
    win.on_quit(move || {
        if let Some(win) = w.upgrade() {
            let _ = win.hide();
        }
    });
    let w = weak.clone();
    win.on_run_in_background(move || {
        if let Some(win) = w.upgrade() {
            let _ = win.hide();
        }
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    let st = state.clone();
    let w = weak.clone();
    win.on_accept(move || {
        let Some(win) = w.upgrade() else { return };
        accept_and_download(&c, &win, &st);
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    let st = state.clone();
    win.on_cancel_download(move || {
        if let Some(job) = lock(&st).job {
            c.bridge.call("jobs.cancel", json!({ "job": job }), |_| {});
        }
    });

    let c = ctx.clone();
    let st = state.clone();
    let w = weak.clone();
    win.on_create(move |form| {
        let Some(win) = w.upgrade() else { return };
        let st = lock(&st);
        let images: Vec<SystemImage> = st.image.iter().cloned().collect();
        let mut form = form;
        form.image = 0;
        match crate::device_form::create_params(&form, &st.profiles, &images) {
            Err(e) => win.set_error(e.into()),
            Ok(params) => {
                win.set_error("".into());
                let start = form.start_after;
                let w2 = w.clone();
                let bridge = c.bridge.clone();
                let app = c.app.as_weak();
                c.bridge.call("device.create", params, move |r| match r {
                    Ok(dev) => {
                        if start && let Some(id) = dev.get("id").cloned() {
                            bridge.run("device.start", json!({ "device": id }), |_| {}, |_| {});
                        }
                        crate::app::toast(&app, "Created your first device".into());
                        let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
                            if let Some(win) = w2.upgrade() {
                                let _ = win.hide();
                            }
                        });
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
                            if let Some(win) = w2.upgrade() {
                                win.set_error(e.message.into());
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });
            }
        }
    });

    let _ = win.show();
    // Keep it alive while shown.
    ctx.windows.borrow_mut().push(Box::new(win));
}

type St = std::sync::Arc<std::sync::Mutex<SetupState>>;

fn lock(st: &St) -> std::sync::MutexGuard<'_, SetupState> {
    st.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct SetupState {
    image: Option<SystemImage>,
    needs_install: bool,
    licenses: Vec<PendingLicense>,
    job: Option<uuid::Uuid>,
    profiles: Vec<HardwareProfile>,
}

fn packages(st: &SetupState) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut p = Vec::new();
    if let Some(i) = st.image.as_ref().filter(|i| i.installed_in.is_none()) {
        p.push(i.image.package());
    }
    if p.is_empty() {
        p.push("emulator".into());
    }
    p
}

fn load_licenses(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, win: &SetupWindow, st: &St) {
    let pkgs = packages(&lock(st));
    let weak = win.as_weak();
    let st = st.clone();
    ctx.bridge
        .call("sdk.licenses", json!({ "packages": pkgs }), move |r| {
            let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
                let Some(win) = weak.upgrade() else { return };
                match r.and_then(|v| {
                    serde_json::from_value::<Vec<PendingLicense>>(v)
                        .map_err(|e| jidr_core::JidrError::unexpected(e.to_string()))
                }) {
                    Ok(lics) if lics.is_empty() => {
                        lock(&st).licenses.clear();
                        win.set_license_read(true);
                        win.set_step(2);
                    }
                    Ok(lics) => {
                        win.set_license_title(license_title(&lics[0].id).into());
                        win.set_license_text(
                            lics.iter()
                                .map(|l| l.text.as_str())
                                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                                .join("\n\n")
                                .into(),
                        );
                        win.set_license_read(false);
                        lock(&st).licenses = lics;
                        win.set_step(2);
                    }
                    Err(e) => win.set_error(e.message.into()),
                }
            });
        });
}

pub fn license_title(id: &str) -> String {
    match id {
        "android-sdk-license" => "Android Software Development Kit License Agreement".into(),
        "android-sdk-preview-license" => "Android SDK Preview License Agreement".into(),
        other => other.replace('-', " "),
    }
}

fn accept_and_download(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, win: &SetupWindow, st: &St) {
    let lics = lock(st).licenses.clone();
    let pkgs = packages(&lock(st));
    let image = lock(st).image.clone();
    let accepted = chrono::Local::now().format("%b %-d, %H:%M").to_string();
    win.set_accepted_note(
        format!(
            "License accepted {accepted}. You can close this window; downloads keep going in Jobs."
        )
        .into(),
    );
    win.set_step(3);
    let title = image
        .as_ref()
        .map(|i| {
            format!(
                "{} (API {}) image",
                model::android_version(i.image.api),
                i.image.api
            )
        })
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "Android Emulator".into());
    let size = image.as_ref().map(|i| i.size).unwrap_or(0);
    set_download(win, &title, JobTone::Running, 0.0, size, "");
    let bridge = ctx.bridge.clone();
    let weak = win.as_weak();
    let st2 = st.clone();
    // Consent first (per license hash), then the install job.
    let b = bridge.clone();
    ctx.bridge.handle().spawn(async move {
        for l in &lics {
            let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel();
            b.call(
                "sdk.accept_license",
                json!({ "id": l.id, "sha256": l.sha256 }),
                move |r| {
                    let _ = tx.send(r);
                },
            );
            if let Ok(Err(e)) = rx.await {
                let msg = e.message;
                let weak = weak.clone();
                let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
                    if let Some(win) = weak.upgrade() {
                        win.set_error(msg.into());
                    }
                });
                return;
            }
        }
        let method = if image.as_ref().is_some_and(|i| i.installed_in.is_none()) {
            "image.install"
        } else {
            "sdk.install"
        };
        let params = match (&image, method) {
            (Some(i), "image.install") => json!({ "image": i.image.package() }),
            _ => json!({ "packages": ["emulator", "platform-tools"] }),
        };
        let _ = pkgs;
        let (wp, wd) = (weak.clone(), weak.clone());
        let (tp, td) = (title.clone(), title.clone());
        let started = std::time::Instant::now();
        b.run(
            method,
            params,
            move |job| {
                let p = job.progress.unwrap_or(0.0);
                let eta = eta_text(started.elapsed().as_secs_f32(), p);
                let tp = tp.clone();
                let wp = wp.clone();
                let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
                    if let Some(win) = wp.upgrade() {
                        set_download(&win, &tp, JobTone::Running, p, size, &eta);
                    }
                });
            },
            move |r| {
                let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
                    let Some(win) = wd.upgrade() else { return };
                    match r {
                        Ok(_) => {
                            set_download(&win, &td, JobTone::Done, 1.0, size, "Done");
                            win.set_downloads_done(true);
                            if let Some(i) = lock(&st2).image.as_mut() {
                                i.installed_in = Some("installed".into());
                            }
                        }
                        Err(e) => {
                            set_download(&win, &td, JobTone::Failed, 0.0, size, "");
                            win.set_error(e.message.into());
                        }
                    }
                });
            },
        );
    });
}

fn eta_text(elapsed: f32, progress: f32) -> String {
    if progress <= 0.02 || elapsed < 2.0 {
        return String::new();
    }
    let left = elapsed * (1.0 - progress) / progress;
    if left >= 60.0 {
        format!("About {} min left", (left / 60.0).ceil() as i64)
    } else {
        format!("About {} s left", left.ceil() as i64)
    }
}

fn set_download(win: &SetupWindow, title: &str, tone: JobTone, p: f32, size: u64, eta: &str) {
    let detail = if size > 0 {
        format!(
            "{:.1} / {}",
            f64::from(p) * size as f64 / 1e9,
            model::gb(size)
        )
    } else {
        format!("{}%", (p * 100.0).round() as i64)
    };
    let row = JobVm {
        id: "".into(),
        title: title.into(),
        tone,
        progress: p,
        indeterminate: false,
        detail: detail.into(),
        eta: eta.into(),
        cancellable: tone == JobTone::Running,
    };
    let verify = JobVm {
        id: "".into(),
        title: "Verify checksums".into(),
        tone: if tone == JobTone::Done {
            JobTone::Done
        } else {
            JobTone::Queued
        },
        progress: 0.0,
        indeterminate: false,
        detail: if tone == JobTone::Done {
            "Done"
        } else {
            "Queued"
        }
        .into(),
        eta: if tone == JobTone::Done {
            ""
        } else {
            "After download"
        }
        .into(),
        cancellable: false,
    };
    win.set_downloads(models(vec![row, verify]));
}

fn to_first_device(ctx: &Rc<Ctx>, win: &SetupWindow, st: &St) {
    let weak = win.as_weak();
    let st = st.clone();
    let taken: Vec<String> = ctx
        .state
        .borrow()
        .data
        .devices
        .iter()
        .map(|d| d.device.name.clone())
        .collect();
    let preferred = ctx.prefs.borrow().root_choice();
    ctx.bridge.call("profile.list", json!({}), move |r| {
        let profiles: Vec<HardwareProfile> = r
            .ok()
            .and_then(|v| serde_json::from_value(v).ok())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let _ = slint::invoke_from_event_loop(move || {
            let Some(win) = weak.upgrade() else { return };
            let mut s = lock(&st);
            let images: Vec<SystemImage> = s.image.iter().cloned().collect();
            let mut form = crate::device_form::new_form(&profiles, &images, &taken, preferred);
            if form.root == RootChoice::None && preferred == RootChoice::Shell {
                form.root = crate::device_form::default_root(images.first(), RootChoice::Shell);
            }
            win.set_profiles(models(crate::device_form::profile_options(&profiles)));
            if let Some(i) = images.first() {
                win.set_image_label(crate::device_form::image_label(i).into());
                win.set_image_status(format!("Installed · {}", model::gb(i.size)).into());
                win.set_image_play_store(!i.image.allows_adb_root());
            }
            win.set_form(form);
            s.profiles = profiles;
            win.set_step(4);
        });
    });
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use jidr_core::ImageRef;

    fn img(api: u32, tag: &str, installed: bool) -> SystemImage {
        SystemImage {
            image: ImageRef {
                api,
                tag: tag.into(),
                abi: "arm64-v8a".into(),
            },
            display: String::new(),
            revision: "1".into(),
            support: Support::for_api(api),
            size: 2_000_000_000,
            license: Some("android-sdk-license".into()),
            installed_in: installed.then(|| "/sdk".into()),
            pristine_ramdisk_sha256: None,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn detection_reports_each_place() {
        let (rows, found) = detect_rows(
            &json!({"studio_sdk": null, "tools_sdk": null}),
            None,
            Some("/opt/sdk"),
        );
        assert!(!found);
        assert_eq!(rows[0].state, "Not found");
        assert_eq!(rows[1].state, "Not set");
        assert_eq!(rows[2].state, "/opt/sdk");
        let (_, found) = detect_rows(&json!({"studio_sdk": "/x", "tools_sdk": "/x"}), None, None);
        assert!(found);
    }

    #[test]
    fn picks_api_35_google_apis_first() {
        let images = [
            img(36, "google_apis", false),
            img(35, "google_apis_playstore", false),
            img(35, "google_apis", false),
        ];
        let p = pick_image(&images).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((p.image.api, p.image.tag.as_str()), (35, "google_apis"));
        let p =
            pick_image(&[img(34, "google_apis", false), img(36, "google_apis", false)]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p.image.api, 36);
    }

    #[test]
    fn plan_lists_only_what_is_missing() {
        let (rows, total) = plan(false, Some(&img(35, "google_apis", false)));
        assert_eq!(rows.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(rows[0].label, "Android 15 (API 35) · Google APIs · arm64");
        assert_eq!(total, "2.0 GB");
        let (rows, total) = plan(true, Some(&img(35, "google_apis", true)));
        assert_eq!(rows.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(total, "emulator only");
    }

    #[test]
    fn eta_is_blank_until_progress_is_measurable() {
        assert_eq!(eta_text(1.0, 0.5), "");
        assert_eq!(eta_text(30.0, 0.5), "About 30 s left");
        assert_eq!(eta_text(60.0, 0.25), "About 3 min left");
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-ui/tests/bridge.rs`:

```rs
//! The GUI's daemon bridge against an in-process daemon: initial load,
//! event-driven reload, and reconnect after the daemon goes away.
#![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]

use std::sync::mpsc;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use jidr_client::{Client, SpawnOptions};
use jidr_daemon::testing::TestDaemon;
use jidr_ui::bridge::{Bridge, Conn, Update};
use serde_json::json;

fn wait_for(rx: &mpsc::Receiver<Update>, what: &str, f: impl Fn(&Update) -> bool) {
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(20);
    while Instant::now() < deadline {
        if let Ok(u) = rx.recv_timeout(Duration::from_millis(200))
            && f(&u)
        {
            return;
        }
    }
    panic!("timed out waiting for {what}");
}

#[test]
fn loads_follows_events_and_reconnects() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let rt = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().unwrap();
    let td = rt.block_on(TestDaemon::start(tmp.path())).unwrap();
    let paths = td.paths.clone();

    let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel();
    let bridge = Bridge::new().unwrap();
    let no_spawn = SpawnOptions {
        program: Some("/nonexistent/jidr".into()),
        timeout: Some(Duration::from_millis(200)),
        ..Default::default()
    };
    bridge.connect_with(paths.clone(), no_spawn, move |u| {
        let _ = tx.send(u);
    });

    wait_for(&rx, "online", |u| matches!(u, Update::Conn(Conn::Online)));
    wait_for(
        &rx,
        "empty device list",
        |u| matches!(u, Update::Data(d) if d.devices.is_empty()),
    );

    // A device created by another client shows up through events.
    rt.block_on(async {
        let c = Client::connect(&paths.socket(), "test").await.unwrap();
        c.call(
            "device.create",
            json!({"name": "Pixel-ish 6.1", "image": "35"}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    });
    wait_for(
        &rx,
        "the new device",
        |u| matches!(u, Update::Data(d) if d.devices.iter().any(|i| i.device.name == "Pixel-ish 6.1")),
    );

    // The daemon goes away: the bridge notices and keeps retrying.
    rt.block_on(td.stop());
    wait_for(&rx, "reconnecting", |u| {
        matches!(u, Update::Conn(Conn::Reconnecting(_)))
    });

    // A new daemon on the same socket: back online with the same device.
    let td = rt.block_on(TestDaemon::start(tmp.path())).unwrap();
    wait_for(&rx, "online again", |u| {
        matches!(u, Update::Conn(Conn::Online))
    });
    wait_for(
        &rx,
        "the device after reconnect",
        |u| matches!(u, Update::Data(d) if d.devices.len() == 1),
    );
    rt.block_on(td.stop());
}
```

`crates/jidr-ui/tests/player_emulator.rs`:

```rs
//! Player touches on a real emulator (#51): a tablet turned through all four
//! rotations, a Settings row touched the way the player touches it, and
//! checked by what the tap opened.
#![cfg(feature = "emulator")]
#![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]

use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use jidr_backend::AospBackend;
use jidr_client::Client;
use jidr_core::{ConnectInfo, JidrPaths};
use jidr_daemon::{Daemon, DaemonConfig};
use jidr_proto::control as pb;
use jidr_ui::player::input::{Gesture, Screen, panel_touches, touch_event};
use jidr_ui::player::session::{connect, oriented};
use serde_json::json;
use tokio_stream::wrappers::UnboundedReceiverStream;

fn test_sdk() -> PathBuf {
    std::env::var_os("JIDR_TEST_SDK")
        .map(PathBuf::from)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| dirs::home_dir().unwrap().join("Library/Android/sdk"))
}

fn test_image() -> String {
    std::env::var("JIDR_TEST_IMAGE").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        let abi = if cfg!(target_arch = "aarch64") {
            "arm64-v8a"
        } else {
            "x86_64"
        };
        format!("system-images;android-31;google_apis;{abi}")
    })
}

/// Kills the emulator however the test ends.
struct Kill(ConnectInfo);

impl Drop for Kill {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let _ = std::process::Command::new(&self.0.adb_path)
            .args(["-s", &self.0.adb_serial, "emu", "kill"])
            .output();
    }
}

fn shell(info: &ConnectInfo, cmd: &str) -> String {
    let out = std::process::Command::new(&info.adb_path)
        .args(["-s", &info.adb_serial, "shell", cmd])
        .output()
        .unwrap();
    String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).into_owned()
}

/// The panel size from `wm size` ("Physical size: 1600x2560").
fn panel(info: &ConnectInfo) -> Screen {
    let out = shell(info, "wm size");
    let size = out
        .lines()
        .find_map(|l| l.strip_prefix("Physical size: "))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("wm size: {out}"));
    let (w, h) = size.trim().split_once('x').unwrap();
    Screen {
        width: w.parse().unwrap(),
        height: h.parse().unwrap(),
    }
}

/// The UI hierarchy (`uiautomator dump`), empty if it failed.
fn ui_dump(info: &ConnectInfo) -> String {
    shell(
        info,
        "uiautomator dump /sdcard/jidr_ui.xml >/dev/null && cat /sdcard/jidr_ui.xml",
    )
}

/// Every non-empty text and its bounds in a hierarchy, for failure messages.
fn texts(xml: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    xml.split("<node")
        .filter_map(|n| {
            let t = n.split("text=\"").nth(1)?.split('"').next()?;
            let b = n.split("bounds=\"").nth(1)?.split('"').next()?;
            (!t.is_empty()).then(|| format!("{t} {b}"))
        })
        .collect()
}

/// Bounds (left, top, right, bottom) in display pixels of the node whose
/// text is exactly `text`.
fn bounds_of(xml: &str, text: &str) -> Option<(f32, f32, f32, f32)> {
    let at = xml.find(&format!("text=\"{text}\""))?;
    let start = xml[..at].rfind("<node")?;
    let end = at + xml[at..].find('>')?;
    let b = xml[start..end]
        .split("bounds=\"[")
        .nth(1)?
        .split('"')
        .next()?;
    let n: Vec<f32> = b
        .split([',', '[', ']'])
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
        .map(|s| s.parse().ok())
        .collect::<Option<_>>()?;
    (n.len() == 4).then(|| (n[0], n[1], n[2], n[3]))
}

async fn eventually<T>(what: &str, mut f: impl FnMut() -> Option<T>) -> T {
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(60);
    while Instant::now() < deadline {
        if let Some(v) = f() {
            return v;
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
    }
    panic!("timed out waiting for {what}");
}

/// The next streamed frame: (width, height, quarter turns).
async fn frame(ctl: &mut jidr_proto::Controller) -> (u32, u32, u32) {
    let fmt = pb::ImageFormat {
        format: pb::image_format::ImgFormat::Rgba8888 as i32,
        width: 400,
        height: 400,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let mut s = ctl.stream_screenshot(fmt).await.unwrap().into_inner();
    loop {
        let img = s.message().await.unwrap().unwrap();
        if let Some(f) = img.format
            && !img.image.is_empty()
        {
            let q = f.rotation.map_or(0, |r| r.rotation.rem_euclid(4) as u32);
            return (f.width, f.height, q);
        }
    }
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn taps_land_under_the_pointer_in_every_rotation() {
    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir_in(std::env::temp_dir()).unwrap();
    // Short root: the daemon socket path must fit in sun_path.
    let paths = JidrPaths::under(tmp.path().join("j"));
    let repo = tmp.path().join("repo");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&repo).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(
        repo.join("repository2-3.xml"),
        "<sdk:sdk-repository xmlns:sdk=\"x\"/>",
    )
    .unwrap();
    let daemon = Daemon::builder(
        DaemonConfig {
            paths: paths.clone(),
            studio_sdk: Some(test_sdk()),
            idle_timeout: None,
            sdk_repo: Some(format!("file://{}/", repo.display())),
        },
        Arc::new(AospBackend::new()),
    )
    .build()
    .unwrap();
    let (stop, stopped) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel::<()>();
    let d = daemon.clone();
    let serve = tokio::spawn(async move {
        d.serve(async {
            let _ = stopped.await;
        })
        .await
    });
    for _ in 0..500 {
        if paths.socket().exists() {
            break;
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
    }
    let client = Client::connect(&paths.socket(), "test").await.unwrap();
    client
        .call(
            "device.create",
            json!({ "name": "Tilt", "image": test_image(), "profile": "tablet-11", "root_mode": "none" }),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    client
        .run(
            "device.start",
            json!({ "device": "Tilt", "cold_boot": true }),
            |_| {},
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let info: ConnectInfo = client
        .call_as("device.connect_info", json!({ "device": "Tilt" }))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let _kill = Kill(info.clone());
    let panel = panel(&info);
    shell(&info, "settings put system accelerometer_rotation 1");

    // The player's input path: one long-lived streamInputEvent.
    let mut ctl = connect(&info).await.unwrap();
    let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel::<pb::InputEvent>();
    let mut input = ctl.clone();
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        let _ = input
            .stream_input_event(UnboundedReceiverStream::new(rx))
            .await;
    });

    for q in [1u32, 2, 3, 0] {
        ctl.set_physical_model(pb::PhysicalModelValue {
            target: pb::physical_model_value::PhysicalType::Rotation as i32,
            value: Some(pb::ParameterValue {
                data: vec![0.0, 0.0, (90 * q) as f32],
            }),
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .await
        .unwrap();
        eventually(&format!("display rotation {q}"), || {
            shell(&info, "dumpsys input")
                .lines()
                .any(|l| {
                    l.contains("displayId=0,")
                        && l.contains(&format!("orientation={q},"))
                        && l.contains("isActive=[1]")
                })
                .then_some(())
        })
        .await;
        let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(30);
        let (w, h, quarter) = loop {
            let f = frame(&mut ctl).await;
            if f.2 == q || Instant::now() > deadline {
                break f;
            }
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
        };
        assert_eq!(quarter, q, "frame rotation");
        let shown = oriented(panel, (w, h));
        // A human tap: Settings' "Connected devices" row (on screen in every
        // orientation), found by its bounds and touched at its centre
        // through the player's mapping, must open that page.
        shell(
            &info,
            "am start -W -f 0x10008000 -a android.settings.SETTINGS",
        );
        let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(60);
        let row = loop {
            let last = ui_dump(&info);
            // Laid out for this rotation, and not already on that page.
            let found = bounds_of(&last, "Connected devices").filter(|b| {
                b.2 <= shown.width as f32
                    && b.3 <= shown.height as f32
                    && !last.contains("text=\"Pair new device\"")
            });
            if let Some(b) = found {
                break b;
            }
            assert!(
                Instant::now() < deadline,
                "no Connected devices row in Settings turned {q} quarter turns ({}×{}); on screen: {:?}",
                shown.width,
                shown.height,
                texts(&last)
            );
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(300)).await;
        };
        let n = (
            (row.0 + row.2) / 2.0 / shown.width as f32,
            (row.1 + row.3) / 2.0 / shown.height as f32,
        );
        let pts = panel_touches(Gesture::Single, panel, shown, quarter, n);
        tx.send(touch_event(&pts, true)).unwrap();
        tx.send(touch_event(&pts, false)).unwrap();
        eventually(
            &format!(
                "the Connected devices page after a tap at {n:?} of a {}×{} screen turned {q} quarter turns (panel {pts:?})",
                shown.width, shown.height
            ),
            || ui_dump(&info).contains("text=\"Pair new device\"").then_some(()),
        )
        .await;
    }

    let _ = client
        .call("device.stop", json!({ "device": "Tilt" }))
        .await;
    let _ = stop.send(());
    let _ = serve.await;
}
```

```slint
    /// Meta shortcuts, shared by the window and the device screen.
    function meta-key(text: string, alt: bool, shift: bool) -> bool {
        if (alt && (text == "i" || text == "I")) { root.shortcut("overlay"); return true; }
        if (alt && text == "0") { root.shortcut("pixel-perfect"); return true; }
        if (shift && (text == "s" || text == "S")) { root.shortcut("screenshot"); return true; }
        if (alt || shift) { return false; }
        if (text == "l") { root.shortcut("logcat"); return true; }
        if (text == "j") { root.shortcut("panel"); return true; }
        if (text == "k") { root.open-palette(); return true; }
        if (text == "n") { root.new-device(); return true; }
        if (text == ",") { root.open-settings(); return true; }
        if (text == "w") { root.shortcut("close-tab"); return true; }
        if (text >= "1" && text <= "9") { root.shortcut("tab-" + text); return true; }
        if (text == "0") { root.shortcut("library"); return true; }
        return false;
    }

    keys := FocusScope {
        key-pressed(ev) => {
            if (ev.modifiers.meta && root.meta-key(ev.text, ev.modifiers.alt, ev.modifiers.shift)) {
                return accept;
            }
            if (ev.text == Key.Escape) {
                root.sheet-open = false;
                root.palette-open = false;
                root.confirm-open = false;
                root.save-open = false;
                root.refuse-open = false;
                RootUi.open = false;
                return accept;
            }
            if (ev.text == Key.Return && root.active-tab < 0 && root.selected >= 0) {
                root.open-device(root.selected);
                return accept;
            }
            return reject;
        }
    }

                log-filter-changed(t) => { root.log-filter-changed(t); }

                    }

            if library && root.snapshots-open && root.selected >= 0: SnapshotsPage {

                manage-snapshots => { root.manage-snapshots(root.selected); }
                restore-snapshot(i) => { root.restore-snapshot(root.selected, i); }
            }
        }
    }
    if root.sheet-open: DeviceSheet {
        y: titlebar.height;
        height: root.height - titlebar.height;
        form: root.form;
        profiles: root.profiles;
        images: root.images;
        device-name: root.form.name;
        host-ram: root.host-ram;
        host-cpus: root.host-cpus;
        submit(f) => { root.submit-form(f); }

        }
    }
    if RootUi.open: RootLayer {
        y: titlebar.height;
        height: root.height - titlebar.height;
    }
    if root.toast != "": Toast {
        y: root.height - 64px;
        text: root.toast;
    }
}
```

```slint
// Base components of the Workbench design system
// (docs/design/system/README.md, docs/design/system/components/*).

import { Theme, Easing } from "../theme.slint";
import { Icons } from "../icons.slint";

/// Type roles from the design tokens (`type-*`).
export enum Role { hero, display, headline, title, body, label, caption, code, metric, metric-lg }

/// Status colour pairs (system README › Status).
export enum Tone { neutral, positive, transition, warning, negative, root-soft, root-strong, accent }

/// Text in one of the type roles. Aligns to the start edge (right in RTL).
export component T inherits Text {
    in property <Role> role: Role.body;
    in property <bool> mono: role == Role.code || role == Role.metric || role == Role.metric-lg;
    /// Code, serials and logcat never mirror.
    in property <bool> ltr: false;
    font-family: mono ? Theme.font-mono : Theme.font-ui;
    font-size: role == Role.hero ? Theme.type-hero-size
        : role == Role.display ? Theme.type-display-size
        : role == Role.headline ? Theme.type-headline-size
        : role == Role.title ? Theme.type-title-size
        : role == Role.label ? Theme.type-label-size
        : role == Role.caption ? Theme.type-caption-size
        : role == Role.code ? Theme.type-code-size
        : role == Role.metric ? Theme.type-metric-size
        : role == Role.metric-lg ? Theme.type-metric-lg-size
        : Theme.type-body-size;
    font-weight: role == Role.hero ? Theme.type-hero-weight
        : role == Role.display ? Theme.type-display-weight
        : role == Role.headline ? Theme.type-headline-weight
        : role == Role.title ? Theme.type-title-weight
        : role == Role.label ? Theme.type-label-weight
        : role == Role.caption ? Theme.type-caption-weight
        : role == Role.code ? Theme.type-code-weight
        : role == Role.metric ? Theme.type-metric-weight
        : role == Role.metric-lg ? Theme.type-metric-lg-weight
        : Theme.type-body-weight;
    letter-spacing: role == Role.hero ? Theme.type-hero-letter-spacing
        : role == Role.display ? Theme.type-display-letter-spacing
        : role == Role.headline ? Theme.type-headline-letter-spacing
        : role == Role.title ? Theme.type-title-letter-spacing
        : role == Role.caption ? Theme.type-caption-letter-spacing
        : role == Role.metric-lg ? Theme.type-metric-lg-letter-spacing
        : 0px;
    color: Theme.text-primary;
    vertical-alignment: center;
    horizontal-alignment: Theme.rtl && !ltr ? TextHorizontalAlignment.right : TextHorizontalAlignment.left;
    overflow: elide;
}

/// A Lucide icon, tinted.
export component Icon inherits Image {
    in property <length> size: Theme.icon-md;
    /// Arrows, chevrons, back/forward and progress mirror in RTL; everything else never does.
    in property <bool> directional: false;
    width: size;
    height: size;
    colorize: Theme.text-secondary;
    image-fit: contain;
}

/// Pair colours for a tone.
export global Tones {
    public pure function container(t: Tone) -> color {
        return t == Tone.positive ? Theme.status-positive-container
            : t == Tone.transition ? Theme.status-transition-container
            : t == Tone.warning ? Theme.status-warning-container
            : t == Tone.negative ? Theme.status-negative-container
            : t == Tone.root-soft ? Theme.status-root-soft-container
            : t == Tone.root-strong ? Theme.status-root-strong-container
            : t == Tone.accent ? Theme.accent-container
            : Theme.status-neutral-container;
    }
    public pure function on(t: Tone) -> color {
        return t == Tone.positive ? Theme.status-positive-on-container
            : t == Tone.transition ? Theme.status-transition-on-container
            : t == Tone.warning ? Theme.status-warning-on-container
            : t == Tone.negative ? Theme.status-negative-on-container
            : t == Tone.root-soft ? Theme.status-root-soft-on-container
            : t == Tone.root-strong ? Theme.status-root-strong-on-container
            : t == Tone.accent ? Theme.accent-text
            : Theme.status-neutral-on-container;
    }
    public pure function border(t: Tone) -> color {
        return t == Tone.positive ? Theme.status-positive-border
            : t == Tone.transition ? Theme.status-transition-border
            : t == Tone.warning ? Theme.status-warning-border
            : t == Tone.negative ? Theme.status-negative-border
            : t == Tone.root-soft ? Theme.status-root-soft-border
            : t == Tone.root-strong ? Theme.status-root-strong-border
            : t == Tone.accent ? Theme.accent-fill
            : Theme.status-neutral-border;
    }
}

/// Spinner: loader-circle, rotating unless Reduce Motion is on.
export component Spinner inherits Rectangle {
    in property <length> size: Theme.icon-sm;
    in property <color> tint: Theme.text-secondary;
    width: size;
    height: size;
    Image {
        width: parent.width;
        height: parent.height;
        source: Icons.loader-circle;
        colorize: root.tint;
        transform-origin: { x: self.width / 2, y: self.height / 2 };
        transform-rotation: Theme.reduce-motion ? 0deg : (animation-tick() / Theme.motion-spinner-duration) * 360deg;
    }
}

/// Status pill (`.sp`): icon + label in a tone's container.
export component Pill inherits Rectangle {
    in property <Tone> tone: Tone.neutral;
    in property <string> text;
    in property <image> icon;
    in property <bool> has-icon: true;
    in property <bool> spinning: false;
    /// The filled 8 px dot used for Running.
    in property <bool> dot: false;
    in property <bool> small: false;
    /// Status text without a plate (`.st`): sidebar second lines.
    in property <bool> bare: false;
    property <length> pad: bare ? 0px : (small ? 7px : 9px);
    property <length> gap: small ? 5px : 6px;
    property <length> icon-size: dot ? 8px : 12px;
    property <bool> show-icon: has-icon || dot || spinning;
    height: small ? 20px : 22px;
    width: label.preferred-width + 2 * pad + (show-icon ? icon-size + gap : 0px);
    border-radius: self.height / 2;
    background: bare ? transparent : Tones.container(tone);
    property <length> icon-x: Theme.rtl ? self.width - pad - icon-size : pad;
    if dot: Rectangle {
        x: icon-x;
        width: 8px;
        height: 8px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        background: Tones.on(tone);
    }
    if spinning: Spinner {
        x: icon-x;
        size: icon-size;
        tint: Tones.on(tone);
    }
    if has-icon && !dot && !spinning: Icon {
        x: icon-x;
        size: icon-size;
        source: icon;
        colorize: Tones.on(tone);
    }
    label := T {
        x: Theme.rtl ? pad : (show-icon ? pad + icon-size + gap : pad);
        width: self.preferred-width;
        text: root.text;
        role: Role.label;
        font-size: small ? 11px : 12px;
        color: Tones.on(tone);
        horizontal-alignment: left;
    }
}

/// Uppercase square tag (`.tag`), e.g. BETA. Never alone next to a status.
export component Tag inherits Rectangle {
    in property <Tone> tone: Tone.warning;

export enum ButtonKind { secondary, primary, tertiary, destructive }

/// Button (`.btn`): md 30 px or sm 24 px, optional icon and kbd hint.
export component Button inherits Rectangle {
    in property <string> text;
    in property <image> icon;
    in property <bool> has-icon: false;
    in property <ButtonKind> kind: ButtonKind.secondary;
    in property <bool> small: false;
    in property <bool> enabled: true;
    in property <string> kbd;
    /// Icon-only square button.
    in property <bool> icon-only: false;
    callback clicked();
    property <length> pad: small ? 8px : 12px;
    property <length> gap: small ? 6px : 8px;
    property <length> isz: small ? Theme.icon-sm : Theme.icon-md;
    property <color> fg: !enabled ? Theme.text-disabled
        : kind == ButtonKind.primary || kind == ButtonKind.destructive ? Theme.text-on-accent
        : kind == ButtonKind.tertiary ? Theme.text-secondary
        : Theme.text-primary;
    height: small ? Theme.control-height-sm : Theme.control-height-md;
    width: icon-only ? self.height
        : 2 * pad + label.preferred-width + (has-icon ? isz + gap : 0px) + (kbd != "" ? kbdv.width + gap : 0px);
    border-radius: small ? Theme.radius-sm : Theme.radius-md;
    border-width: kind == ButtonKind.tertiary ? 0px : 1px;
    border-color: kind == ButtonKind.primary ? Theme.accent-fill
        : kind == ButtonKind.destructive ? Theme.negative-fill
        : Theme.border-default;
    background: !enabled ? (kind == ButtonKind.tertiary ? transparent : Theme.surface-control)
        : kind == ButtonKind.primary ? (ta.pressed ? Theme.accent-pressed : ta.has-hover ? Theme.accent-hover : Theme.accent-fill)
        : kind == ButtonKind.destructive ? (ta.has-hover ? Theme.negative-fill-hover : Theme.negative-fill)
        : kind == ButtonKind.tertiary ? (ta.pressed ? Theme.surface-control-pressed : ta.has-hover ? Theme.surface-control-hover : transparent)
        : (ta.pressed ? Theme.surface-control-pressed : ta.has-hover ? Theme.surface-control-hover : Theme.surface-control);
    animate background { duration: Theme.motion-hover-duration; }
    // Leading edge = left in LTR, right in RTL.
    property <length> lead: Theme.rtl ? self.width - pad : pad;
    if has-icon: Icon {
        x: icon-only ? (parent.width - self.width) / 2 : (Theme.rtl ? parent.width - pad - isz : pad);
        size: isz;
        source: icon;
        colorize: fg;
    }
    label := T {
        visible: !icon-only;
        x: Theme.rtl ? (kbd != "" ? pad + kbdv.width + gap : pad) : pad + (has-icon ? isz + gap : 0px);
        width: self.preferred-width;
        text: root.text;
        role: Role.label;
        font-size: small ? 12px : 13px;
        color: fg;
        horizontal-alignment: left;
    }
    kbdv := Kbd {
        visible: kbd != "";
        x: Theme.rtl ? pad : parent.width - pad - self.width;
        text: kbd;
        tint: fg;
    }
    ta := TouchArea {
        enabled: root.enabled;
        mouse-cursor: pointer;
        clicked => { root.clicked(); }
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-ui/ui/components/status.slint`:

```slint
// Device status and root badges. Every status has a colour pair, an icon and
// a label; root state never depends on colour alone.

import { Theme } from "../theme.slint";
import { Icons } from "../icons.slint";
import { T, Role, Tone, Tones, Icon, Pill, Tag, Spinner } from "base.slint";
import { DevState, RootKind } from "../types.slint";

export global StatusStyle {
    public pure function tone(s: DevState) -> Tone {
        return s == DevState.running ? Tone.positive
            : s == DevState.starting || s == DevState.booting || s == DevState.stopping ? Tone.transition
            : s == DevState.crashed ? Tone.negative
            : s == DevState.busy ? Tone.warning
            : Tone.neutral;
    }
    public pure function icon(s: DevState) -> image {
        return s == DevState.paused ? Icons.pause
            : s == DevState.crashed ? Icons.triangle-alert
            : s == DevState.busy ? Icons.lock
            : Icons.square;
    }
    public pure function spins(s: DevState) -> bool {
        return s == DevState.starting || s == DevState.booting || s == DevState.stopping;
    }
}

/// Device status pill (plated) or bare status text (sidebar, `.st`).
export component StatusPill inherits Pill {
    in property <DevState> state;
    tone: StatusStyle.tone(state);
    dot: state == DevState.running;
    spinning: StatusStyle.spins(state);
    icon: StatusStyle.icon(state);
}

/// Bare status line: the label in its tone colour (stopped stays secondary).
export component StatusText inherits Pill {
    in property <DevState> state;
    bare: true;
    small: true;
    tone: StatusStyle.tone(state);
    dot: state == DevState.running;
    spinning: StatusStyle.spins(state);
    icon: StatusStyle.icon(state);
}

/// RootBadge: 24 px default, 20 px small. Beta is a tag after the badge.
export component RootBadge inherits Rectangle {
    in property <RootKind> kind;
    in property <string> text;
    in property <bool> small: false;
    in property <bool> beta: false;
    property <Tone> tone: kind == RootKind.verified ? Tone.root-strong
        : kind == RootKind.full || kind == RootKind.setting-up || kind == RootKind.unverified ? Tone.root-soft
        : kind == RootKind.failed ? Tone.negative
        : Tone.neutral;
    property <bool> text-only: kind == RootKind.none;
    property <length> pad: text-only ? 0px : (small ? 7px : 10px);
    property <length> isz: small ? 12px : 14px;
    property <length> gap: small ? 4px : 5px;
    property <length> plate-w: 2 * pad + isz + gap + label.preferred-width;
    height: small ? 20px : 24px;
    width: plate-w + (beta ? 6px + tag.width : 0px);
    plate := Rectangle {
        x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - root.plate-w : 0px;
        width: root.plate-w;
        height: parent.height;
        border-radius: self.height / 2;
        background: text-only ? transparent : Tones.container(tone);
        border-width: text-only ? 0px
            : kind == RootKind.failed ? 2px
            : kind == RootKind.shell ? 1px
            : Theme.border-width-emphasis;
        border-color: kind == RootKind.failed ? Theme.negative
            : kind == RootKind.verified ? Tones.container(tone)
            : Tones.border(tone);
        property <color> fg: text-only ? Theme.text-secondary : Tones.on(tone);
        if kind == RootKind.setting-up: Spinner {
            x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - pad - isz : pad;
            size: isz;
            tint: plate.fg;
        }
        if kind != RootKind.setting-up: Icon {
            x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - pad - isz : pad;
            size: isz;
            colorize: plate.fg;
            source: kind == RootKind.verified ? Icons.badge-check
                : kind == RootKind.shell ? Icons.terminal
                : kind == RootKind.full ? Icons.key-round
                : kind == RootKind.unverified ? Icons.circle-help
                : kind == RootKind.failed ? Icons.circle-x
                : Icons.minus;
        }
        label := T {
            x: Theme.rtl ? pad : pad + isz + gap;
            width: self.preferred-width;
            text: root.text;
            role: Role.label;
            font-size: small ? 11px : 12px;
            color: plate.fg;
            horizontal-alignment: left;
        }
    }
    tag := Tag {
        visible: beta;
        x: Theme.rtl ? 0px : root.plate-w + 6px;
        text: @tr("Beta");
        tone: Tone.warning;
    }
}
```

```slint
// Command palette (⌘K): every action and device, filtered as you type.

import { Theme } from "theme.slint";
import { Icons } from "icons.slint";
import { T, Role, Icon, Kbd } from "components/base.slint";
import { StatusText } from "components/status.slint";
import { PaletteItem, PaletteKind, DevState } from "types.slint";

export component Palette inherits Rectangle {
    in property <[PaletteItem]> items;
    in-out property <string> query;
    in-out property <int> selected: 0;
    callback query-changed(string);
    callback run(PaletteItem);
    callback dismiss();
    background: Theme.scrim;
    TouchArea { clicked => { root.dismiss(); } }
    card := Rectangle {
        x: (parent.width - self.width) / 2;
        y: 72px;
        width: 560px;
        height: 52px + min(8, root.items.length) * 40px + (root.items.length == 0 ? 52px : 8px);
        background: Theme.surface-overlay;
        border-radius: Theme.radius-lg;
        border-width: 1px;
        border-color: Theme.border-default;
        drop-shadow-offset-y: Theme.elevation-2-shadow-y;
        drop-shadow-blur: Theme.elevation-2-shadow-blur;
        drop-shadow-color: Theme.elevation-2-shadow-color;
        clip: true;
        TouchArea {}
        Icon {
            x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - 16px - self.width : 16px;
            y: 18px;
            source: Icons.search;
            colorize: Theme.text-tertiary;
        }
        input := TextInput {
            x: Theme.rtl ? 60px : 44px;
            y: 0px;
            height: 52px;
            width: parent.width - 104px;
            text <=> root.query;
            font-size: 15px;
            color: Theme.text-primary;
            vertical-alignment: center;
            horizontal-alignment: Theme.rtl ? TextHorizontalAlignment.right : TextHorizontalAlignment.left;
            selection-background-color: Theme.selection;
            edited => {
                root.selected = 0;
                root.query-changed(self.text);
            }
            accepted => {
                if (root.selected >= 0 && root.selected < root.items.length) {
                    root.run(root.items[root.selected]);
                }
            }
            key-pressed(ev) => {
                if (ev.text == Key.DownArrow) {
                    root.selected = min(root.selected + 1, root.items.length - 1);
                    return accept;
                }
                if (ev.text == Key.UpArrow) {
                    root.selected = max(root.selected - 1, 0);
                    return accept;
                }
                if (ev.text == Key.Escape) {
                    root.dismiss();
                    return accept;
                }
                return reject;
            }
        }
        if root.query == "": T {
            x: input.x;
            y: 0px;
            height: 52px;
            width: input.width;
            text: @tr("Type a command or a device name");
            font-size: 15px;
            color: Theme.text-tertiary;
        }
        Kbd {
            x: Theme.rtl ? 16px : parent.width - 16px - self.width;
            y: 17px;
            text: "esc";
        }
        Rectangle {
            y: 52px;
            height: 1px;
            background: Theme.border-subtle;
        }
        for item[i] in root.items: Rectangle {
            visible: i < 8;
            x: 4px;
            y: 56px + i * 40px;
            width: parent.width - 8px;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: Theme.radius-md;
            background: i == root.selected ? Theme.surface-selected : ita.has-hover ? Theme.surface-control-hover.with-alpha(0.5) : transparent;
            Icon {
                x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - 12px - self.width : 12px;
                source: item.kind == PaletteKind.device ? Icons.smartphone : item.kind == PaletteKind.setting ? Icons.sliders-horizontal : Icons.command;
            }
            T {
                x: Theme.rtl ? 12px + kb.width + 8px : 40px;
                y: item.subtitle != "" ? 4px : 0px;
                height: item.subtitle != "" ? 18px : parent.height;
                width: parent.width - 60px - kb.width;
                text: item.title;
            }
            if item.subtitle != "" && item.kind != PaletteKind.device: T {
                x: Theme.rtl ? 12px + kb.width + 8px : 40px;
                y: 21px;
                height: 15px;
                width: parent.width - 60px - kb.width;
                text: item.subtitle;
                role: Role.caption;
                color: Theme.text-secondary;
            }
            if item.kind == PaletteKind.device: StatusText {
                x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - 40px - self.width : 40px;
                y: 21px;
                height: 15px;
                state: item.state;
                text: item.subtitle;
            }
            kb := Kbd {
                visible: item.kbd != "";
                x: Theme.rtl ? 12px : parent.width - 12px - self.width;
                text: item.kbd;
            }
            ita := TouchArea {
                mouse-cursor: pointer;
                clicked => { root.run(item); }
            }
        }
        if root.items.length == 0: T {
            y: 60px;
            height: 40px;
            x: 16px;
            width: parent.width - 32px;
            text: @tr("Nothing matches “{}”.", root.query);
            color: Theme.text-secondary;
        }
    }
    init => { input.focus(); }
}
```

```slint
/// Logcat panel (`.lcd`): level filter, text filter, rows, footer.
component Logcat inherits Rectangle {
    in property <[LogLine]> lines;

            }

        for l[i] in root.lines: Rectangle {

            T { x: 146px; width: 44px; text: l.pid; role: Role.code; color: Theme.logcat-meta; ltr: true; horizontal-alignment: right; }
            T { x: 198px; width: 20px; text: l.level; role: Role.code; font-weight: 600; color: lc; ltr: true; horizontal-alignment: center; }
            T { x: 226px; width: 150px; text: l.tag; role: Role.code; color: Theme.logcat-tag; ltr: true; }
            T { x: 384px; width: parent.width - 394px; text: l.msg; role: Role.code; color: l.level == "E" || l.level == "F" ? lc : Theme.text-primary; font-weight: l.level == "F" ? 600 : 400; ltr: true; }
        }

    Rectangle {

export component DeviceView inherits Rectangle {
    in property <DeviceVm> device;
    in property <image> frame;
    in property <bool> has-frame;
    /// Frame size in device pixels, in the current orientation.
    in property <int> frame-w: device.width-px;
    in property <int> frame-h: device.height-px;
    in property <bool> mock-screen: false;
    in-out property <bool> pixel-perfect: false;
    in property <float> scale: 1.0;
    in property <bool> recording;
    in property <string> record-text;
    in-out property <bool> panel-open: true;
    in property <bool> clipboard-shared;
    in property <bool> overlay;
    in property <string> overlay-text;
    in property <bool> drop-hover;
    in property <string> drop-title;
    in property <string> drop-body;
    in-out property <bool> logcat-open: false;
    in property <[LogLine]> log-lines;
    in property <string> log-summary;
    in property <int> log-errors;
    in property <string> log-last-error;
    in-out property <int> log-level: 1;
    in-out property <string> log-filter;
    in property <bool> log-following: true;

    callback pointer(int, float, float, bool, bool);
    callback wheel(length, length);
    callback key(string, bool);
    callback tool(string);
    callback start();
    /// The screen's size in logical px changed (re-request frames).
    callback screen-resized(length, length);
    callback log-level-changed(int);
    callback log-filter-changed(string);
    callback log-clear();
    callback log-toggle-follow();
    callback log-open(bool);
    callback meta-key(string, bool, bool);

    background: Theme.surface-base;
    property <bool> running: device.state == DevState.running || device.state == DevState.busy;
    property <length> tool-w: Theme.window-device-toolbar-width;
    property <length> panel-w: root.panel-open ? Theme.window-device-widget-panel-width : 0px;
    property <length> stage-w: root.width - tool-w - panel-w;
    property <length> log-h: root.logcat-open ? 232px : 34px;

    // Stage column (`.dv-stagecol`): stage + logcat.
    stagecol := Rectangle {
        x: Theme.rtl ? tool-w + panel-w : 0px;
        width: stage-w;
        height: parent.height;
        stage := Rectangle {
            y: 0px;
            height: parent.height - log-h;
            background: Theme.surface-sunken;
            clip: true;
            property <length> pad: Theme.frame-stage-padding;
            property <length> bez: device.form == FormFactor.tablet ? Theme.frame-tablet-bezel : device.form == FormFactor.small-phone ? Theme.frame-small-phone-bezel : Theme.frame-phone-bezel;
            property <length> rad: device.form == FormFactor.tablet ? Theme.frame-tablet-radius : device.form == FormFactor.small-phone ? Theme.frame-small-phone-radius : Theme.frame-phone-radius;
            property <length> srad: device.form == FormFactor.tablet ? Theme.frame-tablet-screen-radius : device.form == FormFactor.small-phone ? Theme.frame-small-phone-screen-radius : Theme.frame-phone-screen-radius;
            property <float> aspect: root.frame-w > 0 && root.frame-h > 0 ? root.frame-w / root.frame-h : 0.45;
            // Fit: largest screen that fits, aspect kept.
            property <length> fit-h: max(40px, min(self.height - 2 * pad - 2 * bez, (self.width - 2 * pad - 2 * bez) / aspect));
            property <length> screen-h: root.pixel-perfect ? root.frame-h * 1px / root.scale : fit-h;
            property <length> screen-w: screen-h * aspect;
            changed screen-w => { root.screen-resized(self.screen-w, self.screen-h); }
            changed screen-h => { root.screen-resized(self.screen-w, self.screen-h); }
            init => { root.screen-resized(self.screen-w, self.screen-h); }

            flick := Flickable {
                content-width: max(self.width, stage.screen-w + 2 * stage.bez + 2 * stage.pad);
                content-height: max(self.height, stage.screen-h + 2 * stage.bez + 2 * stage.pad);
                interactive: root.pixel-perfect;
                bezel := Rectangle {
                    x: (flick.content-width - self.width) / 2;
                    y: root.pixel-perfect ? stage.pad : (flick.content-height - self.height) / 2;
                    width: stage.screen-w + 2 * stage.bez;
                    height: stage.screen-h + 2 * stage.bez;
                    border-radius: stage.rad;
                    background: Theme.surface-device-bezel;
                    border-width: 1px;
                    border-color: #ffffff14;
                    screen := Rectangle {
                        x: stage.bez;
                        y: stage.bez;
                        width: stage.screen-w;
                        height: stage.screen-h;
                        border-radius: stage.srad;
                        clip: true;
                        background: #000000;
                        if root.has-frame: Image {
                            width: parent.width;
                            height: parent.height;
                            source: root.frame;
                            image-fit: fill;
                            image-rendering: smooth;
                        }
                        if root.mock-screen && !root.has-frame: MockScreen {}
                        if !root.has-frame && !root.mock-screen: VerticalLayout {
                            alignment: center;
                            spacing: 10px;
                            HorizontalLayout {
                                alignment: center;
                                StatusPill {
                                    state: device.state;
                                    text: device.status;
                                }
                            }
                            if device.state == DevState.stopped || device.state == DevState.crashed: HorizontalLayout {
                                alignment: center;
                                Button {
                                    kind: ButtonKind.primary;
                                    has-icon: true;
                                    icon: Icons.play;
                                    text: @tr("Start");
                                    clicked => { root.start(); }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        touch := TouchArea {
                            enabled: root.running;
                            mouse-cursor: MouseCursor.default;
                            pointer-event(ev) => {
                                if (ev.button != PointerEventButton.left && ev.button != PointerEventButton.other) { return; }
                                if (ev.kind == PointerEventKind.down) {
                                    keys.focus();
                                    root.pointer(0, self.mouse-x / self.width, self.mouse-y / self.height, ev.modifiers.alt, ev.modifiers.shift);
                                } else if (ev.kind == PointerEventKind.up || ev.kind == PointerEventKind.cancel) {
                                    root.pointer(2, self.mouse-x / self.width, self.mouse-y / self.height, ev.modifiers.alt, ev.modifiers.shift);
                                }
                            }
                            moved => {
                                if (self.pressed) {
                                    root.pointer(1, self.mouse-x / self.width, self.mouse-y / self.height, false, false);
                                }
                            }
                            scroll-event(ev) => {
                                root.wheel(ev.delta-x, ev.delta-y);
                                return accept;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            keys := FocusScope {
                width: 0px;
                height: 0px;
                key-pressed(ev) => {
                    if (ev.modifiers.meta) {
                        root.meta-key(ev.text, ev.modifiers.alt, ev.modifiers.shift);
                        return accept;
                    }
                    root.key(ev.text, true);
                    return accept;
                }
                key-released(ev) => {
                    if (ev.modifiers.meta) { return reject; }
                    root.key(ev.text, false);
                    return accept;
                }
            }
            // Pixel-perfect chip (`.pp-chip`).
            if root.pixel-perfect: Rectangle {
                x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - 12px - self.width : 12px;
                y: 12px;
                height: 32px;
                width: ppl.preferred-width + 140px;
                border-radius: 16px;
                background: Theme.elevation-2-surface;
                border-width: 1px;
                border-color: Theme.border-default;
                ppl := T {
                    x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - 12px - self.width : 12px;
                    width: self.preferred-width;
                    text: @tr("Pixel-perfect · 1 device pixel = 1 screen pixel");
                    font-size: 12px;
                }
                T {
                    x: Theme.rtl ? 64px : ppl.x + ppl.width + 8px;
                    width: self.preferred-width;
                    text: root.frame-w + "×" + root.frame-h;
                    role: Role.code;
                    color: Theme.text-secondary;
                }
                Button {
                    x: Theme.rtl ? 6px : parent.width - 6px - self.width;
                    small: true;
                    text: @tr("Fit");
                    clicked => { root.pixel-perfect = false; }
                }
            }
            // APK drop target (`.dropring`, `.droplabel`).
            if root.drop-hover: Rectangle {
                x: 12px;
                y: 12px;
                width: parent.width - 24px;
                height: parent.height - 24px;
                border-radius: 16px;
                border-width: 2px;
                border-color: Theme.accent-fill;
                background: Theme.accent-container.with-alpha(0.6);
            }
            if root.drop-hover: Rectangle {
                x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - 28px - self.width : 28px;
                y: (parent.height - self.height) / 2;
                width: 290px;
                height: 78px;
                border-radius: Theme.radius-lg;
                background: Theme.elevation-3-surface;
                border-width: 1px;
                border-color: Theme.accent-fill;
                drop-shadow-offset-y: Theme.elevation-3-shadow-y;
                drop-shadow-blur: Theme.elevation-3-shadow-blur;
                drop-shadow-color: Theme.elevation-3-shadow-color;
                T {

                tone: Tone.negative;
                dot: true;
                text: root.record-text;
            }
            // Debug overlay (⌥⌘I): fps and latency, never over the screen centre.

                y: parent.height - 8px - self.height;

                height: ovt.preferred-height + 10px;
```

`crates/jidr-ui/ui/shell.slint`:

```slint
// The Workbench window shell: title bar with tabs, sidebar, content area.
// Regions swap sides in RTL (system README › RTL).

import { Theme } from "theme.slint";
import { Icons } from "icons.slint";
import { T, Role, Tone, Tones, Icon, IconButton, Button, ButtonKind, Kbd, Bar, SectionHeader, TrafficLights, Pill } from "components/base.slint";
import { StatusText, StatusStyle, RootBadge } from "components/status.slint";
import { DeviceVm, JobVm, TabVm, DevState, RootKind, JobTone, ConnState, FormFactor } from "types.slint";

/// One title-bar tab (`.tab`).
export component TabItem inherits Rectangle {
    in property <string> text;
    in property <bool> active;
    in property <bool> library: false;
    in property <DevState> state;
    in property <string> kbd;
    in property <bool> closable: false;
    callback clicked();
    callback close();
    property <length> lead: library ? Theme.icon-sm + 7px : 15px;
    height: active ? 33px : 32px;
    width: 24px + lead + t.preferred-width + (kbd != "" ? k.width + 7px : 0px) + (closable ? 21px : 0px);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: active ? Theme.surface-base : (ta.has-hover ? Theme.surface-control-hover.with-alpha(0.5) : transparent);
    border-width: active ? 1px : 0px;
    border-color: Theme.border-default;
    // Square off the bottom edge so the active tab joins the content.
    Rectangle {
        visible: active;
        y: parent.height - 9px;
        x: 1px;
        width: parent.width - 2px;
        height: 9px;
        background: Theme.surface-base;
    }
    property <length> start: Theme.rtl ? self.width - 12px : 12px;
    if library: Icon {
        x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - 12px - self.width : 12px;
        size: Theme.icon-sm;
        source: Icons.layout-grid;
        colorize: active ? Theme.text-primary : Theme.text-secondary;
    }
    if !library && StatusStyle.spins(state): Pill {
        x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - 12px - self.width : 12px;
        bare: true;
        small: true;
        spinning: true;
        tone: Tone.transition;
        text: "";
    }
    if !library && !StatusStyle.spins(state): Rectangle {
        x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - 12px - 8px : 12px;
        width: 8px;
        height: 8px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        background: Tones.on(StatusStyle.tone(state));
    }
    t := T {
        x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - 12px - lead - self.width : 12px + lead;
        width: self.preferred-width;
        text: root.text;
        role: Role.label;
        color: active ? Theme.text-primary : Theme.text-secondary;
    }
    k := Kbd {
        visible: kbd != "";
        x: Theme.rtl ? t.x - 7px - self.width : t.x + t.width + 7px;
        text: kbd;
    }
    ta := TouchArea {
        mouse-cursor: pointer;
        clicked => { root.clicked(); }
    }
    if closable: IconButton {
        x: Theme.rtl ? 6px : parent.width - 6px - self.width;
        size: 18px;
        icon-size: 12px;
        icon: Icons.x;
        clicked => { root.close(); }
    }
}

/// The 44 px title bar: traffic lights, Library tab, one tab per open device, tools.
export component TitleBar inherits Rectangle {
    in property <[TabVm]> tabs;
    /// -1 = Library.
    in property <int> active-tab: -1;
    in property <bool> draw-lights: true;
    in property <ConnState> conn: ConnState.online;
    in property <string> conn-text;
    callback select-tab(int);
    callback close-tab(int);
    callback toggle-sidebar();
    callback drag-window();
    height: Theme.window-titlebar-height;
    background: Theme.surface-chrome;
    TouchArea {
        pointer-event(ev) => {
            if (ev.kind == PointerEventKind.down && ev.button == PointerEventButton.left) {
                root.drag-window();
            }
        }
    }
    lights := TrafficLights {
        drawn: root.draw-lights;
        x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - 14px - self.width : 14px;
        y: (parent.height - self.height) / 2;
    }
    // Tabs sit on the bottom edge.
    tabrow := HorizontalLayout {
        x: Theme.rtl ? tools.x + tools.width + 10px : lights.x + lights.width + 20px;
        width: parent.width - lights.width - 34px - 20px - tools.width;
        y: parent.height - 33px;
        height: 33px;
        spacing: 4px;
        alignment: Theme.rtl ? LayoutAlignment.end : LayoutAlignment.start;
        for slot[j] in root.tabs.length + 1: TabItem {
            property <int> i: Theme.rtl ? root.tabs.length - j : j;
            y: self.active ? 0px : 1px;
            library: i == 0;
            text: i == 0 ? @tr("Library") : root.tabs[i - 1].name;
            state: i == 0 ? DevState.stopped : root.tabs[i - 1].state;
            active: root.active-tab == i - 1;
            kbd: i > 0 && i < 10 && root.active-tab != i - 1 ? "⌘" + i : "";
            closable: i > 0 && root.active-tab == i - 1;
            clicked => { root.select-tab(i - 1); }
            close => { root.close-tab(i - 1); }
        }
    }
    tools := HorizontalLayout {
        x: Theme.rtl ? 10px : parent.width - 10px - self.width;
        width: self.preferred-width;
        y: (parent.height - 32px) / 2;
        height: 32px;
        spacing: 6px;
        alignment: end;
        if root.conn != ConnState.online: Pill {
            y: 5px;
            small: true;
            tone: root.conn == ConnState.offline ? Tone.negative : Tone.transition;
            spinning: root.conn != ConnState.offline;
            icon: Icons.plug;
            text: root.conn-text;
        }
        @children
        IconButton {
            icon: Icons.panel-left;
            icon-size: Theme.icon-md;
            clicked => { root.toggle-sidebar(); }
        }
    }
    Rectangle {
        y: parent.height - 1px;
        height: 1px;
        background: Theme.border-default;
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-ui/ui/types.slint`:

```slint
// View models shared by Rust and Slint. Labels are computed in Rust
// (crates/jidr-ui/src/model.rs) so the UI holds no business logic.

/// Device status as the user sees it (PRODUCT.md §5).
export enum DevState { stopped, starting, booting, running, paused, stopping, crashed, busy }

/// Root badge state (RootBadge spec).
export enum RootKind { none, shell, full, setting-up, verified, unverified, failed }

export enum FormFactor { phone, small-phone, tablet }

export enum JobTone { queued, running, done, failed, cancelled }

export struct DeviceVm {
    id: string,
    name: string,
    /// "Phone 6.1″ FHD+"
    profile: string,
    /// "1080×2400 · 420 dpi"
    screen: string,
    /// "Android 15 · API 35"
    android: string,
    /// "Google APIs"
    image: string,
    state: DevState,
    /// "Running · 2 h 14 m", "Booting Android… 62%", "Busy · in use by CLI"
    status: string,
    /// Boot progress 0..1 while booting.
    progress: float,
    root: RootKind,
    /// "Rooted · Magisk 30.7", "Shell root (adb)", "Full root"
    root-label: string,
    /// Sidebar form: "Rooted", "Shell", "Full", "No root"
    root-short: string,
    /// Play Store image with Full root.
    beta: bool,
    /// "Full root", "Shell root", "Not rooted" (health panel mode line).
    root-mode: string,
    magisk: string,
    /// "2 min ago · su -c id → uid=0"
    verified: string,
    serial: string,
    disk: string,
    ram: string,
    cpus: string,
    uptime: string,
    last-started: string,
    form: FormFactor,
    width-px: int,
    height-px: int,
    play-store: bool,
}

export struct JobVm {
    id: string,
    /// "Android 16 (API 36) image"
    title: string,
    tone: JobTone,
    progress: float,
    indeterminate: bool,
    /// "1.4 / 2.1 GB"
    detail: string,
    /// "2 min left"
    eta: string,
    cancellable: bool,
}

export struct TabVm {
    id: string,
    name: string,
    state: DevState,
}

export struct SnapshotVm {
    name: string,
    /// "Taken with: Full root"
    tag: string,
    root: RootKind,
    auto: bool,
    size: string,
```

```slint
// Widget panels for the docked panel (the device design): Battery, Network,
// Sensors and ⋯ (phone, controls, dev tools, clipboard, biometrics, camera).
// Every control calls a protocol command through Rust (`widget-action`).

import { Theme } from "../theme.slint";
import { Icons } from "../icons.slint";
import { T, Role, Tone, Icon, Button, ButtonKind, Pill, Toggle, Segmented, TextField, Hint, Scroll, Checkbox } from "../components/base.slint";
import { WidgetsVm } from "../types.slint";
import { RootDevTools } from "../../src/root/root.slint";

/// Slider (`.slider`) 0–100 with a linked value field.
export component Slider inherits Rectangle {
    in-out property <float> value;
    in property <float> maximum: 100;
    callback released(float);
    height: 30px;
    property <length> track-w: self.width - 88px;
    track := Rectangle {
        x: Theme.rtl ? 88px : 0px;
        width: track-w;
        height: 4px;
        border-radius: 2px;
        background: Theme.surface-sunken;
        Rectangle {
            x: Theme.rtl ? parent.width - self.width : 0px;
            width: parent.width * clamp(root.value / root.maximum, 0, 1);
            border-radius: 2px;
            background: Theme.accent-fill;
        }
        Rectangle {
            property <length> pos: parent.width * clamp(root.value / root.maximum, 0, 1);
            x: (Theme.rtl ? parent.width - pos : pos) - 8px;
            width: 16px;
            height: 16px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: Theme.text-on-accent;
            border-width: 1px;
            border-color: Theme.border-strong;
            drop-shadow-blur: 2px;
            drop-shadow-color: #00000040;
        }
        TouchArea {
            y: -10px;
            height: 24px;
            moved => {
                if (self.pressed) {
                    let f = clamp((Theme.rtl ? parent.width - self.mouse-x : self.mouse-x) / parent.width, 0, 1);
                    root.value = round(f * root.maximum);
                }
            }
            pointer-event(ev) => {
                if (ev.kind == PointerEventKind.down) {
                    let f = clamp((Theme.rtl ? parent.width - self.mouse-x : self.mouse-x) / parent.width, 0, 1);
                    root.value = round(f * root.maximum);
                }
                if (ev.kind == PointerEventKind.up) {
                    root.released(root.value);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    TextField {
        x: Theme.rtl ? 0px : parent.width - 76px;
        width: 76px;
        text: round(root.value);
        unit: "%";
        mono: true;
        accepted(t) => {
            root.value = clamp(t.to-float(), 0, root.maximum);
            root.released(root.value);
        }
    }
}

}
```
