`crates/jidr-widgets/examples/dev-daemon.rs`:

```rs
//! A real daemon with the widgets provider registered, for running the GUI
//! and the widgets by hand until `jidr daemon` lands (gap B1). Not shipped.
//!
//! ```text
//! cargo build -p jidr-widgets --example dev-daemon
//! JIDR_DAEMON_BIN=target/debug/examples/dev-daemon cargo run -p jidr-gui
//! ```
//! The GUI starts it as `<bin> daemon`; the argument is accepted and ignored.
//! Android Studio's SDK (`JIDR_TEST_SDK`, default `~/Library/Android/sdk`)
//! is used read-only (D3).

use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;

use jidr_backend::AospBackend;
use jidr_core::JidrPaths;
use jidr_daemon::{Daemon, DaemonConfig};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    tracing_subscriber::fmt()
        .with_env_filter(
            tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::try_from_default_env()
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::new("info")),
        )
        .init();
    let paths = JidrPaths::discover()?;
    let studio = std::env::var_os("JIDR_TEST_SDK")
        .map(PathBuf::from)
        .or_else(|| dirs::home_dir().map(|h| h.join("Library/Android/sdk")))
        .filter(|p| p.is_dir());
    let daemon = Daemon::builder(
        DaemonConfig {
            paths,
            studio_sdk: studio,
            idle_timeout: Some(Duration::from_secs(600)),
            sdk_repo: None,
        },
        Arc::new(AospBackend::new()),
    )
    .provider(jidr_widgets::provider())
    .build()?;
    daemon
        .serve(async {
            let _ = tokio::signal::ctrl_c().await;
        })
        .await?;
    Ok(())
}

`crates/jidr-widgets/src/apk.rs`:

```rs
//! Reads the package name from an APK's binary `AndroidManifest.xml`
//! (Android's documented binary XML chunk format: a string pool, then
//! start-element chunks with typed attributes). No tools from the SDK.

use std::io::Read;
use std::path::Path;

use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};

const RES_STRING_POOL: u16 = 0x0001;
const RES_XML: u16 = 0x0003;
const RES_XML_START_ELEMENT: u16 = 0x0102;
const UTF8_FLAG: u32 = 0x100;
/// `Res_value::TYPE_STRING`.
const TYPE_STRING: u8 = 0x03;

fn u16_at(b: &[u8], i: usize) -> Option<u16> {
    b.get(i..i + 2).map(|s| u16::from_le_bytes([s[0], s[1]]))
}

fn u32_at(b: &[u8], i: usize) -> Option<u32> {
    b.get(i..i + 4)
        .map(|s| u32::from_le_bytes([s[0], s[1], s[2], s[3]]))
}

fn bad(what: &str) -> JidrError {
    JidrError::usage(format!("not a valid APK manifest: {what}"))
}

/// The string pool's strings.
fn strings(b: &[u8], at: usize) -> JidrResult<Vec<String>> {
    let header = u16_at(b, at + 2).ok_or_else(|| bad("string pool header"))? as usize;
    let count = u32_at(b, at + 8).ok_or_else(|| bad("string count"))? as usize;
    let flags = u32_at(b, at + 16).ok_or_else(|| bad("string flags"))?;
    let start = u32_at(b, at + 20).ok_or_else(|| bad("strings start"))? as usize;
    let utf8 = flags & UTF8_FLAG != 0;
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(count.min(4096));
    for i in 0..count {
        let off = u32_at(b, at + header + i * 4).ok_or_else(|| bad("string offset"))? as usize;
        let p = at + start + off;
        let s = if utf8 {
            // u8/u16 char count, then u8/u16 byte count, then bytes.
            let mut p = p;
            let skip_len = |p: &mut usize| -> Option<usize> {
                let first = *b.get(*p)? as usize;
                if first & 0x80 != 0 {
                    let second = *b.get(*p + 1)? as usize;
                    *p += 2;
                    Some(((first & 0x7f) << 8) | second)
                } else {
                    *p += 1;
                    Some(first)
                }
            };
            skip_len(&mut p).ok_or_else(|| bad("utf8 length"))?;
            let n = skip_len(&mut p).ok_or_else(|| bad("utf8 length"))?;
            String::from_utf8_lossy(b.get(p..p + n).ok_or_else(|| bad("utf8 string"))?).into_owned()
        } else {
            let mut n = u16_at(b, p).ok_or_else(|| bad("utf16 length"))? as usize;
            let mut p = p + 2;
            if n & 0x8000 != 0 {
                let low = u16_at(b, p).ok_or_else(|| bad("utf16 length"))? as usize;
                n = ((n & 0x7fff) << 16) | low;
                p += 2;
            }
            let units: Vec<u16> = (0..n)
                .map(|k| u16_at(b, p + k * 2).ok_or_else(|| bad("utf16 string")))
                .collect::<JidrResult<_>>()?;
            String::from_utf16_lossy(&units)
        };
        out.push(s);
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// The `package` attribute of `<manifest>` in a binary manifest.
pub fn manifest_package(b: &[u8]) -> JidrResult<String> {
    if u16_at(b, 0) != Some(RES_XML) {
        return Err(bad("missing XML header"));
    }
    let mut at = u16_at(b, 2).ok_or_else(|| bad("header size"))? as usize;
    let mut pool: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    while at + 8 <= b.len() {
        let kind = u16_at(b, at).ok_or_else(|| bad("chunk type"))?;
        let size = u32_at(b, at + 4).ok_or_else(|| bad("chunk size"))? as usize;
        if size < 8 {
            return Err(bad("chunk size"));
        }
        match kind {
            RES_STRING_POOL => pool = strings(b, at)?,
            RES_XML_START_ELEMENT => {
                let header = u16_at(b, at + 2).ok_or_else(|| bad("element header"))? as usize;
                let name = u32_at(b, at + 20).ok_or_else(|| bad("element name"))? as usize;
                if pool.get(name).map(String::as_str) == Some("manifest") {
                    let attr_start = u16_at(b, at + 24).ok_or_else(|| bad("attributes"))? as usize;
                    let attr_size = u16_at(b, at + 26).ok_or_else(|| bad("attributes"))? as usize;
                    let count = u16_at(b, at + 28).ok_or_else(|| bad("attributes"))? as usize;
                    let base = at + header.min(16) + attr_start;
                    for k in 0..count {
                        let a = base + k * attr_size.max(20);
                        let aname = u32_at(b, a + 4).ok_or_else(|| bad("attribute"))? as usize;
                        if pool.get(aname).map(String::as_str) != Some("package") {
                            continue;
                        }
                        let raw = u32_at(b, a + 8).ok_or_else(|| bad("attribute"))?;
                        let dtype = *b.get(a + 15).ok_or_else(|| bad("attribute"))?;
                        let data = u32_at(b, a + 16).ok_or_else(|| bad("attribute"))?;
                        let idx = if raw != u32::MAX {
                            raw
                        } else if dtype == TYPE_STRING {
                            data
                        } else {
                            return Err(bad("package isn't a string"));
                        };
                        return pool
                            .get(idx as usize)
                            .cloned()
                            .ok_or_else(|| bad("package string"));
                    }
                    return Err(bad("<manifest> has no package"));
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        at += size;
    }
    Err(bad("no <manifest> element"))
}

/// Package name of an APK file.
pub fn package_name(apk: &Path) -> JidrResult<String> {
    let file = std::fs::File::open(apk)
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::usage(format!("cannot open {}: {e}", apk.display())))?;
    let mut zip = zip::ZipArchive::new(file)
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::usage(format!("{} isn't an APK: {e}", apk.display())))?;
    let mut entry = zip
        .by_name("AndroidManifest.xml")
        .map_err(|_| JidrError::usage(format!("{} has no AndroidManifest.xml", apk.display())))?;
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    entry
        .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::usage(format!("reading the manifest: {e}")))?;
    manifest_package(&bytes)
}

#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// Builds a minimal binary manifest: `<manifest package="…">`.
    pub(crate) fn tiny_manifest(package: &str, utf8: bool) -> Vec<u8> {
        let strs = ["manifest", "package", package];
        // String pool.
        let mut data = Vec::new();
        let mut offsets = Vec::new();
        for s in strs {
            offsets.push(data.len() as u32);
            if utf8 {
                data.push(s.chars().count() as u8);
                data.push(s.len() as u8);
                data.extend_from_slice(s.as_bytes());
                data.push(0);
            } else {
                let units: Vec<u16> = s.encode_utf16().collect();
                data.extend_from_slice(&(units.len() as u16).to_le_bytes());
                for u in units {
                    data.extend_from_slice(&u.to_le_bytes());
                }
                data.extend_from_slice(&0u16.to_le_bytes());
            }
        }
        while data.len() % 4 != 0 {
            data.push(0);
        }
        let header = 28u32;
        let start = header + 4 * strs.len() as u32;
        let mut pool = Vec::new();
        pool.extend_from_slice(&RES_STRING_POOL.to_le_bytes());
        pool.extend_from_slice(&(header as u16).to_le_bytes());
        pool.extend_from_slice(&(start + data.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
        pool.extend_from_slice(&(strs.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
        pool.extend_from_slice(&0u32.to_le_bytes());
        pool.extend_from_slice(&(if utf8 { UTF8_FLAG } else { 0 }).to_le_bytes());
        pool.extend_from_slice(&start.to_le_bytes());
        pool.extend_from_slice(&0u32.to_le_bytes());
        for o in offsets {
            pool.extend_from_slice(&o.to_le_bytes());
        }
        pool.extend_from_slice(&data);
        // <manifest> start element with one attribute (raw value = string 2).
        let mut el = Vec::new();
        el.extend_from_slice(&RES_XML_START_ELEMENT.to_le_bytes());
        el.extend_from_slice(&16u16.to_le_bytes());
        el.extend_from_slice(&(36u32 + 20).to_le_bytes());
        el.extend_from_slice(&1u32.to_le_bytes()); // line
        el.extend_from_slice(&u32::MAX.to_le_bytes()); // comment
        el.extend_from_slice(&u32::MAX.to_le_bytes()); // ns
        el.extend_from_slice(&0u32.to_le_bytes()); // name = "manifest"
        el.extend_from_slice(&20u16.to_le_bytes()); // attributeStart
        el.extend_from_slice(&20u16.to_le_bytes()); // attributeSize
        el.extend_from_slice(&1u16.to_le_bytes()); // count
        el.extend_from_slice(&[0; 6]); // id/class/style
        el.extend_from_slice(&u32::MAX.to_le_bytes()); // attr ns
        el.extend_from_slice(&1u32.to_le_bytes()); // attr name = "package"
        el.extend_from_slice(&2u32.to_le_bytes()); // raw value
        el.extend_from_slice(&8u16.to_le_bytes());
        el.push(0);
        el.push(TYPE_STRING);
        el.extend_from_slice(&2u32.to_le_bytes());
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        out.extend_from_slice(&RES_XML.to_le_bytes());
        out.extend_from_slice(&8u16.to_le_bytes());
        out.extend_from_slice(&((8 + pool.len() + el.len()) as u32).to_le_bytes());
        out.extend_from_slice(&pool);
        out.extend_from_slice(&el);
        out
    }

    #[test]
    fn reads_package_from_utf16_and_utf8_pools() {
        assert_eq!(
            manifest_package(&tiny_manifest("com.example.shop", false)).unwrap(),
            "com.example.shop"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            manifest_package(&tiny_manifest("ly.jidr.hello", true)).unwrap(),
            "ly.jidr.hello"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_garbage_without_panicking() {
        assert!(manifest_package(b"").is_err());
        assert!(manifest_package(&[3, 0, 8, 0, 255, 255, 255, 255]).is_err());
        let mut m = tiny_manifest("a.b", false);
        m.truncate(m.len() - 10);
        assert!(manifest_package(&m).is_err());
    }
}

`crates/jidr-widgets/src/apps.rs`:

```rs
//! Apps on the device: inspect an APK, launch, uninstall. The player uses
//! these after a dropped APK installs (`file.install` is a core command).

use std::path::PathBuf;

use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, CommandSpec, parse_params};
use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::{Value, json};

use crate::apk;
use crate::device::{Target, target};

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct InspectParams {
    /// Path of the APK on this machine.
    pub apk: PathBuf,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct LaunchParams {
    pub device: String,
    /// Package to launch, e.g. `com.example.shop`.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub package: Option<String>,
    /// Or an APK on this machine whose package to launch.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub apk: Option<PathBuf>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct PackageParams {
    pub device: String,
    /// Package name, e.g. `com.example.shop`.
    pub package: String,
}

pub fn specs() -> Vec<CommandSpec> {
    vec![
        CommandSpec::new::<InspectParams>("app.inspect", "Package name of an APK on this machine"),
        CommandSpec::new::<LaunchParams>(
            "app.launch",
            "Launch an installed app by package (or APK)",
        ),
        CommandSpec::new::<PackageParams>("app.uninstall", "Uninstall an app and its data")
            .destructive()
            .locks_device(),
    ]
}

/// A package name as `pm`/`monkey` accept it (no shell metacharacters).
pub fn check_package(p: &str) -> JidrResult<&str> {
    let ok = !p.is_empty()
        && p.split('.').all(|seg| {
            !seg.is_empty() && seg.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '_')
        });
    if ok {
        Ok(p)
    } else {
        Err(JidrError::usage(format!("not a package name: {p:?}")))
    }
}

/// The component `cmd package resolve-activity --brief` printed (its last
/// line), or `None` when nothing resolves.
pub fn parse_resolved(out: &str) -> Option<&str> {
    let last = out.lines().map(str::trim).rfind(|l| !l.is_empty())?;
    let ok = last.contains('/')
        && last
            .chars()
            .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(c, '.' | '_' | '/' | '$'));
    ok.then_some(last)
}

/// `am start -W` succeeded: `Status: ok` (or `Complete` on images that
/// don't print a status). `Err` carries adb's error line.
pub fn parse_am_start(out: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    let lines: Vec<&str> = out.lines().map(str::trim).collect();
    if let Some(e) = lines.iter().find(|l| l.starts_with("Error")) {
        return Err((*e).to_string());
    }
    if lines.iter().any(|l| *l == "Status: ok" || *l == "Complete") {
        return Ok(());
    }
    Err(lines
        .iter()
        .rfind(|l| !l.is_empty())
        .map_or("am start printed nothing".into(), |l| (*l).to_string()))
}

/// Does `dumpsys window` show `package` in front?
pub fn focused_on(dumpsys: &str, package: &str) -> bool {
    let needle = format!("{package}/");
    dumpsys
        .lines()
        .any(|l| (l.contains("mCurrentFocus") || l.contains("mFocusedApp")) && l.contains(&needle))
}

/// Starts `package`'s launcher activity with `am start -W` and waits up to
/// 5 s for it to come to the front, starting it once more if it doesn't.
/// Falls back to `monkey` when no launcher activity resolves. Returns
/// whether the app was seen in front.
async fn launch(t: &Target, package: &str) -> JidrResult<bool> {
    let adb = t.adb();
    let resolved = adb
        .shell_status(&format!(
            "cmd package resolve-activity --brief -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER {package}"
        ))
        .await?
        .1;
    let Some(component) = parse_resolved(&resolved).map(str::to_string) else {
        let (code, out) = adb
            .shell_status(&format!(
                "monkey -p {package} -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1"
            ))
            .await?;
        if code != 0 || out.contains("No activities found") || out.contains("monkey aborted") {
            return Err(JidrError::not_found(format!(
                "{package} has no launcher activity on {}",
                t.device.name
            )));
        }
        return Ok(false);
    };
    for _ in 0..2 {
        let out = adb
            .shell_status(&format!("am start -W -n {component}"))
            .await?
            .1;
        parse_am_start(&out).map_err(|e| {
            JidrError::sdk(format!(
                "couldn't start {component} on {}: {e}",
                t.device.name
            ))
        })?;
        for _ in 0..10 {
            if focused_on(
                &adb.shell("dumpsys window").await.unwrap_or_default(),
                package,
            ) {
                return Ok(true);
            }
            tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
        }
    }
    Ok(false)
}

pub async fn call(ctx: &CallCtx, method: &str, params: Value) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    match method {
        "app.inspect" => {
            let p: InspectParams = parse_params(params)?;
            Ok(json!({ "package": apk::package_name(&p.apk)? }))
        }
        "app.launch" => {
            let p: LaunchParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let package = match (p.package, p.apk) {
                (Some(pkg), _) => pkg,
                (None, Some(apk)) => apk::package_name(&apk)?,
                (None, None) => return Err(JidrError::usage("give `package` or `apk`")),
            };
            check_package(&package)?;
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let focused = launch(&t, &package).await?;
            Ok(json!({ "launched": package, "focused": focused }))
        }
        "app.uninstall" => {
            let p: PackageParams = parse_params(params)?;
            check_package(&p.package)?;
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            t.adb().uninstall(&p.package).await?;
            Ok(json!({ "uninstalled": p.package }))
        }
        _ => Err(JidrError::usage(format!("unknown method {method}"))),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// Regression (PR #7 CI, API 35): `monkey` only injected an event, so
    /// app.launch said "ok" while Settings never came to the front.
    #[test]
    fn launch_output_is_parsed() {
        let resolved = "priority=0 preferredOrder=0 match=0x108000 specificIndex=-1 isDefault=false\n\
                        com.android.settings/.Settings\n";
        assert_eq!(
            parse_resolved(resolved),
            Some("com.android.settings/.Settings")
        );
        assert_eq!(parse_resolved("No activity found\n"), None);
        assert_eq!(parse_resolved(""), None);
        assert_eq!(parse_resolved("a/b; reboot"), None);

        let ok = "Starting: Intent { cmp=com.android.settings/.Settings }\n\
                  Status: ok\nLaunchState: COLD\nActivity: com.android.settings/.Settings\n\
                  TotalTime: 523\nWaitTime: 526\nComplete\n";
        assert_eq!(parse_am_start(ok), Ok(()));
        let delivered = "Starting: Intent { cmp=com.android.settings/.Settings }\n\
                         Warning: Activity not started, intent has been delivered to currently running top-most instance.\n\
                         Status: ok\nLaunchState: UNKNOWN (0)\nComplete\n";
        assert_eq!(parse_am_start(delivered), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(parse_am_start("Starting: Intent {}\nComplete\n"), Ok(()));
        let missing = "Starting: Intent { cmp=x.y/.Z }\n\
                       Error type 3\nError: Activity class {x.y/x.y.Z} does not exist.\n";
        assert_eq!(parse_am_start(missing), Err("Error type 3".into()));
        assert!(parse_am_start("").is_err());

        let front = "  mCurrentFocus=Window{1 u0 com.android.settings/com.android.settings.Settings}\n\
                       mFocusedApp=ActivityRecord{2 u0 com.android.settings/.Settings t9}\n";
        assert!(focused_on(front, "com.android.settings"));
        let launcher = "  mCurrentFocus=Window{1 u0 com.google.android.apps.nexuslauncher/.NexusLauncherActivity}\n";
        assert!(!focused_on(launcher, "com.android.settings"));
        assert!(!focused_on(front, "com.android.set"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn package_names_are_checked() {
        assert!(check_package("com.example.shop").is_ok());
        assert!(check_package("a_b.c1").is_ok());
        for bad in ["", "com..x", "com.x;rm -rf", "com.x y", ".a"] {
            assert!(check_package(bad).is_err(), "{bad}");
        }
    }
}

//! Battery widget: level, charger, health (gRPC `setBattery`).

use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, CommandSpec, DeviceParams, parse_params};
use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};
use jidr_proto::control as pb;
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::{Value, json};

use crate::device::{grpc_err, target};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum Charger {
    None,
    Ac,
    Usb,
    Wireless,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum Health {
    Good,
    Failed,
    Dead,
    Overvoltage,
    Overheated,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SetParams {
    pub device: String,
    /// Charge level, 0–100 %.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub level: Option<u8>,
    /// Shorthand: `true` plugs in AC, `false` unplugs.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub charging: Option<bool>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub charger: Option<Charger>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub health: Option<Health>,
}

pub fn specs() -> Vec<CommandSpec> {
    vec![
        CommandSpec::new::<DeviceParams>("battery.get", "Battery level, charger and health"),
        CommandSpec::new::<SetParams>("battery.set", "Set battery level, charging and health"),
    ]
}

fn charger_of(c: i32) -> Charger {
    match pb::battery_state::BatteryCharger::try_from(c) {
        Ok(pb::battery_state::BatteryCharger::Ac) => Charger::Ac,
        Ok(pb::battery_state::BatteryCharger::Usb) => Charger::Usb,
        Ok(pb::battery_state::BatteryCharger::Wireless) => Charger::Wireless,
        _ => Charger::None,
    }
}

fn health_of(h: i32) -> Health {
    match pb::battery_state::BatteryHealth::try_from(h) {
        Ok(pb::battery_state::BatteryHealth::Failed) => Health::Failed,
        Ok(pb::battery_state::BatteryHealth::Dead) => Health::Dead,
        Ok(pb::battery_state::BatteryHealth::Overvoltage) => Health::Overvoltage,
        Ok(pb::battery_state::BatteryHealth::Overheated) => Health::Overheated,
        _ => Health::Good,
    }
}

pub fn to_json(b: &pb::BatteryState) -> Value {
    let charger = charger_of(b.charger);
    json!({
        "level": b.charge_level,
        "charging": charger != Charger::None,
        "charger": charger,
        "health": health_of(b.health),
        "present": b.is_present,
    })
}

/// Applies the requested changes to the current state.
pub fn apply(mut b: pb::BatteryState, p: &SetParams) -> JidrResult<pb::BatteryState> {
    use pb::battery_state::{BatteryCharger as C, BatteryHealth as H, BatteryStatus as S};
    if let Some(l) = p.level {
        if l > 100 {
            return Err(JidrError::usage("level must be 0–100"));
        }
        b.charge_level = i32::from(l);
    }
    let charger = match (p.charger, p.charging) {
        (Some(c), _) => Some(c),
        (None, Some(true)) => Some(Charger::Ac),
        (None, Some(false)) => Some(Charger::None),
        (None, None) => None,
    };
    if let Some(c) = charger {
        b.charger = match c {
            Charger::None => C::None,
            Charger::Ac => C::Ac,
            Charger::Usb => C::Usb,
            Charger::Wireless => C::Wireless,
        } as i32;
    }
    if let Some(h) = p.health {
        b.health = match h {
            Health::Good => H::Good,
            Health::Failed => H::Failed,
            Health::Dead => H::Dead,
            Health::Overvoltage => H::Overvoltage,
            Health::Overheated => H::Overheated,
        } as i32;
    }
    b.has_battery = true;
    b.is_present = true;
    b.status = if b.charger == C::None as i32 {
        S::Discharging
    } else if b.charge_level >= 100 {
        S::Full
    } else {
        S::Charging
    } as i32;
    Ok(b)
}

pub async fn call(ctx: &CallCtx, method: &str, params: Value) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    match method {
        "battery.get" => {
            let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let b = t
                .grpc()
                .await?
                .get_battery(())
                .await
                .map_err(grpc_err("getBattery"))?;
            Ok(to_json(b.get_ref()))
        }
        "battery.set" => {
            let p: SetParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let mut c = t.grpc().await?;
            let cur = c
                .get_battery(())
                .await
                .map_err(grpc_err("getBattery"))?
                .into_inner();
            let next = apply(cur, &p)?;
            c.set_battery(next).await.map_err(grpc_err("setBattery"))?;
            Ok(to_json(&next))
        }
        _ => Err(JidrError::usage(format!("unknown method {method}"))),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn params(level: Option<u8>, charging: Option<bool>) -> SetParams {
        SetParams {
            device: "d".into(),
            level,
            charging,
            charger: None,
            health: None,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn level_and_charging_apply() {
        let b = apply(pb::BatteryState::default(), &params(Some(64), Some(false))).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(b.charge_level, 64);
        assert_eq!(
            b.status,
            pb::battery_state::BatteryStatus::Discharging as i32
        );
        let b = apply(b, &params(Some(100), Some(true))).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(b.status, pb::battery_state::BatteryStatus::Full as i32);
        assert_eq!(to_json(&b)["charger"], "ac");
        assert!(apply(b, &params(Some(101), None)).is_err());
    }
}

//! A running device as the widgets see it: adb, gRPC and console handles.

use std::time::Duration;

use jidr_adb::Adb;
use jidr_backend::Console;
use jidr_core::provider::CallCtx;
use jidr_core::{ConnectInfo, Device, JidrError, JidrResult};
use jidr_proto::{Controller, Snapshots};

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Target {
    pub device: Device,
    pub info: ConnectInfo,
}

/// Resolves a running device (`not_found` when it's stopped).
pub async fn target(ctx: &CallCtx, selector: &str) -> JidrResult<Target> {
    let device = ctx.daemon.device(selector).await?;
    let info = ctx.daemon.connect_info(device.id).await.map_err(|e| {
        if e.code == jidr_core::ErrorCode::NotFound {
            JidrError::not_found(format!("{} isn't running; start it first", device.name))
        } else {
            e
        }
    })?;
    Ok(Target { device, info })
}

impl Target {
    pub fn adb(&self) -> Adb {
        Adb::new(self.info.adb_path.clone()).device(self.info.adb_serial.clone())
    }

    pub async fn grpc(&self) -> JidrResult<Controller> {
        Ok(
            jidr_backend::grpc::connect_port(self.info.grpc_port, &self.info.grpc_token)
                .await?
                .0,
        )
    }

    pub async fn snapshots(&self) -> JidrResult<Snapshots> {
        Ok(
            jidr_backend::grpc::connect_port(self.info.grpc_port, &self.info.grpc_token)
                .await?
                .1,
        )
    }

    pub async fn console(&self) -> JidrResult<Console> {
        let token = jidr_backend::console::default_token_path();
        Console::connect(self.info.console_port, token.as_deref()).await
    }

    /// Runs a console command and fails on `KO:` replies.
    pub async fn console_cmd(&self, cmd: &str) -> JidrResult<Vec<String>> {
        let mut c = self.console().await?;
        c.command(cmd).await
    }
}

/// Maps a gRPC failure to a Jidr error.
pub fn grpc_err(what: &str) -> impl FnOnce(tonic::Status) -> JidrError + '_ {
    move |s| jidr_backend::grpc::status_error(what, s)
}

/// What to do next while waiting for a device to answer adb again.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum WaitStep {
    Done,
    Wait,
    /// Run `adb reconnect offline`: the host adb server holds a stale
    /// transport (after a snapshot restore it can stay `offline` for good).
    Reconnect,
    GiveUp,
}

/// The retry/reconnect decision for [`wait_for_adb`], on elapsed time so it
/// can be tested without a device.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct AdbWait {
    timeout: Duration,
    /// Reconnect after the device hasn't answered for this long…
    grace: Duration,
    /// …and at most this often.
    every: Duration,
    failing_since: Option<Duration>,
    last_reconnect: Option<Duration>,
}

impl AdbWait {
    pub fn new(timeout: Duration) -> Self {
        Self {
            timeout,
            grace: Duration::from_secs(5),
            every: Duration::from_secs(10),
            failing_since: None,
            last_reconnect: None,
        }
    }

    /// `answered`: did `adb shell echo ok` print `ok`? `now`: time since
    /// the wait began.
    pub fn step(&mut self, answered: bool, now: Duration) -> WaitStep {
        if answered {
            return WaitStep::Done;
        }
        if now >= self.timeout {
            return WaitStep::GiveUp;
        }
        let since = *self.failing_since.get_or_insert(now);
        let due = self.last_reconnect.is_none_or(|t| now >= t + self.every);
        if now >= since + self.grace && due {
            self.last_reconnect = Some(now);
            return WaitStep::Reconnect;
        }
        WaitStep::Wait
    }
}

/// Waits until the device answers `adb shell echo ok`, reconnecting stale
/// transports on the way. `what` names the step for the error ("restored").
pub async fn wait_for_adb(
    ctx: &CallCtx,
    t: &Target,
    timeout: Duration,
    what: &str,
) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let adb = t.adb().with_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5));
    let host = Adb::new(t.info.adb_path.clone()).with_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10));
    let start = tokio::time::Instant::now();
    let mut wait = AdbWait::new(timeout);
    let mut last = String::new();
    let mut reported = false;
    loop {
        if ctx.cancel.is_cancelled() {
            return Err(jidr_core::cancel::cancelled());
        }
        let answered = match adb.raw(&["shell", "echo ok"]).await {
            Ok(out) if out.stdout.trim() == "ok" => true,
            Ok(out) => {
                last = format!("{}{}", out.stderr, out.stdout).trim().to_string();
                false
            }
            Err(e) => {
                last = e.message;
                false
            }
        };
        match wait.step(answered, start.elapsed()) {
            WaitStep::Done => return Ok(()),
            WaitStep::GiveUp => {
                let state = adb
                    .raw(&["get-state"])
                    .await
                    .map(|o| format!("{}{}", o.stdout, o.stderr).trim().to_string())
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                return Err(JidrError::boot_timeout(format!(
                    "{} {what}, but it didn't answer adb within {} s (state: {state}; last: {last})",
                    t.device.name,
                    timeout.as_secs()
                ))
                .with_data(serde_json::json!({ "adb_state": state, "last_error": last })));
            }
            WaitStep::Reconnect => {
                tracing::info!(serial = %t.info.adb_serial, %last, "adb reconnect offline");
                let _ = host.raw(&["reconnect", "offline"]).await;
            }
            WaitStep::Wait => {}
        }
        if !reported {
            ctx.report(None, "Waiting for the device");
            reported = true;
        }
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn s(secs: f64) -> Duration {
        Duration::from_secs_f64(secs)
    }

    /// Regression (PR #7 CI, API 33/35): after a snapshot restore adb shell
    /// printed nothing for 30 s. snapshot.load now waits, and reconnects a
    /// transport that stays offline.
    #[test]
    fn waits_then_reconnects_offline_devices_at_most_every_ten_seconds() {
        let mut w = AdbWait::new(s(60.0));
        assert_eq!(w.step(true, s(0.0)), WaitStep::Done);

        let mut w = AdbWait::new(s(60.0));
        assert_eq!(w.step(false, s(0.0)), WaitStep::Wait);
        assert_eq!(w.step(false, s(4.9)), WaitStep::Wait);
        assert_eq!(w.step(false, s(5.0)), WaitStep::Reconnect);
        assert_eq!(w.step(false, s(9.0)), WaitStep::Wait);
        assert_eq!(w.step(false, s(15.0)), WaitStep::Reconnect);
        assert_eq!(w.step(true, s(16.0)), WaitStep::Done);
    }

    #[test]
    fn gives_up_at_the_timeout() {
        let mut w = AdbWait::new(s(60.0));
        assert_eq!(w.step(false, s(1.0)), WaitStep::Wait);
        assert_eq!(w.step(false, s(60.0)), WaitStep::GiveUp);
        // A late answer still counts.
        assert_eq!(w.step(true, s(61.0)), WaitStep::Done);
    }
}

//! Android controls (hardware keys), developer toggles (show taps, pointer
//! location, layout bounds, animation scales) and the shared clipboard.

use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, CommandSpec, DeviceParams, parse_params};
use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};
use jidr_proto::control as pb;
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::{Value, json};

use crate::device::{grpc_err, target};

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct KeyParams {
    pub device: String,
    /// `back`, `home`, `recents`, `volume_up`, `volume_down`, `mute`,
    /// `power`, `menu`, `dpad_up|down|left|right|center`, `play_pause`,
    /// `next`, `previous`, `enter`, `delete`, or any W3C key name.
    pub key: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct DevParams {
    pub device: String,
    /// Show touches (`show_touches`).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub show_taps: Option<bool>,
    /// Pointer location overlay.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub pointer_location: Option<bool>,
    /// Show layout bounds (`debug.layout`).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub layout_bounds: Option<bool>,
    /// Window, transition and animator scales (0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 5, 10).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub animation_scale: Option<f32>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ClipParams {
    pub device: String,
    pub text: String,
}

pub fn specs() -> Vec<CommandSpec> {
    vec![
        CommandSpec::new::<KeyParams>(
            "key.press",
            "Press a hardware key (back, home, volume, D-pad, media…)",
        ),
        CommandSpec::new::<DeviceParams>(
            "dev.get",
            "Developer toggles: show taps, pointer location, layout bounds, animation scale",
        ),
        CommandSpec::new::<DevParams>("dev.set", "Set developer toggles"),
        CommandSpec::new::<DeviceParams>("clipboard.get", "The device clipboard text"),
        CommandSpec::new::<ClipParams>("clipboard.set", "Set the device clipboard text"),
    ]
}

/// Our key names → W3C `KeyboardEvent.key` values the emulator accepts.
pub fn key_name(k: &str) -> JidrResult<String> {
    let w3c = match k {
        "back" => "GoBack",
        "home" => "GoHome",
        "recents" | "app_switch" => "AppSwitch",
        "volume_up" => "AudioVolumeUp",
        "volume_down" => "AudioVolumeDown",
        "mute" => "AudioVolumeMute",
        "power" => "Power",
        "menu" => "ContextMenu",
        "dpad_up" => "ArrowUp",
        "dpad_down" => "ArrowDown",
        "dpad_left" => "ArrowLeft",
        "dpad_right" => "ArrowRight",
        "dpad_center" | "enter" => "Enter",
        "delete" => "Backspace",
        "play_pause" => "MediaPlayPause",
        "next" => "MediaTrackNext",
        "previous" => "MediaTrackPrevious",
        other if !other.is_empty() && other.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric()) => other,
        other => return Err(JidrError::usage(format!("unknown key {other:?}"))),
    };
    Ok(w3c.to_string())
}

/// Hardware buttons go in as Linux evdev key codes (down, then up), the way
/// the emulator's own side buttons do; W3C names don't move the volume.
pub fn evdev_code(k: &str) -> Option<i32> {
    Some(match k {
        "mute" => 113,
        "volume_down" => 114,
        "volume_up" => 115,
        "power" => 116,
        "menu" => 139,
        "back" => 158,
        "recents" | "app_switch" => 580,
        "play_pause" => 164,
        "next" => 163,
        "previous" => 165,
        _ => return None,
    })
}

/// The keyboard events for a key name.
pub fn key_events(k: &str) -> JidrResult<Vec<pb::KeyboardEvent>> {
    use pb::keyboard_event::{KeyCodeType, KeyEventType};
    if let Some(code) = evdev_code(k) {
        return Ok([KeyEventType::Keydown, KeyEventType::Keyup]
            .into_iter()
            .map(|t| pb::KeyboardEvent {
                code_type: KeyCodeType::Evdev as i32,
                event_type: t as i32,
                key_code: code,
                ..Default::default()
            })
            .collect());
    }
    Ok(vec![pb::KeyboardEvent {
        code_type: KeyCodeType::Usb as i32,
        event_type: KeyEventType::Keypress as i32,
        key: key_name(k)?,
        ..Default::default()
    }])
}

pub const SCALES: [f32; 7] = [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 5.0, 10.0];

fn flag(v: bool) -> &'static str {
    if v { "1" } else { "0" }
}

pub async fn call(ctx: &CallCtx, method: &str, params: Value) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    match method {
        "key.press" => {
            let p: KeyParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let events = key_events(&p.key)?;
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let mut c = t.grpc().await?;
            for ev in events {
                c.send_key(ev).await.map_err(grpc_err("sendKey"))?;
            }
            Ok(json!({ "key": p.key }))
        }
        "dev.get" => {
            let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let adb = target(ctx, &p.device).await?.adb();
            let show = adb.shell("settings get system show_touches").await?;
            let ptr = adb.shell("settings get system pointer_location").await?;
            let layout = adb.getprop("debug.layout").await.unwrap_or_default();
            let anim = adb
                .shell("settings get global window_animation_scale")
                .await?;
            Ok(json!({
                "show_taps": show.trim() == "1",
                "pointer_location": ptr.trim() == "1",
                "layout_bounds": layout.trim() == "true",
                "animation_scale": anim.trim().parse::<f32>().unwrap_or(1.0),
            }))
        }
        "dev.set" => {
            let p: DevParams = parse_params(params)?;
            if let Some(s) = p.animation_scale
                && !SCALES.contains(&s)
            {
                return Err(JidrError::usage(
                    "animation_scale must be 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 5 or 10",
                ));
            }
            let adb = target(ctx, &p.device).await?.adb();
            if let Some(v) = p.show_taps {
                adb.shell(&format!("settings put system show_touches {}", flag(v)))
                    .await?;
            }
            if let Some(v) = p.pointer_location {
                adb.shell(&format!("settings put system pointer_location {}", flag(v)))
                    .await?;
            }
            if let Some(v) = p.layout_bounds {
                // setprop needs a nudge so running apps re-read it (SYSPROPS_TRANSACTION).
                adb.shell(&format!(
                    "setprop debug.layout {} && service call activity 1599295570 >/dev/null",
                    if v { "true" } else { "false" }
                ))
                .await?;
            }
            if let Some(s) = p.animation_scale {
                for key in [
                    "window_animation_scale",
                    "transition_animation_scale",
                    "animator_duration_scale",
                ] {
                    adb.shell(&format!("settings put global {key} {s}")).await?;
                }
            }
            Ok(json!({ "ok": true }))
        }
        "clipboard.get" => {
            let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let c = t
                .grpc()
                .await?
                .get_clipboard(())
                .await
                .map_err(grpc_err("getClipboard"))?;
            Ok(json!({ "text": c.into_inner().text }))
        }
        "clipboard.set" => {
            let p: ClipParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            t.grpc()
                .await?
                .set_clipboard(pb::ClipData { text: p.text })
                .await
                .map_err(grpc_err("setClipboard"))?;
            Ok(json!({ "ok": true }))
        }
        _ => Err(JidrError::usage(format!("unknown method {method}"))),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn hardware_keys_are_evdev_down_up() {
        let ev = key_events("volume_up").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(ev.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(ev[0].key_code, 115);
        assert_eq!(
            ev[1].event_type,
            pb::keyboard_event::KeyEventType::Keyup as i32

        assert!(key_name("").is_err());
    }

//! The D36 single-command extras: fingerprint touch/remove (R8) and the
//! host webcam as the camera (R7). Mobile signal bars (R3) are `phone.gsm`.

#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum CameraSource {

pub fn specs() -> Vec<CommandSpec> {

        ),
        CommandSpec::new::<DeviceParams>("fingerprint.remove", "Lift the finger off the sensor"),
        CommandSpec::new::<DeviceParams>("camera.get", "Camera sources used at the next start"),
        CommandSpec::new::<CameraParams>(
            "camera.set",
            "Use the host webcam (or the emulated camera) at the next start",
        )
        .locks_device(),
    ]
}

/// Replaces `-camera-back` / `-camera-front` in the launch args.
pub fn set_camera_args(args: &mut Vec<String>, flag: &str, source: CameraSource) {
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(args.len() + 2);
    let mut it = args.drain(..);
    while let Some(a) = it.next() {
        if a == flag {
            it.next();
            continue;
        }
        out.push(a);
    }
    drop(it);
    out.push(flag.to_string());
    out.push(source.arg().to_string());
    *args = out;
}

pub fn camera_of(d: &Device, flag: &str) -> Option<String> {
    d.launch
        .extra_args
        .iter()
        .position(|a| a == flag)
        .and_then(|i| d.launch.extra_args.get(i + 1))
        .cloned()
}

pub async fn call(ctx: &CallCtx, method: &str, params: Value) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    match method {
        "fingerprint.touch" => {
            let p: FingerParams = parse_params(params)?;
            if !(1..=10).contains(&p.finger) {
                return Err(JidrError::usage("finger is 1–10"));
            }
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            t.console_cmd(&format!("finger touch {}", p.finger)).await?;
            Ok(json!({ "finger": p.finger }))
        }
        "fingerprint.remove" => {
            let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            t.console_cmd("finger remove").await?;
            Ok(json!({ "ok": true }))
        }
        "camera.get" => {
            let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let d = ctx.daemon.device(&p.device).await?;
            Ok(json!({
                "back": camera_of(&d, "-camera-back").unwrap_or_else(|| "default".into()),
                "front": camera_of(&d, "-camera-front").unwrap_or_else(|| "default".into()),
            }))
        }
        "camera.set" => {
            let p: CameraParams = parse_params(params)?;
            if p.front == Some(CameraSource::Virtualscene) {
                return Err(JidrError::usage("the virtual scene is a back camera only"));
            }
            let d = ctx.daemon.device(&p.device).await?;
            let (back, front) = (p.back, p.front);
            let d = ctx
                .daemon
                .update_device(
                    d.id,
                    Box::new(move |d: &mut Device| {
                        if let Some(b) = back {
                            set_camera_args(&mut d.launch.extra_args, "-camera-back", b);
                        }
                        if let Some(f) = front {
                            set_camera_args(&mut d.launch.extra_args, "-camera-front", f);
                        }
                    }),
                )
                .await?;
            Ok(json!({
                "back": camera_of(&d, "-camera-back"),
                "front": camera_of(&d, "-camera-front"),
                "applies": "next start",
            }))
        }
        _ => Err(JidrError::usage(format!("unknown method {method}"))),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn camera_args_replace_the_old_value() {
        let mut a = vec![
            "-no-audio".to_string(),
            "-camera-back".into(),
            "emulated".into(),
        ];
        set_camera_args(&mut a, "-camera-back", CameraSource::Webcam0);
        assert_eq!(a, ["-no-audio", "-camera-back", "webcam0"]);
        set_camera_args(&mut a, "-camera-front", CameraSource::None);
        assert_eq!(
            a,
            [
                "-no-audio",
                "-camera-back",
                "webcam0",
                "-camera-front",
                "none"
            ]
        );
    }
}

`crates/jidr-widgets/src/gps/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! GPS widget: set a fix (gRPC `setGps`) and replay GPX/KML routes as a
//! job that walks the track at a chosen speed (D14).

pub mod track;

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU32, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, CommandSpec, DeviceParams, parse_params};
use jidr_core::{Cancel, JidrError, JidrResult};
use jidr_proto::control as pb;
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::device::{grpc_err, target};
use track::{Point, Track};

/// Metres per second at 1× (a city drive).
pub const BASE_MPS: f64 = 10.0;

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SetParams {
    pub device: String,
    /// Decimal degrees, −90…90.
    pub latitude: f64,
    /// Decimal degrees, −180…180.
    pub longitude: f64,
    /// Metres above sea level.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub altitude: Option<f64>,
    /// Degrees clockwise from north.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub bearing: Option<f64>,
    /// Metres per second.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub speed: Option<f64>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RouteParams {
    pub device: String,
    /// A `.gpx` or `.kml` file on this machine.
    pub path: PathBuf,
    /// Playback speed multiplier (1, 2, 4…).
    #[serde(default = "one")]
    pub speed: f32,
    /// Start again from the first point at the end.
    #[serde(default, rename = "loop")]
    pub repeat: bool,
    /// Metres per second at 1× (default 10, a city drive).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub mps: Option<f64>,
}

fn one() -> f32 {
    1.0
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ControlParams {
    pub device: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub speed: Option<f32>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub paused: Option<bool>,
    #[serde(default, rename = "loop")]
    pub repeat: Option<bool>,
}

/// Live controls of a running route replay.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct RouteCtl {
    speed: AtomicU32,
    paused: AtomicBool,
    repeat: AtomicBool,
    cancel: Cancel,
    stop: AtomicBool,
}

impl RouteCtl {
    fn speed(&self) -> f32 {
        f32::from_bits(self.speed.load(Ordering::Relaxed))
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct Routes(Mutex<HashMap<Uuid, Arc<RouteCtl>>>);

impl Routes {
    fn get(&self, id: Uuid) -> Option<Arc<RouteCtl>> {
        self.0.lock().ok()?.get(&id).cloned()
    }
}

pub fn specs() -> Vec<CommandSpec> {
    vec![
        CommandSpec::new::<DeviceParams>("gps.get", "The current GPS fix"),
        CommandSpec::new::<SetParams>("gps.set", "Set the GPS location"),
        CommandSpec::new::<RouteParams>("gps.route", "Replay a GPX or KML route at a chosen speed")
            .long_running(),
        CommandSpec::new::<ControlParams>(
            "gps.route_control",
            "Change the running route's speed, pause or loop",
        ),
        CommandSpec::new::<DeviceParams>("gps.route_stop", "Stop the running route replay"),
    ]
}

pub fn check(lat: f64, lon: f64) -> JidrResult<()> {
    if !(-90.0..=90.0).contains(&lat)
        || !(-180.0..=180.0).contains(&lon)
        || lat.is_nan()
        || lon.is_nan()
    {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(
            "latitude must be −90…90 and longitude −180…180",
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn fix(p: Point, bearing: f64, speed: f64) -> pb::GpsState {
    pb::GpsState {
        passive_update: false,
        latitude: p.lat,
        longitude: p.lon,
        altitude: p.alt,
        bearing,
        speed,
        satellites: 12,
    }
}

/// "4.1 / 10.8 km · 6 min left at 2× · bearing 168°"
pub fn progress_text(
    done_m: f64,
    total_m: f64,
    mps: f64,
    speed: f32,
    bearing: f64,
    paused: bool,
) -> String {
    let left_s = ((total_m - done_m).max(0.0) / (mps * f64::from(speed)).max(0.001)).round() as i64;
    let left = if left_s >= 60 {
        format!("{} min left", (left_s + 59) / 60)
    } else {
        format!("{left_s} s left")
    };
    let sp = if speed.fract() == 0.0 {
        format!("{speed:.0}")
    } else {
        format!("{speed}")
    };
    format!(
        "{:.1} / {:.1} km · {}{left} at {sp}× · bearing {:.0}°",
        done_m / 1000.0,
        total_m / 1000.0,
        if paused { "paused · " } else { "" },
        bearing
    )
}

pub async fn call(
    ctx: &CallCtx,
    routes: &Routes,
    method: &str,
    params: Value,
) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    match method {
        "gps.get" => {
            let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let g = t
                .grpc()
                .await?
                .get_gps(())
                .await
                .map_err(grpc_err("getGps"))?
                .into_inner();
            Ok(json!({
                "latitude": g.latitude, "longitude": g.longitude, "altitude": g.altitude,
                "bearing": g.bearing, "speed": g.speed,
                "route": routes.get(t.device.id).is_some(),
            }))
        }
        "gps.set" => {
            let p: SetParams = parse_params(params)?;
            check(p.latitude, p.longitude)?;
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let point = Point {
                lat: p.latitude,
                lon: p.longitude,
                alt: p.altitude.unwrap_or(0.0),
            };
            t.grpc()
                .await?
                .set_gps(fix(point, p.bearing.unwrap_or(0.0), p.speed.unwrap_or(0.0)))
                .await
                .map_err(grpc_err("setGps"))?;
            Ok(json!({ "latitude": p.latitude, "longitude": p.longitude }))
        }
        "gps.route" => {
            let p: RouteParams = parse_params(params)?;
            if !(p.speed > 0.0 && p.speed <= 64.0) {
                return Err(JidrError::usage("speed must be between 0 and 64×"));
            }
            let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&p.path)
                .map_err(|e| JidrError::usage(format!("cannot read {}: {e}", p.path.display())))?;
            let track = Track::new(track::parse(&text)?);
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let ctl = Arc::new(RouteCtl {
                speed: AtomicU32::new(p.speed.to_bits()),
                paused: AtomicBool::new(false),
                repeat: AtomicBool::new(p.repeat),
                cancel: ctx.cancel.clone(),
                stop: AtomicBool::new(false),
            });
            if let Ok(mut m) = routes.0.lock()
                && let Some(old) = m.insert(t.device.id, ctl.clone())
            {
                old.stop.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
            let r = replay(ctx, &t, &track, &ctl, p.mps.unwrap_or(BASE_MPS)).await;
            if let Ok(mut m) = routes.0.lock()
                && m.get(&t.device.id).is_some_and(|c| Arc::ptr_eq(c, &ctl))
            {
                m.remove(&t.device.id);
            }
            r
        }
        "gps.route_control" => {
            let p: ControlParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let d = ctx.daemon.device(&p.device).await?;
            let ctl = routes.get(d.id).ok_or_else(|| {
                JidrError::not_found(format!("no route is playing on {}", d.name))
            })?;
            if let Some(s) = p.speed {
                if !(s > 0.0 && s <= 64.0) {
                    return Err(JidrError::usage("speed must be between 0 and 64×"));
                }
                ctl.speed.store(s.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
            if let Some(v) = p.paused {
                ctl.paused.store(v, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
            if let Some(v) = p.repeat {
                ctl.repeat.store(v, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
            Ok(json!({ "speed": ctl.speed(), "paused": ctl.paused.load(Ordering::Relaxed) }))
        }
        "gps.route_stop" => {
            let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let d = ctx.daemon.device(&p.device).await?;
            match routes.get(d.id) {
                Some(c) => {
                    c.stop.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
                    Ok(json!({ "stopped": true }))
                }
                None => Ok(json!({ "stopped": false })),
            }
        }
        _ => Err(JidrError::usage(format!("unknown method {method}"))),
    }
}

/// Walks the track: one fix a second (more often at high speeds) until the
/// end, a stop, or cancel.
async fn replay(
    ctx: &CallCtx,
    t: &crate::device::Target,
    track: &Track,
    ctl: &RouteCtl,
    mps: f64,
) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    let mut grpc = t.grpc().await?;
    let total = track.length();
    let mut done = 0.0;
    let mut last = Instant::now();
    let mut laps = 0u32;
    loop {
        ctl.cancel.check()?;
        let paused = ctl.paused.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        let speed = ctl.speed();
        let now = Instant::now();
        if !paused {
            done += mps * f64::from(speed) * now.duration_since(last).as_secs_f64();
        }
        last = now;
        let at_end = done >= total;
        let (p, b) = track.at(done.min(total));
        let v = if paused { 0.0 } else { mps * f64::from(speed) };
        grpc.set_gps(fix(p, b, v))
            .await
            .map_err(grpc_err("setGps"))?;
        ctx.report(
            Some(if total > 0.0 {
                (done / total).min(1.0) as f32
            } else {
                1.0
            }),
            &progress_text(done.min(total), total, mps, speed, b, paused),
        );
        if ctl.stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
            break;
        }
        if at_end {
            if ctl.repeat.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
                done = 0.0;
                laps += 1;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        // Step so each fix advances at most ~50 m (smooth at 4× and up).
        let step = (50.0 / (mps * f64::from(speed)).max(1.0)).clamp(0.2, 1.0);
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs_f64(step)).await;
    }
    Ok(json!({ "distance_m": done.min(total), "total_m": total, "laps": laps }))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn progress_reads_like_the_design() {
        assert_eq!(
            progress_text(4100.0, 10800.0, 9.3, 2.0, 168.0, false),
            "4.1 / 10.8 km · 6 min left at 2× · bearing 168°"
        );
        assert!(progress_text(0.0, 100.0, 10.0, 1.0, 0.0, true).contains("paused"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn coordinates_are_checked() {
        assert!(check(32.8954, 13.1802).is_ok());
        assert!(check(91.0, 0.0).is_err());
        assert!(check(0.0, f64::NAN).is_err());
    }
}

`crates/jidr-widgets/src/gps/track.rs`:

```rs
//! GPX and KML tracks: just enough parsing for route replay (track, route
//! and way points; KML `<coordinates>` and `gx:coord`), plus geometry for
//! walking a polyline at a given speed.

use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub struct Point {
    pub lat: f64,
    pub lon: f64,
    pub alt: f64,
}

/// Value of `name="…"` inside one tag's text.
fn attr(tag: &str, name: &str) -> Option<f64> {
    let key = format!("{name}=");
    let i = tag.find(&key)? + key.len();
    let rest = &tag[i..];
    let q = rest.chars().next()?;
    if q != '"' && q != '\'' {
        return None;
    }
    let end = rest[1..].find(q)?;
    rest[1..1 + end].trim().parse().ok()
}

/// Text between `<name…>` and `</name>` right after `from`.
fn child_text<'a>(s: &'a str, name: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {
    let open = s.find(&format!("<{name}"))?;
    let gt = s[open..].find('>')? + open + 1;
    let close = s[gt..].find(&format!("</{name}>"))? + gt;
    Some(s[gt..close].trim())
}

fn valid(p: &Point) -> bool {
    (-90.0..=90.0).contains(&p.lat) && (-180.0..=180.0).contains(&p.lon)
}

fn parse_gpx(text: &str) -> Vec<Point> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for tag in ["trkpt", "rtept", "wpt"] {
        let open = format!("<{tag}");
        let mut rest = text;
        while let Some(i) = rest.find(&open) {
            let after = &rest[i..];
            let Some(gt) = after.find('>') else { break };
            let head = &after[..gt];
            // The point's body runs to its closing tag (or it self-closes).
            let body_end = if head.ends_with('/') {
                gt
            } else {
                after.find(&format!("</{tag}>")).unwrap_or(gt)
            };
            let body = &after[gt..body_end];
            if let (Some(lat), Some(lon)) = (attr(head, "lat"), attr(head, "lon")) {
                let alt = child_text(body, "ele")
                    .and_then(|e| e.parse().ok())
                    .unwrap_or(0.0);
                out.push(Point { lat, lon, alt });
            }
            rest = &after[gt.max(1)..];
        }
        if !out.is_empty() {
            break;
        }
    }
    out
}

fn parse_kml(text: &str) -> Vec<Point> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    // <coordinates>lon,lat[,alt] lon,lat[,alt] …</coordinates>
    let mut rest = text;
    while let Some(c) = child_text(rest, "coordinates") {
        for tuple in c.split_whitespace() {
            let v: Vec<f64> = tuple
                .split(',')
                .filter_map(|x| x.trim().parse().ok())
                .collect();
            if v.len() >= 2 {
                out.push(Point {
                    lat: v[1],
                    lon: v[0],
                    alt: v.get(2).copied().unwrap_or(0.0),
                });
            }
        }
        let Some(i) = rest.find("</coordinates>") else {
            break;
        };
        rest = &rest[i + 14..];
    }
    if out.is_empty() {
        // gx:Track: <gx:coord>lon lat alt</gx:coord>
        let mut rest = text;
        while let Some(c) = child_text(rest, "gx:coord") {
            let v: Vec<f64> = c
                .split_whitespace()
                .filter_map(|x| x.parse().ok())
                .collect();
            if v.len() >= 2 {
                out.push(Point {
                    lat: v[1],
                    lon: v[0],
                    alt: v.get(2).copied().unwrap_or(0.0),
                });
            }
            let Some(i) = rest.find("</gx:coord>") else {
                break;
            };
            rest = &rest[i + 11..];
        }
    }
    out
}

/// Points of a GPX or KML file, in order.
pub fn parse(text: &str) -> JidrResult<Vec<Point>> {
    let pts: Vec<Point> = if text.contains("<kml") {
        parse_kml(text)
    } else {
        parse_gpx(text)
    };
    let pts: Vec<Point> = pts.into_iter().filter(valid).collect();
    if pts.is_empty() {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(
            "no track, route or way points in the file",
        ));
    }
    Ok(pts)
}

const EARTH_M: f64 = 6_371_000.0;

/// Great-circle distance in metres.
pub fn distance(a: Point, b: Point) -> f64 {
    let (p1, p2) = (a.lat.to_radians(), b.lat.to_radians());
    let dp = p2 - p1;
    let dl = (b.lon - a.lon).to_radians();
    let h = (dp / 2.0).sin().powi(2) + p1.cos() * p2.cos() * (dl / 2.0).sin().powi(2);
    2.0 * EARTH_M * h.sqrt().asin()
}

/// Initial bearing a → b, degrees clockwise from north.
pub fn bearing(a: Point, b: Point) -> f64 {
    let (p1, p2) = (a.lat.to_radians(), b.lat.to_radians());
    let dl = (b.lon - a.lon).to_radians();
    let y = dl.sin() * p2.cos();
    let x = p1.cos() * p2.sin() - p1.sin() * p2.cos() * dl.cos();
    (y.atan2(x).to_degrees() + 360.0) % 360.0
}

/// A track with cumulative distances, for walking it.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Track {
    pub points: Vec<Point>,
    cum: Vec<f64>,
}

impl Track {
    pub fn new(points: Vec<Point>) -> Self {
        let mut cum = Vec::with_capacity(points.len());
        let mut d = 0.0;
        for (i, p) in points.iter().enumerate() {
            if i > 0 {
                d += distance(points[i - 1], *p);
            }
            cum.push(d);
        }
        Self { points, cum }
    }

    pub fn length(&self) -> f64 {
        self.cum.last().copied().unwrap_or(0.0)
    }

    /// Position and heading `d` metres along the track (clamped).
    pub fn at(&self, d: f64) -> (Point, f64) {
        let n = self.points.len();
        if n == 1 || d <= 0.0 {
            let b = if n > 1 {
                bearing(self.points[0], self.points[1])
            } else {
                0.0
            };
            return (self.points[0], b);
        }
        let d = d.min(self.length());
        let i = self.cum.partition_point(|c| *c <= d).clamp(1, n - 1);
        let (a, b) = (self.points[i - 1], self.points[i]);
        let seg = (self.cum[i] - self.cum[i - 1]).max(1e-9);
        let t = ((d - self.cum[i - 1]) / seg).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        let p = Point {
            lat: a.lat + (b.lat - a.lat) * t,
            lon: a.lon + (b.lon - a.lon) * t,
            alt: a.alt + (b.alt - a.alt) * t,
        };
        (p, bearing(a, b))
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const GPX: &str = r#"<?xml version="1.0"?><gpx version="1.1"><trk><trkseg>
      <trkpt lat="32.8954" lon="13.1802"><ele>21</ele></trkpt>
      <trkpt lat='32.8900' lon='13.1850'><ele>25</ele><time>2026-10-13T14:00:00Z</time></trkpt>
      <trkpt lat="32.6635" lon="13.1590"/>
    </trkseg></trk></gpx>"#;

    #[test]
    fn parses_gpx_track_points_in_order() {
        let p = parse(GPX).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p.len(), 3);
        assert_eq!((p[0].lat, p[0].lon, p[0].alt), (32.8954, 13.1802, 21.0));
        assert_eq!(p[1].alt, 25.0);
        assert_eq!(p[2].lat, 32.6635);
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_kml_coordinates_and_gx_track() {
        let kml = "<kml><Placemark><LineString><coordinates>13.1802,32.8954,21 13.1850,32.8900</coordinates></LineString></Placemark></kml>";
        let p = parse(kml).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((p[0].lat, p[0].lon, p[0].alt), (32.8954, 13.1802, 21.0));
        assert_eq!(p[1].lon, 13.1850);
        let gx = "<kml><gx:Track><gx:coord>13.1 32.8 5</gx:coord><gx:coord>13.2 32.9 6</gx:coord></gx:Track></kml>";
        assert_eq!(parse(gx).unwrap().len(), 2);
        assert!(parse("<gpx></gpx>").is_err());
        assert!(parse("<gpx><wpt lat=\"999\" lon=\"0\"/></gpx>").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn walks_the_track() {
        let t = Track::new(parse(GPX).unwrap());
        assert!(
            t.length() > 25_000.0 && t.length() < 27_000.0,
            "{}",
            t.length()
        );
        let (start, _) = t.at(0.0);
        assert_eq!(start.lat, 32.8954);
        let (end, _) = t.at(1e9);
        assert_eq!(end.lat, 32.6635);
        let (mid, b) = t.at(t.length() / 2.0);
        assert!(mid.lat < 32.89 && mid.lat > 32.66);
        assert!((150.0..=200.0).contains(&b), "south-ish: {b}");
        let a = Point {
            lat: 0.0,
            lon: 0.0,
            alt: 0.0,
        };
        assert!((bearing(a, Point { lat: 1.0, ..a }) - 0.0).abs() < 1e-6);
        assert!((bearing(a, Point { lon: 1.0, ..a }) - 90.0).abs() < 1e-6);
    }
}

//! `CommandProvider` for sensors, phone, network, dev tools, screenshots,
//! recording and snapshots (plan Phases 8a, 8b, 10a, 10b). Registered in
//! the daemon by Stream A through [`provider`] (gap A1). Apache-2.0, no Slint.

use std::sync::Arc;

use async_trait::async_trait;
use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, CommandProvider, CommandSpec};
use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};
use serde_json::Value;

pub mod apk;
pub mod apps;
pub mod battery;
pub mod device;
pub mod devtools;
pub mod extras;
pub mod gps;
pub mod media;
pub mod network;
pub mod phone;
pub mod sensors;
pub mod snapshots;

/// The widgets provider, ready to register with the daemon.
pub fn provider() -> Arc<dyn CommandProvider> {
    Arc::new(WidgetsProvider::default())
}

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct WidgetsProvider {
    routes: gps::Routes,
    recordings: media::Recordings,
}

#[async_trait]
impl CommandProvider for WidgetsProvider {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "widgets"
    }

    fn commands(&self) -> Vec<CommandSpec> {
        let mut v = Vec::new();
        v.extend(apps::specs());
        v.extend(battery::specs());
        v.extend(sensors::specs());
        v.extend(network::specs());
        v.extend(phone::specs());
        v.extend(devtools::specs());
        v.extend(extras::specs());
        v.extend(gps::specs());
        v.extend(media::specs());
        v.extend(snapshots::specs());
        v
    }

    async fn call(&self, ctx: &CallCtx, method: &str, params: Value) -> JidrResult<Value> {
        match method.split('.').next().unwrap_or_default() {
            "app" => apps::call(ctx, method, params).await,
            "battery" => battery::call(ctx, method, params).await,
            "sensor" => sensors::call(ctx, method, params).await,
            "network" => network::call(ctx, method, params).await,
            "phone" => phone::call(ctx, method, params).await,
            "key" | "dev" | "clipboard" => devtools::call(ctx, method, params).await,
            "fingerprint" | "camera" => extras::call(ctx, method, params).await,
            "gps" => gps::call(ctx, &self.routes, method, params).await,
            "media" => media::call(ctx, &self.recordings, method, params).await,
            "snapshot" => snapshots::call(ctx, method, params).await,
            _ => Err(JidrError::usage(format!("unknown method {method}"))),
        }
    }
}
