`crates/jidr-widgets/src/media/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! Screenshots (gRPC `getScreenshot` → PNG) and screen recording: the
//! daemon streams frames from the emulator and encodes MP4/H.264 at a
//! constant frame rate (D13; no 180 s cap; audio post-MVP).

#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
pub mod mp4;

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::Duration;
#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
use std::time::Instant;

use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, CommandSpec, DeviceParams, parse_params};
use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};
use jidr_proto::control as pb;
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::device::{Target, grpc_err, target};

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ShotParams {
    pub device: String,
    /// Where to save the PNG (default `~/Pictures/Jidr/<device> <time>.png`).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub path: Option<PathBuf>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RecordParams {
    pub device: String,
    /// Where to save the MP4 (default `~/Movies/Jidr/<device> <time>.mp4`).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub path: Option<PathBuf>,
    /// Stop on its own after this many seconds (default 3600).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub max_seconds: Option<u64>,
    /// Frames per second (default 30).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub fps: Option<u32>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct Recordings(Mutex<HashMap<Uuid, Arc<AtomicBool>>>);

pub fn specs() -> Vec<CommandSpec> {
    vec![
        CommandSpec::new::<ShotParams>("media.screenshot", "Save a PNG of the screen"),
        CommandSpec::new::<RecordParams>(
            "media.record",
            "Record the screen to MP4 (H.264) until media.record_stop or max_seconds",
        )
        .long_running(),
        CommandSpec::new::<DeviceParams>(
            "media.record_stop",
            "Stop the screen recording and save it",
        ),
    ]
}

/// `<dir>/<name> 2026-10-13 at 14.02.07.<ext>`, made unique.
pub fn default_path(dir: &Path, name: &str, ext: &str) -> PathBuf {
    let stamp = chrono::Local::now().format("%Y-%m-%d at %H.%M.%S");
    let safe: String = name
        .chars()
        .map(|c| {
            if matches!(c, '/' | ':' | '\\' | '"') || c.is_control() {
                '-'
            } else {
                c
            }
        })
        .collect();
    let mut p = dir.join(format!("{safe} {stamp}.{ext}"));
    let mut n = 2;
    while p.exists() {
        p = dir.join(format!("{safe} {stamp} {n}.{ext}"));
        n += 1;
    }
    p
}

fn home_dir(sub: &str) -> PathBuf {
    dirs::home_dir()
        .unwrap_or_else(std::env::temp_dir)
        .join(sub)
        .join("Jidr")
}

/// Recording size: the device's, long side capped at 1280, even sides.
pub fn record_size(w: u32, h: u32) -> (u32, u32) {
    let long = w.max(h).max(1);
    let k = (1280.0 / f64::from(long)).min(1.0);
    let (w, h) = ((f64::from(w) * k) as u32, (f64::from(h) * k) as u32);
    (w & !1, h & !1)
}

#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
async fn lcd_size(t: &Target) -> JidrResult<(u32, u32)> {
    let st = t
        .grpc()
        .await?
        .get_status(())
        .await
        .map_err(grpc_err("getStatus"))?
        .into_inner();
    // Newer SDK protos mark `hardwareConfig` deprecated; the build uses the
    // installed SDK's protos when there is one, so allow it either way.
    #[allow(deprecated)]
    let get = |k: &str| {
        st.hardware_config
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(|c| c.entry.iter().find(|e| e.key == k))
            .and_then(|e| e.value.parse::<u32>().ok())
    };
    match (get("hw.lcd.width"), get("hw.lcd.height")) {
        (Some(w), Some(h)) => Ok((w, h)),
        _ => Err(JidrError::sdk("the emulator didn't report its screen size")),
    }
}

pub async fn call(
    ctx: &CallCtx,
    recs: &Recordings,
    method: &str,
    params: Value,
) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    match method {
        "media.screenshot" => {
            let p: ShotParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let img = t
                .grpc()
                .await?
                .get_screenshot(pb::ImageFormat {
                    format: pb::image_format::ImgFormat::Png as i32,
                    ..Default::default()
                })
                .await
                .map_err(grpc_err("getScreenshot"))?
                .into_inner();
            let path = p
                .path
                .unwrap_or_else(|| default_path(&home_dir("Pictures"), &t.device.name, "png"));
            if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
                std::fs::create_dir_all(dir).map_err(|e| {
                    JidrError::usage(format!("cannot create {}: {e}", dir.display()))
                })?;
            }
            std::fs::write(&path, &img.image)
                .map_err(|e| JidrError::usage(format!("cannot write {}: {e}", path.display())))?;
            let (w, h) = img.format.map(|f| (f.width, f.height)).unwrap_or((0, 0));
            Ok(json!({ "path": path, "width": w, "height": h }))
        }
        "media.record" => {
            let p: RecordParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let fps = p.fps.unwrap_or(30).clamp(1, 60);
            let max = Duration::from_secs(p.max_seconds.unwrap_or(3600).max(1));
            let path = p
                .path
                .unwrap_or_else(|| default_path(&home_dir("Movies"), &t.device.name, "mp4"));
            if path.exists() {
                return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
                    "{} already exists",
                    path.display()
                )));
            }
            if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
                std::fs::create_dir_all(dir).map_err(|e| {
                    JidrError::usage(format!("cannot create {}: {e}", dir.display()))
                })?;
            }
            let stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
            if let Ok(mut m) = recs.0.lock() {
                if m.contains_key(&t.device.id) {
                    return Err(JidrError::busy(format!(
                        "{} is already recording",
                        t.device.name
                    )));
                }
                m.insert(t.device.id, stop.clone());
            }
            let r = record(ctx, &t, &path, fps, max, stop).await;
            if let Ok(mut m) = recs.0.lock() {
                m.remove(&t.device.id);
            }
            r
        }
        "media.record_stop" => {
            let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let d = ctx.daemon.device(&p.device).await?;
            let flag = recs.0.lock().ok().and_then(|m| m.get(&d.id).cloned());
            match flag {
                Some(f) => {
                    f.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
                    Ok(json!({ "stopping": true }))
                }
                None => Err(JidrError::not_found(format!("{} isn't recording", d.name))),
            }
        }
        _ => Err(JidrError::usage(format!("unknown method {method}"))),
    }
}

/// The latest frame from the stream.
#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
#[derive(Default)]
struct Latest {
    frame: Option<(u32, u32, Vec<u8>)>,
}

/// Copies frames into `slot` until the stream ends, then sets `ended`: when
/// the device stops or crashes the encoder finishes the file instead of
/// repeating the last frame until `max_seconds`.
#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
async fn pump<S>(mut frames: S, slot: Arc<Mutex<Latest>>, ended: Arc<AtomicBool>)
where
    S: tokio_stream::Stream<Item = Result<pb::Image, tonic::Status>> + Unpin,
{
    use tokio_stream::StreamExt as _;
    while let Some(Ok(img)) = frames.next().await {
        if let (Some(f), false) = (img.format, img.image.is_empty())
            && let Ok(mut l) = slot.lock()
        {
            l.frame = Some((f.width, f.height, img.image));
        }
    }
    ended.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
async fn record(
    ctx: &CallCtx,
    t: &Target,
    path: &Path,
    fps: u32,
    max: Duration,
    stop: Arc<AtomicBool>,
) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    let (lw, lh) = lcd_size(t).await?;
    let (w, h) = record_size(lw, lh);
    let latest: Arc<Mutex<Latest>> = Arc::default();
    // Frame stream (emulator → latest slot).
    let mut grpc = t.grpc().await?;
    let stream = grpc
        .stream_screenshot(pb::ImageFormat {
            format: pb::image_format::ImgFormat::Rgba8888 as i32,
            width: w,
            height: h,
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .await
        .map_err(grpc_err("streamScreenshot"))?
        .into_inner();
    let reader = tokio::spawn(pump(stream, latest.clone(), stop.clone()));
    // Encoder on its own thread at a constant rate; duplicates the last
    // frame when the screen doesn't change.
    let cancel = ctx.cancel.clone();
    let progress = ctx.progress.clone();
    let path_buf = path.to_path_buf();
    let enc = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || -> JidrResult<(i64, bool)> {
        let mut writer: Option<mp4::Mp4Writer> = None;
        let start = Instant::now();
        let mut last_report = Instant::now();
        let mut cancelled = false;
        let frame_dt = Duration::from_secs_f64(1.0 / f64::from(fps));
        let mut current: Option<Vec<u8>> = None;
        loop {
            if cancel.is_cancelled() {
                cancelled = true;
                break;
            }
            let elapsed = start.elapsed();
            if stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) || elapsed >= max {
                break;
            }
            if let Ok(mut l) = latest.lock()
                && let Some((fw, fh, px)) = l.frame.take()
            {
                if writer.is_none() {
                    writer = Some(mp4::Mp4Writer::create(&path_buf, fw, fh, fps as i32)?);
                }
                if let Some(wr) = writer.as_ref() {
                    // Frames of another size (rotation) are cropped/padded to the first.
                    current = Some(fit(&px, fw, fh, wr.size()));
                }
            }
            if let (Some(wr), Some(px)) = (writer.as_mut(), current.as_ref()) {
                // Catch up to the wall clock with the latest frame.
                let due = (start.elapsed().as_secs_f64() * f64::from(fps)) as i64;
                while wr.frames() <= due {
                    wr.push(px)?;
                }
            }
            if last_report.elapsed() >= Duration::from_secs(1) {
                last_report = Instant::now();
                let s = start.elapsed().as_secs();
                progress(
                    Some((elapsed.as_secs_f64() / max.as_secs_f64()) as f32),
                    &format!("Recording {}:{:02}", s / 60, s % 60),
                );
            }
            std::thread::sleep(frame_dt / 2);
        }
        let frames = writer.as_ref().map(mp4::Mp4Writer::frames).unwrap_or(0);
        match writer {
            Some(w) if cancelled => w.cancel(),
            Some(w) => w.finish()?,
            None => {}
        }
        Ok((frames, cancelled))
    });
    let r = enc
        .await
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(format!("encoder: {e}")))?;
    reader.abort();
    let (frames, cancelled) = r?;
    if cancelled {
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(path);
        return Err(jidr_core::cancel::cancelled());
    }
    if frames == 0 {
        return Err(JidrError::sdk("no frames arrived from the emulator"));
    }
    Ok(json!({
        "path": path,
        "frames": frames,
        "fps": fps,
        "duration_s": frames as f64 / f64::from(fps),
        "width": w,
        "height": h,
    }))
}

#[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
async fn record(
    _ctx: &CallCtx,
    _t: &Target,
    _path: &Path,
    _fps: u32,
    _max: Duration,
    _stop: Arc<AtomicBool>,
) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    Err(JidrError::sdk(
        "screen recording uses VideoToolbox and is macOS-only for now",
    ))
}

/// Copies an RGBA frame into a `size` canvas (top-left aligned, black pad).
pub fn fit(px: &[u8], w: u32, h: u32, size: (u32, u32)) -> Vec<u8> {
    let (tw, th) = (size.0 as usize, size.1 as usize);
    let (w, h) = (w as usize, h as usize);
    if (w, h) == (tw, th) && px.len() >= tw * th * 4 {
        return px[..tw * th * 4].to_vec();
    }
    let mut out = vec![0u8; tw * th * 4];
    for y in 0..th.min(h) {
        let n = tw.min(w) * 4;
        let (s, d) = (y * w * 4, y * tw * 4);
        if let (Some(src), Some(dst)) = (px.get(s..s + n), out.get_mut(d..d + n)) {
            dst.copy_from_slice(src);
        }
    }
    out
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn record_size_caps_the_long_side_and_keeps_it_even() {
        assert_eq!(record_size(1080, 2400), (576, 1280));
        assert_eq!(record_size(720, 1280), (720, 1280));
        assert_eq!(record_size(1601, 2561), (800, 1280));
    }

    #[test]
    fn fit_pads_and_crops() {
        let px = vec![7u8; 2 * 2 * 4];
        let out = fit(&px, 2, 2, (3, 1));
        assert_eq!(out.len(), 12);
        assert_eq!(&out[..8], &[7; 8]);
        assert_eq!(&out[8..], &[0; 4]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn default_paths_are_unique() {
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let a = default_path(tmp.path(), "Pixel/ish", "png");
        std::fs::write(&a, b"x").unwrap();
        let b = default_path(tmp.path(), "Pixel/ish", "png");
        assert_ne!(a, b);
        assert!(
            a.file_name()
                .unwrap()
                .to_string_lossy()
                .starts_with("Pixel-ish ")
        );
    }

    /// Device names may hold `\` and `"`; file names never do (they reach
    /// the GUI's pasteboard script).
    #[test]
    fn default_paths_drop_quotes_backslashes_and_controls() {
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let p = default_path(tmp.path(), "a\\\"&(x)\n--", "png");
        let name = p.file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
        assert!(name.starts_with("a--&(x)--- "), "{name}");
        assert_eq!(p.parent(), Some(tmp.path()));
    }

    /// Regression (review of PR #3): when the frame stream ended (device
    /// stopped), the encoder kept repeating the last frame until
    /// `max_seconds`, and `media.record` stayed busy for up to an hour.
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn the_recorder_stops_when_the_frame_stream_ends() {
        let img = pb::Image {
            format: Some(pb::ImageFormat {
                width: 2,
                height: 1,
                ..Default::default()
            }),
            image: vec![1; 8],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        for frames in [
            vec![Ok(img.clone())],
            vec![Ok(img.clone()), Err(tonic::Status::unavailable("gone"))],
        ] {
            let slot: Arc<Mutex<Latest>> = Arc::default();
            let ended = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
            pump(tokio_stream::iter(frames), slot.clone(), ended.clone()).await;
            assert!(ended.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
            assert_eq!(
                slot.lock().unwrap().frame.as_ref().map(|f| (f.0, f.1)),
                Some((2, 1))
            );
        }
    }

    /// Encodes 2 s of frames and checks the file is a valid MP4.
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    #[test]
    fn writes_an_mp4() {
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let path = tmp.path().join("t.mp4");
        let mut w = mp4::Mp4Writer::create(&path, 320, 240, 30).unwrap();
        let mut px = vec![0u8; 320 * 240 * 4];
        for i in 0..60u32 {
            px.iter_mut().for_each(|b| *b = (i * 4) as u8);
            w.push(&px).unwrap();
        }
        w.finish().unwrap();
        let bytes = std::fs::read(&path).unwrap();
        assert!(bytes.len() > 1000);
        assert_eq!(&bytes[4..8], b"ftyp");
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-widgets/src/media/mp4.rs`:

```rs
//! MP4/H.264 writer on AVFoundation's `AVAssetWriter`, which encodes with
//! VideoToolbox in hardware (D13). Frames come in as RGBA, are copied into
//! BGRA pixel buffers from the writer's pool and stamped at a fixed rate.
//!
//! `unsafe` is allowed here only: these are FFI calls into Apple frameworks
//! through the `objc2` bindings. Every call keeps to the documented API:
//! objects are created and used on one thread, pixel buffers are locked
//! while written, and the writer is finished before it's dropped.
#![allow(unsafe_code)]

use std::path::Path;
use std::ptr::NonNull;
use std::sync::mpsc;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};
use objc2::rc::Retained;
use objc2::runtime::AnyObject;
use objc2_av_foundation::{
    AVAssetWriter, AVAssetWriterInput, AVAssetWriterInputPixelBufferAdaptor, AVAssetWriterStatus,
    AVFileTypeMPEG4, AVMediaTypeVideo, AVVideoAverageBitRateKey, AVVideoCodecKey,
    AVVideoCodecTypeH264, AVVideoCompressionPropertiesKey, AVVideoHeightKey, AVVideoWidthKey,
};
use objc2_core_foundation::{CFRetained, CFString};
use objc2_core_media::{CMTime, CMTimeFlags};
use objc2_core_video::{
    CVPixelBuffer, CVPixelBufferGetBaseAddress, CVPixelBufferGetBytesPerRow,
    CVPixelBufferLockBaseAddress, CVPixelBufferLockFlags, CVPixelBufferPool,
    CVPixelBufferUnlockBaseAddress, kCVPixelBufferHeightKey, kCVPixelBufferPixelFormatTypeKey,
    kCVPixelBufferWidthKey, kCVPixelFormatType_32BGRA, kCVReturnSuccess,
};
use objc2_foundation::{NSDictionary, NSNumber, NSString, NSURL};

fn err(what: impl Into<String>) -> JidrError {
    JidrError::unexpected(format!("recording: {}", what.into()))
}

/// CF strings are toll-free bridged to `NSString`.
fn ns(key: &CFString) -> &NSString {
    // SAFETY: CFString and NSString are toll-free bridged; same object.
    unsafe { &*(std::ptr::from_ref(key).cast::<NSString>()) }
}

fn time(frame: i64, fps: i32) -> CMTime {
    CMTime {
        value: frame,
        timescale: fps,
        flags: CMTimeFlags::Valid,
        epoch: 0,
    }
}

pub struct Mp4Writer {
    writer: Retained<AVAssetWriter>,
    input: Retained<AVAssetWriterInput>,
    adaptor: Retained<AVAssetWriterInputPixelBufferAdaptor>,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
    fps: i32,
    frames: i64,
}

impl Mp4Writer {
    /// Starts an H.264 MP4 at `path` (must not exist). Sides are rounded
    /// down to even numbers, as H.264 requires.
    pub fn create(path: &Path, width: u32, height: u32, fps: i32) -> JidrResult<Self> {
        let (width, height) = (width & !1, height & !1);
        if width < 16 || height < 16 {
            return Err(err("frame too small"));
        }
        let path_str = path.to_str().ok_or_else(|| err("path isn't UTF-8"))?;
        // SAFETY: documented AVFoundation calls with valid, retained arguments.
        unsafe {
            let url = NSURL::fileURLWithPath(&NSString::from_str(path_str));
            let file_type = AVFileTypeMPEG4.ok_or_else(|| err("no MPEG-4 file type"))?;
            let writer = AVAssetWriter::assetWriterWithURL_fileType_error(&url, file_type)
                .map_err(|e| err(e.localizedDescription().to_string()))?;

            let bitrate = NSNumber::new_u32((width * height * 4).clamp(2_000_000, 16_000_000));
            let compression = NSDictionary::<NSString, AnyObject>::from_slices(
                &[AVVideoAverageBitRateKey.ok_or_else(|| err("no bitrate key"))?],
                &[&*bitrate as &AnyObject],
            );
            let w = NSNumber::new_u32(width);
            let h = NSNumber::new_u32(height);
            let codec = AVVideoCodecTypeH264.ok_or_else(|| err("no H.264 codec"))?;
            let settings = NSDictionary::<NSString, AnyObject>::from_slices(
                &[
                    AVVideoCodecKey.ok_or_else(|| err("no codec key"))?,
                    AVVideoWidthKey.ok_or_else(|| err("no width key"))?,
                    AVVideoHeightKey.ok_or_else(|| err("no height key"))?,
                    AVVideoCompressionPropertiesKey.ok_or_else(|| err("no compression key"))?,
                ],
                &[
                    &**codec as &AnyObject,
                    &*w as &AnyObject,
                    &*h as &AnyObject,
                    &*compression as &AnyObject,
                ],
            );
            let media = AVMediaTypeVideo.ok_or_else(|| err("no video media type"))?;
            let input = AVAssetWriterInput::assetWriterInputWithMediaType_outputSettings(
                media,
                Some(&settings),
            );
            input.setExpectsMediaDataInRealTime(true);

            let fmt = NSNumber::new_u32(kCVPixelFormatType_32BGRA);
            let attrs = NSDictionary::<NSString, AnyObject>::from_slices(
                &[
                    ns(kCVPixelBufferPixelFormatTypeKey),
                    ns(kCVPixelBufferWidthKey),
                    ns(kCVPixelBufferHeightKey),
                ],
                &[&*fmt as &AnyObject, &*w as &AnyObject, &*h as &AnyObject],
            );
            let adaptor = AVAssetWriterInputPixelBufferAdaptor::assetWriterInputPixelBufferAdaptorWithAssetWriterInput_sourcePixelBufferAttributes(
                &input,
                Some(&attrs),
            );
            if !writer.canAddInput(&input) {
                return Err(err("the writer refused the video input"));
            }
            writer.addInput(&input);
            if !writer.startWriting() {
                return Err(err(writer
                    .error()
                    .map(|e| e.localizedDescription().to_string())
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| "can't start writing".into())));
            }
            writer.startSessionAtSourceTime(time(0, fps));
            Ok(Self {
                writer,
                input,
                adaptor,
                width,
                height,
                fps,
                frames: 0,
            })
        }
    }

    pub fn size(&self) -> (u32, u32) {
        (self.width, self.height)
    }

    pub fn frames(&self) -> i64 {
        self.frames
    }

    fn pool(&self) -> JidrResult<Retained<CVPixelBufferPool>> {
        // SAFETY: the pool exists once writing has started.
        unsafe { self.adaptor.pixelBufferPool() }.ok_or_else(|| err("no pixel buffer pool"))
    }

    /// Appends one RGBA frame of exactly `size()` as the next frame.
    pub fn push(&mut self, rgba: &[u8]) -> JidrResult<()> {
        let (w, h) = (self.width as usize, self.height as usize);
        if rgba.len() < w * h * 4 {
            return Err(err("short frame"));
        }
        // Wait (briefly) for the encoder to take more data.
        let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_millis(500);
        // SAFETY: plain property read on the input we own.
        while !unsafe { self.input.isReadyForMoreMediaData() } {
            if Instant::now() > deadline {
                return Err(err("the encoder stopped taking frames"));
            }
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1));
        }
        let pool = self.pool()?;
        let mut out: *mut CVPixelBuffer = std::ptr::null_mut();
        // SAFETY: valid pool and out-pointer; on success we own the buffer (+1).
        let rc =
            unsafe { CVPixelBufferPool::create_pixel_buffer(None, &pool, NonNull::from(&mut out)) };
        if rc != kCVReturnSuccess {
            return Err(err(format!("no pixel buffer ({rc})")));
        }
        let buf: CFRetained<CVPixelBuffer> = unsafe {
            // SAFETY: created above with a +1 retain count.
            CFRetained::from_raw(NonNull::new(out).ok_or_else(|| err("null pixel buffer"))?)
        };
        // SAFETY: lock, write within bytes_per_row × height, unlock.
        unsafe {
            if CVPixelBufferLockBaseAddress(&buf, CVPixelBufferLockFlags(0)) != kCVReturnSuccess {
                return Err(err("can't lock the pixel buffer"));
            }
            let base = CVPixelBufferGetBaseAddress(&buf).cast::<u8>();
            let stride = CVPixelBufferGetBytesPerRow(&buf);
            if base.is_null() || stride < w * 4 {
                CVPixelBufferUnlockBaseAddress(&buf, CVPixelBufferLockFlags(0));
                return Err(err("bad pixel buffer"));
            }
            for y in 0..h {
                let dst = std::slice::from_raw_parts_mut(base.add(y * stride), w * 4);
                let src = &rgba[y * w * 4..(y + 1) * w * 4];
                for (d, s) in dst
                    .as_chunks_mut::<4>()
                    .0
                    .iter_mut()
                    .zip(src.as_chunks::<4>().0)
                {
                    *d = [s[2], s[1], s[0], 255];
                }
            }
            CVPixelBufferUnlockBaseAddress(&buf, CVPixelBufferLockFlags(0));
        }
        // SAFETY: append from the writer's own thread with a valid buffer.
        let ok = unsafe {
            self.adaptor
                .appendPixelBuffer_withPresentationTime(&buf, time(self.frames, self.fps))
        };
        if !ok {
            return Err(err(self.failure()));
        }
        self.frames += 1;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn failure(&self) -> String {
        // SAFETY: property reads.
        unsafe {
            self.writer
                .error()
                .map(|e| e.localizedDescription().to_string())
                .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("writer status {:?}", self.writer.status()))
        }
    }

    /// Finishes the file and waits for it to be written.
    pub fn finish(self) -> JidrResult<()> {
        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel::<()>();
        let block = block2::RcBlock::new(move || {
            let _ = tx.send(());
        });
        // SAFETY: all appends returned; the block only signals a channel.
        unsafe {
            self.input.markAsFinished();
            self.writer
                .endSessionAtSourceTime(time(self.frames.max(1), self.fps));
            self.writer.finishWritingWithCompletionHandler(&block);
        }
        rx.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(60))
            .map_err(|_| err("finishing the file timed out"))?;
        // SAFETY: property read.
        if unsafe { self.writer.status() } == AVAssetWriterStatus::Completed {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(err(self.failure()))
        }
    }

    /// Abandons the file.
    pub fn cancel(self) {
        // SAFETY: documented cancel.
        unsafe { self.writer.cancelWriting() };
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-widgets/src/network.rs`:

```rs
//! Network widget: Wi-Fi on/off (`svc wifi`), mobile data on/off (console
//! `gsm data`), speed and delay profiles (console `network speed/delay`)
//! and the global HTTP proxy (`settings global http_proxy`, [`proxy`]).
//!
//! Mobile data is switched at the emulated radio, not with Android's own
//! switch: `svc data` / `cmd phone data` exit 0 and change nothing on the
//! API 35 images (CI run 38625267538), while the console works on every image.
//! Android's Quick Settings switch stays as it was; the device just has no
//! mobile data network, as when it loses coverage.

use jidr_backend::console::GsmLine;
use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, CommandSpec, DeviceParams, parse_params};
use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::{Value, json};

use crate::device::target;

pub mod proxy;

/// Named profiles (speed + latency pairs from the console's own tables).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum Profile {
    /// No throttling.
    Full,
    /// LTE speed, no added delay.
    Lte,
    /// HSDPA (3.5G).
    Hsdpa,
    /// UMTS (3G) speed and delay.
    Umts,
    /// EDGE (2.5G) speed and delay.
    Edge,
    /// GPRS speed, GSM delay.
    Gprs,
    /// GSM (2G) speed and delay.
    Gsm,
}

impl Profile {
    /// (console `network speed`, console `network delay`).
    pub fn console(self) -> (&'static str, &'static str) {
        match self {
            Profile::Full => ("full", "none"),
            Profile::Lte => ("lte", "none"),
            Profile::Hsdpa => ("hsdpa", "umts"),
            Profile::Umts => ("umts", "umts"),
            Profile::Edge => ("edge", "edge"),
            Profile::Gprs => ("gprs", "gsm"),
            Profile::Gsm => ("gsm", "gsm"),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SetParams {
    pub device: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub wifi: Option<bool>,
    /// Mobile data.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub mobile: Option<bool>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub profile: Option<Profile>,
}

pub fn specs() -> Vec<CommandSpec> {
    vec![
        CommandSpec::new::<DeviceParams>("network.get", "Wi-Fi, mobile data and speed profile"),
        CommandSpec::new::<SetParams>(
            "network.set",
            "Turn Wi-Fi or mobile data on/off and set the speed/delay profile",
        ),
        CommandSpec::new::<DeviceParams>(
            "network.proxy.get",
            "The device's global HTTP proxy, or null when there is none",
        ),
        CommandSpec::new::<proxy::SetParams>(
            "network.proxy.set",
            "Send the device's HTTP(S) traffic through a proxy (10.0.2.2 is this Mac), e.g. Burp or mitmproxy",
        ),
        CommandSpec::new::<DeviceParams>(
            "network.proxy.clear",
            "Remove the device's global HTTP proxy",
        ),
    ]
}

fn on_off(v: bool) -> &'static str {
    if v { "enable" } else { "disable" }
}

/// Whether the emulated radio has mobile data, from the console's
/// `gsm status` reply (`gsm data state:  home`): registered at home or roaming.
fn mobile_data_on(gsm_status: &[String]) -> Option<bool> {
    let state = gsm_status
        .iter()
        .find_map(|l| l.trim().strip_prefix("gsm data state:"))?
        .trim();
    Some(matches!(state, "home" | "roaming"))
}

/// Did the radio take `gsm data on|off`? `false` when `gsm status` shows
/// the other state or no data state at all.
fn radio_took(want: bool, gsm_status: &[String]) -> bool {
    mobile_data_on(gsm_status) == Some(want)
}

pub async fn call(ctx: &CallCtx, method: &str, params: Value) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    match method {
        "network.proxy.get" => {
            let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
            proxy::get(&target(ctx, &p.device).await?.adb()).await
        }
        "network.proxy.set" => {
            let p: proxy::SetParams = parse_params(params)?;
            // Refuse a bad host or port before looking for the device.
            let host = proxy::check(&p.host, p.port)?;
            proxy::set(&target(ctx, &p.device).await?.adb(), host, p.port).await
        }
        "network.proxy.clear" => {
            let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
            proxy::clear(&target(ctx, &p.device).await?.adb()).await
        }
        "network.get" => {
            let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let adb = t.adb();
            let wifi = adb.shell("settings get global wifi_on").await?.trim() == "1";
            let gsm = t.console_cmd("gsm status").await?;
            let mobile = mobile_data_on(&gsm).ok_or_else(|| {
                JidrError::unexpected(format!("no data state in `gsm status`: {gsm:?}"))
            })?;
            let status = t.console_cmd("network status").await.unwrap_or_default();
            Ok(json!({ "wifi": wifi, "mobile": mobile, "status": status }))
        }
        "network.set" => {
            let p: SetParams = parse_params(params)?;
            if p.wifi.is_none() && p.mobile.is_none() && p.profile.is_none() {
                return Err(JidrError::usage("give wifi, mobile or profile"));
            }
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let adb = t.adb();
            if let Some(w) = p.wifi {
                adb.shell(&format!("svc wifi {}", on_off(w))).await?;
            }
            if p.mobile.is_some() || p.profile.is_some() {
                let mut c = t.console().await?;
                if let Some(m) = p.mobile {
                    // Check the radio took it, and send it once more if not
                    // (API 33 CI once kept data registered after `gsm data off`).
                    let mut status = Vec::new();
                    for _ in 0..2 {
                        c.gsm_state(GsmLine::Data, if m { "home" } else { "off" })
                            .await?;
                        status = c.command("gsm status").await?;
                        if radio_took(m, &status) {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if !radio_took(m, &status) {
                        return Err(JidrError::sdk(format!(
                            "the emulated radio didn't turn mobile data {}: {status:?}",
                            on_off(m)
                        )));
                    }
                }
                if let Some(pr) = p.profile {
                    let (speed, delay) = pr.console();
                    c.network_speed(speed).await?;
                    c.network_delay(delay).await?;
                }
            }
            Ok(json!({ "wifi": p.wifi, "mobile": p.mobile, "profile": p.profile }))
        }
        _ => Err(JidrError::usage(format!("unknown method {method}"))),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn profiles_map_to_console_tables() {
        assert_eq!(Profile::Edge.console(), ("edge", "edge"));
        assert_eq!(Profile::Full.console(), ("full", "none"));
        let p: SetParams = parse_params(json!({"device": "d", "profile": "umts"})).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p.profile, Some(Profile::Umts));
    }

    #[test]
    fn mobile_data_follows_the_radio_data_state() {
        let status = |data: &str| {
            vec![
                "gsm voice state: home".to_string(),
                format!("gsm data state:  {data}"),
            ]
        };
        assert_eq!(mobile_data_on(&status("home")), Some(true));
        assert_eq!(mobile_data_on(&status("roaming")), Some(true));
        assert_eq!(mobile_data_on(&status("off")), Some(false));
        assert_eq!(mobile_data_on(&status("unregistered")), Some(false));
        assert_eq!(mobile_data_on(&["OK".to_string()]), None);
    }

    /// Regression (API 33 CI, PR #10/#11): data stayed registered after
    /// `gsm data off`; network.set now checks `gsm status` and resends.
    #[test]
    fn network_set_checks_the_radio_took_the_data_state() {
        let status = |data: &str| vec![format!("gsm data state:  {data}")];
        assert!(radio_took(false, &status("off")));
        assert!(radio_took(false, &status("unregistered")));
        assert!(!radio_took(false, &status("home")));
        assert!(radio_took(true, &status("roaming")));
        assert!(!radio_took(true, &status("off")));
        assert!(!radio_took(true, &["KO: unknown".to_string()]));
        assert!(!radio_took(false, &[]));
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-widgets/src/network/proxy.rs`:

```rs
//! The device's global HTTP proxy, for Burp or mitmproxy on the Mac.
//!
//! `settings put global http_proxy host:port` is what Android's own
//! `ConnectivityManager` reads; it takes effect at once on API 29–36, holds
//! for every network (Wi-Fi and mobile) and survives reboots and snapshots.
//! The emulator's `-http-proxy` is launch-only, and neither the console nor
//! gRPC can change a proxy on a running device.
//!
//! Clearing writes `:0` instead of deleting the setting: Android only
//! notices a deleted `http_proxy` after a reboot.

use jidr_adb::Adb;
use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::{Value, json};

/// The host's loopback as the emulator sees it.
pub const HOST_LOOPBACK: &str = "10.0.2.2";

/// The settings Android's own proxy screens write next to `http_proxy`;
/// cleared too so nothing brings an old proxy back.
const UI_KEYS: [&str; 3] = [
    "global_http_proxy_host",
    "global_http_proxy_port",
    "global_http_proxy_exclusion_list",
];

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SetParams {
    pub device: String,
    /// Hostname or IPv4 address as the device sees it: `10.0.2.2` is this
    /// Mac, `127.0.0.1` the device itself (with `adb reverse`).
    pub host: String,
    pub port: u16,
}

/// `host:port` from `settings get global http_proxy`; `None` for no proxy
/// (`null`, empty, or the `:0` that clearing writes).
pub fn parse(setting: &str) -> Option<(String, u16)> {
    let (host, port) = setting.trim().rsplit_once(':')?;
    let port: u16 = port.parse().ok()?;
    (!host.is_empty() && port != 0).then(|| (host.to_string(), port))
}

/// A host safe to put in `settings put` (it goes through `adb shell`):
/// letters, digits, dots and dashes, as in a hostname or an IPv4 address.
pub fn check_host(host: &str) -> JidrResult<&str> {
    let host = host.trim();
    let valid = !host.is_empty()
        && host.len() <= 253
        && !host.starts_with(['-', '.'])
        && host
            .chars()
            .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '.' || c == '-');
    if valid {
        Ok(host)
    } else {
        Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
            "host: {host:?} isn't a hostname or IPv4 address (use {HOST_LOOPBACK} for this Mac)"
        ))
        .with_data(json!({ "field": "host" })))
    }
}

fn result(proxy: Option<(String, u16)>) -> Value {
    match proxy {
        Some((host, port)) => {
            json!({ "proxy": format!("{host}:{port}"), "host": host, "port": port })
        }
        None => json!({ "proxy": null, "host": null, "port": null }),
    }
}

async fn read(adb: &Adb) -> JidrResult<Option<(String, u16)>> {
    Ok(parse(&adb.shell("settings get global http_proxy").await?))
}

pub async fn get(adb: &Adb) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    Ok(result(read(adb).await?))
}

/// Checks a proxy before it is set; returns the trimmed host.
pub fn check(host: &str, port: u16) -> JidrResult<&str> {
    let host = check_host(host)?;
    if port == 0 {
        return Err(JidrError::usage("port: must be 1–65535").with_data(json!({ "field": "port" })));
    }
    Ok(host)
}

pub async fn set(adb: &Adb, host: &str, port: u16) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    let host = check(host, port)?;
    adb.shell(&format!("settings put global http_proxy {host}:{port}"))
        .await?;
    let now = read(adb).await?;
    if now.as_ref() != Some(&(host.to_string(), port)) {
        return Err(JidrError::unexpected(format!(
            "the device didn't take the proxy {host}:{port}: http_proxy is {now:?}"
        )));
    }
    Ok(result(now))
}

pub async fn clear(adb: &Adb) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    let mut cmd = "settings put global http_proxy :0".to_string();
    for key in UI_KEYS {
        cmd.push_str(&format!("; settings delete global {key} >/dev/null"));
    }
    adb.shell(&cmd).await?;
    let now = read(adb).await?;
    if let Some((host, port)) = now {
        return Err(JidrError::unexpected(format!(
            "the device still has the proxy {host}:{port}"
        )));
    }
    Ok(result(None))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn reads_the_setting() {
        assert_eq!(parse("10.0.2.2:8080\n"), Some(("10.0.2.2".into(), 8080)));
        assert_eq!(parse("proxy.lan:3128"), Some(("proxy.lan".into(), 3128)));
        assert_eq!(parse(":0"), None, "what clear writes");
        assert_eq!(parse("null"), None);
        assert_eq!(parse(""), None);
        assert_eq!(parse("host:"), None);
        assert_eq!(parse("host:0"), None);
        assert_eq!(parse("host:99999"), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn hosts_are_safe_for_the_shell() {
        assert_eq!(check_host(" 10.0.2.2 ").unwrap(), "10.0.2.2");
        assert!(check_host("burp-box.local").is_ok());
        for bad in ["", "a b", "x;reboot", "$(id)", "h:80", "-x", "::1", "a'b"] {
            let e = check_host(bad).unwrap_err();
            assert_eq!(e.data.unwrap()["field"], "host", "{bad}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn port_zero_is_refused() {
        assert_eq!(
            check("10.0.2.2", 0).unwrap_err().data.unwrap()["field"],
            "port"
        );
        assert_eq!(check("10.0.2.2", 8080).unwrap(), "10.0.2.2");
    }

    #[test]
    fn results_name_host_and_port() {
        let v = result(Some(("10.0.2.2".into(), 8080)));
        assert_eq!(v["proxy"], "10.0.2.2:8080");
        assert_eq!(v["port"], 8080);
        assert!(result(None)["proxy"].is_null());
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-widgets/src/phone.rs`:

```rs
//! Phone widget: calls and SMS (gRPC `sendPhone`, `sendSms`) and the GSM
//! baseband: signal bars (`gsm signal-profile`, R3), data/voice state.

use jidr_backend::console::GsmLine;
use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, CommandSpec, parse_params};
use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};
use jidr_proto::control as pb;
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::{Value, json};

use crate::device::{grpc_err, target};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum CallAction {
    /// An incoming call from `number`.
    Incoming,
    Accept,
    Reject,
    Busy,
    End,
    Hold,
    Unhold,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct CallParams {
    pub device: String,
    /// Phone number, digits with optional leading +.
    pub number: String,
    #[serde(default = "incoming")]
    pub action: CallAction,
}

fn incoming() -> CallAction {
    CallAction::Incoming
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SmsParams {
    pub device: String,
    /// Sender number.
    pub from: String,
    pub text: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum GsmState {
    Unregistered,
    Home,
    Roaming,
    Searching,
    Denied,
    Off,
    On,
}

impl GsmState {
    fn word(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            GsmState::Unregistered => "unregistered",
            GsmState::Home => "home",
            GsmState::Roaming => "roaming",
            GsmState::Searching => "searching",
            GsmState::Denied => "denied",
            GsmState::Off => "off",
            GsmState::On => "on",
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GsmParams {
    pub device: String,
    /// Mobile signal bars, 0 (none) to 4 (great).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub signal: Option<u8>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub data: Option<GsmState>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub voice: Option<GsmState>,
}

pub fn specs() -> Vec<CommandSpec> {
    vec![
        CommandSpec::new::<CallParams>(
            "phone.call",
            "Simulate an incoming call or change its state",
        ),
        CommandSpec::new::<SmsParams>("phone.sms", "Deliver an SMS to the device"),
        CommandSpec::new::<GsmParams>(
            "phone.gsm",
            "Mobile signal bars (0–4) and data/voice registration",
        ),
    ]
}

/// Digits with an optional leading `+` (and spaces/dashes the user typed).
pub fn clean_number(n: &str) -> JidrResult<String> {
    let s: String = n
        .chars()
        .filter(|c| !matches!(c, ' ' | '-' | '(' | ')'))
        .collect();
    let digits = s.strip_prefix('+').unwrap_or(&s);
    if digits.is_empty() || digits.len() > 20 || !digits.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()) {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(format!("not a phone number: {n:?}")));
    }
    Ok(s)
}

fn op(a: CallAction) -> pb::phone_call::Operation {
    use pb::phone_call::Operation as O;
    match a {
        CallAction::Incoming => O::InitCall,
        CallAction::Accept => O::AcceptCall,
        CallAction::Reject => O::RejectCallExplicit,
        CallAction::Busy => O::RejectCallBusy,
        CallAction::End => O::DisconnectCall,
        CallAction::Hold => O::PlaceCallOnHold,
        CallAction::Unhold => O::TakeCallOffHold,
    }
}

fn check_response(what: &str, r: &pb::PhoneResponse) -> JidrResult<()> {
    if r.response == pb::phone_response::Response::Ok as i32 {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
            "{what} refused by the modem ({})",
            r.response
        )))
    }
}

pub async fn call(ctx: &CallCtx, method: &str, params: Value) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    match method {
        "phone.call" => {
            let p: CallParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let number = clean_number(&p.number)?;
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let r = t
                .grpc()
                .await?
                .send_phone(pb::PhoneCall {
                    operation: op(p.action) as i32,
                    number: number.clone(),
                })
                .await
                .map_err(grpc_err("sendPhone"))?;
            check_response("call", r.get_ref())?;
            Ok(json!({ "number": number, "action": p.action }))
        }
        "phone.sms" => {
            let p: SmsParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let from = clean_number(&p.from)?;
            if p.text.is_empty() {
                return Err(JidrError::usage("the SMS text is empty"));
            }
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let r = t
                .grpc()
                .await?
                .send_sms(pb::SmsMessage {
                    src_address: from.clone(),
                    text: p.text,
                })
                .await
                .map_err(grpc_err("sendSms"))?;
            check_response("SMS", r.get_ref())?;
            Ok(json!({ "from": from }))
        }
        "phone.gsm" => {
            let p: GsmParams = parse_params(params)?;
            if p.signal.is_some_and(|s| s > 4) {
                return Err(JidrError::usage("signal is 0–4 bars"));
            }
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let mut c = t.console().await?;
            if let Some(s) = p.signal {
                c.command(&format!("gsm signal-profile {s}")).await?;
            }
            if let Some(d) = p.data {
                c.gsm_state(GsmLine::Data, d.word()).await?;
            }
            if let Some(v) = p.voice {
                c.gsm_state(GsmLine::Voice, v.word()).await?;
            }
            Ok(json!({ "signal": p.signal, "data": p.data, "voice": p.voice }))
        }
        _ => Err(JidrError::usage(format!("unknown method {method}"))),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn numbers_are_cleaned_and_checked() {
        assert_eq!(clean_number("+218 91-234 5678").unwrap(), "+218912345678");
        assert!(clean_number("abc").is_err());
        assert!(clean_number("+").is_err());
        assert!(clean_number("12; reboot").is_err());
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-widgets/src/sensors.rs`:

```rs
//! Rotation and motion/environment sensors (gRPC `setPhysicalModel`,
//! `setSensor`).

use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, CommandSpec, parse_params};
use jidr_core::{JidrError, JidrResult};
use jidr_proto::control as pb;
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::{Value, json};

use crate::device::{grpc_err, target};

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RotateParams {
    pub device: String,
    /// Device rotation in degrees: 0, 90, 180 or 270 (counter-clockwise).
    pub angle: u16,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum Sensor {
    Acceleration,
    Gyroscope,
    MagneticField,
    Temperature,
    Proximity,
    Light,
    Pressure,
    Humidity,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SensorParams {
    pub device: String,
    pub sensor: Sensor,
    /// Values in the sensor's units (3 for vectors, 1 for scalars).
    pub values: Vec<f32>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GetSensorParams {
    pub device: String,
    pub sensor: Sensor,
}

pub fn specs() -> Vec<CommandSpec> {
    vec![
        CommandSpec::new::<RotateParams>("sensor.rotate", "Rotate the device (0, 90, 180, 270°)"),
        CommandSpec::new::<SensorParams>("sensor.set", "Set a motion or environment sensor value"),
        CommandSpec::new::<GetSensorParams>("sensor.get", "Read a sensor value"),
    ]
}

/// Environment sensors go through the physical model (the emulator derives
/// the sensor from it); motion sensors are overridden directly.
enum Route {
    Physical(pb::physical_model_value::PhysicalType),
    Sensor(pb::sensor_value::SensorType),
}

fn route(s: Sensor) -> Route {
    use pb::physical_model_value::PhysicalType as P;
    use pb::sensor_value::SensorType as S;
    match s {
        Sensor::Acceleration => Route::Sensor(S::Acceleration),
        Sensor::Gyroscope => Route::Sensor(S::Gyroscope),
        Sensor::MagneticField => Route::Physical(P::MagneticField),
        Sensor::Temperature => Route::Physical(P::Temperature),
        Sensor::Proximity => Route::Physical(P::Proximity),
        Sensor::Light => Route::Physical(P::Light),
        Sensor::Pressure => Route::Physical(P::Pressure),
        Sensor::Humidity => Route::Physical(P::Humidity),
    }
}

fn expected_len(s: Sensor) -> usize {
    match s {
        Sensor::Acceleration | Sensor::Gyroscope | Sensor::MagneticField => 3,
        _ => 1,
    }
}

pub fn check_angle(a: u16) -> JidrResult<f32> {
    match a {
        0 | 90 | 180 | 270 => Ok(f32::from(a)),
        _ => Err(JidrError::usage("angle must be 0, 90, 180 or 270")),
    }
}

pub async fn call(ctx: &CallCtx, method: &str, params: Value) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    match method {
        "sensor.rotate" => {
            let p: RotateParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let z = check_angle(p.angle)?;
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            t.grpc()
                .await?
                .set_physical_model(pb::PhysicalModelValue {
                    target: pb::physical_model_value::PhysicalType::Rotation as i32,
                    value: Some(pb::ParameterValue {
                        data: vec![0.0, 0.0, z],
                    }),
                    ..Default::default()
                })
                .await
                .map_err(grpc_err("setPhysicalModel"))?;
            Ok(json!({ "angle": p.angle }))
        }
        "sensor.set" => {
            let p: SensorParams = parse_params(params)?;
            if p.values.len() != expected_len(p.sensor) {
                return Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
                    "{:?} takes {} value(s)",
                    p.sensor,
                    expected_len(p.sensor)
                )));
            }
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let mut c = t.grpc().await?;
            let value = Some(pb::ParameterValue {
                data: p.values.clone(),
            });
            match route(p.sensor) {
                Route::Physical(target) => c
                    .set_physical_model(pb::PhysicalModelValue {
                        target: target as i32,
                        value,
                        ..Default::default()
                    })
                    .await
                    .map_err(grpc_err("setPhysicalModel"))?,
                Route::Sensor(target) => c
                    .set_sensor(pb::SensorValue {
                        target: target as i32,
                        value,
                        ..Default::default()
                    })
                    .await
                    .map_err(grpc_err("setSensor"))?,
            };
            Ok(json!({ "sensor": p.sensor, "values": p.values }))
        }
        "sensor.get" => {
            let p: GetSensorParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let mut c = t.grpc().await?;
            let data = match route(p.sensor) {
                Route::Physical(target) => {
                    c.get_physical_model(pb::PhysicalModelValue {
                        target: target as i32,
                        ..Default::default()
                    })
                    .await
                    .map_err(grpc_err("getPhysicalModel"))?
                    .into_inner()
                    .value
                }
                Route::Sensor(target) => {
                    c.get_sensor(pb::SensorValue {
                        target: target as i32,
                        ..Default::default()
                    })
                    .await
                    .map_err(grpc_err("getSensor"))?
                    .into_inner()
                    .value
                }
            };
            Ok(json!({ "sensor": p.sensor, "values": data.map(|d| d.data).unwrap_or_default() }))
        }
        _ => Err(JidrError::usage(format!("unknown method {method}"))),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn angles_and_value_counts_are_checked() {
        assert_eq!(check_angle(90).unwrap(), 90.0);
        assert!(check_angle(45).is_err());
        assert_eq!(expected_len(Sensor::Acceleration), 3);
        assert_eq!(expected_len(Sensor::Light), 1);
    }
}
```

`crates/jidr-widgets/src/snapshots.rs`:

```rs
//! Snapshot manager (Phase 10b): the emulator's `SnapshotService` plus a
//! root-mode tag per snapshot, kept in `<avd>/jidr/snapshots.json`. A
//! snapshot taken under one root mode is refused under another (D29).
//!
//! Jidr picks the on-disk id itself ([`snapshot_id`]): emulator builds differ
//! in how they store names with spaces, so the name the user typed is kept as
//! the tag's `label`.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use jidr_core::provider::{CallCtx, CommandSpec, DeviceParams, parse_params};
use jidr_core::{Device, DeviceStatus, JidrError, JidrResult, RootMode};
use jidr_proto::control as pb;
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::{Value, json};

use crate::device::{grpc_err, target};

/// The emulator's own quick-boot snapshot (D29), saved on every stop.
pub const QUICK_BOOT: &str = "default_boot";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Tag {
    /// The name as typed, when it differs from the id.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub label: Option<String>,
    pub root_mode: RootMode,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub magisk_version: Option<String>,
    pub created_at: DateTime<Utc>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct NameParams {
    pub device: String,
    /// Snapshot name.
    pub name: String,
}

pub fn specs() -> Vec<CommandSpec> {
    vec![
        CommandSpec::new::<DeviceParams>(
            "snapshot.list",
            "Snapshots with their root-mode tags, sizes and thumbnails",
        ),
        CommandSpec::new::<NameParams>("snapshot.save", "Save a snapshot of a running device")
            .long_running()
            .locks_device(),
        CommandSpec::new::<NameParams>(
            "snapshot.load",
            "Restore a snapshot (refused when it was taken under another root mode)",
        )
        .long_running()
        .locks_device(),
        CommandSpec::new::<NameParams>("snapshot.delete", "Delete a snapshot")
            .destructive()
            .locks_device(),
    ]
}

fn avd_dir(ctx: &CallCtx, d: &Device) -> PathBuf {
    ctx.daemon.paths().avd_home().join(format!("{}.avd", d.avd))
}

fn tags_path(avd: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    avd.join("jidr").join("snapshots.json")
}

pub fn read_tags(avd: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Tag> {
    std::fs::read_to_string(tags_path(avd))
        .ok()
        .and_then(|t| serde_json::from_str(&t).ok())
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

fn write_tags(avd: &Path, tags: &BTreeMap<String, Tag>) -> JidrResult<()> {
    let path = tags_path(avd);
    if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)
            .map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(format!("{}: {e}", dir.display())))?;
    }
    let tmp = path.with_extension("json.tmp");
    let text =
        serde_json::to_string_pretty(tags).map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(e.to_string()))?;
    std::fs::write(&tmp, text)
        .and_then(|()| std::fs::rename(&tmp, &path))
        .map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(format!("{}: {e}", path.display())))
}

/// Names users may give: no path separators or control characters.
pub fn check_name(n: &str) -> JidrResult<&str> {
    let n = n.trim();
    if n.is_empty()
        || n.len() > 100
        || n.contains(['/', '\\', ':'])
        || n.chars().any(char::is_control)
        || n.starts_with('.')
    {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(format!("not a snapshot name: {n:?}")));
    }
    if n == QUICK_BOOT {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(
            "default_boot is the quick-boot snapshot; pick another name",
        ));
    }
    Ok(n)
}

/// The snapshot's folder name: ASCII letters, digits, `-`, `.` and `_` stay
/// (but never a leading `.`), other ASCII becomes `_`, and other characters
/// become `x<hex>` so names in other scripts stay distinct.
pub fn snapshot_id(name: &str) -> String {
    let mut id = String::with_capacity(name.len());
    for c in name.chars() {
        if c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(c, '-' | '_') || (c == '.' && !id.is_empty()) {
            id.push(c);
        } else if c.is_ascii() {
            id.push('_');
        } else {
            id.push_str(&format!("x{:x}", u32::from(c)));
        }
    }
    id
}

/// An id that is one plain folder name inside `<avd>/snapshots`: not empty,
/// no separators, no leading `.` (so never `.` or `..`).
pub fn check_id(id: &str) -> JidrResult<&str> {
    let mut parts = Path::new(id).components();
    let plain =
        matches!(parts.next(), Some(std::path::Component::Normal(_))) && parts.next().is_none();
    if !plain
        || id.len() > 255
        || id.starts_with('.')
        || id.contains(['/', '\\'])
        || id.chars().any(char::is_control)
    {
        return Err(JidrError::usage(format!("not a snapshot: {id:?}")));
    }
    Ok(id)
}

/// The id to save `name` under: [`snapshot_id`], with `-2`, `-3`… when
/// another snapshot already holds that id. Saving the same name again
/// replaces it.
fn free_id(avd: &Path, tags: &BTreeMap<String, Tag>, name: &str) -> String {
    let base = snapshot_id(name);
    let mut id = base.clone();
    for n in 2.. {
        let taken = match tags.get(&id) {
            Some(t) => t.label.as_deref().unwrap_or(&id) != name,
            None => id != name && avd.join("snapshots").join(&id).is_dir(),
        };
        if !taken {
            break;
        }
        id = format!("{base}-{n}");
    }
    id
}

/// The id of the snapshot a user or client named: a tag's label, an existing
/// folder, or the id Jidr would give that name. Always passes [`check_id`].
pub fn resolve(avd: &Path, tags: &BTreeMap<String, Tag>, name: &str) -> JidrResult<String> {
    let name = name.trim();
    let id = if let Some((id, _)) = tags.iter().find(|(_, t)| t.label.as_deref() == Some(name)) {
        id.clone()
    } else if check_id(name).is_ok() && avd.join("snapshots").join(name).is_dir() {
        name.to_string()
    } else {
        snapshot_id(name)
    };
    check_id(&id)?;
    Ok(id)
}

/// `<avd>/snapshots/<id>`, refusing anything that isn't one plain folder name.
fn snapshot_dir(avd: &Path, id: &str) -> JidrResult<PathBuf> {
    Ok(avd.join("snapshots").join(check_id(id)?))
}

/// D29: may this snapshot be restored on a device in `mode`? Untagged
/// snapshots (made outside Jidr) and the quick-boot one restore as usual.
pub fn check_root(name: &str, tag: Option<&Tag>, mode: RootMode) -> JidrResult<()> {
    match tag {
        Some(t) if t.root_mode != mode => Err(JidrError::usage(format!(
            "“{name}” was taken with {} and the device is {} now; set the root mode back first",
            mode_name(t.root_mode),
            mode_name(mode)
        ))
        .with_data(json!({ "refused": "root_mode", "snapshot_root_mode": t.root_mode, "device_root_mode": mode }))),
        _ => Ok(()),
    }
}

pub fn mode_name(m: RootMode) -> &'static str {
    match m {
        RootMode::None => "Not rooted",
        RootMode::Adb => "Shell root",
        RootMode::Magisk => "Full root",
    }
}

fn dir_size(dir: &Path) -> u64 {
    std::fs::read_dir(dir)
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .filter_map(Result::ok)
        .map(|e| match e.file_type() {
            Ok(t) if t.is_dir() => dir_size(&e.path()),
            Ok(_) => e.metadata().map(|m| m.len()).unwrap_or(0),
            Err(_) => 0,
        })
        .sum()
}

/// A snapshot folder: name, size, created, thumbnail.
type DiskSnapshot = (String, u64, Option<DateTime<Utc>>, Option<PathBuf>);

/// Snapshots on disk: `<avd>/snapshots/<name>/` (works while stopped).
fn on_disk(avd: &Path) -> Vec<DiskSnapshot> {
    let dir = avd.join("snapshots");
    let mut v: Vec<_> = std::fs::read_dir(&dir)
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .filter_map(Result::ok)
        .filter(|e| e.file_type().is_ok_and(|t| t.is_dir()))
        .map(|e| {
            let p = e.path();
            let name = e.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
            let created = std::fs::metadata(p.join("snapshot.pb"))
                .and_then(|m| m.modified())
                .ok()
                .map(DateTime::<Utc>::from);
            let thumb = Some(p.join("screenshot.png")).filter(|t| t.is_file());
            (name, dir_size(&p), created, thumb)
        })
        .collect();
    v.sort_by_key(|s| s.2);
    v
}

fn failed(what: &str, pkg: &pb::SnapshotPackage) -> JidrResult<()> {
    if pkg.success {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(JidrError::sdk(format!(
            "{what}: {}",
            String::from_utf8_lossy(&pkg.err).trim()
        )))
    }
}

pub async fn call(ctx: &CallCtx, method: &str, params: Value) -> JidrResult<Value> {
    match method {
        "snapshot.list" => {
            let p: DeviceParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let d = ctx.daemon.device(&p.device).await?;
            let avd = avd_dir(ctx, &d);
            let tags = read_tags(&avd);
            let list: Vec<Value> = on_disk(&avd)
                .into_iter()
                .map(|(id, size, created, thumb)| {
                    let tag = tags.get(&id);
                    let name = tag
                        .and_then(|t| t.label.clone())
                        .unwrap_or_else(|| id.clone());
                    json!({
                        "name": name,
                        "id": id,
                        "quick_boot": id == QUICK_BOOT,
                        "root_mode": tag.map(|t| t.root_mode),
                        "magisk_version": tag.and_then(|t| t.magisk_version.clone()),
                        "created_at": tag.map(|t| t.created_at).or(created),
                        "size_bytes": size,
                        "thumbnail": thumb,
                        "restorable": check_root(&name, tag, d.root.mode).is_ok(),
                    })
                })
                .collect();
            Ok(json!({ "device_root_mode": d.root.mode, "snapshots": list }))
        }
        "snapshot.save" => {
            let p: NameParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let name = check_name(&p.name)?.to_string();
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            let avd = avd_dir(ctx, &t.device);
            let mut tags = read_tags(&avd);
            let id = free_id(&avd, &tags, &name);
            check_id(&id)?;
            if id == QUICK_BOOT {
                return Err(JidrError::usage(
                    "default_boot is the quick-boot snapshot; pick another name",
                ));
            }
            ctx.report(None, "Saving memory and disk");
            let r = t
                .snapshots()
                .await?
                .save_snapshot(pb::SnapshotPackage {
                    snapshot_id: id.clone(),
                    ..Default::default()
                })
                .await
                .map_err(grpc_err("SaveSnapshot"))?
                .into_inner();
            failed("saving the snapshot", &r)?;
            tags.insert(
                id.clone(),
                Tag {
                    label: Some(name.clone()).filter(|n| *n != id),
                    root_mode: t.device.root.mode,
                    magisk_version: t.device.root.magisk_version.clone(),
                    created_at: Utc::now(),
                },
            );
            write_tags(&avd, &tags)?;
            Ok(json!({ "name": name, "id": id, "root_mode": t.device.root.mode }))
        }
        "snapshot.load" => {
            let p: NameParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let d = ctx.daemon.device(&p.device).await?;
            let avd = avd_dir(ctx, &d);
            let tags = read_tags(&avd);
            let id = resolve(&avd, &tags, &p.name)?;
            check_root(&p.name, tags.get(&id), d.root.mode)?;
            if !matches!(d.status, DeviceStatus::Running) {
                return Err(JidrError::not_found(format!(
                    "start {} to restore a snapshot",
                    d.name
                )));
            }
            let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
            ctx.report(None, "Restoring");
            let r = t
                .snapshots()
                .await?
                .load_snapshot(pb::SnapshotPackage {
                    snapshot_id: id,
                    ..Default::default()
                })
                .await
                .map_err(grpc_err("LoadSnapshot"))?
                .into_inner();
            failed("restoring the snapshot", &r)?;
            // The guest's adbd connection is stale after a restore: "restored"
            // means usable from the CLI, MCP and GUI.
            crate::device::wait_for_adb(
                ctx,
                &t,
                std::time::Duration::from_secs(60),
                "was restored",
            )
            .await?;
            Ok(json!({ "name": p.name }))
        }
        "snapshot.delete" => {
            let p: NameParams = parse_params(params)?;
            let d = ctx.daemon.device(&p.device).await?;
            let avd = avd_dir(ctx, &d);
            let mut tags = read_tags(&avd);
            let id = resolve(&avd, &tags, &p.name)?;
            if matches!(d.status, DeviceStatus::Running) {
                let t = target(ctx, &p.device).await?;
                let r = t
                    .snapshots()
                    .await?
                    .delete_snapshot(pb::SnapshotPackage {
                        snapshot_id: id.clone(),
                        ..Default::default()
                    })
                    .await
                    .map_err(grpc_err("DeleteSnapshot"))?
                    .into_inner();
                failed("deleting the snapshot", &r)?;
            } else {
                let dir = snapshot_dir(&avd, &id)?;
                if !dir.is_dir() {
                    return Err(JidrError::not_found(format!("no snapshot {:?}", p.name)));
                }
                std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir)
                    .map_err(|e| JidrError::unexpected(format!("{}: {e}", dir.display())))?;
            }
            if tags.remove(&id).is_some() {
                write_tags(&avd, &tags)?;
            }
            Ok(json!({ "deleted": p.name }))
        }
        _ => Err(JidrError::usage(format!("unknown method {method}"))),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn tag(m: RootMode) -> Tag {
        Tag {
            label: None,
            root_mode: m,
            magisk_version: None,
            created_at: Utc::now(),
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn cross_mode_restore_is_refused() {
        assert!(
            check_root(
                "Clean install",
                Some(&tag(RootMode::Magisk)),
                RootMode::Magisk
            )
            .is_ok()
        );
        let e = check_root(
            "Clean install",
            Some(&tag(RootMode::Magisk)),
            RootMode::None,
        )
        .unwrap_err();
        assert!(
            e.message.contains("Full root") && e.message.contains("Not rooted"),
            "{e}"
        );
        assert_eq!(e.data.unwrap()["refused"], "root_mode");
        assert!(check_root("old", None, RootMode::Adb).is_ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn names_are_checked() {
        assert!(check_name("Logged in test account").is_ok());
        for bad in ["", "a/b", "../x", ".hidden", "default_boot", "a\nb"] {
            assert!(check_name(bad).is_err(), "{bad:?}");
        }
    }

    /// Regression: the Linux emulator stored "Clean install" as
    /// `Clean_install`, so the tag keyed by the typed name went missing.
    #[test]
    fn ids_are_folder_safe_and_names_resolve_through_labels() {
        assert_eq!(snapshot_id("Clean install"), "Clean_install");
        assert_eq!(snapshot_id("v1.2-beta_3"), "v1.2-beta_3");
        assert_eq!(snapshot_id("لقطة"), "x644x642x637x629");
        assert_ne!(snapshot_id("لقطة"), snapshot_id("قطة"));
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        std::fs::create_dir_all(tmp.path().join("snapshots/made outside")).unwrap();
        let mut t = BTreeMap::new();
        t.insert(
            "Clean_install".to_string(),
            Tag {
                label: Some("Clean install".into()),
                ..tag(RootMode::None)
            },
        );
        let r = |n: &str| resolve(tmp.path(), &t, n).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r("Clean install"), "Clean_install");
        assert_eq!(r("made outside"), "made outside");
        assert_eq!(r("Logged in"), "Logged_in");
        assert_eq!(r("../x"), "_._x");

        // Saving the same name replaces it; a different name gets a suffix.
        assert_eq!(free_id(tmp.path(), &t, "Clean install"), "Clean_install");
        assert_eq!(free_id(tmp.path(), &t, "Clean_install"), "Clean_install-2");
        assert_eq!(free_id(tmp.path(), &t, "made outside"), "made_outside");
    }

    /// Regression (review of PR #3): `..` resolved to the id `..`, and
    /// `snapshot.delete` on a stopped device removed the whole AVD folder.
    #[test]
    fn names_never_reach_outside_the_snapshots_folder() {
        for n in ["..", ".", "...", ".hidden", "", "   "] {
            let id = snapshot_id(n.trim());
            assert!(!id.starts_with('.'), "{n:?} -> {id:?}");
        }
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let avd = tmp.path().join("dev.avd");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(avd.join("snapshots/keep")).unwrap();
        let tags = BTreeMap::new();
        for n in ["..", ".", "../..", "a/../..", "/etc", "\\x", ""] {
            if let Ok(id) = resolve(&avd, &tags, n) {
                let dir = snapshot_dir(&avd, &id).unwrap();
                assert_eq!(dir.parent(), Some(avd.join("snapshots").as_path()), "{n:?}");
                assert!(
                    !id.starts_with('.') && !id.contains(['/', '\\']),
                    "{n:?} -> {id:?}"
                );
            }
        }
        assert!(resolve(&avd, &tags, "").is_err());
        for id in ["..", ".", "", "a/b", "a\\b", "/abs", ".x"] {
            assert!(snapshot_dir(&avd, id).is_err(), "{id:?}");
        }
        // A tag can't smuggle a bad id in either.
        let mut evil = BTreeMap::new();
        evil.insert(
            "..".to_string(),
            Tag {
                label: Some("Evil".into()),
                ..tag(RootMode::None)
            },
        );
        assert!(resolve(&avd, &evil, "Evil").is_err());
        assert!(avd.join("snapshots/keep").is_dir());
    }

    #[test]
    fn tags_round_trip() {
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let mut t = BTreeMap::new();
        t.insert("Clean install".to_string(), tag(RootMode::Adb));
        write_tags(tmp.path(), &t).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(read_tags(tmp.path()), t);
    }
}
```
